title: LBW: Love Beyond Wicket
summary: LBW: Love Beyond Wicket is a 2026 Indian Tamil-language coming-of-age sports drama television series written by Aruna Rakhee, directed by Ganesh Karthikeyan, and starring Vikranth, Niyathi Kadambi, Harish, Daffe Naveen, Gundu Karthik, Sindhu Shyam, Smruthi Mohankumar and Ayaz Khan. The series' story is based on Cricket coach Rangan and his students. The show premiered on JioHotstar on 1 January 2026 and ended with 120 episodes on 23 July 2026.
plot: This series follows a failed cricket player turned coach for the Muthu Nagar Cricket Academy team (Rangan). Rangan's journey along with students at the struggling academy, who unite to preserve a legacy while finding their own paths, forms the main plotline.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text:
The series was announced by JioHotstar under the banner of South UnBound on 9 December 2025. The platform plans to launch nine new original shows in Tamil language. This series was created as the first series of the Hotstar Specials lineup in 2026.
The series is directed by Ganesh Karthikeyan, written by Aruna Rakhee and producer by A Tele Factory, who previously produced Chinna Thambi, Eeramana Rojave 2 and Heart Beat.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Actor Vikranth play the a Cricket coach Rangan. This is his debut role in a limited series, alongside Akshatha, Daffe Naveen, Niyathi Kadambi, Harish, Sindhu Shyam and Ayaz Khan.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: The first trailer was released under the banner of South UnBound on 9 December 2025. The first promo was released on 17 December 2025 and revealed the releasing date. On 22 December 2025, was releasing the series song. The series was released on 1 January 2026 in Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada, Hindi, Marathi and Bengali.

episodesList.title: First Innings
episodesList.summary: Rangan, once a celebrated cricket hero, is now working as a PT instructor. Rukmani, the head of MNCA, hopes that new batch of players will help restore the academy’s legacy.

episodesList.title: Campus Oath
episodesList.summary: The juniors take a tour of the academy. Coach Natraj warns to adhere to discipline when the boys’ team returns from a disqualified match. Hostel nights reveal ragging antics.

episodesList.title: Morning Runs
episodesList.summary: Coaches Natraj and Selvam test the players' diving skills and patience after they face Rukmani’s fury for being late. Rukmani battles threats that could shut the academy forever.

episodesList.title: Ghost Practice
episodesList.summary: Falling for the seniors’ ghost tale, the juniors dare each other to pre-dawn practice. Rishi impresses at the nets, making Velu jealous. Mani, Thangam and Theo’s bond gets strong.

episodesList.title: Dream Wakeup
episodesList.summary: Rukmani faces the MNCA’s sponsors who warn about Matheyan’s uncontrolled anger. A fight in the canteen creates cracks between the juniors and seniors. Mani dreams about Thangam.

episodesList.title: Footwork and Footwear
episodesList.summary: Matheyan and Jackie help Mani make a video to impress his dad and get money to buy shoes for Thangam. An astrologer predicts that someone from Rangan’s past will reenter his life.

episodesList.title: Hidden Torture
episodesList.summary: Seniors turn training into bullying, masked as combined drills, leaving Veera terrified. Thangam’s breakthrough in bowling is hidden by strong family pressure to get married.

episodesList.title: Revenge Storm
episodesList.summary: Veera’s gangster father storms MNCA over ragging, forcing Rukmani into a public apology. Rajasekar’s inspection ends with a brutal shutdown threat, and he now vows revenge.

episodesList.title: Mani’s Mission
episodesList.summary: Mani confronts Rukmani about the academy shutting down. Rukmani exposes Rajasekar’s drug expulsion past. Thangam and Rishi worry about their parents’ decision about the academy.

episodesList.title: Pair Up Pressure
episodesList.summary: Theo and Matheyan form senior-junior training pairs. Rangan takes Mani to spy on Anchor Cricket Academy’s high-tech facilities. A kitchen disaster brings Rishi and Thangam closer.

episodesList.title: Hidden Feelings
episodesList.summary: Rukmani is shaken by Rajasekar’s threats. Preparations for the 50th-year alumni gala begin. Mani hides his feelings for Thangam while Rukmani sets to train young Valli in cricket.

episodesList.title: Breaking Point
episodesList.summary: Rangan is shocked to see Thangam’s photo among his marriage proposals. Thangam’s growing discomfort around Rangan leads to accusations and outrage and everyone turns against him.

episodesList.title: Mistakes and Misfires
episodesList.summary: Shattered by Rukmani's mistrust, Rangan nearly quits cricket, but his aunt persuades him to return only to face cold stares. Rukmani later apologises for overreacting.

episodesList.title: Golden Jubilee Begins
episodesList.summary: As the event unfolds, excitement masks rising tensions. Mani lifts Thangam's spirits. Velu's bid to rejoin the team backfires, leading to a clash that Theo halts.

episodesList.title: Shadows of the Past
episodesList.summary: Thulasi's speech revives a painful past tied to Rangan. Shaken by the memories, Rangan retreats. Rukmani finds him and together they step forward to face Thulasi and the truth.

episodesList.title: Rangan’s Return
episodesList.summary: Rukmani firmly shuts Rajasekar down. A tense match sees Velu steady the students until Rangan joins and turns it around. The alumni win, but the academy begins to heal.

episodesList.title: Unspoken Wounds
episodesList.summary: As alumni celebrate Rangan's return, Thangam seethes in silence. Amid cricket talks with the management, Rangan mentions players now battle inner struggles more than the game.

episodesList.title: The Weight of the Past
episodesList.summary: Flashbacks reveal Rangan's fall, a former Ranji captain silenced for opposing injustice. Thulasi introduces a new MNCA scheme. Rangan and Thulasi silently acknowledge their past.

episodesList.title: Lines of Trust
episodesList.summary: When allegations arise against Rangan, Thulasi ensures fairness. Thangam bravely reveals her fear came from family pressure, while Rangan maintains a calm demeanour in response.

episodesList.title: Open Challenge
episodesList.summary: Thangam defends Rangan, while others oppose him. Thulasi and Rukmani plan to save the academy. A cricket match brings peace until Girish and Matheyan ignite a rivalry.

episodesList.title: Cracks in Between
episodesList.summary: Unresolved tension leads to emotional fallout as Mani's jealousy erupts publicly. Meanwhile, Thulasi and Rangan find unexpected comfort in cricket, uncovering past truths.

episodesList.title: Inner Battle
episodesList.summary: Thangam tries to reconcile the differences between Rishi and the boys’ team, but they refuse to heed her words. Meanwhile, Rishi contemplates transferring to another school.

episodesList.title: Unstable Ground
episodesList.summary: Selvam's dismissal plunges the academy into chaos, with Natraj managing both teams. Meanwhile, Rukmani and Rangan uncover sexism and ego during the replacement search.

episodesList.title: Crossing the Boundary
episodesList.summary: What starts as a bold underground match quickly descends into open conflict, leading to chaos and violence. Rangan arrives just in time to prevent history from repeating itself.

episodesList.title: Anger Beneath Bruises
episodesList.summary: Girish fails to threaten Rangan. Rishi doubts himself as Girish provokes him. Rangan hides the injured boys from Ms. Rukmani. Jackie blames Rishi, but the juniors defend him.

episodesList.title: Damage Control
episodesList.summary: The girls hide the boy's wounds, but tension grows when Rukmani sees Rishi bruised. Rangan protects the team despite suspicion. Away from the academy, Rangan confides in Thulasi.

episodesList.title: Dreams, Doubts and a Blowback
episodesList.summary: A counselling session uncovers the dreams of the students as well as Rishi’s feelings. Motivated by Thulasi, Rangan offers support to the students and gains Rukmani’s trust.

episodesList.title: They Are My Team
episodesList.summary: Rangan defends his students against misleading police evidence. Theo’s video unveils the truth, yet the damage persists. Natraj storms out in anger, and Rukmini distrusts Rangan.

episodesList.title: Fault Lines
episodesList.summary: Rangan officially steps in as the coach, but Padma openly rejects him. Natraj’s harsh words humiliate Mani targeting his friendship with Theo. Mani discovers scars on Rishi’s hand.

episodesList.title: Pressure Points
episodesList.summary: Girish faces Rajasekar’s anger over fake evidence. Thulasi encourages Rangan. While Thangam thinks Mani is in love with Theo, Vinay confronts Rukmani over Rishi’s safety.

episodesList.title: Hidden Battles
episodesList.summary: Mani fakes illness to escape the academy ground. He learns about Rishi's hidden struggles and his reluctance toward an acting career imposed by his dad. A bond forms between them.

episodesList.title: Midnight Panic and Confessions
episodesList.summary: Thangam, Matheyan and others search desperately for Mani as he lies drunk on Rishi’s terrace. Next day, on the ground, Mani explodes, confessing his love for a stunned Thangam.

episodesList.title: Shifts and Challenges
episodesList.summary: Mani feels anxious remembering his argument with Thangam. Rishi faces his dad’s pressure to leave cricket. Rangam changes the batting order, facing the wrath of Padma.

episodesList.title: Voices Under Noise
episodesList.summary: Theo turns to Matheyan for advice with the girls’ team. At the nets, Rangan’s intense drills test focus and adaptability. Theo calmly guides Padma. Rishi confesses his fear.

episodesList.title: Silent Drift
episodesList.summary: Thangam worries about her growing feelings for Mani. Rangan seeks Rukmani’s approval for new players. Rishi confides in her about his dad’s plan. Theo and Matheyan share a moment.

episodesList.title: One Last Chance
episodesList.summary: Seeing Valli secretly practicing, Rangan recognises her natural reflexes and determination. Mani pleads with Vinay to give Rishi one chance. Thangam decides to stay away from Mani.

episodesList.title: Closed Gates
episodesList.summary: When Rukmani and the principal can't help Rangan to have Valli join the girls’ team, he contacts Thulasi. While Rishi pushes Mani to focus on cricket, the girls doubt Theo’s moves.

episodesList.title: Unsaid Feelings
episodesList.summary: Thulasi proposes a scheme to Rangan to legitimise Valli’s entry into the team. Rishi trains Mani. Theo and Matheyan sneak out to celebrate his birthday and confess their feelings.

episodesList.title: Surface Fractures
episodesList.summary: During a midnight ride, Theo and Matheyan nearly hit a drunken woman. Later, Rangan introduces Valli to the girls' team, which provokes resistance from most of the team members.

episodesList.title: Shifting Bonds
episodesList.summary: Padma suspects Valli manipulated her way onto the team, but Rangan supports her. Later, Rishi guides Mani through each ball in a practice match.

episodesList.title: Gossip and Revelations
episodesList.summary: Valli endures harsh mockery regarding her background, which also impacts her father. Although she contemplates quitting, Rangan refuses to allow her to give up.

episodesList.title: Confessions
episodesList.summary: Natraj reveals the final lineup and surprises the boys with a celebratory meal. As unity grows, Matheyan confides in Theo about Natraj’s emotionally charged coaching style.

episodesList.title: Unsteady Minds
episodesList.summary: Thangam tells Rangan about Valli's poor practice. Theo and Mani have a disagreement from misunderstandings about their friendship, while Thangam remains unfocused during the match.

episodesList.title: Choices Left Unspoken
episodesList.summary: Thangam, confused by her emotions, explores love online and eventually opens up to Theo. Meanwhile, Mani decides the best way to cope with his intense feelings is to bury them.

episodesList.title: Terrace Party
episodesList.summary: Mani tells everyone he moved on from love to friendship with Thangam. He tricks everyone, including Varsha, into attending a party by falsely stating that it is Rishi's birthday.

episodesList.title: Viral Turn
episodesList.summary: The boys struggle in practice after the party and Nataraj punishes them. To showcase Valli's talent, Rangan records her and posts a social media clip that quickly gains attention.

episodesList.title: Rising Tensions
episodesList.summary: News of an NRI-funded fellowship by Dhoorai sparks rivalry in the academy. The girls tease Rangan about Thulasi, while Rukmani hints she knows about them, making Thulasi shy away.

episodesList.title: Night Unravels
episodesList.summary: Shaken after the practice match, Rishi battles anxiety triggered by Nataraj. Rangan's first visit to Thulasi's house turns tense during an unexpected talk with her grandfather.

episodesList.title: Unseen War
episodesList.summary: Rangan and Thulasi spend time together and she talks about her life with Rajeev. Natraj vows payback after a drunk Rishi attacks his house and hurts him.

episodesList.title: Silent Pressure
episodesList.summary: Rajasekar realises the flaw in his academy. While Natraj targets Rishi, Padma’s selfish gameplay creates cracks in the team. Mani meets Thangam’s parents and wins their trust.

episodesList.title: Sudden Arrival
episodesList.summary: Rishi is shaken by the harsh realities of class divide between students. Rangan’s bold call on field leaves Padma shaken. Matheyan panics when his mother arrives at the academy.

episodesList.title: Facing Nightmare
episodesList.summary: Seeing his drunk mother, Matheyan fears his nightmare may come true. While Theo becomes his anchor, Rangan confronts Natraj and declares that he will stand as Matheyan’s guardian

episodesList.title: Tournament Heat
episodesList.summary: At an event, Rangan's return is celebrated, but Natraj becomes increasingly insecure. Later, Matheyan feels shattered when Natraj publicly removes him as team captain.

episodesList.title: Beginning of the Battle
episodesList.summary: On the field, MNCA starts strong, but Natraj’s provocation hurts Matheyan. MNCA faces a crushing defeat. Rangan helps Matheyan confront his pain. Rukmani faces Rajasekar’s taunts

episodesList.title: Fear to Fire
episodesList.summary: Padma discourages the girls, but Theo shuts her down. MNCA's nerves show early. Despite doubts, Rangan shifts focus to strategy, backing his bowlers and trusting their instincts.

episodesList.title: Falling Apart
episodesList.summary: Velu ignores Matheyan’s suggestion. Rishi chooses to fight his battle. Rukmani confronts Natraj for benching Rishi, his poor decisions and rigid leadership that cost MNCA heavily.

episodesList.title: Narrow Loss
episodesList.summary: As pressure builds before a crucial game, the MNCA boys struggle while the girls deliver a win. Rukmani intervenes in Natraj's decisions, restoring team balance but angering him.

episodesList.title: Momentum Shift
episodesList.summary: Just when the boys think their journey is over, Rangan shows Matheyan a slim chance to qualify. Matheyan then reshapes the batting order, despite Natraj's resistance.

episodesList.title: Silent Sabotage
episodesList.summary: As the MNCA boys' hopes rest on Anchor's results, Girish plays a calculated game, benching his main players. Meanwhile, in the girls' camp, Padma returns with a change of heart.

episodesList.title: Against the Odds
episodesList.summary: Natraj loses his authority and vents his frustrations on the team. He humiliates Matheyan, leading Rukmani to dismiss him. Rangan steps in to assist them.

episodesList.title: Interrupted Moments
episodesList.summary: During a group photo, Theo spots Rangan and Thulasi holding hands. Rishi’s father is happy with his success. Rangan and Thulasi share a moment, but Rukmani’s call interrupts them.

episodesList.title: Rukmani's Treat
episodesList.summary: Rukmani takes the teams for a celebratory dinner. While Rishi flirts with Varsha, Theo exposes Rangan’s secret. As Thangam tries to confess to Mani, a message from Anu stuns all.

episodesList.title: Rumours and Rivalries
episodesList.summary: With no coach for the boys' team, debates over Natraj and Rangan spark clashes. Meanwhile, Thangam grows jealous of Mani's date, with Rishi and Theo secretly stirring trouble.

episodesList.title: Shift in Bonds
episodesList.summary: Rumours swirl about Rangan and Thulasi, leaving them unsettled. Mani's approaching date fuels Thangam's restlessness, pushing her to finally confess her love.

episodesList.title: Awkward Beginnings
episodesList.summary: The boys learn of Thangam's confession to Mani and spread it across the academy. Mani struggles to cope with the news. Meanwhile, Rangan and Thulasi hesitate to text each other.

episodesList.title: Date Plan
episodesList.summary: Matheyan devises a plan to ease Mani's and Thangam's awkwardness. Meanwhile, on the field, Padma's growing isolation leads to emotional outbursts.

episodesList.title: Unsteady Hearts
episodesList.summary: Padma’s sudden move to Anchor shocks the MNCA team, and they feel betrayed. Rangan’s reunion with Dharani helps him release past guilt. Thulasi worries about Rajeev’s threats.

episodesList.title: Triple Date
episodesList.summary: The triple date begins with excitement for Rishi, Varsha, Mani, Thangam, Theo, and Matheyan. Each relationship finds its rhythm, turning unspoken emotions into something real.

episodesList.title: Love and Leverage
episodesList.summary: Rangan helps Matheyan to strengthen their bond. While Padma faces isolation and backlash in her new environment, a viral post turns Thulasi and Rangan’s lives into controversy.

episodesList.title: Silent Battles
episodesList.summary: Rishi asks Matheyan support Rangan through the ongoing controversy. Thulasi faces pressure from the media and her party. Padma begins to feel the emotional cost of her decision.

episodesList.title: Cracks Beneath the Calm
episodesList.summary: Rishi accepts calmly when Varsha decides to leave the academy. Rangan and Rukmani realise Rajasekar is behind the rumours. While Thulasi faces pressure, Girish targets Matheyan.

episodesList.title: Lines Crossed
episodesList.summary: Rajiv’s video as Thulasi’s supportive husband gains sympathy. Matheyan confronts Girish for targeting his mother, while Rangan faces Rajasekhar and declares his stand for Thulasi.

episodesList.title: New Year Break
episodesList.summary: Matheyan struggles with his feelings about his mother. Rukmani calmly manages tensions, advising Rangan. She announces a New Year break to help everyone regain clarity and reset.

episodesList.title: Holiday Begins
episodesList.summary: Love finds room to grow for Mani and Thangam during the break. Theo brings a nervous Matheyan to her home and introduces him to her parents.

episodesList.title: Love Under Pressure
episodesList.summary: Thangam lies to her mother and leaves for Mani's house. At Theo's house, Matheyan faces parental inquisition about his parents, making him uncomfortable and Theo furious.

episodesList.title: Between Holding and Losing
episodesList.summary: Matheyan's deep fear of rejection surfaces during a tense exchange with Theo, making her confront her parents. Thangam's mother realises she is hiding something and warns her.

episodesList.title: Strength and Silence
episodesList.summary: Despite Mani's concern and meddling, Matheyan and Theo struggle with their circumstances. Rangan introduces new training methods to the boys' team.

episodesList.title: The Counter Move
episodesList.summary: Baskar comes prepared with his complaints, but Thulasi is way ahead when she presents video proof. However, Rajasekar has another plan up his sleeve, thanks to Girish.

episodesList.title: Where Hearts Drift
episodesList.summary: Rangan anticipates Rajasekhar's move and has a plan prepared. Triggered by the Anchor boys, a casual game at the local ground turns unpleasant as pride curdles into insecurity.

episodesList.title: The Distance Between Us
episodesList.summary: A light-hearted moment spirals when Jackie takes offence to a casual remark. Rangan attempts to restore unity, but miscommunication and bruised egos continue to widen the rift.

episodesList.title: When Control Slips
episodesList.summary: Tensions explode as Matheyan hits Jackie in front of everyone, leaving both teams shaken. Matheyan later feels guilty, while Jackie is torn between anger and humiliation.

episodesList.title: Cracks Deepen
episodesList.summary: Burdened by team issues, Rangan finds clarity from Thulasi. He helps Matheyan face his family struggles and problems with Jackie, urging resolution over avoidance.

episodesList.title: What Still Matters
episodesList.summary: Thulasi and Rangan enjoy playful moments together in Chennai. Meanwhile, tensions rise among the boys at the academy despite the girls' efforts to help.

episodesList.title: Rangan's Challenge
episodesList.summary: Matheyan visits his mother at a bar, and she promises to quit drinking. At the academy, the seniors accuse Rangan of favouritism, and his challenge leaves him in shock.

episodesList.title: Healing and Breaking
episodesList.summary: Rangan reveals that the girls versus boys match is a strategy to push unity among boys. While Mani isolates himself, ignoring Thangam, Matheyan prepares his mother for rehab.

episodesList.title: Emotion vs Ego
episodesList.summary: Mani and Thangam try to outperform each other during practice. Hurt turns into determination when the girls realise the boys are looking down on them.

episodesList.title: Mind Over Momentum
episodesList.summary: The girls begin intense training to secure a victory over the boys. Meanwhile, the boys' team faces challenges due to changes and instability within the team.

episodesList.title: Deal with Divide
episodesList.summary: Amid the challenges faced by the boys' team and their ongoing conflict with the girls' team, Mani receives an offer from Velu. Will this proposal disrupt or resolve the conflict?

episodesList.title: The Cost of Pride
episodesList.summary: As the girls thrive on unity and leadership, the boys struggle to find common ground. Will teamwork triumph, or will the boys rise above their differences?

episodesList.title: Last Ball, Last Chance
episodesList.summary: The girls win against the odds, while the boys face the consequences of their mistakes. Mani and Thangam reconcile, but Thangam's possessiveness sparks tension with Anu.

episodesList.title: When Everything Falls Apart
episodesList.summary: Matheyan and Jackie put their differences aside and reunite, surprising everyone. Meanwhile, Anu's world is turned upside down by a sudden expulsion from Anchor Academy.

episodesList.title: Dreams or Duty?
episodesList.summary: Anu starts a new chapter at MNCA as Theo feels jealous about her arrival. Rishi makes the difficult decision to quit cricket to support his father through a financial crisis.

episodesList.title: Between Missing and Moving On
episodesList.summary: The academy struggles to move on after Rishi's departure. When exam dates are announced, cricket takes a backseat. Meanwhile, Thulasi heads into a crucial divorce hearing.

episodesList.title: When Silence Hurts
episodesList.summary: Exam pressure replaces cricket. The juniors desperately search for study notes and help. Thulasi's divorce hearing takes a major setback when Rajeev refuses a mutual separation.

episodesList.title: Preparation and Crisis
episodesList.summary: Velu orders the seniors to not help the juniors, but two of them ignore him. Rangan receives a golden opportunity, but the situation gets worse for his beloved MNCA and Rukmani.

episodesList.title: MNCA Under Threat
episodesList.summary: As Rangan hunts for sponsors, the MNCA crisis snowballs, leading to a meeting with the trustees. Anu and Jackie bond over physics, creating tension between Mani and Thangam.

episodesList.title: Renewed Hope
episodesList.summary: The exams finally arrive. Thangam receives good news, which becomes a welcome respite for the academy. Rukmani begins accepting MNCA's possible end, but Rangan stays hopeful.

episodesList.title: Costly Clash
episodesList.summary: Theo's parents visit her at the academy, but she misunderstands their intentions. While Rangan gives a tour to a potential investor, an unwelcome sight greets them.

episodesList.title: Love in Fragments
episodesList.summary: Matheyan rejoices as his mother slowly returns to her old self. At the advertisement shoot, Thangam and Girish grow closer, stirring jealousy in Mani.

episodesList.title: Weight of Staying
episodesList.summary: Anu steals the spotlight in a practice match, leaving Thangam jealous, especially as Mani cheers for her. Elsewhere, Rangan is shaken upon learning about the attack on Thulasi.

episodesList.title: Under Evaluation
episodesList.summary: Rangan spends a restless night, troubled by the unachievable condition he imposed on the Chennai club. Later, Matheyan is deeply unsettled by his mother's unexpected health scare.

episodesList.title: Before Impact
episodesList.summary: Rukmani shocks Rangan by deciding to sell MNCA's assets. Meanwhile, competition drives a wedge between Mani and Pandu, while Anu and Thangam clash openly on the field.

episodesList.title: Hearts Start to Align
episodesList.summary: As tensions build across the academy, personal bonds start affecting the game. Rangan reveals the funding deal with Chennai Club to Rukmani and later shares it with Thulasi.

episodesList.title: Shifting Equations
episodesList.summary: Thangam confronts Mani over his lies, straining their relationship. Kalyani collapses during practice and shocks Rangan by revealing that she is pregnant.

episodesList.title: Choice Within
episodesList.summary: As Kalyani faces an unexpected pregnancy and a life-changing choice, Rangan helps her find her answer. Meanwhile, growing selection pressure drives a wedge between Mani and Pandu.

episodesList.title: Shift in Play
episodesList.summary: Kalyani's absence leaves the girls' team struggling. Mani's growing insecurity over Girish drives a wedge between him and Thangam, hurting both their relationship and their game.

episodesList.title: Words That Hurt
episodesList.summary: As Kalyani's departure weighs heavily on Rangan, he lashes out at Thulasi. Her emotional distress quickly becomes the subject of discussion at her workplace.

episodesList.title: Practice, Pressure, Promises
episodesList.summary: Worried the academy is nearing its end, Matheyan plans a surprise proposal for Theo with Mani and Thangam's help. But Matheyan's bike crashes, leaving her with a knee injury.

episodesList.title: Parallel Hearts
episodesList.summary: After Matheyan's proposal, he and Theo revel in their new relationship, while Mani and Thangam fight. The academy travels to Chennai for its most significant challenge yet.

episodesList.title: One Team, Many Battles
episodesList.summary: Rangan mocks the team's low spirits, but Theo stands by them and tries to light up the mood. A stop at a Dhaba turns chaotic as a clash with Anchor Academy erupts into a fight.

episodesList.title: Her Birthday, His Forever
episodesList.summary: Mani and Thangam decide not to speak until the tournament ends. Rangan's birthday proposal plans for Thulasi take an unexpected turn after Rajeev humiliates them.

episodesList.title: Beyond the Game
episodesList.summary: Jackie uncovers MNCA's financial crisis and Rangan's secret sacrifice for the academy. Meanwhile, disaster strikes as Theo suffers a serious knee injury, ruling her out for weeks.

episodesList.title: Out of Sync
episodesList.summary: Anu's surprise captaincy takes a tense turn when a crucial call involving Thangam sparks misunderstandings between the two. Later, Rajasekhar's taunts rile up Rangan and Rukmani.

episodesList.title: Double Pressure
episodesList.summary: A sudden schedule shake-up catches the MNCA girl's off guard. Clashing egos and crumbling teamwork push the boys to the edge against Madurai Hawks.

episodesList.title: What Makes a Team
episodesList.summary: MNCA's internal conflict costs them another match, revealing Rangan's fierce side. Matheyan's and Rangan's guidance encourages the team to confront their egos and insecurities.

episodesList.title: Us vs Them
episodesList.summary: Rangan motivates the teams. With the chase collapsing, Matheyan delivers a breathtaking win and takes MNCA into the quarterfinals. Amid celebrations, Jackie gets devastating news.

episodesList.title: The Quarter-Final Storm
episodesList.summary: Mani and Thangam's relationship reaches a painful breaking point. The girls fight through a tense quarterfinal. On the boys' side, Mani's early exit intensifies the pressure.

episodesList.title: When Life Demands More
episodesList.summary: Theo receives clearance to rejoin the girls' team as captain. Disaster strikes when Jackie learns Matheyan's mother is in critical condition, forcing Matheyan to rush home.

episodesList.title: Unsaid Goodbyes
episodesList.summary: Just before the finals, Matheyan faces the darkest moment of his life. Although Rangan stands by him through this tough time, panic spreads when Matheyan suddenly goes missing.

episodesList.title: A Legacy Reborn
episodesList.summary: Despite Matheyan's disappearance, Rangan pushes the team forward, reminding them what's at stake. Meanwhile, Matheyan fulfils his late mother's last wish on her birthday.

title: Nadu Center
summary:
Nadu Center (transl. Mid Center) is a 2025 Indian Tamil-language coming-of-age sports drama television series created by Naru Narayanan and Mahaakerthi Aravindraj for JioHotstar. The series directed by Naru Narayanan and produced by Senthil Veeraasamy, Arabbhi Athreya and Avinaash Hariharan under the banner of Aqua Bulls Content.
It follows a story of teenage school students who are struggling to bloom in their lives and the challenges faced by the basketball club at their school. The series stars SK Surya, Sarah Black, Surya Sethupathi, Terance Patrick Evers, Mukesh MK, Dominic Donald, Yashwanth, Sahana Sundar, Madhu Vasanth, Arthi Ashwin, Kishore, Shivani Shukla, Asha Sharath, M. Sasikumar, Regena Cassandrra and Kalaiyarasan. It premiered on JioHotstar on 20 November 2025 and consists of 17 episodes.
plot: Pradeep Kadhirchelvan "PK" is a 17-year-old national-level basketball player expelled from an elite school for alleged misconduct. Transferred to a notorious institution plagued by violence and indiscipline, PK struggles to fit in until the vice principal sees in him the potential to lead change. Tasked with building a basketball team out of the school's most unruly students, PK begins an unexpected journey of leadership and self-discovery — fighting prejudice, earning trust, and reviving the school's lost pride.

title: The Ba***ds of Bollywood
summary:
The Ba***ds of Bollywood is an Indian Hindi-language satirical action comedy drama series created, co-written, and directed by Aryan Khan in his directorial debut for Netflix. Produced by Gauri Khan under Red Chillies Entertainment, it features Bobby Deol, Lakshya, Raghav Juyal, Sahher Bambba, Anya Singh, Manoj Pahwa, Manish Chaudhari, Rajat Bedi, Meherzan Mazda, Divik Sharma, Mona Singh, Gautami Kapoor, Vijayant Kohli, Neville Bharucha, and Armaan Khera.
The series follows Aasmaan Singh, an actor from Delhi, whose successful debut under producer Freddy Sodawallah leads to a role opposite Karishma Talvar in a film by Karan Johar. He faces challenges including Freddy’s multi-film contract, interference from Karishma’s father Ajay Talvar, a developing romance, and unforeseen complications. The series premiered on 18 September 2025 with seven episodes and received positive reviews, with critics highlighting Khan's direction, the story, screenplay, and performances.
plot: Aasmaan Singh is a young actor whose debut film, produced by the domineering Freddy Sodawallah, becomes a hit, earning him a role opposite Karishma Talvar in a new project directed by Karan Johar. Freddy’s insistence on an exclusive three-film contract threatens Aasmaan’s opportunity, pushing him, his manager Sanya, and friend Parvaiz to navigate Bollywood’s competitive landscape. As Aasmaan’s bond with Karishma grows, her father, veteran actor Ajay Talvar, disapproves and attempts to sabotage Aasmaan’s career, while personal and professional challenges, including public scandals and family pressures, test their ambitions in the unpredictable world of Bollywood.

episodesList.title: Meet the Ba***ds
episodesList.summary: Aasmaan Singh lives in Mumbai with his friend Parvaiz and uncle Avtaar Singh, a former playback singer. His debut film, produced by Freddy Sodawallah’s company, becomes a hit. Aasmaan’s parents, Rajat and Neeta Singh, visit from Delhi to celebrate. At a party, Aasmaan meets actor Ajay Talvar. His manager, Sanya Ahmed, pitches him to Karan Johar for a film role, but Freddy pressures Aasmaan into signing a three-film deal. At a roundtable conference hosted by Sanjeev, Aasmaan insults Karishma Talvar, Ajay’s daughter, for her industry connections, causing tension with Ajay. Impressed by Aasmaan’s boldness, Karan offers him the role.

episodesList.title: Movie Mafia
episodesList.summary: Aasmaan, Sanya, and Parvaiz meet Freddy and encounter Jaraj Saxena, who has been sidelined for 15 years after signing with another producer. Freddy initially supports Aasmaan’s work with Karan but later urges him to cancel. At Dharma Productions, Aasmaan learns Karishma is the female lead and apologises for his earlier remarks, but a reporter’s comment sparks a scene. Aasmaan signs a commercial to fund his father Rajat’s liver transplant. Rajat advises him to stay resilient. Ajay disapproves of Aasmaan’s casting opposite Karishma. When Freddy pressures Aasmaan to abandon Karan’s project, Aasmaan cancels the three-film deal and leaves.

episodesList.title: Barbaad Mohabbat
episodesList.summary: Aasmaan, Parvaiz, Sanya, Karishma, and her bodyguard Sukhi travel to Goa to rehearse intimate scenes. The intimacy coach is replaced by Emraan Hashmi, who struggles to train them. Ajay monitors Karishma through Sukhi. After failing to perform, Aasmaan and Karishma are locked on a balcony, where they bond and improve their acting, impressing Hashmi. The next day, Aasmaan performs a Heimlich manoeuvre when Karishma chokes on a fishbone, and the incident goes viral, causing a scandal. Karishma’s brother Shaumik embarrasses the family by publicising the news. Karishma explains the situation to her parents. Freddy assigns lawyers against Aasmaan, but Parvaiz’s friends force Freddy to sign a new deal. Ajay refuses Freddy’s request for help, unwilling to work with him if Aasmaan joins Karan’s film.

episodesList.title: Bullshit Party
episodesList.summary: Aasmaan and his friends celebrate when Parvaiz secures a new deal from Freddy, though they overlook his coercive methods. Freddy faces challenges as Ajay refuses to work with him due to Aasmaan’s involvement in Karan’s film, threatening Sodawallah Productions. Karan approaches Aasmaan and Avtaar for his movie. Ajay grows concerned about Karishma’s friendship with Aasmaan and invites him home to rehearse but becomes uneasy with the script’s intimate scenes. At Karishma’s birthday party, her boyfriend Sameer proposes under pressure from Ajay, and she reluctantly accepts. Aasmaan leaves the party upset. Karishma, learning Ajay orchestrated the proposal, questions Aasmaan about his feelings, but he is kidnapped by goons before responding.

episodesList.title: My Hero
episodesList.summary: Aasmaan is taken to meet Ghafoor Ismail, an underworld don. Jaraj Saxena obtains a video of the meeting and uses it to strike a deal with Freddy to ruin Aasmaan’s career. Freddy leverages the video to convince Ajay to sign a film with him in exchange for removing Aasmaan from Karan’s project. The video leads to Aasmaan’s removal from the film. Karishma suspects Ajay’s involvement but he denies it. She visits Aasmaan but misinterprets seeing him with another woman as him moving on. Meanwhile, Rajat undergoes a liver transplant, but his body rejects it, and he passes away.

episodesList.title: The Filmfirst Awards
episodesList.summary: Aasmaan attends the Filmfirst Awards with his family, where he is nominated for Best Actor. Karishma discovers Ajay’s role in removing Aasmaan from Karan’s film. Aasmaan wins the award and delivers a speech. Backstage, Karishma reveals Ajay’s actions, leading Aasmaan to confront and punch Ajay, sparking a public scandal. Karishma challenges Ajay over his interference and expresses her desire to be with Aasmaan. Ajay locks her in a study, but she contacts Aasmaan, confessing her feelings. Aasmaan and Parvaiz rescue Karishma from Ajay’s house.

episodesList.title: Picture ka title hoga...
episodesList.summary: Aasmaan and Karishma plan to marry, but Ajay intercepts them before they can sign the marriage papers, leading to a confrontation. Neeta reveals that Aasmaan and Karishma are half-siblings from her past affair with Ajay, halting their plans. Aasmaan and Karishma agree to remain friends and part ways. Aasmaan and his team partner with Ghafoor Ismail to produce more films. Meanwhile, Jaraj, Freddy and Jeejeebhoy orchestrate a meeting between Neeta and Ajay, blackmailing them to star in a new Sodawallah Productions family drama series titled The Bastards of Bollywood, including Aasmaan and Karishma.

soundtrack.composer: The soundtrack features an original score by Shashwat Sachdev and songs composed by Sachdev, Anirudh Ravichander and Ujwal Gupta. The music rights were acquired by T-Series. The album, released on 16 September 2025, includes 13 tracks. The first single, "Badli Si Hawa Hai", written by Kumaar and sung by Arijit Singh and Amira Gill, was released on 23 August 2025. "Tenu Ki Pata", featuring vocals by Diljit Dosanjh, Aryan Khan and Ujwal Gupta, was released on 11 September 2025. "Ghafoor", with vocals by Shilpa Rao and Ujwal Gupta, was released as a music video on 19 September 2025.

title: Do You Wanna Partner
summary: Do You Wanna Partner is an Indian Hindi-language comedy drama series that premiered on Amazon Prime Video on 12 September 2025. Produced by Dharmatic Entertainment, it is directed by Archit Kumar and Collin D'Cunha and stars Tamannaah Bhatia and Diana Penty as two friends launching a craft beer startup in a male-dominated industry. The series explores female entrepreneurship, friendship, and resourcefulness, with an ensemble cast including Nakuul Mehta, Jaaved Jaaferi, Neeraj Kabi, Shweta Tiwari, Rannvijay Singha, Ayesha Raza Mishra and Sufi Motiwala.
plot: Shikha and Anahita, two friends, launch a craft beer business in urban India, navigating challenges in a male-dominated industry, including skeptical families, investors, and bureaucratic hurdles. The series blends humor and social commentary, highlighting their friendship and ingenuity as they pursue personal and professional growth.

episodesList.title: Bootstrap
episodesList.writer: Nandini Gupta, Aarsh Vora, Mithun Gongopadhyay
episodesList.summary: When Shikha's employer is taken over by Vikram Walia, the beer tycoon who ruined her father's business, she drowns her frustrations over drinks with her friend Anahita. After Anahita faces her own corporate betrayal, the duo decides to launch a rival beer brand to challenge Walia's empire.

episodesList.title: USP
episodesList.writer: Nandini Gupta, Aarsh Vora, Mithun Gongopadhyay
episodesList.summary: Shikha and Anahita dive into their entrepreneurial journey, recruiting a quirky brewmaster to their team. Facing dismissive investors and bureaucratic hurdles, they uncover an unexpected key to overcoming their challenges.

episodesList.title: Marketing
episodesList.writer: Nandini Gupta, Aarsh Vora, Mithun Gongopadhyay
episodesList.summary: The arrival of their enigmatic mentor, David Jones, transforms Shikha and Anahita's prospects, securing key deals. However, maintaining the myth of David's existence becomes increasingly difficult as his reputation grows uncontrollably.

episodesList.title: Brand Ambassador
episodesList.writer: Nandini Gupta, Aarsh Vora, Mithun Gongopadhyay
episodesList.summary: A financial crisis pushes Shikha and Anahita into a risky alliance with the dubious Laila. When Laila insists on meeting the elusive David Jones, the duo scrambles to find someone to embody their fictional mentor.

episodesList.title: The Launch
episodesList.writer: Nandini Gupta, Aarsh Vora, Mithun Gongopadhyay
episodesList.summary: The Jugaaro beer launch electrifies Delhi, with Dylan stepping up as David Jones. But when Walia disrupts the event and Dylan reveals a shocking secret, Shikha and Anahita must navigate a cascade of crises.

episodesList.title: Silent Partner
episodesList.writer: Nandini Gupta, Aarsh Vora, Mithun Gongopadhyay
episodesList.summary: Jugaaro's rise to fame secures a major music festival deal, but Walia's latest attack threatens everything. As Shikha contemplates a perilous deal with Laila, romantic sparks at the festival add new complications.

episodesList.title: Friction
episodesList.writer: Nandini Gupta, Aarsh Vora, Mithun Gongopadhyay
episodesList.summary: Jugaaro's success unravels as secrets spill out. Anahita's hidden romance and Shikha's risky dealings come to light, fracturing their partnership, while Dylan is caught in the crossfire of their crumbling trust.

episodesList.title: Pivot
episodesList.writer: Nandini Gupta, Aarsh Vora, Mithun Gongopadhyay
episodesList.summary: With time running out to settle debts with Laila, Shikha faces a heart-wrenching choice. She and Anahita set aside their conflicts for a final, high-stakes effort to save Jugaaro, but their dream hangs in the balance.

title: Arabia Kadali
summary:
Arabia Kadali (transl. Arabian Sea) is an Indian Telugu-language survival drama television series created by Krish Jagarlamudi, who co-wrote with Chintakindi Srinivas Rao. The series is produced by First Frame Entertainments and stars Satyadev and Anandhi in the lead roles.
It was released on Amazon Prime Video on 8 August 2025. The story is based on a real-life incident that occurred in 2018, depicting how Pakistani forces captured the fishermen from Srikakulam, Andhra Pradesh in international waters. Thandel, a film released in February 2025, is also based on the same story.

title: Bindiya Ke Bahubali
summary:
Bindiya Ke Bahubali is 2025 Indian Hindi-language OTT series written and directed by Raj Amit Kumar and starring Saurabh Shukla, Ranvir Shorey, Seema Biswas, and Sheeba Chaddha.
Season II of the series was premiered on 21 January 2026. Both seasons can be watched for free on Amazon MX Player.
plot: Bindiya Ke Bahubali explores the aftermath of a mafia don's arrest during an election campaign. Based in fictional town of Bindiya, somewhere in Bihar, India, a volatile battle over legacy and power is ignited when Bada Davan of Davan family (Saurabh Shukla) is detained, and his ambitious son, Chhote Davan (Ranvir Shorey) attempts to seize control. The rest is the huge interplay between various members of this family and the outside world.

episodesList.title: The Davan Empire
episodesList.summary: Tensions erupt in Bindiya around the land next to Bindiya River, forcing Chhote Davan to negotiate peace through grit. As Chhote dreams of contesting elections, his father Bada Davan publicly snatches the spotlight, triggering emotional turmoil, betrayal that sets off a deadly political chess game.

episodesList.title: The Davan Family
episodesList.summary: Bada Davan is jailed for murder, but his family is torn over whether he's guilty-or being set up. Everyone in the family seems to have their own agenda and are searching for the missing ₹25 crore that could decide the future of Bindiya. Babu risks his career to uncover the truth, while Chacha takes over power.

episodesList.title: Colonel Kaun?
episodesList.summary: With Bada Davan in jail and the family empire splintering, Chhote galvanizes public support while Chacha hunts 25 crores hidden by the dead Accountant, Lala. As both grow in power, Bada shocks them by triggering a ruthless vote within the gang to decide who becomes the next Colonel. What begins as political survival turns into emotional betrayal and a dangerous war within.

episodesList.title: Family Tandoor
episodesList.summary: Sukki forces support for Chacha in the Colonel vote, but chaos breaks loose for Davan Family when his ego collides with mockery. Chhote fends off Murli's blackmail while juggling Ajji's dowry drama and a fractured family. As every Captain picks sides, the coup is officially underway within the family as well as outside the family.

episodesList.title: Poonch Main Lathi
episodesList.summary: As new colonel is chosen, Chhote demands from Chacha to have no more deals with Bhamirs. Meanwhile, Kisna takes his first steps in Davan family business by threatening and bribing Murli. As Chacha schemes with Bhamir Anant Singh, a 25-crore liquor convoy heads to Patna-until on Chhote's tip, Murli's STF ambushes the route.

episodesList.title: War Hoga
episodesList.summary: While Chhote hides 25 Crore election cash in four different portions, Babu finds that love of his life is mistress to his own brother Chhote. Chhote offers Kisna crores to leave Bindiya and Murli plots surveillance on everyone. Chacha is kidnapped by Bhamirs and the episode ends with a call for War.

episodesList.title: Pakka War Hoga
episodesList.summary: As Chhote negotiates a high-stakes deal with Bhamirs betraying his fathers command, hidden family tensions explode. Imli manipulates him for control, while old rivalries resurface through blackmail and sex scandals. A viral exposé turns Bada into a political sensation, triggering vengeance and tragedy that culminates in a devastating fall that can only result in War.

episodesList.title: Shopping
episodesList.summary: Bada defies party orders from prison, sending Chhote to Patna to secure his election ticket. As Chhote’s charm clashes with elitist politics, Imli seduces Baccha, Ajji steals hidden cash, and Babu’s obsession with Sasha spirals into danger. Meanwhile, Murli has a perfect plot to bring next one down in the Davan empire.

episodesList.title: Ek Aur Davan Gaya
episodesList.summary: Chhote’s failed ambush exposes deep family cracks while Kisna’s first kill haunts him. Ajji secretly steals what's not hers, and Murli arrests Sasha to trap Chhote. The episode races toward Roli’s explosive courtroom arrival and a fatal setup in motion.

episodesList.title: Koi Nahi Apna
episodesList.summary: Roli’s testimony sparks chaos as Dharavi shatters the case against Bada, revealing a larger conspiracy. Bhamir's attack Moda Village for revenge and making a way for their Powerplant ambitions, using Police, Raja Babu and Vikram Singh. Babu abducts Roli to find who is actually behind His fathers arrest. Chhote defies Bada, declaring independence and political ambition and father and son finally comes to a break that will last forever.

episodesList.title: Gaanv Chhodab Naahi
episodesList.summary: In this pivotal episode, Chhote orchestrates a deadly trap under the guise of reconciliation—convincing rival Vikram Singh to apologize to Moda Village's resilient residents, only to push him into an enraged crowd where rape victim Soni exacts her fiery revenge. While the village celebrates their defiant stand against displacement, internal family fractures deepen: Ajji steals Chhote's hidden fortune to fund her medical dreams, Kisna siphons money for personal ventures, and Babu's forensic investigation reveals Chacha's betrayal in Bada's arrest.  The episode climaxes in catastrophic violence transforms from a bachelor party venue into a massacre site.

episodesList.title: War
episodesList.summary: Kisna's bachelor party at the Yadav Recreational Club erupts into a bloodbath when Babbal Banna and Raja Babu's militia launch a coordinated siege, transforming celebration into carnage.  Chhote arrives with an LMG-mounted mini truck for a dramatic rescue, but the cost is devastating Myra suffers severe sword wounds from Babbal Banna, As survivors escape through bomb-rigged tunnels to a secret Davan hideout, Chhote calls Anant Singh with a chilling promise—he's abandoning politics for pure gangsterism, vowing vengeance that will reshape Bindiya's power structure forever.

tagline: Bindiya Ke Bahubali explores the aftermath of a mafia don's arrest during an election campaign.

title: Mayasabha
summary:
Mayasabha: Rise of the Titans is an Indian Telugu-language political drama television series created by Deva Katta, who co-directed the series and co-wrote its screenplay with Kiran Jay Kumar. The series is produced by Vijay Krishna Lingamaneni and Sree Harsha under the banner of Hitmen & Proodos Productions LLP. It stars Aadhi Pinisetty and Chaitanya Rao in the lead roles, co-starring Sai Kumar, Divya Dutta, and Nassar.
It premiered on SonyLIV on 7 August 2025. The story is fictionalized retelling of the events based on the politics of Andhra Pradesh that took place between the 1970s and 1995.
plot: Set in the volatile political landscape of 1970s-1990s Andhra Pradesh, the series dramatises the evolving relationship between two prominent political figures—Kakarla Krishnama Naidu and M. S. Rami Reddy—portraying their journey from friends-turned-political rivals.

episodesList.title: The Story Of India Is The Story Of Caste
episodesList.summary: In Mid 90s, All the 160 MLAs belonging to RCR party, his two sons, his two son in laws namely Valluri Chalapathi Rao(first son-in-law) and Krishnam Naidu (second son-in-law) are asked to summon at Ashrama Hotel. They have declared a non co-operation movement against the CM RCR due to increasing influence of Susheela Kumari in the party affairs. They provide an ultimatum that if they have to continue in the party, Susheela kumari should be kept away from party affairs.Because of this the ongoing internal conflict between Susheela Kumari and Krishnam Naidu has come to light.At that time, Krishnam Naidu makes a phone to Rami Reddy(His past friend, but now a political rivalry) on what to do in this situation, for Rami Reddy tells him whether both Krishnam Naidu or RCR wins, the next is they have to face him politically. Then the story shifts to 1970s.

title: Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi 2
wikiTitle: Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi 2
summary:
Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi 2 (transl. Because Even a Mother-in-Law Was a Daughter-in-Law Once 2) is an Indian Hindi-language television series premiered on 29 July 2025 on StarPlus and streams digitally on JioHotstar. It is a sequel and reboot of the Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi. Smriti Irani and Amar Upadhyay returned to portray the leads, Tulsi and Mihir Virani.
Following a positive response to the reboot version, a separate storyline featuring Angad and Vrinda, initially as an extension of Kyunki Saas... , was launched and subsequently developed into a standalone spin-off titled Kyunki Rishton Ke Bhi Roop Badalte Hain.
plot:
''''
Twenty-five years later, Tulsi remembers Amba and Savita with fondness as Mihir gifts her a luxury car on their 38th anniversary. Mihir and Tulsi's children Gautam, Shobha and Karan have all shifted abroad. Karan, Nandini and Shobha visit for the anniversary party. Tulsi had adopted and raised her late cousin Kesar and her husband Anupam's children—Angad, Paridhi, and Hrithik. Mihir's aunt Daksha still loves gossiping about films. Mihir's other aunt, Gayatri, berates Tulsi and questions her son Hemant's place in the family. Later, Mihir and Tulsi celebrate their anniversary, where Mihir openly expresses his immense love for her.
Trouble begins when Paridhi confesses about her love-interest Ranvijay, who lives in a chawl and Mihir initially disapproves of him. While Angad is also arrested on charges of hit and run. Here enters Vrinda Gokhale, a girl from humble background who witnessed the actual accused Viren Mehta, a man who also beats his wife Sandhya Parekh. Vrinda helps Angad to prove his innocence by revealing about her brother Nitin being pressured to falsely accuse Angad which helps her land a job in wing managed by Angad. Soon Noina Sarabhai, an NRI businesswoman and Mihir's college friend enters and through her Paridhi marries Ajay Parekh, brother of Sandhya, when Ranvijay ditches her after the shares of Mihir's company dropped and the Parekh family has Viren arrested for troubling Angad and assaulting Sandhya.
Unbeknownst to everyone, Noina always loved Mihir one-sided which Paridhi learns of and plots to separate her parents by fueling to Noina's hidden feelings. Meanwhile, Ranvijay reconnects with Paridhi and to be with him she falsely accuses Ajay and his family in domestic violence case leading to their arrests. But Tulsi learns of it and testifies in their support just like she killed her son Ansh to protect Nandini. Noina's niece Mitali develops a crush on Angad and fixes her alliance with him while Vrinda's marriage is fixed to Ranvijay's abusive friend Suhas. Angad and Vrinda's friendship blossoms into love while Suhas and Mitali plot against them. Vrinda finally breaks the alliance when Suhas tries to molest her and Angad does so when he discovers Mitali's plot about fooling her friends by pretending that she is possessed to escape her gambling loan. However, Mitali tries to blackmail him into marriage, leading him and Vrinda to elope and be banished from Shantiniketan.
Noina becomes obsessed and plots against Mihir and in one such plot, she feigns suicide after Angad's marriage and a drunk Mihir saves her and spends night with her. While the family maid Manjuri Sinha aka Munni falls for Hrithik and starts chatting with him as "Munmun". After the truth reveal, Tulsi sends her to a hostel sponsoring her further education. A guilt-ridden Mihir transfers his property to Tulsi's name while his brother Kiran repeatedly encourages him for a divorce. Tulsi and Mihir's attempt to stop Paridhi and Ranvijay's marriage fails when Tulsi learns about Noina and Mihir and leaves home leaving behind the whole property and a letter ensuring the family about her safety and shifts to ancestral home of Amba in Anjar, which she transferred on her name before dying and vows to start off her life again from there.
Six years later, Tulsi has established her handloom textile start-up Bandhej Cooperative Business in Amba's ancestral home with several poor girls and leads it with Vaishnavi, a girl working there as designer while Noina has taken control of Shanti Niketan and made life of Gayatri, Daksha, Maharaj, the family cook and other members of family miserable which made Gayatri repent. Mihir yearns for Tulsi but does not allow Noina to cross her boundaries outside professional meetings and taunts her for her plotting against Tulsi and family. Paridhi repents her earlier behaviour with Tulsi as Ranvijay actually beats her and is careless for their daughter Garima too while Ritik is also in a loveless marriage with Mitali and has a daughter, Timsi, whom she ignores. While quarrels have become a routine in Shantiniketan. Angad and Vrinda happily inhabit a chawl with their children, Akshay and Madhavi. Meanwhile, Manjuri has now the become District Collector of Mumbai. Mihir along with Noina, Ritik, Mitali and Parth visit to Anjar for handicraft designs for their business where Noina spots Tulsi but prevents Mihir from meeting her.
Tulsi and her team is invited to Mumbai for an exhibition-cum-competition. With much reluctance, Tulsi agrees for her team not knowing that Viranis are also participating in the same exhibition. Tulsi meets Angad and Vrinda who take her to their home. Soon, Karan's son Parth locks horns with Vaishnavi while Sahil's son Dev, who is spoilt by Noina, develops a crush for her.
Tulsi and Mihir finally meet after six years but hiding his true feelings, Mihir fakes love for Noina so that Tulsi can move on and win the competition. Ritik fails to get permission from Manjuri for their new factory and blames Tulsi for his failure. He slits his wrist but Tulsi saves him. Gayatri and Shobha meet Tulsi at hospital where Gayatri apologizes for her past behaviour. Angad visits Ritik after his suicide attempt but both get into a heated argument as Ritik calls Angad a gold digger who is jealous of his brother and holds Vrinda responsible for breaking their family.
Tulsi discovers that the Viranis are in big financial crisis and even Shanti Niketan is mortgaged to her grandfather-in-law Govardhan's friend and businessman Prataprai Dhangiri of Surat. She even discovers Ranvijay's plot of taking over Virani Industries. Ranvijay tries to manipulate Angad for transferring shares of Virani Industries in his name. Prataprai calls Mihir and orders him to attend his great-grandson's wedding with Tulsi and entire Virani family. Gayatri requests Tulsi to accompany them for the wedding as Prataprai is very conservative man who will not accept Tulsi and Mihir getting separated. He holds Tulsi in very high esteem and only she can convince him to give them some time to repay the loan. Tulsi agrees to visit Surat and fake her relationship with Mihir to be normal for the sake of her kids and Shanti Niketan. On the way to Surat, insecure Noina taunts Tulsi for her relationship with Mihir but Tulsi is unaffected. Mihir and Tulsi get some time alone but Tulsi avoids talking with him.The twist of events led Tulsi to know about the truth of Ranvijay about whom she warned Pari before. All of it ends up with Dev marrying Prataprai's granddaughter Saloni. Here Pari meets Ajay and repents for her behaviour and shows her insecurity towards the safety of her daughter Garima. Various acquaintance led Ajay to confess his feelings to Pari, who refuses feeling embarrassed about her past behaviour.

title: Mandala Murders
summary:
Mandala Murders is a 2025 Indian Hindi-language crime thriller series that premiered on Netflix on 25 July 2025. Created and co-directed by Gopi Puthran, alongside Manan Rawat, the series is produced by YRF Entertainment and is based on the novel The Butcher of Benares. Set in the fictional town of Charandaspur, Uttar Pradesh, it blends mystery, supernatural horror, and psychological thriller elements. The series follows detectives Rea Thomas and Vikram Singh as they investigate ritualistic murders linked to a secret cult, the Aayastis, and a mythical entity called Yast.
The series stars Vaani Kapoor, Vaibhav Raj Gupta, Surveen Chawla, Raghubir Yadav, and Shriya Pilgaonkar in key roles. Spanning eight episodes, it explores themes of faith vs science and love vs sacrifice, combining modern police procedural with occult practices. Reviews have been mixed, with praise for its atmospheric world-building, cinematography, and performances, but criticism for uneven pacing and narrative complexity.
plot: Set in the fictional Charandaspur, Uttar Pradesh, Mandala Murders follows CIB officer Rea Thomas (Vaani Kapoor) and suspended cop Vikram Singh (Vaibhav Raj Gupta) as they investigate ritualistic murders orchestrated by the Aayastis, a cult seeking to resurrect a god-like entity, Yast, using human body parts arranged in a mandala pattern. The narrative alternates between the present and 1950s flashbacks, revealing the cult’s origins through Rukmini (Shriya Pilgaonkar), its founder, and Rea’s grandmother, who opposed it. As the detectives uncover personal ties to the cult, they confront political figure Ananya Bhardwaj (Surveen Chawla), who drives its modern revival. The investigation leads to a climactic showdown in underground chambers, where Rea disrupts the final ritual, though the cult’s influence lingers.

tracks.title: In 1950s Charandaspur, a ritual fails. In 2025, Vikram Singh discovers a torso-less corpse, launching a murder investigation tied to his past.
Rea Thomas arrives in Charandaspur, meeting Ananya Bhardwaj. Vikram confronts a figure from his past, deepening the mystery.
Shastri, a shadow worshipper, warns Rea of a dark prophecy. Vikram learns about the mandala symbol’s significance.
Haunted by his past, Vikram teams with Rea to decode eight mandalas linked to the murders, aiming to prevent an attack.
Rea searches for the princess’s identity, sharing her fears with Vikram. Jimmy Khan cracks a code, while Ananya asserts control.
Ancient texts at Monalisa Curio reveal the cult’s history, pushing Rea and Vikram closer to the truth.
Vyankat’s revelations shock Vikram. Rea races to save a child from becoming the next victim.
Vikram is kidnapped for the Yast ritual. Rea confronts Ananya in the underground chambers, disrupting the resurrection.

title: Khakee: The Bengal Chapter
summary:
Khakee: The Bengal Chapter is a 2025 Indian Hindi-language period political thriller television series created by Neeraj Pandey. It is directed by Debatma Mandal and Tushar Kanti Ray, and co-written by Pandey, Mandal and Samrat Chakraborty. Produced by Shital Bhatia under the banner of Friday Storytellers, the series features an ensemble cast including Prosenjit Chatterjee, Jeet, Saswata Chatterjee, Ritwik Bhowmik, Chitrangada Singh, Mahaakshay Chakraborty and Aadil Zafar Khan, with Parambrata Chatterjee appearing in a special role. 
A standalone sequel to Khakee: The Bihar Chapter, the series features a soundtrack composed by Jeet Gannguli, while Sanjoy Salil Chowdhury provided the background score. 
The series premiered on Netflix on 20 March 2025. It is the first Bengali-origin show to stream on Netflix and also marks the Hindi-language debut of Jeet. The series received mixed-to-positive reviews from critics and was well received by audiences.
plot: Shankar Baruah aka Bagha, a Kolkata based don, close to ruling party of West Bengal is involved in all unlawful activities in Kolkata region and opposition party raise their voice against ruling party run Government on lawlessness in Kolkata. Ruling party appoints a clean record Police officer, named Saptarshi Sinha, to show government action on Bagha by some raids and arrests. Bagha used to get information of raids through Barun Roy, key people of ruling party. But that police officer is killed by Bagha's gang member Sagor Talukdar and Ranjit Thakur. Murder of a senior Police officer becomes a matter of shame for ruling party in State of West Bengal. Bagha along with his gang members becomes underground along his gang & maintaining telephonic conversation with Barun Roy. In the meantime, Barun Roy discloses Bagha's location to Sagor and Ranjit. Government brings Arjun Maitra as head of SIT, he tries to crack down on Bagha. But Bagha was found dead and government proved their credibility to people. But here the story has twist. Maitra is transferred as security to Chief Minister Shirshendu Das for violation orders from top. He explores a nexus between police officials, politicians, businessmen and underworld. He implements strategies to divide Sagor and Ranjit. Finally Maitra becomes successful to break the nexus.

title: Dabba Cartel
summary:
Dabba Cartel is a 2025 Indian Hindi-language crime drama series. Created by Shibani Dandekar Akhtar, Vishnu Menon, Gaurav Kapur, and Akanksha Seda, and directed by Hitesh Bhatia, the series is produced under Excel Entertainment. It stars Shabana Azmi, Jyothika, Shalini Pandey, Nimisha Sajayan, and Anjali Anand as a group of women operating a drug cartel under the guise of a food delivery company.
The series premiered on Netflix on 28 February 2025.
plot: Dabba Cartel is set in the Mumbai suburb of Thane. The story revolves around five middle-class women running a traditional dabbawala (lunchbox) service. Unexpectedly, they become involved in a high-stakes drug operation, using lunchboxes to transport illicit goods. As their network expands, they must navigate dangerous criminals, law enforcement, and personal betrayals, all while maintaining the facade of their normal lives.

title: Crime Beat
summary: Crime Beat is an Indian Hindi-language crime thriller web series directed by Sudhir Mishra and Sanjeev Kaul. Starring Saqib Saleem, Rahul Bhat, Danish Husain, Saba Azad, Kishor Kadam, Sai Tamhankar, Vipin Sharma, Rajesh Tailang, Gaurav Dwivedi, Adinath Kothare and Vipin Sharma. The series is inspired by Somnath Batabyal's 2013 novel The Price You Pay. It revolves around investigative journalism and crime reporting. Produced by Rajiv Ramesh Agarwal & Manju Ramesh Agarwal, Crime Beat released on February 21, 2025 on ZEE5.
plot: The story follows Abhishek Sinha, a rookie journalist navigating the competitive field of crime reporting. His investigation takes a new turn when he uncovers information about the possible return of a fugitive gangster to India. As he pursues the lead, he works with law enforcement and encounters the complex intersections of crime, politics, and media. Along the way, he faces ethical challenges, professional ambitions, and the risks associated with exposing hidden truths.

episodesList.title: The How What and Why
episodesList.summary: Delhi's notorious mafia don, Binny Chaudhary, returns to the city and is killed in front of a large crowd. Rookie crime reporter Abhishek Sinha investigates the don's life for his next big story.

episodesList.title: Master of Disguise
episodesList.summary: Amir Akhtar approaches DCP Uday for insights into Binny's past. Meanwhile, Abhishek uncovers the existence of a mysterious figure known as 'Heroine,' linked to Binny. Determined to dig deeper, he pursues the lead on his own after Amir limits his role in the investigation.

episodesList.title: The Escape
episodesList.summary: Abhishek gets caught trespassing in Binny's mansion. Meanwhile, Binny evades the CBI-Interpol with the aid of an Iranian tribe. Elsewhere, ACP Mayank uncovers a vital clue about the elusive 'Heroine.

episodesList.title: The Homecoming
episodesList.summary: Binny discreetly arrives in Mumbai instead of Delhi, catching DCP Uday and Rawat off guard. His unexpected return unsettles 'Heroine,' while Abhishek continues his relentless pursuit for a front-page breakthrough.

episodesList.title: Karne Kaun Dega
episodesList.summary: Following Abhishek's tip, ACP Mayank locates 'Heroine,' triggering a deadly shootout that results in Salim's death. In the aftermath, DCP Uday reprimands Mayank for the operation and unveils a startling truth about his father, who died a martyr.

episodesList.title: Main Lakshya Hoon Tera
episodesList.summary: Abhishek quits Amir's firm and faces difficulties securing work. With the support of senior photographer Pashupati, he lands a position at a leading newspaper. Soon after, he unexpectedly comes face to face with Binny Chaudhary.

episodesList.title: Khiladi, Katputli aur Khel
episodesList.summary: Heroine' leads Abhishek to Binny, who hands him a video containing businessman Mahajan's confession. As Abhishek interviews Binny, the CBI, acting on Minister Rawat's orders, closes in with the intent to eliminate Binny.

episodesList.title: The New Ringmaster
episodesList.summary: Maya is abducted by Binny's men and is shocked to discover her father's connection to the CWG scam. As ACP Mayank leads the CBI to the scene, he is compelled to withdraw. Meanwhile, Binny makes his final move.
