title: The Kapil Sharma Show
summary:
The Kapil Sharma Show (also known as TKSS) is an Indian Hindi language stand-up comedy and talk show that airs on Sony Entertainment Television. Hosted by comedian Kapil Sharma, the programme premiered on 23 April 2016.
The first season was set around Sharma and his neighbours living in the fictional Shantivan Non-Cooperative Housing Society. The show is filmed at Film City in Goregaon East, Mumbai. 
The initial season was produced by Sharma’s production company K9 Productions in association with Frames Productions. From the second and third seasons, production responsibilities were shared by Salman Khan Television and Banijay Asia, along with K9 Productions, while TEAM (Triyambh Entertainment and Media) served as the creative producer. 
The 5th season of the show premiered in September 2022, with Archana Puran Singh returning as the guest judge.
plot: The format is largely identical of Sharma's former show Comedy Nights with Kapil. The kapil sharma Show revolves around Kapil Sharma and his team of comedians, including Sumona Chakravarti, Kiku Sharda, Chandan Prabhakar, Krushna Abhishek, Bharti Singh and Rochelle Rao, who play residents of the Shantivan Non-cooperative Housing Society. Normally every episode unfolds in two parts with the first part being a comic skit enacted by the actors of the show and the second part being the celebrity interview where popular personalities from various fields indulge in a light-hearted interaction with karma. Navjot Singh Sidhu was the permanent guest of the show but was later replaced by Archana Puran Singh after 16 February 2019.

episodesList.summary: A musical night in The Kapil Show today, inviting the Padmashri Shankar Mahadevan, Shaan, Harshadeep Kaur, and Salim Merchant. The night is full of soulful performances and some rib-tickling experiences. Also, Chandu is back on the show and has a hysterical interaction with the guests.

episodesList.title: Ustaad Wadali In The House
episodesList.summary: Today's episode begins with a magical performance by Ustaad Padmashri Puranchand Wadali and his son Lakhwinder Wadali. The atmosphere of the show gets soulful by their presence and their singing.

episodesList.title: The Cast Of Pati Patni Aur Woh
episodesList.summary: The show begins with a sketch premise where Chappu has finally got a job as a food delivery guy. The set turns into a hilarious comedic segment when Chappu forgets to bring Bachcha's order. After that Kapil invites the lead cast of an upcoming movie, 'Pati Patni Aur Woh' on the show.

episodesList.title: Welcoming The Legend Jeetendra With Tusshar Kapoor
episodesList.summary: Kapil starts the show with the welcome of evergreen Bollywood star Jeetendra and his son Tushar Kapoor. Jeetendra shares many of his funny experiences and also answers to the rumors questioned by Kapil. Later Kapil creates a lot of entertainment with Tushar Kapoor as well.

episodesList.title: The Star Cast Of Panipat
episodesList.summary: In today's episode, the star cast of a newly released movie, Panipat, is invited to the show. Kapil welcomes the Khalnayak of Bollywood, Sanjay Dutt, to share a few interesting stories with him. Later on, Kriti Sanon and Ashutosh Gowariker join him for a humorous and entertaining evening.

episodesList.title: Welcoming The Cast Of Dabangg 3
episodesList.summary: Kapil starts the show with many funny questions and answers with the audiences and even they are reciting their experiences. Later Kapil welcomes the cast of Dabangg 3 i.e, Chulbul Pandey urf Salman khan, Sonakshi Sinha, and Saiee Manjrekar. Kapil enquires different rumors from the guests on behalf of the spectators and having lots of fun with them.

episodesList.title: The Dabangg Stars Of Bollywood
episodesList.summary: The night continues with the glamorous cast of an upcoming movie Dabangg 3. Kapil invites the producer of the film Arbaaz Khan, the director Prabhudeva and a co-star Sudeep Kichha on stage. Together they share a wonderful and joyous time. After a while, they also play the famous 'Ke Bhail Crorepati', hosted by Bachcha Yadav. Stay Tuned for a rib-tickling evening and lots of humorous moments.

episodesList.title: Celebrating The 100th Episode With GOOD NEWWZ
episodesList.summary: An auspicious moment for the show, as we celebrate the 100th episode with the cast of an upcoming movie, Good Newwz. Akshay Kumar picks on everyone in Kapil's team including Kapil and mocks them. For the first time this season, Kareena Kapoor Khan comes on the show, followed by the entire cast. Together they share some extremely rib-tickling moments with Kapil, and the night touches the perfect mixture of fun and emotion.

episodesList.title: Colourful Night With Renowned Musicians
episodesList.summary: Today's episode starts with some glorious performances by some renowned artists in the music industry. Together they have produced the music album for an upcoming movie, Good Newwz. The night is full of special moments and experiences. Each one of them shares a lovely and hysterical evening on the show. Stay Tuned for a colourful and glamorous night!

episodesList.title: The Kakkar Family In The House
episodesList.summary: In today's episode, Bachcha makes a new year resolution to find a suitable groom for his sister-in-law. Listening to which, Chandu presents himself as the most eligible bachelor for Bhoomi. A while later, Kapil invites the entire Kakkar family on stage. They share a wonderful and joyous evening and share some of their childhood memories with Kapil.

episodesList.title: A Night Full Of Bhojpuri Superstars
episodesList.summary: In today's episode, Kapil welcomes the superstars of Bhojpuri Cinematic Universe on the stage. The famous Bhojpuri Dance number, the Lollipop song was given by the very well known, Pawan Singh. Nirahua comes riding a rickshaw along with the glamorous ladies of Bhojpuri Cinema. Stay Tuned for a 'Desi Night' and a hilarious show.

episodesList.title: Welcoming The Lead Cast OF Tanhaji
episodesList.summary: The show begins with standup premise where Bachcha is not ready to let his sister-in-law stay with them. The entire family comes out with their personal opinion, and the set becomes hysterical. Later, Kapil invites the lead cast of an upcoming movie, a superstar couple of Bollywood, Ajay Devgan and Kajol. They share a humorous and entertaining evening with Kapil and some everyday life experiences.

episodesList.title: Special Celebrations With Deepika
episodesList.summary: In today's episode, Kapil invites the lead cast of an upcoming movie, Chhapaak, Deepika Padukone on stage. The night is special as Kapil is unable to contain his feelings and keeps on flirting with Deepika. Later, we celebrate Deepika's birthday with Laxmi Agarwal and the director of the movie, Meghna Gulzar.

episodesList.title: A Night With Jackie Dada
episodesList.summary: Kapil welcomes one of the most legendary and charming actors of Bollywood's previous era, Jackie Shroff, on stage. The entire cast of the show is called on stage to play some games with Jackie Dada, and the show gets hysterical with its pace. At the end of the show, they dedicate a dance performance to him, which makes him relive some of his golden days from Bollywood.

episodesList.title: The Googly Experts Of Indian Cricket Team
episodesList.summary: The show begins with a very funny sketch performed by the entire family. Kapil welcomes two tremendously talented and brilliant players of the Indian cricket team, Piyush Chawla and Yuzvendra Chahal. Both of them are effective leg-spinners and have always performed well. Yuzvendra also talks about the two NGO's which he is attached to that helps young girls who want to pursue their career in sports.

episodesList.title: A Night Full Of Panga
episodesList.summary: Kapil opens the show with welcoming the actors Kangana Ranaut, Richa Chadda, etc. along with the Director of the upcoming film Panga. The guests talk about the film which is based on women kabaddi and the hurdles about their personal and professional lives. From witty commentaries to sharing funny moments, the guests enjoy the show thoroughly with Kapil and Archana. Stay Tuned to know what happens in Top Ka Adalat.

episodesList.title: Swaying With The Street Dancers
episodesList.summary: In today's show, Kapil very heartily welcomes Remo D'Souza, Varun Dhawan and Prabhu Deva. Later followed by the whole team of Street Dancer 3D and Shraddha Kapoor. It's a joyous and entertaining evening with everyone present. As-usual the family members have a humorous interaction with the entire cast and Remo. The show ends with Sapna dancing with Varun and Shraddha and having a fun-filled time.

episodesList.title: Hungama On The Kapil Sharma Show
episodesList.summary: The whole cast of Hungama 2 comes to The Kapil Sharma Show to promote their upcoming movie. Shilpa Shetty, Paresh Rawal, Rajpal Jadav, Ashutosh Rana, eat. share funny incidents related to the film and their personal and professional life which is followed by the audience speaking about whether to get married early or late. Later, at "Baat Ki Khal", the guests discuss the necessity of judges in reality shows.

episodesList.title: Laughter Cruise Jaaneman
episodesList.summary: Take a trudge through these laughter-full meadows to ‘The Kapil Sharma Show’. It will tickle your funny bone till the end. Take this joyous ride, as our host makes sure that the stars of ‘Jawani Jaaneman’ have a hearty laugh throughout the entire episode, and also, we learn about Saif Ali Khan’s simple side.

episodesList.title: Sang Malang
episodesList.summary: Once again, take a turn to the lane of laughter and fun, where Kapil Sharma will meet today our stars of ‘Malang’ to tickle them with his humour till the end. Where, in a quiz, our beloved stars will affirm some truths about themselves and will clear the rumour, and in the end Dhwani Bhanushali will perform a song for us to savour.

episodesList.title: Thirty Years Of Aashiqui
episodesList.summary: In today’s exciting episode Kapil Sharma invites Rahul Roy, Anu Aggarwal, and Deepak Tijori to celebrate thirty years of Aashiqui’s release. They tell him how they got the roles, how their lives changed after the success, and how their characters name in ‘Aashiqui’ are the same as their real names. The Aashiqui’s cast makes the audience laugh with humorous incidents in the film. Kapil tells Rahul how everyone in India became a lover after watching Aashiqui. What impact it had on India’s moviegoers. The laughter becomes uncontrollable when Sapna and others arrive and crack their unique jokes. Also, Kapil Sharma shows his singing talents.

episodesList.title: Kartik’s Love Aaj Kal
episodesList.summary: In this episode Kapil welcomes the superstars of the Movie ‘Love Aaj Kal’ to the stage. Kapil challenges Kartik to lift Archana. He succeeds and then pretends to fall on the floor. Kartik and Sara then talk about the trending kartik hashtag on the twitter. They also discuss about their gym life. Kartik tells Kapil that he loves dancing. Kapil claims he can dance well too, just in his mind. Kartik then talks about his love life. He discusses how difficult it was for him to meet his girlfriend in school. Then Kapil asks Kartik and Sara whether they ever had lice in their hair. Sara admits to having lice once while Kartik tells he had lice many times. The laughter dose increases even more when Kammo Bua arrives and starts flirting with Kartik’s father. After that Kartik and Sara play a guess game and Kapil encourages the audience to share their valentine story.

episodesList.title: Is Kapil Ayushmann’s Lucky Charm?
episodesList.summary: Kapil Sharma welcomes the star cast of “Shubh Mangal Zyada Saavdhan” on the show. Kapil asks Ayushmann if his show is lucky for him as his previous films were successful because Ayushmann promoted them on his show. On the other hand, Jitendra also confesses that he only signed the film to be on Kapil’s Show. After a while, Kiku Sarda dressed as a hip hopper compares Ayushmann to Shaktiman, he also asks Jitendra whether he got paid for the movie or he just had to make do with likes, shares, and subscribes as a form of payment. After a while, audiences interacts with the star cast. Kapil also dances with one of the audience members. Kapil later on, asks the stars to confirm some of the rumours. Whereas Krishna dressed as Sapna gives vermilion to Ayushmann and asks him to use it on Jitendra. The show ends with Ayushmann singing a song from his movie.

episodesList.title: Vicky And "Bhoot Part 1, The Haunted Ship"
episodesList.summary: This episode starts with a hilarious comedy sketch of Kapil and his team. After a while, Vicky Kaushal appears on the show to promote his film “Bhoot Part 1, The Haunted Ship”. Kapil interacts with Vicky about the film and his fears in general. Later on, Krushna appears on the stage and entertains Vicky with her goofiness and tries to flirt with him. Finally, the show ends with Sumona trying to scare Vicky.

episodesList.title: Kapil Is India’s Best Dancer
episodesList.summary: Today’s episode starts with the usual bang, where Kapil and Archana pull each other’s leg. Kapil then invites the judges of India’s Best Dancers on the stage; Geeta Kapoor, Malaika Arora, Terence Lewis. Kapil then asks them they already have a dance show, Super Dancers, why there’s a need for another. Geeta explains that was for kids and this is for teenagers. Archana makes fun of Kapil’s waistline. Kapil and the guest judges then crack few jokes and pull each other’s legs. Geeta also shares that how everyone starts addressing her as ‘Ma’. At that moment, Kapil jokes and asks Archana Puran Singh that how did she become a father. Then Kapil does a funny question and answers round. Then Sumona arrives and tries to become the India’s Best Dancers’ Show’s host, but Kapil can’t stop himself from teasing her. The laughter continues when the Dance Show’s host, Bharti arrives and tickles everyone’s funny bones. Kapil and Geeta Kapoor then do a funny imitation of airplane announcement.

episodesList.title: Kapil’s Sensational Thappad
episodesList.summary: Kapil Sharma starts the show with quirky and interesting take on history. He then takes a fun quiz on history with the audience. Later, he invites Taapsee Pannu on stage. Kapil asks Taapsee why her films’ titles are of single words, is it because she is single? He cracks a few more jokes with her and afterwards, invites another actror Diya Mirza and Thappad’s Director Anubhav Sinha. Kapil flirts with Diya by saying that she looks good in the black saree and jokingly calls Archana Bulgaria’s parrot. Kapil can’t stop flirting with Diya, to which Diya asks him whether he knows the film’s title or not? Kapil then does a Yes & No session with both the actors and the director. Then Chandu arrives unexpectedly with his own fashion show and the laughter doubles. Later, Chandu invites Bhoori, the fashion designer on the stage, hoping she will take his side, but they both end up pulling each other’s leg. Chandu leaves and Bhoori shows ‘Thappad’s’ star cast her fashion collection.

episodesList.title: Tiger Shroff’s Singing Skills
episodesList.summary: Kapil welcomes Tiger Shroff and Shraddha Kapoor for the promotion of “Baaghi 3”. He asks Tiger whether to reduce his intake of sugar or to reduce some romance in life to stay fit like him. Then, Kapil invites Ahmed Khan and Ritesh Deshmukh on the stage. Both of them enter on the stage with their awesome dance moves. Kapil tells Ritesh that he is his biggest fan. He also compliments Tiger for being an Indian action hero. Ritesh confesses that he wore Genelia’s shirt for a scene. Then, Kiku appears on the stage and entertains the guests with his unique promotion style. He asks Tiger if his body got tanned while shooting in the sun. Ahmed tells everybody that the film contains 85% real stunts and 15% VFX. Shraddha and Tiger showcase their dance performance on the stage. Ritesh compliments Ahmed for his various talents and both of them, entertain everyone with their mimicking skills as well. Everyone requests Tiger to sing a song.

episodesList.title: Ramayan’s 33 Years, Cast Celebrates
episodesList.summary: The cast of late Ramanand Sagar’s iconic serial Ramayana reunites to celebrate the 33 years of its airing. Kapil Sharma invites Arun Govil (Ram), Dipika (Sita) and Sunil Lahri (Lakman) with huge applause from the audience. Kapil goes nostalgic as he shares his first meeting with Arun Govil. Meanwhile, Arun reveals that his first audition was rejected by Sagar for the role of Shri Ram. Dipika and Sunil also share about how they were finalized to play their roles. Further, Arun narrates how he was abused by a man for smoking a cigarette, as they considered him God. Dipika shares how she realized after two-three months of Ramayan airing, that she and Arun were being revered by senior citizens too. Kiku Sharda and Bharti Singh’s humorous act leaves the cast in splits. Later, Prem Sagar, son of Ramanand Sagar arrives and launches the biography of his visionary father titled ‘An Epic Life: Ramanand Sagar, From Barsaat to Ramayan’ written by him.

episodesList.title: Women’s Day With The Devi’s
episodesList.summary: The occasion of Women’s Day just gets more special, as Kajol and Shruti Hassan arrive for the promotion of their short film Devi. Kapil wishes them a Happy Women’s Day, and congratulates Kajol on the blockbuster success of her last release Tanhaji. Kajol talks about Devi, which is based on a sensitive social cause, and feels that it should bring the required change and touch everyone from within. Meanwhile, Kapil invites the other cast members of the film, which includes Mukta Barve, Neena Kulkarni, Shivani Raghuvanshi and Yashaswini Dayama. Feeling that his show hasn’t looked so glamorous before, Kapil gets a photo session done with them. Further, Yashaswini croons Love You Zindagi, and Shruti also entertains with singing Alvida song beautifully. The cast even plays an extremely funny game. Later, Kajol reveals an interesting incident about misleading the media persons on the day of her wedding. The fun quotient adds up with Kajol shaking a leg with Bharti on Bole Chudiyaan.

episodesList.title: Akshay Kumar’s Early Morning Fun
episodesList.summary: Kapil Sharma wishes everyone a very Good Morning, as they’re shooting for this episode at 6 am in the morning. Kapil reveals the reason behind this early shooting is none other than their guest, superstar Akshay Kumar. He welcomes Akshay, who comes to promote his film Sooryavanshi. Akshay shares that there are many complaints against him of waking up so early for promotions. Then, Akshay recommends some artists to Kapil and shows everyone some funny morphed pictures of Chunky Pandey, Riteish Deshmukh, Saurabh Shukla, and Boman Irani. Meanwhile, Akshay tells something about award functions, which evokes laughter. They invite Sooryavanshi director Rohit Shetty, who arrives and says that he wishes to take over the judge’s chair from Archana Puran Singh. Rohit shares that Akshay didn’t wear the safety harness while shooting for the Helicopter scene in the film. Akshay shower praises on the Police, who sacrifice their lives for everyone. Later, Katrina Kaif is welcomed by Kapil.

episodesList.title: Double The Fun With Team Sooryavanshi
episodesList.summary: Kapil Sharma’s dose of entertainment continues with team Sooryavanshi. Kapil starts the show with a hilarious act, where he’s dressed up as a Police Inspector. Kapil then invites producer Karan Johar, and congratulates him for being awarded the prestigious Padma Shri. Karan compliments Kapil that he’s looking hot. Karan later shares about what makes him and Rohit Shetty come together for entertainers like Simmba and Sooryavanshi. Upon being asked whether he is more talented or flexible, Karan replies with a witty answer. Meanwhile, Karan says that he shouldn’t post any new ‘videos’ now. Rohit and Karan then share how Kareena Kapoor Khan gets to know about everything that is happening in Bollywood. Hearing about these incidents about Bebo, Akshay suggests that Mumbai Police should hire Kareena. Then, Kapil plays a game with Karan, where he has to recite some popular Police dialogues from Hindi films.

episodesList.title: Dream Girl Returns
episodesList.summary: Kapil Sharma invites Esha Deol on the show. He compliments her that she is looking very pretty and congratulates her on her debut book Amma Mia’s launch. Esha talks about the book and her two daughters, Radhya and Miraya, who inspired her to write the book. Continuing with the chat, Kapil then invites Esha’s mother and Bollywood’s Dream Girl, Hema Malini on stage. Hema then shares tips of being fit and reveals that as a kid, Esha was the naughtiest. Meanwhile, Hema narrates how she convinced Dharmendra to let Esha act in films. Later, Hema and Esha go on a nostalgic trip looking at some old pictures of Esha and Ahana along with their parents. Hema also shares how and when she got the title of ‘Dream Girl’ in films. Esha then Kapil to sing a song, and he beautifully croons Hema’s classic romantic number Humein Tumse Pyar Kitna. Sapna, Baccha Yadav and Titli Yadav entertain with their hilarious acts. Towards the end, Hema and Esha launch the book Amma Mia on the show.

episodesList.title: The Devdas Unfolds On Kapil’s Show
episodesList.summary: Bhoori rocks the stage with her dance performance but Shamsher Singh interrupts and interrogates her. Meanwhile, enters Baccha, who has decided to direct Devdas, the Bengali classic. Eventually, Shamsher, who’s playing Devdas gets bored and decides to portray a Punjabi Devdas. What will this Punjabi Devdas be like? Later, Sai Manjrekar and Ayush Sharma visit the show to promote their new single, Manjha. In a warm tete-a-tete with Kapil, they open up about their Bollywood journey so far.

episodesList.title: Kapil Becomes Yamraj
episodesList.summary: The episode starts on a musical note. Kapil beautifully croons classic songs, Inteha Ho Gayi Intezar Ki and Kisi Ki Muskurahaton Pe Ho Nisar. Kapil starts entertaining with his funny jokes about a new born baby. Meanwhile, a funny act on Yamlok brings the house down with laughter. Kapil becomes Yamraj and solves the confusion of a newly deceased on whether he should enter the Swarg Lok or Narak Lok. Kapil as Yamraj, tells everyone to use sanitizer, spreading awareness on Coronavirus.

episodesList.title: Kapil’s Wonderful Audience
episodesList.summary: In this episode, Kapil Sharma speaks with his audience and learns some interesting things about them. He entertains them with his quirky one liners. He also plays some funny games with the audience and makes them happy.

episodesList.title: Back And How!
episodesList.summary: Enjoy your favourite The Kapil Sharma Show once again. Kapil and his madhouse is back in action and you don’t want to miss it for anything. Watch Kapil connect with his fans distantly. And also get thoroughly entertained with a hilarious, yet realistic skit by the performers.

episodesList.title: Entertainment Unleashed!
episodesList.summary: Sonu Sood, has stolen millions of hearts with his acting, but more for his philanthropy. On The Kapil Sharma Show in this episode, Sonu talks to Kapil about his experience with the migrant workers. Also, enjoy the entertaining acts by our quirky host Kapil and the team.

episodesList.title: Life, Off-Screen!
episodesList.summary: Kapil and his team are working together for a long, and they all are like one big family. Let’s meet with the spouses of these family members. This weekend, Kapil interacts with Parmeet Sethi, Priyanka Sharda, and Kashmira Shah on their marriage and love life.

episodesList.title: Mission Laughter
episodesList.summary: Kapil Sharma welcomes Team Avrodh: The Siege Within actors - Amit Sadh, Neeraj Kabi, Madhurima Tuli, and Darshan Kumaar on the show. Kapil interacts with the stars about the web show. Later, they all play a funny game and enjoy some interesting revelations. Plus, adding to the fun are the hilarious acts by the gang.

episodesList.title: The Entertaining Brothers
episodesList.summary: The Independence Day celebration gets exciting on The Kapil Sharma Show as the music composer duo Salim–Sulaiman makes a rocking entry with the song Chak De India. They share some interesting facts while the hilarious acts of Sapna and Accha Yadav take the entertainment factor notches higher.

episodesList.title: The Laughter Loots
episodesList.summary: Hop on to a crazy laughter ride with Kapil Sharma as he engages in a conversation with the Lootcase actors, Ranveer Shorey, Kunal Khemu, and Rasika Duggal. Their quick comebacks to Kapil’s funny questions are sure to have you splitting into your sides. Catch this high-on-entertainment episode of The Kapil Sharma Show to know more about the movie Lootcase and much more.

episodesList.title: Mika, Shefali And Chahatt Raise The Hotness Bar!
episodesList.summary: The hotness bar reaches an all-new level on The Kapil Sharma Show, as the singing star, Mika Singh, and two sexy divas, Shefali and Chahatt, joins Kapil. Mika Paji not only entertains us with his all-time popular chartbusters but also gets chatty with Kapil on various topics like his song, Jumme Ki Raat. Hilarious acts by Mitti Mouse and Bua take the entertainment to an all-new level.

episodesList.title: Your Honor Haazir Ho!
episodesList.summary: The fun quotient on The Kapil Sharma Show increases in this episode as Kapil welcomes the Your Honor actors, Jimmy Sheirgill, Mita Vasisht, and Varun Badola. With Kapil’s tongue-in-cheek questions and witty replies by the celebs, this is a crazy laughter ride that you must not miss.

episodesList.title: Welcome, Covid-19 Warriors!
episodesList.summary: This weekend, our favourite host, Kapil Sharma has very special guests on the show. Let’s meet Dr. Muffazal Lakdawala and Dr. Gautam Bhansali, the doctors who have poured their sweat and blood to treat the Covid-19 patients despite the risk of getting infected. Watch their mind-blowing interactions with Kapil and the team in this wonderful episode. Check out their inspiring journey through the pandemic right now!

episodesList.title: The Zingaat Entertainment
episodesList.summary: Conquering millions of hearts with their melodious and foot-tapping music, composer duo, Ajay-Atul makes a Zingaat entry, as our host, Kapil Sharma welcomes them to celebrate Ganesh Mahotsav. Ajay-Atul talks about their love for music since childhood and shares many more interesting facts while treating us to a humorous conversation with our quirky host, Kapil and his laughter gang. Plus, the duo sings Deva Shree Ganesha adding much more fun to the Ganpati celebrations.

episodesList.title: Teen Geetkaar Bane Kapil Ke Yaar
episodesList.summary: The entertainment mode on The Kapil Sharma Show turns lyrical, as celebrated lyricists Swanand Kirkire, Amitabh Bhattacharya, and Manoj Muntashir, join our favourite host. Kapil starts asking them some funny questions which leave the guests in splits. Plus, the hilarious acts by Baccha Yadav and Mitti Mouse take the fun to a new level. Join the Kapil gang to have some musical fun and get to know some funny secrets and the hidden talent of our guests.

episodesList.title: Hansi Ki Bauchhar With Angad-Neha
episodesList.summary: Our host, Kapil Sharma, engages in a conversation with Bollywood’s power couple, Angad Bedi and Neha Dhupia. Kapil’s hilarious questions on marriage and lockdown secrets get the couple to be at their wittiest best, followed by a romantic moment between the two. Plus, Bachcha Yadav’s bank becomes a house of comedy, with each customer’s crazy quirks and antics.

episodesList.title: Comedy Ki Raat Sachin-Jigar Aur Diyva Ke Saath
episodesList.summary: Promising lots of music, fun, and entertainment, our host, Kapil Sharma welcomes the rocking music composer duo, Sachin-Jigar, and singer, Divya Kumar. From asking the guests some funny questions to giving an audition to Sachin-Jigar for playback singing, everything results in unlimited laughter. The guests even join in for an entertaining game of ‘Never Have I Ever’. Also, do not forget to catch Sapna’s punny act with Jigar, which will leave you in splits.

episodesList.title: Kadak Bhojpuri Entertainment With Manoj-Ravi
episodesList.summary: The entertainment bar reaches an all-new level as Bhojpuri superstars, Ravi Kishan and Manoj Tiwari join Kapil. The duo’s banter while giving witty answers to Kapil’s questions is unmissable. From Krushna’s ace act as Big B and Bachcha Yadav’s top-notch comical punches, this episode has it all. And what’s even more fun is the enactment of some cricketing moves by Manoj and Ravi.

episodesList.title: Richa-Harshdeep’s Unlimited Masti
episodesList.summary: Kapil Sharma invites two outstanding singers, Richa Sharma and Harshdeep Kaur, promising a high-on-entertainment ride. With some interesting revelations about Richa’s childhood mischiefs to Harshdeep getting a wedding proposal at Gurudwara, the guests get chatty with Kapil and enjoy their time on the show. Plus, the talented duo’s singing along with Kapil, and Sapna’s special massage makes it all the more necessary to watch this hilarious episode.

episodesList.title: Ashutosh-Renuka, Couple Goals Ki Paribhasha
episodesList.summary: Kapil Sharma welcomes one of Bollywood’s most ideal couples, Ashutosh Rana and Renuka Shahane. Kapil’s questions about Renuka falling in love with Ashutosh, Ashutosh’s writing, Renuka’s first visit to Ashutosh’s set, and much more, get the couple to be at their wittiest best. Renuka showcases her hidden talent and sings a romantic number for Ashutosh. Plus, Bachcha and Titli’s banter makes Renuka wish if she and Ashutosh were a couple like them.

episodesList.title: Annu Kappor, The Harfanmaula Kalakar
episodesList.summary: Mention Annu Kapoor, one instantly remembers the Antakshari days and Sapna brings back those memories during her chit chat with this legendary actor who made waves even as a show anchor. Annu ji, in his full swag and style, reveals a lot of his life’s secrets. Matching Kapil’s comedy moves he wows us with his soulful singing and infectious energy. Watch this episode to know a fine actor, a perfect stage anchor, and a lovely human being - Annu Kapoor.

episodesList.title: Mahabharat Ke Kamaal Kisse
episodesList.summary: The show tonight looks grand as some of the mega stars of the mega serial Mahabharat grace the show. The actors share funny and interesting stories, lesser-known facts come to light. Did you know casting director ‘Shakuni’ took 3500 auditions for over two years to finalise the cast? How did Nitish Bharadwaj learn the ‘Arjun’ dialogues? And not to forget the goofy, Punjabi-speaking ‘Hanuman’!

episodesList.title: Hasi Mazak ‘Hum Log’on Ke Saath
episodesList.summary: It’s a Hum Log cast reunion after 36 years and masti unlimited is guaranteed. Bachcha Yadav brings his infectious laughter dose and a Hum Log monologue of his childhood days. Divya Seth shares her birthday with Kapil and may replace Archana by her signature laughter. Rajesh Puri gets a chhole gift? Seema did real social work for 3 years based on her screen role. Did Manoj date Majhli on screen and Badki off screen? There’s Lallu’s dacoit photoshoot and many more Hum Log tales.

episodesList.title: Anubhav’s Blackmailing Tactics For Manoj
episodesList.summary: Great buddies Manoj Bajpai and Anubhav Sinha - have stories galore to share. Anubhav’s blackmail funda for Manoj or Manoj’s jibe at stingy Anubhav. While Manoj’s happy hour in a Paris bound flight was incredible, Anubhav confesses to having rejected many movies due to his average acting skills. What took 26 years for the buddy duo to collaborate for work? And when they did, something fabulous like ‘Bambai Mein Ka Ba’ came out. Stay tuned to Bachcha’s Raddi News. Is Sidhu back? But where is Kapil?

episodesList.title: Fun Overdose On Sony’s 25th Anniversary
episodesList.summary: As Sony TV turns 25, Kapil brings together a special episode to celebrate this silver jubilee. The entire cast share their best wishes for the channel and as usual, do not shy away from leg-pulling. Add to that, Indian Idol’s famed singer - Salman Ali’s melody, nakli Sidhu Paaji’s dhamaal, Bachchan sahab’s grandeur, Sunny’s dhai kilo ka haath, and much more. Enjoy this super funny episode to see the team’s antics.

episodesList.title: Beautiful Poonam,  Gorgeous Padmini
episodesList.summary: A huge shout out to the two beautiful Bollywood divas, who ruled hearts in the 80's era. They are none other than buddies, Poonam Dhillon and Padmini Kolhapure. When the duo catch up, fun, banter and meethi shararat go up by a notch. While Padmini is concerned about Kapil losing weight, Poonam complains that he isn't flirting enough with her. The best part is when Padmini says that Jackie Shroff used to flirt the most, and in walks Jaggu dada. Lastly, Padmini sings so well, wow!

episodesList.title: Siblings Shararat With Huma And Saqib
episodesList.summary: Fine actor Huma Qureshi is on the show with her younger brother, Saqib. Huma wanted to be an actress from her childhood, Saqib followed suit. Saqib was photographed as a child, dressed in Huma’s ghagra. Did you know Huma just completed a film with Akshay Kumar even amidst pandemic? Huma addresses Kapil as her brother, he forgets his lines in turn! Saqib was the greedy one. Huma once hit Saqib very hard and then panicked like crazy.

episodesList.title: Shatrughan Sinha, Beyond Khamosh
episodesList.summary: Better known for his action roles, Shotgun Sinha, today seems to be in his unplugged avatar, thanks to Kapil. From his marriage proposal story to being referred to as Shatur-murg, Mr. Sinha bares it all. His Khamosh still rings fresh after years. Did you know that Shatru ji used to deliver his scenes without retakes? What happened when he forgot his wife’s birthday? Son, Luv Sinha loves his action movies over romance.

episodesList.title: Divalicious Nora, Dapper Guru
episodesList.summary: Nora Fatehi and Guru Randhawa are an absolute delight to watch on The Kapil Sharma Show. Kapil gets all flirty with Nora and asks her to be a part of his web series. Guru Randhawa spins the magic of vocals and gets everyone swaying to his tunes. Meanwhile, Shona and Baabu approach Nora to do their homework, and shake a leg with Guru and Nora. Kapil’s band gets belly dancing lessons from Nora and Guru talks about how he taught Nora some cool Bhangra.

episodesList.title: Jodi Kamaal: Genelia And Riteish
episodesList.summary: After dating for ten long years, they wedded and today, Riteish and Genelia rock the show with their laughter tales. Watch out Riteish’s funda for pheras and shapaths for a wedding. Top it with Krushna’s Himalaya comedy, to complete the laughter scene. Answering a fan, Riteish confesses that he always says sorry to Genelia during their arguments. Genelia, in turn, gets to ask only ten questions to her hubby per day.

episodesList.title: Suresh Raina, Beyond Cricket
episodesList.summary: Suresh Raina, the skilled cricketer is in his fun avatar along with his wife, Priyanka. Suresh and Priyanka's child was born on the day lockdown started. Thus, Priyanka steps out of the house after ten months, thanks to Kapil's invitation. Suresh tried his hands at household chores during lockdown. Interestingly, Priyanka’s father was Suresh’s cricket coach. Was this a prelude to their wedding? Ever thought what do the cricketers’ wives do if their better halves don't score well? Keep watching.

episodesList.title: Laughter Crackers By Team Laxmii
episodesList.summary: The much awaited movie, Laxmii's star cast, Akshay Kumar and Kiara Advani, are here, and oh, what fun! From signature steps of ‘Burj Khalifa’ to holding an adalat, the duo does it all, with unfiltered fun and masti. Amid laughter bouts, team Kapil Sharma also has gifts for Akshay, to celebrate his silver jubilee. Watch out for the saree task and Kiara’s singing. The real life Laxmi joins the show and voices a strong message on behalf of the transgender community’s acceptance in society.

episodesList.title: Bulk Masti With Remo’s Gang
episodesList.summary: Remo brings his dance gang to the show and they talk about the making of the music video, Log Kya Kahenge, along with their other lockdown stories. Remo today is a trendsetter to those who thought dancing ain’t no good as a career. Amid Kapil’s non-stop humour, Punit gets a baraat wala rehearsal for his wedding, which is round the corner. While Sapna’s Garmi step is drool worthy, Bumper has found a match in Dharmesh!

episodesList.title: Chhalaang Stars In The House!

When Rajkummar comes to ask for Titli’s rishta, there’s total madness around. Was Nushrratt Bhuri’s college mate? Rajkummar ran away to Mumbai for Boogie Woogie and used to sit outside Shah Rukh Khan’s house. Today he mimics SRK like a pro. Later, actor-director, Divya Khosla Kumar and Singer, Darshan Raval join in, to complete the fun scene.

While Govinda creates a maahol with his unfiltered chit-chats, Bachcha brings his new friends to entertain the comedy king.

title: Kuch Rang Pyar Ke Aise Bhi
wikiTitle: Kuch Rang Pyar Ke Aise Bhi
summary: Kuch Rang Pyar Ke Aise Bhi (transl. There are some colors of love like this too) is an Indian Hindi-language romantic drama television series which aired on 29 February 2016 to 2 November 2017 on Sony TV. It stars Erica Fernandes, Shaheer Sheikh and Supriya Pilgaonkar. The second season of the show aired from 25 September 2017 to 2 November 2017 lasting for 26 episodes. A third season Kuch Rang Pyar Ke Aise Bhi: Nayi Kahaani was aired from 12 July 2021 to 12 November 2021.

soundtrack.title: Original Songs
soundtrack.composer: Soundtrack of the show were composed by Adil-Prasant. Songs were sung by Subhajit Mukherjee and Arpita Mukherjee. On 10 February 2017 the channel released a compilation of show's romantic songs on YouTube as Valentine's Day special. "Tu Mujhme Mujhse Zyaada Hai (Duet)" is one of the "Most Romantic Hindi Title Songs" among the shows telecasted by the channel.

title: Uppum Mulakum
summary:
Uppum Mulakum (transl. Salt and Pepper) is an Indian Malayalam-language sitcom that premiered on Flowers TV on 14 December 2015. The series was created by R. Unnikrishnan, who also directed the first two seasons. It follows the daily lives of Balachandran Thampi, his wife Neelima, and their children.
The series stars Biju Sopanam, Nisha Sarangh, Rishi S. Kumar, Juhi Rustagi, Al Sabith, Shivani Menon, and Baby Ameya, who joined the cast in 2018. The third season was directed by Afsal Abdul Latheef and later by Suhil Raj A. S. Parvathy Ayyappadas joined the series in 2023 portraying Diya, the wife of Vishnu; both characters later exited following the conclusion of the second season. In 2025, Sidharth Prabu joined the cast in the third season as Sidhu, the husband of Lakshmi (Lechu), following the character's return from Dubai.
The series completed 1,000 episodes in 2019 and crossed 2,000 episodes on 27 June 2025, becoming the longest-running Malayalam sitcom. Juhi Rustagi exited the series in 2019 after episode 1,013 and later returned in the second season.
Uppum Mulakum received the Kerala State Television Award for Best Comedy Show in 2017.

title: Siya Ke Ram
summary: Siya Ke Ram (transl. Sita's Ram) is an Indian devotional television series, starring Madirakshi Mundle, Ashish Sharma and Karthik Jayaram. It was produced by Nikhil Sinha under Triangle Film Company. The serial presents the epic Ramayana, depicting the story of Lord Ram and Devi Sita from Sita's perspective. On 16 November 2015, it was premiered on Star Plus.
plot: The main plot is taken from the Hindu epic Ramayana, which was written by Sage Valmiki, and Adbhuta Ramayan, and follows the story through devi Sita's perspective.

episodesList.title: Janak's Daughter, Sita Arrives!
episodesList.summary: Janak is childless! His kingdom, Mithila has had a drought for 12 years. Elsewhere, Ram and his brothers are under the tutelage of Guru Vashisht. Janaka builds a golden sickle and unearths a baby girl, as he begins to plough! The baby's first cry leads to rainfall!

episodesList.title: Baby Sita Lifts Shiv Dhanush!
episodesList.summary: Janak wants to be ensured if the baby has a family. He is shocked to see the baby lift Shiv Dhanush. A sage suggests Janak to keep the baby. Janak decides to name her, Sita. Dasharath is eager to meet his sons. Janak and his family watch a play performed by Sita and her sisters.

episodesList.title: Dasharath Visits Guru Vashisht
episodesList.summary: Sita plays Goddess Durga in a skit. Janak admires her performance. Dasharath visits Guru Vashisht's ashram. He shares with the Guru, his guilt of accidentally killing Shravan Kumar. Later, Dasharath watches his sons display their combat skills in a competition.

episodesList.title: Ram, Sita Impress Parents
episodesList.summary: Dasharath watches Ram excel in the archery and combat tests conducted by Guru Vashisht. Elsewhere, Sita impresses her family by making mud figures. Yogini Sulabha visits Mithila to test Janak. She blesses Sita and predicts Mithila to become the centre of spiritual learning in the days to come.

episodesList.title: Dasarath Spends Time with Ram
episodesList.summary: Dasarath enjoys a hearty meal with his sons. Ram notices a wound on Dasarath's foot and tends to it. Dasarath recalls Ram's childhood. Elsewhere, Sunaina teaches Sita how to cook. Kaushalya is sad thinking about Ram's sister, Shanta. Ram has a vision of Lord Vishnu in his dream.

episodesList.title: Gautam To Tutor Sita
episodesList.summary: Ram talks to Guru Vashisth about his nightmare. Elsewhere, Maharishi Gautam tells Janak that he wants to become Sita's Guru. Janak announces in the gyan sabha of rewarding the most knowledgable person with 1000 cows. Janak is worried learning that the cows have run away.

episodesList.title: Sita Questions Gautama Rishi
episodesList.summary: Sita and her sisters go through the forest to look for the missing cows. A Brahmin warns her against roaming in the woods since Ahalya's ashram is located there. He tells her that Ahalya had been cursed by Gautam Maharshi. Sita returns home with the cows. Later, she questions Rishi Gautam about his curse.

episodesList.title: Ram and His Brothers Return Home
episodesList.summary: Sita learns that a prince from Raghu's clan will end Ahalya's curse. Janaka decides to send Sita to a Gurukul and consoles a worried Sunaina. Ram and his brothers take leave of Guru Vashisht and begin their journey home. Sita’s sister, Shurtakirti is startled by a serpent while enjoying a game.

episodesList.title: Ram Returns to Ayodhya
episodesList.summary: A pandit curses Rishi Jabali. Ram, Laxman, Bharat and Shatrughan arrive in Ayodhya. Rishi Jabali is happy that Ram remembers him. Dasharat tells Ram and his brothers that they can meet their mothers after the puja. Janak is worried that King Sudhanwa will attack Mithila.

episodesList.title: Ram and Brothers Visit Mothers
episodesList.summary: Janak learns that King Sudhanva is about to attack Mithila. Kaushalya recalls Ram's childhood and feels upset about not meeting him. Ram and his brothers enter the palace and visit their mothers. Sumitra tells them about the yagna performed by Dasharath for their birth.

episodesList.title: Kaikeyi's Happy To See Ram
episodesList.summary: Sita expresses her wish to set up a nursing camp if Sudhanva wages a war against Mithila. Manthara tries in vain to poison Kaikeyi's mind against Ram. Later, Kaikeyi is overjoyed to see Ram. Kaushalya meets Ram and embraces him. Sita comforts her sisters as they worry about the war.

episodesList.title: Ram Attends Royal Court
episodesList.summary: Ram and his brothers are unable to sleep in the luxurious place. They change into their Gurukul clothes and sleep peacefully on the floor. Sita consoles her sisters Shrutakirti and Manvi as they worry about the war. Ram is upset to see the special treatment offered to the dignitaries in his court.

episodesList.title: Ram Has A Sister, Shanta!
episodesList.summary: Janak tells Sunaina that his brother Kushadwaj is about to gain victory over Sudhanva. Rama visits the atheist sage Jabali. Sita is upset as her cousins will be relocating to the new kingdom. Ram finds the idol of his sister Shanta. Kaushalya reveals to Ram that he has a sister!

episodesList.title: Ram Makes a Vow
episodesList.summary: Kaushalya tells Ram about his sister Shanta. She tells him that Rishi Shringa had performed a yagna for his birth. The yagna had to be performed by a householder. Shanta had gone to Sringeri to marry the Rishi and bring him to Ayodhya. Ram vows to make Kaushalya meet Shanta.

episodesList.title: Kaushalya to Meet Shanta?
episodesList.summary: Ram asks Dasharath about Shanta. Dasharath remembers Shanta's sacrifice and shares his grief with Ram. He allows Ram to take Kaushalya to see Shanta. Ram and Kaushalya reach Shringeri. Mandvi and Shrutakirti go missing.

episodesList.title: Shanta Meets Her Brothers
episodesList.summary: Sita goes in search of Mandvi and Shrutakirti. Kaushalya is happy to meet Shanta. Shanta recognises her brothers Ram, Lakshman, Bharath and Shatrughna. Meanwhile, Sita finds Mandvi and Shrutakirti. Janaka tells Kushadwaj to let Mandvi and Shrutakirti stay with him.

episodesList.title: Dasharath Ignores Kaikeyi
episodesList.summary: Kushadwaj agrees to let Mandvi and Shrutakirti stay at Mithila. Ram's family bids farewell to Shanta. Janak talks to Sita about the great Raghu clan. Kaikeyi is angry at Dasharath for being indifferent to her. Sita questions Janaka for punishing Sudhanva for invading Mithila.

episodesList.title: Ram Shows his Kind Side
episodesList.summary: Janak asks Sudhanva to return to Sankashya. Kaushalya tells Dasharath about Shanta. She apologises to Dasharath for being irresponsible. A washerman, Bhadra is overjoyed when Ram assures of helping him. Shathanand shares his woes with Sita. Sumitra tells Kaikeyi that Kaushalya is with Dasharath.

episodesList.title: Kaikeyi Waits for Dasharath
episodesList.summary: Ashwapati, Kaikeyi’s father asks Yudhjeet to visit Ayodhya and remind Dasharath about his promise. Kaikeyi asks Manthara to groom her and waits for Dasharath. She is disheartened when she learns that Dasharath will not come. Ram comforts Kaikeyi.

episodesList.title: Sita Protects Janak
episodesList.summary: Kaikeyi tells Manthara to go home for speaking against Ram. Sita decides to stop Parshuram from attacking Mithila. Kaikeyi teaches sword fighting to her sons. Janak wants to welcome Parshuram to his city. Sita picks up the Shiva Dhanush to protect Janaka from Parshuram.

episodesList.title: Parshuram Meets Janak
episodesList.summary: Parshuram assures Sita that he has not come there to harm Janak. He tells Janak that the person who will tie the thread to the Shiv Dhanush will be the eligible groom for Sita. Dashrath confronts Yudhjit and tells him that Ram will be his heir. Kaikeyi argues with Dashrath for hiding the truth.

episodesList.title: Bharat-Shatrughan Leave for Kekaya
episodesList.summary: Kaikeyi asks Yudhjit to take Bharat with him to Kekaya. But Dashrath is against her decision. Bharat tells Kaushalya that he does not want to go. Shatrughan decides to accompany Bharat to Kekaya. Sita asks Gargi to become a tutor at Maharishi Yagnawalkya's gurukul.

episodesList.title: Kaikeyi Wants Bharat as King
episodesList.summary: Bharat leaves Ayodhya. Yagnavalkya accepts Sita's request to let Gargi teach her. Kaikeyi manipulates Dasharath; wants him to make Bharat his successor. Janak decides to build a Gouri temple. Guru Vashisht asks Ram to protect the glory of the Raghus. Lord Vishnu appears before Sumitra!

episodesList.title: Ram Feels Troubled
episodesList.summary: Dashrath greets Guru Vashisht with his wives. Guru Vashish cautions him to not break his promises. Sage Vishwamitra visits Mithila and recognises Sita's divinity. He cautions Janak against a potential danger to the kingdom. Ram wishes to meet Kaikeyi. However, Kaikeyi does not open the door for him.

title: Naagin
summary:
Naagin (transl. Female serpent) is an Indian supernatural fiction television series about shape-shifting serpents produced by Ekta Kapoor under Balaji Telefilms.
The first season aired from 1 November 2015 to 5 June 2016. It starred Mouni Roy, Arjun Bijlani and Adaa Khan.
The second season aired from 8 October 2016 to 25 June 2017. It starred Mouni Roy, Karanvir Bohra, Adaa Khan, Kinshuk Mahajan and Sudha Chandran.
The third season aired from 2 June 2018 to 26 May 2019. It starred Surbhi Jyoti, Pearl V Puri, Anita Hassanandani and Rajat Tokas.
The fourth season titled Naagin: Bhagya Ka Zehreela Khel premiered on 14 December 2019, its telecast was halted from 22 March 2020 due to COVID-19 outbreak and restarted on 18 July 2020 and ended on 8 August 2020. It starred Nia Sharma, Vijayendra Kumeria, Jasmin Bhasin, Anita Hassanandani and Rashami Desai.
The fifth season aired from 9 August 2020 to 6 February 2021. It starred Surbhi Chandna, Sharad Malhotra and Mohit Sehgal.
The sixth season aired from 12 February 2022 to 9 July 2023 and starred Tejasswi Prakash, Simba Nagpal, Mahek Chahal, Pratik Sehajpal, Shrey Mittal and Vatsal Sheth.
The seventh season aired from 27 December 2025 to 14 June 2026. It starred Priyanka Chahar Choudhary and Namik Paul.
The eighth season is scheduled to release in 2027.

episodesList.title: A Mysterious Woman Haunts Ritik
episodesList.summary: Rithik follows a woman in his dream and the woman turns into a snake and bites him. His mother is informed that only Rithik's marriage can save him from the impending danger.

episodesList.title: The Naagin Begins With Her Revenge Plan
episodesList.summary: Rithik's engagement at the Haveli faces unexpected obstacles. Meanwhile, the Naagins, Sesha and Shivanya, are finally free to take any form after 20 years.

episodesList.title: Sesha's Truth Revealed?
episodesList.summary: Sesha reaches the mansion disguised as a dancer and mixes poison in the drinks but no one is harmed. Yamini finds Sesha turning into a snake.

episodesList.title: Shivanya Re-enters The House
episodesList.summary: Tanvi and Hrithik's engagement is underway when Shivanya re-enters Hrithik's house with the help of Sesha. She intends to avenge her parent's death.

episodesList.title: Viren's Attempts to Get Intimate With Shivanya
episodesList.summary: Shivanya confronts Viren's advances at the Raheja house.  Ritwik rescues her from Viren's blackmail, leading to a blossoming romance between Shivanya and Ritwik.

episodesList.title: The Truth About Hrithik's Horoscope
episodesList.summary: Ankush and Yamini find a shocking poster and hide it. Hrithik claims he's marrying Tanvi for her happiness but Yamini reveals the truth about his horoscope.

episodesList.title: Conflict At The Wedding Ceremony.
episodesList.summary: Shivanya's bite thwarts Tanvi's wedding. Yamini's stunned reaction to Shivanya as the bride ignites Shivanya's revenge, forcing Yamini to accept her marriage to Rithik.

episodesList.title: A Marriage Made In Heaven
episodesList.summary: Hritik's mother arranges his marriage to Shivanya, who saved his life, instead of his beloved Tanvi. Hritik, despite his love for Shivanya, offers her freedom.

episodesList.title: An Unexpected Blessing For Shivanya
episodesList.summary: Yogiraj's blessing guides Shivanya towards love, not revenge. Meanwhile, Ankush's visions unveil Suri as the fourth culprit.

episodesList.title: Naagin Unleashed
episodesList.summary: A servant's discovery of a snake skin near the temple prompts the priest to burn it, hoping to draw the snake out. Sesha fears for Shivanya's safety and prays for her protection.

episodesList.title: Sesha to Kill Suri
episodesList.summary: Shivanya suspects Suri in her parents' death, noticing his six fingers. But Shesha, impatient, plans to kill him at the airport.

episodesList.title: Naagin's Vengance
episodesList.summary: Tanvi tells her parents that she heard Shivanya talk about revenge. Later, as Sushim informs Ankush about the Naagin's return. Shesha and Shivanya overhear their conversation.

episodesList.title: Naagin Ploys Killers Against Each Other
episodesList.summary: Shivanya takes the form of an astrologer named Ramya and warns the killers. Later, Sesha takes the form of Monisha and tricks Sailesh into seducing the real Monisha.

episodesList.title: Naagin's Close Escape
episodesList.summary: Rithik reveals his love for Shivanya, but Tanvi questions her. Guruma uses magic against Sesha, who plots Suri's death in the temple.

episodesList.title: Will Shivanya Attend The Mahakali Puja?
episodesList.summary: Suri's shock: Shivanya's at the temple! Guruma orders a 'Mahakali Puja' to expel the 'naagin', forcing Shivanya and Rithik to participate.

episodesList.title: Ritik is Poisoned
episodesList.summary: Shivanya saves Ritik from the poison given by Sesha. Later, Sesha prays for a storm which endangers Ankush's and his family's life.

episodesList.title: Shivanya Fights Mahakali
episodesList.summary: Kali Ma possesses a young girl and kills Sesha. Later, Shivanya uses the idol of Lord Shiva and pleads to Kali Ma to give back the lives she has taken.

episodesList.title: Naagin Enters The Haveli
episodesList.summary: Shivanya persuades Goddess Kali to side with the innocent snakes. Shivanya and Ritik go to the old Haveli; Sesha disrupts Guruma's prayers and bites her.

episodesList.title: Dewvdi's Secret
episodesList.summary: Shivanya and Ritik face strange happenings at the old mansion. Guruma traps Sesha in the cave. Back home, Yamini and Ankush confront them.

episodesList.title: Sesha and Shivanya Wins Yet Again.
episodesList.summary: Guruma traps Sesha. Shivanya, bitten by a snake, begs Rithik to take her to Gurumaa.  While Rithik and Gurumaa seek herbs, Shivanya rescues Sesha from the cave.

episodesList.title: The Wrong Locket.
episodesList.summary: Shivanya's secret visit to the Naagin temple is discovered by Yamini. Shesha steps in to save the day by switching lockets. Meanwhile, Kabir arrives at Ankush's to see Thanvi.

episodesList.title: Sesha Plans to Kill Sailesh Mathur
episodesList.summary: Sesha, disguised as Ankur, steals Sailesh's ring at the Kya Kool Hain Hum-3 premiere. She lures him to Shiv Mandir, setting the stage for a deadly plot with Shivanya.

episodesList.title: Kabir Kills Tanvi.
episodesList.summary: Tanvi sees Shivanya and Shesha transforming into serpents. Kabir transforms into a big Mongoose in front of Tanvi and kills her. The fake Kabir kills the real Kabir.

episodesList.title: Kabir Tries to Kill Shivanya.
episodesList.summary: Rithik grieves over Tanvi's death. Kabir tries to kill Shivanya but Gurudev saves her. Sesha and Shivanya want to find the mongoose. Kabir traps Sesha.

episodesList.title: Shivanya and Sesha Kill Kabir
episodesList.summary: Rithik tells Shivanya that he saw a dream about a diamond. Shivanya takes Kabir's watch to Guruji. A masked man comes and kills Suri's wife.

episodesList.title: Nagapanchami Day
episodesList.summary: Monisha is shot by a stranger. Shesha suspects Rithvik, but the truth is revealed - Ankush is the killer.  Nagapanchami rituals unfold in Ankush's house.

episodesList.title: Shivanya is Stabbed
episodesList.summary: Shivanya, poisoned by a dagger, fights for survival as Gurudev attempts a cure. Sesha, her transformed clone, discovers a mark on Ritik that echoes a legend in the book "Naagmani."

episodesList.title: Shivanya's Journey Through The Dark Forest
episodesList.summary: Shivanya and Shesha, vengeful ichchadari naagins, seek retribution for their parents' murder at the hands of Ankush, Viren, and others.

episodesList.title: Guruma Looses All Her Powers
episodesList.summary: Guruma's failed attacks leave the Naagin vulnerable. She races to the Rahejas for help, while Gurudev unveils the Naagmani's power to revive Shivanya.

episodesList.title: Shivanya Returns Home
episodesList.summary: Shivanya reunites with a Sesha-controlled Ritik. Rejecting his enchanted love, she forces him away, defying Remya's accusations of being a Naagin, confirmed false by Guruma.

episodesList.title: Shivanya Gets Her Powers Back
episodesList.summary: Katak and Sesha restore Shivanya's powers through ancient rituals. Lord Krishna intervenes, granting her strength. She exacts revenge on Shailesh and his men.

episodesList.title: Ritik Witnesses The Killing Of Shailesh
episodesList.summary: Shivanya's resurrected powers claim Shailesh's life. Traumatized Ritik alerts the family, leaving them shocked. Sesha aids Shivanya in retrieving the Mang Tika.

episodesList.title: Shivanya Invokes The Naagmani
episodesList.summary: Shivanya dances to awaken the naagmani, while Sesha fights to keep Ritik and Guruma away. Ankush seeks the naagmani, but the Naagins stand guard.

episodesList.title: Yamini Tries to Steal Nagmani
episodesList.summary: Yamini's attempt to steal the Nagmani from the cave fails as the auspicious time passes. She postpones her plan. Meanwhile, Shivanya rescues an unconscious Ritik from the temple.

episodesList.title: Sangram Singh Escapes From The Cave
episodesList.summary: Sangram Singh, after running away from the cave, decides to find his son at any cost. Later, he reveals that he never expected his sister Yamini to betray him and wreck his life.

episodesList.title: The Serpent's Gem
episodesList.summary: Manipulated by Yamini, Rithik seeks the serpent's gem, while Sesha and Shivanya try to stop him. But Yamini's betrayal sends Maharaj Sangram Singh to his death.

episodesList.title: Shivanya Saves Ritik's Life
episodesList.summary: Shivanya hunts her parents' killer, but the Naag mani yields no clues. Ankush attacks Ritik, thwarted by Shivanya. Sesha finds Ritik's father and the Naag mani missing.

episodesList.title: The Mystery Of The Naagmani
episodesList.summary: Guruma introduces Mayuri, her new assistant, to lure Ritik. Meanwhile, Sesha investigates the Naagmani, following in her father's footsteps.

episodesList.title: The Mysterious Powers Of Mayuri
episodesList.summary: Mayuri reveals Shesha's true form to Yamini, using a mirror and her powers.  Later, she mysteriously injures Shivanya to further expose her identity.

episodesList.title: The Duel Between Shesha and Mayuri
episodesList.summary: Shesha confronts Mayuri for secretly attacking Shivanya and tries to kill her. However, Mayuri defeats Shesha in the fight and holds her captive in an attempt to seize the nagmani.

episodesList.title: Mahishmati Race to Destroy Human Race
episodesList.summary: Sangram Singh reads an ancient book and learns that Mahishmati race is on its way to destroy the human race. Meanwhile when Mayuri captures Shesha, she gets killed by Shivanya.

episodesList.title: Finding The Fifth Murderer
episodesList.summary: Yamini's treachery is exposed when Ritik (Shesha) attacks Sangram. Shivanya, as Sangram, confronts Yamini, demanding the fifth killer's name. Yamini retaliates with accusations.

episodesList.title: The Aghoris Capture Shivanya
episodesList.summary: Shivanya, while shopping, is abducted by Aghoris and tortured in a fiery ordeal.  She loses her Mangalsutra, while Sesha's love for Ritik deepens.

episodesList.title: Ritik The Saviour
episodesList.summary: Sesha joins Shivanya's fight against the Aghoris, but gets trapped. Ritik arrives with the police, saving them and the other serpents.

episodesList.title: Yamini Plots Yet Again
episodesList.summary: Yamini manipulates Ankush to get a Naagin killed. Her tears and cunning scheme turn Shivanya against Ankush. Will they see through her deceit?

episodesList.title: Dangerous Omens
episodesList.summary: Shivanya's heartbreak deepens as Sesha nearly marries Ritik, but Ankush's arrest and Yamini's temple discovery of an unconscious Guru Maa disrupt the chaos. Sangram foresees doom.

episodesList.title: Yamini's Truth is Revealed
episodesList.summary: Shivanya chases Yamini, thief of the powerful Naagmani, into a cavern. Will Shivanya stop Yamini before she claims ultimate power?

episodesList.title: Sesha Cohorts With Yamini
episodesList.summary: Sesha and Yamini combine forces to attain the Nagmani. Later, they attempt to kill Shivanya and stop her from being a hurdle. Will they succeed in incapacitating her?

episodesList.title: Shivanya is Trapped
episodesList.summary: Shivanya, posing as Sesha, tries to seduce Ritik, but her secret's out. Fleeing Guru Maa, she must reveal a shocking truth about his parents. Will he believe her?

episodesList.title: Shivanya Confronts Sesha
episodesList.summary: Ritik's world shatters when Yamini exposes Shivanya's secret. Sesha attacks, and Yamini tricks Ritik into killing Shivanya to save their family. Can love survive?

episodesList.title: Yamini's Killing Spree
episodesList.summary: Yamini murders Shivanya, then throws Ritik into the sea. Resurrected by the shivling, Shivanya rescues Ritik. Can she find the Nagamani to save him?

episodesList.title: Ritik is Resurrected
episodesList.summary: Shivanya uses the Naagmani to save Ritik and reunite him with his father. Sesha's freedom comes at Guru Dev's cost. Yamini's evil catches up to her.

episodesList.title: Yamini Loses Her Mind
episodesList.summary: Yamini, armed and ready, hears of Ritik's return. But Ritik's fate is tied to protecting the Naagamani, not becoming a Naag. Will Shivanya finally find justice?

episodesList.title: The Sacrilegious Union
episodesList.summary: Guru Maa's dark magic summons a deadly tornado, trapping Ritik and Shivanya in ice. Ritik's rescue leads to intimacy, but at what cost?

episodesList.title: Sangram Gets Shot
episodesList.summary: Sesha's theft of the Naagmani is thwarted by Shivanya, only for Sangram (under Guru Maa's control) to steal it. A gunfight leaves Sangram wounded.

episodesList.title: Kabeer Returns to Kill Naagin
episodesList.summary: Bee-stung Sangram seeks revenge on Ritik, turning evil. Meanwhile, Kabir returns to fight the Naagins, allying with Sesha. Their shared hatred masks deeper, personal vendettas.

episodesList.title: Shivanya Comes Face to Face With Kabir
episodesList.summary: Sesha, disguised as Remya, leads Shivanya to her room. Kabir, lured by Sesha, enters to kill Shivanya. Will Ritik save her?

episodesList.title: Viren Gets Shot
episodesList.summary: Yamini finds Ritik faked-imprisoned by a Naagin. He escapes to save Shivanya, leading to a showdown with Viren and the police, ending in Viren's shooting.

episodesList.title: Shivanya Seeks Sesha's Help
episodesList.summary: A deadly attack by Sesha turns Shivanya into a snake. Kabir, a mongoose, fights Sesha, then kidnaps Ritik. Shivanya must make a dangerous deal with Sesha for Ritik's rescue.

episodesList.title: Shivanya and Sesha Kill Kabir
episodesList.summary: Shivanya and Sesha defeat Kabir, freeing Ritik. But Yamini and Sesha plot to reignite the ancient Chandravanshi-Suryavanshi feud. Can Shivanya stop them?

episodesList.title: The Wrath Of Kali Maa
episodesList.summary: Shivanya and Ritik's ritual to summon Kali Maa is interrupted by Yamini's attack. But Shivanya gains the goddess's power. Will Yamini face the wrath of Kali Maa?

episodesList.title: The Battle For The Naagmani Reaches Fever Pitch
episodesList.summary: Ritik and Shivanya face their ultimate challenge as Queen Avantika and Sesha join forces against them, threatening to steal the Naagmani.

episodesList.title: Manyataa On The Run!
episodesList.summary: To marry Keshav, Manyataa abandons her powers. Revenge follows, leaving her child as her only hope. Will they survive?

episodesList.title: Manyataa-Nayantara's Quest For Revenge!
episodesList.summary: Naagin Nayantara and her mother plot slow revenge on the Parekhs for Keshav's death. Their first target?

episodesList.title: Nayantara Lays a Wicked Trap!
episodesList.summary: Nayantara isolates Dev. Can he escape her clutches before it's too late?

episodesList.title: Nayantara Plans to Expose Dev!
episodesList.summary: Nayantara's revenge plot against the Parikhs takes a sinister turn. Targeting Dev's grandmother, she aims to expose his hidden serpent identity. Will her scheme succeed?

episodesList.title: Manyataa Awaits Her Vengeance!
episodesList.summary: Twenty-five years of plotting culminates. Mother & daughter Naagins seek vengeance.

episodesList.title: A Dilemma For Manyata
episodesList.summary: Manyata's daughter's failure delays her revenge. Will she uncover the reason and ultimately succeed?

episodesList.title: Manyata Struggles For Answers!
episodesList.summary: Seeking answers, Manyata discovers the Saprkosh's location: the Mayaavi Registaan. Her perilous journey starts.

episodesList.title: Manyata Gets Access to The Sarpkosh!
episodesList.summary: Across hills and plains, Manyata reaches the Sarpkosh; will it reveal her daughter's identity?

episodesList.title: Nayantara Vows to Destroy Brinda!
episodesList.summary: Brinda's secret threatens Nayantara, who plots deadly revenge. Manyata misses a crucial sign. Nayantara's actions spiral.

episodesList.title: Will Nayantara's Plan Bear Fruit?
episodesList.summary: Nayantara's flute compels Brinda to transform into her Naagin form, granting her control.  Will she succeed in leading Brinda to her fiery demise, or will Dev intervene?

episodesList.title: Brinda's Heartfelt Request to Dev!
episodesList.summary: Humiliated, Brinda schemes to marry Dev off, hoping to escape the fallout. Will her plan succeed?

episodesList.title: Brinda Turns Icchadhari Naagin!
episodesList.summary: Naagin Brinda intervenes as Manyata seeks revenge on the Parekh family. Will she save them or join the fight?

episodesList.title: Brinda to Help Manyata!
episodesList.summary: Nayantara's secret's out. Manyata needs Brinda's help to protect her daughter from the vengeful Parekhs.

episodesList.title: Nayantara On The Run!
episodesList.summary: The Parekhs hunt Nayantara after she escapes with Manyata's help. Will she survive their attack?

episodesList.title: Nayantara Falls Off The Cliff!
episodesList.summary: Wronged by Dev's family, Brinda vows revenge after her sister's murder.

episodesList.title: Brinda Seeks an Eye For an Eye!
episodesList.summary: A marriage proposal masks revenge. Can Dev & Brinda's families overcome this deception?

episodesList.title: Nayantara Eyes The Naagin Powers!
episodesList.summary: Nayantara seeks Vish's help to become a Naagin and defeat Brinda. The Naagmani is the key, but can she acquire it?

episodesList.title: A Deceitful Trap For Brinda!
episodesList.summary: Faced with ultimate sacrifice, Brinda seeks Manyata. Vishaka's help is a deceptive trap. Will Brinda uncover her betrayal?

episodesList.title: Vishaka Deceives Brinda!
episodesList.summary: Missing father, police arrive. Brinda's secret's exposed, but Vishaka saves her. Will Brinda trust this savior blindly?

episodesList.title: Brinda Gets a Divine Vision!
episodesList.summary: Manyata's missing from her Lal Tekdi prison cell. Brinda's vision led her there, but who thwarted her rescue?

episodesList.title: Naagin Ka Sach Aaya Bahar!
episodesList.summary: Brinda's revenge plan against Dev unravels when he catches her in the act. Their conflict escalates.

episodesList.title: Vishaka's Diabolic Plan!
episodesList.summary: Brinda hunts for Manyata, tricked by Vishaka. Jealous Dev witnesses the deception. Vishaka's goal revealed.

episodesList.title: Vishaka to End Dev's Life?
episodesList.summary: Deception and murder fuel Vishaka's quest for the Nagmani. Will Brinda save Dev from her deadly plot?

episodesList.title: Dev Defends Brinda's Honour!
episodesList.summary: Truth bombshell: Brinda's pregnancy announcement is upended by Vishaka's shocking gender change and paternity claim.

episodesList.title: Brinda to The Rescue
episodesList.summary: Vishaka's goons kidnap Dev. Brinda, fueled by fury, takes on the kidnappers alone. Can she save her husband?

episodesList.title: Brinda Loses Manyata!
episodesList.summary: Naagmani theft leads Brinda to believe Dev is the culprit. Vishaka frames Dev, harming Manyata. Who is Brinda's true enemy?

episodesList.title: Nayantara Becomes Shalakha!
episodesList.summary: Vishaka's magic transforms Nayantara into her ally. Brinda's power is their only hope.

episodesList.title: Brinda Returns to Dev!
episodesList.summary: Dev's Holi joy shatters as Brinda reveals their marriage, still valid.

episodesList.title: Brinda Threatens to Kill Nayantara!
episodesList.summary: Jealous Brinda ousts Nayantara from her bedroom after discovering her helping Dev. Was it a deliberate provocation?

episodesList.title: Shalakha Honey-traps Dev!
episodesList.summary: To win Dev, Shalakha tricks him into a honeymoon. Can Brinda stop her?

episodesList.title: Vishaka's Identity Gets Exposed!
episodesList.summary: Vishaka's revenge: Shalaka's plot against Brinda exposes her. Will truth conquer hatred?

episodesList.title: Brinda's Naagin Avatar Exposed!
episodesList.summary: Naagin Brinda's victory turns sour. Shalakha's revelation traps her. Will Brinda overcome this?

episodesList.title: Can Brinda Convince Dev?
episodesList.summary: Dev leaves family drama. Brinda's secret may make him stay.

episodesList.title: Shalakha Manipulates Dev!
episodesList.summary: Shalakha's obsession with Dev blinds her to Brinda's love. Using a stolen fragment of Dev's soul, she manipulates him to break up with Brinda. Will Brinda fight back?

episodesList.title: Brinda's Mother is Murdered!
episodesList.summary: A mother's death. A lover's deception. Brinda confronts a shocking truth.

episodesList.title: Brinda Swears to Avenge!
episodesList.summary: Dev killed Brinda's mother and plans to leave her for Shalaka. Fueled by rage, Brinda vows revenge.  Her plan unfolds now.

episodesList.title: Can Dev Protect His Family?
episodesList.summary: A Naagin's wrath descends on a wedding. Dev defends his family against Brinda's deadly quest for revenge.

episodesList.title: Naagin Legacy Unleashed
episodesList.summary: In the sacred year of the 2025 Mahakumbh, danger strikes India. Chosen as the protector, Naagin Anantha's fate will decide everything.

episodesList.title: Naagin Rescues Purvi and Anantha
episodesList.summary: Goons attack Purvi and Anantha, prompting the Naagin to protect them. Later, as the moonlight falls on Purvi, she begins to transform into the Naagin, in pain.

episodesList.title: Parmeet's Shield Against The Naagin
episodesList.summary: Purvi feels intense itching as her skin peels off during her serpent transformation. Later, Parmeet shows his friends the dragon, claiming it will protect them from the Naagin.

episodesList.title: Naagin's Deadly Battle
episodesList.summary: Purvi secretly saves a young boy using her snake powers. Later, she transforms into a Naagin as the snakes come to her aid, leading the battle against the wolf.

episodesList.title: Ravish Confesses The Truth
episodesList.summary: Samir catches Ravish with his wife and threatens Prameet. Later, Ravish admits he loves Anantha, wants to marry her, and claims the baby she carries is his.

episodesList.title: Gurinder Hunts Parmeet's Secret
episodesList.summary: Parmeet plots to expose the Maha Naag Rani, while Karan's prank tricks Purvi into confessing her love. Later, Gurinder shocks everyone by accusing Parmeet's family of being spies.

episodesList.title: Parmeet's Family Takes a Dark Turn
episodesList.summary: Parmeet accuses Anantha of being the Naagin and demands the Naag Mani. Later, his family brutally kills Gurinder's family, as Anantha reveals to Purvi that she is the true Naagin.

episodesList.title: Purvi Awakens As Naagin
episodesList.summary: Purvi rises from the mud as the Naagin and attacks the men who buried her alive. Later, Airul gives ten days to find the Naagmani, triggering a deadly hunt.

episodesList.title: Purvi Disguises As Ahana
episodesList.summary: An upset Vikram refuses the engagement with Pinky, leading to a confrontation with Aryaman. Later, Purvi disguises herself as Ahana and enters Parmeet's house as Vikram's lover.

episodesList.title: Naagin's Revenge Claims Swarna
episodesList.summary: Purvi and Vikram's engagement ceremony begins as they exchange rings. Later, Purvi transforms into the Naagin, stabs and kills Swarna, framing Samir for the crime.

episodesList.title: Samir Faces Naagin's Revenge
episodesList.summary: Under a dinner pretext, Aryaman spikes Purvi's drink to uncover her truth. Later, the Naagin attacks Samir as he is released from jail and prepares to return to his country.

episodesList.title: Ahana's Bold Defiance
episodesList.summary: Ahana confesses her supernatural identity after Aryaman exposes the video evidence. Later, she refuses to let him ruin the wedding and vows to fight back.

episodesList.title: Vikram Fumes At Aryaman
episodesList.summary: As part of the wedding rituals, Ahana and Aryaman walk seven rounds around the yagna and tie the sacred thread. Later, Vikram confronts Aryaman for marrying Ahana in his stead.

episodesList.title: Ahana's Love Becomes Her Weakness
episodesList.summary: As Ahana turns Naagin to protect the diamond, Aryaman witnesses her truth. Torn by love, she spares him and chooses a perilous path to erase his memories forever.

episodesList.title: Bharani's Plot Against Love Fails
episodesList.summary: Bharani fumes, recalling how she posed herself as Aryaman and attacked, yet failed to stop the Naagin from loving him. Later, Ahana wipes Aryaman's memory before he can expose her.

episodesList.title: Ahana Perceives Mahadev's Divine
episodesList.summary: After the Puja, Ahana performs the Shiv Tandav, believing Mahadev is guiding her to the Divya Naagin. Later, Vikram entrusts his company shares to Purav and Radhika.

episodesList.title: Bharani Faces Ahana's Wrath
episodesList.summary: Ahana lashes out at Bharani, accusing her of killing Anantha while disguised as Aryaman. Later, Ahana reminisces about Aryaman and shares her grief with Anantha.

episodesList.title: Ahana's Deadly Revenge
episodesList.summary: At a party, Aryaman and Vikram's clash turns explosive until Ahana intervenes. Later, she transforms into a Naagin and eliminates Pammi in a shocking act of revenge.

episodesList.title: Aryaman's Battle to Save India
episodesList.summary: Ahana grows cautious after finding the Mantra book as Chengistan plots against India. Later, Aryaman warns everyone about the threat and decides to inform the militant force.

episodesList.title: Can Ahana Save the Amarnath Yatris?
episodesList.summary: Amid rising danger, Ahana tries to solve the mystery of her new attacker. After overhearing about the threat to the Amarnath Yatra train, Ahana rushes to their rescue.

episodesList.title: Aryaman's Secret Past Unveiled
episodesList.summary: Ahana discovers Aryaman’s shocking past and makes a heartbreaking choice. Later, she and Bharani infiltrate a high-security centre to uncover the enemy's plan.

episodesList.title: Ahana's Deadly Discovery
episodesList.summary: Ahana discovers Aryaman's family's killers, who plan to destroy India. Later, she cleverly infiltrates Erul's base amidst creature attacks, escaping only to uncover a new enemy.

episodesList.title: The Dragon Targets Radhika!
episodesList.summary: Ahana discovers Radhika's secret and her lingering love for Aryaman. Tension heightens when Radhika gets attacked by a mysterious dragon. Who'll step in to save her?

episodesList.title: Aryaman Loves Ahana
episodesList.summary: Ahana secretly saves Tina from Dimple’s murder attempt and prepares to take revenge on the family. Later, Aryaman rejects Radhika, as he realises his love for Ahana.

episodesList.title: Ahana's Revenge Strikes Dimple
episodesList.summary: Ahana forces a terrified Dimple to do the same manual labour she once mocked. Using her Naagin powers, Ahana crushes her under stones, taking revenge.

episodesList.title: The Dragon Pearl's Secret Power
episodesList.summary: After snatching the Dragon Pearl during the battle to save the Ramos launch, Ahana realises it can remove the dragon’s illusion and reveal its true human identity.

episodesList.title: Ahana Unmasks Pinky's Fiancé
episodesList.summary: Ahana discovers that Pinky’s new fiancé is actually a dangerous dragon in disguise. She tries to warn the family, but they don't believe her and celebrate the engagement instead.

episodesList.title: Yaman's Arrival Flips the Script
episodesList.summary: Yaman's arrival stuns Ahana as events unfold unexpectedly. With the wedding just two days away, Ahana realises her plan has spiralled out of control.

episodesList.title: Bharni Falls to Ravish’s Wrath
episodesList.summary: A drugged Ahana misleads her enemies while hunting for secret papers. Meanwhile, a betrayal leaves Bharni unconscious and at the mercy of the vengeful Ravish.

episodesList.title: Ahana’s Spooky Scheme
episodesList.summary: At Mangalpur’s eerie Bhoot Bangla, Ahana plots a supernatural haunting to stall Pinky’s wedding. Parmeet falls prey to ghostly pranks, leaving the family in terror.

episodesList.title: Ahana Faces Dragon King
episodesList.summary: Guruji alerts Ahana about Dragon King Bahumath, while Yaman offers Ahana a deal to get back his dragon pearl and leave Pinky's life.

episodesList.title: Radhika's Ultimate Darkness Emerges
episodesList.summary: Pinky's wedding turns tragic when Yaman is found dead, raising Ahana's suspicions. Radhika awakens as the ultimate dragon, hinting at an epic Naagin–Dragon battle ahead.

episodesList.title: Radhika Plots Against Ahana
episodesList.summary: As power and betrayal collide, Radhika secretly weaves a dangerous plan to bring Ahana down. While Ahana senses something amiss, hidden motives and dark forces begin to surface.

episodesList.title: The Dragon Conspiracy Unfolds
episodesList.summary: Ahana fights off goons to save Tina, foiling Parmeet's plan. A shocking twist unfolds as Radhika reveals how Basha and the scientists tested on her to awaken the ultimate dragon.

episodesList.title: Aryaman Hands Divorce Papers
episodesList.summary: A tiger sent by Radhika confronts Ahana, who transforms into a naagin, sparking a fierce battle. Soon after, Ahana is heartbroken as Aryaman hands her their signed divorce papers.

episodesList.title: Ahana's Revenge Awakens
episodesList.summary: Shattered by Aryaman's betrayal, Ahana's pain turns into fierce rage as she embraces her Naagin powers. As Radhika tightens her grip and dark forces rise, Ahana vows revenge.

episodesList.title: Erul Halts the Weddings
episodesList.summary: As Ahana prepares to marry Vikram and Radhika weds Aryaman, the wedding turns dramatic when Erul storms in. Chaos erupts as hidden motives surface and loyalties are tested.

episodesList.title: Radhika’s Deadly Betrayal
episodesList.summary: Ahana reclaims her identity as the Anant-kul Naagrani and the Nagmani. However, her in-laws frame her for murder while the secretive Radhika begins targeting her.
