Anita makes Manmohan perform all the daily chores.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Gets Tired Of Serving Anita
episodesList.summary: Saxena, Malkhan and Teeka Ram gather together to harass Manmohan for being Anita's servant. Anita curses him for not helping her. Tillu sleeps next to Manmohan and realises that Manmohan is in love with Anita. Manmohan is frustrated with working like a servant. Anita wants Manmohan to distribute 1000 invitations of her grooming classes in the society personally. Manmohan wants the priest to tell Vibhuti that his presence will not hurt Anita anymore. Manmohan sees Anita and Vibhuti dance.

episodesList.title: Manmohan is Shocked to Learn About Anita's Pregnancy
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti reveals that Anita was acting unwell as she wanted to test him. Vibhuti and Anita are very happy with each other. Anita's friend arrives and they discuss Vibhuti's unemployment. She tells Anita to pretend that she is pregnant and see the changes in Vibhuti. Anita wants Vibhuti to stand on his feet as she wants him to become a respectable father. Vibhuti informs Manmohan, Teeka Ram and Malkhan that he is going to become a father. Manmohan is shocked to hear this news.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Lies to Anita About His 'hard-earned' Money
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti unsuccessfully tries to sell the life insurance policy to Teeka Ram and Manmohan. Anita knows that Vibhuti will be hurt after he gets to know the truth. Vibhuti tries to sell the policies but fails. Vibhuti steals Teeka Ram's, Malkhan's and a vegetable seller's purses and robs Manmohan's house. Vibhuti gives the money to Anita and tells her that it is his hard-earned money. Manmohan blames Tillu for stealing INR 50,000 from his bedroom, but Anita is convinced that Tillu is not the thief.

episodesList.title: Happu Mistakes David For a Hooligan
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti leaves at night to rob Saxena's house and Anita follows him. Saxena beats Vibhuti for stealing. Anita reveals that she is not pregnant. David Mishra, Vibhuti's uncle calls him and says that he will be visiting him for a day. Vibhuti asks Manmohan for help as his uncle will be arriving. Vibhuti wants Anita to stay at Manmohan's house. Happu catches David as he mistakes him to be a hooligan and takes him to Vibhuti. David tells Vibhuti that he some property for him.

episodesList.title: David Catches Anita With Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Anita stays at Manmohan’s house. David tells Vibhuti that he hates Anita. Vibhuti enquires about the property, but David ignores the topic. Tillu keeps a watch on Manmohan. Vibhuti reaches Manmohan’s house, where Anita is sleeping and spends some romantic time with her. David and Manmohan are angry to see Vibhuti with Anita. David blames Vibhuti for cheating on Angoori and decides not to give the property to Vibhuti. David speaks to Manmohan about Vibhuti and Anita’s illegitimate relationship.

episodesList.title: Anita Pretends to Make Vibhuti Her Brother
episodesList.summary: David wants Manmohan to know about Anita cheating on him. Manmohan gets confused. David speaks with Happu about Vibhuti’s extramarital affair and he thinks that Vibhuti has an affair with Angoori. Vibhuti states that he will make David give them the property. Manmohan is hurt seeing Vibhuti and Anita’s closeness. Manmohan suggests to David that he should give him some money to make Anita his sister. Anita pretends to make Vibhuti her brother, but ultimately they do not get the property.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Befirends Bhushan Babuta
episodesList.summary: Anita does not like Vibhuti chilling with Teeka and suggests that he keeps the company of reputed people to become something in life. Vibhuti promises to do so and meets the owner of Babuta builders, Bhushan Babuta. Tillu uses a fake gun to force Manmohan to give his salary, and later, realises that it is a real gun. A drunk Vibhuti returns home and tells Anita about his new friend. Vibhuti invites Bhushan home, and Anita invites Manmohan to tell him about Vibhuti and Bhushan's friendship.

episodesList.title: Bhushan Gets Smitten With Anita
episodesList.summary: Bhushan arrives home for dinner. He is smitten by Anita's looks. Anita feels uncomfortable with Bhushan's constant staring. Bhushan leaves and Anita reprimands Vibhuti for having befriended such an ill-mannered man. Anita wants Vibhuti to break his friendship with Bhushan. Ammaji and Laddoo arrive to check on Manmohan, as Tillu had complained about him. Bhushan arrives in the morning and admires Anita. He insists that Anita accept a car as a gift, but she refuses. Vibhuti misses Angoori.

episodesList.title: Anita Flirts With Bhushan
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti gets impatient to see Angoori and he enquires about her. Bhushan writes a letter to Anita and proposes to her. To make Vibhuti envious, she fakes calling Bhushan and acknowledging the gift. Vibhuti overhears this conversation and gets hurt. He shares his sadness with Manmohan. Bhushan arrives home and flirts with Anita. Anita also fakes love for Bhushan. Later, she scolds Bhushan and beats him black and blue. Anita wants Vibhuti to buy a bike and Manmohan decides to buy a vehicle.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Teaches Manmohan How to Ride a Motorbike
episodesList.summary: Manmohan tells Happu that he needs a motorbike. Vibhuti promises Manmohan that he will teach him to ride the motorbike. Vibhuti starts Manmohan's bike training from the basics wasting Manmohan's time to earn more money. Anita tells Vibhuti to get a bike anyhow. Tillu complains to Ammaji that Manmohan harasses him at night. On the second day of training, Manmohan tries to ride the bike and meets with an accident with Happu. Happu obtains money from Manmohan for riding without a licence.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Arranges a Second-hand Bike
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti continues Manmohan's bike lessons. Manmohan bangs into Happu again and Happu's second leg also gets injured. He again curses Manmohan and asks him for money as compensation. Anita decides to shut her grooming classes as she does not want to travel in a rickshaw. Vibhuti arranges a bike for Anita. Manmohan finally learns to ride the bike. He sees Vibhuti on a second-hand bike which is purchased by Manmohan's bike coaching money. Vibhuti's bike breaks down and this angers Anita.

episodesList.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Drink Saxena's Potion
episodesList.summary: Anita wants Vibhuti to be romantic. Vibhuti has strength issues, which is why he ignores her request and reads a book. Anita feels that he is making excuses. Manmohan sees someone eve-teasing Anita. He tries to save her but instead gets beaten up by the goon. Anita beats the goon to protect herself. Saxena drinks a chemical and becomes exceptionally strong defeating anyone who competes with him. Manmohan and Vibhuti steal and drink the chemical and feel the changes happening within.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Transforms Into a Wolf
episodesList.summary: The chemical seems to have a strong effect on both Manmohan and Vibhuti. Saxena informs Happu that a werewolf has attacked Malkhan. Vibhuti and Manmohan urge Happu to investigate. Malkhan describes that the animal looked like a half man and a half wolf. Vibhuti and Manmohan display signs of the werewolf. Ammaji is also injured by the wolf. Ammaji scolds Manmohan for mocking her. At night, Anita sees Vibhuti transforming into a wolf. Gulfam Kali complains that the wolf had attacked her too.

episodesList.title: Amma Ji and Anita Want to Cure Manmohan and Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Anita is scared of spending her entire life with a wolf. Ammaji and Tillu suspect that Manmohan might be a wolf. The wolf attacks another person at night. Anita summons a doctor to check whether Vibhuti is a wolf. The doctor runs away. Ammaji calls an occultist who tells her and Anita to squeeze a lemon on Manmohan and Vibhuti's heads. When Anita does so, Vibhuti tells her that he has got gas by drinking a chemical. Manmohan also tells Ammaji that he has got gas because of the chemical.

episodesList.title: Anita Overhears Manmohan Belittling Angoori
episodesList.summary: Manmohan and Vibhuti tell each other that they have got gas. Happu Singh traps them with a net saying they are the werewolves. But a policeman catches a thief dressed as the werewolf. Angoori calls Vibhuti as she is unable to reach Manmohan. Anita overhears Manmohan tell someone on the phone that she doesn't have an existence without him. Anita tells Vibhuti and everyone including Ammaji to pretend as if Manmohan doesn't exist. Ammaji plans a party for Manmohan's father's birthday.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Tries to Make His Presence Felt
episodesList.summary: Manmohan is tired of everyone pretending that he doesn't exist. So, he plans to expose their lie and beats Teeka and pushes Happu's scooter. They complain to Anita and Vibhuti. But Vibhuti assures them that everything will be fine. Subsequently, Manmohan sleeps between Anita and Vibhuti. Manmohan also goes to the washroom while Vibhuti is inside it. When he says something bad to Anita, Vibhuti goes to beat him up. Manmohan apologises to Anita. Actor Arjun Kapoor comes to promote his film.

episodesList.title: Anita's Strange Behaviour
episodesList.summary: At night, Anita takes a pastry outside the house. When Teeka queries her, she wipes it on his face. Vibhuti reads an article about women's mental illness. Manmohan tells Vibhuti that he saw Anita playing 'stapoo'. Anita denies committing such acts. Vibhuti hears Anita talk to her dead grandfather on the phone. When Manmohan says that Anita was washing vessels at his house, Vibhuti goes to check on Anita. But he sees only pillows on the bed. Just then, Manmohan and Vibhuti hear a loud scream.

episodesList.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Seek Saxena's Help
episodesList.summary: Manmohan and Vibhuti find Anita reading a magazine. Anita denies that she screamed and acts strangely later. A doctor informs Vibhuti that shock treatment can heal Anita and also suggests that Vibhuti play with her. Anita tells Vibhuti to jump from the balcony when he loses the card game. Eventually, Anita stops him from doing so. Vibhuti and Manmohan ask Saxena to treat Anita as he has recovered from his mental illness. Saxena tells them to leave him and Anita alone so that he can treat her.

episodesList.title: Anita Beats Happu
episodesList.summary: A recovered Saxena tries to treat Anita, but Anita's instability triggers instability in him, and he becomes crazy again. Manmohan blames Vibhuti's unemployment for Anita's madness. Anita calls Happu home and beats him ruthlessly. Happu sees Anita's madness and runs away. The doctor tells Vibhuti that Anita would recover if he lets her be. Anita assures Vibhuti that she has recovered, which is why Vibhuti summons Manmohan. When Vibhuti and Manmohan are at home, Anita again behaves madly.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Stops Anita From Meddling In Other's Affairs
episodesList.summary: Anita's friend Vinita tells her that her husband Vijay harasses her. Anita is shocked to hear how much Vijay has changed. Manmohan decides to help Anita to impress her and calls Vijay up and tries to threaten Vijay. But Vijay reaches Manmohan's home and beats him black and blue. Vibhuti wants Anita to stay away from other people's matters as it might land them in trouble. But Anita decides to help Vinita and invites her home. Vijay calls up Manmohan and says that he will beat him up again.

episodesList.title: Vinita Gets Attracted to Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Vinita is attracted to Vibhuti. Vibhuti maintains a distance from Vinita, but she grabs all chances to come closer to Vibhuti. As Anita and Vibhuti talk romatically, Vinita creates a scene by saying that she feels scared when couples behave intimately. Vinita makes Anita and Vibhuti act as if they are fighting, which leads to them actually fighting. Anita ignores Vinita's behaviour as she trusts her. But Manmohan makes her realise that something is cooking between Vibhuti and Vinita.

episodesList.title: Rocky and Charulata's Love Story
episodesList.summary: Anita blames all the dull people around her for her monotonous life. To add some spice in life, Anita orders Vibhuti to act as if he is a collegiate boy. Vibhuti changes his attire and turns into a boy named Rocky, and Anita acts as his girlfriend Charulata. Manmohan learns about Anita's desire and decides to join Saxena's newly started school. Teeka Ram and Malkhan join Saxena's school. The neighbours see the new look of Anita and Vibhuti and make fun of Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Anita Gets Harrassed By College Students
episodesList.summary: Anita enjoys role-playing as Rocky's girlfriend Charulata. But Vibhuti is tired of this foolish role-playing. Anita realises that people are making fun of him. Manmohan is sick of their childishness. Malkhan calls a mental hospital to get Vibhuti and Anita admitted. Anita goes to a college, wherein some students harass her. Anita tells them that she is Rocky's girlfriend and Rocky will teach them a lesson. Instead of Rocky teaching them a lesson, those students catch bash him.

episodesList.title: Anita Finds a Treasure Map
episodesList.summary: Anita finds an old letter that belongs to the landlord Sharma's ancestor. She reads it and learns that Sharma's ancestor hid gold in their house. Anita also finds out a map that guides them and learns that the gold is hidden in their drawing room. Anita makes Vibhuti dig deep all by himself as she does not want anyone to know about the treasure. Manmohan sees Vibhuti carrying a spade inside his house. The next morning, he realises that Anita is not letting anyone inside her house.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gets Stuck Underground
episodesList.summary: Happu tells Manmohan about the kidnapping of a powerful man, Sanjay Maheshwari. Manmohan suspects Vibhuti's involvement. Manmohan is curious to learn about the matter at Anita's home. He makes Saxena enter Anita's house, but Anita refuses to let him do so. Manmohan takes Happu's help to find the truth. Manmohan tells Happu that he suspects Vibhuti as Anita isn't letting anyone enter her home. Vibhuti has gone 20-feet deep and is unable to come out. Anita vainly tries to pull him with a rope.

episodesList.title: Happu and Manmohan Help Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Happu and Manmohan enter Anita's house at night. Anita makes Happu and Manmohan pull the rope, without letting them know what they pulling. But they fail to get Vibhuti out. Anita summons Teeka Ram and tells him that he would earn INR 1000 if he pulls the rope. Teeka is almost successful, but a girl distracts him, and he also fails. Anita tells Manmohan and Happu that Vibhuti is 20-feet inside the ground. They help Vibhuti come out. Soon, they all learn that the treasure was stolen years ago.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Unknowingly Hires Gulfam Kali As a Maid
episodesList.summary: Anita goes out of town and orders Vibhuti to clean the house. A saree-clad lady arrives with a veiled face. The lady tells Vibhuti to hire her as their maid. Vibhuti agrees and makes her do all the work. Manmohan is also frustrated as there is no one to cook food for him. Vibhuti uncovers the truth that the maid is actually Gulfam Kali. Soon, Anita returns home and sees the maid. She likes her work and allows her to stay. Saxena cooks spicy food for Manmohan.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Takes The Help Of Vibhuti's Maid
episodesList.summary: Manmohan wants the maid to cook for him, and Vibhuti allows him to use her service. A stranger arrives and makes the maid dance. Manmohan sees this and realises that she is Gulfam Kali. As Manmohan tries to get rid of her, Amma Ji and Tillu arrive. Manmohan tries to keep Gulfam Kali's presence a secret, but Amma Ji finds out that the lady hidden in Manmohan's kitchen is Vibhuti's maid and orders Manmohan to send her back. Manmohan and Vibhuti inform Happu about Gulfam Kali's whereabouts.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Promises to Get Angoori Back
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti tells Happu to arrest Gulfam Kali in Anita's absence. Instead of arresting Gulfam Kali, Happu gets into an argument with her. Anita returns only to learn the truth. Saxena tells Vibhuti that he misses Angoori. Vibhuti questions Manmohan to get Angoori back, but Manmohan ignores the request. Vibhuti promises to get Angoori back in two days. He tries to manipulate Amma Ji by telling her that Manmohan might molest Tillu at night due to Angoori's absence. Amma Ji slaps him.

episodesList.title: Saxena Injures Himself to Change Manmohan's Mind
episodesList.summary: Saxena jumps off his balcony to force Manmohan to get Angoori back. Manmohan ignores him. Anita is too bored to chit-chat with Manmohan. Amma Ji also suggests to Manmohan that he get Angoori back. Vibhuti tells Manmohan that he is a palmist and that he can see that Manmohan's bad time has started, because of which he should bring Angoori back. Saxena keeps injuring himself repeatedly. Happu suggests to Manmohan that he listen to Saxena or else he fears that Saxena will die.

episodesList.title: Amma Ji Catches Manmohan With Gulfam Kali
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti tells Malkhan to drop a coconut on Manmohan's head. Instead, it falls on Vibhuti's head. Vibhuti curses Malkhan for missing the target. Saxena keeps falling and injuring himself. Vibhuti makes a plan with Tillu and Gulfam Kali. Vibhuti tells Gulfam Kali to sleep next to Manmohan at night. She does so and, the following day, Amma Ji sees Manmohan sleeping with Gulfam Kali. Saxena falls once again and gets injured. Amma Ji thinks deeply about the issue. Finally, Angoori returns.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Vision Becomes Unclear
episodesList.summary: Manmohan welcomes Angoori. The next morning, Vibhuti sees a glimpse of Angoori and, in an attempt to get a clearer view, falls on the street and finds a bandaged Saxena next to him. Vibhuti's vision becomes unclear. Angoori's lunch invitation elates Saxena. Because of his foggy vision, Vibhuti makes a mess of the coffee that Anita asks him to prepare. He discloses his problem, and Anita calls a doctor. Vibhuti flirts with Angoori. The doctor gives a bleak picture about Vibhuti's vision.

episodesList.title: Anita Refuses to Abandon Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Manmohan is happy when Anita says that Vibhuti cannot come for dinner due to ill health. Vibhuti embarrasses Anita by dumping Manmohan's face in the dinner plate and sitting in Manmohan's and Angoori's lap latter. Anita sees Manmohan and Angoori romance. Manmohan objects to Daroga trying to fix a blind boy's marriage and both clamour for an opportunity with Anita upon hearing about Vibhuti's condition. In spite of Gulfam Kali cosying up to Vibhuti, Anita's trust in him remains unshaken.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Regains His Clear Vision
episodesList.summary: Angoori gets upset with Manmohan for making fun of Vibhuti's blindness. Saxena offers to be Vibhuti's eyes like Sanjay was Dhritarashtra's eyes in the Hindu epic Mahabharata. Vibhuti slaps Saxena for stating irrelevant stuff and falls off his balcony on Manmohan. Vibhuti's eyesight is restored, but Manmohan loses his. When Angoori tells Manmohan about Pehalwan going to the Himalayas and the ritual of hugging all the women thrice, Manmohan imagines hugging Anita and Vibhuti gets a brilliant idea.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Seeks Spiritual Enlightenment
episodesList.summary: Inspired by Ammaji's Pehalwan, Vibhuti gets into the mode of spiritual emancipation and looks at it as an opportunity to fulfil his desire of finally getting physically close to Angoori. Anita is hugely troubled by his wanting to give up on worldly affairs to seek enlightenment. Vibhuti perplexes Malkhan, Teeka and Tidda with his sermons. Manmohan is pleased with this change in Vibhuti and approaches Anita. During their conversation, the mention of children triggers a thought in Anita's mind.

episodesList.title: Baba Gadgadanand's Followers Abduct Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Daroga gets excited on hearing from Malkhan and Teeka about Vibhuti's plans. When Saxena hears about Vibhuti's plan, he tells Daroga and Manmohan that he will take care of Anita. Anita expresses her desire to become a mother, but engrossed in Angoori's thoughts, Vibhuti denies her the privilege. The next day, when Vibhuti is leaving the house, Angoori brings a 'rakhee' for him as part of the ritual, which promptly makes him alter his plan. Vibhuti is taken away by Baba Gadgadanand's followers.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti to Make an Adult Film
episodesList.summary: Anita wants Vibhuti to find for himself a job and suggests a waiter's job. Vibhuti feels insulted. Vibhuti's friend Prem introduces him to a businessman, Amar Singh Khusatiya, who asks Vibhuti to make adult films for him for which he offers him INR 10 lakhs. Although hesitant initially, Vibhuti takes the advance. Manmohan gets lured into accepting the main lead, but Ammaji scolds him. Anita is unhappy that Gulfam Kali and not she is being considered as the actress as the main lead.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Promise to Anita and Angoori
episodesList.summary: To impress Anita, Manmohan pays Teeka and Malkhan to act as his fans. Angoori wants to act in Vibhuti's film, and Vibhuti takes her audition, which is interrupted by Saxena. Vibhuti hires Saxena as his associate director and asks him to sign Gulfam Kali. Vibhuti holds the first rehearsal session with his actors. Gulfam Kali delivers her dialogues with near perfection, but Manmohan is confused. Vibhuti promises both Anita and Angoori that he will give them special roles in his film.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gets a Bad News
episodesList.summary: Manmohan pesters Saxena to tell him about his character in the film. Malkan and Teeka get a role in Vibhuti's film. Daroga takes money from Vibhuti. Vibhuti holds a workshop with his actors. Manmohan is unhappy with Anita's casting as his sister. Vibhuti objects to Anita interfering with his creativity. Vibhuti is shocked when Prem tells him that Khusatiya has been arrested for looting a bank and all his associates have come under the police scanner. Manmohan's stinginess displeases Angoori.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Pretends to be Charitable
episodesList.summary: Seeing the high electricity bill, Anita wants to cut down the usage. Trying to impress Angoori, Vibhuti stages a phone call to portray his charitable nature. The beggar overhears Vibhuti and takes the money that Anita had given Vibhuti to pay the electricity bill. Angoori reveals Manmohan's black money. Anita gets upset with Vibhuti for treating everyone at the tea stall. The next day, to impress Angoori, Vibhuti donates his pressure cooker, and Angoori spills the beans in front of Anita.

episodesList.title: The Mishra House Gets Raided
episodesList.summary: Daroga and Manmohan are worried about their black money. Angoori sees Vibhuti donating Anita's sarees and household items. Manmohan and Daroga keep their money safe in Anita's house. Anita sees Gulfam Kali in her saree and asks Vibhuti to bring her stuff back. Manmohan films Vibhuti begging everyone to return his stuff and shows the video to Angoori and Anita. In the income-tax raid at the Mishra house, Daroga and Manmohan's cash is seized. The electricity is disconnected from the Mishra house.

episodesList.title: Baba Kamukanand Helps Vibhuti and Manmohan
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and Manmohan are upset as their love interests do not reciprocate their love. Vibhuti and Manmohan see a TV ad stating the magical powers of Baba Kamukanand, who specialises in turning around one-sided love. Vibhuti and Manmohan lie to each other about the reason for visiting the Baba and get a stone from him. Baba instructs them to hit their love-interest's husband. While they wait for the opportunity to do so, feeling romantic, Angoori and Anita take their husbands to their bedrooms.

episodesList.title: Baba Kamukanand's Trick Fails
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and Manmohan throw the stone at each other but experience the opposite effect. Angoori ignores Vibhuti as Ammaji tells her not to talk to any man other than her husband. Mistaking Manmohan for a greengrocer, Anita yells at him. Manmohan and Vibhuti revisit Baba Kamukanand, who gives them five marbles each to bury in each other's courtyard at midnight. They meet Daroga at Babaji's site. Daroga too has designs on Anita and comes to place lemons under her pillow as instructed by Babaji.

episodesList.title: Angoori Ends Up Slapping Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Anita beats Daroga, thinking that he is a thief. Vibhuti and Manmohan thrash him too. Daroga escapes before anyone can see his face. Vibhuti and Manmohan bury the marbles in each other's courtyard and justify their act. The next day, on Ammaji's instructions, Angoori slaps Vibhuti for the betterment of Manmohan's business. Playing a prank on him, Anita ridicules Manmohan. The dejected men visit Baba Kamukanand where they meet a battered Daroga. Anita apprises Angoori about the fraudster Baba.

episodesList.title: Manmohan's Misunderstandings
episodesList.summary: Manmohan and Vibhuti try to make the chapati for the black dog. At night, Vibhuti and Manmohan search for the black dog but instead encounter Saxena, who guides them to the black dog. To test their success, Vibhuti and Manmohan approach their love interests but meet with disappointment. The fraudulent Baba Kamukanand is jailed. Manmohan overhears Anita narrating a story penned by her and thinks that she has a hole in her heart. An aggrieved Manmohan meets Vibhuti at the tea stall.

episodesList.title: Anita Makes a Plan Of Her Own
episodesList.summary: Manmohan breaks the news of a hole in Anita's heart to Vibhuti and Daroga. Manmohan consoles Vibhuti, and Angoori too learns about the tragedy. Vibhuti contacts a heart specialist. Realising the error, Anita makes a plan with Angoori wherein she tells Vibhuti and Manmohan that the only way out is a male heart to be transplanted in her and her heart with the pacemaker in the donor's body. Anita is amazed to see everyone clamouring to donate their heart and thanks them. Angoori reveals the truth.

episodesList.title: Angoori's Previous 'husband' Returns
episodesList.summary: Ladoo and Angoori make fun of Manmohan's childhood photos. Angoori cries when Manmohan tells her that his marriage was fixed with the beautiful girl in the photo. Bhoorey Lal states the return of the goon Dhinger, who Angoori was married to in her childhood. Dhinger demands that Angoori should be returned to him. Angoori refuses to go. Bhoorey Lal consumes alcohol, and Vibhuti and Anita try to convince him against child marriage. Vibhuti encounters Dhinger, who possesses a gun.

episodesList.title: Anita's Challenge to Dhinger
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti, Bhoorey Lal and Manmohan get drunk. A drunk Bhoorey Lal tells Vibhuti that had he met him earlier, he would have got Angoori married to him. Manmohan confesses his love for Anita. Teeka gives Dhinger Angoori's address but, by mistake, he lands up at Anita's house. Scared of Dhinger's gun, Bhoorey Lal reveals Angoori's address. Angoori confronts Dhinger and introduces Manmohan as her servant. Anita tells Dhinger to narrate a joke to Angoori and, if she does not laugh, to leave her alone.

episodesList.title: Angoori Thrashes Dhinger
episodesList.summary: Angoori laughs at a joke that Manmohan had narrated earlier, and Dhinger assumes that he has won her heart. He prepares to take Angoori. Vibhuti and Manmohan incite Daroga to nab Dhinger, but Dhinger and Daroga turn out to be old friends. Manmohan thrashes Bhoorey Lal mistaking him for Dhinger. Anita thinks of a plan. As part of a ritual, Angoori tells Dhinger that if he cannot withstand her beating, she will not go with him. Everyone encourages Angoori to thrash Dhinger, who is unaffected.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Opens a Juice Stall
episodesList.summary: Using all her might, Angoori thrashes Dhinger, who reels under her slaps. Bhoorey Lal's priest informs him that Dhinger and Angoori's marriage ceremony was incomplete. Daroga takes Dhinger. Anita finds an assistant manager's job for Vibhuti, but his ego doesn't allow him to report to his collegiate colleague. Overhearing Angoori's desire to have fresh juice, Vibhuti opens a juice stall opposite her home. Anita is unhappy with Vibhuti's new venture. Tillu threatens Manmohan to pay him his salary.

episodesList.title: Anita and Vibhuti Sabotage Vibhuti's New Business
episodesList.summary: Anita shares her woes regarding Vibhuti's job situation with Manmohan and seeks his help to close Vibhuti's juice stall. While Anita takes Vibhuti inside the house, Manmohan mixes a loose-motion medicine in the juice. Malkhan, Teeka, Saxena and Daroga drink the juice and get an upset stomach. Angoori vouches for Vibhuti's juice's purity. A dejected Vibhuti has to shut shop. Anita discloses that she is the culprit and learns that the person who was to hire Vibhuti has been thrown out of his job.

episodesList.title: Ladoo Plans His Abduction
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti asks Anita to lend him INR 50000, which will let him secure a job. When Anita refuses to lend him money, Vibhuti asks Manmohan for help. As Manmohan insults Vibhuti, he decides to kidnap Ladoo to extort money from Manmohan. Tillu is frustrated as a greedy Manmohan refuses to pay him his wages. Ladoo devises a plan with Tillu to have himself kidnapped and teach his greedy brother a lesson. Vibhuti's plan fails when Tillu kidnaps Ladoo from his house instead of Teeka and Malkhan.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gets Accused Of Kidnapping Ladoo
episodesList.summary: Angoori is worried about Ladoo's safety. When Daroga Happu starts investigating the kidnapping, Anokhelal reveals that he saw Vibhuti, Malkhan and Teeka talking about kidnapping. Happu confronts Malkhan and Teeka. Malkhan and Teeka reveal the truth, and Vibhuti confesses his plan to kidnap Ladoo. Meanwhile, Tillu calls Manmohan to demand the ransom. Vibhuti feels responsible and decides to pay the ransom. Tillu is caught red-handed when Angoori meets him to deliver the ransom.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Swiss Bank Account
episodesList.summary: Manmohan flirts with Anita and shows off with a costly diamond ring he purchased for Angoori, which makes Vibhuti jealous. Vibhuti reads in the newspaper about the leaked list of people who have black money in Swiss bank accounts. Vibhuti, to impress Angoori, lies to her that he has crores of rupees in his Swiss bank account. When Angoori and Manmohan tell Anita about Vibhuti's Swiss bank account, she angrily demands INR 20 crore in cash. Manmohan calls the cops to expose Vibhuti's lies.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Tries to Hide From The Cbi
episodesList.summary: Manmohan and a CBI officer arrive at Vibhuti's house. Vibhuti asks Angoori to hide him from the officer, but she refuses to associate herself with a criminal. Vibhuti turns to Malkhan and Teeka for help, but they demand money in return. Vibhuti hides from the officer in Angoori's bedroom. Manmohan kicks Vibhuti out of the house. The CBI officer confronts Vibhuti, but a news report clears Vibhuti's name. Manmohan's initials are in the new list of black money suspects given in the news report.

episodesList.title: Angoori Tends to Vibhuti's Injury
episodesList.summary: Manmohan is embarrassed in front of Anita when Ladoo and Saxena play a prank on him. Vibhuti learns that Angoori loves pranks and decides to scare her for fun. When Manmohan visits Anita to apologise, he learns that she loves swings. Angoori gets startled by Vibhuti and hits him. Manmohan builds a swing for Anita to impress her. Angoori applies medicine on Vibhuti's wounds. Manmohan and Anita play on the swing. Later, Ladoo pranks Manmohan, Vibhuti and Happu again by feeding them spoiled food.

episodesList.title: A Heat Stroke Affects Kanpur
episodesList.summary: Kanpur reels under the effect of extreme heat. Anita's skin turns red in the heat. She demands that Vibhuti bring a cooler, but the coolers and air conditioners are out of stock. Angoori bathes frequently for relief. With the electricity gone, the Tiwaris and the Mishras spend the night outdoors. Manmohan uses the 'hand-fan' to relieve Anita's suffering and Vibhuti does likewise to Angoori. In the morning, Daroga brings the news of the forecasted escalation of heat in the next three days.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan Steal a Cooler
episodesList.summary: Daroga faints due to the heat. Saxena dresses up like a sheikh and proclaims that the world is going to turn into a dessert. Ammaji sits on an ice slab and instructs Angoori not to step out of the house. Vibhuti sprays water on Angoori and gets ice cream for her, which melts on the way. On learning from Teeka about Masterji's cooler, Manmohan and Vibhuti steal the cooler and make a pact to share it. Manmohan brings it home but gets irritated upon getting disturbed by Tillu and Ladoo.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Lies About The Cooler to Masterji
episodesList.summary: The Mishras arrive at the Tiwari house to sleep surrounded the cool air of the cooler. Masterji arrives to teach Ladoo and enquires about the cooler. Vibhuti distracts him with his lies that he and Manmohan have bought the cooler from Delhi. Daroga is given the responsibility of finding the stealer of Masterji's cooler. Teeka and Malkhan, who know who the thief is, blackmail Manmohan into sleeping in the cool air of the cooler at the Mishra residence in spite of Angoori and Anita's objection.

episodesList.title: David Arrives Unannounced At The Mishras
episodesList.summary: Masterji threatens to fail the police commissioner's son in the exams, which spurs Daroga into action to find the cooler's thief. Masterji states his suspicion regarding Manmohan. Vibhuti's uncle David arrives unannounced while everyone is sleeping at the Mishra house and creates a ruckus about Manmohan sleeping next to Angoori while Anita is with Vibhuti. While being questioned about the cooler, Manmohan places the blame on Vibhuti. Chachaji supports Vibhuti and drives Daroga and Masterji away.

episodesList.title: Things Heat Up In Tiwaris' and Mishra's Lives
episodesList.summary: Chachaji suffers from acute indigestion. Chachaji is scared of two things, his wife and Ammaji. Ammaji arrives unannounced and questions the sleeping arrangement. Ammaji and Chachaji do not realise each other's presence. Anita overhears the cooler's truth, and she and Angoori insist that the cooler be returned. Daroga takes a bribe from Manmohan and Vibhuti to remain silent, but on hearing the truth, Masterji uses his stick on them. Chachaji returns, and everyone gets a respite with the rain.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gets Bitten By a Donkey
episodesList.summary: Angoori loves donkeys and narrates to Vibhuti about her pet donkey Jhabra. A donkey bites Vibhuti. The doctor, who has been bitten by a cat, behaves like one. Daroga narrates his experience of being bitten by a horse. A boy exhibits canine behavioural pattern after having been bit by one. Vibhuti's strange urge to eat grass and braying worries Anita, which she shares with Manmohan. Angoori encourages Vibhuti to eat a plant and shows affection towards him.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Pretends to Behave Like a Donkey
episodesList.summary: Anita gets angry with Manmohan for making fun of Vibhuti. Manmohan feels happy on hearing about Vibhuti's behaviour from Angoori. Vibhuti discloses to Prem his pretence of turning into a donkey to win Angoori's heart. Manmohan gleefully makes Vibhuti carry Angoori's heavy bags as Jhabra would, and Ladoo too makes fun of him. Anita gets worried on seeing a donkey's tail in her bed. Hand in glove with the doctor, Vibhuti carries on the pretence. Manmohan invites the Mishras for dinner.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Donkey Tail Comes Out
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti's donkey sounds anger Anita. Vibhuti refuses to eat human food and, due to the grass that he eats, he complains that he is suffering from a stomach ache. Manmohan apprises Daroga about Vibhuti's state and comes to the Mishra residence, where Vibhuti kicks them out. Daroga brings Chedi Dhobhi to take Vibhuti with him and, in the tussle that ensues, Vibhuti's artificial tail comes out, exposing his pretence. Manmohan hears about Anita's fetish for old mature men and decides to enamour her.

episodesList.title: Mamohan's Venture Into 'ageing'
episodesList.summary: Manmohan dyes his sidelocks grey. Bhoorey Lal apprises Angoori about her aunt being duped into marrying a much older man. Angoori gets suspicious on seeing Manmohan's sidelocks and asks him to eat the sugarcane. Manmohan suffers from a toothache and refuses to do so, but she insists that he break a walnut with his teeth. His tooth breaks. Manmohan's mature look impresses Anita, who accepts his friendship proposal. Manmohan asks Daroga for a fake birth certificate that states his age as 60.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Angoori Find Manmohan's Birth Certificate
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti asks Angoori to confirm Manmohan's age. Anita and Manmohan enjoy their night walk. Manmohan impresses Anita with his fake interest in poetry and reading. Manmohan shows his fake birth certificate to Anita. Anita ridicules Vibhuti and calls him immature. Angoori lays her hand on Manmohan's birth certificate and shows it to Vibhuti, who confirms her worst fears. An upset Angoori confronts Manmohan, who does not deny his old age. Anita asks Manmohan to accompany her to a classic film.

episodesList.title: Bhoorey Lal and Ammaji Question Manmohan
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti presents a grim picture of the future with an old Manmohan to Angoori and calls Bhoorey Lal. Anita invites the Tiwaris for dinner. An irritated Vibhuti feeds Manmohan bitter gourd, which is meant for an old man. Angoori and Vibhuti get bored of Manmohan's senseless poetic recital. Bhoorey Lal and Ammaji arrive and question Manmohan's act. Manmohan gets disheartened as Anita remembers her father on seeing him and reverts to his real self. Angoori shocks him by dressing up as an old woman.

episodesList.title: V-man Saves Angoori
episodesList.summary: Angoori watches a superhero film and tells Manmohan that he is her superhero. Manmohan feels insulted with her reasons for him being her superhero. Vibhuti overhears their conversation and decides to impress Angoori. Anita ridicules Vibhuti for watching 'Spider man'. Putting his plan into action, Vibhuti gets a superhero's attire stitched and rescues Angoori from the two goons hired by him. He reveals himself as 'V-man'. When Angoori tells Manmohan about Vibhuti, he complains to Anita.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Sob-story Wins Anita's Trust
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti impresses Angoori by aiming the samosa with precision into Manmohan's mouth. Vibhuti wins Anita's trust by narrating a sob story about Saxena's passion for the superhero, which compelled him to become one. Anita feels proud of Vibhuti's good-naturedness. Manmohan is irritated by Angoori's constant praise of the superhero. Saxena puts across his conditions to collaborate with Vibhuti in his charade. Manmohan overhears Vibhuti when he visits the tailor to alter his superhero attire.

episodesList.title: Jallara Beats Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti parades in his V-man's outfit in front of Anita. Saxena interrupts their romantic interlude. To expose Vibhuti, Manmohan hires the huge Jallara. When Jallara teases Angoori, she goads Vibhuti into using his superhero powers to beat him. Vibhuti gets beaten instead. Anita tends to Vibhuti's wounds and asks him not to discard the V-man's costume. Manmohan goes out of town and appoints Saxena to guard Angoori, especially from Vibhuti. An irritated Vibhuti vents out his frustration on Anita.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Falls Prey to His Own Scheme
episodesList.summary: Teeka tells Vibhuti about a romantic film. Anita coaxes Vibhuti into seeing the film. Vibhuti tries means to meet Angoori, but luck doesn't favour him. Saxena catches him impersonating Manmohan on the phone. Later, when Vibhuti hides behind a burkha, he is forced to reveal himself in front of Daroga. He puts sleeping pills in Anita's juice so that he and Angoori can go for the film. While Vibhuti falls off to sleep after drinking the spiked juice, Anita and Angoori go for the film with Manmohan.

episodesList.title: The Mishras' Haunted House
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti's nightmare comes true when their landlord Mr Sharma wishes to sell the house and expects them to vacate. Manmohan and Vibhuti are upset about being separated from their love interests. They devise a plan to drive the prospective buyer away by portraying that the house is haunted. The buyer turns out to be a tantrist and leaves a voodoo doll in the Mishra house, which causes havoc. The buyer tells them that he isn't interested in the house. Mr Sharma too has no need to sell the house.

episodesList.title: Saxena Turns Into Rj Maddy
episodesList.summary: Saxena makes inroads in everyone's hearts as RJ Maddy of Chirand Radio. Manmohan gets irritated due to Angoori getting stuck to her radio. Anita ignores Vibhuti while engrossed in RJ Maddy's programme. RJ Maddy gives on-air advice to Tillu, who complains about Manmohan. On the pretext of seeking his blessings, Tillu threatens Manmohan to pay his pending salary. Datroga gets emotional while listening to RJ Maddy. Vibhuti feels neglected. RJ Maddy advises Teeka, who seeks feminine attention.

episodesList.title: Saxena Wants Vibhuti to be an Rj
episodesList.summary: Anita's indifference towards Vibhuti disheartens him. RJ Maddy advises Tillu to use a knife, which he does against Manmohan and extracts INR 1000. Daroga refuses to lodge Manmohan's complaint against RJ Maddy. Vibhuti realises that Saxena is RJ Maddy and gives him a paan to tamper with his voice. Everyone eagerly awaits RJ Maddy's programme. But having lost his voice, Saxena calls Vibhuti, who had earlier stated his experience as an RJ, to take over for the sake of his fans.

episodesList.title: Rj Rocky's Advice to His Fans
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti takes over the radio station as RJ Rocky. He impresses Angoori and Anita and gives a Tillu a solution to extract his money from Manmohan. Tillu threatens Manmohan with a hockey stick. Anita questions Vibhuti's whereabouts at night. Anita calls Prem the next night to check on Vibhuti and suspects that Prem is lying to her. Vibhuti promises to mention Angoori's name on the radio. Daroga tells Manmohan about DJ Rocky's formula, which has helped him to win his love interest's heart.

episodesList.title: Rj Rocky is Held Responsible For Teeka's Death
episodesList.summary: Manmohan takes RJ Rocky's advice to win his lady love's heart. Anita suspects Vibhuti's activities. Manmohan's gesture of giving a red rose and planting a kiss on Vibhuti's cheek confirms her worst fears. She shares her concern with Angoori. Daroga gets suspended after following RJ Rocky's advice. Anita follows Vibhuti to Saxena's house and realises the truth. The Tiwaris inform the Mishras about Teeka's suicide after following RJ Rocky's advice. Vibhuti encounters Teeka's ghost.

episodesList.title: Kachcha Baniyan' Gang Loots Daroga
episodesList.summary: Kanpur is being looted by a 'Kachcha Baniyan' gang of two members, who attack at night dressed in underwear and a vest. Vibhuti sees Manmohan dressed similarly as he sneaks out at night. He sees Tillu with Manmohan the next night. Angoori gets angry with Vibhuti for bad-mouthing Manmohan. When Daroga gets looted, Vibhuti devises a plan and announces that he possesses INR 5 lakhs. While Daroga and Vibhuti catch Manmohan and Tillu, Anita informs them that the 'Kachcha Baniyan' gang has struck.

episodesList.title: Teeka's Marriage Proposal
episodesList.summary: Teeka jogs to keep himself fit as Daroga has promised to fix his marriage. Anita tells Manmohan not to make fun of him. The woman is 10 years older than Teeka and her family wants a groom with a big family with values. Anita and Angoori agree to stand in as Teeka's family and get their husbands' consent as well. All are shocked on seeing the woman's father, who is a dwarf. But the bigger shock is the lady, whom they thought was the mother, turns out to be the prospective bride herself.

episodesList.title: Teeka's Wedding is Fixed
episodesList.summary: Both parties brag about their values. Teeka informs Saraswati's father that his father has gone for a pilgrimage. When Saraswati's father insists on waiting for the father to return before confirming Teeka and Saraswati's wedding, Teeka states that he will call his father the next day. Manmohan and Vibhuti dress up Saxena as an old man and present him as the father. Saraswati's father and Saxena get along well, and the marriage is fixed. Vibhuti and Manmohan warm up for a fight over alcohol.

episodesList.title: Amma Ji Joins The Charade For Teeka's Marriage
episodesList.summary: Manmohan and Vibhuti drunkenly brawl. Anita and Angoori coax them into standing together for Teeka's wedding to take place without any hindrances. The Modern Colony celebrates Teeka and Saraswati's engagement. Manmohan handles Ammaji's surprise appearance, and she joins the charade of the fake 'family'. Malkhan too arrives uninvited. Saxena concedes to Saraswati's father's demand of Teeka owning a house before the marriage by stating that Manmohan will transfer his house in Teeka's name.

episodesList.title: Saraswati Refuses to Marry Teeka
episodesList.summary: Manmohan gets mad at Saxena for promising to name Manmohanâ€™s house in Teekaâ€™s name. Teeka promises to return the house to Manmohan after his wedding with Saraswati. Teeka announces that his wedding date is set, and everyone congratulates him. Saraswati and her father request for the wedding to take place at Manmohanâ€™s house. episodesList.title: Queen Victoria's Great-granddaughters Lisa and Sisa

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan Plan to Nab Khooni Ustra

Vibhuti and Manmohan unknowingly beat Happu Singh, who has a blade in his hand which he found on a street. episodesList.title: Angoori Flirts With Vibhuti

The solution to avoid the problem is that Angoori must flirt with other men apart from her husband. Also, Angoori cannot reveal the reason behind the flirting to anyone. Angoori flirts with Vibhuti, making him very nervous, and he runs away. Angoori is worried about what Vibhuti might be thinking about her. Angoori fakes about her falling on the ground and brings Vibhuti down to meet her.

episodesList.summary: Angooriâ€™s flirtatious behaviour shakes Vibhuti from the inside. Vibhuti learns about reports of eve-teasing by women from Happu Singh and concludes that it is Angoori. Manmohan informs Angoori that he was saved from a thunderstorm, and she informs Ammaji. Vibhuti vents out his frustration on Anita, who throws him out of the house. Vibhuti cries outside the house. He finds Angoori in front of him. Angoori makes Vibhuti drink alcohol and they dance together, while Pelu makes a video of them.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Sees Angoori Flirting With Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Ammaji advises Angoori to put more effort into flirting to keep Manmohan out of trouble. Pelu sends Vibhuti's dance video to Teeka Ram, who shows it to Happu and Manmohan. Anita apologises to Vibhuti but throws him out of the house again after Manmohan shows his dance clip. Vibhuti reveals to Manmohan about how Angoori has been behaving weirdly during nights. Manmohan decides to check on Angoori by himself. Angoori flirts with Vibhuti and gives him a 'ghunghru' to wear while Manmohan is shocked.

episodesList.title: Anita Stops Manmohan From Killing Himself
episodesList.summary: Angoori makes Vibhuti dance while Manmohan watches in shock. Anita lets Vibhuti come inside the house. However, he is thrown out again after Anita sees his dancing video. Manmohan is unable to bear the truth of Angoori and tries to hang himself, but is stopped by Anita. Manmohan informs Anita about Angooriâ€™s changed behaviour at night. Anita, now aware of the truth, decides to bring Angoori on the right path. Anita unsuccessfully tries to make Angoori realise her grave mistake.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Confronts Ammaji

Angoori kicks Vibhuti under the table. Manmohan is shocked to know that Angoori is flirting with Vibhuti on the advice of Ammaji. A shattered Manmohan asks Ammaji to visit him. Upon arrival, Manmohan confronts her in front of Vibhuti and Anita. Ammaji reveals the cure to save Manmohan from grave danger. Happu Singh catches the real culprit.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Adopts Janaki Das

episodesList.title: Manmohan Seeks Shelter At Vibhuti's House

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Clicks Manmohan's Picture With Gulfam Kali

Vibhuti admits that he had lied about catching Birju. To Vibhuti's relief, Commissioner Resham Pal fires him from the post of an Inspector.

episodesList.title: When Manmohan's Dreams Came True...

Vibhuti is unhappy to live as Manmohanâ€™s wife. Manmohan sees Saxena dressed as Yamraj and gets scared. A frightened Manmohan kisses Vibhuti on his cheeks.

episodesList.title: David Falls For The 'woman' Living With Manmohan

However, on Angooriâ€™s request, he agrees to continue with the act. David returns from London and falls in love with Vibhuti, who is disguised as a woman. episodesList.summary: Manmohan arrives at Anitaâ€™s birthday party and is smitten by her beauty. Vibhuti goes to Angooriâ€™s house and asks her to get ready quickly. episodesList.title: Anita Gets Stuck With Prem Due to The Curfew
episodesList.summary: Manmohan and Vibhuti are happy to spend the night in the company of each otherâ€™s wives. Anita asks Vibhuti to return home and bring Angoori along with him The four of them meet in the middle of the street. The mob attacks them and Anita is left alone at Angooriâ€™s house. Anita mistakes Prem for an intruder and beats him. She gets bored of listening to Prem. Vibhuti and Manmohan start drinking before the party begins. Anita is stuck with Prem as the curfew is not called off.

episodesList.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Escape to Saxena's House
episodesList.summary: Angoori catches Manmohan and Vibhuti having a drink. The curfew is still on and Anita is stuck with Prem. Vibhuti ties a rope from Manmohanâ€™s house to his house to reach home. Manmohan joins him and the rope breaks under their weight. They fall in the middle of the road and enter Saxenaâ€™s house to escape from the mob. Itâ€™s almost morning and the two are still stuck at Saxenaâ€™s house. Anita arranges for Happu Singh to get Vibhuti out of Saxenaâ€™s house.

episodesList.title: Anita's Birthday is Celebrated
episodesList.summary: As there is a curfew on the streets, Happu asks Vibhuti and Manmohan to come out of hiding to celebrate Anita's birthday. The goons beat up Happu. Anita and Angoori get stuck in one house with Prem, Vibhuti's friend. In the meantime, Vibhuti and Manmohan get stuck in another house. Anita asks all to come in the balcony. Vibhuti cuts the cake on Anita's behalf and throws the pieces of cake in Anita and Angoori's mouth. Anita gets angry when Manmohan says that Vibhuti took money from him.

episodesList.title: Anita and Angoori Decide to Test Their Husbands' Love
episodesList.summary: Anita is upset that Vibhuti's been talking to Prem since a long time. She wants him to talk to her, but he falls asleep. Angoori dresses up for Manmohan, but he too falls asleep. Angoori asks Ammaji for help. Anita and Angoori share their problems with each other. Vibhuti and Manmohan also tell each other that they have nothing to talk about to their wives. Anita tells Angoori that they need to test if their husbands love them. Angoori pretends to be injured and asks Manmohan to carry her.

episodesList.title: Angoori and Anita Spy On Their Husbands
episodesList.summary: Manmohan asks Malkhan and Teeka Ram to carry Angoori inside. Vibhuti scolds Anita for pouring cold water on him at midnight. Prem asks Manmohan and Vibhuti to meet Gulfam Kali. On the magazine editor Kalawati Sharma's advice, Angoori and Anita follow their husbands everywhere. This irritates Vibhuti and Manmohan. Angoori accuses Manmohan of having an affair with Gulfam Kali and says that she will go to Anita's house. When Vibhuti gets angry at Anita, she asks him to leave the house.

episodesList.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Apologise to Their Wives
episodesList.summary: Angoori and Vibhuti meet while going to each other's houses. Angoori cries and tells Anita that Manmohan doesn't love her. But Anita asks her to be strong. Vibhuti and Manmohan laugh aloud so their wives think they are happy. Anita tells Angoori to pretend to be happy. Prem and Happu ask Vibhuti and Manmohan to visit the brothel to meet Gulfam Kali, but they refuse. Kalawati tells Anita that she will send two men to her house. Manmohan and Vibhuti go to Anita's house to apologise to their wives.

episodesList.title: Two Men Take Anita and Angoori For a Long Drive
episodesList.summary: Manmohan and Vibhuti watch as two men on bikes take their wives for a long ride. Distraught, they go to Gulfam Kali's brothel. But Vibhuti and Manmohan imagine their wives dancing instead of Gulfam and they cry. While returning, they talk ill about Angoori and Anita, so Teeka Ram, Malkhan and Anokhelal beat them up badly. The wives are very happy. Vibhuti and Manmohan apologise to Anita and Angoori saying they are incomplete without them, but they ask them to shut up and leave the house.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan Get an Upset Stomach
episodesList.summary: Resham raids and arrests Happu, Prem, Vibhuti and Manmohan. Vibhuti and Manmohan get bailed out. Anita and Angoori tell Vibhuti and Manmohan that they were not having an affair and that the men were sent by Kalawati to teach them a lesson. The husbands confess their love for their wives. Later, the husbands fall asleep as before, while their wives wish to talk. Vibhuti and Manmohan get upset stomach after eating 'chole bhature' at a tea stall. As their wives are not home, they go to Ammaji.

episodesList.title: Ladoo Gives a Tip to Anita
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti scolds a man, who calls him useless. He and Anita fight. Manmohan fights with Angoori as she gives him 'samosas'. Vibhuti, Manmohan and Happu beat up Teeka Ram and Malkhan to vent out their anger. Anita sees that Laddoo is always happy. Laddoo says he listens to music. Angoori plays songs, but Vibhuti scolds her. Anita says that all are stressed so they should add music to their life. Saxena says that he sings well, being a classical singer. Vibhuti praises Angoori's voice.

episodesList.title: Anita Fixes Vibhuti's Marriage With Bittan
episodesList.summary: Everyone starts talking in a musical tone to each other. Teeka Ram scolds Malkhan when he asks him to buy some biscuits. Happu complains by singing that his wallet was stolen. A girl named Bittan asks Vibhuti for directions. When he does so singing, she tells him she loves him, but he runs away. Anita's aunt tells her that the girl's family will come to meet her for Rajesh's wedding. Bittan and her brother, Chuttan, think Vibhuti is Anita's brother. Anita fixes her marriage with Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Balushankar Sends Flowers For Angoori
episodesList.summary: Chuttan threatens to kill Vibhuti if he doesn't marry Bittan. He asks Anita to divorce Vibhuti when he learns that she is his wife. Balushankar sends a bouquet of flowers to Angoori with a letter, in which he praises her voice, but insults Manmohan. Teeka Ram and Malkhan tease a girl by singing. She beats them up. Anita calls Happu. Happu says that Chuttan is a minister's sycophant, so Resham asked Vibhuti and Anita to get divorced. Manmohan gets angry when Angoori says Balushankar fed her.

episodesList.title: Anita Shows Vibhuti's Mms to Chuttan
episodesList.summary: Chuttan asks Anita to sign the divorce papers. Manmohan spits the 'kheer', thinking Balushankar gave it. Saxena tells everyone that Balushankar is married and got caught in an MMS scandal. Anita makes a plan. Manmohan calls Balushankar home, and Anita calls Gulfam. Teeka Ram has an MMS of Vibhuti and Gulfam. Balushankar thinks he's talking to Angoori, but it's his wife hiding under the sheets, who beats him up. Anita shows Chuttan the MMS. He recognises Gulfam as he made 17 MMS videos with her.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Loses His Voice
episodesList.summary: Anita is relieved when Bittan says she won't marry Vibhuti after seeing the MMS. Vibhuti and Anita hug each other but soon learn that Teeka Ram sent the MMS to many people. After dinner, Angoori insults Manmohan, who gets angry and scolds her for calling him a bull. Vibhuti downs a glassful of ice with liquor and loses his voice. Ammaji asks Angoori to tie a rope from the ceiling around her neck and chant a 'mantra' 108 times. Vibhuti thinks she is going to kill herself and saves her life.

episodesList.title: Ammaji Gives Advice to Angoori
episodesList.summary: Manmohan surprises Anita by bringing a certain brand of handkerchiefs. Angoori feels that Laddoo and Manmohan don't love her. Anita reads an article that says ignoring your partner is the biggest kind of torture. So Anita uses it on Vibhuti and he uses it on Angoori. Vibhuti gives Angoori's 'kheer' to Teeka Ram then takes it back from him. Angoori tries to woo Manmohan, but he sleeps. Ammaji asks Angoori to pretend that she will die in a few days to get attention. Angoori bribes a doctor to lie.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan Cry Over Angoori's Diagnosis
episodesList.summary: Manmohan asks Angoori to make food in spite of knowing that she is sick. Vibhuti learns from the doctor that Anita is sick. Manmohan tells Anita that he is feeling lonely as Angoori is sick. Manmohan and Vibhuti argue and beat up Teeka Ram and Malkhan. They become hysterical when they learn that Angoori will die in a few days. They hide from Angoori and cry. Vibhuti prays for Angoori. A priest asks Vibhuti to perform a ritual for Angoori's health. Anita speaks to a doctor in Mumbai.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Walks On Hot Coals For Angoori
episodesList.summary: Angoori gets worried when Anita says she'll take her to Mumbai for treatment. Laddoo reads Angoori's thoughts and tells Anita. Angoori says she made a false report as everyone was avoiding her. They plan to continue the drama. Vibhuti spits 'paan' on Manmohan and mentions the ritual. Anita takes Angoori for shopping. The priest asks Vibhuti to walk on hot coal pieces so that Angoori is healed completely. Vibhuti walks on the coals for Angoori. Saxena asks Manmohan to be with Angoori.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Learns About Angoori's Lie
episodesList.summary: Teeka Ram, Malkhan, Saxena and Happu perform acts to make Angoori happy. Vibhuti tells Angoori a story about himself, Angoori and Manmohan by giving examples of animals. Angoori tells Ammaji that she feels guilty for lying about her health. Vibhuti hears Angoori and gets upset with her. Vibhuti takes Manmohan to the priest who cheated him. The priest shows him a knife and takes Manmohan's watch and bracelet. Vibhuti plans to expose Angoori and talks to Anita about Manmohan's remarriage.

episodesList.title: Ammaji Stops Manmohan's Engagement
episodesList.summary: Anita tells Angoori about Manmohan's plan to marry again. Angoori is distraught. So she dances to prove to him that she is fine. But Manmohan tells her that people start behaving that way before dying. Anita scolds Vibhuti for planning Manmohan's wedding. Angoori is shocked to see that Manmohan has decided to marry Gulfam. Anita and Angoori tell Gulfam about Manmohan's flaws, but she says she loves him anyway. Ammaji stops the engagement and beats Manmohan. Angoori says she's fine.

episodesList.title: Sunny Leone Casts Vibhuti In Her Film
episodesList.summary: Anita scolds Vibhuti for breaking a plate and calls him jobless. Manmohan learns that Sunny Leone will visit Kanpur for a shoot. He is very excited. Tillu asks Manmohan for his salary. Angoori and Manmohan call Vibhuti jobless. As Vibhuti cries and complains outside, Sunny plans to cast him in her next film as the lead. She says she's impressed with his acting and gives him a cheque of INR 11 lakhs. Vibhuti's photo appears in the newspaper. Anita is forced to do the household chores.

episodesList.title: Sunny Praises Anita and Angoori
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti complies with their requests and gives Teeka Ram, Malkhan and Happu his autograph on their faces. Vibhuti makes Saxena his secretary. Vibhuti eats 'badam Ka halwa' made by Angoori and insults Manmohan. Anita works hard to make for Vibhuti's favourite dish. But he says he had dinner with Sunny. During a shoot, Vibhuti praises Angoori and tells the news reporters that Anita is his wife. Vibhuti cooks Thai food for Sunny. Sunny praises Angoori and Anita's beauty. Manmohan meets Sunny.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Plans Vibhuti's Abduction
episodesList.summary: Sunny discusses a scene with Vibhuti in which she cuts her finger in the kitchen and he tears his shirt and bandages her finger. Anita refuses to let him do the scene. Sunny lets Happu come in. He pleads with her to make him her cook. Teeka Ram starts crying, seeing Sunny in person. Malkhan asks Sunny to give him her used soap. Angoori cooks food for Vibhuti and asks Manmohan to eat outside. Manmohan suggests kidnapping Vibhuti. He agrees to pay Teeka Ram and Malkhan to kidnap Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Anita Fears Vibhuti Getting Close to Sunny Leone
episodesList.summary: Manmohan sends Saxena away and asks Vibhuti to wear a burkha and meet Sunny at a location. Tillu sends Lallu, a gangster, to kill Vibhuti. So Manmohan wears a burkha to escape him. Teeka Ram and Malkhan abduct Manmohan, thinking he's Vibhuti. Vibhuti scolds them. Anita is shocked to see Vibhuti home. She scolds Manmohan for failing to get Vibhuti kidnapped. Anita dreams that Sunny and Vibhuti get close during a dance. Vibhuti tells her that she always doubts him. A news reporter questions Anita.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Quits His Job For Anita
episodesList.summary: Anita wears a burkha to hide from the reporters. Meanwhile, Manmohan sends Saxena away and tells Vibhuti that Sunny is in trouble. Vibhuti also wears a burkha. Teeka Ram and Malkhan kidnap Anita, mistaking her for Vibhuti. Anita scolds them and Manmohan as well. Manmohan promises to hire professional kidnappers. Anita apologises to Vibhuti and says she won't bother him. Vibhuti does the household chores and tells Angoori that he quit his job as Anita doesn't like him working with Sunny.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Sees Ahuti Romancing Anita
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti is chased by a wrestler, whom he owes money. He hides at Angoori's house. Angoori lies to the wrestler and sends him away. Vibhuti asks Anita to give him INR 50 thousand to pay the wrestler, as he had borrowed and lost in gambling. Saxena gives Vibhuti an idea to dress up like an old man. Vibhuti pretends to be Ahuti. He insults Manmohan and flirts with Angoori. Manmohan is shocked to see Anita dance with Ahuti. Angoori is in the mood for romance, but Manmohan scolds her.

episodesList.title: Ahuti Takes Anita and Angoori Out For a Treat
episodesList.summary: Manmohan calls Vibhuti, and he says he knows that Anita is dancing with Ahuti while he is dancing with his mother. Manmohan rebukes Anita for her behaviour, but she says that his mind is dirty. Teeka Ram and Malkhan gamble at the tea stall, and Ahuti scolds them. They make fun of Vibhuti. Ahuti slaps them and scolds Happu when he asks him the same question. Ahuti irritates Manmohan by calling Angoori 'Bhabhiji'. Ahuti drives the rickshaw and takes Angoori and Anita for a 'pani puri' treat.

episodesList.title: Angoori and Vibhuti Start Laundry Business
episodesList.summary: Manmohan makes Ahuti drink and begs of him to leave Kanpur. When Ahuti refuses, Manmohan plans to pay him. Ahuti takes the INR 50 thousand from Manmohan and gives it to the wrestler. Angoori wants a diamond necklace worth INR 1.5 lakhs, but Manmohan lies that his business is going through heavy losses. Anita accuses Vibhuti of being jobless. Angoori wants to help Manmohan and she starts a laundry business with Vibhuti. Manmohan and Anita are embarrassed by their spouses' work.

episodesList.title: Anita Wants Vibhuti to Close His Shop
episodesList.summary: Manmohan's in the mood for romance, but Angoori is washing clothes at night. Anita asks Vibhuti to wear a 'lungi' then changes her mind and scolds him. Anita asks Vibhuti to close his shop as Mr Gupta, a financer, will come home the next day. But he refuses, saying it's his livelihood. Manmohan makes Anita drink tea at his regular tea stall. Manmohan gets furious when Teeka Ram and Malkhan give Angoori their dirty clothes to wash. Anita complains to Happu, but Resham refuses to close the shop.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Buys The Necklace For Angoori
episodesList.summary: Manmohan expresses his grief to Anita about Angoori washing other people's clothes. Manmohan beats up Teeka Ram and Malkhan when they ask him to give their clothes to Angoori. Mr Gupta invests in Vibhuti's business rather than Anita's boutique. Ammaji arrives and is shocked to find Angoori washing loads of clothes. Ammaji beats Manmohan. He then tells Angoori the truth and buys her the necklace. Anita tells Vibhuti that she will be his partner but makes him do all the work. Vibhuti runs away.

episodesList.title: Saxena Plans Revenge On Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: While Vibhuti is busy talking to Angoori, Saxena disturbs him and asks him to slap him. So, to send him away, Vibhuti lies that there are live wires at a distance. Saxena learns that there are no wires and vows revenge. He mixes something in Vibhuti's tea. Vibhuti wakes up at Gulfam's house 10 hours later and lies to Anita that he saved a girl from some dangerous goons. Saxena calls Vibhuti and threatens him, asking him to tease Angoori if he doesn't want Anita to see his video with Gulfam.

episodesList.title: Saxena Forces Vibhuti to do His Bidding
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti teases Angoori on Saxena's orders. Teeka Ram and Malkhan beat Vibhuti up, as Angoori cries. Saxena asks Vibhuti to put a chewing gum in Anita's hair. Anita had just curled her hair and scolds Vibhuti. She is forced to cut her hair. Saxena asks Vibhuti to slap him. He says two mosquitoes were sitting on his cheeks. He slaps him a third time. He lies to Anita and Angoori that a priest asked him to do those things. Saxena asks him to do the things again. Anita tells Manmohan everything.

episodesList.title: Saxena's Last Task For Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: On Saxena's orders, Vibhuti applies mud from Angoori's plant on Manmohan's face. Kalu complains to Happu that a boy teases her. Saxena again asks Vibhuti to slap Happu. Vibhuti slaps him and walks away. Vibhuti cries, and Saxena says he will not trouble him. He asks Vibhuti to apologise to all and say that he had gone insane. He does so. Manmohan forgives Vibhuti, hugs him and asks him to eat food with him. Vibhuti apologises to Anita and Happu. Vibhuti again applies mud on Manmohan's face.

episodesList.title: Angoori Shelters Tillu, Teeka Ram, and Malkhan
episodesList.summary: Anita gets a lawyer and asks Vibhuti to divorce her. Saxena asks Anita not to get divorced. He says he asked Vibhuti to do those things to teach him a lesson. Anita apologises. Vibhuti boasts to Angoori of being a helpful person. Tillu, Teeka Ram and Malkhan lose their homes and ask Vibhuti to keep them in his house. Angoori keeps them at her house. Teeka Ram kisses Manmohan. Manmohan scolds Angoori and complains to Anita. She scolds Manmohan for planning to remove the trio from his house.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Joins Saxena's Movement
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti gets furious with the three and mixes spices in their food. Saxena says that they should start a movement. Manmohan plans to join the movement. Vibhuti enters Angoori's bedroom to look at her. He hides, but Teeka Ram sees a shadow and the three beat Vibhuti up. He lies that he climbed her room to check if a robber was there. Manmohan shouts slogans, but Happu beats him up. Happu leaves when Anita says he's siding with the builders. Gulfam says that she will make an MMS of the builder.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gives Angoori a Piece Of 'moon'
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti calls the trio a nuisance. Happu says he spoke to the builder, who has agreed to return the houses. Vibhuti says he's lying as Gulfam did the work. Malkhan refuses to go, but Vibhuti and Manmohan throw the trio out. Manmohan sees Anita sleepwalking, and she sleeps on his sofa. She asks him not to tell Vibhuti. Angoori reads an article and gets angry on Manmohan as he doesn't gift her anything. Vibhuti gives Angoori a stone, saying it's a piece of moon, and lies that he is an astronaut.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Venture Into Space
episodesList.summary: Manmohan waits outside for Angoori to sleepwalk, but she jogs elsewhere. Vibhuti wears a spacesuit and asks Angoori to feed him curd and sugar. She asks him to get her some mud from Mars. Manmohan tells a sleeping Anita that he loves her. Vibhuti sees Anita sleepwalk. Vibhuti asks Angoori to sprinkle the mud on Manmohan's food, as it's healthy. Manmohan gets a doctor, who asks Anita to drink four pegs of liquor before sleeping. Vibhuti lies to Angoori about his spaceship being stuck in traffic.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Instigates Happu to Arrest Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Manmohan scolds Angoori for returning home late, and she says she was with Vibhuti, the astronaut. Happu is searching for a criminal, who roams in a spacesuit. Manmohan tells him that the guy is Vibhuti. Vibhuti asks Saxena to dress up and pretend to be a Martian, an extraterrestrial being from Mars. Angoori is happy to meet the Martian. Happu tells Anita that Vibhuti is a secret agent of the enemy. Vibhuti tells Happu that he was fooling around with Angoori and is not a secret agent.

episodesList.title: Dr Abhay Ashiana's Novel 'martha'
episodesList.summary: Anita is reading a novel of a famous novelist Dr Abhay Ashiana. Manmohan arrives and reveals the name of the murderer in the novel. Anita becomes furious and scolds him for spoiling the suspense. Saxena brings Abhay home and asks Anita to keep him at her house as there are loose wires in his. Anita is the writer's big fan. He begins writing his novel Martha. As he narrates the novel, it sounds very similar to the lives of the people he is staying with. A lady, Martha, beats up Teeka and Malkhan.

episodesList.title: Martha Thrashes Modern Colony's Residents
episodesList.summary: Teeka Ram and Malkhan tell Anita and Angoori that an old lady beat them up. The Mishras have dinner at Manmohan's house along with Abhay, who continues narrating his novel. Like the story, Vibhuti gets a call. He goes outside and gets beaten up by Martha. Martha appears near Vibhuti's bedroom and scares him and Anita. Anita learns that it's the same Martha who is in Abhay's novel. Teeka Ram and Malkhan get scared seeing Saxena dressed like Martha, but he says he's playing Hilda's role in a play.

episodesList.title: Dr Abhay's Martha Appears In Reality
episodesList.summary: Anita and Vibhuti try to leave the house, but Abhay forces them to stay and listen to his story. As he narrates his story, Martha beats up Manmohan and Happu. They return and narrate their story to everyone. Anita says that Abhay said that Martha beats up the men who eye other women. Vibhuti and Manmohan hear Abhay tell Mayor Ghungroo that the main characters will die. So they tell Abhay to change the climax, but he refuses. Later, as Abhay reads the climax, Martha appears before everyone.

episodesList.title: Angoori's Grandmother Gets Impressed By Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Happu arrives and removes Martha's wig. The man dressed as Martha is Abhay's cook. To make his book famous, Abhay had asked his cook to become Martha. Happu says that Abhay will be sent back to the mental hospital. Angoori's father tells her that her granny has come out of coma and wants to get Angoori married. Angoori tells about this to Manmohan. Angoori's grandmother asks him some questions about maths and science. Manmohan fails to answer them, but Vibhuti answers them and impresses granny.

episodesList.title: Anita Becomes Vibhuti's Cousin
episodesList.summary: When Anita arrives, Vibhuti tells granny that she is his cousin. Ammaji scolds Manmohan for losing Angoori. Angoori's father praises Vibhuti while he's drinking with Vibhuti and Manmohan. Manmohan is upset so Vibhuti makes a plan to change his place and put Manmohan instead for the 'pheras'. Vibhuti informs Tillu, Teeka Ram, Malkhan and Happu about Anita's wedding. Tillu plans to take his salary from Manmohan. Angoori's father asks Anita to dance at the sangeet as she is Vibhuti's sister.

episodesList.title: Angoori's Wedding Ceremony With Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Anita dances at Angoori's sangeet. Teeka Ram, Malkhan, Happu, Vibhuti and Angoori also dance. Granny then asks Vibhuti and Angoori to feed each other sweets. Granny says that the bridegroom will ride the devil. Angoori's father asks Manmohan to be the devil. Vibhuti sits on Manmohan and gives Angoori a rose. Anita worries about the wedding and gets furious at Vibhuti smiling continuously. The 'baraat' arrives. Vibhuti is carried by two people, and Anita puts the garlands on VIbhuti and Angoori.

episodesList.title: Anita Asks Govinda to Teach Her to Dance
episodesList.summary: Anita plans to ask Govinda to teach her dance for her grooming class. Govinda comes to buy Anita's house. Govinda asks Vibhuti to show him around the house. Teeka Ram and Malkhan ask him tips to woo girls. Vibhuti tells Saxena that he joked about selling the house. Govinda dances with everyone. Anita praises Govinda's dance. Anita asks Vibhuti to return home. But he refuses, saying he gets to eat Angoori's food. Anita tells Manmohan that she's missing Vibhuti and asks him to do the housework.

episodesList.title: Malluka's Threat Makes The Men Dress Up As Women
episodesList.summary: Anita scolds Vibhuti for not washing her clothes properly. Angoori tells Manmohan that she wants to work at his shop, but he refuses. Happu tells everyone that a goon named Malluka wants men to dress like women and do the housework, otherwise he will kill them. While the women do men's work, Vibhuti, Manmohan, Resham and Happu dress up like women. The doctor says that Malluka tried to kill him but missed and hurt his butt. Angoori is happy to learn that now she will get to run Manmohan's shop.

episodesList.title: Angoori and Anita Dress Up As Men
episodesList.summary: Teeka Ram and Malkhan get kidnapped by goons, who think they are girls. When the goons learn that they are boys, they beat them up. Vibhuti is surprised to see Anita dressed up like a handsome man. Angoori also dresses up like a man and says she's going to the shop. They ask their husbands to cook food for them. Teeka Ram and Malkhan complain to Happu, and he files an FIR. Manmohan and Vibhuti cook food. Saxena asks Vibhuti and Manmohan to slap him. Malkhan says he's fed up with being a woman.

episodesList.title: Angoori Takes Over Manmohan's Business
episodesList.summary: The men say they won't dress up like girls anymore and take off their wigs. Malluka throws a letter, which says that the knife will be in their butts the next time. Vibhuti and Manmohan get intimate with Anita and Angoori respectively. Tillu tells Angoori it's a pleasure to work with her. Laddoo's Teacher beats up Tillu when he insults him. Teeka Ram and Malkhan complain that the goons stripped them and beat them. Vibhuti and Manmohan make food for their wives. Angoori's business is doing well.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Locks Up Malluka
episodesList.summary: The men decide to catch Malluka and plan to send a prey to him. They make chits and Vibhuti's name comes up first. Angoori says she has made a sale of INR five thousand. Anita and Angoori trouble Manmohan. Happu says in the news that the criminal is Vibhuti. Malluka makes a cop unconscious and tries to kill Vibhuti. But he escapes and locks Malluka in the prison. Manmohan is happy to be a free man. Vibhuti refuses to do the housework, but is forced to do it. Happu boasts of catching Malluka.

episodesList.title: Ammaji Tells Angoori to Donate to Charity
episodesList.summary: Ammaji brings a priest sent by Pandit Ramphal who says that Angoori should do charity as a very auspicious time will arrive for her. Angoori donates her chain to Vibhuti. As their gas is over, Anita asks Manmohan if she and Vibhuti can eat dinner at his place. Angoori cooks lot of food, but Manmohan takes it all inside. An insulted Anita leaves with Vibhuti. Manmohan gives lots of things in charity to people. But Ammaji says Pandit Ramphal made a mistake and they had to act miserly instead.

episodesList.title: The Snakes' Revenge On Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti gets intimate with Anita. Manmohan sees and plans to teach him a lesson. Vibhuti by mistake pours water on two snakes who were mating. A snake charmer tells Vibhuti that the snakes will take revenge. Manmohan enters Vibhuti's room while he and Anita are romancing and tells him that he caught a snake entering his room. Anita reads that a snake bit three people. Manmohan keeps a fake snake on Vibhuti's leg. Angoori sees Manmohan placing a snake in his shirt. Ammaji tells Angoori something.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Turns Into a Snake
episodesList.summary: When Teeka Ram and Malkhan search for rats at Anita's house, she asks them to look elsewhere as the snakes ate the rats. Angoori and Vibhuti watch as Manmohan drinks milk like a snake. Vibhuti puts a snake in Manmohan's pants and catches it later. Angoori tells Ammaji that Manmohan is turning into a snake. Teeka Ram and Malkhan sell the rats to Manmohan. So Happu beats them. Manmohan pretends to eat a rat. Vibhuti sees it and tells Anita that Manmohan is a snake. But she doesn't believe him.

episodesList.title: Manmohan's Snake Dance
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti tells Angoori that he saw Manmohan eat a rat. Angoori tells Ammaji that Manmohan is turning into a snake. Ammaji tells her she will speak to Pandit Ramphal. Manmohan invites the Mishras for dinner, but Vibhuti refuses and Anita says they will come. Teeka Ram and Malkhan ask Happu to give them INR one crore for a rat as the gem that Happu is looking for is worth crores. Manmohan puts a snake under the sofa and scares Vibhuti. Manmohan dances like a snake while all are shocked.

episodesList.title: Angoori Dresses As a Nagin to Woo Nagraj
episodesList.summary: Angoori is convinced that Manmohan is a Nagaraj. Happu Singh, Teeka and Malkhan try to get the nagmani from Manmohan but they fail. Anita tries to convince Angoori that Manmohan is acting as Nagaraj but in vain. Manmohan continues to scare Vibhuti. Manmohan asks Vibhuti to consider Anita as his sister. Happu Singh is bitten by a real snake while trying to capture Manmohan. A shaken Vibhuti refers to Anita as his sister in a state of panic. Angoori dresses as a Nagin and tries woo Manmohan.

episodesList.title: Malkhan and Teeka Try to Extract Nagmani From Manmohan
