A worried Gulfam Kali reaches out to Vibhuti and Manmohan for help but they ignore her and continue with their game of chess. Gulfam Kali is heartbroken.

episodesList.title: Gulfam Kali's Funeral
episodesList.summary: Tillu informs Angoori that Manmohan plays chess at the shop all the time. Gulfam Kali tells Anita and Angoori about her problem. Anita makes a plan and asks Gulfam Kali to pretend to commit suicide. At Gulfam Kali's funeral, everyone mourns for her and pays tribute to her by saying a few words about her. Anita and Angoori tell everyone that her soul will haunt the men responsible for her death. At night, while playing chess, Manmohan and Vibhuti see Anita coming towards them holding a candle.

episodesList.title: Gulfam's Spirit Possesses Anita and Angoori
episodesList.summary: Manmohan and Vibhuti are scared to see a possessed Anita walking by. Happu, Malkhan, Prem and Teeka believe that Anita is possessed by Gulfam Kali's spirit. Happu falls in fear. Possessed with Gulfam Kali's spirit, Angoori scares Manmohan who sweats in fear. Vibhuti and Manmohan blame Happu, Malkhan, Teeka and Prem for Gulfam Kali's death. Manmohan sees Anita dancing and praises her. Anita informs Manmohan that she is Gulfam Kali which terrifies Manmohan.

episodesList.title: Gulbadan Entertains The Men
episodesList.summary: A possessed Angoori threatens to cut Vibhutiâ€™s fingers if he plays chess. Manmohan and Vibhuti are about to play chess but run after hearing Gulfam Kali's voice. Manmohan and Vibhuti are scared to sleep with their wives alone. They ask Saxena and Tillu to sleep with them. Happu, Teeka, Malkhan and Prem enjoy Gulbadan's dance. Everyone is frightened after Gulbadan is revealed to be the dead Gulfam Kali. Anita and Angoori scare their husbands at night with the help of Saxena and Tillu.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gets Shocked to See Gulfam Kali Alive
episodesList.summary: Manmohan gets scared when Tillu speaks as Gulfam Kali. Vibhuti overhears Anita and Gulfamâ€™s conversation. He realises that Gulfam Kali is alive and that she is playing a prank on him and Manmohan with Anita and Angoori as accomplices. Vibhuti tells Manmohan the truth about their wives' plan. Anita tries to scare them to stop them from playing chess but she is unsuccessful. Vibhuti and Manmohan vow to stop playing chess and spend time with their wives instead. David arrives from London.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Sees a Terrifying Dream
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti, Angoori, Manmohan and Anita have a conversation when builder Ramesh Gupta, the owner of Ashanti Construction arrives with his secretary, Shaila and an engineer. He plans to build a shopping complex by razing Modern colony but the four disagree. He threatens them and leaves. Vibhuti dreams that Manmohanâ€™s home is razed by the builder and Angoori leaves the colony. Angoori, Anita, Manmohan and Vibhuti seek the Commissioner's help to stop the construction of the mall.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Vows to Stop The Demolition Of The Colony
episodesList.summary: Manmohan is sad when Anita tells him that she will miss everyone in the colony but forgets to take his name. Vibhuti promises Angoori that he will stop her house from being razed. Vibhuti and Manmohan have a drink and discuss their circumstances of having to live apart. Builder Gupta arrives and informs the colony residents that he has seven bulldozers lined up outside the colony. He faces resistance from the residents. Gupta informs everyone that Vibhuti is his long-lost son, Vijay.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Gets Jealous Of Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Manmohan is sad about knowing that Vibhuti is rich. Vibhuti informs Angoori that the construction of the mall will not take place. VIbhuti starts flaunting his newfound status in front of the colonyâ€™s residents. Gupta announces to the press that Vibhuti is his son, Vijay. Vibhuti plans on expanding Guptaâ€™s business. Anita is unhappy with Vibhuti pretending to be Guptaâ€™s son. Vibhuti and Anita plan on going to Nainital the next day and ask Angoori and Manmohan to accompany them.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Tears David's will
episodesList.summary: David arrives from London but finds the door to his house locked. Vibhuti, Manmohan, Anita, and Angoori return from their picnic. David makes his will in Vibhutiâ€™s name. Vibhuti, however, tears the papers as he doesnâ€™t need his uncleâ€™s property anymore. An infuriated David leaves. Vibhuti plans on hiring Manmohan as his assistant. He offers Manmohan INR 1 lakh per month salary. Guptaâ€™s employees and clients ask Vibhuti for their dues. The creditors throng Vibhutiâ€™s home for money.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Seeks Refuge In Manmohan's House
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti hides from the creditors who have stationed themselves outside his home. He escapes and sneaks into Manmohanâ€™s house. Manmohan and Angoori find Vibhuti hiding beneath their bed. He tells the couple the truth about Gupta. Manmohan is scared about his job as he has sold his shop to Tillu. Anita finds the creditors outside her house in the morning. She goes to search for Vibhuti and asks Tillu and Malkhan to find him. Angoori and others ask Vibhuti to abscond to which he reluctantly agrees.

episodesList.title: Ammaji Tells Angoori About Nani and Dadi's Rivalry
episodesList.summary: A robber enters Manmohanâ€™s house. Angoori tries to wake him up but he asks Angoori to check. The robber is caught by Angoori. The robber is concerned as this time Manmohan is not the one who has come to check. The robber tells Angoori that Manmohan is suffering from laziness and asks her to try the tips given in â€˜Dadi ke nuskheâ€™ book kept in her cupboard. Ammaji, too, advises Angoori the same. In addition, she cautions her not to touch â€˜Nani ke nuskheâ€™ book as Dadi and Nani were enemies.

episodesList.title: Angoori's Secret Concoction Makes Manmohan Energetic
episodesList.summary: Anita plans on installing a 5-ton air conditioner. Manmohan is full of energy after drinking a special drink made by Angoori. Manmohan takes Anita for jogging. Upon returning, he is still full of energy. Angoori complains to Ammaji that Manmohan is not utilising his energy properly and that he uses it to play kabaddi with her instead of romancing with her. Ammaji asks Angoori to get household chores done by Manmohan. Manmohan happily cleans the utensils. Manmohan finds Anitaâ€™s ring.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Plans to Steal The Secret Recipe Book
episodesList.summary: Angoori wakes up to find Manmohan doing pushups with Laddoo on his back. Manmohan challenges Vibhuti for an arm-wrestling match and easily defeats Vibhuti making Angoori and Laddoo happy. Vibhuti plans on learning about the recipe of the energy drink from Manmohan by forcing him to drink alcohol. Manmohan blurts the secret about â€˜Dadi ke nuskheâ€™ book to Vibhuti. Vibhuti tries to steal the book but is caught and beaten by Manmohan. Vibhuti mistakenly steals â€˜Nani ke Nuskheâ€™ book.

episodesList.title: Anita Gets Frustrated By Vibhuti's Sluggish Behaviour
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti feels weak after having the energy drink. Vibhuti realises his mistake of stealing the wrong book after overhearing Manmohan and Angooriâ€™s conversation. Anita is angry with Vibhuti as he goes to sleep instead of romancing with her. Vibhuti feels tired and sleepy throughout the day. Ammaji visits Angoori and asks her to attend a 'jagrata' with Manmohan. Vibhuti sleeps all day. Vibhuti gives Manmohan a bottle of alcohol with his energy drink mixed in it.

episodesList.title: David Suspects Anita's Behaviour
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti is hell-bent on staying awake the whole night for a ritual that will grant him a lot of wealth. Teeka and Malkhan try to steal a lot of shoes, but Happu catches them. Later, a priest reveals that sleeping, not staying awake the whole night, will grant the devotees wealth. Teeka and Malkhan offer Happu his own money as a bribe. David overhears Vibhuti and Anitaâ€™s conversation while they are role-playing and thinks that Anita is cheating on Vibhuti. An angry David tears his will papers.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan Secretly Gamble
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti plays poker with Teeka and Malkhan and wins a lot of money with his cards. Manmohan agrees to play poker with Vibhuti. Anita is mad as Vibhuti returns home late and lies to her. Angoori grows suspicious of Manmohanâ€™s behaviour and contacts Ramkali. Impressed by Vibhutiâ€™s gambling skills, a mysterious woman, Lilly, seeks to hire him and offers him a deal. Angoori says that she hates gamblers. Vibhuti decides to hide his gambling addiction from Angoori to avoid being hated by her.

episodesList.title: Happu Reveals Vibhuti's Secret to Anita
episodesList.summary: Teeka and Malkhan follow Vibhuti to an expensive club. Vibhuti wins a lot of games for Miss Lilly. Teeka and Malkhan trick the club's guard and enter. Vibhuti lies to Anita that heâ€™s been hired as a club manager. Vibhuti tells Manmohan to come to the club and gamble. Vibhuti offers an expensive sari to Angoori bought with his gambling money. Happu spots Vibhuti, Malkhan and Teeka at the club. Happu reveals to Angoori and Anita that Vibhuti has become a professional gambler for the club.

episodesList.title: Angoori Snubs Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Anita confronts Vibhuti about his gambling activities and rebukes him for gambling at a club every night. Manmohan tells Angoori about his gambling when she keeps asking him to tell her the truth. Vibhuti and Manmohan comically insult Happu for being an incompetent cop. Ramkali decides to teach Manmohan a lesson. Angoori tells Vibhuti that she'll not talk to him for being a compulsive gambler. David learns about Vibhutiâ€™s gambling and assures Anita that he'll get him away from the nasty habit.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan Break Their Promise
episodesList.summary: Lilly seduces Vibhuti, who gets uncomfortable and leaves. Manmohan fears going home, thinking that his mother will beat him for his disloyalty to Angoori. David confronts Vibhuti about his gambling. Vibhuti and David have a comical conversation about gambling and the latterâ€™s will. Vibhuti tells David that he will quit gambling. Ramkali beats Manmohan, who decides to quit gambling as well. Vibhuti and Manmohan continue to gamble. Anita and Angoori decide to teach their husbands a lesson.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Forbids Anita From Dancing At The Casino
episodesList.summary: Anita performs a dance at the casino where Vibhuti and Manmohan are gambling. A disappointed Vibhuti leaves the casino and tells Anita not to dance at the casino. But she says that she will stop only if he stops gambling. David comically tears another one of his wills. Ramkali wants to take Angoori to the formerâ€™s village. As Vibhuti doesn't want Angoori to leave, he lies that Anita is pregnant. Manmohan is sad upon hearing the news. Ramkali talks to Anita about being pregnant.

episodesList.title: David Invites Vibhuti and Anita to London
episodesList.summary: David arrives while Vibhuti and Anita are sharing an intimate moment and reveals that he is getting married in London. Manmohan and Angoori are invited to the wedding, but the latter refuses to go as she is scared of flights. Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu want to go to London, but don't have the money. Vibhuti talks Angoori into going to London with the rest. Tillu lies that he was robbed by some goons and steals Manmohanâ€™s money with Teeka and Malkhan. A couple of terrorists plan to hijack a plane.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan’s Visa Get Rejected
episodesList.summary: Angoori tells Manmohan that she too wants to go to London. Manmohan learns that Tillu has sponsored Teeka and Malkhanâ€™s air tickets for London. Happu has a comical conversation with a visa officer. Everyoneâ€™s London visas, barring Vibhuti and Manmohanâ€™s, are approved by the officer. However, David uses his diplomatic connections to get their visas approved. Everyone prepares for the London trip. The terrorists decide to hijack the plane, which the Mishras and Tiwaris plan to board.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan’s Sit Next to Each Other's Wives
episodesList.summary: Anita agrees to sit next to Manmohan in the airplane. The terrorists have placed a gun on the plane. The Mishras and the Tiwaris board the flight. Happu and the others too board the plane. The flight attendant is unable to read English, and Anokhelal assists her. Vibhuti sits next to Angoori and tells her to rely on him if she gets scared. Happu has a stomach problem. Anita fastens Manmohan's seatbelt. Happu needs to go to the bathroom urgently. Happu enters the bathroom with the gun.

episodesList.title: The Terrorists Hijack The Plane
episodesList.summary: The terrorist makes Anokhelal retrieve the gun from the planeâ€™s bathroom. Teeka and the gang call and trouble an air hostess, who slaps Malkhan. Happu forgets his pants in the bathroom. The terrorist draws his gun and hijacks the plane. The terrorist says that he'll throw Vibhuti out of the plane if he doesn't comply. The terrorists want to divert the plane to Afghanistan and tell the commissioner to release their aides or else everyone on the plane dies. The hostages in the plane get scared.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan Nab The Terrorist
episodesList.summary: The terrorist makes Manmohan and Vibhuti talk to the commissioner. He wants to see Angoori and Anita dance. The duo distracts the terrorist, and Anita snatches the gun from the terrorist and hands it to Vibhuti. The terrorists are locked in a bathroom. However, the pilot hits his head in the cockpit and loses his memory. Anita makes Vibhuti take control of the plane. An air control official, Shukla, fails to guide Vibhuti over the radio. Pelu pilots the plane and successfully lands it.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Refuses to Go to Mussoorie With Anita
episodesList.summary: Manmohan dreams that he is romancing Anita, but Angoori wakes him up. Anita wants to go to Mussoorie with Vibhuti in her friendâ€™s car. However, a schizophrenic man warns her not to go to Mussoorie. Tillu and the gang are shelterless while its raining outside. Vibhuti does not want to go to Mussoorie, but Anita emotionally blackmails him. Vibhuti bribes a priest for Angoori. Malkhan and Teeka ask Vibhuti to let them stay with him, but he denies. It begins to rain heavily again.

episodesList.title: Anita Decides to Go to Mussoorie Alone
episodesList.summary: As per Vibhutiâ€™s plan, the priest tells Manmohan that he shouldn't go out in the rain with Angoori as his life is in danger. Manmohan asks Vibhuti to dance with Angoori in the rain to avoid disappointing her. Vibhuti wants Manmohan to go to Mussoorie with Anita. Vibhuti instigates Angoori against Manmohan. Manmohan feeds Anita lies against Vibhuti. Anita decides to go to Mussoorie alone and rejects Manmohanâ€™s offer to accompany her. Tillu and the gang ask Happu if they can move in with him.

episodesList.title: Anita and Angoori Leave For Mussoorie
episodesList.summary: Tillu, Malkhan and Teeka slap Happu in order to get arrested so that they can have some shelter. Angoori is upset as Manmohan refuses to enjoy the rains with her. Anita too is sad as Vibhuti does not want to go to Mussoorie with her. Angoori and Anita talk about their husbands and decide to teach them a lesson. Anita and Angoori leave for Mussoorie without telling anyone. The police commissioner orders Happu to let the trio go as they are treating the jail as a comfortable guest house.

episodesList.title: Anita and Angoori Arrive In Mussoorie
episodesList.summary: Anita and Angoori arrive in Mussoorie. Vibhuti and Manmohan grow restless, thinking about their missing wives. Malkhan, Tillu and Teeka decide to harass the commissionerâ€™s wife to get into jail. Angoori and Anita arrive at the haunted guest house, where Anitaâ€™s friend Meenal and her husband Anurag are staying. Anita is shocked to learn from the guest house's receptionist that Meenal and Anurag never checked into the guest house. A headless man limps along the guest house's corridors.

episodesList.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Take Happu's Help
episodesList.summary: The commissioner orders Happu to take the trio back to their landlord. Manmohan and Vibhuti decide to leave for Mussoorie with Happu to help Angoori and Anita. Anita, Angoori, Meenal and Anurag are kidnapped. The headless monster stalks Happu and the rich businessman. Vibhuti and Manmohan see their wives in the guest house. The women say that theyâ€™re spirits. Ramlal, the guest house's receptionist, reveals that he had planned to scare the businessman, who wanted to buy his guest house.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Misbehaves With Angoori
episodesList.summary: A couple of goons harass a girl. Anita wants Vibhuti to fight the goons. Manmohan suffers losses in his business. The priest tells Manmohan to misbehave with Angoori in order to turn his luck around. Happu assures Anita that he will teach the goons a lesson but runs away after hearing the goonâ€™s name. Anita decides to teach the goons a lesson by herself. Manmohan yells at Angoori to cover his loss as directed by the priest. Anita dresses up as a vigilante to punish the goons.

episodesList.title: Anita Becomes Meow Girl
episodesList.summary: Anita, disguised as the â€˜meow girlâ€™, beats the goons up. Manmohanâ€™s client repays him money and renews his order. Manmohan thinks that his losses are being recovered because of the priestâ€™s advice. The priest advises Manmohan to be cruel with Angoori for better results. Anita overhears Manmohan abusing Angoori. A disguised Anita beats Manmohan. Vibhuti wonders where Anita goes at night. Vibhuti feels that Anita is cheating on him. Anitaâ€™s uncle meets Vibhuti, who learns that she is lying.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Links Anita With Commissioner
episodesList.summary: Anitaâ€™s uncle tells Vibhuti that she hasn't met him in a long time and that heâ€™s fit and dandy. Manmohan thinks that it was Angoori who beat him. Angoori wonders why Manmohan treats her badly despite she not behaving faultily. Vibhuti tells Angoori that Anita is cheating on him, but she is drowned in her own sorrows. Anita arrives when some men are watching Gulfam Kali dance and batters the men. Anita gets a text from the commissioner, but Vibhuti reads it and thinks that the two are dating.

episodesList.title: Happu Instigates Vibhuti Against Anita
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti is sad, thinking that Anita doesnâ€™t love him and is cheating on him. Manmohan talks to Anita about his sadness and pain, but she laughs at him. Happu Singh and the others learn that Manmohan has been beaten by the Meow Girl. Anokhelal is on a quest to befriend the Meow Girl. Happu overhears the commissioner's conversation with Anita and thinks that she is cheating on Vibhuti. Happu fuels Vibhutiâ€™s misunderstanding towards Anita, and the two visit Gulfam Kali. David returns to India.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan Leave Their Houses
episodesList.summary: Amidst Gulfam's enthralling dance, the Meow Girl scratches Happu, Vibhuti and the other men to punish them. As Manmohan awaits Angoori to massage his pulled back, the Meow Girl lashes his back even as he thinks that Angoori is doing it to turn him on. David is shocked that Anita is dating Commissioner Singh and tauntingly states to Vibhuti that even the latter is better than Singh. Vibhuti and Manmohan leave their houses for their self-respect. Anita and Commissioner Singh reveal the truth.

episodesList.title: Achanaklal Predicts Vibhuti's Future
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti flirtatiously agrees to accompany Angoori at midnight to a chowk to help her complete her vow. Anita lets Vibhuti accompany Angoori after he reveals to Anita Manmohanâ€™s selfish refusal to accompany Angoori. Angoori leaves after making Vibhuti dig the site and place her pouch. Vibhuti finds a golden coin there. Anokhelalâ€™s clairvoyant grandfather Achanaklal predicts Teeka, Malkhan, Happu and Tilluâ€™s future and present. Achanaklal predicts treasure for Vibhuti beneath the Tiwari house.

episodesList.title: Anita and Vibhuti Dig Tiwari's House For Treasure
episodesList.summary: The Tiwaris, whose house is damaged, have relocated temporarily to the Mishra house where they are given spiked milk by Vibhuti. Anita looks forward to possessing the treasure. Manmohan, who wishes to ogle at a sleeping Anita, is caught red-handed by Anita and Vibhuti as they return from the Tiwari's house. Anita realises that the milk contained anti-headache pills. Anita and Vibhuti stop the Tiwaris from returning to their home. A hungry Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu excavate the Tiwari house.

episodesList.title: Happu Ask Vibhuti For a Share In The Treasure
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti informs Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan about Achanaklalâ€™s prediction and consents to a quadrilateral division of the treasure. Happu learns the truth too and starts digging a public road between the Tiwari and the Mishra houses as per Achanaklalâ€™s prediction. Vibhuti evicts the Tiwaris rudely from his house. The Tiwaris wonder who dug their house. Commissioner Singh also starts digging on learning the truth, which confuses the Tiwaris further. The Mishras reveal the truth to the Tiwaris.

episodesList.title: The Truth Behind Achanaklal's Predictions
episodesList.summary: The doctor joins the excavators after learning the truth. The excavators want cocky supervisor Vibhuti to dig with them. Manmohan tears Davidâ€™s will's papers, which are for the benefit of the Mishras as a massive treasure awaits them. David joins the excavators. As they excavate to find the treasure, two nurses from a hospital inform them that Achanaklal is unhinged and his prediction is false. Commissioner Singh allegedly appoints Anokhelal as Kanpurâ€™s commissioner for a day to restore law.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Vows to Earn Inr 10000 Daily
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti asserts to a taunting Manmohan and Anita that he will earn INR 10000 daily. Vibhuti eventually decides to provide key supplies to Anokhelal's insane friends with Prem's car. Happu, who is taunted about his obscenely materialistic nature, assists Vibhuti unexpectedly. As Vibhuti drives Prem's car in hilly terrain, he visualises dancing romantically with Angoori. Anokhelal pays INR 10000 to Vibhuti for his service, which elates Anita, who lambasts a fearful Manmohan for watering the notes.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti is Forced to Work In Manmohan's House
episodesList.summary: Anita sends Vibhuti back to the Mishra house to wash the utensils. After realising that Chhedi's wife Gulabiya is forced to defecate in public despite having a toilet in her house, Anita boycotts Chhedi. Vibhuti is forced to wash the clothes of the Mishras. Manmohan suggests that Vibhuti stay with David in London. Vibhuti volunteers to launder Angoori's clothes, but she gives him Manmohan's dirty clothes. Malkhan and Teeka unintentionally defecate at Masterji's house.

episodesList.title: Happu Jails Vibhuti and Manmohan For Protesting
episodesList.summary: Manmohan lambasts Vibhuti for poorly laundering his clothes. Chhedi refuses to reform despite Vibhuti and Manmohan's advice. Anita vows to send Chhedi to jail for violating the law by defecating. Anita threatens to bar an apathetic Vibhuti from using the personal toilet of the Mishras. Despite Tillu, Malkhan and Teeka mocking Vibhuti's joblessness, he, Anokhelal, Manmohan and Masterji campaign for public hygiene. Anita secures their release from jail by threatening to expose Happu's defecation.

episodesList.title: The Plait Cutter Terrorises The Modern Colony
episodesList.summary: Anita and Angoori use Collector Jain to campaign against defecation. Jain catches Teeka, Malkhan and Happu red-handed as they prepare to defecate. Jain counsels Chhedi not to defecate and not to let Gulabiya defecate. Jain highlights public sanitation. Later, Manmohan assures a worried Angoori that her plait is safe amidst news of a plait cutter on the run. An enticed Vibhuti's assertion that he feels like cutting Anita's plait shocks her. The plait cutter victimises Gulfam and Happu's wife too.

episodesList.title: Gaaleeyanand Threatens Vibhuti and Manmohan
episodesList.summary: As per the abusive Gaaleeyanand's instruction, Vibhuti and Manmohan prepare at midnight to cut Angoori and Anita's hair respectively to win their hearts. Though the two women titillate their husbands, the latter escape somehow. Manmohan lies to Happu and Vibhuti that he is out to nab the plait cutter. Vibhuti lies to Manmohan and Happu that he is out to trim the plants. Malkhan and Teeka agree to protect two young sleazy women's hair. Angoori stops Vibhuti from styling her hair with a scissor.

episodesList.title: Anita and Angoori Decide to Catch The Plait Cutter
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and Manmohan obtain fresh advice from Gaaleeyanand after failing in their mission. Meenal informs Anita and Angoori tearfully that her hair has been cut. The two sleazy young women dump Teeka and Malkhan. Anita and Angoori are out at night to trap the plait cutter with their plan. Manmohan and Vibhuti too wake up to execute their plan. As Anita, Angoori and Happu, who adores Anita's hair, await the plait cutter, Vibhuti and Manmohan don't find Angoori and Anita at their respective homes.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Starts a Security Agency
episodesList.summary: Anita's constant praise of Anurag's professional successes hurts Vibhuti. Tillu, who is offered food by Angoori, curses Manmohan when the latter refuses to remunerate him. Vibhuti hates Anurag due to the latter's mediocre academic record. Anita's praise of Anurag's accomplishments irks Manmohan. Vibhuti opens a security agency after Tillu angrily states that he is ready to work as a guard. Angoori rejects Vibhuti's advice that she hire a bodyguard. Anokhelal seeks work with Vibhuti's agency.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Trains Anokhelal, Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan
episodesList.summary: Eventually, Anita supports Vibhuti's security agency. Soon, she is forced to accommodate Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan at the Mishra house. Vibhuti's public training early in the morning with his recruits Anokhelal, Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan angers Manmohan. Vibhuti's impassioned promotion of his security agency makes no difference to Angoori. The four recruits fail to attract a client. As Anita brings Manmohan to her home for lunch, she realises that the four recruits have eaten up everything.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Tricks Manmohan Into Hiring a Bodyguard
episodesList.summary: As per Vibhuti's plot, Tillu pretends to be a dangerous goon, Yaacoob, and threatens to abduct Angoori, after which Vibhuti convinces a stingy Manmohan to hire him as Angoori's bodyguard. Teeka pretends to be a thief and robs Masterji's cheque, after which Vibhuti convinces him to hire Teeka as his guard. The recruits munch everything at the Mishra house, which angers Anita. Vibhuti's plot lets him guard Angoori in her bedroom sans Manmohan. Vibhuti's plan to frighten Anita backfires badly.

episodesList.title: Anita Ousts Vibhuti From The House
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti's four recruits munch Angoori's halwa for Manmohan instead of tasting it to determine its health, which angers Manmohan. Vibhuti's sympathy for his recruits, who have been evicted from the Mishra house by Anita, leads to Anita evicting him too. Anita is happy to meet her pal Bitti, who is in search of the prince of her dreams. Vibhuti bars Manmohan from dropping Angoori at Ammaji's home due to security reasons. Anokhelal sleeps with a snake, which rattles the other recruits.

episodesList.title: Anita Gets Abducted
episodesList.summary: Anita asks Manmohan to abduct her so that Vibhuti closes his security agency. Happu overhears Vibhuti's agency's untruthful modus operandi. A professional masked kidnapper abducts Anita, who misunderstands that he is Manmohan. A masked Manmohan with a canine sound doesn't get a reply from Anita and, instead, a dog angrily rips apart his pant. Vibhuti realises that Anita has been abducted and cries and is arrested. Happu exposes Vibhuti's plan, which saddens Angoori.

episodesList.title: Ammaji Tells Tiwari About Raamphal's Prediction
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti accuses Manmohan of humiliating him in the garb of humour. Ammaji informs the Tiwaris and the Mishras at the Tiwari house that Pandit Raamphal has predicted astrological danger for Angoori. Circumstances lead Teeka and Malkhan to a mansion in Chandangad, the eeriness of which makes the two flee from there, but with a costly musical anklet. Manmohan buys the anklet for Anita but is forced to give it to Angoori. As Manmohan adorns Angoori with it, eerie developments take place nearby.

episodesList.title: Angoori Gets Possessed
episodesList.summary: Angoori's public dance at night, which leads to Thakur Saab mourning the loss of his wife Gulaab Jaan, surprises Vibhuti. Manmohan faints on seeing Angoori disappear and appear eerily. Angoori doesn't believe Vibhuti's claim that she had danced. After an interaction with Happu, Vibhuti apologises to Angoori for his claim. But Angoori, with Gulaab's voice, then eerily admits to him that she did dance. Anita gets angry with Manmohan over the anklet. Tillu plots to steal his salary from Manmohan.

episodesList.title: Gulaab Tells Vibhuti About Her Past
episodesList.summary: Angoori, who is possessed by Gulaab whenever she wears the anklet, talks in pure Urdu about being an attendant at Nawab Shaukat's durbar, which unsettles Vibhuti. Manmohan points out Angoori's pure Urdu and non-vegetarian cooked food to Anita, who thinks that an insecure Manmohan envies Angoori. A possessed Angoori drinks alcohol with Manmohan and Vibhuti. Happu nabs Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan as they try to rob at the Tiwari home. Ammaji blames Manmohan for Angoori's disappearance from the house.

episodesList.title: The Residents Of Modern Colony Arrive At Chandangad
episodesList.summary: The Mishras, Tillu, Malkhan, Teeka, Ammaji, Happu, Anokhelal and Manmohan are in Chandangad after the truth is known about the musical anklet, the mansion and Chandangad. In the mansion, all of them convince a reluctant Thakur Saab to accommodate them there for a night after he denies that Angoori is with him. Happu, Vibhuti and Manmohan encounter their blanket sliding away from them and turning into an invisible entity. The eeriness of the servant Lakhan frightens Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan.

episodesList.title: Gulab Jaan's Spirit Possesses Angoori
episodesList.summary: Anita and the others wonder about the person inside the locked room. Anita tries to lure Thakur to make way for others to enter the room. Lakhanpal sees them entering and informs Thakur. Everyone stares at Angoori who is possessed by Gulab Jaan's spirit. Gulab Jaan states that Thakur had choked her to death. Gulab Jaan's skeleton is discovered behind a wall which shocks everyone. Gulab Jaan's spirit enters Ammaji's and beats Thakur. Angoori wakes up with no memory of the events.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Becomes a Taxi Driver
episodesList.summary: After the dinner, Meenal states that the dinner was not tasty. Anita blames Vibhuti for her bad kitchen skills. Prem informs Vibhuti that he wants to use his newly bought car as a taxi and is searching for a driver. Vibhuti agrees to be his driver which makes Anita angry. Teeka and Malkhan thank the Commissioner for sponsoring their garage. Vibhuti gives a ride to Angoori but refuses Anita. Manmohan gets mad at Angoori for returning late. An upset Anita asks Vibhuti to sleep in the taxi.

episodesList.title: Anita Tells Manmohan to Sabotage Vibhuti's Taxi
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti tells Angoori that he will drop her to the market but she refuses as she fears Manmohan. Left with no choice Angoori goes in Vibhuti's taxi. Malkhan and Teeka fail to repair Happu's scooter's horn. Anita advises Manmohan to ruin Vibhuti's taxi. Manmohan hires Malkhan and Teeka for the job. Manmohan gets angry with Vibhuti for bringing Angoori home late and charging a high fare. Anita misses Vibhuti who sleeps in his taxi and convinces him to return home.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Angoori Lose Their Memory
episodesList.summary: Malkhan and Teeka take Vibhuti's taxi's engine out. Vibhuti takes Angoori to the market in his taxi. Anita and Manmohan learn that Malkhan and Teeka have taken the taxi's brakes out instead of the engine. Vibhuti and Angoori are shocked after learning about the break fail. Manmohan and Anita are devastated after Happu informs them that Vibhuti and Angoori's car has fallen down the cliff. Vibhuti and Angoori are saved by a fisherman, Kallu Mama and his wife, Dulari but lose their memory.

episodesList.title: Happu Brings Angoori and Vibhuti Back
episodesList.summary: Kallu and Dulari assume that Vibhuti and Angoori are lovers and decide to get them married. Anita informs David about Vibhuti and Angoori's accident and that they cannot be traced. Malkhan and Teeka feel guilty about Vibhuti and Angoori's accident. Happu arrives with Angoori and Vibhuti which makes everyone happy. To Anita and Manmohan's disappointment, Angoori and Vibhuti don't recognise them as they have lost their memory. Manmohan and Anita take Vibhuti and Angoori inside the house.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Worst Nightmare
episodesList.summary: Anita and Manmohan fail to bring their respective spouse's memory back. Anita and Manmohan stop Vibhuti and Angoori from leaving. Anita comes up with a plan to bring Vibhuti and Angoori's memory back. Anita, Manmohan and David take Vibhuti and Angoori for a car ride. Vibhuti and Angoori's memory returns but David loses his memory during the ride. Everything that happened turns out to be Vibhuti's nightmare. On Anita's order, Vibhuti returns the car to Prem and gets back to his normal life.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Devastating Medical Test Reports
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti wakes up after dreaming about Anita marrying Happu when she learns about Vibhuti's illness. Anita assures Vibhuti that she will not leave him at any cost. Dr Gupta mistakenly gives Vibhuti the wrong medical test reports. A devastated Vibhuti asks Dr Gupta to keep the news about his ill-health a secret. Manmohan boasts about his clean health report in front of Vibhuti. Malkhan and Teeka talk about the film 'Anand' in front of Vibhuti making him emotional.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Invites Vibhuti to His Party
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti takes Manmohan's advice on whether to tell Anita about his ill-health. Bhuja realises about his blunder of mixing up the reports. Manmohan invites Anita and Vibhuti at his party to celebrate his good health which bothers Vibhuti. Everybody enjoys the party except Vibhuti. A drunk Vibhuti arrives at Gulfam Kali's place and argues with a man there. Gulfam Kali consents to Vibhuti's last wish to take a few selfies with her. The man with whom Vibhuti had argued is stabbed by an unknown man.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gets Arrested For Murdering Kantilal
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti sees a man dragging a dead body. The man tells Vibhuti the reason for committing the crime. Vibhuti decides to take the blame for the murder in exchange for money and asks the man to take his photo with the body. Happu informs everyone that Vibhuti has murdered Kantilal and arrests him. Manmohan takes Anita to a renowned lawyer, Booteshwar Muthreja. Anita requests Booteshwar to defend Vibhuti's case but he refuses. He insults Anita. Anita and Angoori slap Booteshwar and leave.

episodesList.title: Saxena Fights Vibhuti's Case
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti tells Anita about his illness and the reason for taking the blame for the murder which makes Anita happy. Dr Gupta arrives with the good news of Vibhuti's good health. Happu advises Anita to hire a good lawyer. Saxena tells Anita that he will fight Vibhuti's case. In the court, Muthreja arrives to fight against Saxena. Vikram tells the court that he has photos of Vibhuti killing Kantilal and sends them to Happu. Saxena accuses Vikram of clicking the photos instead of saving Kantilal.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Professes His Love to Angoori In Court
episodesList.summary: Saxena and Muthreja argue during the trial. Tillu, Teeka, Malkhan, and Gulfam Kali are called for questioning in the court. Happu tells Anita that he has found a Jodhpuri suit's button near the dead body. The next morning, Anita and Manmohan visit a tailor, Adil Behaya, to inquire about the button. Adil Behaya informs Anita that it belongs to Vikram Chenoi and agrees to testify in the court. In the court, Vibhuti says 'I Love You' to Angoori in front of everyone.

episodesList.title: Anita and Angoori Gather Evidence Against Vikram
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti dreams about proposing to Angoori and dancing with her in the court. Adil Behaya testifies against Vibhuti. Gulfam Kali informs Anita and Angoori that she is going to perform at Vikram's farmhouse. Anita and Angoori perform at Vikram's farmhouse instead of Gulfam Kali. Tillu finds Vikram's suit with the buttons similar to the one that was discovered near the dead body. Manmohan dreams about Vibhuti getting a death penalty and romances with Anita before he is woken by the judge.

episodesList.title: Anita Saves Vibhuti From The Death Sentence
episodesList.summary: In the court, Saxena shows Vikram's coat found at his farmhouse. Muthreja alleges that the coat belongs to Vibhuti. The judge pronounces that Vibhuti is guilty. Manmohan and Angoori console Anita. Malkhan and Teeka tell Anita that they will kidnap the judge's daughter and ask Vibhuti's freedom as ransom. Everyone is shocked at seeing the judge's daughter's photo. The judge gives Vibhuti a death penalty. Anita brings evidence against Vikram. The judge sets Vibhuti free which makes everyone happy.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Throws a Party For Ladoo
episodesList.summary: Tillu informs everyone that Ladoo has passed in his exams which makes them jubilate. Manmohan decides to throw a party to celebrate Ladooâ€™s success. Masterji decides to tell Manmohan about Ladoo's poor performance but Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan stop Masterji. Everyone celebrates at the party. The commissioner orders Happu, who is on his way to the party, to hide in a dustbin to capture a goon. Happu finds a tied Masterji in a dustbin. Happu arrives at Manmohanâ€™s party with Masterji.

episodesList.title: Anita and Vibhuti Pretend to be Ladoo's Parents
episodesList.summary: At the party, Masterji informs everyone about Ladoo failing in his exams. Vibhuti gets angry with Anita for insulting him in front of Manmohan. Ammaji decides to take Ladoo with her but Anita tells Ammaji to give Ladoo another chance. On Anita's advice, Manmohan calls Martha Mathew English School but they want the parents to be well educated. Ammaji suggests to Anita that she and Vibhuti should pretend as Ladoo's parents. Miss Martha from the school arrives and questions Vibhuti and Anita.

episodesList.title: Anita Prepares Ladoo For His Exams
episodesList.summary: Anita and Vibhuti introduce the Tiwaris to Miss Martha. Miss Martha asks Vibhuti and Anita to come to the school for a meeting. After Martha leaves, Anita and Vibhuti fight with each other and just then, Martha enters the house. Ladoo informs Martha that Vibhuti tortures him. Martha brings Happu to arrest Anita and Vibhuti. Saxena arrives with Anita and Vibhuti's release papers. Anita helps Ladoo for his English exam. Ladoo passes in his exam which makes everyone happy.

episodesList.title: Anita Invites Pralay Jhangirabadi At Her House
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and Anita are thrilled to see their classmate, Pralay Jhangirabadi, a renowned poet, on a talk show. Anita invites Pralay at her house and decides to host a poetic evening. Vibhuti invites Manmohan, Angoori and Saxena. Manmohan unintentionally upsets Anita while complimenting her. Vibhuti gets angry to see Malkhan, Teeka, Tillu and Happu at the event. Saxena talks to himself stating that Pralay will get raged upon seeing Manmohan's redshirt.

episodesList.title: Pralay Threatens to Kill Manmohan
episodesList.summary: Pralay Jhangirabadi arrives at Vibhuti's house and makes weird faces on seeing Manmohan's redshirt. Everyone introduces themselves poetically. Pralay makes a weird face on seeing Anita's red saree and asks everyone to speak poetically. Everyone showcases their poetry one by one. David Mishra and Manmohan insult each other with their poems. On Anita's request, Pralay reads his poem while Vibhuti proposes to her. Pralay threatens to kill Manmohan if anyone moves from their place.

episodesList.title: Pralay Wishes to Marry Anita
episodesList.summary: Saxena informs everyone that Pralay Jhangirabad becomes insane on seeing red colour. Pralay threatens everyone to speak poetically and takes Manmohan into the bedroom. Pralay confesses his love for Anita and wishes to marry her. Happu is unsuccessful in calming Pralay. Pralay threatens to drown himself along with Manmohan in River Ganga if Anita rejects his proposal. Pralay agrees to let Manmohan have a cup of tea on the condition that Anita will slap Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Bhoorey Lal Agrees to Save Manmohan
episodesList.summary: David consoles Vibhuti who gets slapped by Anita. Ammaji arrives after learning that Pralay has held Manmohan hostage. Vibhuti asks Ammaji to speak only in rhymes. Pralay suspects that everyone is planning to catch him. David flirts with Ammaji which annoys Anita. Anita comes up with a plan to free Manmohan and capture Pralay. Pralay learns about Anita's plan to capture him and injures Vibhuti and Happu. Bhoorey Lal learns that Pralay has kept Manmohan hostage and reluctantly agrees to save him.

Masterji is concerned about the patients being in his neighbourhood. Happu, Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu, too, pretend as Saxenaâ€™s family. The two families meet and discuss Saxena and Anokheeâ€™s marriage and finalise their marriage. They slap each other to confirm the marriage.
