episodesList.title: Anita Makes Her Thesis On Angoori
episodesList.summary: Anita visits Angoori and sees her drinking blood, which is actually beetroot juice to cure her blood deficiency. Anita questions Angoori and makes notes for her thesis. Vibhuti and Manmohan arrange the sugarcane for Tony Braganza. Malkhan and Teeka are hospitalised for consuming spurious liquor. The commissioner informs Anita about Manmohan and Vibhuti being involved in the liquor racket. They clarify their stance with Anita. Anita shows the commissioner that Angoori left the house at night.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan Expose Tony and His Gang
episodesList.summary: Anita and Commissioner Singh follow Angoori and meet Daroga, who joins them in confronting Angoori for drinking blood. Angoori clarifies that she is not a Dracula by apprising them that she drinks a medicinal mixture prescribed by a priest. At the graveyard, Vibhuti and Manmohan give a consignment of sugarcanes to Tony Braganza's spirit to cure Angoori. When they learn the truth together with the police, they expose Tony Braganza and his co-gang member. Anita gives up her thesis on Draculas.

episodesList.title: Anita Prepares to Settle Down In The Us
episodesList.summary: Manmohan goes through a nightmare about Anita leaving Kanpur. Anita receives a phone call from her brother Mark Shuturmurg, who invites her to come to the US and settle with Vibhuti there. Teeka states his dream of going to the US to Malkhan and Tillu. Dressed in a western outfit, Anita states her excitement to Manmohan and Daroga, who are grief-stricken. Angoori tells Vibhuti that the only thing that she will miss about him is his Urdu. Manmohan and Vibhuti share their grief over alcohol.

episodesList.title: Mark Shuturmurg Arrives to Meet Anita
episodesList.summary: Following Ammaji's advice to improve Manmohan's business, Angoori gets duped by a beggar, whom she mistakes for a foreigner. Vibhuti throws the scrap dealer out after Anita calls him to sell the furniture. But Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu take away a table from her house. Desperate to make Anita not leave Kanpur, Vibhuti makes a tall commitment of earning INR one lakh a month. Wanting Anita close to him, Manmohan sponsors a motor garage for Vibhuti, but the arrival of Mark upsets the boat.

episodesList.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Ask Gulfam to Enchant Mark
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti imagines frolicking with Angoori in his garage. A car owner requests him to repair his car. Vibhuti decides to not leave Kanpur. Manmohan states Vibhuti's success as the reason for his happiness. Anita introduces Manmohan to Mark, who insults him. Manmohan and Vibhuti ask Gulfam Kali to enchant Mark to stall the plan of leaving Kanpur. Gulfam Kali mistakes Angrez Kumar for Mark. Remembering Ammaji's advice, Angoori agrees to show Mark around and is spotted by Manmohan and Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Mark Wants to Take Angoori to The Us
episodesList.summary: The irate car owner shouts at Vibhuti. Angoori's return home gets delayed, which makes Manmohan angry. Daroga wants Prem to apply for a job for him in the FBI. He readily agrees to Vibhuti and Manmohan's plan of instigating Anita to beat him and later register a case against her to stop her from going to the US. Instead, he gets thrashed by the public for eve-teasing, and the plan fails. Mark insists on taking Angoori to the US. David arrives, and Anita tears his will into pieces.

episodesList.title: Anita Throws a Farewell Party
episodesList.summary: Anita refuses to accept Vibhuti's inheritance. David and Mark spat about English versus American superiority. Vibhuti dresses up as a foreigner to make Anita relent. Manmohan and Vibhuti break their heads over the solution to this problem. Manmohan weeps, thinking about Anita's departure. Anita hosts a farewell party. Modern Colony and Ammaji attend the party where Vibhuti renders a patriotic song. Vibhuti and Anita's visa is rejected, and everyone, including Anita, rejoices.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Disguises Himself As a Beggar
episodesList.summary: Anita and Vibhuti hear the news of a beggar, who dies as a millionaire. Ammaji gets an electric shock from the doorbell. She instructs Angoori to feed delicacies to beggars and donate INR 501 for the betterment of Manmohan's business. Vibhuti sees the special treatment that Angoori gives a beggar. He disguises himself as a beggar, and Manmohan gives him special Halwa and Poori and money. Vibhuti sends the delicacies to Anita. Vibhuti plans to recruit Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu to his gang.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Seeks Alms From Angoori
episodesList.summary: Manmohan becomes suspicious of Vibhuti. Ammaji gets another electric shock. Ladoo puts a bomb under Manmohan's chair. Vibhuti gives his day's earnings to Anita and tells her that he is working for Prem. Vibhuti recruits Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu as beggars briefing them about BBIA, his organisation. The next day, Vibhuti, dressed up as a beggar, troubles Angoori. Manmohan gives him Jalebis and a saree as instructed by Ammaji and gets shocked seeing Anita wearing the same saree and eating Jalebis.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Exposes Vibhuti's New Profession
episodesList.summary: Recognising the saree and the Jalebi container, Manmohan questions Anita, who defends Vibhuti. When Pelu arrives with the 'kheer' that Manmohan had given Vibhuti, Anita decides to check on him. Vibhuti gifts a saree to Angoori, which angers Manmohan. Manmohan takes Anita to the temple where Vibhuti begs and exposes him. Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu beg for money from the Doctor and Masterji. Ladoo places a bomb on Tillu's hand, and Teeka bears the repercussion. The commissioner reprimands Daroga.

episodesList.title: Anita Encourages Vibhuti to Beg
episodesList.summary: Anita encourages Vibhuti to continue being a beggar and joins him to manage the collections. Manmohan is shocked to see Anita's support for Vibhuti. Vibhuti, dressed up as a beggar, impresses Angoori with his profound talk. Anita offers tips to increase the collections. David becomes bankrupt and joins Vibhuti's gang. The other beggars' gang beat Vibhuti's gang for usurping their areas. Modern Colony celebrates Diwali, and Ladoo pledges not to light crackers, which cause pollution.

episodesList.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Flatter Their Wives
episodesList.summary: Saxena shares the news about women falling prey to false praise. Vibhuti showers unlimited praise on Angoori, which pleases her. On the other hand, Manmohan and Daroga praise Anita, which elate her. Later, Manmohan praises Angoori's poetry and promises to get a book published about her jokes. Vibhuti laughs at Anita and tells her that her sense of humour is awesome. While the two of them celebrate their success, Saxena brings Angoori and Anita, who forbid their husbands from entering the house.

episodesList.title: Angoori and Anita Visit Professor Mintoo Chhabbra
episodesList.summary: Professor Mintoo Chhabbra, a love guru, claims to revive romance in couples' married lives. Anita takes Vibhuti for a romantic film where he falls off to sleep. Angoori takes Manmohan to a farmland where he spends time talking to his client. Angoori and Anita state their woes to each other and plan to visit the professor. Win Kundra comes in search of his choreographer Siddhu and offers to take Angoori to a shooting site. Saxena helps Gulfam Kali finalise a groom from Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan.

episodesList.title: Anita and Vibhuti's Role Reversal
episodesList.summary: Manmohan and Vibhuti resist visiting the professor. Angoori complains to Ammaji about Manmohan. At the counselling session with Masterji and his wife Vidya, Tiwaris and the Mishras, the professor tells them that they suffer from 'MNBG' and advises them to switch their roles. Saxena is worried about the groom selection and reacts violently to Daroga. Attempting to reignite their romance, Anita dresses up and behaves like Vibhuti and Vibhuti like Anita. David arrives during their act.

episodesList.title: Saxena Plans to Shave Half Of Happu's Moustache
episodesList.summary: Assuming that Vibhuti and Anita have had a gender change, David tears the will. Bhoorey Lal and Ammaji see Manmohan and Angoori dressed up and behaving like each other. Saxena's task for the boys is to plaster Daroga's face with cake. The couples share their experiences of their first task with the professor. To rekindle the romance in their marriages, he tells them to romance each others' wives, which excites the men. Saxena's next task is to shave Daroga's half moustache.

episodesList.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Romance Each Other's Spouses
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and Angoori's candlelight dinner ends in a disaster when David interrupts and tears his will. Ammaji convinces Bhoorey Lal to forgive Manmohan. But on seeing him romancing Anita, Bhoorey Lal slaps him. Ammaji faints when Angoori tells her about her evening with Vibhuti. Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu execute Saxena's task of shaving Daroga's half moustache and get hammered by him. They expose Saxena. The professor asks Vibhuti and Manmohan to run away with each other's wife.

episodesList.title: The Commissioner Sees Happu Threatening Manmohan
episodesList.summary: Saxena tells Daroga about targeting him to avenge his insult. Anita and Angoori disapprove of their husbands running away with each other's wife. Although excited initially, realising their folly, Vibhuti and Manmohan romance their wives. Anita's fountain pen's ink smears David's face, and he tears his will. Daroga promises to get Tillu's salary from Manmohan. He is caught threatening Manmohan by the commissioner, who is at the Mishra residence to change his underwear.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Gets a Huge Business Order
episodesList.summary: Anita jumps at the proposition of opening her grooming institute in partnership with Meenal and Anurag. Manmohan gets an order of INR two crores and is promised the money the next day. When Anita asks for INR one crore as a loan, Manmohan readily agrees. Angoori dreams of a Swiss trip. The commissioner tells Daroga that if he nabs the kidnappers who are threatening him, he would be promoted. Manmohan's order gets cancelled, which crashes Angoori's dreams. Anita asks for the cash promised to her.

episodesList.title: Anita Agrees to Sell Vibhuti For Money
episodesList.summary: Manmohan can't give Anita the loan of INR one crore. Anita requests two days' time from Meenal to arrange the cash. Singhania approaches Prem with a proposal of getting Vibhuti married to his sister, who loves Vibhuti. Prem refuses, but Manmohan closes the deal in INR three crores. At first, Anita is appalled at the thought of selling her hubby, but on seeing the advance money, agrees. Daroga ropes in Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu to kidnap the commissioner, but Daroga gets trapped in his game.

episodesList.title: Teeka and Gang Plot to Abduct The Commissioner
episodesList.summary: Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu realise their mistake of kidnapping Daroga instead of the commissioner. Anita's heartless and greedy behaviour distresses Vibhuti. Manmohan gets Vibhuti's complete health check-up done. Vibhuti feels like a piece of furniture while everyone inspects him. Anita discusses the payment schedule with Singhania. Manmohan and Vibhuti visit Gulfam Kali where Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu wait for Daroga and the commissioner to execute their second plan to abduct the commissioner.

episodesList.title: Sweety and Vibhuti's Ring Ceremony
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti rubbishes Anita's concern for him. Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu miss the target once again and abduct Daroga instead of the commissioner. Singhania's sister Sweety and Vibhuti exchange rings. Prem and David join in the celebrations. Anita is unhappy with Vibhuti dancing with Sweety. Daroga tells the boys to abduct a burkha-clad commissioner on a secret mission but is told by the commissioner that he will wear the burkha instead. Angoori disagrees with Vibhuti being sold.

episodesList.title: Ammaji has a Wall Built On The Tiwaris' Terrace
episodesList.summary: Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu abduct the burkha-clad Daroga. Anita changes her mind, and Singhania cancels the wedding, saying that Sweety wants to marry Manmohan. Vibhuti watches Angoori. Manmohan feels happy watching Anita from his balcony. For Manmohan's business' betterment, Ammaji gets a wall built on the balcony of the Tiwaris. Vibhuti and Manmohan devise a plan portraying the wall's inauspiciousness. Ammaji agrees to get the wall demolished and falls through the wall on Manmohan and Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Invents 'judwa Mania'
episodesList.summary: While eating 'Dahi Bhalle', Vibhuti chucks one at a girl and puts the blame on Manmohan, who gets thrashed by Tillu, Teeka, Malkhan and others for eve-teasing. Vibhuti donates his blood to Manmohan. Manmohan gets an idea to take revenge while watching a film. He pretends that, every time Vibhuti gets hurt, he feels the pain. The doctor calls this condition 'Judwa Mania'. Vibhuti does not support Anita's new assignment of working for mad people. Angoori ignores Vibhuti, which bothers him.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Urges Angoori to Punish Him
episodesList.summary: Anita shares with Meenal about the details of her new project with IHO and briefs Teeka, Malkhan, Tillu and her staff. Daroga congratulates Anita. On being ignored by Angoori, a heartbroken Vibhuti tells her to slap him as his retribution. Vibhuti thinks that Manmohan will feel the pain. Manmohan enjoys himself at Vibhuti's expense. Manmohan tries to gain Anita's sympathy. Next, Vibhuti gets himself beaten with a slipper from Angoori. Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu convince Prem to fake madness.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Convinces Angoori to Beat Him Ruthlessly
episodesList.summary: Anita threatens to throw Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan out of their jobs when they bring Prem, who poses as a mad man. Vibhuti offers them money and asks them to hit him. Manmohan enjoys Vibhuti being beaten and later, at night, fakes pain in front of Vibhuti. Vibhuti convinces Angoori to beat him ruthlessly with a hunter, and Daroga witnesses this. Daroga informs Anita and promises to bring a video recording. Manmohan comforts Angoori and tells her not to feel guilty for hitting Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Angoori Brands Vibhuti With a Hot Iron Rod
episodesList.summary: Daroga films a handcuffed Vibhuti being hit by Angoori with a belt while Manmohan watches gleefully. Anita is distressed on seeing the video and is convinced that all three are mad. Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan mistake that the commissioner is a mad man and pay a price by getting arrested. Manmohan dupes Angoori into using a hot iron rod on Vibhuti. David and Anita catch all three of them and put them in the mental asylum where Manmohan confesses that his plan is to take revenge on Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Anita Gets Angry When Vibhuti Criticises Her
episodesList.summary: Anita shares with Angoori her favourite author's view on husbands lying to their wives, and they insist that Vibhuti and Manmohan speak the truth. Angoori gets hurt due to Manmohan and Vibhuti's low opinion about her singing and low IQ. Anita gets angry when Vibhuti criticises her looks and when Manmohan and Vibhuti call her haughty. Vibhuti and Manmohan state their true opinion about Teeka, Tillu, Malkhan and Daroga. Disliking the truth, Angoori and Anita ask their hubbies to revert to lies.

episodesList.title: Anita Becomes an Inspector
episodesList.summary: A goon holds the commissioner at gunpoint. While Daroga deserts him, Anita overpowers the goon. Vibhuti overhears Ammaji telling Angoori that she needs to dance in a dacoit's presence for Manmohan's business to flourish. At the annual police function, Daroga is demoted while Anita is appointed as an inspector. Tillu warns Teeka and Malkhan about their bleak future. Anita threatens to suspend Happu Singh if the pending cases are not solved. Vibhuti tells Angoori that he has a dacoity friend.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gets Kidnapped By a Dacoit
episodesList.summary: Anita's strictness unnerves Manmohan, who comes to the cop station to give her sweets. He informs her about dacoit Anjana Singh's whereabouts. Angoori dances in front of Vibhuti disguised as the dacoit. Anita and Happu Singh arrive, and Vibhuti is exposed. Before he can prove his innocence, the real dacoit abducts him. No one is ready to believe a helpless Vibhuti, who is forced to loot. Teeka and Malkhan become greengrocers. A disguised Manmohan gets himself caught for eve-teasing by Anita.

episodesList.title: Anjana Singh Refuses to Grant Freedom to Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti, as dacoit Anjana Singh, loots Manmohan and Tillu. He gives the money to Anjana Singh, who denies him his freedom. Manmohan reports the robbery to Inspector Anita. Anita states her dilemma to Angoori. Vibhuti wants to talk to Anita as her husband, but Anita holds him at gunpoint. Using Angoori as his crutch, Vibhuti escapes. Commissioner reprimands Anita for allowing Vibhuti to escape. Manmohan throws Angoori out for hampering Vibhuti's arrest. Anjana Singh takes Vibhuti to Gulfam Kali.

episodesList.title: Angoori Becomes a Dacoit
episodesList.summary: A homeless Angoori joins Vibhuti and dacoit Anjana's Singh's gang. Inspector Anita reprimands Happu Singh for sleeping in the police station and calls for Manmohan's arrest for pushing Angoori to become a criminal. Vibhuti imagines romancing Angoori. While Vibhuti and Angoori are looting vegetables from Teeka and Malkhan, Inspector Anita arrives. Manmohan causes Vibhuti and Angoori to escape. Vibhuti tears David's will of INR 20 crores and strips him off his personal belongings.

episodesList.title: Inspector Anita Traps The Dacoit
episodesList.summary: At Angoori's insistence, Vibhuti and Dacoit Anjana Singh come to Manmohan's house to clean his safe. Inspector Anita catches them and discloses her, Angoori and Manmohan's plan of Angoori joining the dacoit's gang to trap Vibhuti. Happu Singh catches the real dacoit, who escapes. Happu Singh gets reinstated, and Anita resigns. Manmohan mistakes Ammaji for her character Pappu in a play, who romances with Anita while rehearsing. Teeka and Malkhan get caught trying to dupe a CID officer.

episodesList.title: Angoori and Vibhuti Visit Baba Lakdanand
episodesList.summary: Tillu lifts Teeka and Malkhan's sagging spirits by bringing work. Manmohan overhears Anita coaxing Vibhuti to grow his hair like actor Salman Khan. Ammaji informs Angoori about Baba Lakdanand, a tantric who is visiting Kanpur. Angoori accompanies Vibhuti to the tantric to resolve his unemployment and agrees to shave Manmohan's hair once Vibhuti gets work. Anita sees Vibhuti in Manmohan, who grows his hair to suit Anita's taste. Vibhuti consents to replace the absconding acrobat.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti is Tasked With Performing a Perilous Act
episodesList.summary: Angoori informs Manmohan about Lakdanand's instruction, which requires offering Manmohan's hair to him after Vibhuti gets work. Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu prepare for the show. Seeing Vibhuti as an acrobat upsets Anita. Angoori is happy for Vibhuti and approaches Manmohan to cut his hair. Manmohan is put in a spot with Ammaji's arrival, but he defers losing his hair by a day. Anita throws a stinking Vibhuti out of her bedroom. Vibhuti is told about the perilous act that he has to perform.

episodesList.title: Angoori Prepares to Shave Off Manmohan's Head
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti refuses to perform the dangerous act and realises Manmohan's motive behind discouraging him from working. Manmohan bribes Daroga to stop Vibhuti's street performance. Realising Daroga's weakness, Vibhuti makes him dance like a monkey. Anita sees Vibhuti in Manmohan. Vibhuti gives a razor to Angoori to shave Manmohan's hair. Manmohan overhears Ammaji and Angoori's plan to sedate him and then shave his head. Although Manmohan throws away the spiked milk, Ammaji's blow knocks him out.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Wears a Wig
episodesList.summary: Manmohan hides his bald head under a monkey cap and, when questioned by Anita, attributes it to ill health. He buys a wig and meets Anita for lunch where his wig gets blown away by the strong breeze. A disappointed Anita asks him to leave. Manmohan asks Daroga to return the bribe for his failure to stop Vibhuti's work. Daroga's second attempt is also foiled. Manmohan puts a lizard in Vibhuti's shirt, causing him to fall during his act. Anita tells a bedridden Vibhuti that he isn't meant to work.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti, Manmohan, and Daroga Get Thrashed
episodesList.summary: Daroga informs the Tiwaris and the Mishras about a terrorist escaping from jail. Manmohan and Vibhuti make fun of Daroga. Vibhuti, Manmohan and Daroga decide to put each other down. Angoori and Anita decide to display their strength against the terrorist. Vibhuti gets beaten by Angoori, who mistakes him for the terrorist. Likewise, Manmohan gets thrashed by Anita. Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu mistake Daroga for the terrorist and beat him. All three hide the actual reason for their injuries.

episodesList.title: Anita and Angoori Join Political Parties
episodesList.summary: Anita joins politics and decides to contest the municipal elections as Tej Tewar Party's candidate with Manmohan as her secretary. Nand Kishore of the Bholi Bhali Party urges Angoori to be their candidate. Vibhuti coaxes Angoori to agree. Manmohan stops Angoori, but on Vibhuti's provocation and with Ammaji's support, Angoori agrees. In front of Ammaji, Manmohan has to support Angoori. Prem gives Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan the task of sticking posters for the elections.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan to Ruin Their Wives' Campaign
episodesList.summary: Anita and Angoori get their photo shoots done for their campaign posters. Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan wonder who would be more advantageous for them between Anita and Angoori. Anita gives a speech focusing on the youth, and Angoori on the mothers. Manmohan and Vibhuti run each other down. Vibhuti promises to get Prem's gambling dens reopened in exchange for his help in tarnishing Anita's image. Manmohan and Daroga vow to ruin Angoori's innocent image. Prem records Vibhuti pressing Anita's legs.

episodesList.title: A News Channel Airs Angoori and Anita's Videos
episodesList.summary: Daroga films Angoori not being able to answer Manmohan's general knowledge questions, thereby exposing her ignorance. Tipish Kumar's news channel airs Angoori and Anita's videos. Ammaji beats Manmohan. Masterji and Baba Parmanand are the panellists on the news show. Manmohan and Daroga watch Vibhuti bribing Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan by giving them one year's free access to Gulfam Kali's place in exchange for their votes for Angoori. Manmohan devises a plan to counteract Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Bails Out Tillu, Teeka, and Malkhan
episodesList.summary: Anita and Angoori express their comradeship and discuss their husbands' animosity towards each other. Vibhuti enjoys the breakfast prepared by Angoori and forbids Manmohan from eating as he is from the opposition. Anita tells Manmohan to prepare breakfast for her and himself as Vibhuti has refused to do so. Vibhuti is unable to polish Angoori's Urdu. He tells Gulfam Kali to take care of Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan, but Daroga arrests them. Manmohan secures their bail and wins their votes for Anita.

episodesList.title: Anita and Angoori Withdraw From The Elections
episodesList.summary: Angoori and Anita with their respective husbands, Manmohan and Vibhuti, appear on a news debate. The news host, Tapish Kumar, asks them about their plan to bring about a change in the city. Manmohan and Vibhuti insult each other and indulge in a physical fight. Anita and Angoori decide not to take part in the elections. Teeka informs Malkhan about a trick that can make any girl fall in love. Ladoo, who overhears their conversation, tells Malkhan and Teeka to impress girls with their talent.

episodesList.title: Angoori Steals Jewellery
episodesList.summary: Angoori steals jewellery from Ghanshyam Das's house. Meenal asks her to keep his jewellery until she returns from Dubai. Angoori asks Vibhuti to throw a bag in the forest leaving Vibhuti puzzled. Vibhuti learns that Malkhan, Teeka and Tillu have found the bag. The trio is filled with joy when they find the jewellery inside the bag. On Anita's insistence, Manmohan agrees to keep Meenal's jewellery at his house. Manmohan is shocked to learn that the jewellery is missing from the safe.

episodesList.title: Adhoore Lal Tells Angoori's Story to Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Manmohan tells Anita that he cannot find the keys to his safe. Angoori asks Vibhuti to drop another package in the forest. Vibhuti gets suspicious after seeing jewellery inside the packet found by Malkhan, Teeka and Tillu. Vibhuti sees Angoori sneaking out of her house in the middle of the night and decides to follow her. Vibhuti is heartbroken to learn that Angoori is a thief. He meets Angoori's uncle, Adhoore Lal who narrates a story to him that turned Angoori into a thief.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Finds Meenal's Missing Jewellery
episodesList.summary: Anita is relieved on finding Meenal's jewellery and informs Manmohan. Angoori arrives at Vibhuti's house to steal but Vibhuti stops her. When Meenal asks for her jewellery Anita is shocked to see that it is missing from her safe. Vibhuti asks Angoori to return the stolen jewellery but learns that she has thrown the jewellery in the forest. Vibhuti finds the jewellery with Happu and gives it back to Anita. Angoori informs Anita that she has stolen the jewellery.

episodesList.title: Angoori Steals Queen Kamlavati's Diamond
episodesList.summary: Anita tells Vibhuti and Manmohan to keep an eye on Angoori. The commissioner gives Happu the responsibility of keeping Queen Kamlavati's diamond safe in the museum. Manmohan informs Anita and Vibhuti that Angoori has stolen Queen Kamlavati's diamond. Happu and the commissioner find Vibhuti and Manmohan, who arrive to bring back the diamond, sneaking into the museum. Anita informs Vibhuti and Manmohan that they will have to recreate the event that has impacted Angoori.

episodesList.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Want to Adopt Teeka
episodesList.summary: Angoori washes Adhoore Lal's face and decides that she will never steal. The priest informs Teeka that whoever will foster him will become rich. Manmohan and Vibhuti convince their wives to adopt Teeka. Vibhuti and Manmohan shower love on Teeka and invite him for dinner leaving Tillu and Malkhan confused. Happu informs Manmohan that Teeka is having a feast at Vibhuti's home. Tillu and Malkhan reveal Teeka's truth in front of Vibhuti and Manmohan. Manmohan and Vibhuti beat Teeka.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Angoori Meet With an Accident
episodesList.summary: Angoori tells Vibhuti that Manmohan is taking her for shopping. Manmohan makes an excuse and refuses to go with Angoori as he wants to spend time with Anita. Vibhuti takes Angoori for shopping on Prem's scooter. While returning, Vibhuti and Angoori meet with an accident and Angoori loses consciousness. Manmohan blames Vibhuti for the accident. Angoori addresses Vibhuti as Bhushan and slaps him multiple times which shocks everyone.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Slapped!
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti tries to enter Angoori's bedroom in the middle of the night. Angoori wakes up and slaps Vibhuti while addressing him as Bhushan. Manmohan invites Anita and Vibhuti for Ammaji's birthday party. At the party, Vibhuti dances with Angoori while donning a mask. Angoori recognises Vibhuti and slaps him for coming to the party. Ammaji tells Manmohan that she has to leave to take care of Pandit Ramphal and asks Manmohan to keep a nurse for Angoori. Vibhuti borrows nurse's clothes from Saxena.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Dons The Guise Of Julie Chattopadhyay
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti disguises himself as a nurse and introduces himself as Julie Chattopadhyay. Manmohan is not convinced by her nursing abilities, and Anita interrogates him. Saxena vouches for her and, later, takes his compensation with a thrashing. Masterji is scandalised by the sounds from the bushes. Happu Singh faces a problem of not being able to urinate and seeks Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan's aid. Vibhuti confesses to Anita about his disguise, and Manmohan sees Anita romancing Julie Chattopadhyay.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Ousts Julie
episodesList.summary: Manmohan is scandalised and anguished on witnessing Anita romance Julie. Later, Masterji informs him about Julie and Saxena, and Manmohan sees David embracing Julie. Manmohan overhears Julie telling Angoori to divorce him. An agonised Happu is desperate for help. Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan suggest a way. What nobody could do, Prem's malfunctioned scooter does. Happu finally urinates. Manmohan throws Julie out, and in the tussle that ensues, Vibhuti's wig comes out.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Kisses Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti visits a Baba to win Angoori's love. Manmohan to get rid of his irritation. Baba gives 'Kajal' to Vibhuti to apply and look at only the person he wants to attract. He tells Manmohan to kiss the person, who irritates him the most. Vibhuti opens his 'Kajal'-applied eyes in front of Manmohan, who kisses him. Happu shows Anita a video of Manmohan kissing Vibhuti, and Anita informs Angoori about it. Angoori prepares to leave the house. Ammaji thrashes Manmohan. Manmohan explains his action.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Donates His Sperm At Dr Micky's Clinic
episodesList.summary: Happu cries and shares his grief about not knowing his father's name with Vibhuti. Vibhuti tells him about his royal lineage, which Dr Micky Donor overhears. He invites Vibhuti to his clinic to donate his sperm. Ammaji tells Angoori and Manmohan that she wants a grandchild. Anita tells Vibhuti to arrange INR two lakhs to give the landlord. Vibhuti donates his sperm at Dr Micky's clinic and sees Ammaji and Angoori there. Meenal advises Anita to have a baby to make Vibhuti a responsible man.

episodesList.title: Happu Learns That He is Vibhuti's Brother
episodesList.summary: Dr Micky Donor advises Angoori to fake her pregnancy to get Manmohan interested in fatherhood. Anita tries to convince a reluctant Vibhuti about becoming parents. She questions Vibhuti about the INR 2 lakhs that he gives her. Dr Micky Donor discloses to Happu that the latter and Vibhuti are brothers. An emotional Happu informs Vibhuti and Anita about this. Angoori's fake pregnancy elates Manmohan. To pay the landlord of the premises of Anita's grooming class, Vibhuti donates his sperm again.

episodesList.title: Angoori Pretends to be Pregnant
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti can't believe his ears and wrongly assumes that his sperm has caused Angoori's pregnancy. He takes a raw mango for Angoori. Happu shares with Anita the entire story about how he is Vibhuti's brother. Vibhuti tries to calm a distraught Anita. Manmohan stops Angoori from doing the household chores. Ammaji advises Angoori to carry on the pretence for a while longer. An emotional Happu interrupts Vibhuti and Anita's romance and tells Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan about his sob story.

episodesList.title: Anita Wants to Become a Mother
episodesList.summary: Anita overhears Angoori, who informs Bhoorey Lal about her pregnancy at Manmohan's insistence. An excited Anita emphatically expresses her desire of parenthood to Vibhuti. Happu's emotional outburst irritates the Mishras. Unable to contain his happiness, Bhoorey Lal wants to organise a 'Godh Bharai' ceremony for Angoori. Manmohan is unhappy with Anita's wish to become a mother. Dr Micky Donor rejects Teeka's offer to donate his sperm. Tillu and Malkhan try their luck, but they too are rejected.

episodesList.title: Gulfam Kali Forcibly Hides In The Tiwaris' Bathroom
episodesList.summary: An inebriated Vibhuti informs Bhoorey Lal that he has impregnated Angoori. An embarrassed Ammaji reveals her plot to instil paternal feelings in Manmohan. Vibhuti reveals to Anita that he misunderstood that Angoori's pregnancy was linked to his sperm donation. Dr Micky requests an exasperated Happu to hunt for his own father. As Gulfam forcibly hides in the bathroom of the Tiwaris, Anita and Vibhuti seek to bathe at the Tiwari house due to a water supply cut at their house.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Becomes Kanpur's Cleanliness Ambassador
episodesList.summary: Anita wants Vibhuti to retrieve her diamond ring from the dustbin as she suspects that he placed it there irresponsibly. Angoori thinks that she should throw garbage on Vibhuti to ensure prosperity for her house after Ammaji warns of astrological trouble for Manmohan. Vibhuti fines Minister Singh for littering in public after the latter appoints him Kanpur's cleanliness ambassador. Vibhuti's fame and plans as ambassador elate Anita and Angoori but irk Manmohan.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Fines Anita For Littering Her Home
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti fines Manmohan, assuming that the latter will throw banana peels, and for misbehaving with his cleanliness officers. Vibhuti bars Teeka from fining Angoori despite her littering Vibhuti after the latter flirts with her over her tasty carrot halwa. Anokhelal litters publicly and Happu and wants to be punished brutally, but the cleanliness officers and Happu escape from him. Vibhuti fines Anita for littering her home. Manmohan angrily deems that the cleanliness campaign is fleecing people.

episodesList.title: Anita Pretends to be Manmohan's Wife
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti fines Agarwal, assuming that the latter will spit out chewing gum publicly. To seal her grooming class' deal with Agarwal's marital counselling bureau, Anita pretends to be Manmohan's wife. Angoori, who notices Manmohan's delight, is told by Ammaji that she will have to make her hitherto target throw garbage publicly as the astrological state is improving. Vibhuti refuses to punish Anokhelal. Angoori makes Vibhuti litter publicly, which leads to him being fined. Vibhuti fines Malkhan.

episodesList.title: Kanpur's Residents Begin to Fear Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti fines Master Bhoop for the litter at a venue after a conversation with Minister Bhojraj. Angoori makes Vibhuti litter the venue, which shocks Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu. Manmohan seeks to boost his chemistry with Anita to retain Agarwal's trust. Ammaji visits the Tiwaris for a puja. Anita-Manmohan's pretence is exposed, which leads to Agarwal scrapping the deal. Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu find Anokhelal in a gutter after the pipe gets blocked. Kanpur's residents fear Vibhuti and his team.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Nainital Trip With Gulfam Kali
episodesList.summary: Manmohan romances a miffed Angoori. Bhojraj sacks Vibhuti from his position as cleanliness ambassador. Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu plot to scuttle Vibhuti's supposed sleazy plan in Nainital with Gulfam. Anita gets angry when she receives a message on the phone that Vibhuti has booked a room with Babita in Nainital in a hotel. Angoori suspects that Manmohan has lied to her about the reason behind his scheduled visit to Nainital. Angoori, Anita, Manmohan and Happu follow Vibhuti and Gulfam.

episodesList.title: Anita Goes Missing In Chimpugad
episodesList.summary: Close to an eerie Chimpugad, as Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan bike, a saree-clad person lurks. Manmohan recommends that the new year be welcomed in Chimpugad, to which Angoori and Anita consent happily and Vibhuti reluctantly. Vibhuti flirts with Angoori over the romantic reputation of Chimpugad. The Mishras and the Tiwaris play spoken parlour in Chimpugad. Anita hears someone screaming outside her tent and subsequently goes missing. Vibhuti and the Tiwaris report to Happu about a missing Anita.

episodesList.title: Anita's Odd Behaviour
episodesList.summary: Anita's disappearance anguishes Manmohan and Happu. A tearful Anokhelal bashes Manmohan and orders Happu to find Anita as soon as possible. A shattered Anokhelal batters a crestfallen Vibhuti, who weeps in front of Angoori. Vibhuti disagrees emphatically with Manmohan when the latter suggests that Vibhuti should unite with Gulfam. Anita returns and rather weirdly cooks food and feeds it to Vibhuti. A seemingly possessed Anita's arrival at the police station elates Happu, whom Anita flirts with.

episodesList.title: Anita Kisses Manmohan
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti resumes flirting with Angoori. An arguably possessed Anita flirts with Manmohan at her home and kisses him, which sends 'electric signals' throughout his body. At Zorawar's hideout, as the real tied Anita watches, Mona, who has disguised herself as Anita with 'plastic surgery', plots evilly with him. Mona sends Vibhuti out of the Mishra house, which makes him suspect that Anita wants to flirt with Happu. Mona wants justice for her murdered sister. Manmohan wonders why Anita kissed him.

episodesList.title: Mona Runs Away With Jk
episodesList.summary: Manmohan, who thinks that Anita kissed him and wants to know why, gets kissed by Mona again. Happu affectionately blackmails Commissioner Singh into letting Anita meet the imprisoned criminal JK without knowing that it is Mona who wants to meet him. Mona reveals with giggles to Angoori that Vibhuti loves Angoori and that she kissed Manmohan, which shocks Angoori and the two men, who assume that she is Anita. Mona fools Singh and Happu and runs away with JK. A trapped Anita is in a dilemma.

episodesList.title: Angoori Identifies The Real Anita
episodesList.summary: At Mona's hideout, Vibhuti's personal questions are answered rightly by Mona and Anita, which heightens the confusion as to who is Anita. Manmohan, who gets slapped by both women, is also unable to identify Anita. Angoori helps the cops arrest Mona. Later, Anita happily lets a feminine Saxena do domestic work in her house. Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan wish to wed the maid not knowing that he is Saxena. Anita doesn't know it too and agrees to help the maid choose one of the men as her hubby.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan Get Flashbacks Of Their Past Lives
episodesList.summary: Tillu asks Manmohan for his salary. Manmohan refuses and slaps him. Tillu gangs up with Teeka and Malkhan and beats Manmohan. Vibhuti sees Manmohan getting beaten and has flashbacks of his previous life where he was 'Karan' and Manmohan was 'Arjun'. He saves Manmohan. That night, Manmohan has the same flashbacks. Saxena confirms that it is indeed a case of flashbacks of their previous birth. Happu asks Teeka, Malkhan, and Tillu to threaten Lakkad Singh, the son of a minister, Kankar Singh.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan Meet Their Mother
episodesList.summary: Saxena hypnotises Manmohan and Vibhuti and takes them back to their previous birth. They realise they are 'Karan' and 'Arjun', residents of Pissu Nagar, who were killed by Thakur Durbal Singh. Their mother is waiting for them for the last 35 years. Lakkad Singh beats Tillu and Malkhan. He forcefully enters Gulfam Kaliâ€™s place and harasses her. Manmohan and Vibhuti are interviewed by a local news channel along with Saxena in connection with the story of their reincarnation.

episodesList.title: Phulwa Devi Gets Her Sons Back

Phulwa Devi, however, has no recollection of her past. To get her memory back, Manmohan and Vibhuti marry Zorawar and Bakhtawar. Phulwa Devi gets her memory back. Chaddha informs Vibhuti and Manmohan that he will get the property papers ready in their name. Happu requests Lakkad Singh not to harass Gulfam Kali.

episodesList.title: Chaddha Exposes Manmohan and Vibhuti's Marriage

Vibhuti and Manmohan promise to give Tillu's salary, in addition to a job for him and Teeka and Malkhan after inheriting the Phulwa Devi's property. Chaddha shows a video of Manmohan and Vibhuti's marriage which reveals that the marriage was faked to get Phulwa Deviâ€™s over-aged daughters married to them. He asks Manmohan and Vibhuti to return to Pissu Nagar to stay with their newly-wedded wives. Anita and Angoori are worried about Vibhuti and Manmohan.

episodesList.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti's Plan to Earn Respect
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and Manmohan engage in an argument as to who gets respected by society. Manmohan decides to teach Vibhuti a lesson. Tillu, Malkhan and Tika harass Gulfam Kali. Vibhuti arrives and slaps the trio. Manmohan makes a plan with Gulfam Kali. Gulfam Kali arrives at Vibhutiâ€™s home and starts flirting with him. Vibhuti mistakes Gulfam Kali for Anita. Anita gets angry on seeing Gulfam and Vibhuti flirting. Vibhuti realises the truth and comes up with a plan of his own.

episodesList.title: Back Ache!!

But Minal wants Anita and Vibhuti to participate in a dance competition. She asks Anita to send her a video of them dancing where their chemistry is evident. Following that, Angoori helps relieve her uncle of his back pain. Later, Vibhuti hurts his back when Anita asks him to practice the dance with her. So Vibhuti visits Angoori to cure him of his back pain.

episodesList.title: Accidents Happen!

However, Vibhuti injures his back for the second time when he tries to lift Anita. So he goes to Angoori and begs her to kick him on his back but Manmohan tells Vibhuti to say mean things to Anita first. Meanwhile, Anita tells her friends that she will perform a dance when Vibhuti returns home. Just then, Vibhuti comes home and insults Anita.

episodesList.title: Thrown Out!

When Manmohan calls the doctor, the latter blames Vibhuti for Angoori's injury. On the other hand, Anita apologises to Minal on Vibhuti's behalf but Minal calls them the worst couple. Following that, Anita decides to teach Vibhuti a lesson. Later at night, he tries to apologise to her but she kicks him out of the house. He goes to Saxena's house to spend the night.

episodesList.title: Captured!
episodesList.summary: Anita tells Manmohan that she kicked Vibhuti out of the house. On hearing this, Manmohan tells Anita that Vibhuti does not deserve a woman like her in his life. On the other hand, Mr Saxena ties Vibhuti's hands so he is unable to answer Anita's calls. Just then, Angoori tells Anita the reason behind her leg injury. Following that, Anita tries to call Vibhuti but he is unable to answer so she gets worried. Later, Anita gets annoyed when Happu Singh asks her silly questions about Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Lost or Found?

Anita tells him that Vibhuti is missing and he states that a person like Vibhuti can either be found in a bar or a brothel. When they go to the brothel, Gulfam Kali tells Anita that Vibhuti didn't visit. Meanwhile, Vibhuti dresses up on Saxena insistence, who wants to take him around the world after eloping with him. Vibhuti makes some excuse and somehow lands in Angoori's house. Will Anita save him?

Later, Anita tries to share a romantic moment with Vibhuti, but he tells her that he's not in the mood. Similarly, Angoori and Tiwari dance together at home. Following that, Vibhuti and Tiwari manage to reach home but crash their bikes into each other near their homes. Happu replies that he got badly thrashed by Vibhuti who also threw him from the window. Meanwhile, Angoori gets upset when Tiwari tells her the same joke. She tells Tiwari that he is insulting women. Soon after, she calls Tiwariâ€™s mother and complains to her. Ammaji arrives and explains how and why she was a part of Vibhuti and Angoori’s romantic charade. Meanwhile, Resham Pal takes action against the Sanskar Sena.

episodesList.summary: Vibhuti delights in Angoori’s kite flying, which annoys Anita. Malkhan and Anokhelal decide to save Teeka. At night, Anita is upset with Vibhuti for flying kites, but Vibhuti manages to pacify her. Manju Bua visits Angoori and is interrupted by Manmohan again. Further, Manmohan gets a call from Manju Bua. In the graveyard, Michael demands food, which Teeka’s friends arrange for. However, Michael, who is not satisfied, refuses to let Teeka go and tells them to return the next day with more food.

episodesList.title: Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hain - Episode 921 - September 7, 2018 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hain is a Hindi comedy drama television series starring Aashif Sheikh, Rohitash Gaud, Saumya Tandon and Shubhangi Atre Poore. The story revolves around two neighbouring couples - Manmohan and Angoori, and Vibhuti and Anita, who live in Modern Colony. Both men are attracted to each other’s wives and leave no chance to impress them, which often lands them in funny situations.

episodesList.title: Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hain - Episode 922 - September 10, 2018 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti, Angoori, Anita and Manmohan find out that Prem was behind the letters from Manju Bua, while Michael turns out to be a living person. The next day, Anita tells Vibhuti that she is to go on a trip for a few days. Vibhuti, therefore, wishes to invite his mother over, which leads to an argument between them. Later, he overhears Angoori telling Ammaji that she wants to adopt an elderly person. Meanwhile, Manmohan and Happu both acquire products from a whimsical medicine seller.

episodesList.title: Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hain - Episode 923 - September 11, 2018 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti disguises himself as his own elderly father, Ahuti, and cons Angoori into taking him to her house. Angoori visits Vibhuti and reprimands him for ill-treating his father, but Vibhuti manages to pacify her. Anita returns home early. Later, Ahuti bullies Manmohan by making him cook so he can chat with Angoori. At night, Vibhuti gets a call from Anita, who demands to know where he is. Vibhuti lies through his teeth, but Anita soon catches on to his fibs.

episodesList.title: Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hain - Episode 924 - September 12, 2018 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: In a jail cell, Happu realises how much he has aged. Anita exposes Vibhuti’s lie about Prem, but he spins another tale that involves his father. Ahuti returns to a worried Angoori with alms to pay for her hospitality, which deeply upsets Angoori. Manmohan tells Anita about Vibhuti’s father, and she confronts Vibhuti. Ahuti cons Angoori into dancing with him, but Manmohan interrupts with unpleasant news. Meanwhile, Malkhan, Teeka and Anokhelal are worried to see an instantly aged Happu.

episodesList.title: Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hain - Episode 925 - September 13, 2018 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Anita, Angoori and Manmohan try to get Ahuti out of the bathroom, unaware that they are reasoning with a cell phone recording. Teeka, Malkhan and Anokhelal try to save for their old age by abstaining from spending on food and Gulfam’s happy hours. Ahuti pretends to be on his deathbed and gets Angoori to say she loves him. Manmohan meets David and tells him about Ahuti. Later, the elderly Happu shows up looking for shelter in Angoori’s house. Anokhelal faints, but a doctor passing by has a cure.

episodesList.title: Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hain - Episode 926 - September 14, 2018 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti’s act as Ahuti is exposed, while Happu finds a way to reverse his instant ageing. The next day, Vibhuti notices that Malkhan, Teeka and Tillu have become instantly rich. The secret of their instant wealth is Dimperial, a finance company. Vibhuti makes the wealthy trio take him to the Dimperial office and is highly impressed. Meanwhile, Manmohan visits Anita, who is distressed by the increasing cost of living. He urges her to reconsider her relationship with Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hain - Episode 927 - September 17, 2018 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Manmohan overhears Vibhuti telling Anita how Dimperial can double one’s money overnight. Later, Vibhuti runs into Manmohan at the Dimperial office. The next day, both of them visit Mr Dimple and are thrilled to get double their invested amount back. Thereafter, Vibhuti convinces Anita to sell everything in the house, while Manmohan pawns off his house to Kallu Pathan, an intimidating moneylender. Meanwhile, Teeka, Malkhan, Tillu and Happu encounter a musical beggar who refuses alms.

episodesList.title: Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hain - Episode 928 - September 18, 2018 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti, Anita, Manmohan and Angoori dream of their lives after the money comes flowing in. The next day, Vibhuti and Manmohan, along with Malkhan, Teeka, Tillu, Happu and Prem wait for Mr Dimple outside his office. Soon, everyone realises they have been scammed. While Vibhuti and Manmohan break the news to Anita and Angoori, the rest of Mr Dimple’s victims are weak and starving. Vibhuti and Manmohan visit Kallu to try and get Manmohan’s house back, but Kallu is as shrewd as he is peculiar.

episodesList.title: Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hain - Episode 929 - September 19, 2018 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Driven by hunger, Vibhuti and Manmohan fight tooth and nail for a roti from Kallu Pathan but lose it to Malkhan. Teeka, Malkhan, Tillu and Happu, also starving, decide to compete for the roti but lose it to a dog. Later, while Mr Dimple’s victims wonder where to get food from, they meet one more starving acquaintance. Kallu Pathan offers Vibhuti and Manmohan food. In exchange, he makes them join his harem, dresses them in burqas and renames them.

episodesList.title: Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hain - Episode 930 - September 20, 2018 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Angoori and Anita tell about a wedding where they can try their luck for some free food. At the wedding, Vibhuti, Manmohan and Happu lie to some guests about how they know the groom. They get caught eventually and are driven away empty-handed. Later, Happu joins Vibhuti, Manmohan, Angoori and Anita in enjoying delicious but imaginary food. Just as Anita is about to set off to rob an ATM, Resham informs them that Mr Dimple has been caught.

episodesList.title: Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hain - Episode 931 - September 21, 2018 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: A centuries-old mummy is in a museum of Kanpur on display. Hoping to strike instant fame, Anita wants Vibhuti to take a selfie with the mummy. Meanwhile, Saxena announces Sanskrit Week and offers a handsome reward to anyone who speaks pure Sanskrit for the next seven days. Elsewhere, Bhoorey is convinced the mummy carries the curse of his ancestors’ sins. However, Bodhi assures him the coffin will not be opened. Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu try teasing a girl in Sanskrit, but it backfires on them.

episodesList.title: Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hain - Episode 932 - September 24, 2018 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hain is a Hindi comedy drama television series starring Aashif Sheikh, Rohitash Gaud, Saumya Tandon and Shubhangi Atre Poore. The story revolves around two neighbouring couples - Manmohan and Angoori, and Vibhuti and Anita, who live in Modern Colony. Both men are attracted to each other’s wives and leave no chance to impress them, which often lands them in funny situations.

episodesList.title: Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hain - Episode 933 - September 25, 2018 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Anita excitedly uploads Vibhuti’s selfie with the mummy. Bhoorey watches a news segment wherein Bodhi speaks of being attacked by the mummy. Frightened, Bhoorey meets Vibhuti. While Teeka, Malkhan, Tillu and Happu receive a visit from the mummy, Bhoorey narrates to Angoori, Vibhuti, and Manmohan how the mummy once swore revenge against his ancestors. Thereafter, the mummy visits them, but they drive it away. Anita and the doctor mistake the mummy for a heavily bandaged Gupta.

episodesList.title: Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hain - Episode 934 - September 26, 2018 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: The mummy is on the loose, and it breaks into Angoori’s house. Thereafter, Bhoorey, Manmohan, Vibhuti and Angoori turn to Bodhi for help. He consults Migrant Mishra, who advises him to entice the mummy of King Jutankhamun with a look-alike of his queen, Lashkara. Later, Bhoorey explains to Manmohan and Angoori the plan to trap the mummy, while Vibhuti convinces Anita of the necessity of dressing up as Lashkara. Vibhuti reveals himself in his new avatar, and Angoori calls out to the mummy.

episodesList.title: Migrant Mishra Captures a Bandaged Figure
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti as Lashkara seduces the mummy, who takes him away. However, Vibhuti escapes, and the mummy runs amok again. Later, a bandaged figure visits Vibhuti. While Laskhara dances and keeps it distracted, Migrant Mishra captures it. Later, Saxena is impressed with two schoolboys speaking fluent Sanskrit. Everyone awaits Saxena’s decision regarding the reward, but he insults them, and they leave empty-handed. Migrant Mishra secures the mummy in its coffin, unaware that it is actually Gupta.

episodesList.title: Gulfam Tells Happu She is Pregnant With His Child
episodesList.summary: Happu extorts money from Vibhuti and Manmohan and spends it on Gulfam. Angoori, Vibhuti and Manmohan ask Gulfam’s help in getting the money back, and she agrees. Later, Gulfam tells Happu she is pregnant with his child and gets him to give her money by threatening him. At night, Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu are furious with Happu for impregnating Gulfam, and Teeka beats him up. While Happu learns the truth from Vibhuti and Manmohan, Gulfam assures Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu that she is not pregnant.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Sells Snacks On Prem’s Cycle
episodesList.summary: In a bid to stop Angoori from donating huge amounts of money, Manmohan lies to her about his business suffering. Meanwhile, Anita, whose business is truly on the decline, tells Vibhuti to get a job. A worried Angoori wants to help Manmohan, and she approaches Prem as a rickshaw driver. Thereafter, Vibhuti agrees to ride Prem’s cycle and sell snacks. Meanwhile, Malkhan tries to release the genie from a lamp but in vain. Teeka suggests duping someone else. Later, Malkhan and Teeka con Happu.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Meets Hrithik, a Rickshaw Driver
episodesList.summary: On his nightly round, Vibhuti, disguised as a snack seller, encounters Hrithik, who is, in fact, Angoori in disguise as a male rickshaw driver. Although Angoori does not recognise him, he realises who Hrithik really is. The next day, Vibhuti hands over his earnings to Anita, while Angoori leaves hers for Manmohan to find. Meanwhile, Happu calls upon the genie and wishes to become Commissioner. Later at night, a concerned, disguised Vibhuti meets Hrithik, while Happu visits Teeka and Malkhan.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Tells Vibhuti His Suspicions Regarding Angoori
episodesList.summary: After Manmohan reports Angoori’s disappearance to Happu, he catches her sneaking into the house. She fibs about her whereabouts, but Manmohan soon spots her lie. Later, a depressed Manmohan tells Vibhuti that he suspects Angoori is having an affair. For a hefty price, Vibhuti agrees to find out where Angoori disappears to at night. Meanwhile, Happu complains to his genie that none of his wishes have come true. However, the genie makes up excuses and continues making gastronomic demands.

episodesList.title: Angoori Reveals The Truth About Hrithik
episodesList.summary: After Bhoorey’s scooter is stolen, he rides in Hrithik’s rickshaw. Bhoorey reaches home and, upon finding Angoori missing, beats Manmohan. Unable to bear this, Angoori reveals the truth. Thereafter, Vibhuti realises Anita too was lying about her business. Meanwhile, Teeka and Malkhan suffer from diarrhoea, which they learn is Happu’s payback for duping them. While Bhoorey is reprimanding Prem, he gets his scooter back. At night, Manmohan feels guilty and apologises to Angoori for lying to her.

episodesList.title: Manmohan, Vibhuti, Teeka and Happu Get Depressed
episodesList.summary: Teeka is struck by depression when he reflects on his life and realises how devoid it is of accomplishments and marital stability. Manmohan sees a dull Teeka and, in trying to cheer him up, realises how dismal his own married life is. The depression is contagious, and Vibhuti is next in line to recognise how fruitless his life has been. While Vibhuti and Manmohan lament their existence, Happu has a go at trying to cheer up Teeka. Although he succeeds, he himself falls victim to depression.

episodesList.title: Bhoorey, Manmohan and Vibhuti's Mysterious Business
episodesList.summary: While Teeka starts a new business as a cobbler, Anita makes Vibhuti take her to dinner at Hotel Red Diamond. There, Vibhuti meets an old friend, Sanjana. While one the job, Teeka receives a huge business offer and is whisked by businessmen Nagar, Dagar and Sagar. Vibhuti lies about his employment and financial status to Sanjana. Impressed, she asks him to divorce Anita and marry her. A few days later, a mysterious bag changes hands between Bhoorey, Manmohan and Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Sanjana Blackmails Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti secretly meets Sanjana. She requests him to blackmail her miserly husband, Brij Bhushan, for INR 5 lakhs, which she claims she desperately needs. Meanwhile, Angoori dances for Manmohan, but he remains indifferent. Sanjana calls Vibhuti and blackmails him with the photos they had clicked together. Meanwhile, Happu is being hounded for money he borrowed while under the influence. The next day, Vibhuti decides to blackmail Manmohan. Elsewhere, Teeka shows up touting his wealth and new name.

episodesList.title: Angoori and Anita Try to Help Their Spouses
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti devises a plan to extract INR 5 lakhs from Manmohan by blackmailing him. Vibhuti phones Manmohan under a false name and calls him to a brothel to pay a cheque of INR 3 lakhs. Upon Manmohan's arrival, a woman starts dancing with him that enables Vibhuti to take pictures for blackmail. Later, Angoori and Anita are suspicious of their husbands' late night outings, and try to resolve the case of blackmail their husbands have gotten into. But, their endeavours land them in more trouble

episodesList.title: A Dying Sanjana Gives Clues to Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Angoori and Manmohan decide to get the money from Bhoorey Lal by creating a situation for blackmail. Manmohan threatens Bhoorey of revealing his obscene photos to his family if he doesn’t give INR five lakhs. Pillar’s numbers become the dropping point of the ransom. Elsewhere, Vibhuti gets hit and the bag is snatched from him. Just before dying, Sanjana gives Vibhuti some clues. After telling Anita of the murder, Vibhuti is on the run because he was seen at the murder spot.

episodesList.title: Resham and Happu Arrest Chinoy
episodesList.summary: With Prem’s help, Manmohan, Vibhuti and Angoori, disguised as dancers, get to Sanjana’s room in Chinatown Club. While they dance, Anita retrieves Sanjana’s diary. She later shares how Sanjana needed the money to save herself from Chinoy. Chinoy shows up wielding a gun, but Resham and Happu come to the rescue. The next day, Bhoorey’s money finds its way back to him through Happu, Vibhuti and Manmohan. Meanwhile, Teeka, having realised the rich life is not for him, returns to Malkhan and Tillu.

episodesList.title: Mr Foreigner Searches For Amateur Actors
episodesList.summary: Saxena introduces everyone to Mr Foreigner, his English friend and an award-winning film producer. Mr Foreigner is on the lookout for amateur actors for his next film, which is based on the story of Ravan and is to be shot in London. Everyone argues about whose role they will play, but Saxena settles the matter by picking chits and assigning everyone their roles. In order to get into character, Saxena requests everyone to go about their daily routine in their respective costumes.

episodesList.title: Manmohan, Angoori and Vibhuti Practise Their Roles
episodesList.summary: As instructed by Saxena, everybody tries to get into their respective character. Tiwari, dressed as Ravan, scolds Vibhuti in Vibhushan’s costume, when they get into recital mode over the beautiful Angoori, who is dressed as Mondadori. Mr Foreigner and Saxena are very impressed by what they observe. Optimistic about going to London, Angoori and Tiwari in costume start talking about everybody’s affairs and trying to be creative. On observing them, Mr Foreigner and Saxena are confident of success.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Assures to Settle Manmohan's Claim
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti suffers from gastroenteritis. Despite the unbearable pain, the prospect of a trip to London entices him to continue playing his role. A life insurance officer visits Tiwari for the claim he made for his burnt-down shop. On investigation, the officer offers Tiwari a far smaller amount than expected. Vibhuti assures Tiwari he will get the claim fulfilled, and they make a deal on the commission. During their round-up, Mr Foreigner and Saxena are impressed with their actors.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Tiwari Catch Suresh Rawal
episodesList.summary: On seeing Mr Foreigner and Saxena, all the role playing characters go into acting mode in the police station. Vibhuti and Tiwari are put in prison for a fraud insurance claim. They bribe Happu Singh who lets them escape. Vibhuti and Tiwari spot Suresh Rawal discussing a deal with a suspicious man on how Tiwari’s shop was set ablaze. They film it and nab Suresh and hand him over to Happu Singh. The next day, they attend the grand rehearsal where they act, sing and dance.

episodesList.title: Vibhtuti Promises to Take Angoori to The Fair
episodesList.summary: Saxena's revelation about Mr Foreigner makes everyone shower them with abuses. Manmohan refuses to take Angoori to the village fair. A broke Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu ask Happu to lend them money but receive a slap in return. Vibhuti plans to take Angoori to the fair by fibbing to her. Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu are elated to have Happu sponsoring them. Vibhuti and Manmohan arrive, and they all eat the sweets snatched from Saxena. Realising it is mixed with laxatives, everyone runs to the loo

episodesList.title: Anita Suspects That Vibhuti had Affairs In The Past
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and Anita praise each other’s young looks and Anita suspects that Vibhuti may have had affairs. Manmohan is worried about having to pay INR five lakhs as income tax. He refuses to pay Tillu his wages. When Anita sings a song, Vibhuti starts to tremble and sweat. Tillu, Malkhan and Teeka are jealous on learning that Happu is posted on duty outside a girls’ hostel. Ammaji gets an amulet for Manmohan to get his marriage back on track and to protect him from evil spirits, but he discards it.

episodesList.title: Haunted Room In The Girls' Hostel
episodesList.summary: Dressed as women, Teeka, Tillu and Malkan are stopped at the girl’s hostel by Happu. The girls at the hostel tell the trio that room 13 is haunted. Later, the men hear singing from the locked room and run for their lives. Anita’s college friends decide to hold a reunion party. Manmohan is told to collect INR 8 lakh cash from the girl’s hostel from a prospective client. Vibhuti brings biscuits for Angoori and asks her to sing. She obliges, but her song makes Vibhuti tremble and sweat

episodesList.title: The Ghost On Manmohan's Back
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and Anita get nostalgic during the reunion at their house. Vinod keeps eyeing Anita and reveals that he was the one who had put colour on her during the Holi festival and got beaten up, and not Vibhuti. In the meanwhile, Tiwari enters the haunted room number 13 at the girl’s hostel and returns home with the invisible ghost on his back who is only reflected in the mirror. On hearing a familiar song, Vibhuti goes out in the balcony to see a weird looking Tiwari singing it.

episodesList.title: The Ghost Goes Back-hopping
episodesList.summary: Teeka reveals how he had disguised as a client to send Tiwari to the haunted room number 13. Later, the ghost latches on to Malkhan’s back and he starts to sing the same song, surprising Happu and scaring Tillu and Teeka. Vibhuti’s uncle starts to sing the same song before he lands up at Vibhuti’s house with the ghost. After circling and singing around Vibhuti, his uncle starts kissing him. Subsequently, the ghost attaches herself to Vibhuti. Meanwhile, Saxena learns the art of exorcism.

episodesList.title: Vibha's Ghost Reveals Her Murderer's Name
episodesList.summary: The ghost latched on Vibhuti makes him do abnormal things. In the meanwhile, Saxena is trying to attract the ghosts with the help of a ritual. Tiwari and Angoori complain to Anita and Vibhuti while the ghost gets dragged away and lands up at Saxena’s ritual ceromony. Tiwari, Angoori and Anita, on seeing the ghost reflected in the mirror, get frightened. The ghost reveals that she is Vibha and was loved and murdered by Vibhuti, and the proof is in room number 13 of the girl’s hostel.

episodesList.title: Anita Catches Vibha's Real Murderer
episodesList.summary: Vibha's ghost tells everyone she has a video recording of the murder in room number 13. At the police station, everyone watches the video intently and sees Vibhuti murder Vibha. But, Vibhu consistently says the person is not him. Anita, aware of Vibhu’s mannerisms, notices a twitch in the person's shoulder and gets suspicious. Their friends drop by, and Anita sees Vinod with the same mannerism and accuses him. The impersonator removes his mask in the footage ahead and the murderer is revealed.

episodesList.title: Dr Gupta Brings Some Marriage Proposals
episodesList.summary: In the morning, Vibhuti visits Tiwari who, along with Happu Singh, makes fun of Vibhuti for being jobless. Prem offers Vibhuti a partnership at his new hair-cutting salon. Angoori convinces Tiwari to get a hairstyle resembling Amitabh Bachchan. The doctor brings marriage proposals for Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan and tells them they will have to become 'Ghar Jamais' in order to inherit a lot of wealth. In return, the doctor asks them for a bungalow as a gift.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gives Manmohan's Hair a Makeover
episodesList.summary: Angoori reminds Tiwari to go to a good salon for a haircut. Teeka and friends, too, want to go for facials. Vibhuti promotes his modernised salon. An impressed Tiwari lands up at the salon and consumes a spiked welcome drink which puts him to sleep. Later, Tiwari wakes up to curly blue hair and freaks out Vibhuti justifies his work by saying the style belongs to Amit Pachori as Tiwari had not specified which Amitji he wanted to emulate. Vibhuti then presents Tiwari with a bill of INR 8,500

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Gives Unique Salon Treatment
episodesList.summary: A blue-haired Tiwari plans revenge after receiving a beating from Ammaji. Happu comes to Vibhuti’s salon and consumes the spiked welcome drink. On waking up, Happu is shocked to find himself with a toothbrush moustache, half eyebrows, and a bill of INR 2,500 Doctor tells Teeka and gang to get their facials done as the fathers of the brides will visit them the next day. To their horror, Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu wake up to faces that are golden, green and red after Vibhuti’s treatment

episodesList.title: Manmohan's Revenge On Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Tiwari initiates his plan to take revenge on Vibhuti. Angoori sings with her face half covered. Vibhuti enquires her about it, and Tiwari replies that the cream he had given her spoilt her face. A devastated Vibhuti loses all interest in his new salon. Tiwari tells Vibhuti that Angoori wants him to leave the city. Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan, with their coloured faces, are visited by a stranger who calls them losers. The doctor tells the trio that he is the father of the brides.

episodesList.title: Puttan Comes to Live With Angoori
episodesList.summary: Angoori’s Daddoo tells Putan that her brother will come and stay with her and Tiwari once he is released from jail. Anita decides to become a writer. Putan arrives with a bang as he crashes his scooter into Happu. Fed up with Putan’s previous antics, Tiwari dreads his stay in their house. Vibhuti also knows Putan will only create trouble for all of them. Meanwhile, Putan decides to turn over a new leaf. Happu tells Vibhuti that Gullu is planning marriage and she wants to dump him.

episodesList.title: Angoori Looks For Prospective Brides For Puttan
episodesList.summary: Putan tells Angoori to get him INR 25 lakhs from Dadoo to do business. Knowing Putan’s criminal ways, she refuses. Putan plans to get rich by marrying a rich girl. Vibhuti’s attempts at wooing Anita fail as she begins writing for her novel and doesn't wish to be disturbed. Happu is unable to eat the food cooked by Gullu as it is too spicy. Angoori calls for prospective brides for Putan. Tiwari and Vibhuti are irked to see an insolent Putan getting pampered by Angoori. Teeka proposes to Gullu.

episodesList.title: Gullu and Puttan Fall In Love
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and Tiwari, both unhappy with Puttan’s criminal ways, want him out of their lives. Puttan tells Tiwari and Vibhuti to get him married. They devise a plan and approach Gullu who they know is looking to get married. Vibhuti and Tiwari praise Puttan and tell her the proposal is from him and arrange a meeting between Gullu and Puttan. For the two, it's love at first sight. Puttan comes home and announces to Angoori and Bhoorey that he is in love. Tiwari upsets Anita with his filmy dialogues.

episodesList.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti's Disguise As Gullu’s Parents
episodesList.summary: Bhoorey and Angoori are shocked to learn that Puttan is in love with Gullu. Bhoorey wants to hit Puttan, but Tiwari and Vibhuti intervene and save him. Tiwari and Vibhuti tell Gullu that she should get her parents to meet Puttan’s family, but Gullu tells them that her parents are not available. Desperate to get Puttan out of their lives, Tiwari and Vibhuti decide to disguise as Gullu’s parents and meet Bhoorey and Angoori to talk about the marriage arrangements.

episodesList.title: Gullu and Puttan's Engagement Ceremony
episodesList.summary: Bhoorey is shocked to learn the story behind Gullu having two biological fathers. However, Saxena arrives and exposes them Bhoorey backs out, but on Puttan's warning, immediately agrees for the engagement. As Vibhuti and Tiwari celebrate their success, Happu, Prem, Teeka, Malkhan, and Tillu arrive and vent their frustration on them. Later, the heartbroken gang attend Gullu's engagement ceremony. Seeing Gullu and Puttan putting a ring on each other's fingers drowns her secret admirers in misery

episodesList.title: Puttan Breaks His Engagement
episodesList.summary: A worried Tiwari and Vibhuti want to put a stop to Puttan and Gullu’s marriage due to Puttan's plan of staying in the Tiwari house even after his marriage. The devise a plan to lure Gullu back to dancing. Later, on seeing Gullu dancing in front of wealthy clients, Puttan breaks his engagement. Elsewhere, Anu realises she has written the worst book ever and puts an end to her writing career. She appreciates Vibhuti’s encouragement and calls him the best husband.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gets Selected For The Moon Mission
episodesList.summary: Anita tells Vibhuti to get a real job so that she too can be proud of him. A TV show announces that they will send a common man along with the astronauts to the moon and that the common man may also win INR 10 lakhs. Anita makes Vibhuti apply for the same. Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu too apply for the same. Scientist NL Gupta interviews the candidates and selects Vibhuti as the winner. Vibhuti shares the good news with Angoori, who requests him to get some sweetmeats from the moon

episodesList.title: Angoori Packs Snacks For Vibhuti's Moon Mission
episodesList.summary: Tiwari congratulates Anita with sweetmeats for Vibhuti’s attempt to win INR ten lakhs and go to the moon. Tiwari criticizes Vibhuti, but gets surprised at Vibhuti’s selection. Tiwari requests Vibhuti to promote his business of undergarments on the moon, and promises to pay him INR 10,000 per month. As per her logic, Angoori packs long lasting snacks for Vibhuti, in case he feels hungry on the moon. Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu fall into a trap of an old man’s tale.

episodesList.title: Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu Plan to Rob Hidden Treasure
episodesList.summary: Anita is happy with Vibhuti for getting the chance of winning the prize money to go to the moon. Anita states her wish to romance Vibhuti in an astronaut's costume. Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu plan to rob the hidden treasure from the police station by beating Happu and going to prison. The next day, Vibhuti is given a farewell by the neighbours. Happu, as told by an astrologer, repents for his sins by forgiving and forgetting, thus dashing Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu’s plans of finding the treasure.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Lands On The Moon
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Angoori watch telecast of the rocket that is taking Vibhuti to the moon. From within the rocket, Vibhuti says in his interview that India looks the best from outer space. On landing on the moon, all the other scientists are allotted jobs except for Vibhuti who is asked to clean, vacuum and cook. Vibhuti makes romantic calls to Anita and Angoori. To get into jail for the hidden treasure, Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan decide to insult Commissioner Resham Pal Singh.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gets Stuck On The Moon
episodesList.summary: Tiwari gets jealous every time Vibhuti calls Angoori from the moon. Tiwari wants to know why Vibhuti is not promoting his 'Chameli Chhap' innerwear from the moon. The rocket takes off for earth, leaving Vibhuti behind who is busy hoisting the innerwear. Anita, Angoori and Tiwari are shocked when they hear Vibhuti was left behind on the moon. Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan go to jail and find the casket but are unable to open it. Vibhuti starts to hallucinate on the moon and begs Anita to save him.

episodesList.title: A Scientist From Bangladesh Rescues Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Angoori discuss Vibhuti being stuck on the moon, Just then, an innerwear falls on Tiwari. Looking at the innerwear, Tiwari is assured that it has fallen from the moon, but Saxena tells him that the innerwear is his A feeble Vibhuti is visited by a professor who lands on the moon from Bangladesh and rescues Vibhuti. Vibhuti gets another offer from scientist Sawant who says he will pay INR 25 lakhs to Vibhuti if he goes to Mars. Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan search for the 'Rasvarti' herb.

episodesList.title: Puttan Plans to Extract Money From Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Angoori brings 'kheer' for Vibhuti, who boasts to her of being a macho man, but, on seeing a rat, he gets petrified. Angoori leaves Vibhuti feeling insulted. Saxena gives Malkhan reenergising herbs, which he shares with Teeka. Saxena tells them the herb does the opposite. Puttan wants to extract INR 20,000 from Tiwari and includes Tillu in his plan of playing tiger. Puttan growls and Tillu says it’s the tiger who scratched him in Tiwari’s shop. A fearful Tiwari runs away.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Plan to Impress Angoori Backfires
episodesList.summary: To prove his bravery, Vibhuti plans to get Angoori in trouble and then rescue her to become a hero in her eyes. However, the plan backfires when Prem sees Gullu and beats Vibhu. Tillu tells Tiwari that the tiger’s visit to the shop has severely hit the business. Puttan suggests he will catch the tiger, provided he is given INR 20,000 for it. Later, Tiwari tells Angoori of Puttan’s cheating and they decide to visit the jungle at night. Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan finally find the ‘Rasverti’ herb.

episodesList.title: Saxena Befriends The Tiger In The Forest
episodesList.summary: In the jungle, Happu threatens to put Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan behind bars for stealing from the jungle. Just then, they hear growls and hide in the machan. Vibhuti sees Saxena, who is dressed as a tiger, being photographed by Puttan. They too, hear the growls and hide in the machan. Tiwari and Angoori reach the deep forest and hear the growls. On seeing the real tiger, they too hide in the same machan. Saxena decides to lure the tiger away but soon comes back with the tiger as his friend.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Conducts His Grandmother's Prayer Ceremony
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti overhears Manmohan sharing anecdotes about his grandmother to Angoori, Pandit and Anita. Hearing Anita's story about her uncle, Vibhuti comes up with an idea to trouble Manmohan. Later, Manmohan receives an earful from Ramkali after informing her about celebrating his grandmother's birthday. Gulfam Kali hits Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu by her car, thereby landing Happu in trouble and the trio in the hospital During his grandmother's prayer ceremony, Manmohan shares a story from her life.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Dons Tiwari's Grandmother's Garb
episodesList.summary: After seeking Tiwari's grandmother's blessings, Vibhuti falls unconscious. Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu enjoy their stay at the hospital. Vibhuti bribes Dr. Gupta and Pandit into supporting him. Later, Vibhuti arrives in Tiwari's grandmother's garb and gives an elaborate performance. Tiwari and Angoori fall prey to Vibhuti's plan. An excited Tiwari apprises Anita about the situation. At the hospital, Dr. Gupta hands several bills to Happu while Gulfan decides to stay the night for the injured trio.

episodesList.title: Helen Buys Clothes For Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Saxena takes Tiwari's grandmother, Helen, out for shopping and later hands Tiwari a bill of INR 20,000 Helen buying clothes for Vibhuti irks Tiwari, but Helen silences him. Tiwari takes Helen to meet Anita. Helen discloses unpleasant stories of Tiwari's childhood to Anita and hands her the gift. Later, Helen lovingly eats from Angoori's hands. At the hospital, Happu catches Tillu, Malkhan, Teeka and Dr. Gupta dancing with Gulfam, but Dr. Gupta covers up for them and hands another bill to Happu

episodesList.title: Bhoorey and Ramkali Meet Helen
episodesList.summary: Under Helen Tiwari's garb, Vibhuti dreams of romancing Angoori. The next day, Anita has a good time watching Helen mistreating Tiwari and sharing interesting stories from her personal life with Angoori. Bhoorey visits Angoori, who introduces him to Helen. Ramkali arrives and greets Helen, who poses an extremely awkward question to her, making Ramkali flee on the spot. Happu overhears Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu's discussion about fooling him, and later, makes them pay a heavy price for it

episodesList.title: Manmohan Brings His Grandfather to Meet Helen
episodesList.summary: Anita overhears Prem and Vibhuti's conversation and tells it to Tiwari, who gets emotional. Anita and Tiwari come up with a plan to make Vibhuti spill the beans. As Tiwari's grandmother narrates stories to Angoori, Tiwari brings his grandfather home, shocking Vibhuti After Tiwari's grandfather tries to get intimate with him, Vibhuti runs downstairs and reveals the truth to everyone. Later, Vibhuti comes home to another surprise. Happu too tells the truth to Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu.

episodesList.title: Puttan's Gujarati Girlfriend
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti asks Angoori the reason for feeling sad. She tells him she wants Puttan married at the earliest. When Vibhuti criticises Puttan, she reprimands him, making Tiwari happy. Meanwhile, Puttan is romancing Hetal in the park. She tells him her mother wants her to marry only a Gujarati. On hearing Puttan will stay with his in-laws in Surat, Tiwari and Angoori agree to act like Gujaratis to get Puttan married off. Prem wants to start a dairy farm and offers Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan a job.
