episodesList.summary: Jhumru convinces Vibhuti to become a street performer again. Anita, Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan decide to join Vibhuti as dance performers and Saxena is hired as Vibhuti's manager. Anita gets upset with Vibhuti and Tiwari worries about Mittal.

episodesList.title: Master Ji Breaks Vibhuti's Leg
episodesList.summary: Master Ji breaks Vibhuti's leg and reveals to everyone that Tiwari paid him to do it. Anita and Angoori curse Tiwari for it. After three months, Vibhuti gets normal with people's motivation and then presents his last street performance.

episodesList.title: A Mysterious Anita
episodesList.summary: Anita sees a nightmare. DK visits Tiwari and leaves his car with him for two days. Late at night, Tiwari offers a lift to Anita, who had been waiting at a bus stop. Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan rush to the police station to prove their innocence.

episodesList.title: Anita Visits a Graveyard
episodesList.summary: Tiwari is startled to hear Anita's request of going to the graveyard. Later, she denies the claims made by Tiwari before Vibhuti and Angoori. Tiwari visits a tantric, who recommends him to keep Anita and Vibhuti away from each other for two days.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Visit a Graveyard
episodesList.summary: The 'tantric' asks Vibhuti to spend some quality time with Anita in the coming two days. Ammaji gives a book of 'mantras' to Angoori. Scared of a changed Anita, Vibhuti rushes to Angoori and Tiwari for help. Tiwari and Vibhuti leave for a graveyard.

episodesList.title: Roxy Reveals Her Identity
episodesList.summary: Angoori uses a book to call upon the ghost in Anita's body, who claims herself to be Roxy. Vibhuti requests Roxy to let him romance Anita as it will help him change his fortune. DK visits Tiwari to take his car back and Anita invites him for a party.

episodesList.title: Roxy's Horrifying Party
episodesList.summary: DK and Tiwari's family enjoy the dinner at Vibhuti's house. Meanwhile, Roxy shows up again leaving everybody scared. Happu concludes that Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan are responsible for the thefts. Angoori and Anita reveal tantric's truth to Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: A Chimpanzee Attacks Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Angoori, Anita, Tiwari and Vibhuti discuss about the increasing terror of the monkeys in the city. Prem offers Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan a job in the forest department. Vibhuti takes Angoori to a zoo wherein he gets bitten by a chimpanzee.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Starts Behaving Like a Monkey
episodesList.summary: Anita finds Vibhuti behaving like a monkey. Later, Vibhuti takes Tiwari's clothes away. Ammaji recommends Angoori to feed some monkeys. Vibhuti explains the changes in his body to Angoori. Master ji gets stuck in yet another problem.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Attacks Happu and Tiwari
episodesList.summary: The increase in Vibhuti's monkey-like behaviour forces him to bite Tiwari. A determined Anita decides to make Vibhuti normal. Tiwari requests Happu to help him make Vibhuti normal but Happu falls prey to Vibhuti's attacks.

episodesList.title: The Trio Captures Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan capture Vibhuti for Tiwari but Saxena sets him free. On seeing him out again, Tiwari demands that the trio return his money. Meanwhile, David tells Anita about his decision to give his wealth to Vibhuti over a phone call.

episodesList.title: David Learns Vibhuti's Truth
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti tries hard to control himself when he meets David. However, Tiwari tells David about Vibhuti's medical condition. On seeing Vibhuti behave like a monkey, David tears the property papers. Later, Dr. Gupta provides a cure to Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Budget Separates Vibhuti and Anita
episodesList.summary: Anita gets angry at Vibhuti for not paying the vegetable seller on time. They get into an argument and then decide to stay distant. Tiwari scolds Angoori for being a spendthrift. Saxena informs Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan about the government's new scheme.

episodesList.title: Anita Struggles Without Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Ammaji gives a tip on how to manage household expenses in INR 5000. Anita struggles with the daily chores of the kitchen. Vibhuti permits Teeka and Malkhan to stay with him in his lawn. Master Ji accuses Happu of stealing food from his house.

episodesList.title: Happu Gets Accused Of Stealing Food
episodesList.summary: Tiwari gets in trouble due to the budget decided by him. Master Ji accuses Happu of stealing a kettle from his house. He later meets Makhmal and complaints against Happu. Anita asks Tiwari to help her with kitchen work.

episodesList.title: Anita Organises a Party
episodesList.summary: Anita tells Tiwari to complete the chores of her house. Vibhuti visits Angoori and brings some food for her. Later, Anita organises a party keeping her budget in mind. Everyone from Modern Colony arrives at the party except for Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Enters The House Again
episodesList.summary: Tiwari sings a song in Anita's party. Angoori gives Vibhuti some food stolen from the party. At the police station, Teeka and Malkhan reveal that they were stealing the food. Anita pretends of getting hurt and Vibhuti comes back inside the house.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti to Land In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti expresses his feelings for Angoori to Prem. Tiwari also reveals his feelings for Anita and someone video shoots it. Vibhuti receives a video on phone wherein he is expressing his love. Saxena talks about making a documentary on Happu.

episodesList.title: The Blackmailer Calls Tiwari and Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti gets a call from the blackmailer who sent him his video. Tiwari feels shocked on receiving his video. Angoori and Anita are advised to control their anger. The blackmailer tells Angoori and Anita to leave their husbands over a phone call.

episodesList.title: The Blackmailer's Tricky Plan
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti fails at his attempt to tease Angoori. The blackmailer tells Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan to humiliate Happu. Meanwhile, even Tiwari tries to tease Anita. Later, the blackmailer forces Vibhuti and Tiwari to annoy Angoori and Anita.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Tiwari Reveal Their Predicament
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Vibhuti discuss about their blackmailers. The again try to tease Anita and Angoori. The next morning, when Anita and Angoori get angry Tiwari and Vibhuti reveal the truth. Happu promises to trace the location of their blackmailer.

episodesList.title: The Blackmailer Gets Caught
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Vibhuti locate the blackmailer and discover that it is David. Later, Tiwari brings coffee for Anita and Vibhuti brings tea for Angoori. Tillu and Malkhan doubt that Saxena has abducted Teeka, which angers them enough to assault him.

episodesList.title: The Director Antenio From Italy
episodesList.summary: Angoori tells Tiwari about her interest in the profession of acting. Prem tells Vibhuti about his Italian director friend Antenio over a phone call. Anita calls Tiwari and Angoori home to meet Antenio. Later, everybody goes to meet Antenio.

episodesList.title: Modern Colony Residents Earn Their Roles
episodesList.summary: Antenio explains their roles to everyone. Later, people bag their roles after clearing the auditions. Vibhuti and Tiwari get upset with Malkhan and Teeka for getting important roles, while Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan celebrate their achievement.

episodesList.title: The Film's Shooting Begins
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and Tiwari bribe Bagawat Mirza to edit some scenes in the movie. Later, shooting of the film begins and Vibhuti acts for a role with Angoori. During the shooting, Teeka gets upset at the last-minute changes done in the scene.

episodesList.title: Happu Gets Upset Due to a Movie Scene
episodesList.summary: Angoori talks to Tiwari about the sudden changes in the movie's plot. Happu expresses his disappointment about his role in the movie to Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan. Later, Vibhuti, Malkhan and Anita win praises for their acting from Antenio.

episodesList.title: The Film's Shooting Stops
episodesList.summary: Anita and Angoori complain about another unnecessary change in the script. Antenio's father gets arrested and the film's shooting stops at once. Later, Teeka and Malkhan reveal that Tiwari and Vibhuti had made the changes in the scenes.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Raids Tiwari's House
episodesList.summary: Tiwari discusses his bank balance with Anita and Vibhuti. A person known as Satyaprakash appoints Vibhuti, Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan as income tax officers. Later, Vibhuti takes a team of officers to Tiwari's home for an income tax raid.

episodesList.title: Tiwari is Upset Due to The Raid
episodesList.summary: Tiwari tells Angoori to ask Vibhuti for his help. Anita gets worried about Vibhuti becoming an income tax officer. Vibhuti explains Anita the benefits of income tax raid and then raids his own house. Later, Tiwari arrives at Anita's house.

episodesList.title: Ammaji Thrashes Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Anita tells Tiwari that Vibhuti has raided his own house. Ammaji thrashes Teeka, Tillu, Malkhan and Vibhuti so as to keep them away from the money she got by selling off some land. Later, Vibhuti insults David on his arrival.

episodesList.title: Happu Assaults Vibhuti and His Team
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti seizes all the black money in David's possession. CID officer Nathu apprises Happu of Satyaprakash being a thug. Happu assaults Vibhuti and his team to get Satyaprakash's whereabouts. Satyaprakash returns Tiwari's money after getting arrested.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti's Plans Fail Miserably
episodesList.summary: Anita and Angoori convince Vibhuti and Tiwari to watch the film. Tiwari and Vibhuti buy tickets to watch the movie with each other's wives. Later, both of them refuse the movie's offer and then Vibhuti and Tiwari watch the movie alone.

episodesList.title: Tillu In Love With a Royal Girl
episodesList.summary: Tiwari refuses to pay INR 50,000 to Tillu. Later, Tillu requests Tiwari and Vibhuti to pose as his family and help him marry Marjina, the daughter of 'Nawabs'. Tiwari convinces Angoori and Anita convinces Vibhuti to pretend as Tillu's family.

episodesList.title: Marjina's Father Zaleeluddin's Stubbornness
episodesList.summary: Saxena gives Urdu lessons to all. Tiwari and Vibhuti welcome Marjina's father Zaleeluddin, while maintaining the pretence of being 'Nawabs'. Later, they keep arguing about who'll first enter the house. Anita uses her wit to end it.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti's Attempt At 'shayari'
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Vibhuti recite 'shayari' before Zaleeluddin. Saxena shows up as Tillu's mother. Later, Tiwari and Vibhuti keep praising each other's wives. Tiwari stops Angoori from presenting a 'shayari' to entertain Zaleeluddin.

episodesList.title: Tillu and Marjina's Wedding
episodesList.summary: Zaleeluddin finalises Tillu and Marjina's wedding date. Later, the Modern Colony residents give dance performances at their wedding. At night, Teeka and Malkhan feel shocked to see a devastated Tillu and they rush him to Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Marjina Assaults Tillu
episodesList.summary: Tillu reveals to everyone how Marjina assaulted him. As suggested by Happu, Tillu goes back to Marjina and gets thrashed again in an attempt to collect some evidence. Later, Anita suggests an idea that helps Tillu divorce Marjina.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Cheats Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Tiwari insults Vibhuti in Anita's presence. Tiwari later refuses to take Angoori shopping. Prem tells Teeka and his friends to decorate Modern Colony for his sister-in-law. Vibhuti extracts some money from Tiwari for buying a gift for Anita.

episodesList.title: Dhanteras' Celebration At Vibhuti's House
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti lies to Anita about the money given to her. Ammaji learns about Tiwari refusing Angoori to go shopping and scolds him for it. Later, on the occasion of 'Dhanteras', the Modern Colony residents plan to play cards at Vibhuti's house.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Steals From Tiwari's House
episodesList.summary: Tiwari tells Anita about how he was defrauded. Tiwari curses Vibhuti for cheating him of his money. Later, he uses a disguise to extract money from Vibhuti. On learning Tiwari's truth, Vibhuti steals from his house.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Lose For Love
episodesList.summary: Tiwari tries to extract his money from Vibhuti but gets outsmarted. Saxena introduces Teeka to Shalu and suggests him to take her for shopping. Modern Colony residents later play a game wherein Tiwari and Vibhuti lose because of each other's wives.

episodesList.title: Angoori and Anita's Fiery Argument
episodesList.summary: Tiwari reveals to Anita about Vibhuti cheating him. She questions Tiwari's judgements and supports Vibhuti, which gives rise to an argument between Anita and Angoori. After Diwali celebrations, Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan curse Prem for not being paid.

episodesList.title: Prem's Death Leaves Vibhuti Shocked
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and Prem insult each other, but Anita intervenes and gets upset about it. The next morning, Happu reveals that Prem is no more and Vibhuti goes into a shock. While everyone tries to console him, Angoori hides something from Tiwari.

episodesList.title: Condolence Meet At Vibhuti's House
episodesList.summary: Modern Colony residents join Vibhuti for Prem's condolence meet. Happu arrives there and reveals that he has failed in finding Prem's corpse. Teeka plans to fake a suicide with Dr. Gupta to test Tillu and Malkhan but they get to know about it.

episodesList.title: Prem's Death Depresses Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti finds Prem at Angoori's house, but she tells him that it just a hallucination. Saxena becomes a psychiatrist and suggests Vibhuti to commit suicide. Meanwhile, Teeka feels upset on seeing Tillu and Malkhan's indifference towards him.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Party In Prem's Remembrance
episodesList.summary: Tiwari tries to console a dejected Vibhuti by insulting him like Prem, instead it makes him angry. Anita organises a party on Vibhuti's insistence wherein he forces Modern Colony residents to give energetic dance performances on sad, slow pace songs.Tiwari tries to console a dejected Vibhuti by insulting him like Prem, instead it makes him angry. Anita organises a party on Vibhuti's insistence wherein he forces Modern Colony residents to give energetic dance performances on sad, slow pace songs.

episodesList.title: Cow Dung Crisis On 'chhat Puja'
episodesList.summary: Prem reveals to Vibhuti and Tiwari about the reason behind his pretence. The next day, Anita and Angoori request Tiwari and Vibhuti to arrange cow dung for 'Chhat Puja'. They later bribe Tillu for his 'Palak Ka Saag' and present it as cow dung.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Decides to Set Up a Factory
episodesList.summary: Agrawal places an order of innerwear worth INR 3 crores with Tiwari's shop. As per Anita's suggestion, Tiwari partners with her and Prem to start a new factory. Later, Modern Colony residents visit Tiwari for job interviews.

episodesList.title: Happu Demands Inr 5 Lakhs From Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Tiwari, Anita and Prem interview Vibhuti for a job opportunity. Tiwari punishes Vibhuti for reaching late to the workplace. Later, Happu demands a bribe of INR 5 lakhs from Tiwari by accusing him of illegally starting up a handloom.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Motivates The Employees
episodesList.summary: On Tiwari's request, Happu gets convinced for a bribe of INR 10,000. Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan fight among each other for an employee Rekha in the factory. Later, Tiwari's announcement of sharing his profit with all employees makes Vibhuti motivate them.

episodesList.title: Tiwari's Employees Go On a Strike
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti overhears Tiwari and Prem scheming against the employees and goes on a strike with them. Angoori doesn't bother to convince them otherwise and joins the strike. Later, Prem and Tiwari try to bribe Vibhuti to turn him against the employees.

episodesList.title: Rocky Thrashes Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Prem's recruit Rocky thrashes Vibhuti and tells him that Anita sent him for it. Vibhuti arrives home and whines about it. Anita asks Prem and Tiwari to apologise to Vibhuti. Later, Tiwari gets a shocking news from Mr. Agrawal.

episodesList.title: Kalavati Disturbs Tiwari and Vibhuti's Life
episodesList.summary: Anita and Angoori meet writer Kalavati Sharma at an event, who recommends them to keep an eye on their husbands. Later, Anita and Angoori question their husbands on women perfumes. Teeka and friends begin an extortion business by the name 'T Company'.

episodesList.title: Saxena's Strange Request
episodesList.summary: Saxena sprays a women's perfume on Tiwari and Vibhuti. Kalavati expresses that she doubts Tiwari and Vibhuti's intentions. As per Prem's recommendation, Tiwari and Vibhuti meet Baba Komalnath. Saxena requests Tillu and Malkhan to break his leg.

episodesList.title: Ammaji Thrashes Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Vibhuti get outnumbered by some thieves. To evade Anita's questions, Vibhuti tells her that he was with his friend Ghatotkachh Moinuddin D'mello. Anita and Angoori suspect that Vibhuti is lying. Ammaji thrashes Tiwari to extract the truth.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti's Successful Plan
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Vibhuti pay Teeka and his friends to abduct a man known as Gupta. They then introduce Gupta as Ghatotkachh Moinuddin D'mello to their wives. Later, Angoori meets real Ghatotkachh which leaves Tiwari and Vibhuti perplexed.

episodesList.title: Anita and Angoori's Doubt Vanishes Away
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Vibhuti bring Gupta home and reveal the truth to their wives. Happu visits Tiwari and informs him about confiscating the looted belongings. Anita and Angoori try to console their husbands. Happu orders a shut down of T Company.

episodesList.title: Baba Predicts Angoori's Death
episodesList.summary: Malang Baba forecasts Angoori's death due to a road accident by three boys. When Vibhuti finds Angoori with her new scooter he begins to fear for her life. Later, a skeptical Vibhuti stops Teeka and his friends from driving a vehicle.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Plea to Yamraj
episodesList.summary: By the time Vibhuti comes with money, Teeka and his friends leave with the vehicle. Vibhuti struggles to stop Angoori while she is riding the scooter and Tillu hits her with the vehicle. Later, Vibhuti tells Yamraj to stay away from Angoori.

episodesList.title: Yamraj Accepts Vibhuti's Plea
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti tampers with Angoori's scooter. Tillu hits him again with his vehicle. Anita and Tiwari jointly play a prank on Tiwari to win a competition. Later, Vibhuti pleads Yamraj to forgive Angoori, which he finally agrees to.

episodesList.title: Angoori's Death Infuriates Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Anita calls Tiwari home to scare him. Yamraj tells Vibhuti that he has no option but to take Angoori's life. Later, Tiwari tells Vibhuti that Angoori is no more. Vibhuti loses his temper and thrashes Teeka and his friends.

episodesList.title: Yamraj's True Identity Revealed
episodesList.summary: The news of Angoori being alive brings great joy to Vibhuti's life. Saxena tells Vibhuti that Yamraj is none other than his friend Kallan. Later, due to the strike of rickshaw drivers, Tiwari and Vibhuti try different ways to help Anita and Angoori.

episodesList.title: Anita Gets Rich Overnight
episodesList.summary: Faqira, a lawyer, tells Anita that she has inherited a ring worth INR 1.5 crores from her maternal uncle. The boss of Teeka and his friends ousts him from his house. Later, Modern Colony residents arrive at Anita's party to take a look at the ring.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Swallows 1.5 Crore Inr Ring
episodesList.summary: Tiwari's prank makes Vibhuti swallow the expensive ring. Anita and Vibhuti visit Dr. Gupta for help and he suggests operating him. Angoori recommends feeding him a decoction. Prem hires Teeka and his friends to abduct Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gets Abducted
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Angoori forcefully feed Vibhuti a concoction. When it does not help, Angoori makes a phone call to Ammaji. Teeka and his friends abduct Vibhuti wearing face masks. Tiwari apprises Anita of this incident and she loses her temper.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Returns Home
episodesList.summary: Teeka tries to extract the ring from Vibhuti's body. Happu brings Vibhuti back home. Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan learn that Prem had hired them to abduct Vibhuti. Anita, Tiwari and Angoori once again feed Vibhuti a concoction.

episodesList.title: Anita's Ring Comes Out As Fake
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti comes out of the toilet and informs that he has flushed out the ring. However, Tiwari manages to get it from the sewer. Later, a jeweller scrutinizes it and tells that it is artificial. Saxena pays Teeka and his friends to thank them.

episodesList.title: Who will Become Tiwari's Father?
episodesList.summary: Anita daydreams about currency notes raining on her. Tiwari tells Angoori that he is unsure about who is his real father. Ammaji tells Angoori and Tiwari that someone has to become Tiwari's father for 15 days for the happiness of the family.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Adopts Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Tiwari tells Anita that on legal terms, he wants to make Vibhuti his father. Anita, being tempted by the money, says yes. Saxena announces this to everyone in the colony. Later, Tiwari and Vibhuti trouble each other.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Completely Accepts Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti tries to overpower Tiwari. Anita asks Tiwari for the payment he had promised. When Prem makes fun of Tiwari's father, Vibhuti begins to take Tiwari as his son. Teeka and Tillu visit the police station with their girlfriends.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Tiwari Visit a Movie Theatre
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti takes Tiwari to a movie theatre. Later, they both share their love stories with each other. Anita brings Vibhuti back home out of anger. Meanwhile, Angoori curses Tiwari for spending so much time with Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti's Relationship Ends Forever
episodesList.summary: Ammaji thrashes Tiwari in Vibhuti's presence. Happu scolds Tiwari and Vibhuti, who are trying to run away from their houses. Anita achieves success in her plan to turn them both against each other. Saxena helps them end their father-son relationship.

episodesList.title: Tiwari's Uncle Lands Him In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Tiwari's maternal uncle Annu Awasthi calls him to ask for money. Anita learns about a 'Kachchha-Baniyan' gang prevailing in Kanpur. Annu visits Tiwari wearing only undergarments. He curses Tiwari for not dressing up like him.

episodesList.title: Teeka and His Friends Rob Annu
episodesList.summary: Annu explains the importance of undergarments to Vibhuti. As instructed by Vibhuti, Teeka and his friends rob Annu's jewellery. Anita's friend thrashes Vibhuti but she goes to lodge a complaint against Annu and Tiwari assuming that they did it.

episodesList.title: Annu and Tiwari's Arrest
episodesList.summary: Tiwari calls Happu to lodge a police complaint for the robbery but Annu scolds him for doing so. Anita's complaint makes Happu arrest Tiwari and Annu. The real culprit later gets caught, following which Annu leaves from Tiwari's house.

episodesList.title: Teeka's Birthday Celebration
episodesList.summary: Anita and Vibhuti blame each other for the poor management of household expenses. Tillu and Malkhan request Prem some money for organising Teeka's birthday party but he refuses to give it. Teeka loses heart on learning about this.

episodesList.title: Teeka Pleads Tiwari and Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Teeka requests Vibhuti and Tiwari to help him organise his birthday party but they refuse to help. Later, they all give him a surprise by organising a party for him. Tiwari and Vibhuti get angry at Angoori and Anita for spending money on the party.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Becomes Bangle Seller For Angoori
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti learns that Angoori loves bangles. Prem lends Teeka and his friends money for their business on a condition that they pay double the amount. Vibhuti gives them a business idea and becomes a bangle seller. Angoori later buys bangles from him.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Cheats Angoori
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti cheats Angoori, which makes Tiwari mad at her. He visits Anita to complain about it. Vibhuti explains his profit to Teeka and his friends. Vibhuti again cheats Angoori while selling the bangles. Prem demands from the trio his first installment.

episodesList.title: Teeka and His Friends Threaten Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Anita finds Vibhuti with Gulfam and scolds him for spending time with her. Tiwari approaches Happu to lodge a complaint against Vibhuti for cheating Angoori. Later, as instructed by Vibhuti, Teeka and his friends threaten Tiwari to buy bangles.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Compelled to Dance Wearing Bangles
episodesList.summary: Tiwari visits Vibhuti's store and buys bangles from him. Later, the threats by Teeka and his friends force Tiwari to dance and entertain them which leaves Angoori shocked. Prem takes back the capital that he had lent to Teeka and his friends.

episodesList.title: Happu Arrests Teeka and His Friends
episodesList.summary: On Anita's insistence, Happu comes up with a plan to shut Vibhuti's business. Teeka and his friends fall prey to the plan and soon get arrested. Anita proudly tells Vibhuti that she actively participated in the plan to shut his business.

episodesList.title: Anita Becomes The Mayor
episodesList.summary: Ammaji asks Tiwari to begin a new business. The civil servant team's chief Satyapal Shrivastava requests Anita to join as the Mayor and she happily agrees to it. Tiwari and Angoori visit Anita to congratulate her. Teeka and his friends become homeless.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Recommends Tiwari to Anita
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti gives Tiwari a proposal to build a bridge. Later, he discusses it with Anita and then explains Tiwari the benefits of his proposal. Tiwari begins Angoori Construction Company. Saxena becomes the Santa and gives presents to Teeka and friends.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Gets a Bridge-building Contract
episodesList.summary: Anita gives the bridge's contract to Tiwari, who assigns Prem to build it and hires Teeka and his friends as his labourers. Vibhuti wishes Anita on their wedding anniversary. Later, Anita and Angoori being busy makes Vibhuti feel lonely.

episodesList.title: Angoori Scolds Tiwari For His Carelessness
episodesList.summary: Anita's assistant doesn't let Vibhuti in her office. Prem along with Teeka and his friends jointly attempt to steal cement. Vibhuti fails at his plan to go for dinner with Anita. Angoori scolds Tiwari and advises him to focus on his work.

episodesList.title: Angoori Gets Arrested
episodesList.summary: Tiwari gets the news that the bridge made by him has collapsed. Happu arrests Angoori as she is the owner of the construction company. Fed up of the work, Anita quits her job. Later, Angoori gets released and exposes the culprit behind the accident.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's 'nalle Ka Halwa'
episodesList.summary: Everyone praises the sweet dish prepared by Vibhuti and Minal suggests him to open a shop of his own. He agrees for it after Anita convinces him and names it as 'Nalle Ka Halwa'. Later, Saxena serves Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan a bull dung soup.

episodesList.title: Tiwari's New Year Party to Get Disastrous
episodesList.summary: Ammaji scolds Tiwari on being unable to impregnate Angoori. Makhmal reveals that he was demoted due to his rivalry with Resham Pal. Vibhuti refuses to pay a bribe to Happu, who later spoils the sweet dish at Tiwari's new year party for revenge.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Cake Affects Everyone's Health
episodesList.summary: the residents of Modern colony arrive at Tiwari's New Year party, but Anita has to wait back to look after Anurag. Everyone enjoys Vibhuti's Halwa cake at the party. However, Tiwari along with Teeka and his friends suffer from stomach upset.

episodesList.title: Happu Spikes Vibhuti's Halwa
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and others at his party blame Vibhuti for their stomach upset. Happu tells Vibhuti to prepare halwa again and serve them. Later, Happu adds poison to Vibhuti's halwa and once again people who ate it have an upset stomach.

episodesList.title: Happu Arrests Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Happu arrests Vibhuti for spiking his 'halwa'. On Anita's insistence, he releases him. As per Ramphal's suggestion, Ammaji ensures that Angoori and Tiwari maintain distance with each other. Vibhuti learns that Happu has schemed against him.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Unaware Of a Forthcoming Problem
episodesList.summary: Angoori and Anita promise Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan to get them married soon. Tiwari and Vibhuti lie to their wives to go to Prem's party. However, they are left stranded in a jungle while returning home. Later, Saxena tells everyone that he is fine.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Tiwari Return With Istri
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Vibhuti bump into Istri. Angoori and Anita worry for both of them. They return home with Istri but there is a strange change in their behaviour. Saxena, Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan are eager to marry Istri. She later organises a 'swayamvar'.

episodesList.title: Istri's Unique Ritual
episodesList.summary: Istri chooses Saxena as her groom and asks for a drop of blood from everyone to complete the ritual. Dr Gupta is shocked when he sees Istri outside. Later, everyone takes part in the ceremony. Master Ji tells Happu about the disappearance of Dr Gupta.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti's Frightening Appearance
episodesList.summary: Istri drinks the blood collected from others and Tiwari and Vibhuti begin to look pale. A scared Anita and Angoori run to Happu for help. He visits them and their changed looks scare him as well. Istri proposes to marry Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan.

episodesList.title: Guru Ghantal Imprisons Istri In a Cave
episodesList.summary: Saxena again becomes a psychopath. Guru Ghantal helps Anita and Angoori to get rid of Istri. Once again, two people reopen the cave in which Istri was imprisoned. Later, Modern colony residents enjoy happy moments of kite flying together.

episodesList.title: Don and Rozy Follow Anita
episodesList.summary: Don and Rozy keep chasing Bhoja who drops a pen drive in Anita's purse. They then begin following her and Don remembers his friend on seeing Vibhuti. Meanwhile, Vibhuti borrows 3000 INR from Teeka and friends to buy Angoori a saree.

episodesList.title: Kallu, Vibhuti's Lookalike
episodesList.summary: Don pays his friend and Vibhuti's lookalike, Kallu 2 lakhs INR to get Vibhuti's pen drive. Anita plans a dinner party at her house. Kallu shocks Don by pulling off Vibhuti's appearance effortlessly. Teeka and friends ask Vibhuti to return their money.

episodesList.title: Kallu Replaces Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Don and Rozy abduct Vibhuti and Kallu takes his place in his home. Later, Don tells Vibhuti about the pen drive and shows him Kallu's doings using a CCTV camera. Vibhuti loses his temper on seeing Kallu holding Angoori's hands.

episodesList.title: Kallu's Threat Scares Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Tiwari complains about Vibhuti's doings to Anita. Kallu tells Tiwari that he likes Angoori and will elope with her someday. Kallu asks Anita to bring her purse and she agrees to do so. Teeka and his friends feel scared on hearing Saxena.

episodesList.title: The Trio Helps Vibhuti Return Home
episodesList.summary: Tiwari tells Anita about Vibhuti's threat. Kallu thrashes Teeka and his friends. The trio later frees a locked up Vibhuti and takes Happu's help to get Kallu arrested. After returning home, Vibhuti clears Tiwari and Angoori's misconception due to Kallu.

episodesList.title: Angoori Prepares to Thrash Someone
episodesList.summary: Ammaji suggests Angoori to thrash any man near a riverbank where clothes are being washed. When Tiwari disagrees to follow the plan, Angoori takes Vibhuti's help. Anita puts on an act to test Vibhuti. Later, Vibhuti and Prem jointly fool Tiwari.

episodesList.title: Teeka and Friends Become Saxena's Pet
episodesList.summary: A jobseeker-turned-astrologer Vibhuti suggests Tiwari to feed a purple-skinned dog. Anita continues with her pretence. Angoori and Vibhuti arrive at the laundry bay. Saxena asks Teeka and friends to wear dog collars and later takes them out for a walk.

episodesList.title: Angoori Beats Vibhuti Up
episodesList.summary: Angoori thrashes Vibhuti at the laundry bay. At home, Anita bites Vibhuti. Tiwari unknowingly feeds Masterji, who is wearing a costume of a purple dog. Later, Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan try to escape Saxena but he threatens them.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Learns About Anita's Pretence
episodesList.summary: Anita tells Vibhuti that they should get separated. Vibhuti tells Tiwari about Anita behaving like a dog. Angoori once again thrashes Vibhuti. Saxena sets Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan free. Vibhuti learns about Anita's pretence.

episodesList.title: Mother-in-law's Arrival Bugs Anita
episodesList.summary: Anita gets worried upon learning about the arrival of Vibhuti's mother. Anita decides to stay at Tiwari's home to avoid her. Anita gets fed up of her mother-in-law's changing decisions. Even Masterji has to temporarily shift due to his mother-in-law.

episodesList.title: Angoori and Vibhuti's Viral Chikchok Video
episodesList.summary: Anita requests Angoori to prepare her favourite dish. Angoori forgets to cook it as she gets busy making a Chikchok video. Tiwari gets upset and scolds her for this. Later, Vibhuti and Angoori make a Chikchok video that goes viral on social media.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Idea to Evade Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Tiwari scolds Vibhuti for making a Chikchok video with Angoori. Vibhuti suggests Angoori to give Tiwari a sedative pill. Happu advises Vibhuti and Angoori to avoid roaming around during the night. Teeka is left stunned to find his hand sprained.

episodesList.title: Chik Chok’s Offer
episodesList.summary: Everyone ignores Annu Awasthi as they are busy enjoying Chik Chok videos. Tillu and Teeka suffer the consequences of using their phones excessively. Chik Chok officials provide an offer to Tiwari, Angoori and Vibhuti for which they must pay INR 25,000.

episodesList.title: A Lesson Learnt
episodesList.summary: Anita pays her share of the money she owes Chik Chok through Tiwari. The news of Chik Chok’s scam comes on TV. Annu Awasthi scolds the four for their foolishness and gives them an advice. David tears the will in front of Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Anita's Suggestion to Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Saxena tells everyone about an invention by a team of scientists overseas. Adding to it, he gives them a piece of good news as well. Vibhuti tells Anita about David's condition. Anita gives Vibhuti an idea to get David's property.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gets Pregnant
episodesList.summary: Anita tells Tiwari that it is not her but Vibhuti who is pregnant. Vibhuti visits Dr. Harsh Santoshi with Saxena and he begins with his regular pregnancy treatment. Vibhuti's mother Helen comes home to see him and learns that he is pregnant.

episodesList.title: Angoori's Advice to a Pregnant Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Angoori congratulates Vibhuti for his pregnancy and advises him to take care of his health. She later tells that she wants Tiwari to become a mother as well. Meanwhile, David and Helen get into a heated argument due to some old conflicts.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Baby Shower
episodesList.summary: Angoori insists Tiwari to try and get pregnant. The next morning, seeing Vibhuti's condition, Anita phones Dr. Harsh Santoshi. Later, the Modern Colony residents celebrate Vibhuti's baby shower ceremony.

episodesList.title: After Vibhuti, Tiwari Gets Pregnant
episodesList.summary: Amma and Angoori forcibly take Tiwari to a doctor. Teeka and friends commit hooliganism to sell goods. Anita and Helen continue to grumble. David reveals something about the property. Later, everyone's shocked when they see a news on TV.

episodesList.title: Angoori Intends On Stealing From Vibhuti's House
episodesList.summary: Ammaji tells Angoori to steal a piece of jewellery from someone's house to nullify a flaw in her horoscope. Helen refuses to give her family jewellery to Anita. Angoori goes to check where Helen keeps her necklace and then plans to steal it.

episodesList.title: Angoori Steals Helen's Necklace
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti sees Angoori while she is stealing Helen's necklace. Helen accuses Anita of stealing the necklace. To save Angoori, Vibhuti stops Helen from calling the police. Tiwari finds a necklace at home. Vibhuti learns the reason behind Angoori's theft.

episodesList.title: Tiwari's Efforts Go to Waste
episodesList.summary: Helen lodges a police complaint for the missing necklace. Saxena falsely testifies against Teeka and friends. Vibhuti sees Tiwari keeping the necklace back at its place and keeps it back in Angoori's room. Tiwari later comes to inform Helen about it.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Throws The Necklace In Vibhuti's House
episodesList.summary: Dr. Gupta tells Helen that the thief who stole the necklace will soon start vomiting. On seeing Anita vomit, Helen calls her a thief again. Tiwari secretly throws the necklace into Vibhuti's house. Ammaji asks Angoori to steal the necklace again.

episodesList.title: Angoori Returns Helen's Necklace
episodesList.summary: Angoori again steals Helen's necklace but Tiwari keeps it back. Vibhuti sees him doing so and keeps it back in Angoori's house. Angoori later returns it and tells everyone the reason behind stealing it. Tiwari gives Angoori a surprise.

episodesList.title: The Week Of Respect
episodesList.summary: Tiwari tries to arrange the money to repay his debts. Vibhuti tells everyone that the winner of the Tehzeeb competition going on in the city, will be rewarded with 1 lakh rupees. Tiwari organises a party and everyone treats each other respectfully.

episodesList.title: A Competition Of Insolence
episodesList.summary: Everyone at the party defines 'tehzeeb' in their own way. During the Tehzeeb Competition, Saxena's uncle Gultaini announces that whoever is the most disrespectful shall be rewarded with 25 lakh INR. Anita tells Vibhuti to participate in it.

episodesList.title: Insolence Turns Modern Colony Into a Madhouse
episodesList.summary: Angoori and Anita keep insulting Vibhuti and Tiwari to win the competition. Happu also insults Commissioner. When Helen visits Anita, the latter insults her in Saxena and Gultaini's presence. Teeka and friends cross the limits of insulting everyone.

episodesList.title: The Competition Of Insolence Bothers Bhoorey
episodesList.summary: Angoori insults Helen upon seeing Saxena and Gultaini. Vibhuti narrates the incident to Helen. Helen, Vibhuti and Tiwari misbehave with Bhoorey. Later, Agarwal visits Tiwari and tells him that he can return his money whenever he wants.

episodesList.title: The Winner Of The Competition Of Insolence
episodesList.summary: Tiwari misbehaves with Agarwal, who had come to help him. Later, everybody disrespects each other in a poetic manner. The Modern Colony residents gather to know who wins the competition. Gultaini eventually announces the winner.

episodesList.title: The Arrival Of Tiwari's and Vibhuti's Impersonators
episodesList.summary: Angoori and Anita refuse to recognise Tiwari and Vibhuti and stay with someone else mistaking them to be Tiwari and Vibhuti. When Vibhuti arrives home, his imposter ousts him from there. Meanwhile, Tiwari also faces a similar problem.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Tiwari Recall The Incident In The Cemetery
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Vibhuti go to the police station but even Happu refuses to recognise them. They both bribe Teeka and friends, asking them to identify them before Angoori and Anita. Later, both recall the incident that happened with them in the cemetery.

episodesList.title: Who is Conspiring Against Tiwari and Vibhuti?
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Vibhuti get upset when they see their imposters flirting with Anita and Angoori. A man tries to tell both of them about some conspiracy but someone shoots him. Later, Tiwari and Vibhuti ask the imposters a few questions.

episodesList.title: Malkhan Falls Prey to The Modern Colony's Conspiracy
episodesList.summary: Even Masterji and Saxena refuse to recognise Tiwari and Vibhuti. Malkhan tries to tell them something but someone shoots him too. Later, Tiwari and Vibhuti call Ammaji and Helen, but they do not recognise them either.

episodesList.title: Angoori and Anita Reveal The Truth
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti goes to his house and tears David's will. Tiwari and Vibhuti get hurt when even Bhoorey doesn't recognise them and consume poison. Later, Angoori and Anita tell them how they planned it all to teach them a lesson.

episodesList.title: Bhoorey and Helen's Love Story Begins
episodesList.summary: Helen visits Anita and criticises Anita's clothes. Bhoorey visits Angoori and decides to stay with her for a few days after seeing Helen. On his insistence, Angoori invites Anita, Vibhuti and Helen for a meal. Meanwhile, Prem starts his courier service.

episodesList.title: Anita's Warning to Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Bhoorey and Helen recite poems to praise each other at the dinner table. Anita warns Vibhuti about Helen and Bhoorey which leads to an argument between them. Later, Vibhuti tries to flirt with Angoori and Bhoorey tries to flirt with Helen.

episodesList.title: Bhoorey Sends a Gift For Helen
episodesList.summary: Helen sends halwa for Bhoorey with Tiwari. Bhoorey also asks Teeka to courier his gift. Helen jumped with joy on receiving a perfume and a letter as a gift. Vibhuti gets details about Bhoorey and his wife from Angoori.

episodesList.title: Helen and Bhoorey Get Caught At The Lovers' Park
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Vibhuti decide to stop Helen and Bhoorey. Masterji tells Vibhuti and Anita that Helen and Bhoorey have gone to watch a film. Later, Happu tells Tiwari and Vibhuti at the police station that Helen and Bhoorey were caught at the Lovers' park.

episodesList.title: David and Bhoorey Fight Due to Helen
episodesList.summary: Tiwari bribes Happu to save Bhoorey and Helen from getting arrested. David threatens Bhoorey to stay away from Helen and the two get into a fight. Helen and Bhoorey say that they are just good friends and curse everyone for doubting their relationship.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti to Make Eco-friendly Colours
episodesList.summary: Anita refuses to play Holi due to her shoot and Angoori tries to avoid the harmful colours. The doctor brings marriage proposals for Teeka and friends. Vibhuti starts an eco-friendly colours' business with Tiwari. Later, Happu makes a huge mistake.

episodesList.title: Who are The Men Plotting Against Vibhuti?
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti makes eco-friendly colours but two men plan to tamper with it. During the inauguration of his shop, Vibhuti and his family argue over the ribbon-cutting. Later, the Modern Colony residents organise a poetry conference.

episodesList.title: Holi At The Modern Colony
episodesList.summary: Everyone criticises each other in a poetic manner. While Vibhuti convinces Anita, Tiwari convinces Angoori to play Holi with the eco-friendly colours. Later, the entire Modern Colony plays Holi with colours made by Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: The Sloganeering Against Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Due to adulteration, the colours of Holi do not come off anyone's face and everyone blames Vibhuti. The doctor informs Teeka and his friends that the girls' family is coming to see them. Later, the Modern colony residents protest against Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti is Proven Innocent
episodesList.summary: Happu tries to handle the situation and comes to arrest Vibhuti. Teeka and friends are saddened by the failure of their marriage discussions. The real culprit is caught with the help of Matru Dhobi. Saxena gets a solution to take off Holi's colours.

episodesList.title: Bhabi Ji Sanidhya Tax' In Kanpur
episodesList.summary: Mantriji declares that everyone in the city will have to pay BST for talking to his sister-in-law. Tiwari and Vibhuti worry as it stops them from talking to Anita and Angoori. Happu explains BST to Teeka and friends. Saxena gets a new job as a CA.

episodesList.title: Saxena Tells How to Cheat On Bst
episodesList.summary: A tax officer collects INR 25,000 from Tiwari for talking to Anita. Tiwari talks to Anita through Vibhuti in the manner suggested by Saxena. Teeka and friends become victims of BST. Vibhuti also visits Angoori to talk through Tiwari.

episodesList.title: Bhoorey and David Fall Prey to Bst
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti talks to Angoori through Tiwari. Bhoorey is charged a tax of INR 1 lakh 80 thousand for talking to Helen, which Tiwari has to pay. Even David becomes a victim of BST. Later, Vibhuti and Tiwari's new plan fails.

episodesList.title: Saxena Advises Tiwari and Vibhuti to Rebel
episodesList.summary: At night, Tiwari visits Anita and Vibhuti visits Angoori. Bhoorey and David arrive to meet Helen but then get into an argument. The next day, the tax officials give a bill of INR 2.5 lakhs to Tiwari and Vibhuti. Saxena asks them both to rebel.

episodesList.title: Modern Colony's Protest Against Bst
episodesList.summary: The Modern colony residents protest against BST. Commissioner arrives in disguise with Happu and the rest of the policemen and they beat everyone up. Later, Tiwari and Vibhuti manage to trick Mantriji into ruling out BST.

episodesList.title: Ammaji Wants Tiwari to Marry a Buffalo
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti's uncle Ram Ghulam promises to give him INR 50 crores in exchange for letting Reshma stay with him. When Ram Ghulam visits Vibhuti, Anita begins arguing with the latter. Ammaji tells Tiwari to marry a buffalo due to his 'kundali dosha'.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Anita In a Fix
episodesList.summary: On seeing Reshma, Anita and Vibhuti agree to adopt Reshma. Chhedi refuses to get his buffalo married to Tiwari. Later, Ram Ghulam's INR 50 crores' offer related to Reshma puts Vibhuti and Anita in a fix.

episodesList.title: Angoori Proposes to Get Tiwari Married to a Buffalo
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti takes Reshma's marriage proposal to Teeka and friends. They later visit Vibhuti for the wedding interview but Reshma rejects them. Angoori learns about Reshma and she talks to Vibhuti about getting Tiwari and Reshma married.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Reshma's Wedding Preparation Begins
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Angoori visit Vibhuti with a marriage proposal for Reshma. After a few questions and answers, Reshma agrees to marry Tiwari and everybody plans to get them married soon. David brings a cheque of INR 1 crore, but Vibhuti and Anita avoid him.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Reshma's Wedding
episodesList.summary: The Modern Colony residents gather for Tiwari and Reshma's wedding. They take turns to dance and celebrate. Tiwari places a gold ring on Reshma's horn and the wedding ceremony comes to an end. Later, Tiwari is stunned by the call Ammaji receives.

episodesList.title: Marrying a Buffalo
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hai, Tiwari gets rid of his 'grih dosha'. He refuses to marry Reshma, breaking Anita and Vibhuti's dreams. Anita offers INR 5 crores to convince Tiwari, and he agrees. Later, the greed for money lands all of them in trouble.

episodesList.title: Angoori Sees a Nightmare
episodesList.summary: Angoori gets scared after seeing a nightmare and tells Vibhuti about it. Meanwhile, Gupta, one of Tiwari's clients, asks Tiwari to take his wife Ramola to see Kanpur. Teeka and friends bring Happu to inaugurate their detective agency.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gets Busy With Spying On Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Anita gets annoyed at Vibhuti for taking extra interest in the neighbours. She lays down a condition before him. Vibhuti sees Tiwari with Ramola and poisons Angoori's mind against him. Later, Vibhuti tells Teeka and friends to spy on Tiwari.

episodesList.title: Tiwari's Truth Surfaces Before Angoori
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti takes Angoori to the hotel where Tiwari is present with Ramola. Vibhuti does not get a gift for Anita. She scolds him after Meenal insults her for it. Later, due to some incidents, Vibhuti feels that Tiwari wants to kill Angoori by feeding her poison.

episodesList.title: Angoori Hires People to Spy On Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Tiwari tries to feed Angoori some 'kheer' after mixing the medicine given by Ammaji. Vibhuti shows Anita a few pictures of Tiwari and Ramola and she believes him. Angoori asks Teeka and friends to spy on Tiwari. Anita calls Ammaji and tries to reveal the truth to her.

episodesList.title: Angoori Gets Rebuked For Spending Money Carelessly
episodesList.summary: Tiwari refuses to pay a grocer and the matter is taken to the police. Tiwari scolds Angoori for spending his money extravagantly. Meanwhile, Saxena becomes a crime reporter. A news report about Happu is published in the newspaper. Commissioner thinks of a way to improve the image of the police.

episodesList.title: Angoori Becomes a Police Officer
episodesList.summary: Commissioner asks Angoori to join the police force to improve the image of the police department. Tiwari refuses to let her join the police force but he agrees when Vibhuti lists the benefits of Angoori's job. Later, Angoori arrives at the police station and everyone welcomes her.

episodesList.title: Angoori Allows Teeka and Friends to Commit Crime
episodesList.summary: Angoori asks a dhaba owner to provide food to Teeka and friends. Tiwari tries to spend time with Angoori. Vibhuti gets excited to see her picture in a newspaper. Crime reporter Saxena asks Angoori a few questions. She allows Teeka and friends to commit minor crimes.

episodesList.title: Teeka and Friends Plan a Kidnapping
episodesList.summary: A man brutally beats Tiwari. Teeka and friends plan to kidnap Seth Ghanshyamdas for money. At night, David's essential belongings get stolen from Vibhuti's house. Teeka and friends learn that Seth Ghanshyamdas has died. Angoori visits Vibhuti regarding the theft.

episodesList.title: Angoori Helps The Robbers
episodesList.summary: Angoori tells David that she will find the thief but he has to pay half the money to the thief. She later helps two bank robbers. Teeka and friends plan to steal a statue from the museum. Tiwari tells Angoori to quit her job. Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan learn that the statue kept in the museum is fake.

episodesList.title: Angoori Gets Jailed
episodesList.summary: Angoori refuses to quit the police job. Commissioner, after helping the robbers, ousts Angoori from her position and gets her jailed. Vibhuti tells Tiwari to offer Commissioner a bribe of INR 10 lakhs to bail Angoori out. Later, Tiwari and Vibhuti tell each other the reason behind drinking alcohol.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Tiwari Promise to Quit Drinking
episodesList.summary: Anita scolds an intoxicated Tiwari and ousts him from her room. Angoori gets nervous to see Vibhuti in her room. The next day, Angoori refuses to forgive Vibhuti and Anita refuses to forgive Tiwari. They both promise to quit drinking. Later, they plan to drink again.

episodesList.title: Anita Warns Vibhuti From Consuming Alcohol
episodesList.summary: Despite Anita's warning, Vibhuti drinks alcohol with Tiwari. Upon reaching home, Tiwari and Vibhuti lie to their respective wives that they have not consumed alcohol. But Anu and Angoori receive a video which states otherwise. Later, Saxena decides to teach a drunk Teeka and his friends a lesson.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti's Excuse For Addiction
episodesList.summary: Mini suggests Anita to talk to Vibhuti lovingly to make him quit drinking. Ammaji suggests the same to Angoori. The next day, Tiwari and Vibhuti suggest their wives to serve drinks to make them quit it. Saxena thrashes Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan for drinking. Anita and Angoori test their husbands.

episodesList.title: Liquor Ban Imposed In Kanpur
episodesList.summary: Anita and Angoori see their husbands secretly drinking. The next day, they threaten liquor minister Chandrabhan of not voting for him, and he declares a liquor ban in Kanpur. This news upsets the men of the city. Saxena distributes sweets to everyone to celebrate the ban.

episodesList.title: Teeka and Malkhan Steal Liquor From Masterji's House
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Vibhuti buy liquor from a man from the grey market. A shortage of liquor upsets Teeka and Malkhan. They decide to steal from Masterji's house. Angoori and Anita tell their husbands that the man selling the liquor was Saxena and it was their plan. Teeka and Malkhan steal a liquor bottle.

episodesList.title: Angoori Gets a Cheque Of Inr 2 Crores
episodesList.summary: As suggested by a faqir, Tiwari donates 100 bananas to Malkhan because of greediness. Advocate Dayakrupa from Virpur, tells Angoori that her uncle has sent a cheque of INR 2 crores for her. Vibhuti also distributes bananas but he suffers loss in the share market. Angoori decides to donate the money.

episodesList.title: Tiwari's Plan to Extract Money From Angoori
episodesList.summary: Tiwari offers Vibhuti INR 10 lakhs in exchange for convincing Angoori to give Tiwari INR 1 crore. The next day, Ammaji tells Angoori to give it to him as a loan. Meanwhile, Vibhuti suggests Tiwari to pretend to get himself abducted. Angoori overhears it and decides to teach them a lesson.

episodesList.title: Angoori Refuses to Pay Ransom Money For Tiwari
episodesList.summary: A disguised Vibhuti arrives to abduct Tiwari. Angoori tells him to first play Snakes and Ladders with her. Vibhuti abducts Tiwari and demands ransom from Angoori. She refuses to do his bidding and tells him to kill Tiwari. Teeka and friends start a new job.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Abducts Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Prem tells Vibhuti that Angoori may have fallen in love with someone else and Vibhuti gets happy. He tells Tiwari to kidnap him. Tiwari kidnaps Vibhuti. However, Angoori still refuses to give the ransom money.

episodesList.title: Angoori Reveals The Truth to Tiwari and Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Vibhuti are disheartened due to Angoori's behaviour. To reduce their stress, Saxena calls Teeka and friends, but it doesn't help. Angoori tells them that she knew their plan and was deliberately playing a prank.

episodesList.title: Modern Colony Residents' Dream to Fly
episodesList.summary: Angoori and Anita express their desire to fly. Saxena tells Tiwari and Vibhuti that he has become a pilot and he can help anyone fly in a helicopter for INR 25 thousand. Teeka and friends ask for money from Masterji.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Buy Helicopter Tickets
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti arranges INR 25,000 by lying to Anita and gives Angoori 2 helicopter tickets. Even Tiwari visits Anita with helicopter tickets. Anita faints and Dr. Gupta advises her to stay away from heights.

episodesList.title: Prem Lands In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Dr. Gupta asks Anita to overcome her fear of heights. Vibhuti practices flying with Angoori. Anita questions Prem about Vibhuti's money after seeing him safe. Tiwari and Vibhuti lie about their respective tickets.

episodesList.title: Teeka and Friends Trouble Happu
episodesList.summary: Tiwari asks Anita to climb a table and clean the fan to overcome her fear of heights. However, she falls down while doing so. Teeka and friends unintentionally foil a disguised Happu's plan once again.

episodesList.title: The Truth About Saxena's Job
episodesList.summary: Chhedi visits Anita's house and Vibhuti's lie surfaces. Anita tells Vibhuti to return her INR 25,000. Teeka and friends beat up Happu, who is disguised as a goon. Saxena reveals that he does the job of cutting vegetables.

episodesList.title: Anita Threatens to Divorce Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Saxena reveals about his job to Tiwari and Anita. Anita tells Vibhuti on a call that if he wanders around unemployed, she will divorce him. Tiwari terminates Tillu and Angoori tells Tiwari to give this job to Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Becomes Tiwari's Servant
episodesList.summary: Tiwari offers Vibhuti a job and he accepts it. Later, Tiwari treats Vibhuti like a servant during his stint at Tiwari's shop. Out of the fear of losing his job, Vibhuti does the odd jobs at Tiwari's house.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Becomes a Millionaire
episodesList.summary: Tiwari insults Vibhuti and ousts him from his position. Saxena promises an upset Vibhuti to help him. Later, he visits Vibhuti's house and reveals that Vibhuti's uncle Harry has left a property worth INR 110 crores for him.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Avenges His Insult
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti steps out wearing a suit and asks Tiwari a few questions before investing money in his business. Even Helen and David try to impress Vibhuti. Vibhuti visits Tiwari's house for a meal and deliberately insults him.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Learns Vibhuti's Truth
episodesList.summary: Tiwari hears Vibhuti telling Angoori that he is not a millionaire. Tiwari plans to expose Vibhuti. Later, he and Helen team up to put up an act of her kidnapping. He demands a ransom of INR 10 crores from Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Puts an End to His Pretence
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti demands INR 10 crore from Tiwari but he refuses. Later, he confesses about his pretence before everyone. Anita calls Tiwari and asks him to fix the wall clock of her house. Saxena starts behaving like a child.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Starts Behaving Like a Child
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti drops a hammer on Tiwari's head. Tiwari regains consciousness and starts to behave like a child. Vibhuti tricks Teeka and Malkhan and snatches their money. Later, they disguise as robbers to get their money back.

episodesList.title: Tiwari's Behaviour Upsets Angoori
episodesList.summary: Angoori gets upset with Tiwari's behaviour. Tiwari and Saxena become friends. David gives the property papers to Vibhuti. Saxena and Tiwari unknowingly spoil the property papers. Ammaji tells Angoori a superstitious remedy.

episodesList.title: Teeka and Malkhan Abduct Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti babysits Tiwari to help Angoori. David gets property papers for Vibhuti but Tiwari and Saxena make paper planes out of it. Vibhuti locks Tiwari in bathroom. Teeka and Malkhan abduct Tiwari to get ransom from Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Teeka and Friends Abduct Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti gets worried after Tiwari goes missing from his house. Teeka calls as a kidnapper and asks a ransom of INR 1 lakh from Vibhuti for Tiwari's release. Vibhuti leaves with the money but someone snatches it from him.

episodesList.title: Tiwari's Condition Gets Normal
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and David hide about Tiwari's kidnapping from Angoori. Later, Tiwari, who had become a child, becomes normal again and returns home. Vibhuti learns that Teeka and Malkhan had abducted Tiwari.

episodesList.title: Angoori's Cooking Video Goes Viral
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti suggests Angoori to make videos of her cooking and upload it on social media. Tiwari discourages her, but Ammaji's fear makes him approve of it. Later, Angoori's cooking video goes viral.

episodesList.title: Anita Makes a Video
episodesList.summary: Teeka and friends ask Vibhuti to make them famous as well and Vibhuti asks them about their talents. To prove herself competent, Anita makes a video on female security and beats Tiwari. Ammaji suggests a unique idea.

episodesList.title: Angoori Becomes Arrogant
episodesList.summary: Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hain is a Hindi comedy drama television series starring Aashif Sheikh, Rohitash Gaud, Saumya Tandon and Shubhangi Atre Poore. The story revolves around two neighbouring couples - Manmohan and Angoori, and Vibhuti and Anita, who live in Modern Colony. Both men are attracted to each other’s wives and leave no chance to impress them, which often lands them in funny situations.

episodesList.title: Tiwari's Special Medicine
episodesList.summary: Ammaji tells Angoori to become more arrogant. Tiwari takes a medicine for pain from Dr Gupta and happily gets beaten by Anita while making videos for her. Angoori repeatedly insults Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Angoori's Revelation About Her Changed Behaviour
episodesList.summary: Angoori and Anita tell Vibhuti and Tiwari that their absence in the video does not matter. Teeka and friends realise that they have nothing special. Angoori informs everyone about Ammaji's remedy. Now, viewers in India can

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Becomes a Don
episodesList.summary: A man tells Don Franchisco that his son's murderer is in Modern colony of Kanpur. To frighten the people there, Vibhuti becomes Don Veto. Helen and David support him in this plan. Now, viewers in India can

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Pretends to be a Murderer
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti pretends to murder someone before Tiwari. Tiwari tells Anita that Vibhuti is the son of a bigshot Italian don. Saxena insults Vibhuti. Teeka and friends decide to join Vibhuti's gang. Now, viewers in India can

episodesList.title: Teeka and Friends Loot Masterji
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti tells Tiwari to sweep the colony. Later, he tells Anita that the police will be able to trace them if she does excessive shopping. Teeka and friends loot Masterji to join Vibhuti's gang. Now, viewers in India can

episodesList.title: The Conspiracy to Kill Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: David tells Tiwari to leave an important parcel near the drain. Tiwari goes with the parcel and runs into Happu there. A man vows to avenge his son's death by killing Don Veto, who is Vibhuti. Now, viewers in India can

episodesList.title: Happu Opens The Parcel
episodesList.summary: David tells Teeka and friends to do a big job to join his gang. Tiwari puts the parcel given by David under a tree and as he leaves, Happu opens it. Later, Teeka and friends steal Prem's money.

episodesList.title: Franchesco Arrives to Take Revenge On Veto
episodesList.summary: Happu arrests Teeka and friends for looting Prem. Later, a man named Franchesco arrives to avenge his son's death by killing Veto. Happu and Commissioner save Vibhuti by arriving on time. Now, viewers in India can

episodesList.title: Strange Advice For Tiwari and Vibhuti's Issues
episodesList.summary: Anita and Angoori praise each other's husbands on a TV show. Meanwhile, Baba Chakshuanand gives strange advice for Tiwari and Vibhuti's issues. By Happu's help, Teeka and friends open an agency. Now, viewers in India can

episodesList.title: Angoori-anita Start Hating Vibhuti-tiwari
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and Tiwari approach Teeka and friends' agency. With Tillu and Malkhan's help, they try to instil hatred for themselves in each other's wives' mind. Saxena beats Vibhuti-Tiwari for their misdeeds.

episodesList.title: Happu Suspects Teeka and Friends
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and Tiwari's efforts go in vain. Later, Vibhuti again tries to instil hatred for himself in Angoori's mind. Happu suspects that Teeka and friends are cheating him. Now, viewers in India can

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Fall Prey to Their Own Plan
episodesList.summary: Tiwari executes the theft before Anita. Angoori and Anita tell each other about their husbands’ actions. Further, they confront their husbands. Tiwari and Vibhuti learn a truth.

episodesList.title: Happu Snatches Teeka and Friends' Salary
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti gives money to beggars before Angoori. Tiwari also tries to tie a 'rakhi' to Kamla before Anita. Later, Vibhuti feeds Teeka, disguised as a beggar. Happu snatches Teeka and his friends' earnings.

episodesList.title: Saxena Decides to Bring a Change
episodesList.summary: Anita and Angoori tell each other that Tiwari and Vibhuti have gotten back to normal. Saxena takes up the task of bringing a change in the nation. Masterji asks Teeka and friends to prepare 50 clay pots.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Saves Vibhuti's Life
episodesList.summary: Tiwari saves Vibhuti's life after a snake bites him. Later, Bhoorey eve teases Helen. This angers David and he visits Tiwari's house to eve tease Ammaji. Helen asks Bhoorey to apologise to her.

episodesList.title: Teeka and Friends Incur a Loss
episodesList.summary: Teeka and friends arrive at the Modern Colony to sell pots. Bhoorey and David get into a scuffle which leads to breaking of the pots. Vibhuti tries to return Tiwari's favour but falls prey to his ploy.

episodesList.title: Angoori Gets Abducted
episodesList.summary: David and Bhoorey break Teeka and friends' pots while fighting. Helen suggests Vibhuti abduct Tiwari and save him to return Tiwari's favour. However, instead of Tiwari, Angoori gets abducted.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gets Captured While Trying to Save Angoori
episodesList.summary: A kidnapper asks Tiwari a ransom of INR 5 lakh to free Angoori. Vibhuti goes to save her but learns that the kidnappers are real as they hold him captive. David reveals the truth to Bhoorey and Ammaji.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Helps Ammaji Get Rid Of Constipation
episodesList.summary: With Happu's help, Tiwari rescues Angoori and Vibhuti. Vibhuti mixes laxatives in Ammaji's tea while trying to mix it in Tiwari's tea. Ammaji thanks Vibhuti for helping her in curing the constipation.

episodesList.title: Ammaji's New Superstitious Remedy
episodesList.summary: Tiwari demands his money back from Vibhuti. Ammaji tells Tiwari a superstitious remedy for success. According to it, he has to cook food and feed them personally. Angoori apprises Vibhuti of it.

episodesList.title: The Pretence Of Malkhan's Death
episodesList.summary: Tiwari gives Vibhuti a two-day extension to return his money. Later, he feeds Teeka and friends, and Malkhan pretends to be ill. Teeka and Tillu lie to Angoori that Malkhan has died.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Sees Malkhan's Corpse
episodesList.summary: Teeka, Tillu and Vibhuti accuse Tiwari of Malkhan's murder. On Tiwari insistence, they hand over Malkhan's corpse. Later, Tiwari learns that Malkhan is alive.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's New Pretence
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti, Tillu and Teeka go to collect INR 10 lakhs from Tiwari, who lays down a condition before them. Vibhuti begins the pretence of Malkhan's fake family. Later, Tiwari decides to teach him a lesson.

episodesList.title: Teeka and Friends Plan to Dupe Saxena
episodesList.summary: Tiwari tells Vibhuti that he has chosen Saxena for Malkhan's widow. Teeka and friends, along with Vibhuti, plan to extract INR 10 lakhs from Saxena. Tiwari decides to foil their plan.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gets Exposed
episodesList.summary: Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hain is a Hindi comedy drama television series starring Aashif Sheikh, Rohitash Gaud, Saumya Tandon and Shubhangi Atre Poore. The story revolves around two neighbouring couples - Manmohan and Angoori, and Vibhuti and Anita, who live in Modern Colony. Both men are attracted to each other’s wives and leave no chance to impress them, which often lands them in funny situations.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Starts a Food Stall
episodesList.summary: Tiwari decides to try a new business and starts a fast food stall for Tillu. Teeka and Malkhan steal Vibhuti's wallet. At the stall, Vibhuti gives his order to Tillu.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti to Become a News Anchor
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti asks Tillu to lend him some money. Tiwari arrives there and snatches a parcel from Vibhuti. Prem offers Vibhuti to become an anchor for a news channel. Teeka and Malkhan steal Masterji's wallet.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Becomes a Topic Of Debate
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti asks Tiwari and Angoori to participate in a debate on his news channel. Saxena shows a video clip on the channel in which Tiwari is seen defecating in the open. Later, the debate begins.

episodesList.title: Modern Colony Residents Thrash Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Tiwari leaves the debate and walks away. Modern Colony residents protest against Tiwari and beat him up. Later, the news channel shows the messages shared between Tiwari and Malkhan.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gets a Threat
episodesList.summary: The Modern colony residents once again protest against Tiwari and beat him up. Prem tells Vibhuti that he wants the channel to incur a loss and not profit. Vibhuti gets a threat to shut down the channel.

episodesList.title: Who will Shoot The Arrow At Ravan?
episodesList.summary: Angoori becomes the chairwoman of the Dussehra Committee. Tiwari gets the right to shoot an arrow at Ravan by donating INR 51,000. Vibhuti decides to snatch this right. Teeka and friends ask for work.

episodesList.title: Angoori Gives a Final Warning to Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti comes as a beggar and accuses Tiwari. Angoori threatens to take away the right to shoot an arrow at Raavan’s effigy from Tiwari. Saxena asks Teeka and team questions from the Mahabharata.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Actions Anger Helen
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti, disguised as a woman, accuses Tiwari of eve-teasing. Angoori gives Tiwari one last chance. Helen lashes out at Vibhuti for mortgaging her ring. Saxena asks tough questions to Teeka and friends.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Promise to Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti wins the right to shoot an arrow after the voting results. On seeing Tiwari upset, Angoori vows to give Tiwari the right to shoot. Vibhuti promises Tiwari that he will help improve his image.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Gets The Right to Shoot an Arrow
episodesList.summary: Teeka and friends fulfil Saxena's condition to get a role in Ramlila. Vibhuti uses Prem's help and enhances Tiwari's image with his plan. Angoori gives Tiwari the right to shoot an arrow on Dussehra.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Question Worries Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti teases Tiwari by asking him his real father's name. Saxena starts a pathology lab in the colony. Tiwari asks Ammaji his real father's name. Later, Tiwari gives samples for a DNA test.

episodesList.title: David Turns Out to be Tiwari's Father
episodesList.summary: David tells Vibhuti that he has won the case and he will give him property worth INR 20 crores. A medical report proves that David is Tiwari's father. Ammaji narrates a 20-years-old incident to Tiwari.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Claims to be David's Son
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti asks Teeka and friends to do a job in exchange for INR 5 lakhs. Later, he goes to Tiwari's house with a report and says that David is his father too. Masterji lands in trouble.

episodesList.title: David's Sons Create Problems For Him
episodesList.summary: Tiwari-Vibhuti fight over David and the matter lands them in a police station. Teeka and friends say that they too are David's children. Later, Saxena arrives and tells about the mistake in the reports.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Dream to Watch a Film With Angoori
episodesList.summary: Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hain is a Hindi comedy drama television series starring Aashif Sheikh, Rohitash Gaud, Saumya Tandon and Shubhangi Atre Poore. The story revolves around two neighbouring couples - Manmohan and Angoori, and Vibhuti and Anita, who live in Modern Colony. Both men are attracted to each other’s wives and leave no chance to impress them, which often lands them in funny situations.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti's Greed
episodesList.summary: Bhoorey reveals that he is expecting to get a lot of money soon. Out of greed, Vibhuti and Tiwari begin to argue over looking after him. He decides to stay with Tiwari. Tiwari and Bhoorey ignore Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti to Create a Rift Between Tiwari and Bhoorey
episodesList.summary: Helen advises Vibhuti to create a rift between Tiwari and Bhoorey. Vibhuti tells Helen his plan. Later, Bhoorey arrives with Tiwari and Angoori at Vibhuti's house on Helen's invitation.

episodesList.title: Tiwari's Actions Hurt Bhoorey
episodesList.summary: Tiwari loses his watch in Vibhuti's house and the matter worsens when Bhoorey is searched. On Vibhuti's insistence, Angoori searches Tiwari. He tries to pacify Bhoorey, and Vibhuti makes his next move.

episodesList.title: Who will Sleep With Tiwari?
episodesList.summary: During a power outage, Anita's fear of darkness prompts her to hug whoever is nearby. Neighbors gather to investigate the blackout. Manmohan hides his night blindness. The men seek answers from Pandit Ji, an electricity department employee. Vibhuti alerts Manmohan about Anita's fear. When power briefly returns, Manmohan seizes the opportunity to draw closer to Anita.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Angoori Celebrate 'karva Chauth'
episodesList.summary: Tiwari tries to stop Angoori from leaving the house. Vibhuti accepts his mistake. Modern colony residents play cricket and Tiwari gets hurt. Later, Tiwari and Angoori celebrate 'Karva Chauth'.

episodesList.title: Angoori Prepares Delicious 'laddus'
episodesList.summary: Anita decides to go to a hermitage for peace of mind. Vibhuti proposes a business to Tiwari after hearing Prem's words. Later, Tiwari tries to convince Angoori to prepare 500 kg of 'laddus'.

episodesList.title: Teeka and Friends Threaten Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Teeka and friends threaten to kill Tiwari, who helplessly hires them as an assistant to Angoori. Anita narrates her experience at the hermitage. Later, the process of making 'laddus' begins.

episodesList.title: Anita Foils Vibhuti's Plan to Romance Her
episodesList.summary: Ammaji tells Tiwari to get Teeka and friends to work instead of Angoori. Vibhuti tries to romance Anita.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Panics On Seeing Singhania Begging
episodesList.summary: Anita goes back to the hermitage. Vibhuti sees Singhania begging and beats Prem for lying to him. Later, he imagines that Angoori has shot herself due to the order getting cancelled.

episodesList.title: Modern Colony Residents Celebrate Diwali
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Angoori see Singhania begging. Tiwari, along with Teeka and friends, beat Vibhuti. Later, 'laddus' prepared by Angoori get sold and the residents of Modern Colony celebrate Diwali together.

episodesList.title: How will Vibhuti Prove Himself Good?
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti goes for an interview and he is asked for a character certificate. Vibhuti badmouths Tiwari and drives away one of his clients. Saxena begins a new job of predicting people's future.

episodesList.title: Angoori Humiliates Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Ammaji gives Angoori a new remedy. Vibhuti brings Mr. Charitrawan to meet Angoori, but the remedy forces her to humiliate Vibhuti. Even Helen humiliates him. Vibhuti asks Teeka and friends for help.

episodesList.title: Angoori Bhabhi Ne Kyon Toda Vibhuti Ka Dil?
episodesList.summary: Angoori asks Vibhuti to call his boss again but due to Tiwari's conspiracy, she insults Vibhuti again. Later, Tiwari and Helen realise their mistake and they praise Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti's Mischief
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti deliberately teases Angoori to make her badmouth him before his boss. Angoori insults him before his boss, but it does not help the purpose. Later, Tiwari and Vibhuti plan to prank Anita.

episodesList.title: Angoori's English Bothers Tiwari and Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Tiwari insults Vibhuti, who decides to take revenge. Vibhuti takes advantage of Angoori's poor English and makes her insult Tiwari and his family. Later, Tiwari takes revenge on Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Uses Johnny Joker As a Pawn
episodesList.summary: Johnny Joker's death upsets Angoori. Vibhuti sits near his grave and narrates to Ramghulam his tale. Ramghulam tells Tiwari, Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan that Vibhuti has been possessed by Johnny's spirit.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Becomes Johnny Joker
episodesList.summary: Tiwari asks Vibhuti to become a clown for Ammaji's birthday but he refuses. Later, Vibhuti arrives in the guise of Johnny Joker. He mixes something in everyone's drinks to make them feel itchy.

episodesList.title: Saxena Becomes The Lady Johnny Joker
episodesList.summary: Tiwari tells Saxena about Vibhuti getting possessed by Johnny Joker's spirit. Saxena meets him and becomes the lady Johnny Joker himself. Later, Angoori dances with Johnny Joker.

episodesList.title: Ramghulam Exposes Vibhuti's Pretence
episodesList.summary: Commissioner and Happu disguise as clowns for a mission. Teeka and team mistake them for Vibhuti and Saxena and thrash them. Later, Ramghulam arrives to expose Vibhuti's pretence.

episodesList.title: The Night Of 'sweet Moon'
episodesList.summary: David explains the significance of 'sweet moon' to Vibhuti and Helen. Vibhuti makes a plan to see it with Angoori and gives Teeka and friends a task. Later, David reveals a shocking truth to Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Angoori and Vibhuti Get Disappointed
episodesList.summary: Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hain is a Hindi comedy drama television series starring Aashif Sheikh, Rohitash Gaud, Saumya Tandon and Shubhangi Atre Poore. The story revolves around two neighbouring couples - Manmohan and Angoori, and Vibhuti and Anita, who live in Modern Colony. Both men are attracted to each other’s wives and leave no chance to impress them, which often lands them in funny situations.

episodesList.title: Angoori and Vibhuti Become Strict
episodesList.summary: After hearing Prem, Angoori and Vibhuti come up with an idea. Angoori gets strict with Tiwari and Vibhuti does the same with Anita. Teeka and friends prepare to begin their new job.

episodesList.title: Teeka and Friends Serve Anita and Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Anita opts for Teeka and friends' 'Bhadas Nikalo' service and beats Tillu. Even Tiwari pays Teeka and friends to beat them. Prem tells Vibhuti about his wife's love affair.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Anita's Secret Plan
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Anita fear to enter their houses. Anita comes up with an idea after talking to Minal. Anita and Tiwari pretend to be in love with someone. Meanwhile, Masterji vents out his frustration.

episodesList.title: Tillu's Luck Changes In a Moment
episodesList.summary: Angoori and Vibhuti apologise to Tiwari and Anita who then reveal about their pretence. Lawyer Yamraj Dubey tells Tillu that he has inherited his aunt's property. However, the truth leaves Tillu stunned.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Suffers From a Shortage Of Money
episodesList.summary: Anita stops giving money for Vibhuti's expenses and he faces shortage of money. Angoori pets Saxena, who is behaving like a dog. Tiwari wants to grow his business. Prem tells Vibhuti about Tiwari's need.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Becomes Baba Lucky Kabutar
