episodesList.summary: Vibhuti becomes Baba Lucky Kabutar and visits Tiwari. Later, he tells Tiwari a way to find his lucky pigeon. Tiwari falls for Vibhuti's bluff and begins to consider him lucky. Saxena again bites Happu.

episodesList.title: Saxena Bites Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Tiwari asks Vibhuti to touch his files, and he demands INR 20,000 for it. Saxena bites Vibhuti. A man named John keeps looking for a dog. Teeka and friends think about Saxena after hearing John.

episodesList.title: Baba Lucky Kabutar Gets Exposed
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti visits Tiwari in his guise as Baba Lucky Kabutar. Due to Ammaji, Vibhuti has to reveal to everyone that he is Baba Lucky Kabutar. Teeka and friends discover John's truth. Saxena bites the trio.

episodesList.title: Some Robbers Thrash Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Dr Gupta tells about the robbers roaming in the town. Vibhuti asks Teeka and friends to come to Angoori's house in the guise as robbers. However, the real robbers arrive there and thrash Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: The Story Of Chandralekha
episodesList.summary: Chandralekha attacks Atma Lal Tripathi, who is writing a story on her. Prem asks Vibhuti to write his horror show's story. Helen tells Vibhuti about Chandralekha and he decides to write a story on her.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Begins to Write Chandralekha's Story
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti starts writing Chandralekha's story. Dr Gupta tells everyone that Chandralekha's spirit harms those who tamper with her story. Vibhuti offers Tiwari a character for Angoori's sake.

episodesList.title: Chandralekha Attacks Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: On seeing Angoori's strange behaviour, Tiwari and Vibhuti feel confused. Teeka and friends face disappointment. At night, Vibhuti begins to write a story and Chandralekha suddenly attacks him.

episodesList.title: Will Modern Colony be Able to Get Rid Of Chandralekha?
episodesList.summary: Angoori beats everyone during the shoot. Vibhuti and the others go to a library to get rid of Chandralekha. At the library, they find a book and decide to find its author.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Finds a Way to Get Rid Of Chandralekha
episodesList.summary: The writer Robert Hussain tells Vibhuti and the others about a way to get rid of Chandralekha. Vibhuti prepares to get Chandralekha married to Tiwari. Angoori requests Chandralekha to not marry Tiwari.

episodesList.title: Ammaji's New Remedy Troubles Bhoorey
episodesList.summary: Ammaji tells Angoori to insult Bhoorey as a superstitious remedy. Bhoorey comes home and Tiwari and Angoori repeatedly insult him. Teeka and friends join an NGO that works for the welfare of the elderly.

episodesList.title: Angoori's Behaviour Saddens Bhoorey
episodesList.summary: Angoori serves onion-roti to Bhoorey. Later, Angoori and Tiwari tell him to sleep in the lawn. Teeka and friends help Bhoorey defecate in the open. Angoori insults Vibhuti as well.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Lodges a Complaint Against Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti lodges a complaint against Tiwari at Teeka and friends' NGO. They visit Tiwari's house but Angoori and Tiwari deny harassing Bhoorey. Later, Teeka and friends threaten Tiwari, who beats them up.

episodesList.title: Ammaji Reveals The Truth to Bhoorey
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti lodges a complaint against Angoori and Tiwari with Happu but Tiwari ends the matter by paying a bribe. Bhoorey confirms that Ammaji has revealed the truth to him. Teeka and friends thrash Tiwari.

episodesList.title: The Modern Colony Residents Celebrate Christmas
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti tells Angoori about Santa Claus, and Angoori wishes to get a car. Vibhuti, disguised as Santa, brings a toy car for Angoori. Later, the Modern Colony residents celebrate Christmas together.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gets a Leg Injury
episodesList.summary: Tiwari hits Vibhuti with a scooter. Helen and David tell Vibhuti to file a case against Tiwari and Vibhuti pretends to lose his legs. Ammaji informs Tiwari that he is going to incur loss of crores.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Demands Inr 5 Crores From Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti's condition makes Tiwari feel sorry. A lawyer reveals to Tiwari that Vibhuti has filed a claim of INR 5 crores against him. To avoid paying him, Tiwari accepts Vibhuti's conditions.

episodesList.title: New Year Celebrations In Modern Colony
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti bears all the pain during the examination. His lawyer and Tiwari's next move works, and Vibhuti confesses the truth. Later, all the Modern Colony residents celebrate the New Year together. Now, viewers in India can watch Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hai episodes before their TV telecast on ZEE5!

episodesList.title: New Year Celebrations In Modern Colony
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti bears all the pain during the examination. His lawyer and Tiwari's next move works, and Vibhuti confesses the truth. Later, all the Modern Colony residents celebrate the New Year together.

episodesList.title: The Recession Worries Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Worried by the recession, Tiwari scolds Angoori. Anita warns him after Angoori's complaint. Ammaji tells him a superstitious remedy. Vibhuti incurs a loss of INR 1.5 lakhs and plans to make up.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Cheats Tiwari Of Money
episodesList.summary: Tiwari tells Vibhuti about Ammaji's superstitious remedy. Vibhuti disguises as a woman to fulfil Tiwari's remedy. As per Vibhuti's plan, Teeka and friends disguise as cops and extract money from Tiwari.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gives Angoori a Present
episodesList.summary: Tiwari asks Vibhuti to convince a woman to meet him again. Vibhuti gives Angoori a present. Anita decides to help Happu catch the robbers roaming in the town.

episodesList.title: Anita Brings a Disguised Vibhuti Home
episodesList.summary: Tiwari drinks with Vibhuti, disguised as a woman. Surprisingly, Anita and Happu arrive there. Anita takes Vibhuti home. At night, Vibhuti changes his attire and lies to Anita that the woman has run away.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Calls a Party After His Constipation Gets Cured
episodesList.summary: At Anita's insistence, Saxena agrees to marry Vibhuti, who is disguised as a woman. However, Vibhuti soon gets exposed. Tiwari calls a party to celebrate his constipation getting cured.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Decides to Get Bachelors Married
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti damages a car brought by Prem. He promises to get Teeka and friends married after finding them disappointed. A goon phones Vibhuti and demands INR three lakhs for damaging his car.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Unaffordable Fee
episodesList.summary: Teeka and friends visit Vibhuti's marriage bureau and he asks for INR 3 lakhs to get them married. They request Tiwari to lend the money. Saxena asks Vibhuti to get his sisters married.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Gives Money to Teeka and Friends
episodesList.summary: Teeka and friends vow never to marry. Tiwari arrives there and gives him INR 3 lakhs to get married. Vibhuti practices singing wedding songs with Angoori. Anita grooms Teeka and Tillu.

episodesList.title: Angoori Suffers From a Sore Throat
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti worries about his loss after Angoori suffers from sore throat. Later, Vibhuti introduces Tillu to Saxena, who is disguised as a girl. A news about the Marona virus shocks Tiwari.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Learns About Vibhuti and Saxena's Plan
episodesList.summary: Tiwari learns about Saxena and Vibhuti's plan. He takes his money back from Vibhuti and Happu arrests a goon. First Vibhuti, and then David beats Tiwari to help him cure his back sprain.

episodesList.title: Angoori's Former Lover
episodesList.summary: Angoori reveals to Vibhuti that she had a lover before getting married. Vibhuti and Tiwari confront Angoori and they learn that her lover Raju was a goat. Later, Tiwari informs Angoori of Raju's death.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gives Angoori a Magical Phone
episodesList.summary: Raju's death deeply saddens Angoori. Anita doubts Vibhuti and she asks Teeka and friends to keep an eye on him. Vibhuti gives Angoori a magical phone to talk to Raju.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Talks to Angoori Pretending As Raju
episodesList.summary: Anita asks Teeka and friends to keep an eye on Vibhuti. The trio goes out at night and Saxeni Maa beats them. Vibhuti pretends as Raju over a phone call with Angoori and asks her to pour water on Tiwari.

episodesList.title: Teeka and Friends Lie About Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Angoori tells Vibhuti about her conversation with Raju at night. Teeka and friends lie to Anita that Vibhuti is having an affair with someone. At night, she stops Vibhuti from going out of their bedroom.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Lies Surface Before Angoori
episodesList.summary: At Raju's insistence, Angoori feeds Tiwari fritters made of grass. Tiwari talks to Anita about his issues. Tiwari asks Angoori to tell him the whole truth. He later exposes Vibhuti before Angoori.

episodesList.title: Bhukkan Dada Threatens Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Bhukkan threatens Dada Tiwari to extort INR 2 crores. Teeka and friends devise a plan against Tiwari. The doctor gives Tiwari a bad news. Later, Vibhuti advises Anita that she should not recite poetry.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Plans His Own Murder
episodesList.summary: Tiwari gets scared due to a nightmare. Prem tells Vibhuti about Tiwari's incurable disease. Tiwari plans to get himself murdered. Later, he asks Angoori about her wishes.

episodesList.title: Supari Dada Causes Trouble For Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Dr Gupta tells Tiwari that he is fine. Tiwari visits Supari Dada and requests him to cancel the contract to kill him. Later, Happu tells Vibhuti about Supari Dada's death.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Pretends to be Supari Dadi and Calls Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti, pretending to be Supari Dada over a phone call, threatens to kill Tiwari if he steps out of the house. A frightened Tiwari stays home. Vibhuti uses the opportunity to take Angoori to a theatre.

episodesList.title: Anita Bhabhi's New Avatar | Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hai | Promo
episodesList.summary: Watch the promo of Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hai where the residents of Modern Colony are thrilled to see Anita Bhabhi in her new avatar.

episodesList.title: A Complaint is Lodged Against Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Angoori asks Tiwari to visit Pauwa Baba and seek his help to have a child. Anita scolds Teeka and friends for eve-teasing girls. A girl named Suparna complains to Happu to take revenge on Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Takes a Vow Of Silence
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti asks Pauwa Baba to advise Tiwari to take a vow of silence. However, Tiwari learns about it. Happu arrives to arrest Vibhuti, who tells Happu that he will get Tiwari to testify in his favour.

episodesList.title: An Agitation Against Vibhuti In Modern Colony
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti asks Tiwari to testify in favour of him, but Angoori reveals his vow of silence. The Modern colony residents agitate against Vibhuti. Later, he confesses about tricking Tiwari before Angoori.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Gets Renamed As Bulbul
episodesList.summary: Tiwari breaks his vow of silence and testifies in Vibhuti's favour. Ammaji renames Tiwari as Bulbul. Vibhuti pretends as Baba Hyderabadi and tells Saxena that his lover Bulbul's spirit is in the colony.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Gets Fed Up Of Saxena
episodesList.summary: Tiwari gets fed up of Saxena's behaviour. He visits Happu Singh with his problem. Later, Tiwari and Angoori try to find the truth by fooling Saxena. However, the truth surfaces and Vibhuti gets exposed.

episodesList.title: Shambhu Sapera Curses Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Shambhu Sapera, a snake charmer, asks Tiwari for something to feed his snakes but he insults him. At night, Vibhuti sees Tiwari behaving like a snake. Teeka and friends discuss about snake-stone.

episodesList.title: Angoori Looks For a Serpent With Special Powers
episodesList.summary: Tiwari, fearing the curse of Shambhu Sapera, behaves politely with Vibhuti. Ammaji asks Angoori to worship a serpent with special powers to save Tiwari. Angoori tells Vibhuti about it.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's New Act
episodesList.summary: Angoori tells Vibhuti about the curse of Shambhu Sapera. Vibhuti pretends to be a serpent before Angoori. Teeka and friends visit Vibhuti's house to acquire the Nagmani, but Vibhuti fools them.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Finds Vibhuti and Angoori Drinking Milk Together
episodesList.summary: Ammaji advises Angoori to befriend Vibhuti. Angoori lies to Tiwari and takes milk for Vibhuti. Tiwari gets confused on seeing them both drinking milk together. Vibhuti fools Teeka and friends again.

episodesList.title: Angoori Performs 'nagin' Dance With Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Tiwari tells Dr Gupta his problem. As advised by Ammaji, Angoori performs 'Nagin' dance with Vibhuti. This angers Tiwari and Angoori reveals the truth. Soon, even Vibhuti's pretence comes to an end.

episodesList.title: The News Of Anita's Surgery Frightens Tiwari
episodesList.summary: A doctor tells Vibhuti that Anita will have to undergo facial surgery. Vibhuti thinks about making some changes in Anita's face which makes Tiwari lash out at him. Saxena opposes Valentine's Day.

episodesList.title: Modern Colony Residents Celebrate Anita's Return
episodesList.summary: The bandage on Anita's face is removed and everyone is shocked to see her. Anita arrives at Modern colony with her new face and everyone celebrates her arrival. Saxena warns Teeka and friends again.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Sneaks Into Anita and Vibhuti's Room
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti behaves like a stranger with Anita, which angers her. Tiwari refuses to take Angoori to a restaurant on Valentine's Day. Later, he sneaks into Anita and Vibhuti's room for some unknown reason.

episodesList.title: Valentine's Day In Modern Colony
episodesList.summary: Anita behaves rudely Tiwari and later tells him the reason behind doing so. Happu arrests Teeka and friends. Tiwari celebrates Valentine's Day with Angoori and Vibhuti celebrates it with Anita.

episodesList.title: Anita Starts an Ngo
episodesList.summary: Anita starts an NGO and Vibhuti agrees to assist her as a lawyer. Ammaji suggests Tiwari a remedy to save Angoori from an impending danger. Later, Tiwari tortures Tillu.

episodesList.title: Anita Helps Tillu Get Justice
episodesList.summary: Anita assures Tillu of helping him. Angoori tells Ammaji about Tiwari's actions. Vibhuti decides to defend Tillu as his lawyer. Anita asks Tiwari to pay a compensation of INR 3 crores.

episodesList.title: The Court Of Modern Colony
episodesList.summary: Tiwari makes Angoori swear to hide the truth and hires Saxena as his lawyer. Commissioner and Masterji become the judges and an outrageous court proceeding of Modern Colony begins.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Decides to Fight Tiwari's Case
episodesList.summary: Saxena leaves advocacy. On seeing Angoori upset, Vibhuti decides to fight Tiwari's case. At Ammaji's insistence, Tiwari again tries to torture Tillu but Anita saves him.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Questions Render Tillu Unconscious
episodesList.summary: Anita and Vibhuti come face-to-face at the court. Tillu faints on hearing Vibhuti's questions. Tiwari tells Vibhuti about torturing Tillu. Angoori apprises Anita of this and the case gets dismissed.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Becomes a Security Guard
episodesList.summary: Anita tells Vibhuti to become a security guard for some thrill. The next day, Vibhuti arrives as Chowkidar Veer Singh and Anita hires him. Tillu and Malkhan eve-tease Teeka's twin sister, Tikli.

episodesList.title: David Suspects Veer Singh
episodesList.summary: Angoori recites a poem to Tiwari. Anita waits for Vibhuti but is unable to go to the room due to David and Helen. David suspects Veer Singh and Anita. Tillu and Malkhan apologise to Teeka.

episodesList.title: Veer Singh Breaks Tikli's Heart
episodesList.summary: Tiwari questions Anita about her and Veer Singh's closeness but Anita gives him a befitting reply. Veer tells Angoori that Vibhuti is the right partner for her. Later, Veer breaks Tikli's heart.

episodesList.title: Anita Lies About Veer Singh to Angoori
episodesList.summary: Tiwari takes Angoori to eat 'Pani Puri' with her and sees Anita with Veer Singh there. Anita tells Angoori that she is taking Veer's help to make Vibhuti feel jealous. Angoori asks Anita for her help.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Gets Upset to See Angoori With Veer Singh
episodesList.summary: Angoori eats 'Pani Puri' with Veer Singh to make Tiwari feel jealous. At night, an enraged Tiwari sets out to beat Veer Singh. Later, Teeka gets shocked after reading Tikli's letter.

episodesList.title: Angoori to Dance For Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Prem tells Vibhuti how to earn money by selling paintings. Prem tells Angoori that Vibhuti was a good painter during his college days. She decides to dance and inspire Vibhuti to paint again.

episodesList.title: Angoori's Dance Inspires Vibhuti to Paint
episodesList.summary: Angoori dances and Vibhuti makes her painting. Prem disguises as David's foreigner friend Tom and comes to buy it. Happu wears a buffalo's costume to arrest a gang while Tiwari searches for buffalo dung.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Makes a Painting For Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Tiwari asks Vibhuti to make a painting and Anita finalises the deal for INR 50,000. Angoori's dance inspires Vibhuti and he makes a painting. Prem, disguised as Tom, offers to buy it for INR 5 lakhs?

episodesList.title: Tiwari Dances For Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Teeka and friends ask Vibhuti to make a painting by paying him for it. Due to Angoori's foot sprain, Tiwari dances for Vibhuti, who then makes a painting. Tom sees the painting but refuses to buy it.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Learns About Prem and Vibhuti's Lies
episodesList.summary: Tiwari learns about Prem and Vibhuti's pretence. Later, Tiwari exposes Vibhuti with Tillu's help and Anita scolds Vibhuti. Dr Gupta asks Vibhuti to make a painting for him?

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Becomes a Guide
episodesList.summary: After Angoori tells Vibhuti about Raju guide, he pretends to be Raju guide. Tiwari struggles after incurring a loss in the stock market as well as his business.

episodesList.title: Tiwari's House to Become a Haunted House
episodesList.summary: After Prem tells Vibhuti about a British man who wants to see a haunted house, Vibhuti decides to dupe him by turning Tiwari’s house into a haunted bungalow.

episodesList.title: The Haunted Bungalow Brings In Big Money
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti brings a British man to see the haunted house, who gives him INR 50,000. An elderly man offers to give INR 5 Lakh to see a ghost.

episodesList.title: An Elderly Arrives to See a Ghost
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Angoori arrive to stay at Anita's house. Happu asks Teeka and friends to act like prisoners. An elderly man arrives to see a ghost.

episodesList.title: A Frightening Truth Of an Elderly Man
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Vibhuti learn the identity of the man in the bungalow. Ammaji suggests a superstitious remedy because of which Angoori cooks a spicy dish.

episodesList.title: Will Tiwari and Vibhuti's Friendship Land Them In Trouble?
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Vibhuti argue with their wives. The next day, Anita and Angoori's behaviour shocks them. Teeka and friends realise the importance of friendship.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Land In Big Trouble
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Vibhuti get restless when their wives do not return home. Later, Commissioner arrests Tiwari and Vibhuti. Saxena thrashes Teeka and friends.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Turns Angoori Against Anita
episodesList.summary: Anita and Angoori leave their husbands' home and go to a restaurant. Tiwari and Vibhuti devise a plan to turn Angoori against Anita.

episodesList.title: Dr Gupta's Shocking Lie
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and Tiwari get exposed when Anita and Angoori confront each other. Dr Gupta lies to Teeka. Later, Tiwari and Vibhuti execute another plan.

episodesList.title: Commissioner Exposes Tiwari and Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Commissioner exposes Tiwari and Vibhuti. Anita and Angoori tell their side of the story. Teeka and friends' friendship becomes an eye-opener for Saxena.

episodesList.title: Angoori's Eggplant Dish
episodesList.summary: Anita asks Angoori to cook for her investor. Unaware and revengeful, Vibhuti adds laxatives to the dish. The investor and Tiwari struggle after eating it.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Dream About Holi
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Vibhuti dream about applying colour to Anita and Angoori. Masterji beats up two boys. Anita and Angoori decide to test their husbands.

episodesList.title: Anita and Angoori's Plan Gets Foiled
episodesList.summary: Anita and Angoori threaten their husbands over a phone call. They ignore it because they think it's a prank. Teeka and friends collect donations.

episodesList.title: Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hai
episodesList.summary: The stone Anita throws at Tiwari hits her client. Anita and Angoori ask Teeka and friends to eve-tease them. However, the police arrive and arrest them.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Get Intoxicated
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Vibhuti cleverly feed each other ladoos laced with bhang. Later, they get intoxicated while all the Modern Colony residents play Holi.

episodesList.title: Anita and Angoori's Deceit
episodesList.summary: After Vibhuti assumes that Anita is cheating on him, she asks Angoori to pretend before Tiwari. Later, they reveal the truth in front of their husbands.

episodesList.title: Anita and Vibhuti's Child
episodesList.summary: After Anita's father calls and informs her about his expected arrival, Anita and Vibhuti introduce a doll as their child. Vibhuti hires Malkhan and Tillu.

episodesList.title: Anita's Father Danny Arrives Home
episodesList.summary: Angoori lashes out at Tiwari and says that she wants to be a mother. Anita's father declares that his grandson will be the heir to his property.

episodesList.title: Danny Learns About The Fake Infant
episodesList.summary: Anita throws the doll off the balcony during an argument with Vibhuti, and Danny learns about the fake infant. Tiwari feels glad to find out the truth.

episodesList.title: Danny Takes a Big Decision
episodesList.summary: To impress Danny, Tiwari ousts Vibhuti from his house. Anita and Danny argue over him. Later, Vibhuti is shocked to learn about Anita's engagement.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Rejects Danny's Wealth
episodesList.summary: The Modern Colony residents attend Danny's party wherein he announces Anita and Rahul's engagement. He later gives Vibhuti a blank cheque to test him. Vibhuti asks him for Anita instead of his wealth.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gets Accused Of Theft
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti asks Anita for INR 5 lakhs. At night, he sneaks into Tiwari's bedroom to win a bet against Tiwari. After Vibhuti leaves, a thief steals Angoori's necklace and Vibhuti gets accused of it.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Arrested On Charge Of Theft
episodesList.summary: Angoori and Tiwari visit Vibhuti's house with Commissioner. He arrests Vibhuti for stealing Angoori's necklace. In the police cell, Manohar gives Vibhuti electric shocks to extract the truth from him.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gets Traumatised
episodesList.summary: Manohar gets 'thief' tattooed on Vibhuti's hand, which traumatises him. Vibhuti gets released after the real thief is caught, but he fails to get out of the shock. Anita decides to get him treated.

episodesList.title: Everyone Pretend to be Thieves
episodesList.summary: Everyone pretend to be thieves to improve Vibhuti's mood. The Modern Colony residents organise a thief party and then Commissioner arrives there. Later, Vibhuti unveils a secret.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti, a Messiah Of The Poor
episodesList.summary: Angoori tells Vibhuti about Robinhood and he arrives as the messiah of the poor people. He sneaks into Tiwari's house and snatches his fritters. Later, he gives Teeka and friends the fritters to eat.

episodesList.title: Messiah Vibhuti Loots Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Angoori tells Vibhuti about the messiah of the poor. Later, Vibhuti visits Tiwari again, loots his INR 5,000 and runs away. He gives some money to Teeka and friends and they cheer for their messiah.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Loots Masterji
episodesList.summary: Angoori tells Vibhuti how much she likes a messiah of the poor. Prem gives Masterji INR 1 lakh to keep and Vibhuti, disguised as the messiah, loots the money. Tiwari hides money in his pyjamas.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Fears Getting Exposed
episodesList.summary: With Angoori's help, the messiah of the poor once again loots Tiwari. Anita tells Vibhuti about getting the messiah arrested, which frightens Vibhuti. Commissioner orders Happu to arrest the messiah.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Learns About The Messiah's Reality
episodesList.summary: Happu takes a bribe from the messiah of the poor and lets him go. Tiwari learns that Vibhuti is the messiah. He decides to teach Vibhuti a lesson and apprises this to Anita and Prem.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Becomes The Fake Messiah
episodesList.summary: Tiwari disguises as the messiah of the poor and beats Teeka and friends. Vibhuti challenges Tiwari for a fencing fight. Commissioner and Happu arrive there and both of them get exposed.

episodesList.title: How will Vibhuti Arrange Inr 1 Lakh?
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti goes to drop Anita at the airport, and they meet a man on the way. He tells them about his son, Daddy. Anita is in need of INR 1 lakh and Vibhuti begins a pretence.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Becomes Ghostbuster Daddy
episodesList.summary: Teeka and friends see Helen behaving like a witch and apprise Tiwari of this. Helen attacks Tiwari and Vibhuti saves her. Later, Vibhuti refers to himself as Ghostbuster Daddy.

episodesList.title: Daddy's Remedy For Tiwari's Condition
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti, disguised as Daddy, proves that Tiwari has got an upset stomach because of a witch and asks for INR 25,000 to improve his condition. Teeka and friends see a witch and ask Daddy for help.

episodesList.title: Teeka and Friends Marry a Witch
episodesList.summary: Daddy promises the witch Laura to get her married to Teeka and friends. Later, he fulfills his promise. Dr Gupta threatens Vibhuti. Soon, Daddy begins Tiwari's treatment.

episodesList.title: Angoori Fakes Her Death
episodesList.summary: Daddy asks Tiwari to dance. Happu asks Vibhuti for a bribe and Dr. Gupta tells everybody about Vibhuti's pretence. Later, Angoori fakes her death and Vibhuti blurts out the truth.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Becomes a Doctor
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti gets a fake certificate with Prem's help and becomes an anger management doctor. Angoori agrees to work with him. Vibhuti invites Teeka and friends to his centre for treatment.

episodesList.title: Angoori is Furious With Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Ammaji asks Tiwari to always be close to Angoori. At Vibhuti's advice, Angoori vents out her anger on Tiwari. Vibhuti helps Teeka and friends control their temper.

episodesList.title: Angoori Throws Tiwari Out
episodesList.summary: After being ousted by Angoori, Tiwari sleeps with Vibhuti. First Angoori and then Teeka and friends vent out their anger on Happu. Tiwari bribes Happu to forgive Angoori for her actions.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Fakes His Death
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti imagines a dance with Angoori. David tells Tiwari that Vibhuti has not completed any course. To frighten Vibhuti, Tiwari takes Angoori's help and fakes his own death.

episodesList.title: Happu's and Tiwari's Corpses
episodesList.summary: On seeing Tiwari's body, Vibhuti panics and calls Happu. But Happu also joins Angoori's plan and pretends to be dead. When Vibhuti reveals the truth to Angoori, she ends her pretence.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Learns Classical Music
episodesList.summary: Angoori tells Vibhuti how much she likes classical music. Vibhuti visits Pandit Suresh Shastri to learn classical music. Two months later, Angoori gets impressed on seeing Vibhuti singing a 'bandish'.

episodesList.title: Can Vibhuti Make It Rain?
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti gets Teeka and friends to do the household chores in exchange for giving them music lessons. They ask Vibhuti to make it rain and prove himself. But, Vibhuti, lands in trouble due to the shortage of a water tanker.

episodesList.title: Bhoorey's Request to Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti succeeds in making it rain with his song, shocking everyone. Bhoorey asks Vibhuti to make it rain in his fields. Pandit Suresh Shastri promises Vibhuti to teach him the music to seduce girls.

episodesList.title: Angoori Slaps Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Angoori slaps Vibhuti when he sings raga 'Patau'. Pandit Suresh Shastri points out Vibhuti's mistake. Later, Vibhuti wins Tiwari's heart. Ammaji tells Tiwari to be careful of his neighbours.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Makes Tiwari Dance
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti assures Bhoorey that he will help him if he brings Tiwari to his house. When Tiwari arrives, Vibhuti threatens him with a dagger and forces him to dance. Tiwari complains to Happu about Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Devesh’s Ploy to Kill Indresh
episodesList.summary: Everybody’s condition at the resort begins to deteriorate after having the food. Devesh asks the employees to kill Indresh in exchange for money. Swati tries to help everyone and looks for Indresh.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti In The Guise Of a Woman
episodesList.summary: Angoori ignores Tiwari to teach him a lesson. Later, Ammaji asks Angoori to help Tiwari have an affair with someone else. At Angoori's request, Vibhuti disguises as a woman and arrives before Tiwari.

episodesList.title: Meena Tries to Woo Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti disguises himself as a woman and introduces himself to Tiwarias Meena. Tiwari takes her home and Meena tries to woo him but fails.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Learns About Meena
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti apologises to Angoori for being unable to woo Tiwari. Vibhuti tells Angoori his next plan and Tiwari overhears it. Meena reveals her secret to Commissioner when he tries to flirt with her.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Falls In Love With Meena
episodesList.summary: Tiwari pretends to have fallen for Meena. Later, he makes people sing songs for her across a road. Tiwari takes out Meena's wig and exposes Vibhuti. Angoori reveals the whole matter to everyone.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Disguises As an Electrician
episodesList.summary: Tiwari asks the commissioner to help him get a gun license, but a shock due to Tiwari's doorbell annoys the latter. Vibhuti starts working as an electrician and arrives to fix Tiwari's doorbell.

episodesList.title: Pandit Ramphal's Birthday
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti steals electricity while fixing the bell of Tiwari's house. Ammaji asks Tiwari to make arrangements for Pandit Ramphal's birthday. Vibhuti is given the task of lighting the house.

episodesList.title: Ramlal's Dangerous Plan
episodesList.summary: The commissioner visits Tiwari and gets electrocuted again. Everyone attends Pandit Ramphal's birthday party. Teeka and his friends overhear Ramlal, the shop's real owner, hatching a plan.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Develops Electrophobia
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti gets electrocuted in the process of saving Pandit Ramphal. Dr Gupta tells everyone that Vibhuti has electrophobia. Later, Vibhuti begins to stay away from electrical appliances.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Beats Manohar In Jail
episodesList.summary: At Tiwari's insistence, Happu arrests Vibhuti. At the police station, Vibhuti has a fit and thrashes Manohar. Tiwari improves Vibhuti's condition using the help of Teeka and friends.

episodesList.title: Saxena's Birthday Party
episodesList.summary: Saxena organises his birthday party at a luxurious hotel. He asks Tota, the manager, to incite all the guests into fighting with each other. Later, they both get busy poisoning everyone's ears.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Taunts Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti taunts Tiwari. Later, Vibhuti and Anita spend some quality time. Saxena tells Teeka and friends that one of them will have to sleep under a tree. Tota provokes Ammaji against Helen.

episodesList.title: Ammaji and Helen Trouble Others
episodesList.summary: Helen arrives to sleep in Vibhuti and Anita's room. Meanwhile, Ammaji enters Tiwari's room. Anita confides in Tiwari about her problem. Saxena turns Tiwari and Vibhuti against each other.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Lashes Out At Ammaji
episodesList.summary: Saxena feels glad as Tiwari and Vibhuti fight. Anita and Angoori try to reconcile Helen and Ammaji. Tiwari lashes out at Ammaji when she enters his room. Teeka and friends fight with each other.

episodesList.title: Angoori and Anita's Fight
episodesList.summary: A fight breaks out between Angoori and Anita. Later, Tiwari and Vibhuti try unsuccessfully to pacify their angry wives. Meanwhile, Saxena escalates the fight between Teeka and the friends.

episodesList.title: Saxena Tells Everyone The Truth
episodesList.summary: Saxena tells everyone that he incited everyone into fighting with each other and they thrash him. Later, they leave the hotel and return home. Anita gets mad at Vibhuti for being unemployed.

episodesList.title: Teeka to Disguise As Vibhuti's Wife
episodesList.summary: Anita asks Tiwari to pay her electricity bill. A sage advises Vibhuti to make a female friend his wife for a few days. Vibhuti asks Teeka to disguise as his wife.

episodesList.title: Angoori Suspects Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Angoori sees Vibhuti with Teeka and follows them. She later informs Tiwari that Vibhuti has a second wife. Tiwari goes there and records Teeka and Vibhuti's conversation on his phone.

episodesList.title: Anita Chooses Prem As Her Husband
episodesList.summary: Tiwari shows a disguised Teeka and Vibhuti's pictures to Anita, which breaks her heart. She later asks Tiwari to bring Prem to pretend to be her second husband.

episodesList.title: Anita and Prem's Pretence
episodesList.summary: Anita requests Prem to do a pretence with her to teach Vibhuti a lesson. Angoori sees them together and informs Vibhuti about Anita's infidelity. Later, Vibhuti reveals the truth to everyone.

episodesList.title: Tiwari, Vibhuti and Prem Become Waiters
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti, Tiwari and Prem gamble with Madam Noori at a hotel club. She later gets them to become waiters when they lose at gambling. Saxena arrives at the hotel with Dr Gupta.

episodesList.title: Angoori and Anita At The Hotel
episodesList.summary: The news of Anita and Angoori's expected arrival frightens Tiwari and Vibhuti, and they disguise themselves. Later, they pick up Anita and Angoori's luggage. Teeka and friends arrive at the hotel.

episodesList.title: Teeka and Friends to Live Like Camels
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Vibhuti flirt with Anita and Angoori while roaming around in a disguise. Saxena, disguised as Sheikh, meets Teeka and friends as their future father-in-law and asks them to live like camels.

episodesList.title: Anita and Angoori Learn The Truth
episodesList.summary: Angoori and Anita learn about Tiwari and Vibhuti's state. Later, they both deliberately trouble their husbands. Meanwhile, Saxena asks Teeka and friends to dance like a camel.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Get Freedom
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Vibhuti apprise Angoori and Anita of their state. Anita and Angoori defeat Noori while gambling and set Tiwari and Vibhuti free. Teeka and friends learn that Sheikh is Saxena.

episodesList.title: The Plan to Please Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: When Anita tells Vibhuti that he is insensitive, his blood pressure shoots up quickly. Dr Gupta asks everyone to please Vibhuti. Tiwari pretends to be oversensitive in front of Anita and Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Everyone Entertains Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: After hearing Tiwari, Vibhuti starts behaving strangely. The residents of Modern Colony entertain Vibhuti by sharing some jokes. Anita asks Tiwari to control his emotions.

episodesList.title: Dr Gupta's Advice
episodesList.summary: Anita and Vibhuti visit Tiwari's house for dinner. Vibhuti suffers a stroke due to Tiwari's words. Tiwari overhears Anita saying that she likes funny people. Dr Gupta asks everyone to hurt Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Laughter Troubles Anita
episodesList.summary: Tiwari shares a joke that makes Vibhuti laugh for a long time. Vibhuti's state increases Anita's problems. Meanwhile, Saxena tells Vibhuti about his life after his birth.

episodesList.title: Angoori Locks Tiwari In The Bathroom
episodesList.summary: Angoori locks Tiwari in the bathroom before Vibhuti and Anita arrive at their home for a feast. Vibhuti tells Prem about his pretence and Anita overhears them. Later, she pretends to leave the house.

episodesList.title: Angoori's Strange Dream
episodesList.summary: Angoori narrates her strange dream to Vibhuti. Saxena tells Anita that she has put too many restrictions on Vibhuti. Later, Teeka and friends start a new job of putting everyone to sleep.

episodesList.title: Anita Visits Tiwari With a 'rakhi'
episodesList.summary: Anita visits Tiwari with a 'rakhi' and he gets scared. Vibhuti breaks the clock that was gifted by Anita. Teeka and friends put Dr Gupta to sleep by reciting their lullaby.

episodesList.title: Ammaji's New Remedy
episodesList.summary: Ammaji suggests a superstitious remedy to help Tiwari get sound sleep. Angoori tells Vibhuti that she needs a man whose wife beats him. Tiwari seeks help from Teeka and friends.

episodesList.title: Tiwari's Insomnia
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti's every attempt to instigate Anita to beat him fails. Anita vents out her anger on Saxena. Teeka and friends fall asleep during their struggle to put Tiwari to sleep.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Finally Falls Asleep
episodesList.summary: Angoori calls Prem for help but Vibhuti asks him to leave. Anita introduces Tiwari to Kinshuk Tiwari, which clears Tiwari's misunderstanding. Soon, Tiwari falls asleep and Vibhuti's plan goes awry.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Plan to Cheat People
episodesList.summary: Anita starts an NGO to keep people away from superstition. Vibhuti, along with Dr Gupta, hatches a plan to cheat people. Prem adulterates Teeka's meal, which gives him a stomach ache.

episodesList.title: Malkhan Falls Prey to Vibhuti's Plan
episodesList.summary: Angoori inaugurates Vibhuti's alternative therapy centre. Teeka visits Vibhuti for his stomach ache and gets cured. Later, Malkhan develops a stomach ache on eating the fritters given by Dr Gupta.

episodesList.title: The Commissioner's Warning to Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Anita and Tiwari protest against Vibhuti. Prem adulterates Tiwari's food and he has an upset stomach. After Anita and Tiwari's complaint, the commissioner gives Vibhuti a final warning.

episodesList.title: Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hai
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti treats Tiwari's illness, which angers Anita. Tillu's stomach hurts and he visits Vibhuti. Later, Prem adulterates the commissioner's food and he has an upset stomach.

episodesList.title: Anita Exposes Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Anita threatens Dr Gupta and he reveals the whole truth to her. Vibhuti falls for Anita's plan and tells everyone about his fake therapy. Teeka and friends beat Vibhuti for not treating Teeka.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Misunderstands Anita
episodesList.summary: Angoori tells Vibhuti that she loves rain. Anita talks to her friend on the phone and Vibhuti misunderstands her. He shares his grief with Angoori. Tiwari lies to Anita for money.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Umbrella Selling Business
episodesList.summary: Angoori gives Vibhuti INR 2 lakh and he starts a business of umbrella. Tiwari asks Angoori for that money. Teeka and friends request Vibhuti to entrust them the job of selling umbrellas.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Business In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Anita asks Tiwari for her money. Khashedu, Vibhuti's jinxed friend, brings bad news. Teeka and friends trick Masterji into buying an umbrella. Choubey refuses to take back the umbrellas from Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Trick to Sell Umbrellas
episodesList.summary: Tiwari lashes out at Angoori for doing business with Vibhuti. Vibhuti learns that the money Angoori gave him belongs to Anita. Vibhuti comes up with a trick to sell umbrellas and Teeka executes it.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Buys Umbrellas From Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti fools Prem and sells the umbrellas to him. The commissioner learns about it. At Vibhuti's request, Tiwari buys all the umbrellas. Anita reveals the truth behind her decision to divorce Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Anita Sees Chhaavi Jholkar's Spirit
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti disturbs Angoori and Tiwari while they worship their ancestors. Anita visits Chhaavi Jholkar. a renowned 'Lavani' dancer and sees her spirit there. Teeka and friends make a decision.

episodesList.title: Anita Meets Tiwari In Person
episodesList.summary: Anita talks in Marathi and slaps Vibhuti. Later, Tiwari meets Anita in person. Angoori gets angry on seeing Tiwari dancing with Anita. Consequently, Angoori asks Vibhuti to dance with her.

episodesList.title: Anita Wishes to Marry Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Angoori dances with Vibhuti to make Tiwari jealous. Chhaavi Jholkar, mistaking Tiwari for Ganpat, talks about marrying him. Vibhuti gives Teeka and friends a perfume to make Anita smell it.

episodesList.title: Chhaavi Meets The Real Ganpat
episodesList.summary: Tiwari tries unsuccessfully to make Anita smell the perfume. Chhaavi's spirit leaves Anita's body upon meeting the real Ganpat. Teeka and friends visit Tiwari for dinner, where Tillu tries to steal.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Becomes a Pilot
episodesList.summary: Tiwari learns that Anita loves pilots and comes in front of her in a pilot's uniform. Pelu asks Vibhuti to drive his rickshaw. Teeka and his friends promise Rusa that they will help her get a job.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Becomes a Rickshaw Driver
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti tells Anita that he will drive a rickshaw and later uses it to drop Angoori. Teeka and friends see Tiwari sleeping in the bushes. The trio promises Rusa to help her become an air hostess.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gets Insulted At Tiwari's Party
episodesList.summary: Anita learns about the 'Best Wife' competition. Manohar issues a challan to Vibhuti's rickshaw. Everyone insults Vibhuti at the party at Tiwari's house. However, Bhoorey encourages Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Saxena Reveals Tiwari's Secret to Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Bhoorey's arrival delights Angoori. A few of Anita's students ask Tiwari some questions related to flying a plane. Saxena tells Vibhuti that Tiwari is not a pilot. Later, Tiwari interviews Rusa.

episodesList.title: Tiwari's Secret Comes to Light
episodesList.summary: Angoori gets upset with Tiwari for not taking her on a plane tour. Along with Anita and the Modern Colony residents, Vibhuti hatches a ploy and exposes Tiwari. Later, Anita pacifies Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Uncontrollable Hands
episodesList.summary: Tiwari tells Angoori that the license of his shop is fake. Vibhuti faints due to Anita's taunts and fails to control his hands after regaining consciousness. The commissioner later gets a threat call.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Blows Angoori a Kiss
episodesList.summary: Unable to control his hands, Vibhuti blows a kiss to Angoori. Tiwari seeks help from the commissioner to get the license. He later decides to get help through the commissioner's sister-in-law, Rusa.

episodesList.title: Teeka Becomes Tiwari's Brother
episodesList.summary: Tiwari explains his plan to Teeka and they prove to the commissioner that they are brothers. The commissioner visits Tiwari's house with Rusa's marriage proposal. Soon, Anita comes there with Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Throws Food At The Commissioner
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti conceals his hands and his appearance shocks everyone. When his hands are released, he throws food at the commissioner and breaks Ammaji’s vase. Tiwari invites Anita to Teeka’s engagement.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Recovers Due to a Bomb Blast
episodesList.summary: Everyone attends Teeka and Rusa's engagement. Vibhuti arrives there and finds a bomb. He takes it away and gets injured when the bomb explodes. However, his illness is cured due to this.

episodesList.title: Saxena's Weather Channel
episodesList.summary: Saxena provides weather forecasts through a TV channel. Tiwari and Vibhuti spend some quality time with their wives. Later, Anita lashes out at Tiwari. Prem tells Tiwari and Vibhuti about a sage.

episodesList.title: Sage Mausami Chatterjee's Remedy
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and Tiwari meet sage Mausami Chatterjee and he advises them to sleep in the open. They later deliberately quarrel with their wives to be able to sleep outside. However, they feel cold outside.

episodesList.title: The Weather Troubles Modern Colony
episodesList.summary: The condition of Tiwari, Vibhuti and the other people of Modern Colony worsens due to the cold. Tiwari and Vibhuti ask sage Mausami to change the weather. However, extreme heat troubles everyone.

episodesList.title: A Storm Hits Kanpur
episodesList.summary: Troubled by the heat, Tiwari and Vibhuti request sage Mausami to change the weather again and it starts raining. Later, another request from them leads to a storm in Kanpur.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Return Home
episodesList.summary: Despite heavy storm, Tiwari and Vibhuti do not go inside the house. Ammaji and Helen forcibly bring Tiwari and Vibhuti inside. Later, Tiwari and Vibhuti learn that sage Mausami is a fraud.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Becomes a Landlord
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti's actions nearly render him and Anita homeless. Ammaji asks Tiwari to oppress the people by becoming a landlord. Tiwari changes his attire and hires Tillu and Malkhan.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Enslaves Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti borrows INR five lakh from Tiwari. Tiwari enslaves Vibhuti in exchange for money. Later, Vibhuti serves Tiwari, who romances Angoori in front of him.

episodesList.title: Angoori Gets Vibhuti Thrashed
episodesList.summary: Tiwari, the landlord, takes Anita in a rickshaw to drop her at her grooming class. Tillu beats Vibhuti at Angoori's behest. Later, Tillu whips Masterji and Dr Gupta too. Soon, Bhoorey visits Angoori.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Misbehaves With Anita
episodesList.summary: Tiwari eve-teases Anita. Vibhuti goes to confront Tiwari, who asks him to prepare Anita for a dance performance. Despite Vibhuti's opposition, Anita decides to dance.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Abducts Angoori
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti arrives as a rebel and abducts Angoori. The commissioner arrests Tiwari, while Vibhuti surrenders to the police. Ammaji arrives there and discloses the truth.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Gets Thrashed
episodesList.summary: Angoori and Anita cosy up to Tiwari and Vibhuti, but both run away. Ammaji beats Tiwari when Angoori complains about it. Later, Tiwari romances Angoori in Vibhuti's presence.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Angoori Romance In The Open
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti tells Anita about Tiwari's romantic actions. Tiwari and Angoori cosy up before the couple. Later, Vibhuti and Anita visit Tiwari's house for dinner. Vibhuti takes a medicine from Dr Gupta.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Spikes Tiwari’s Drink
episodesList.summary: Anita complains to Helen about Vibhuti, but she takes his side. Vibhuti spikes Tiwari’s drink, after which he gets a bad breath. Anita again tries to get romantic with Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Tiwari's Counter-attack Against Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: The odour from Tiwari's mouth bothers the Modern Colony residents. He visits Dr Gupta, who gives him the same medicine that Vibhuti had given him. Later, a disguised Tiwari feeds it to Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Anita Gets Angry At Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti's mouth stinks and he grasps the whole matter. Anita scolds Tiwari for feeding the medicine to Vibhuti. Influenced by Masterji, Vibhuti questions the purpose of his existence in the world.

episodesList.title: Presidential Candidate Saxena
episodesList.summary: Saxena tells everyone that he is contesting for the president of Modern Colony. For their personal interest, Tiwari and Vibhuti promise to support Saxena and campaign for him.

episodesList.title: Saxena Becomes The President
episodesList.summary: The Modern Colony residents celebrate Saxena's victory. Saxena announces the implication of stricter laws in Modern Colony, which shocks everyone. Later, Teeka falls prey to the new law.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Get Whipped
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Vibhuti get whipped by Saxena's recruit for breaking the rules. Later, Tiwari and Vibhuti land in trouble again after talking to Anita and Angoori. Tillu gets thrashed for talking to Rusa.

episodesList.title: Modern Colony Residents Beat Saxena
episodesList.summary: Saxena forces the men of Modern Colony to wear a veil. All the men, including Tiwari and Vibhuti, walk around donning a veil. Later, everyone beats Saxena after getting fed up with him.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Sells Energy Pills to Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Angoori confides in Ammaji about her marital troubles. Prem hires Vibhuti, Teeka and the others to sell energy pills. Anita expresses her dislike for Vibhuti’s job. Tiwari buys the pills from Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Suffers a Heart Attack
episodesList.summary: Tiwari suffers a heart attack due to a loss in his business. Vibhuti disguises as a woman to indulge in some gambling with Prem. The commissioner raids the club and Vibhuti lands in trouble.

episodesList.title: Tiwari's Pretence For The Insurance Money
episodesList.summary: Anita visits the police station and Vibhuti discloses that he is disguised as a woman. Tiwari pretends to be ill to get the insurance money. Vinod, an insurance agent, visits Tiwari's house.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Efforts to Treat Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Insurance agent Vinod reveals that Tiwari will get the money if he doesn't get well within a week. A disguised Vibhuti teases Anita to treat Tiwari. Later, he spreads the false news of Ammaji's death.

episodesList.title: Angoori Romances Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: At Vibhuti's advice, Angoori dances in front of Tiwari, who gets up from the wheelchair when she romances Vibhuti and tells everyone that he was pretending. Saxena gives a warning to everyone.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Tiwari Get Jailed
episodesList.summary: Saxena writes a book called 'Nari Shastra'. After reading it, Tiwari and Vibhuti misbehave with Anita and Angoori. Consequently, both end up in jail and Saxena explains the reason behind writing it.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti to Groom Teeka and His Friends
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti challenges Anita that he will groom Teeka and his friends. Ammaji asks Angoori to go to the market wearing a gold chain. Soon, Dr Gupta gets robbed. Later, Vibhuti comes up with an idea.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Robs Angoori
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti robs Angoori's gold chain. The commissioner asks Happu to stop the robberies. David tells Vibhuti that he is bringing a lot of gold. Vibhuti gets scared on seeing Tiwari with a knife.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Flees Leaving Angoori In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti beats Tiwari to save Angoori. Later, he goes to the market with Angoori, but runs away as soon as Teeka and his friends arrive to rob Angoori. Later, Angoori gets angry at Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Happu's Plan Lands Him In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Anita promises Angoori that she will protect her. A masked Vibhuti robs David. Happu devises a plan to catch the thieves. Later, he gets beaten up by Anita while trying to rob Angoori's chain.

episodesList.title: Anita Reveals a Shocking Truth
episodesList.summary: After David's complaint, Happu arrests Vibhuti and Teeka and friends. Anita tells Happu that they were committing robberies at her behest. The Gulzar gang asks Teeka and friends a few questions.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Tiwari Attend Saxena's Show
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Vibhuti attend Saxena's TV show. Both their views on extra-marital affairs shock Angoori and Anita. Meanwhile, Teeka and his friends start a detective agency to impress the commissioner.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Suspects Anita
episodesList.summary: Anita and Angoori decide to teach Vibhuti and Tiwari a lesson, and Anita seeks help from Kamesh Gupta. Teeka and friends blackmail Vibhuti and Tiwari. Later, Anita plants doubts in Vibhuti's mind.

episodesList.title: The Misadventures Of Manmohan and Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Tiwari suspects Angoori. Anita and Angoori pretend to have affairs with Kamesh. Soon, Tiwari and Vibhuti ask Teeka and his friends to spy on their wives, but they thrash them both.

episodesList.title: The Misadventures Of Manmohan and Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Vibhuti question their wives about betraying them. Vibhuti tells Angoori and Tiwari tells Anita about the deceit by their wives. The commissioner catches Teeka and friends spying.

episodesList.title: Anita and Angoori On Saxena's Show
episodesList.summary: Anita and Angoori share their views on Saxena's TV show. Later, Tiwari and Vibhuti learn that their wives have left the city. Anita and Angoori tell everyone about their pretence.

episodesList.title: Teeka and His Friends Get Rich
episodesList.summary: Teeka and his friends inform the Modern Colony residents about winning a lottery. Tiwari suffers losses in business and thinks about taking their help. Later, he invites them to his house for dinner.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Polishes Teeka's Shoes
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti polishes Teeka's shoes for INR five lakh and Anita sees this. Tiwari asks for INR 50 lakh from Teeka and his friends when they visit him. Later, Tiwari and Vibhuti serve Teeka and his friends.

episodesList.title: Teeka and His Friends Fight Over Rusa
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and Tiwari lie to Anita and Angoori about working at Teeka and his friends' house. Teeka and his friends ask the commissioner for Rusa's hand in marriage. The trio gets into a fight over Rusa.

episodesList.title: Teeka and Friends' Strange Condition
episodesList.summary: Teeka and friends ask Tiwari and Vibhuti to drink liquor from their shoes. Anita and Angoori reveal that they have not won any lottery. Tillu lies to take a leave but Tiwari learns the truth.

episodesList.title: Angoori's Cyber ​​cafe
episodesList.summary: Angoori faints while working. Tiwari starts a cyber cafe for Angoori on Dr Gupta's advice. Vibhuti asks Angoori for a job at her cyber cafe. Later, Happu arrests Teeka and friends.

episodesList.title: Teeka and Friends Seek Revenge From Happu
episodesList.summary: Tiwari refuses to give Vibhuti a job. Manohar tells Happu that Teeka and friends are innocent. Teeka and friends decide to take revenge on Happu. Later, the trio visits Angoori's cyber cafe.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Seeks Help From Hacker Saxena
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti learns that Saxena is a hacker and seeks his help. Later, he teaches Angoori a few things about computers. Manohar reads out the comments on the internet against Happu to the commissioner.

episodesList.title: Tiwari's Comments Anger Anita
episodesList.summary: Anita gets angry with Tiwari's comments on her video. Saxena again hacks Tiwari's account and comments on Anita's video. The commissioner orders Happu to look for Amar, Akbar and Anthony.

episodesList.title: Happu Finds The Real Conspirator
episodesList.summary: Happu takes Saxena and Vibhuti to the police station and beats them up. Later, he raids Angoori's cyber cafe and finds the real conspirator. Happu also informs Anita about Vibhuti's wrongdoings.

episodesList.title: Who will Play Lord Ram's Character?
episodesList.summary: The announcement of Ramlila in Modern Colony takes place. Angoori and Anita ask Tiwari and Vibhuti to play Lord Ram. Saxena says that he will give marks to everyone according to their conduct.

episodesList.title: Saxena Reveals Everyone's Scores
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti, disguised as God, asks Angoori to forbid Tiwari from playing Lord Ram's character. Tiwari too turns Anita against Vibhuti. Saxena tells everyone their scores according to their conduct.

episodesList.title: Angoori and Anita's Ploy
episodesList.summary: Angoori and Anita deliberately get Tiwari's and Vibhuti's marks deducted. Tiwari implicates Tillu in a theft case to get his marks deducted. Angoori narrates her problem to Vibhuti and seeks his help.

episodesList.title: Anita Discerns Tiwari's Trick
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti implicates Tiwari in a case of theft. Tiwari instigates Anita and she fights with Vibhuti. Later, both of them realise Tiwari's trick. Vibhuti again visits Angoori in the guise of God.

episodesList.title: Saxena Announces The Winner
episodesList.summary: Tiwari likes his neighbour, Vibhutis ultramodern wife, Anita, and Vibhuti likes Tiwaris simple wife, Angoori. Their quest to impress each others wives often leads to hilarious situations.

episodesList.title: Saxena's Views On Divorce
episodesList.summary: Anita and Angoori argue with Vibhuti and Tiwari. Saxena tells the four of them that after 10 years of marriage, couples usually get divorced. Teeka and friends ask Masterji for a loan.

episodesList.title: Teeka Poses As a Divorced Woman
episodesList.summary: Anita and Angoori avoid arguments with their husbands. Angoori lashes out at Vibhuti. Teeka poses as a helpless woman and Saxena gives him some money. Prem recovers money from Teeka and friends.

episodesList.title: Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hai! - October 20, 2021
episodesList.summary: Tiwari likes his neighbour, Vibhutis ultramodern wife, Anita, and Vibhuti likes Tiwaris simple wife, Angoori. Their quest to impress each others wives often leads to hilarious situations.

episodesList.title: Kalavati's Advice to Angoori and Anita
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti daydreams about dancing with Angoori. Kalavati, a columnist, gives a piece of advice to Angoori and Anita. Tiwari and Angoori get into an argument. Later, Tillu extracts money from Saxena.

episodesList.title: Teeka and Friends Fall For Saxena's Trick
episodesList.summary: Anita and Vibhuti get into a fight and Anita throws away Vibhuti's radio. Teeka and friends fall for Saxena's trick and visit him posing as women. Tiwari and Angoori celebrate 'Karva Chauth'.

episodesList.title: Angoori Vs Tiwari
episodesList.summary: As per Angoori and Tiwari's bet, Tiwari does the household chores. Angoori, who is handling Tiwari's shop, tells Vibhuti that she has to earn INR 1.5 lakhs to win. Vibhuti lies to Masterji for money.

episodesList.title: The Misadventures Of Manmohan and Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Anita laughs at Tiwari who is washing clothes. A disguised Vibhuti visits Angoori's shop and buys goods worth INR 25,000. Later, Ammaji and Angoori are shocked to see the burnt rotis made by Tiwari.

episodesList.title: A Disguised Vibhuti Visits Angoori's Shop
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti hides the innerwear bought from Angoori under the bed, and Anita asks him to romance under the bed. He, disguised as a woman, buys goods worth INR 50,000 from Angoori. Teeka saves Saxena.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Takes On a Disguise to Help Angoori
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti borrows money from Prem by lying to him to help Angoori. He visits Angoori's shop in a sheikh's disguise and this time buys goods worth INR 75,000. Tillu and Malkhan pacify Teeka.

episodesList.title: The Misadventures Of Manmohan and Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti asks David to sell a few innerwear. To celebrate Angoori's victory, a party is held at her house and Vibhuti gets exposed. However, everyone praises him for helping Angoori.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti's Cleanliness Drive
episodesList.summary: Angoori and Anita ask Tiwari and Vibhuti to clean the house. Tiwari helps Anita clean her house. Even Vibhuti cleans Angoori's house. Rusa makes a demand to Teeka and friends.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Cleaning Agency
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Vibhuti get fed up while cleaning the house. Vibhuti starts a cleaning agency with Teeka and friends and they use a disguise to clean Angoori's house. Tiwari tells Anita about the agency.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Lashes Out At Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti sends Teeka and friends to Anita's house for cleaning, and cleans Angoori's house himself. An upset Tiwari lashes out at Vibhuti. David gets Teeka and friends to do his personal work.

episodesList.title: Ammaji Ousts Tiwari From The House
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti gives a letter to Angoori. After reading it, Angoori feels that Tiwari is having an affair with someone. Ammaji beats Tiwari and throws him out of the house. Rusa scolds Teeka and friends.

episodesList.title: Diwali In The Modern Colony
episodesList.summary: Tiwari sings a song at night, which disturbs Anita and Vibhuti's sleep. Later, he brings the truth of Vibhuti's cleaning agency to the fore. The residents of Modern Colony celebrate Diwali together.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Becomes a Recovery Agent
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti impresses the manager of Bank of Bhagoda. Tiwari tells Anita about borrowing a loan and throws liquor at Vibhuti. The manager assigns the task of recovery to Vibhuti, Teeka and friends.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Threatens Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti tells his family about his job. Tiwari tells Angoori that if he does not pay the bank installment, his house will be snatched away. Later, Vibhuti threatens Tiwari to extort money from him.

episodesList.title: Teeka and Friends Threaten The Commissioner
episodesList.summary: Tiwari informs Anita about Vibhuti's threat. The commissioner wears an outfit given by Teeka and friends, and everyone laughs at him. He gets the trio arrested and later they threaten him.

episodesList.title: Angoori's Request to Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Anita asks Vibhuti to be soft on Tiwari. Even Angoori asks Vibhuti to help Tiwari and then goes to watch a film with him. Teeka and friends look for Tiwari after the duration of 24 hours is over.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gets Arrested
episodesList.summary: Teeka and friends thrash Tiwari for not repaying the loan. Happu arrests Vibhuti for molesting Angoori. Vibhuti gets released from jail by promising to quit his job. Later, Anita tells him the truth.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Sees Bela Donna's Spirit
episodesList.summary: Tiwari overhears Vibhuti boasting about his bravery to Angoori. At Tiwari and the others' insistence, Vibhuti spends the night in the graveyard. Vibhuti is horrified to see Bella Donna's spirit.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti is Possessed By Bela Donna's Spirit
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti disguises as Bela Donna and his behaviour scares Tiwari. The next day, Vibhuti's behaviour turns normal. Teeka and friends tell Happu about Vibhuti being possessed by Bela Donna's spirit.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Romances With Bela Donna
episodesList.summary: Happu visits Vibhuti's house and gets scared on seeing Bela Donna. Tiwari has a few drinks with Teeka and friends and Bela Donna talks to Angoori. Later, Tiwari inadvertently romances with Bela Donna.

episodesList.title: Bela Attacks Tantreshwar
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Angoori inform Anita about Bela Donna. Angoori brings Maharaj Tantreshwar to Anita's house and he questions Bela Donna about her motive. Soon, Bela Donna attacks Tantreshwar.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti In Trouble Because Of Bela Donna
episodesList.summary: To escape Bela Donna, everyone locks themselves in jail. Tiwari learns that Bela Donna is alive and learns about Vibhuti's pretence. He beats Vibhuti, and Saxena reveals a secret.

episodesList.title: A Furious Angoori Arrives At Anita's House
episodesList.summary: Angoori gets offended by Tiwari's words during a quarrel and rushes to Anita's house. Vibhuti goes to Tiwari's home to fetch Angoori's belongings. The next day, Tiwari arrives to pick up Angoori.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Shows a Video to Angoori
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and Angoori cook together. Angoori misses Tiwari and doesn’t eat anything. Tiwari drinks alcohol with Teeka and Malkhan and Vibhuti records a video of him with a girl and shows it to Angoori.

episodesList.title: The Misadventures Of Manmohan and Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Tiwari tries to take Angoori away from Anita's house. When David and Helen arrive, Vibhuti sends them to Tiwari's house. Vibhuti, disguised as a hermit, tells Tiwari a way to bring his wife back.

episodesList.title: Angoori Overhears Tiwari’s Words
episodesList.summary: Tiwari makes a wish, while Angoori and Vibhuti overhear him. Later, Vibhuti instigates Angoori against Tiwari. For a monetary benefit, Prem agrees to thrash Vibhuti at Tiwari’s behest.

episodesList.title: The Misadventures Of Manmohan and Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Tiwari gets an idea due to David’s words. At Tiwari’s behest, Prem beats up Vibhuti and Anita retaliates against him. Anita and Vibhuti confront Tiwari. Later, Tiwari and Angoori patch up.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gets a Necklace For Anita
episodesList.summary: Anita tells Vibhuti to give her a special gift on their anniversary. Saxena tells Tillu and Malkhan about Kuber’s necklace. Vibhuti gets a necklace and gifts it to Anita, but she doesn’t like it.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gives a Necklace to Angoori
episodesList.summary: On hearing Angoori’s words, Vibhuti gives her a necklace which proves to be lucky for Tiwari. Tillu and Malkhan plan to steal it. Anita apologises to Vibhuti and asks him to return the necklace.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Steals The Necklace From Angoori
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti steals the necklace from Angoori. Angoori tells Tiwari about the theft. Later, Vibhuti lies to Anita when she asks for the necklace. Tillu and Malkhan steal the necklace and give it to Rusa.

episodesList.title: The Necklace Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: An upset Angoori tells Vibhuti that her necklace got stolen. Vibhuti tells Anita about the necklace’s magical powers and gets shocked as the necklace goes missing. Ammaji gives a solution to Tiwari.

episodesList.title: A Man Throws The Necklace Into a Well
episodesList.summary: Anita sees Angoori wearing the necklace and tells Vibhuti to steal it. Vibhuti goes to steal the necklace, but finds it missing. Later, the thief throws the necklace into a well.

episodesList.title: Tillu Falls For Munmun Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Angoori prepares for the arrival of Tiwari's cousin, Munmun. Anita ousts Vibhuti from the house. Tillu goes to pick up Munmun and falls in love with her. Later, even Vibhuti meets Munmun.

episodesList.title: Munmun Falls In Love With Tillu
episodesList.summary: Saxena recites his poems to Vibhuti at knifepoint. Tillu takes Munmun to get ice-cream for her. Teeka and Malkhan deliberately praise Tillu in Munmun's presence. Later, Munmun falls for Tillu.

episodesList.title: Tillu's Affluent Father Billu
episodesList.summary: Tiwari gets angry on seeing Munmun in Tillu's lap. Tillu narrates his ordeal to Vibhuti. A piece of news shocks Tiwari. Saxena tells him that Tillu is the son of Billu, an affluent businessman.

episodesList.title: The Misadventures Of Manmohan and Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti visits Tiwari posing as Tillu's father, Billu Chopra. Anita sees Vibhuti in Tiwari's bedroom and visits Tiwari's house in the middle of the night. Vibhuti, disguised as Billu, meets Anita.

episodesList.title: Ammaji Falls In Love With Billu
episodesList.summary: Anita lodges a missing complaint of Vibhuti. Ammaji tells Angoori that she is in love with Billu. Tiwari asks Billu to marry Ammaji. Later, Anita exposes Billu.

episodesList.title: Angoori to Sleep Outside a Temple
episodesList.summary: Ammaji tells Angoori to sleep outside Baba Phadaknath's temple for a month. Rusa advises Anita to treat her husband with love. Vibhuti fights with Anita and decides to go to Angoori.

episodesList.title: The Misadventures Of Manmohan and Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: A misunderstanding lands Tiwari in trouble. Vibhuti comes to live with Angoori when Anita throws him out of the house. Later, Ammaji tells Angoori that Tiwari needs to perform the Vedic remedy.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Regrets Returning Home
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti dreams about dancing with Angoori and later returns home. Angoori tells him that she is the one to do the superstitious remedy and Vibhuti regrets returning home. Anita scolds Tiwari.

episodesList.title: Angoori Gets Rid Of The Superstitious Remedy
episodesList.summary: Anita tells Vibhuti that love can happen at any age. Vibhuti goes to a temple to stay with Angoori, but Tiwari comes there. Angoori later reveals that she doesn't have to do the superstitious remedy.

episodesList.title: The Story When Teeka Went Missing
episodesList.summary: Bhoorey complains to Teeka that no one loves him. Teeka tells him how Tillu and Malkhan had once spread the news of him going missing and explains that the Modern Colony residents love him a lot.

episodesList.title: The Misadventures Of Manmohan and Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti winks at Angoori. Tiwari and Angoori then go to complain about it to Anita, but Vibhuti refuses to accept the allegation. When Vibhuti winks at Angoori again, she goes to complain to Happu.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Meets a Doctor
episodesList.summary: Happu arrives to arrest Vibhuti. It is proved that Vibhuti is really winking at Angoori. Vibhuti runs to the doctor for treatment. Later, he tells the commissioner about his illness.

episodesList.title: Dr Gupta Hides The Truth From Everyone
episodesList.summary: Dr Gupta does not reveal the truth when Saxena instigates him against Vibhuti. The Modern Colony residents protest against Vibhuti. He requests Dr Gupta for the truth, but a snake bites the latter.

episodesList.title: Angoori Winks At Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Prem secretly gives food to Vibhuti. Tiwari tries to get Anita and Vibhuti divorced with the help of lawyer Saxena. Dr. Gupta comes there and tells Anita the truth. Later, Angoori winks at Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: The Yphone 14 Fraud
episodesList.summary: Teeka and friends replace Angoori's slip to get a YPhone 14. Tiwari brings a YPhone 14 for Anita. Vibhuti puts that phone at Angoori's door. Later, Teeka and friends take it away to gift it to Rusa.

episodesList.title: Angoori's Promise to Everyone
episodesList.summary: Angoori contests for the post of 'President of Modern Colony'. She promises to give everyone jobs after becoming the President. Vibhuti vows to defeat his opponent, Bharadwaj.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Plans to Defeat Angoori
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti protests against Bhardwaj and gets thrashed. Later, Vibhuti learns that if Angoori wins, he will have to go to Mumbai for a job. He conspires Angoori's defeat along with Teeka and friends.

episodesList.title: A Conspiracy Against Angoori
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti, Teeka, and friends insult Tiwari to get him to stop Angoori from contesting at the election. Anita scolds Tiwari when he does so. Vibhuti and Tiwari disguise themselves and meet Angoori.

episodesList.title: Angoori is Arrested For Taking a Bribe
episodesList.summary: Happu arrests Angoori for taking a bribe. Tiwari and Vibhuti are exposed with the help of Anita's friend, and Anita scolds them. Later, Saxena tells everyone that the elections are cancelled.

episodesList.title: Angoori and Anita's Wishes
episodesList.summary: Angoori and Anita decide to go out for New Year's Eve with their husbands. Tiwari and Vibhuti convince them to stay at home. Later, Tiwari and Vibhuti devise a plan against each other.

episodesList.title: Mahamai's Shocking Revelation
episodesList.summary: Nandish's mother Mahamayi is overjoyed to find Adishesh's necklace. Shivani tells Trishul the truth about her illness. Later, Mahamayi recalls an incident from the past and reveals a shocking secret.

episodesList.title: Angoori's Dream About Mars
episodesList.summary: Angoori dreams that she is a resident of planet Mars. She tells Vibhuti about her dream. Anita advises Tiwari to praise Angoori. Teeka and friends prepare to disguise as aliens.

episodesList.title: The Misadventures Of Manmohan and Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti tells Angoori that he is an alien from Mars. He tells Anita not to help Tiwari. Later, Vibhuti gets Angoori to see Teeka and friends, who have been roaming around posing as aliens.

episodesList.title: Angoori Tells Tiwari About Her Pregnancy
episodesList.summary: Angoori tells Tiwari that she is pregnant, which upsets Vibhuti. Bhoorey recalls his son, Juttan, who was lost soon after he was born. Later, the midwife tells Helen that Vibhuti is not her son.

episodesList.title: Helen's Revelation Hurts Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Helen tells Vibhuti that he is not her son, which breaks his heart. Ammaji thinks of naming Angoori's child as Jummanphal. Later, Modern Colony residents attend Angoori's baby shower celebration.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Turns Out to be Angoori's Brother
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti tells everyone that he is not Helen's son. Bhoorey sees a birthmark and says that Vibhuti is his son, Juttan. David and Helen leave the house. Later, Angoori addresses Vibhuti as a brother.

episodesList.title: Angoori's Brother Vibhuti Takes Care Of Her
episodesList.summary: Anita tells Vibhuti that Helen and David have left the house. Bhoorey asks Vibhuti to take care of Angoori as her brother. Teeka and friends ask Prem for money to make arrangements for David's food.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Learns The Truth Behind The Mark
episodesList.summary: When the mark on Vibhuti's body disappears, he realises that he is not Bhoorey's son. Tiwari, David, Helen and Ammaji confess to planning it all. Later, Modern Colony residents celebrate 'Lohri'.

episodesList.title: The Misadventures Of Manmohan and Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Teeka and Malkhan bring Vibhuti home as he faints while watching a film. After regaining consciousness, he behaves like a character of the film 'Jewel Thief' and addresses Angoori as his lover, Mona.

episodesList.title: The Misadventures Of Manmohan and Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Angoori roams around in Mona's guise and Vibhuti asks her to dance. Anita lives like a house help. David tells Vibhuti that he is not the Jewel Thief. Vibhuti asks him to work as a servant too.

episodesList.title: The Misadventures Of Manmohan and Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti does not let Angoori go home. Angoori tells Ammaji that Tiwari is behind Vibhuti's condition. At Vibhuti's behest, Teeka and friends steal a pair of slippers, which belongs to Masterji.

episodesList.title: Masterji Learns About Vibhuti's Pretence
episodesList.summary: Along with Teeka and friends, Vibhuti executes a robbery at Tiwari's house. Later, Dr Gupta asks Vibhuti for money to lie about his illness and Masterji overhears it. Angoori talks about her problem.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Pretence Gets Exposed
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti tells Angoori that she can marry anyone but their relationship will remain. Tiwari visits Anita with his complaint, and Masterji tells them the truth. Later, Vibhuti's pretence is exposed.

episodesList.title: Angoori Finds Her Grandfather's Diary
episodesList.summary: Angoori finds her grandfather's diary while cleaning an old chest. At Ammaji's behest, Angoori reads the diary and gets engrossed in the tales about her grandma. A distraught Tiwari visits Anita.

episodesList.title: Angoori Thrashes Happu and Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Angoori hallucinates her grandpa. Tiwari is glad to meet Sunny Leona, the commissioner's British brother-in-law. Angoori beats Happu and Vibhuti mistaking them for British. Tiwari seeks Anita's help.

episodesList.title: Angoori Thrashes Sunny Leona
episodesList.summary: Tiwari likes his neighbour, Vibhutis ultramodern wife, Anita, and Vibhuti likes Tiwaris simple wife, Angoori. Their quest to impress each others wives often leads to hilarious situations.

episodesList.title: Angoori's 'mission Azadi'
episodesList.summary: Angoori refuses to pay taxes to Vibhuti and beats him. Later, she inspires the people of the chawl to fight for freedom. At Tiwari's behest, the commissioner comes home again with Sunny Leona.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Tampers With The Diary
episodesList.summary: Angoori beats Sunny Leona again. Tiwari and Vibhuti tamper with Angoori's diary and she forgets her whim about her grandfather. A goon runs away after beating Happu and Masterji lands in trouble.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Becomes a Donor
episodesList.summary: Ammaji asks Angoori to be a miser. David suddenly becomes poor. Baba Khare Khoteshwar advises Tiwari to become a donor. Vibhuti plans to extract money from Tiwari for David.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and David Become Beggars
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and David become beggars to extract money from Tiwari. Teeka and Tillu are upset when Angoori refuses to give food. Anita instructs them to catch the beggars and shares her plan with Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Asks Tiwari For Inr 9 Lakh
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and David ask Tiwari for a gold chain, and he gives Angoori's chain. Anita lashes out at Tiwari after seeing him give money to a beggar. Later, Vibhuti and David ask Tiwari for INR 9 lakh.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and David Get Exposed
episodesList.summary: Ammaji hits Vibhuti and David when they ask her for alms. They feel happy to receive money from Tiwari. Vibhuti and David reveal their true identities to everyone when Teeka and Tillu thrash them.

episodesList.title: It is Important to Get Vaccinated
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and Tiwari tell Rusa their plan against Teeka and friends, who avoid taking the vaccine. Later, Rusa invites Teeka, Tillu, and Malkhan to meet one by one and gets them all vaccinated.

episodesList.title: Angoori is Criticised
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti promises Angoori to take her to the movies. Later, he learns that she wishes to dine out. Vibhuti initiates a ploy. Tiwari doesn’t take Angoori out for dinner because she is not modern.

episodesList.title: Angoori's Modern Avatar
episodesList.summary: Anita Chides Tiwari and tells him that he would give Angoori a make-over. Angoori’s modern avatar angers Tiwari. Later, Ammaji arrives in her modern avatar as well, and David fawns over her.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Plan Backfires
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti borrows money from Prem to take Angoori and Ammaji to a five-star hotel, but ends up washing utensils to pay the bill. Later, Teeka arrives at Tiwari’s house disguised as Hukum Batata.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Worries About Angoori's Friends
