title: Devon Ke Dev...Mahadev
summary: Devon Ke Dev… Mahadev (transl.  Lord of the Lords… Mahadev), often abbreviated as DKDM, is a series based on Mahadev, one of the main deities of Hinduism. It premiered on 18 December 2011, airing Monday to Friday nights on Life OK. The 820-episode series concluded on 14 December 2014. The entire series has been made available on Disney+ Hotstar and Hulu.
plot:
The show's plot revolves around the story of Lord Shiva, which follows his journey from being an ascetic to a family man.
During the creation of the world according to Lord Vishnu and Lord Brahma, Adi Parashakti leaves Shiva from his Ardhanarishvara form. In order to shape the universe, she takes various births to marry Shiva but fails 106 times due to which Shiva becomes an ascetic. Hence Lord Brahma suggests his mind-born son Prajapati Daksh to please Adi Shakti and request her to incarnate as his daughter.
Adi Parashakti is born the 107th time as Daksh's daughter Sati. Meanwhile, Shiva cuts off Brahma's fifth head making Daksh hate him. Sati falls for Shiva and finally marries him, much to Daksh's dismay. Hence, Daksh humiliates Shiva in front of Sati in his yagna. Unable to tolerate her husband's insult, Sati sacrifices her life once again. An infuriated Shiva orders Virabhadra to behead Daksh. Later, he revives him at Prasuti's request and goes into deep meditation for centuries.
Adi Parashakti then is born as Parvati the 108th time as the daughter of Himavan and his wife Menavati. She is aware of her divinity as are her parents, and grows up in Dadichi's hermitage. From an early age, she starts addressing Mahadev/Shiva as her husband which Menavati, as a concerned mother, dislikes strongly.
When she grows up, Parvati tries to make Mahadev realize that she is none other than his wife Sati reincarnated. But he rejects her and in the process, turns Kamadev into ashes. As a result, Kama's distraught wife, Rati curses Parvati.
Parvati then agrees to marry as per her mother, Menavati's wish. However eventually Parvati and Himavan make Menavati realise who Parvati is, after which she gives in. Parvati goes on to meditate for 3,000 years to please Mahadev to marry her. And finally, Mahadev and Parvati are married. Later, Mahadev imparts some tantric knowledge to Parvati that helps her to take various forms like Nav Durga; Mahavidyas (Kali, Tara, Tripura Sundari, Bhuvaneshvari, Tripura Bhairavi, Chhinnamasta, Dhumavati, Bagalamukhi, Matangi and Kamala) and Matrikas to destroy Raktabeej, Shumbha Nishumbha, Chanda Munda, Durgmasura, Arunasura, Banasura, etc.

episodesList.title: Daksh Punishes Sati
episodesList.summary: Sati, who is the daughter of Prajapati Daksh, finds a rudraksh while drawing water from river along with her sisters. Prajapati Daksh, an opposer of Lord Shiv, dares to place Vishnu's incomplete idol in the temple. Prajapati Daksh performs Narayani Yagna to please Lord Vishnu as the statue was not entering the temple. Sati loses her way while collecting Parijat flowers in the forest. Sati gets visions of the solution for the statue enterting the temple in Rishi Dadhichi's ashram, whom she meets while finding her way back home. Accordingly, Sati places Shiv's idol in the incomplete Vishnu's statue and the statue enters the temple. Sati becomes emotional when she sees Lord Shiv for the first time.

episodesList.title: Sati’s punishment
episodesList.summary: When Shiva reveals himself in all his glory, Prajapati Daksh mocks him and claims he is superior. Shiva vows to destroy his arrogance. Daksh turns on Sati and blames her for the dishonour Shiva caused him. He asks her to choose between obedience to her father and her devotion to Shiva.

episodesList.title: Sati vows to keep her word
episodesList.summary: After announcing punishment for Sati, Prajapati Daksh decides to punish the sculptor who made the shivaling. He is unmoved even as his wife Prasuti pleads in Sati’s favour. Sati’s sisters are concerned that she may not be able to fulfil the conditions of her punishment.

episodesList.title: Sati's wish
episodesList.summary: Sati has to travel far to gather one lakh lotuses and write Vishnu’s name on them as part of her punishment. Meanwhile, the sculptors gather to beg Daksh’s forgiveness but he expels all of them from his kingdom. Saddened, they turn to leave, when Maharishi Dadichi arrives in the royal court.

episodesList.title: Daksh expels the sculptors
episodesList.summary: Maharishi Dadhichi asks Prajapati Daksh not to be so cruel towards the sculptors. But Daksh asks him not to interfere in a king’s decisions. At this point, an exhausted Sati returns to the palace and faints. Is Prajapati Daksh moved by his daughter’s condition?

episodesList.title: Sati is exhausted
episodesList.summary: Sati’s sister Khyati pleads with Saptarishi Bhrigu to stop her father from punishing Sati further. Prasuti also tries to make Daksh change his mind. But the Prajapati vows revenge on Shiva for using Sati to humiliate him. Meanwhile, Sati has a vision that leaves her mesmerised.

episodesList.title: Shiva's presence attracts Sati's attention
episodesList.summary: Seeing Shiva's aura,Sati wakes up from a dream clueless about the hidden significance of it. A perplexed Sati shares about her dream with Aaditi unable to hide her curiosity. As Sati describes about seeing a faint picture of an Ardhanarishvara, Aaditi calms her down. On the other hand, King Daksh hides his emotions for his daughter behind his traits of being a Prajapati. While in search of lotuses, Sati meets the sculptor community and fails to avert the strong presence of Shiva.

episodesList.title: Shiva reveals himself again
episodesList.summary: Narad Muni arrives in the court of Prajapati Daksh, just as he announces that his literature will completely ignore Shiva. Narad Muni asks Sati about including Shiva in her father’s Vishnu sculpture. Sati says it was a mistake. Narad then leaves for Kailash, where Shiva is in deep meditation.

episodesList.title: Narad Muni comes to Daksh’s court
episodesList.summary: Narad conveys the news from Daksh’s court to Shiva. Shiva is aware of Narad’s plan and says he cannot be tied down by Grihastha. Narad leaves, telling Nandi that Sati will change all that. Sati, meanwhile, is still troubled by the visions of Ardhanarishwara and decides to forego her sleep.

episodesList.title: Shiva's explanation
episodesList.summary: Sati is trapped in a forest during a storm. Thoughts of Shiva continue to trouble her. Agitated, she demands that Shiva should stop occupying her thoughts and declares that she will not let him conquer her or her father. She returns to the palace and vows to finish her task.

episodesList.title: Shiva occupies Sati’s thoughts
episodesList.summary: Sati stays at her task and everyone is concerned as her condition deteriorates. She refuses to give up, and Prajapati Daksh boasts that his daughter will always uphold his principles. When Sati completes her task, Daksh gets a terrible shock. It is not Vishnu’s name that is written on the flowers.

episodesList.title: Daksh gets a terrible shock
episodesList.summary: Sati begs her father’s forgiveness for Shiva’s name on the lotuses and asks him to give her a harsher punishment. But he forgives her and asks her to take over the arrangements of the spring festival. Then, Nandi appears and worships Sati. What will happen if Prajapati Daksh sees him?

episodesList.title: Daksh forgives Sati
episodesList.summary: Daksh is angry when he sees Nandi worshipping Sati. She, too, is surprised to learn that Nandi is Lord Shiva's vehicle. In Kailash, Nandi describes Devi Sati to Shiva. He tells Nandi about his Vairagya and that the Grihastha’s life is not for him.

episodesList.title: Nandi tells Shiva about Sati
episodesList.summary: Sati weeps before her father and wonders why Nandi and Shiva are pursuing her. Daksh tells her she must never fear anything, because she is the daughter of the all-powerful Prajapati. He decides to show her how even the five elements obey him.

episodesList.title: Daksh flaunts his powers
episodesList.summary: Daksh convinces Sati that Shiva and his followers have been using her to try and get to the Prajapati, because he is all-powerful. Meanwhile in Kailash, Kan and Pret criticise Nandi for having brought the lotuses with Shiva’s name on them. Then, Sati finds a lotus in the palace garden.

episodesList.title: Sati is convinced
episodesList.summary: Narad Muni reports to Shiva about the events in Prajapati Daksh’s kingdom. Daksh is planning a gathering of the Mahasabha and wants Chandrama to be present. Chandrama’s father Rishi Atri agrees that he should go. What role will Chandrama play in the union of Shiva and Sati?

episodesList.title: Daksh summons Chandrama
episodesList.summary: Daksh announces his desire to destroy Shiva. In Kailash, Nandi goes running to tell Shiva that the sculptor community, descendants of Vishwakarma, have been thrown out by Daksh. Shiva gives them shelter. The sculptors thank Shiva but ask if he would protect Sati, too.

episodesList.title: Shiva shelters the sculptors
episodesList.summary: Daksh punishes the sculptor and his family. Laxmi is upset with Daksh for the punishment he has given Sati. Sati's sister expresses her concern about Sati fulfilling her promise.

episodesList.title: Daksh invites Shiva
episodesList.summary: Daksh announces his decision to invite Shiva to his Mahayagna. In Kailash, Nandi is distressed that every spring season, Shiva retires to the cremation grounds and goes into the ‘samadhi’ state. Narad Muni then explains to him why Shiva does what he does.

episodesList.title: Shiva is angry
episodesList.summary: Narad Muni tells Nandi about Shakti’s connection to Shiva’s Samadhi state. Nandi wants to know if they will be reunited and Narad Muni assures him it will all be revealed in time. But Shiva fumes when Nandi asks him about Sati.

episodesList.title: Attempts to bring Shiva to earth
episodesList.summary: Narad Muni decides that it’s time for Shiva and Sati to meet. He creates a situation by singing so badly that a group of singers who are travelling to the Spring Festival lose consciousness. Narad then calls Shiva to come and save them. Will Shiva oblige?

episodesList.title: The spell of Mahadev’s music
episodesList.summary: Mahadev arrives on earth and sings a raga that revives the group of singers. Sati, who has gone to fetch water for the yagna, also hears the song and begins to dance. When Mahadev sees her stand before him, he vanishes. Narad Muni says his singing was for the betterment of the universe.

episodesList.title: Is Sati in love?
episodesList.summary: When Sati returns to the palace, the singers speak about the magic of Mahadev’s music. Sati confesses that it has had a great effect on her. Meanwhile, dancer Madanike is invited for the Vasant Utsav. She takes one look at Sati and makes a surprising deduction.

episodesList.title: Mahadev is invited to the yagna
episodesList.summary: Madanike insists that Sati has fallen in love, which Sati denies. Meanwhile, Rishi Dadhichi reaches Kailash and extends an invitation for Daksh’s yagna. Mahadev turns him down, saying he has no need for the ways of Mahamandals. Will the rishis be able to change his mind?

episodesList.title: Shukracharya is displeased
episodesList.summary: Mahadev agrees to go to the Mahamandal and tells the rishis he will be entirely responsible for its outcome. Angered that Mahadev is attending the yagna, Shukracharya vows to take on the deities. Narad Muni asks Mahadev not to go to Daksh’s court. But Mahadev has an answer for him.

episodesList.title: The Vasant Utsav begins
episodesList.summary: Placing his faith in Vishnu, Daksh assures the gods that he will protect them from Shukracharya’s army of asuras. Daksh asks Chandrama to ensure that the Vasant Utsav goes off well. In Kailash, Mahadev is again displeased with Nandi for talking about Sati.

episodesList.title: Madanike warns Sati
episodesList.summary: The Asuras decide to attack the gods if the Mahamandal goes against them. During the Vasant Utsav, Sati sings the same melody she heard Mahadev sing in the forest. Madanike learns about Sati’s feelings and warns her of the consequences.

episodesList.title: Sati won't act on her feelings
episodesList.summary: Madanike tells Sati that her love for Mahadev will be disastrous. Sati assures her that she knows the enmity between her father and Mahadev and will not do anything to make it worse. Meanwhile, Shilaad wants to take Nandi with him and Mahadev agrees, but Nandi does not want to leave Mahadev.

episodesList.title: Madanike is a Shiva bhakt
episodesList.summary: Nandi leaves Mahadev against his will. Shilaad comes back to Mahadev to tell him of Nandi’s condition. In Daksh’s palace, Sati is surprised to see Madanike worshipping a Shivaling. Madanike praises Mahadev’s virtues and speaks of her worries for Sati, who is caught between Daksh and Mahadev.

episodesList.title: Mahadev brings Nandi back
episodesList.summary: Mahadev makes Nandi special by ensuring that devotees will henceforth whisper their prayers in his ears and he will convey them to Mahadev. In Daksh’s palace, while Revati complains to her mother about being unhappy in her marriage to Chandrama, Sati sets out to go with Madanike to fetch colours.

episodesList.title: Sati and Madanike are separated
episodesList.summary: Madanike sees a bad omen and doesn’t want to take Sati with her to Rangraj. When they are alone, Sati again tells her that she has no place for Shiva in her heart. But a storm separates them while they are walking through the forest. Prasuti then sends out a search party for Sati.

episodesList.title: Shiva saves Sati in the storm
episodesList.summary: At the time when two seasons meet, the demon Vrittasura unleashes a terrible storm and Sati, who is separated from Madanike, is caught in it. That is when Shiva himself comes to protect Sati from Vrittasura. Rishi Dadhichi and the sculptors also witness the magnificent power of Mahadev.

episodesList.title: Sati has a change of heart
episodesList.summary: While Shiva is deep in trance, he is troubled by thoughts of Sati. She too is lost in Mahadev’s thoughts. Sati looks forward to the Mahamandal, longing to see Mahadev. Meanwhile, Indra tells Daksh that Shukracharya and his army is heading for the Mahamandal.

episodesList.title: Mahadev’s charisma sweeps off Sati’s heart
episodesList.summary: Smeared with ash, draped in animal hide, sitting atop a rock in the shamshan and drinking bhang (Mahadev’s Prasad), Mahadev is absorbed in his meditation amongst the Aghori ascetics. Narad Muni instigates Nandi to question Mahadev about bringing Devi Sati to Kailash. Withdrawn from the complexities of life, Mahadev smirks at Nandi’s question thinking about Sati, leaving behind the materialistic life for Kailash. On the other hand, Sati falls for Mahadev and confesses her love before Madanike.

episodesList.title: Sati decides to meet Mahadev
episodesList.summary: Fearing the results of her love for Mahadev, Madanike scolds Sati. Sati says she cannot help her feelings for Shiva. Although worried, Madanike agrees to stand by her side. Rishi Dadhichi prepares a special place for Mahadev in the Mahamandal. Restless to meet Shiva again, Sati heads for Kailash.

episodesList.title: Shiva rejects Sati
episodesList.summary: Shiva is angry when he sees Sati in Kailash and forces her to return. Sati goes back saddened that he has refused her love. Meanwhile, Shukracharya believes that Shiva is on the side of the gods since he is going to the Mahamandal and he prepares his army for war.

episodesList.title: Mahadev arrives for the Mahamandal meeting
episodesList.summary: Undeterred by Mahadev's rejection, Sati ascertains Madanike about bringing the Mahayogi out of his Vairagya. Preparing for Shaalimar and Tulsi's marriage, enamoured by Mahadev's love, Sati sees Shivaling in place of Shaalimar. Shukracharya questions Prajapati Daksh about inviting Lord Shiva in the Mahamandal. True to his words given to Maharishi Dadhichi, Mahadev embarks his presense in the Mahamandal meeting. But, as soon he advances towards his seat, Daksh gets his seat demolished.

episodesList.title: Daksh humiliates Mahadev
episodesList.summary: As Mahadev approaches his seat, Daksh has it pulled away and destroyed. He continues to insult Shiva. He declares that Shiva’s Vairagya is against the principles of his reign. He then unleashes a terrible curse on Mahadev. It angers Shukracharya, who declares vengeance for the insult to Mahadev.

episodesList.title: Mahadev reiterates his feelings
episodesList.summary: Mahadev is unaffected by Daksh’s curse that no one in his kingdom will worship him. Daksh sends written instructions to Sati and leaves for Brahma Lok. Sati is torn between her devotion for Mahadev and her loyalty to her parents. Later, Madanike asks her a question that leaves her speechless.

episodesList.title: Sati is torn
episodesList.summary: Just as Sati prepares to open her heart to her father, she is shocked by his letter, in which he threatens to go to any length to keep Mahadev out of her life. In Kailash, Narad Muni asks Mahadev why he does not accept Sati, with whom he has been united since the beginning of time. What is Mahadev’s answer?

episodesList.title: Prasuti's advice
episodesList.summary: Deeply upset, Sati tries to understand her mother’s feelings about her devotion to Mahadev. In Brahma Lok, Brahma tells his son Daksh that the union between Shiva and Sati has already been decided. But an arrogant Daksh vows to change that destiny with his powers.

episodesList.title: Sati wants answers
episodesList.summary: Sati’s love for Mahadev keeps growing. She decides to seek out Rishi Dadhichi, who led her to Mahadev in the first place, and ask him to explain to her what is happening in her life. The Rishi tells her the moment for her to accept her destiny has come. The Rudraksha she first found holds the key.

episodesList.title: Sati finds her answers
episodesList.summary: Rishi Dadhichi asks Sati to touch the Shivaling which will end all the conflict in her mind. She obeys and finds that all her doubts and questions are answered. Brahma goes to Mahadev and asks him not to punish Sati for Daksh’s mistakes.

episodesList.title: Mahadev and Sati dance together
episodesList.summary: Prasuti scolds Madanike for encouraging Sati’s devotion to Mahadev. Sati decides to dance until Mahadev joins her. They dance in union, before he disappears. When Daksh arrives on the scene, Sati is still dancing for Mahadev. Sati later faints.

episodesList.title: Sati becomes unconscious
episodesList.summary: Sati faints on an image of Shiva drawn with colours. Daksh is furious and blames Madanike for everything and decides to punish him. In Kailash, Narad Muni continues with his efforts to make Mahadev accept Sati. Meanwhile, Rishi Kashyap makes a terrible prediction.

episodesList.title: Sati enters the Yoga Nidra state
episodesList.summary: Rishi Kashyap informs Daksh that Sati has entered the Yoga Nidra state, after she and Mahadev danced together. He says she can only be awakened by Mahadev’s touch. Daksh refuses the solution and announces that he will give half his kingdom and powers to anyone who can awaken Sati.

episodesList.title: Sati’s condition gets worse
episodesList.summary: Rishi Dadhichi and Kashyap find Mahadev in Yoga Nidra Samadhi. Nandi warns of trouble if they attempt to wake him. The Rishis are confused about what to do with Mahadev. Meanwhile, Daksh summons the Navagrahas, the nine planets, to awaken Sati; will they be successful?

episodesList.title: Daksh decides to revive Sati
episodesList.summary: Sati begins to show signs of slipping into Chir Yoga Nidra, from which she can never wake up. An arrogant Daksh believes he can revive Sati and begins to summon all his powers. Meanwhile, Mahadev emerges from his Samadhi and comes to Sati.

episodesList.title: Shiva's advice to Sati
episodesList.summary: Sati is woken by Mahadev’s touch and is overjoyed to see him. But he asks her not to go against her father’s wishes. Sati explains to her mother that Shiva had only come to save Daksh from losing his kingdom. Prasuti responds angrily and asks Sati to first throw Shiva out of her heart.

episodesList.title: Madanike leaves the palace
episodesList.summary: Prasuti accuses Madanike of being disloyal to the family. Daksh also says that what she’s done cannot be pardoned. Sati manages to hand over the Shivaling to Madanike and pleads with her parents to stop Madanike from leaving. But they are unmoved.

title: Chidiya Ghar
summary: Chidiya Ghar (Hindi pronunciation: [t͡ʃɪ.ɽɪ.jɑː ɡʱəɾ]; transl. Zoo) is a sitcom which aired on Sony SAB from 28 November 2011 to 2 October 2017. The series was produced by Ashwni Dhir under the banner of Garima Productions. The show gets its name "Chidiya Ghar" because Chidiya Ghar means "zoo" in Hindi as all the characters in this show have animal names of the hindi language.
plot:
Chidiya Ghar is a house in Banaras named after Mrs. Chidiya Kesari Narayan, late wife of retired principal, Shri Kesari Narayan. The story is about Kesari, his sons, Ghotak and Gomukh their respective wives, Koyal and Mayuri, younger son Kapi and his wife Chuhiya, grandchildren Gillu, Gaj, Machar, Makhi and daughter Maina, son-in-law Totaram, sister Billo, servant Gadha Prasad, his wife Naagin/Markati and brother Mendak Prasad. Their names resemble animals and each individual bears some animal's characteristic and Kesari always teaches them a lesson being helpful in the future, after passing the problems of the same lessons. Their colony was named "Chidiya Ghar" in the honor of Kesari Narayan's contributions. It consists of Deemak Chacha, Girgit Mausi, her husband Bhed Vajpayee, their daughter Titli, her lover Tommy and his friend Puppy.
Through this show, Kesari Narayan i.e. Baabuji of Chidiya Ghar teaches educational values which he calls "Sanskaar". Each story starts with Kesari teaching an idiom through his Chidiyaghar Pathshala, and an incident happens where the idiom comes true.

title: Akashadoothu
summary:
Akashadoothu is 2011 Malayalam language Television drama  produced by M.Renjith aired on Surya TV. It is a sequel to 1993 Indian Malayalam-language drama film Akashadoothu  directed by Sibi Malayil.The film tells the tale of a widow suffering from leukemia, the series takes off exactly 16 years after we saw the children going their separate ways after the funeral of their mother.
Malayalam actress Chippy plays the lead role of Meenu along with Veteran actors K.P.A.C. Lalitha, Sukumari, Vanitha Krishnachandran, Seema G. Nair, Prem Prakash, Jose Prakash plays the supporting roles.
plot: After the demise of Annie (Madhavi), the four children parts away and after sixteen years Meenu ( eldest daughter played by Chippy) tries to reunite with her younger brothers Tony, Rony and Monu. However things take an unexpected turn when they reunite.

title: Kuch Toh Log Kahenge
summary: Kuch Toh Log kahenge (transl.  People Will Say Something After All) is an Indian Hindi-language romantic comedy family drama television series which aired on Sony TV. It premiered on 3 October 2011 and ended on 28 March 2013. The series revolves around a team of doctors working at Dr. Kotnis General Hospital in Lucknow. The show was an official adaptation of the Pakistani television drama Dhoop Kinare.
plot:
Kuch Toh Log Kahenge is a love story that centers around the lives of doctors working at Dr. Kotnis General Hospital in Lucknow. The two main characters, Dr. Ashutosh Mathur and Dr. Malika Trehan, are former college friends and colleagues at the hospital. Dr. Ashutosh is portrayed as a serious and somewhat aloof individual due to past experiences that have left a mark on him emotionally. He is not inclined towards frivolity or enjoyment and maintains a strict demeanor in both his personal and professional life.
Dr. Malika, on the other hand, secretly carries feelings for Dr. Ashutosh, which she subtly hints at by mentioning she has been waiting for him for over a decade. Despite her affections, Dr. Ashutosh shows no interest in pursuing a romantic relationship with her, largely due to the age gap between them.
The story takes a turn with the introduction of Dr. Nidhi Verma, a young and vibrant intern at the hospital. Dr. Nidhi's lively and cheerful nature contrasts with Dr. Ashutosh's serious demeanor. As time goes on, they develop a unique camaraderie, and Dr. Ashutosh finds himself drawn to her, despite the significant age difference between them. However, Dr. Malika perceives this growing connection and becomes envious, leading her to make attempts to create obstacles between them.
Dr. Malika's efforts lead to Nidhi's dismissal from the hospital, a decision influenced by her fear of the blossoming relationship between Ashutosh and Nidhi. Amidst misunderstandings and challenges, the two main characters eventually confess their love for each other. The narrative further unfolds as they navigate societal norms and family dynamics to unite against the odds.
Parallel to the central romance, various subplots add depth to the storyline. Dr. Rangnath, an administrator at the hospital, navigates his feelings for Anji, Nidhi's childhood friend. Another subplot revolves around the intricate relationships between family members and acquaintances, as well as their emotional journeys.
Throughout the series, the characters face emotional dilemmas, personal growth, and external pressures, which contribute to the overall complexity of the narrative. Themes such as love, sacrifice, societal expectations, and personal aspirations are interwoven into the plot, creating a multi-dimensional portrayal of human experiences.
The story also touches on topics like family conflict, professional challenges, and the impact of past decisions on present circumstances. As the characters grapple with their emotions and relationships, they evolve individually and collectively.
The show portrays the evolution of Ashutosh and Nidhi's love story from its inception, through trials and tribulations, to eventual triumph. The narrative highlights the significance of love, understanding, and perseverance in the face of adversity.
As the series progresses, various characters' lives intertwine, bringing about resolutions to their respective conflicts. The show weaves together numerous narrative threads, ultimately culminating in a satisfying conclusion.
Kuch Toh Log Kahenge presents a tale of romance and human relationships that engages viewers with its emotional depth and relatable characters. Through its exploration of love, sacrifice, and personal growth, the series resonates with audiences and offers a reflection of the complexities of real-life relationships.
directedBy: Mandar Devasthali, Sachin Gokhale, Sharad Pandey & Rishi Mandial
writtenBy: Kamlesh Pandey, Dilip Jha & Archita Vishwas
network: Sony Entertainment Television India and Sony Entertainment Television Asia

episodesList.title: Meet Ashutosh and Nidhi
episodesList.summary: While Dr. Ashutosh relives a few memories of his childhood, Dr. Nidhi prays to God for the first time as her MBBS results are going to be out. What is written in their destinies?

episodesList.title: Ashutosh and Nidhis First Meeting
episodesList.summary: Nidhi and Ashutosh while driving their respective cars meet with a small accident. Nidhi starts making a fuss about it on the road and asks Ashutosh to accompany her to the police station. Like a gentleman, he gives Nidhi all the cash he has and leaves saying it is a matter of life and death.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Faces Trouble at Work
episodesList.summary: Nidhi concedes in front of Ashutosh that she was forced to be a part of the medical field and is fine if she gets fired from work. Ashutosh persuades her to prove her self and show interest in this profession. But, it seems Nidhi is having a tough time trying to follow the rules and regulations set by Doctor Ashutosh at the hospital.

episodesList.title: Nidhis Day at the Childrens Ward
episodesList.summary: At her first day at the Children's Ward, Nidhi comes across some unique and talented children. Even though it is a task to deal with the children, she easily manages to bond with them. However, her playful behavior towards the kids is criticized by Ashutosh.

episodesList.title: Anjali Meets Dr. Ranganth
episodesList.summary: Nidhi takes a patient to the ultrasound room without Doctor Ashutosh's consent. Mallika fumes in anger and mocks Nidhi. Anjali reaches the hospital to meet Nidhi and comes across Doctor Ranganath. Later, Nidhi and Dr. Ashutosh have a one on one conversation about Nidhi's behaviour at work.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Makes a Big Mistake
episodesList.summary: Anjali urges Nidhi to go to the pub and have a good time. Meanwhile, the intern doctors try to get in touch with Doctor Nidhi in order to inform her about her patient who is critical. Better late than never, she rushes to the hospital but it seems, God has something else in store for her. Ashutosh blasts at Nidhi for making such a big mistake.

episodesList.title: Shahenshah Is Out of Danger
episodesList.summary: Nidhi is disturbed as his patient, Shahenshah is critical. She decides to stay in the hospital the whole night and observe his condition. Next morning, Ashutosh wakes her up and asks her to go home and rest. He also finds Nidhi's earrings next to Shahenshah's bed and gives it to her. Is this the start of something new?

episodesList.title: Nidhi Talks About Ashutosh
episodesList.summary: Nidhi talks about Dr. Ashutosh to her best friend, Anji. She tells Anji how Ashutosh suggests her to rethink about her profession as it is a difficult one. Later, Nidhi also tells her how Ashutosh gave her the earring which had fallen out of her ear.

episodesList.title: Nidhis Big Decision
episodesList.summary: Ashutosh doesn't really like Nidhi's decision of opting out of her profession. He tells her that it is a big loss for him as he would lose a great doctor. When Nidhi is adamant about her decision, Ashutosh bids her a goodbye with a heavy heart.

episodesList.title: Patients Want Dr. Nidhi to Come Back
episodesList.summary: Anjali cheers up Nidhi and takes her out for shopping. She also gives some fashion tips to Nidhi urging her to purchase a Sari. Ashutosh, coincidentally, visits the same mall to purchase a tie. Moments later, Dr. Ranganath calls Dr. Ashutosh asking him to reach the hospital as fast as he could, as the kids are going on hunger strike. Reaching the hospital, he discovers that the kids want Dr. Nidhi to come back and that's the reason they are showing these tantrums.

episodesList.title: Doctors in a Fix
episodesList.summary: Doctor Ranganath reaches Nidhi's place and tries to convince her to come to the hospital. She refuses to tell him that she doesn't want to be a doctor. He doesn't give up and continues to convince her, but his efforts go in vain and he leaves. Nidhi is in a dilemma now. Back at the hospital, Mallika argues with Ashutosh over the kid's behavior.

episodesList.title: Shahenshah Meets With an Accident
episodesList.summary: Shahanshah runs away from the hospital in order to find Nidhi and convince her to come to the hospital. Unfortunately, he meets with an accident. Luckily, Nidhi finds him and immediately rushes him to the hospital. She informs the hospital officials to prepare the scan rooms. Mallika bugs out on seeing Nidhi in the Operation Theatre and asks her to leave. But Dr. Ashutosh grants her permission to stay in the room.

episodesList.title: Malika Is Hurt
episodesList.summary: When Malika asks Nidhi to leave the Operation Theatre as she is an outsider, Ashutosh goes against Malika and asks Nidhi to help them with the operation. Malika later expresses her displeasure saying she is hurt as Ashutosh chose Nidhi over her.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Is Overthinking
episodesList.summary: After seeing Ashutosh and Malika hugging each other, Nidhi is a little disturbed. She keeps overthinking about the scenario until Anji asks her to stop saying such things shouldn't be affecting her.

episodesList.title: Nidhis Friend Gets Hitched
episodesList.summary: Nidhi and Anji visit one of their friends for her wedding. After having a fun-filled day with her colleagues, Nidhi is surprised to spot Dr. Ashutosh in the wedding. While dancing in the Barat, Dr. Malika forces Dr. Ashutosh to join them.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Washes Ashutoshs Shirt
episodesList.summary: Nidhi mistakenly drops cold drink on Dr. Ashutosh's shirt. She later has to take the trouble of washing his shirt in a bathroom while he waits outside in the bedroom experiencing an awkward situation.

episodesList.title: Dr. Ashutosh Loses His Shoes
episodesList.summary: As per a ritual, the bride's sisters and friends hide the groom's shoes so that they get money or gifts in return. While picking up the groom's shoes, Nidhi and her friends pick up Ashutosh's shoes and he later has a hard time finding his shoes.

episodesList.title: Nidhis Car Is Towed
episodesList.summary: Nidhi's car is towed by the traffic cops as she had parked it in a no parking zone. She realizes that Ashutosh's shoes have gone with the car. Later, one of the ladies in the wedding asks Ashutosh to drop Nidhi to her place as her car is towed.

episodesList.title: Ashutosh Drives Nidhi Home
episodesList.summary: While in the car with Ashutosh, Nidhi asks Ashutosh to play some music. When Ashutosh tells her that he doesn't like music, Nidhi asks him to start enjoying life regardless of how old he is.

episodesList.title: Nidhi and Ashutosh Enjoy the Rain
episodesList.summary: On their way home, Nidhi asks Ashutosh to stop the car midway. She steps out to get drenched in the rain. Moments later, she pulls Dr. Ashutosh out of the car. Surprisingly, he enjoys the rain instead of getting angry on Nidhi.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Cancels a Trip for Dr. Ashutosh
episodesList.summary: After learning that Dr. Ashutosh has got a viral fever after getting drenched in the rain the previous night with her, Nidhi cannot stop blaming herself. She cancels her trip and returns home from the airport.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Goes to Meet Dr. Ashutosh
episodesList.summary: After canceling her Europe trip, Nidhi dresses up in a blue saree which is Ashutosh's favorite color and goes to see him. Seeing Nidhi's gestures, Anji tells her that she might be falling in love with Ashutosh.

episodesList.title: Ashutosh Talks to Nidhi About His Family
episodesList.summary: When Nidhi comes to see Ashutosh, they spend some quality time and Ashutosh even talks about his family, something he rarely does. When he gets too emotional, Nidhi supports him well and offers to make a nice cup of tea to light up his mood.

episodesList.title: Dr. Malika Is Insecure
episodesList.summary: When Dr. Malika comes to visit Ashutosh, she is insecure to see Nidhi at his house. She later tells Ashutosh that her family is concerned about her marriage and asks Ashutosh for an answer. Ashutosh makes it clear that he can never fall in love.

episodesList.title: Dr. Malika Apologizes to Ashutosh
episodesList.summary: Dr. Malika apologizes to Dr. Ashutosh for whatever she had said the previous day. She tells him that she wouldn't be happy unless he forgives her. She also asks him for a dinner date as proof that he has forgiven her.

episodesList.title: Dr. Nidhi Decides to Resume Her Internship
episodesList.summary: Dr. Nidhi makes up her mind to resume her internship at the hospital. When she reaches the hospital, she meets Dr. Malika who demotivates her and asks her to drop her plan of rejoining.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Is Restless
episodesList.summary: When Nidhi learns that Dr. Ashutosh has met with an accident, she rushes to meet him. Anji stops her and makes her realize that she has started falling for Ashutosh and that she should have some control over her feelings.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Is on Cloud Nine
episodesList.summary: After Nidhi tells Dr. Ashutosh that Dr. Malika has restricted her from rejoining the hospital, he says he would talk to Malika and that she can come back to the hospital. Seeing Ashutosh's gesture, Nidhi is so happy that she cannot keep calm.

episodesList.title: Anji Gives Nidhi a Silent Treatment
episodesList.summary: When Nidhi does not listen to Anji and goes to meet Dr. Ashutosh, Anji gets hurt. She decides to give Nidhi a silent treatment and avoids her. Meanwhile, everyone at the hospital gives Nidhi a warm welcome.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Is Furious
episodesList.summary: Expecting to accompany the senior surgeons in the operation theatre, Nidhi is furious when Dr. Malika orders her to update their patients' files. Later, she asks Nidhi to work in the night shift and continue doing the paperwork.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Cooks for Ashutosh
episodesList.summary: After knowing Ashutosh's favorite dish, Nidhi takes the trouble of cooking for him. Seeing Nidhi in the kitchen, Anji is surprised as she has never cooked anything on her own before.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Is Disappointed
episodesList.summary: Nidhi reaches Ashutosh's house after cooking his favourite food. Kaka tells her that Ashutosh has been upset lately as he unable to buy his dream house. When Kaka asks Ashutosh to attend the guest, he says he doesn't want to meet anyone. Disappointed, Nidhi leaves the food with a rose and a note for Ashutosh.

episodesList.title: Ashutosh Finds Nidhi's Food Spicy
episodesList.summary: After reading the note Nidhi had left behind, Ashutosh attacks on the food Nidhi had brought him. Taking the first bite, he realizes that the food is extremely spicy. Nonetheless, he finishes the entire bowl on his own.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Consoles Ashutosh
episodesList.summary: Nidhi goes to visit Ashutosh after work. Seeing his room messy, she asks him to control his anger. She also makes him understand that he shouldn't let his past affect his future. She gives him another rose and leaves.

episodesList.title: A Grand Welcome for Ashutosh
episodesList.summary: Ashutosh informs Nidhi that he is going to start coming to the hospital once again. Excited, Nidhi takes over the Children's Ward and decorates the entire space to welcome Ashutosh.

episodesList.title: Dr. Mallika Complains About Nidhi
episodesList.summary: Dr. Mallika complains about Nidhi to Dr. Ashutosh. When Nidhi tries to put her point in front of Ashutosh, he refuses to listen to her. Nidhi then goes to Dr. Mallika and tells her that she would neither leave the hospital nor Dr. Ashutosh.

episodesList.title: Dadi Bua Meets Dr. Ashutosh
episodesList.summary: Dr. Mallika urges Ashutosh to finish his work quickly as they have to leave for the medical camp. Surprisingly, Nidhis Dadi bua talks ill about Dr. Ashutosh to Dr. Ashutosh himself and later notifies Nidhi about it. Nidhi is worried now. Anjali tries to make her understand.

episodesList.title: Mallika Fights With Ashutosh
episodesList.summary: Anjali helps Nidhi in getting ready as she wishes to impress Dr. Ashutosh. Nidhi looks beautiful and receives a lot of compliments. Ashutosh also noticed her changed look. Mallika spots Nidhi in the hospital and bugs out. She meets Ashutosh and fights with him over Nidhi's topic.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Will Test Doctor Ashutosh
episodesList.summary: Nidhi is happy as Ashutosh noticed her hairstyle. Anjali is still adamant to keep the test in process. She reaches the mall to buy a shirt for Ashutosh and now she will test him, If he wears the shirt, it means he is also in love with Nidhi. Will Ashutosh be able to pass this love test?

episodesList.title: Nidhis Negligence Makes Ashutosh Angry
episodesList.summary: Ashutosh surprises Nidhi and the kids by showing up at the picnic spot. He also wears that shirt which NIdhi got for him. She shares this with Anjali happily. But Anjali asks her to still test him. Later, Ashutosh bugs out at Nidhi for her negligence. Mallika is sure to put Nidhi in a big trouble this time.

episodesList.title: Ashutosh Apologizes to Nidhi
episodesList.summary: Ashutosh blasts Nidhi. Dr. Ranganath informs Ashutosh that it's Nidhi's father's birthday. He feels guilty for scolding her on her happy day. He gives her a lift to her home. At home, everyone is anxiously waiting for Nidhi to come back. Ashutosh urges her to sit in his car as he wants to drop her home.

episodesList.title: Mallika Hates Nidhi
episodesList.summary: Mallika fumes in anger when she learns that Ashutosh was at Nidhi's home a night before and forgot to come over to Mallika's place for dinner. She asks Ashutosh to choose between her and Nidhi. Nidhi, on the other hand, is jumping with joy thinking about Ashutosh.

episodesList.title: Ashutoshs Perturbing Thoughts
episodesList.summary: Mallika makes Ashutosh realize that he is in love with Nidhi who is half her age. These taunts keep lurking in his mind and disturbs his sleep in the night. Anjali informs Nidhi that maybe Ashutosh also loves Nidhi. Nidhi jumps with joy.

episodesList.title: Doctor Ashutosh Is in Love
episodesList.summary: Doctor Ashutosh is in love with Nidhi. Doctor Ranganath observes this and informs Anjali about this. Nidhi, on the other hand, is very disturbed and fights with everyone at home, Ashutosh acts weirdly in the hospital which shocks everyone.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Questions Ashutosh
episodesList.summary: Nidhis father is worried for Nidhi. Nidhi is alone in her room crying over Ashutosh. Anjali makes her understand and urges her to come to a party with her. Coincidentally, Ashutosh also is invited to the same party. Nidhi spots him there and walks up to him and bombards him with her questions. He stands quietly as he feels really ashamed.

episodesList.title: Armaan Smells Something Fishy
episodesList.summary: Armaan talks to Ashutosh but Ashutosh doesn't tell him anything. He tries to escape and goes to his room. Mallika shows up at Ashutosh's place with home cooked food, but Ashutosh denies to eat anything and leaves for the hospital. Armaan can feel there is something bottled up inside Ashutosh which he is confused about and is not able to share with his best friend also.

episodesList.title: Rohan's Entry in Nidhi's Life
episodesList.summary: Rohan comes to stay at Nidhi's home. Dadi Bua has invited him as she feels Nidhi needs a friend. But Nidhi doesn't seem to notice him. Ashutosh, on the other hand, behaves weirdly. This does not go down too well with Mallika and she ends up being upset. She also blasts at her sister, blaming her for all the mess caused in her life.

episodesList.title: Ashutosh Confesses to Armaan
episodesList.summary: Mallika is very upset and realizes she has hurt Ashutosh a lot. Armaan talks Ashutosh into playing chess with him in order to draw out some information as to what is pinching him inside. Ashutosh confesses his love for Nidhi in front of Armaan.

episodesList.title: Armaan Makes Ashutosh Understand
episodesList.summary: Mallika is very upset as things are not going too smoothly between her and Ashutosh. She expresses her feelings in front of Dr, Ranganath. Rohan tries his best to cheer up Nidhi. Armaan tries his luck to cheer up Ashutosh but Ashutosh is adamant. Ashutosh doesn't realize that Nidhi is also in love with him.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Guesses It Right
episodesList.summary: Nidhi's father coincidentally meets Dr. Mallika at her brother's office. She gets shocked to know that he is Nidhi's father. Nidhi's father decides to take the full family for lunch. She spots Ashutosh at the same resort. The waiter brings Ashutosh's order to Nidhi's table by mistake. She asks him to take the order and give it to their table. The waiter does so and notifies Ashutosh & Armaan about it. Armaan teases Ashutosh. Will Ashutosh be able to understand Nidhi's love?

episodesList.title: Nidhi Gets a New Job
episodesList.summary: Armaan realizes that Nidhi also loves Ashutosh, but Ashutosh does not believe this. He requests his friend, who is also the head of City Hospital, to appoint Nidhi as an intern in his hospital. Nidhi is on cloud nine after hearing this. Rohan spoils her mood and ends up giving some personal grooming tips to her, which cheers her up.

episodesList.title: Mallika Misunderstands Ashutoshs Intentions
episodesList.summary: Armaan makes Ashutosh understand that Nidhi needs his love and not his favors. Ashutosh, on the other hand, is successful in getting a job for Nidhi. Rohan troubles Nidhi and forces her to confess everything that's troubling her, but she insults him on the contrary. Doctor Ranganath manages to convince Anjali to re-design his hospital's uniforms. Ashutosh asks Mallika to attend a conference in Mumbai. She shares this news with her sister, who brainwashes her and talks her into staying back to keep an eye on Doctor Ashutosh and refuse this offer.

episodesList.title: Doctors Conference
episodesList.summary: Mallika convinces Ashutosh to go to the conference instead of her, thinking she is successful in keeping him away from Nidhi. But, destiny has other plans for the lovebirds, Ashutosh & Nidhi. Nidhi is asked to attend the conference as well. At first, she hesitates but then she agrees to go to Mumbai. She spots Doctor Ashutosh there and breaks into tears silently. She is also shocked when she hears him speak good things about her in front of the audience.

episodesList.title: Ashutosh & Nidhi Talk to Each Other
episodesList.summary: Ashutosh and Nidhi are confused what to say to each other. Nidhi discusses this with Anjali and Ashutosh discusses this with Armaan. Armaan tries his best to bring them together and his plans show positive results. Ashutosh and Nidhi meet and are sitting at the same table but are confused what to say to each other. Will Nidhi be able to see love in Ashutosh's eyes?

episodesList.title: Love Is About Taking a Few Steps
episodesList.summary: Suhasini finds out that Nidhi is also in Mumbai and she rushes to inform Mallika about this. Mallika gets disturbed when she hears this news. Meanwhile, Armaan is busy planning to bring Ashutosh and Nidhi together. He changes the chits in the bowls and manages to bring Ashutosh and Nidhi together once again. What will Ashutosh and Nidhi do now?

episodesList.title: Nidhi Quits Her New Job
episodesList.summary: Mallika reaches Mumbai. She tells the truth to Nidhi about how she got this new job. Nidhi fumes in anger when she finds out the truth and quits the new job. She also bids goodbye to Doctor Ashutosh and leaves with Rohan. Mallika joins Armaan and Ashutosh for dinner. Armaan explains love facts to Ashutosh but Ashutosh is very sad.

episodesList.title: Rohan Overhears Ashutosh
episodesList.summary: Rohan cheers up Nidhi. Suhasini warns Mallika not to let Ashutosh know that she told Nidhi about the job recommendation. Rohan overhears Ashutosh and Armaan's conversation and is surprised to know that Ashutosh also loves Nidhi. Will he help to bring the love birds together?

episodesList.title: Rohan All Set to Help Nidhi
episodesList.summary: Anjali informs Ashutosh about Nidhi quitting her new job. Mallika tries to keep Nidhi away from Ashutosh. Rohan decides to help Nidhi in whichever way he can. He reaches Ashutosh's hospital but Mallika misguides him. He is about to leave when Doctor Ranganath tells him the truth.

episodesList.title: Armaan & Rohan Join Hands
episodesList.summary: Rohan meets Armaan. They discuss Ashutosh & Nidhi's case. They join in hands to bring both of them together. Rohan also confesses that he doesn't love Nidhi and is just a friend. Will they be successful in bringing them together?

episodesList.title: Lunch at Lucknow Darbaar
episodesList.summary: Armaan and Rohan plan to make Nidhi and Ashutosh meet at Lucknow Darbaar. But they are not able to. Coincidentally, Ashutosh and Nidhi end up coming at the Mosque. Will they see each other and confess their love?

episodesList.title: Ashutosh and Nidhi Faces Each Other
episodesList.summary: Ashutosh and Nidhi come across each other in the mosque. Rohan and Armaan make them understand how much they love each other and should get back together. Will Ashutosh and Nidhi listen to them?

episodesList.title: Nidhi Is Super Excited
episodesList.summary: Ashutosh and Nidhi think about each other all night and accepts that they love each other. Next morning Nidhi is all excited to narrate all of this to her friend Anji. Will she be equally excited?

episodesList.title: Ashutosh Goes Shopping
episodesList.summary: Nidhi asks Ashutosh to go and buy the t-shirt she wants him to wear. He consults Armaan as he finds this thing very childish. But Armaan tells him that he has to do everything when in love. When Ashutosh goes shopping, he sees someone else buying that tshirt. Will he manage to get that one?

episodesList.title: Dr. Mallika Hurts Herself
episodesList.summary: Ashutosh is unable to manage as the t-shirt gets destroyed. But still he meets Nidhi and they spend a great time. Dr. Mallika is jealous when she sees them together and tries to hurt herself. What will she do next?

episodesList.title: Nidhi and Ashutosh Are Stuck
episodesList.summary: Ashutosh takes Nidhi to one of his old houses where he spent the childhood. While returning back, they get stuck as the car breaks down in between. How will they spend the night? Will they manage?

episodesList.title: Tiff Between Nidhi and Dr. Mallika
episodesList.summary: Dr. Mallika confronts Ashutosh and asks him what is it between him and Nidhi. He admits that he loves Nidhi. This breaks Dr. Mallika's heart as she has been waiting for 12 years. Dr. Mallika shouts at Nidhi which creates a tiff between them.

episodesList.title: Anji Is in Big Trouble
episodesList.summary: Anji discovers that the clothes she has been given by the merchant are not of the same material as it was shown. This puts her in great stress. She is worried as she has to show all the samples to the clients. Will they reject Anji's clothes?

episodesList.title: Nidhi Starts Her Preparation
episodesList.summary: Nidhi's father's consignment gets canceled. And he gets a call from the bank for repayment of the loan. Meanwhile, Nidhi starts renovating the house she wants to gift to Ashutosh.

episodesList.title: Ashutosh Relives His Past
episodesList.summary: Dr. Mallika plans a conspiracy and gets Nidhi's father's loan canceled. There Ashutosh is super happy with the house Nidhi gifted him. He relives the moments with his father. Nidhi gets to know that her father had a heart attack.

episodesList.title: Nidhi's Dad Hospitalised
episodesList.summary: Nidhi is traumatized as she gets to know things. Her father is taken to the hospital where she is informed that he has to be kept for 2 days. Nidhi gets to know the real reason behind the heart attack and is taken aback.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Behaves Indifferent
episodesList.summary: Dr. Mallika gets to know that the owner of the house is Nidhi and plans to tell this to Ashutosh. When Nidhi does not pick up Ashutosh's call, he gets tensed and starts overthinking. Will this create more issues?

episodesList.title: Ashutosh Confronts the Truth
episodesList.summary: Ashutosh gets to know that Nidhi is the owner of the house when Mallika tells him everything. He starts fuming in anger and decides to not talk to Nidhi. His mom also knows about this. He breaks down even more.

episodesList.title: Ashutosh Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: Armaan makes Ashutosh understand that all this is not Nidhi's fault. Nidhi has no other option but to sell the house to repay the loan. Ashutosh goes missing and no one is able to contact him.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Has a Well-Wisher
episodesList.summary: Nidhi gets a call from the bank as she has only 4 days left to repay the amount. This puts Nidhi under great pressure. But surprisingly she gets a call who is ready to buy her property. Will this help Nidhi?

episodesList.title: Ashutosh Is in Dilemma
episodesList.summary: Nidhi does not know that she is being played. She is still confused about what she is doing. Meanwhile, Ashutosh keeps thinking whether he hates Nidhi or loves her.

episodesList.title: Dr. Mallika Plays Nidhi
episodesList.summary: Ashutosh gets back home safely and realizes his love for Nidhi. He calls her saying that he wants to meet her. Dr. Mallika uses false mean and forges Nidhis house on her name.

episodesList.title: Dr. Ranganath Humors Ashutosh
episodesList.summary: Nidhi And Ashutosh after all the misunderstandings, finally meet at the chai shop. There they clear out all the things. After a long time, Ashutosh goes to his hospital where he is humored with Ranganaths Talks.

episodesList.title: Dr. Mallika Attempts Suicide
episodesList.summary: Ashutosh denies Dr. Mallikas love and says that he cannot be with her as he is in love with Dr. Nidhi. She is taken back listening to this. And attempts suicide by cutting her nerves.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Consults Anjali
episodesList.summary: Dr. Mallika is taken to hospital where she is happy to see Dr. Ashutosh. Ashutosh is confused about Dr. Mallika as he cannot understand how to deal with her. Nidhi consults Anji whether she should meet Mallika or not.

episodesList.title: Dr. Ranganath & Anji on a Date
episodesList.summary: Nidhi visits Dr. Mallika in the hospital and they have a deep conversation. Ashutosh says that he will meet Nidhis father. Anji and Dr. Ranganath go out to an art gallery, which he considers as a date.

episodesList.title: Nidhis Father Gets Discharged
episodesList.summary: Nidhi anxiously waits for Dr. Ashutosh, but as usual, he is late. Anji enquires about Nidhi & Ashutoshs bond from Rohan and reveals her antipathy towards their so-called bond. Rohan makes her understand the value of their bond. Nidhi and Dr. Ashutosh spend a good time together. Later, Nidhis father gets discharged and is back at home. Everyone is happy to see him in a good condition, unlike Colonel Uncles office colleague.

episodesList.title: Plans for a Picnic
episodesList.summary: Mallika is up to something evil. Dr. Ashutosh apologizes to Nidhi for not being able to wear the tie she had gifted him. Dr. Ranganth pleads with Anji to meet him once. Later, Nidhi, Anji, and Rohan make plans for a picnic. Rohan notifies Armaan about it who furthers manipulates Ashutosh and talks him into coming with him.

episodesList.title: Dr. Ranganath, a Harmless Flirt
episodesList.summary: Ashutosh tries to pacify Nidhi and make her understand that he will not be able to make it for the picnic. Nidhi also doesnt go for the picnic. On learning that she also didnt go, Dr. Ashutosh promises to spend one entire day with her. Armaan doubts Mallikas evil plans. Anji is also upset with Dr. Ranganath and decides to join Nidhis fathers office.

episodesList.title: A Moment Well Spent
episodesList.summary: Anji reaches Nidhis Fathers office and wishes to check the records. Mansukhani hesitates which puts Anji in a doubt. Dr. Ranganath tries to pacify Anji but she is very angry and upset. Mallika, on the other hand, is planning really hard to separate Nidhi and Ashutosh. Anji does Nidhis makeover to impress Ashutosh. Ashutosh takes Nidhi for violin concert but ends up taking her home. They spend a beautiful moment together.

episodesList.title: Violin & Some Tea
episodesList.summary: Nidhi urges Ashutosh to play the violin. He plays the violin and gets carried away with its rhythms. Armaan is thrilled to see Ashutosh play the instrument. Later, Ashutosh takes out Nidhi for a coffee. Rohan saves Nidhi from her Dadi Bua. Ashutosh asks Nidhi to re-consider her decision of entering into a relationship with him. Her reply makes Ashutosh laugh.

episodesList.title: Old Traditional Sphinx
episodesList.summary: Ashutosh talks about his happy moments spend with Nidhi. Mallika gets jealous. Nidhi discusses her pressures with Rohan. Anjis Mother is suspicious about Nidhis actions. Nidhi & Anjis fathers discuss Nidhis marriage and consider Rohan to be a perfect match for her. Nidhi plans to obliquely ask her father about his conception of alliance with an elder person.

episodesList.title: Uncertainty Predominates
episodesList.summary: Nidhi speaks roughly with Ashutosh which bothers him. Dr. Ranganath rings Anji and attempts to pacify her, but his struggles seem to fail. Ashutosh is concerned for Nidhi and pressurizes her to share her concerns. Mallika gets discharged from the hospital. Anji meets Dr. Ranganath and apologizes for being so rude. Later, Nidhi meets Ashutosh to share her concerns and bursts into tears thinking about her future with him.

episodesList.title: Anji Is in Love
episodesList.summary: Ashutosh makes Nidhi chuckle. Anji and Dr. Ranganath party in a pub. Anji shares about her moments spend with Dr. Ranganth wit Nidhi. Nidhi states that Anji is in love with Dr. Ranganath. Later, Anji introspects and imbibes all the best moments she had spent with Dr. Ranganth. Nidhi invites Ashutosh for a party at a pub. He laughs it off explicating his disinterest.

episodesList.title: Ashutosh Goes to a Pub
episodesList.summary: Rohan and Nidhi force Dr. Ashutosh to come along with them to the pub for a party, assuring that he will not regret his decision and will have a good time there. He agrees to come. Armaan ridicules him observing his attire and begs him to change. But things do not seem to end in a happy way as Ashutosh leaves the pub in anger. Why? To find out, watch this full episode.

episodesList.title: Mallikas Evil Dinner Plan
episodesList.summary: Ashutosh leaves the pub in anger and expresses his anger in front of Armaan. Nidhi runs after him but loses sight of him. Later, things settle between them. Mallika enquires about the disco party and is surprised to know that Ashutosh had gone to that place. Surprisingly, she invites him and Nidhi for dinner at her place.

episodesList.title: Mallika's Gesture Disturbs Nidhi
episodesList.summary: Nidhi agrees to come for dinner at Mallika's home with Ashutosh. Mallika's gesture confuses everyone. She attempts to influence Nidhi and Ashutosh, mocking upon their contradistinctive tempers and tastes. But Nidhi gives it back to her very boldly.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Takes Violin Lessons
episodesList.summary: Ashutosh and Nidhi discuss their relationship. Nidhi feels Mallika is deliberately trying to pull her down. Ashutosh understands and promises to be by her side always. Later, Nidhi decides to learn violin. Though her rhythm does not go down too well with others, she manages to prove that she can also develop a keen interest towards classical music as well.

episodesList.title: Ashutosh Needs Glasses
episodesList.summary: Nidhi cannot learn classical music and is unhappy about it. Anji makes her understand. Ashutosh also tries his bit and shows his admiration towards her efforts. Nidhi witnesses that Ashutosh has difficulty in reading things. She discusses this with Armaan, who also notes the same, but Ashutosh shows hesitation towards wearing spectacles. Anji is taken aback to see a girl at Dr. Ranganaths house.

episodesList.title: Ashutosh Looks Young
episodesList.summary: Nidhi helps Ashutosh get rid of his hesitation. Colonel Verma urges to meet Rohans parents which leaves Nidhi in a doubt. Anji is very upset and she shares her issue with Nidhi. Nidhi asks her not to overthink and rushes to buy glasses for Ashutosh. Ashutosh asks her to come back to the hospital. What will be Nidhis answer?

episodesList.title: Fight Between Anji & Nidhi
episodesList.summary: Dr. Mallikas words disturb Nidhi a lot. She observes that Dr. Ashutosh becomes conscious because of their age gap. She rushes to share her problem with Anji but they end up having a big fight.

episodesList.title: Armaan & Rohans Plan
episodesList.summary: Armaan & Rohan discuss Ashutosh & Nidhi and plan to solve their fight. Ashutosh & Nidhi anxiously wait for each others call but their ego is too big to make the first move. On one hand, Rohan and Armaan feel bad as they thought that failed to re-unite Nidhi and Ashu. But, things seem to go in a different way. Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Conflicting Notions of Valentines Day
episodesList.summary: Ashutosh hates Valentines day. Nidhi, on the contrary, embraces this day and states her wish to celebrate this day with Dr. Ashutosh. She gets confused when she discovers that their views do not match. At the hospital, Ashutosh learns the value of this day and realizes that he should try and indulge himself in celebrating such happy moments to build some memories. Anji and Dr. Ranganath again have an argument. Dr. Ranganath tries to pacify her but its of no use. It seems this Valentines day, Dr. Ranganath will have no partner!

episodesList.title: Ashutosh Celebrates Valentines Day
episodesList.summary: Nidhi and Anji solve their issues. Mallika gets upset as Ashutosh shouts at her over Nidhis topic. Anji and Dr. Ranganath also solve their issues and go on a date. Ashutosh also surprises Nidhi trying to make her day special. Mandira requests Colonel Verma if she can come home and he gives her permission to come. This does not go down to well with Dadi Bua.

episodesList.title: Mandira Comes Home
episodesList.summary: Nidhis plan surprises Dr. Ashutosh. He has no words to express his happiness and enjoys every moment with Nidhi. Anjis father notices her with Dr. Ranganath and scolds her. Dadi Bua creates a mess in the house over Mandiras topic and threatens to leave the house, but calms down on seeing Nidhi & Rohan.

episodesList.title: Dadi Bua Insults Mandira
episodesList.summary: Nidhi is very happy to see Mandira. Dadi Bua insults Mandira and asks her to leave the house. Colonel Verma stops her but Mandira urges Dadi Bua to take out all her frustrations at once. All this commotion takes place in front of Rohan and Dr. Ashutosh. This episode disturbs Nidhi & Ashutosh. Witnessing this commotion, Anjis parents also come to Nidhis house.

episodesList.title: Dadi Bua vs Colonel Verma
episodesList.summary: Colonel Verma is disturbed because of all the mess that Dadi Bua created. Nidhi is still very positive about everything. Later, Dadi Bua & Colonel Verma enter into an argument which only Rohan was able to solve. Anji's mother asks Nidhi to come back home. How will Dadi Bua react when she finds out about Nidhi & Dr. Ashutosh?

episodesList.title: Anjis Mother Knows the Truth
episodesList.summary: Dadi Bua asks Nidhi to stay away from Dr. Ashutosh which upsets her. Anjis mother scolds Nidhi and urges her to tell the truth. Nidhi declares her love for Ashutosh in front of Anjis mother. Anjis mother tries to make Nidhi understand but she seems to be blind in love and defends her bond with Dr. Ashutosh.

episodesList.title: Nidhis Disturbing Vision
episodesList.summary: Nidhi decides to tell her father the truth about Dr. Ashutosh. She hallucinates that her revelation shocks Colonel Verma & Dadi Bua. She calls Dr. Ashutosh and urges to meet. Dr. Ashutosh understands her fears and questions her. She asks him to take a stand for their bond as they do not have much time left. He, on the contrary, affirms to stand by her side always.

episodesList.title: Airport Conversations
episodesList.summary: Anjis mother is happy to know Dr. Ashutosh decision for Nidhi. Dadi Bua urges Colonel Verma to take Nidhi & Rohans alliance seriously. Dr. Ashu shares his problems with Mallika seeking some help but she, on the contrary, scares him more. Later, he tells Nidhi that he has some urgent work in Delhi and desires to meet her.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Meets Mandira
episodesList.summary: Mandira calls Nidhi and asks her to meet her. Nidhi takes Mandira into confidence and tries to share her love life with her. Dadi Bua and Colonel Verma have some other plans for Nidhi.

episodesList.title: So Far Yet So Near
episodesList.summary: Nidhi anxiously waits for Ashutosh's call. Meanwhile, Dadi Bua decides to play cards with everyone and asks Chote Sarkar to call Rohan & Nidhi as well. Ashutosh, on the other hand, is a little busy and is not able to talk properly with Nidhi. Even though they are in different cities, her beloved gestures and antics win Dr. Ashutosh's heart!

episodesList.title: Rohans Parents Are in Lucknow
episodesList.summary: Rohans parents come to Lucknow and are very thrilled to meet Nidhi. Nidhi and Rohan are unaware of the planning that is going on behind their back. Anji and Dr. Ranganath have a happy time in a cafe. Chote Sarkar, as usual, stalks Anji following Anjis Fathers orders. Ashutosh misses his flight to Lucknow and is tensed as he had promised to meet Nidhi.

episodesList.title: Surprise Turned Shock
episodesList.summary: Ashutosh notifies Nidhi about the delayed flights. Dadi Bua and Rohans parents are very excited about Nidhi & Rohans alliance. Nidhi and Rohan are unaware of all this commotion. Anjis mother informs Nidhi which shocks her. She rushes to tell Colonel Verma about her relationship with Dr. Ashutosh but just couldnt. What will Nidhi do?

episodesList.title: Rohan Refuses to Marry Nidhi
episodesList.summary: Nidhi reveals the truth to Dr. Ashutosh about Rohan & her engagement. Rohan also gets a shock on learning about this. He tries his best to reject this marriage proposal but his parents refuse to understand and take a step back. Nidhi is very tensed and takes out all her frustrations on Rohan. Poor Rohan stands helpless and clueless!

episodesList.title: Unexpected Occurrences
episodesList.summary: Dadi Bua urges Nidhi to get ready for the engagement ceremony. Nidhi hesitates but Dadi Bua cannot notice this. Meanwhile, Ashutosh is trying his best to reach Lucknow as fast as he can. Its a tough moment for the duo! Will Ashutosh reach Lucknow in time to stop Nidhi and Rohans alliance?

episodesList.title: Nidhi Bombarded With Questions
episodesList.summary: Nidhi confesses to Colonel Verma that she is in love with someone else and not Rohan. Colonel Verma notifies Rohans parents and rejects the marriage proposal. On the other hand, Ashutosh is not reachable and this worries Rohan and Nidhi. Rohan asks Armaan for help.

episodesList.title: Nidhis Revolting Confession
episodesList.summary: Nidhi reveals Dr. Ashutoshs name in front of everyone. Dadi Bua fumes in anger. Rohan & Anji intervenes but Dadi Bua blasts at them. Everyone starts interrogating about Dr. Ashutosh but there is no news of him. Armaan returns with no news but a lot of suspicions.

episodesList.title: Ashutoshs Accident
episodesList.summary: Armaan finds out that Dr. Ashutosh has met with an accident. He informs Nidhi and Mallika about it, which shocks them. Dadi Bua talks ill about Ashutosh which triggers her anger. Nidhi, Rohan, and Anji rush to find Dr.Ashutosh. Where is Dr. Ashutosh?

episodesList.title: Its All About Faith
episodesList.summary: Nidhi is very upset. No one is able to trace Dr. Ashutosh. Dadi Bua, on the other hand, mocks Dr. Ashutosh. Nidhi refuses to eat and drink anything until they find out about Dr. Ashutosh. Later, its declared that Ashutosh is dead and everyone gathers to moan for him, except Nidhi. Will Nidhis love bring back Dr. Ashu? Is he really gone?

episodesList.title: Villagers Rescue Ashutosh
episodesList.summary: Nidhi denies believing that Ashutosh is no more. She along with Rohan and Anji rushes to find Dr. Ashutosh in the nearby villages. Meanwhile, Dr. Ashutosh's body floats and reaches a river bank where some villagers rescue him.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Finds Ashutosh
episodesList.summary: Nidhi's hope proved that love exists. She is successful in finding Dr. Ashutosh. Anji informs Dr. Ranganath who furthers notifies everyone else. Armaan reaches for help. Mallika tries to take charge and insults Nidhi.

episodesList.title: Ashutosh Wants Nidhi
episodesList.summary: Dadi Bua forcefully takes her back home. Colonel Verma tries to convince her to forget Ashutosh. Ashutosh asks for Nidhi when he opens his eyes, which upsets Mallika.

episodesList.title: Pleasure to the Eyes
episodesList.summary: Dr. Ashutosh is fine and so is everyone. He feels Nidhi is in some tension and discusses that with Armaan. Mallika asks Armaan to leave and not disturb Ashutosh. Anji meets Dr. Ashutosh on behalf of Nidhi.  Later, Nidhi couldnt control herself and rushes to the hospital to meet her love.

episodesList.title: Ashutoshs Speedy Recovery
episodesList.summary: Mallika is not able to see Ashutosh and Nidhi together. Dadi Bua & Colonel Verma are against Nidhi and Dr. Ashus bond but her firmness disturbs them. Ashutoshs recovery makes Nidhi very happy but she is sad thinking what the future holds!

episodesList.title: Ashutosh Gets Discharged
episodesList.summary: Mallika is surprised to see that Ashutosh got himself discharged. Armaan comes to pick him up.  Ashutosh and Armaan pop up at Nidhis place to convince Colonel Verma and Dadi Bua but are shocked to know that she was forced to go on a mini vacation with Dadi Bua.

episodesList.title: Hunting the Address
episodesList.summary: Colonel Verma takes Nidhi to some resort in order to keep her away from Ashutosh. Nidhi is heartbroken. Dadi Bua tries to cheer her up but all her efforts fail. Meanwhile, Ashutosh and Armaan are trying their luck to get Nidhis address. Will Ashutosh be able to find Nidhi?

episodesList.title: Ashutosh Observes Nidhis Silence
episodesList.summary: Ashutosh meets Nidhi. Anji is worried for Nidhi. Mallika reaches Ashutoshs place and learns he is still not home. On the other hand, Ashutosh is worried about Nidhi and discusses the same with Armaan. Mallika calls Armaan to enquire about Ashutosh. Armaan asks her not to worry and keeps down the call.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Is Lost
episodesList.summary: Ashutosh wakes up early to meet Nidhi. Nidhi, on the other hand, lies to Dadi Bua and escapes to meet Ashutosh. Anji is worried for Nidhi and remembers her childhood days. Rohan calms her down. Dadi Bua and Colonel Verma find Nidhi in the woods and take her back home.

episodesList.title: Ashutosh Tries to Convince Colonel Verma
episodesList.summary: Ashutosh meets Colonel Verma and Dadi Bua in order to convince them to accept Nidhi and his alliance. Colonel Verma and Dadi Bua are adamant on their decision. They do not have the courage to go against the norms of the society. Nidhi is silent. She calls Anji and Rohan to cry out her heart. Dadi Bua is equally upset and worried for Nidhi.

episodesList.title: Separation Is the Only Solution
episodesList.summary: Nidhi gets permission to meet Ashutosh for once. She rushes to meet him in the woods. He asks her for the final decision and she notifies that they will never speak to each other again. She comes back and informs Colonel Verma and Dadi Bua about it.

episodesList.title: Hurt Yet Calm
episodesList.summary: Nidhi and Ashutosh are back to their homes. Both of them try to maintain their calm in their own sweet ways. Nidhi involves herself in the household work whereas Ashutosh gets involved in the hospital work. Rohan takes Nidhi outside where they come across a stranger roaming helplessly on the road.

episodesList.title: Jeevan Sandhya Nursing Home
episodesList.summary: The stranger turns out to be a patient who stays in Jeevan Sandhya Nursing Home. Nidhi and Rohan take him there. Ashutosh spots Nidhi on the road and goes numb. Mallika treats her brother and sister-in-law and reveals the good news about Ashutosh and Nidhi's separation.

episodesList.title: Emergency Pecks In
episodesList.summary: Nidhi decides to take care of Baba at Jeevan Sandhya Nursing Home, as this way she can keep herself occupied. Ashutosh is also trying to concentrate on his work in the hospital. Emergency shows up at Jeevan Sandhya Nursing Home and Nidhi rushes to that place. A patient requires immediate brain surgery. Will Nidhi call Ashutosh for help?

episodesList.title: Nidhi Assists Dr. Ashutosh
episodesList.summary: Emergency shows up at Jeevan Sandhya Nursing Home. Nidhi and Rohan take the patient to Dr. Ashutoshs hospital. She also informs Dr. Ashutosh to come. During the surgery, Nidhi assists Dr. Ashutosh and later, he drops her back home.

episodesList.title: Is Ashutosh at Fault?
episodesList.summary: Anji confesses her love to Dr. Ranganath and rushes to tell Nidhi. Nidhi is happy for Anji. Later, Nidhi reaches Kotnis Hospital to see her patient. Mallika mocks Nidhi. Anjis father forces her to leave her job at the hospital and work only with Colonel Verma. Ashutosh lands in trouble as the Jeeva ashrams patient he operated is very critical now.

episodesList.title: Reporters Troll Ashutosh
episodesList.summary: Ashutosh feels that he has failed as a doctor. Mallika takes charge to perform the operation. Anji and Dr. Ranganath indulge in a healthy conversation. Nidhi is very happy to have come across Baba in the Jeevan Sandhya Nursing Home. Anji informs Nidhi about the chaos created at Kotnis Hospital.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Speaks to Baba
episodesList.summary: Media trolls Ashutosh and writes negative information in the newspaper. Dadi Bua fumes in anger on reading about him. Nidhi spends a lot of time in Jeevan Sandhya Nursing Home with Baba. She comes to know that Baba is from the medical background as well. Later, she meets Dr. Ashutosh and urges him to be strong and face the cruel world.

episodesList.title: Baba Wants to Go Home
episodesList.summary: Its difficult for Ashutosh to forget Nidhi. Mallika supports Ashutosh and takes him out for dinner. Ashutosh is very thankful to her. Nidhi meets Baba and urges him to think about his past life. Destiny is playing weird games with Ashutosh and Nidhi and makes them meet again and again.

episodesList.title: Rohan Develops Feelings for Nidhi
episodesList.summary: Baba goes out again. Nidhi gets worried. Ashutosh offers to help find Baba. Rohan shows up at Jeevan Sandhya Nursing Home to meet Nidhi. It seems Rohan is falling for Nidhi. Mallika receives an unknown call.

episodesList.title: Baba Cries for Help
episodesList.summary: Nidhi involves all the patients and old citizens of Jeevan Sandhya Nursing Home in some or the other games. Baba remembers his past and cries for help. Nidhi calms him down. Rohan finds it difficult to compromise with his newly developed feelings for Nidhi. Nidhi shares about Baba with her family members.

episodesList.title: Ashutoshs Treatment Works
episodesList.summary: Nidhi helps Baba remember his past. It seems the medicines are working on him. Baba remembers some theories and recalls Dr. Ashutoshs name. She rushes to share this news with Ashutosh. He asks her to help him recall his past. With constant pressurizing, he might remember everything concerning his past.

episodesList.title: Mallikas Marriage Proposal
episodesList.summary: Baba takes Nidhi to a deserted house explaining that he remembers a little.  Jagan, Armaan, Mallika, and Ashutosh go out for dinner. Jagan confesses his love for Mallika and asks Ashutosh as to why he did not marry Mallika till now. Ashutosh fumes in anger. Dinner date turns into a disaster! Mallika proposes Ashutosh for marriage. What will Ashutosh reply?

episodesList.title: Ashutosh Meets His Baba
episodesList.summary: Ashutosh refuses to Marry Mallika. Nidhi is busy helping Baba recall his past. She is surprised to see that Baba knows how to play the violin. Baba recalls everything and cries for Ashutosh. Nidhi rushes to get Ashutosh. Ashutosh is very happy to meet Baba and hugs him tightly. Baba urges to go home with Ashutosh and showers his good wishes and blessing on Nidhi.

episodesList.title: Nidhis Maternal Grandfather
episodesList.summary: Baba is Nidhis Maternal grandfather. She is happy to know this but cannot tell her father Colonel Verma about it. Nidhi requests Ashutosh not to tell anything to Baba. Ashutosh spends time with Baba and is very happy. Nidhi is very sad as she cannot make any ends meet, be it between Ashutosh and her family or between her maternal grandfather and Colonel Verma.

episodesList.title: Mallika Resigns From Kotnis Hospital
episodesList.summary: Baba urges Nidhi to come to Ashutoshs place. Nidhi agrees to come. Rohan meets Anji and confesses his love for Nidhi to her. He asks Anji to help him out. Nidhi meets Baba and gives him his medicine. Mallika calls Jagan and gets emotional. She resigns from Kotnis Hospital.

episodesList.title: Ashutosh Questions Baba
episodesList.summary: Anjis mother speaks to Rohan about Nidhi and makes him understand the whole situation. She also notifies Nidhi about his feeling. Mallika and Jagat enjoy their lunch with Aditya and Suhasini when Dr. Ashutosh shows up. Baba and Ashutosh plan to give each other a makeover. Ashutosh asks Baba the reason why he left all of them. Will Baba let go of his hesitation and answer Ashutoshs question?

episodesList.title: Rohan Confronts Nidhi
episodesList.summary: Nidhi confronts Rohan and learns that he is in love with her. Dr. Ranganath offers to take Anji for an ice cream. Rohan fears he might lose his friend because of love. Anjis mother convinces Dadi Bua and Colonel Verma. Nidhi blasts at everyone asking them to stop interfering in her life. She also makes Rohan understand.

episodesList.title: In God We Trust
episodesList.summary: Mallika has decided to marry Jagat. She calls Ashutosh one last time but to her surprise, Baba receives the call. She asks Baba to help her. Baba immediately asks Ashutosh to take him out. On their way, Ashutosh reminds Baba of one famous dargah where Baba used to go. Baba and Ashutosh go inside and surprisingly come across Nidhi.

episodesList.title: Baba Wants to Know
episodesList.summary: Ashutosh and Nidhi helplessly stare at each other. Baba notices Ashutosh and Nidhis hesitation and questions Ashutosh on this. He realizes that Ashutosh and Nidhi love each other. He prays to God for their love. Nidhi wants to run away. Baba interrogates Armaan and wants to know Ashutosh and Nidhis story.

episodesList.title: Colonel Verma Repeats Babas Mistakes
episodesList.summary: Baba reaches Nidhis place. He recognizes Colonel Verma and Dadi Bua and is surprised to know Nidhi is his grandchild. Colonel Verma fumes in anger after seeing Baba. Baba tries his best to convince Colonel Verma and Dadi Bua but his efforts and words seem to fall on deaf ears.

episodesList.title: Baba Provokes Ashutosh
episodesList.summary: Nidhi packs her clothes to leave for Europe. Anji and Rohan are unhappy with her decision. Ashutosh is anxious and doesnt want Nidhi to go but his helplessness stops him from coming and talking to her. Baba provokes him to go and stop his love from going away. Ashutosh rushes to the airport to stop Nidhi. Will Nidhi desist the thought of running away?

episodesList.title: Colonel Verma Waves His Magic Wand
episodesList.summary: Colonel Verma stops Nidhi. He re-unites Nidhi and Ashutosh. Ashutosh is very happy and informs Armaan and Baba about it. Everyone is very happy. Colonel Verma decides to get Nidhi married to Ashutosh. Dadi Bua is very angry and refrains from participating in any event.

episodesList.title: Dadi Buas Anger Melts
episodesList.summary: Nidhi and Ashutoshs engagement is fixed. Dadi Bua is still angry. Dr. Ranganath reaches Anjis place to talk with her mother about Anji and his alliance. Ashutosh and Nidhi, eagerly look forward to their engagement. Colonel Verma gears up with the preparations. Dadi Buas anger dissolves and she readily accepts Nidhi and Ashutoshs alliance.

episodesList.title: The Ring Thing
