episodesList.summary: Ashutosh shows up at Nidhis place. to everyones surprise, Dadi Bua wholeheartedly welcomes him. Ashutosh has come to take Nidhis finger measurement for the engagement ring. She hesitates and is very shy. Her happiness is beyond any explanation.

episodesList.title: Engagement Ceremony
episodesList.summary: Colonel Verma loses the ring. Everyone hunts for the ring. Ashutosh and family reach Nidhis place. The engagement ceremony begins. Everyone is very happy and so are Nidhi and Ashutosh.

episodesList.title: Little Things Matter
episodesList.summary: Nidhi stops Rohan from leaving. Everyone at Nidhis place is excited about Nidhi and Ashutoshs marriage. Armaan and Baba hunt for a lady who can welcome Nidhi in her new home. They mutually decide to invite Armaans mother.

episodesList.title: Plumber Finds the Ring
episodesList.summary: Dr. Ranganath calls the plumber to find the ring in the drain. Nidhi gets hyper and mocks Ashutosh. Everyone heaves a sigh of relief when the plumber finds the ring. Ashutosh discusses the girl problem with Armaan. Armaan also lectures him. Anjis parents plan to get Anji married. Dadi Bua believes in rituals and Ashutosh doesnt. This will definitely result in an ego clash. What will Ashutosh do?

episodesList.title: The Haldi Ceremony
episodesList.summary: Armaans mother shows up. Everyone is happy to see her. She orders everyone to buy goodies and decorate the whole house. Haldi ceremony begins in both the houses. Everyone is dancing and enjoying and are very happy for Nidhi and Ashutosh.

episodesList.title: Dadi Bua Meets an Old Friend
episodesList.summary: Nidhi is not allowed to meet Dr. Ashutosh before marriage. Anji and Chote Sarkar make her understand. Armaans mother meets Nidhis, Dadi Bua. They both recognize each other and make merry. They mutually decide to have the Sangeet Ceremony together. Baba is very happy for both the kids.

episodesList.title: Sangeet Ceremony
episodesList.summary: Dr. Ranganath comes for the Sangeet Function. Anjis father interrogates about Dr. Ranganath from Ashutosh. He wants to see whether Dr. Ranganath is the ideal guy for his daughter Anji. Later, everyone performs turn by turn for Nidhi and Ashutosh. The Sangeet Ceremony is a hit!

episodesList.title: Funny Sherwani
episodesList.summary: Nidhi and Ashutosh make each other blush. She urges to choose Ashutoshs wedding sherwani. On receiving the parcel, everyone starts laughing. Baba and Armaan make fun of Ashutosh. Saroj Bala loves the sherwani. Ashutosh refuses to sit on the horse and make his entry which upsets Nidhi.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Gets Emotional
episodesList.summary: Ashutosh demands a horse to make a grand entry. Armaan and Ranganath try and arrange for a horse. Dadi Bua panics and wants everything in proper order and manner. Nidhi realizes that Ashutosh received the wrong sherwani. Rohan rushes to give him the new one. Anji packs Nidhis clothes and gets emotional.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Is a Prankster
episodesList.summary: Nidhi and her family eagerly wait for Ashutosh and his family. Everyone is very happy and excited. All the girls tease Anji. Ashutosh makes a grand entry. Nidhi rushes to see him. The duo exchange look and blush. Ashutosh and Nidhi are so in love with each other.

episodesList.title: Happily Married
episodesList.summary: Nidhis girl gang surrounds Ashutosh and try their tricks on him. Rohan brings food for Nidhi and gets emotional. Anjis father notices Ranganath and Anji standing very close to each other. Nidhi and Ashutosh finally tie their knots.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Bids Adieu
episodesList.summary: The rituals are going as per Dadi Buas orders. Everyone is enjoying the marriage function. Anji is finding a way to grab Ashutoshs shoes. Moments later, everyone gets emotional to see Nidhi leave. Nidhi bids adieu to everyone and enters in a new phase of life. She is warmly welcomed in Ashutoshs house by Baba.

episodesList.title: Day After Marriage
episodesList.summary: It's Nidhi and Ashutosh's first night but unfortunately, Ashutosh has to rush to the hospital for an emergency operation. Nidhi waits for him at home. Anji's father and mother talk about Anji and Dr. Ranganath's wedding. Dadi Bua waits for Nidhi and Ashutosh for the pug phera ritual.

episodesList.title: Dadi Bua's Ritual
episodesList.summary: Armaan's mom scolds Ashutosh for leaving Nidhi alone on the first night. He rushes to Nidhi's home. Nidhi reads Rohan's letter and gets upset. Rohan has left. Ashutosh comes to meet Nidhi. Dadi Bua is happy to see him. She expects the duo to sit for a ritual.

episodesList.title: Dr. Ranganath's Test
episodesList.summary: Anji's father and Colonel Verma meet Dr. Ranganath and take his test. Dr. Ranganath is very nervous. Anji and Nidhi are nervous too. But Solanki Sir agrees for the alliance. Nidhi informs Ashutosh about this news. She also has everything planned for her honeymoon and asks Ashutosh to come early.

episodesList.title: Adventurous Honeymoon
episodesList.summary: Nidhi and Ashutosh reach their honeymoon destination. Ashutosh finds it weird but Nidhi is extremely happy. Anji's parents are preparing for Anji's marriage. Anji goes with Ranganath for lunch. Nidhi plans to shock Ashutosh and he hesitates.

episodesList.title: Honeymoon in the Jungle
episodesList.summary: Nidhi and Ashutosh's honeymoon looks more like an adventure. Her little demands, make Ashutosh do those things which he hasn't done ever. They also manage to find food in the jungle. Chote Sarkar has a tough time with Dadi Bua. Anji and Ranganath go on a lunch date.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Is Lost
episodesList.summary: Honeymoon in the jungle doesn't seem to go right. Nidhi gets lost and does not remember her way back to Ashutosh. Ashutosh gets worried and rushes to find her. Moments later, they find each other and heave a sigh of relief. Armaan & Baba have a happy coffee conversation.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Makes Food
episodesList.summary: Nidhi and Ashutosh enjoy their honeymoon time. The early morning ginger tea adds more spice to their time. Dadi Bua is worried for Nidhi and her new life. She suggests sending chote sarkar to her place would be a good option. But Chote Sarkar refuses to go and leave Colonel Verma. Nidhi and Ashutosh come back from their honeymoon and its time for Nidhi to make food in her new home for the first time. Will she be able to make good edible meals?

episodesList.title: Heavy Discussions
episodesList.summary: Nidhi asks Ashutosh about Dr. Ranganath's family. Anji and Nidhi try and find out about him. Baba sits to talk with Ashutosh post which he leaves for work. Nidhi makes food for him but he already ate his food. Anji directly asks Ranganath about his family and he gets triggered.

episodesList.title: Ashutosh Pacifies Nidhi
episodesList.summary: Nidhi is upset with Ashutosh. Ashutosh comes to know that Nidhi is on an empty stomach since morning. He pacifies her and makes her eat. Dadi Bua shows up at Nidhi's place. Saroj Bala doesn't like Dadi Buas coming. Anji explains about Ranganath's family to her parents.

episodesList.title: Midnight Cravings
episodesList.summary: Nidhi apologizes on behalf of Dadi Bua and sorts out her issues with Ashutosh. Armaan's mother is ready to go back home. Nidhi takes blessings from her. Armaan also leaves for his place. Dr. Ranganath is tensed as his family still doesn't know about Anji. Anji bugs out on learning this. In the night, Nidhi makes noodles and remembers Rohan.

episodesList.title: Ashutosh Asks Nidhi to Find Mallika
episodesList.summary: Nidhi wants ice cream and Ashutosh rushes to a hotel to buy it for her. He spots Mallika in an upsetting state and runs after her but unfortunately, meets with an accident. Nidhi and everyone take him to Kotnis Hospital and get worried. Ashutosh narrates the story to her and asks her to find Mallika.

episodesList.title: Dr. Asutoshs Personal Therapist
episodesList.summary: Anjis parents surprise Anji with a ring to give to Ranganath. Nidhi takes care of Ashutosh in the hospital. He happily enjoys her love and care. Later, Nidhi doesnt allow the nurse to give a sponge bath to Ashutosh. She offers to do it herself.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Spots Mallika
episodesList.summary: Nidhi spots Dr. Mallika and is shocked to see her condition. She runs away from that place thinking Mallika might be a hindrance between her and Ashutosh. Nidhi forces Mallika to sit in the car and brings her to the hospital. Meanwhile, Dr. Ranganaths parents force him for marriage.

episodesList.title: Mallika in a Terible State
episodesList.summary: Mallika wakes up after a traumatic dream and starts babbling. The nurse comes to her rescue and calls Dr. Ashutosh. Ashutosh is very guilty. Mallika is now in safe hands but is traumatized. On the hand, Dr. Ranganath is stressed out but is not able to tell Anji anything.

episodesList.title: Ranganath Tells His Parents
episodesList.summary: Ashutosh feels bad for Mallika. Dr. Ranganath gets to know that Mallika's family is in Australia. Dadi Bua reaches Ashutosh's place to help Nidhi but this does not go down too well with her. Anji is upset as Dr. Ranganath still is hesitating to tell his parents.

episodesList.title: Mallika's Suicide Attempt
episodesList.summary: Mallika attempts to jump from the hospital terrace. Ashutosh and everyone else tries to stop her. She is scared and is not willing to trust anyone. Ashutosh promises to take care of her. This does not go down well with Nidhi. Dadi Bua and Baba debate over the house care. Anji scolds Nidhi for bringing Mallika to her place.

episodesList.title: Sizzling Candlelight Dinner
episodesList.summary: Nidhi impresses Ashutosh and wears a very sizzling dress. He is out of words. She also organizes a candlelight dinner for him where Chote Sarkar serves them with good food and wine. Mallika interrupts and spoils their mood. Anjis parents quarrel over Anji and Dr. Ranganaths relationship.

episodesList.title: Ashutosh Pampers Nidhi
episodesList.summary: Ashutosh showers love on Nidhi. He applies nail polish on Nidhis nails and pampers her. Dadi Bua checks on Mallika when suddenly she wakes up from a bad dream and shouts. Ashutosh comes to her rescue. Dadi Bua is not fine with this. Dr. Ranganath meets his parents chosen girl and fumes in anger.

episodesList.title: Nidhi's Fear
episodesList.summary: Dadi Bua asks Ashutosh not to go close to Mallika. But Ashutosh is adamant to let Mallika stay with them. Mallika tells her story to Ashutosh. He feels disgusted and helpless. Colonel Verma comes to know about the argument that happened at Ashutosh's place. Baba assures him that he will sort out this confusion.

episodesList.title: Best Friend at Stake
episodesList.summary: Ashutosh apologizes to Nidhi for being rude and decides to send Mallika back to the hospital. Dr. Ranganath is fed up with this girl chosen by his parents. Anji and Nidhi have a plan to convince and impress Anjis parents. She asks Dadi Bua and Chote Sarkar for help.

episodesList.title: Gaon Ki Gori
episodesList.summary: Nidhi stops Mallika from leaving her house. Dr. Ranganath is very upset and tired of his parental drama. Ashutosh is impressed with Nidhi's gesture. He apologizes to Dadi Bua for his rudeness. Nidhi meets Anji and sorts out her mess.

episodesList.title: Mallika Wreaks Havoc
episodesList.summary: Anji asks Nidhi to come along as a support. She prepares to meet Dr. Ranganath's parents in the temple. The meeting goes quite well. Mallika wreaks havoc in the house on seeing Ashutosh and Nidhi's marriage pictures. Nidhi gets upset to see the torn pictures. Baba and Hiraman Kaka calm her down.

episodesList.title: Troubled Situation
episodesList.summary: Nidhi is tensed because of Mallika. Anji calms her down. Ashutosh has no option but to help his friend who is in dire need of care. But this does not go down to well with Nidhi.

episodesList.title: Choice to Be Made
episodesList.summary: Nidhi is tired of Mallika's antics. Mallika is trying to intrude between Ashutosh and Nidhi in the name of her ill health. Will Ashutosh be able to understand Nidhi's state of mind?

episodesList.title: Mallika Is Evil
episodesList.summary: Mallika is normal but is playing her evil games to separate Nidhi from Ashutosh. Nidhi blindly believes that she is unwell and gives her the best care. What is next on Mallika's mind? Will Nidhi be able to find out about her evilness?

episodesList.title: One Month Anniversary
episodesList.summary: Ashutosh and Nidhi make plans to go for dinner and celebrate their one-month anniversary. Mallika tries to stop them from going and succeeds. Moments later, Ashutosh's surprise, makes Nidhi happy.

episodesList.title: Mallika's Intrusion
episodesList.summary: Mallika tricks Nidhi and accuses her of torturing her in front of Ashutosh. Ashutosh quarrels with Nidhi but makes her understand. Nidhi calls Dadi Bua and discusses it with her.

episodesList.title: Medicine Overdose
episodesList.summary: Mallika acts crazy. Ashutosh asks Nidhi to give her an injection. Nidhi does as ordered. Mallika gives an overdose to herself to put Nidhi in trouble. Ashutosh and Baba troll Nidhi for this.

episodesList.title: Playing Safe
episodesList.summary: Anji's doubts prove to be true. Mallika is faking her illness. Nidhi is shocked to see this. Dr. Ranganath's parents express their wish to meet Anji's parents. Anji & Nidhi plan to play evil games with Mallika now.

episodesList.title: Mallika Confuses Baba
episodesList.summary: Anji's parents get ready to meet Dr. Ranganath's parents. Nidhi shares her problem with Baba. He understands her problem but Mallika's gestures confuse him. Ashutosh again quarrels with Nidhi.

episodesList.title: Parents Meet
episodesList.summary: Nidhi talks Baba into sending Ashutosh with her to Anji's place. Everyone gathers at Anji's place to discuss Ranganath and Anji's alliance. Solanki doesn't like Ranganath's family. Mallika keeps calling Ashu but Nidhi doesn't pick up her calls.

episodesList.title: Mallika's Deliberate Attempts
episodesList.summary: Mallika is again up to some mischief. She urges Ashutosh to blast the daylights out of Nidhi's life. Baba also supports Ashutosh. Nidhi leaves the house in anger and seeks Anji's help.

episodesList.title: Warning Alarm
episodesList.summary: Ashutosh is upset with Nidhi. Anji comes for Nidhi's rescue. Nidhi apologizes to Mallika and warns her to be careful. No matter what, Nidhi will fight for love and not let Mallika ruin her and Ashutosh's bond.

episodesList.title: Shock Treatment
episodesList.summary: Nidhi decides to make Mallika taste her own medicine. Anji and Nidhi make plans to show Mallika's true side to everyone. Mallika is in tension and fears Nidhi might take her away from her so-called best friend Ashutosh. What is going on Nidhi's mind?

episodesList.title: Picnic Turned Torture
episodesList.summary: Mallika plans to kill Nidhi. She asks Ashutosh to take her to the hilltop. Nidhi, on the contrary, makes a picnic plan. Anji and Ranganath also join. At the picnic spot, Ashutosh & Nidhi enjoy a happy rain dance when Mallika's sound interrupts their moment.

episodesList.title: Nidhi's Life at Stake
episodesList.summary: Mallika orders high dose medicines. She talks Baba into checking her room so that she can collect the parcel. She waits for the right moment to use those tablets to harm Nidhi. Ranganath finds out about this and calls Nidhi & Ashu to inform them.

episodesList.title: Mallika's Sin
episodesList.summary: Mallika dissolves sleeping pills in Nidhi's food. Anji notifies Nidhi about it. Nidhi then refuses to eat the food. She wreaks havoc in the house. Ashutosh tries to eat the food kept on Nidhi's plate to prove her wrong, but to his surprise, Mallika confesses her sin.

episodesList.title: Mallika Leaves
episodesList.summary: Mallika leaves the house. Ashutosh apologizes to Nidhi. Later, everyone enjoys their moments at Anji's place. Anji and Dr. Ranganath's parents happily agree for their alliance.

episodesList.title: Imagination Brings a Smile
episodesList.summary: Nidhi and Ashutosh are happy again. Ashutosh decides to go back to the hospital again. Nidhi wishes to have a cozy moment with Ashu but he is in a hurry to go. Nidhi imagines being close to Ashu and smiles. Ashutosh meets a baby in the hospital and thinks of talking to Nidhi about it.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Joins Kotnis Hospital
episodesList.summary: Nidhi joins Kotnis Hospital. She hesitates as her fellow interns have become full-fledged doctors. She hopes to get the kids department but gets the hospitality duty. She is shocked.

episodesList.title: Dr. Ranganath Explains the Duty
episodesList.summary: As Nidhi is back in the hospital, Dr. Ranganath explains her all the duties and responsibilities she has to carry. But she is in deep thought as she wants to talk to Dr. Ashutosh urgently, and ignores Dr. Ranganath's talk.

episodesList.title: Dr. Ashutosh Is Shocked
episodesList.summary: Dr. Ashutosh gets a message when he is in his hospital regarding a transaction. He is super shocked to see that someone made a transaction of 1 lakh rupees. He gets angry as he thinks Nidhi shopped for that big an amount. How will he react?

episodesList.title: Baba Warns Dr. Ashutosh
episodesList.summary: Dr. Ashutosh looks for Nidhi in the whole house. Baba asks him whether Nidhi informed him or not that she is going for the sangeet and will only come after the wedding. When Ashutosh denies, Baba warns him to sort out all the differences between them.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Misses Dr. Ashutosh
episodesList.summary: While attending the sangeet, Nidhi starts missing Dr. Ashutosh. She wants to meet him and leaves for home from the sangeet ceremony. Both, Dr. Ashutosh and Nidhi accepts that they were missing each other.

episodesList.title: Dr. Ashutosh Dances for Nidhi
episodesList.summary: Everybody performs for Dr. Ranganath and Anjali's sangeet ceremony. But suddenly, Dr. Ashutosh gets offended and says that no one asked him to dance. He puts himself forward and asks Nidhi for her hand as he wants to dance for her. Nidhi stands shocked.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Pranks on Dr. Ashutosh
episodesList.summary: Nidhi and Anjali plan to prank Dr. Ashutosh. As soon as Dr. Ashutosh enters the room, Nidhi puts color on his face, with which he gets angry. Everyone gets upset in the room and Ashutosh slightly yells at Nidhi. It all turns out bad.

episodesList.title: Dadi Bua Gets Impatient
episodesList.summary: Everyone is working on decorating the house. Still, Dadi Bua gets impatient and yells at everyone for working slow. She starts instructing everyone strictly. Nidhi makes her understand and calms her down.

episodesList.title: Awkwardness Among Everyone
episodesList.summary: Dadi Bua starts again with her one and only mantra of having grandchildren. She makes it awkward for Dr. Ashutosh, Nidhi, and everyone around as she keeps on insisting them to have a child. She is eagerly waiting for a grandchild so that she can enjoy her grandparenthood.

episodesList.title: Dr. Nidhi's Pile of Responsibilities
episodesList.summary: Dr. Nidhi follows Dr. Ashutosh everywhere as she wants the child department. But he insists her to take up Dr. Ranganath's responsibility until he rejoins the hospital. As soon as she enters the cabin, Dr. Nidhi is shocked to see the pile of files she has to complete.

episodesList.title: Alone Time After a Long Time
episodesList.summary: After a very long time, Nidhi and Dr. Ashutosh get some alone time. They prefer to have breakfast together and spend the day in a jolly mood. They talk about the misunderstandings and differences they had so that it gets sorted.

episodesList.title: Dr. Ashutosh's Grand Birthday
episodesList.summary: Nidhi plans a surprise for Dr. Ashutosh as it is his birthday by decorating the house with candles and flowers. Dr. Ashutosh is super surprised to see all the decoration, gifts, and notes.

episodesList.title: Serious Competition for Dr. Ashutosh
episodesList.summary: Nidhi gets the whole hospital decorated for Dr. Ashutosh's birthday. He is very happy but also thinks that he should give Nidhi something in return too. He is concerned as he thinks he will too willl have to plan something huge and equally grand for Nidhi. What will he plan?

episodesList.title: Dr. Ranganath in a Romantic Mood
episodesList.summary: Dr. Ranganath and Anjali are on their honeymoon trip. And, he tries to be romantic but Anjali keeps on pulling his leg. He tries his best to give Anjali the best moments and express his love for her in every possible way.

episodesList.title: Dr. Mallika in Serious Danger
episodesList.summary: A strange person enters the hospital and yells on top of his voice that he is not going to leave Dr. Mallika. She will have to repay for her doings. He threatens Dr. Ashutosh as well. Nidhi freaks out and asks him to inform Dr. Mallika about it.

episodesList.title: Dr. Ashutosh Speaks His Heart Out
episodesList.summary: Nidhi again starts asking Dr. Ashutosh to give her the childrens' ward. But Ashutosh reacts in a different way. Nidhi insists him to talk his heart out, talk about his feelings, and basically talk about what he wants.

episodesList.title: Elders Give Their Advice
episodesList.summary: Dadi Bua suddenly enters Ashutosh's house and asks Mathurji about what is going on in his house. Initially, he jokes around but later he discusses the matter with Dadi Bua. What advice will they give to Dr. Ashutosh and Nidhi?

episodesList.title: Dr. Ashutosh in Dilemma
episodesList.summary: Dr. Ashutosh visits the hospital for a surgery where Mallika is admitted as a patient. He enquires about Mallika and gets to know that she is in need of the utmost help. He is confused if he should offer her help or not. Will he help her out of humanity?

episodesList.title: Love Is in the Air
episodesList.summary: A bright sunny day and Dr. Ashutosh does not want to get up until he sees Nidhi. He keeps calling her name and asks her to be by his side. Nidhi comes shying with all the love. It seems like love is in the air.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Gets Over Concerned
episodesList.summary: Dr. Ashutosh informs Nidhi that he will have to shift Dr. Mallika to a safer place along with a trustworthy person. Nidhi gets overly concerned as she is scared that Dr. Mallika will again enter Ashutosh's life. On the other hand, Dadi Bua is still waiting for a response from Nidhi.

episodesList.title: Dr. Ranganath Is Back
episodesList.summary: Nidhi straightforwardly says it to Dr. Ashutosh that she wants a happy life and that there is no space for Dr. Mallika in it. He agrees to what Nidhi says and agrees to it too. Dr. Ranganath is back in the hospital and Nidhi hands him all his responsibilities.

episodesList.title: Anjali Needs Advice
episodesList.summary: Anjali visits Nidhi in the hospital as she wants some advice from Nidhi. Whereas, Nidhi without even listening, starts giving her solutions when she does not even know Anjali's problem. Anjali wants a job and asks Nidhi for help.

episodesList.title: Anjali Gets Pranked
episodesList.summary: Nidhi requests her father to give Anjali a job in his business. Nidhi's father readily agrees to it but they all decide to prank Anjali by giving her hints that it might be difficult for her to work with him.

episodesList.title: The Unavoidable Scene
episodesList.summary: Nidhi witnesses Dr. Ashutosh meeting Mallika in the hospital. She gets agitated and leaves the hospital in anger. Anjali tries to comfort Nidhi but she yells at her too and asks her to get out of the house or she will end the friendship.

episodesList.title: Dr. Mallika in Kotnis Hospital
episodesList.summary: Mallika's health deteriorates and Dr. Ashutosh decides to take her to Kotnis hospital. But Mallika refuses as she is tensed about Nidhi. Dr. Ashutosh, against her will, takes Malika to the hospital. Nidhi is in shock to see Mallika back in the hospital.

episodesList.title: Words That Hurt
episodesList.summary: There is a tiff between Dr. Ashutosh and Nidhi. She wants to leave the house and to which Ashutosh also agrees. He is also fed up with Nidhi's childish behavior. Nidhi is disheartened and cannot bear such harsh words.

episodesList.title: Dadi Bua Is Mistaken
episodesList.summary: Nidhi decides to finally leave the house and stay at her own house with his Dadi Bua and father. Dadi Bua is mistaken that Nidhi has come to meet them. Will they agree with her in this decision?

episodesList.title: The Bestfriends Talk
episodesList.summary: Someone gives a missed call to Dr. Ashutosh from Nidhi's mobile. When he calls back, Nidhi gets excited but he says the wrong number and hangs up. Anjali is unable to see Nidhi in this situation and tries to talk to her.

episodesList.title: Date, Not a Date
episodesList.summary: Dr. Ranganath arranges a date for Dr. Ashutosh and Nidhi. But everything is very weird between them. Even sitting together, they are not talking to each other. Is ita date? Or it is not a date?

episodesList.title: Dr. Nidhi's Illogical Decision
episodesList.summary: Dr. Nidhi finds a stranger in a shootout and tries to help him. Despite the passers-by warning her that it is a police case, she still takes him to the hospital. Dr. Ashutosh yells at her that this illogical decision of hers can put them in danger.

episodesList.title: Dr. Ashutosh Gets Jealous
episodesList.summary: Amar calls Nidhi in the middle of the night just because he wanted to see her. Nidhi gets angry and warns him to stay out of her personal life. Dr. Ashutosh overhears them talking and gets jealous as well as super angry.

episodesList.title: Dr. Ashutosh Enquires the Injured
episodesList.summary: Dr. Ashutosh and Dr. Ranganath together question the injured, Mr. Amar. He keeps on joking around, which infuriates Dr. Ashutosh. He loses his calm seeing this callous attitude of Amar and warns him to cooperate with them or he will have to call the police.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Has a Secret Lover
episodesList.summary: Amar starts liking Dr. Nidhi and he is not willing to leave the hospital. he starts making excuses so that he can stay back in the hospital. Dr. Ashutosh is understanding what Amar is feeling. Will this create another issue?

episodesList.title: Nidhi Gets Caught in Her Act
episodesList.summary: Dr. Nidhi finds Dr. Ashutosh's car in the parking lot. She finds him sleeping in his cabin but then he wakes up and questions Nidhi why is she here. Dr. Ashutosh informs Nidhi that he knows whatever game she is playing and making a fool of the intern.

episodesList.title: Dadi Bua Tries to Fix
episodesList.summary: Dr. Ashutosh and Nidhi are not talking to each other at all. Dadi Bua is concerned about her and becomes restless. She wants to talk to Nidhi so that she sorts out all the differences.

episodesList.title: Amar's Lie Is Out
episodesList.summary: Amar's report is out and it comes out that he himself removed the stitches from his body and is not taking the medication properly. Dr. Ashutosh discusses it with Dr. Ranganath as he knows Nidhi will not accept it if he gives her the report.

episodesList.title: Dr. Ashutosh Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: Kaka calls Nidhi in the middle of the night to inform that Dr. Ashutosh has not reached home. Nidhi gets concerned and starts calling him but unfortunately, she is not able to reach him. She, Anjali, and Dr. Ranganath, all together search for him.

episodesList.title: Dr. Ashutosh Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Everyone including the police starts searching for Dr. Ashutosh. Among all this chaos, Nidhi gets a call saying that wherever Dr. Ashutosh is, the person will find him out. Is it the kidnapper who calls or a well-wisher?

episodesList.title: Nidhi and Dr. Ashutosh Reunited
episodesList.summary: Nidhi finally manages to find Dr. Ashutosh. But it's such a chaos between the kidnappers and policemen, that somehow Dr. Ashutosh gets hit by a bullet and faints. Nidhi and the family is left in a shock.

episodesList.title: Dr. Ashutosh Joins the Dots
episodesList.summary: Nidhi writes various riddles for Dr. Ashutosh, so that he understands what her heart wants. He starts solving those riddles and slowly joins all the dots she was giving as hints.

episodesList.title: Nidhi's Birthday Celebrations
episodesList.summary: It is Nidhi's birthday and everyone surprises her with cards and cakes. Anjali insists Dr. Ashutosh to dance for Nidhi but he refuses. Nidhi requests him that it will be a birthday gift if he dances.

episodesList.title: The Confidential Case
episodesList.summary: Dr. Ashutosh, Dr. Ranganath, and Dr. Nidhi are called for an emergency in the hospital. But it turns out that CM and his son wants to talk something. But they insist that it is a confidential case and do not want to discuss with anyone other than Dr. Ashutosh himself.

episodesList.title: The Terms and Conditions
episodesList.summary: Dr. Ashutosh is being strictly warned to not disclose any information about CM's health issues. They force him to do the operation alone secretly and threaten with several terms and conditions.

episodesList.title: Team Work Pays Off
episodesList.summary: CM is being operated at Kotnis Hospital. But gradually he loses his pulse and doctors are not able to do anything. CM's son starts shouting on top of his voice and again threatens Dr. Ashutosh and his team. Will they be able to save CM?

episodesList.title: Nidhi Gets the Designation
episodesList.summary: Nidhi successfully helps Dr. Ashutosh in operating the CM. And with this success, Dr. Ashutosh designates Nidhi as the senior doctor. And it is time for celebration and a new beginning.

episodesList.title: Someone Is in the House
episodesList.summary: Nidhi is suspicious that someone is there in her house and she wants to find it out. She spreads a bait by fake calling Anjali. She is sure about her instinct. Will she able to find who is there in the house?

episodesList.title: Dr. Ashutosh's New Friend
episodesList.summary: While returning home, a strange girl comes in front of their car. He helps the injured girl by treating her with medicines. They get along while he treats the little girl and is impressed with her bossy but cute nature.

episodesList.title: Nidhi and Khushi Get Along
episodesList.summary: Dr. Ashutosh gets Khushi to his house and Nidhi is surprised to see this. Nidhi narrates the story to Ashutosh but he insists on letting Khushi stay at their house. Nidhi catches Khushi stealing chocolates but surprisingly they sit to have a chat and get along easily.

episodesList.title: Dr. Ranganath Stressed
episodesList.summary: Nidhi gives her number to Khushi and asks her to call if she needs any help as she is going to the hospital for work. Dr. Ashutosh finds Dr. Ranganath in serious mode and asks him about the matter. He is stressed about Anjali and her behavior.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Helps Khushi
episodesList.summary: Nidhi sits with Khushi while she is drawing things on a paper. After noticing her drawing, Nidhi asks her about her house, mother, so that she can help her out to find her mother and reunite them together. Does Khushi remember anything?

episodesList.title: Ashutosh in a Chef Mode
episodesList.summary: Dr. Ranganth appreciates Nidhi for her work and the efficiency with which she works. Dr. Ashutosh is in a chef mode as he wants to try cooking noodles for Nidhi and Khushi. will he be successful?

episodesList.title: Is There Any Connection
episodesList.summary: Khushi starts playing a game with Baba and Hiramann and makes them run in the whole house. When they give up on catching her, she warns them to lose weight. Dr. Ashutosh contacts the police when he sees Khushi calling a policeman his father. Is there any connection between them?

episodesList.title: Khushi Bribes Dr. Ashutosh
episodesList.summary: Khushi does not allow Ashutosh and Nidhi to leave for work and insists them to stay back at home. Dr. Ashutosh makes her understand to be a good girl but she bribes him by saying that she wants something in return.

episodesList.title: A Romantic Night
episodesList.summary: Dr. Ranganth is very busy as he is working on a critical case. But Anjali tries to lure him by being romantic. Dr. Ranganath tries avoiding her but fails miserably. Anjali's father overhears them talking about his critical condition.

episodesList.title: Khushi - A Family Member?
episodesList.summary: Dadi Bua calls Nidhi to invite both of them for Navratri puja at their house. Nidhi is upset while talking as they got a call from the police to return Khushi back to them. Khushi has become so close to everyone that it will hurt when she leaves.

episodesList.title: Ashutosh's Family in Trouble
episodesList.summary: Khushi leaves the house without informing anyone and this makes them go restless. By that time the police enters to take Khushi. But when they find that Khushi goes missing, they charge Ashutosh and family for carelessness and warns them. Is the family in trouble?

episodesList.title: Khushi Shifted to an Orphanage
episodesList.summary: Dr. Ashutosh, Nidhi, and Baba finally decide to shift Khushi in a home shelter orphanage. But Ashutosh is asked not to visit her daily because it will become her habit and gradually a problem for her.

episodesList.title: Anjali Wants a Baby
episodesList.summary: Khushi comes back to Ashutosh and Nidhi and insists on staying with them. They all finally agree. Anjali, on the other hand, tells Dr. Ranganath that she wants a baby and that she has promised her father too.

episodesList.title: Dadi Bua or Khushi?
episodesList.summary: Dadi Bua does not like Khushi and her being around during the Navratri puja. Dr. Ashutosh and Nidhi have an argument and she asks him to let this matter stay away from Dadi Bua for a while.

episodesList.title: Navratri Puja Celebration
episodesList.summary: It is Navratri puja time and Nidhi's family serves food to little girls in their house. Dadi Bua serves food to Khushi as well, but she starts showing tantrums which irritate Dadi Bua a lot.

episodesList.title: Khushi Wins Dadi Bua's Heart
episodesList.summary: Dr. Ashutosh romantically surprises Nidhi by preparing breakfast for her. Khushi enters the puja room to steal ladoos but instead finds Dadi Bua's saree on fire. She somehow sets out the fire by pouring water on it. Dadi Bua thanks her and accepts her happily.

episodesList.title: Ashutosh Understands Nidhi
episodesList.summary: Dadi Bua is not stopping with the thought that she wants a grandchild. Nidhi firmly tells her that it is not possible at all now. Nidhi discusses this matter with Ashutosh so that Dadi Bua does not bother him. He clearly supports Nidhi's decision.

episodesList.title: Mischevious Khushi
episodesList.summary: Khushi is upset because Dr. Ashutosh is not talking to her properly. She thinks Nidhi has said something bad about her. Khushi plans to teach Nidhi a lesson and tries to pour oil on the floor so she slips.

episodesList.title: Khushi or Kashish
episodesList.summary: The police get a lead about Khushi's family. Meanwhile, Nidhi tells the whole story behind Khushi's wicked mind, how she tried to harm her, but fortunately failed. Ashutosh gets angry and asks Khushi to confront him.

episodesList.title: Tough to Decide
episodesList.summary: Finally, Khushi's relatives come to Ashutosh's house to take her back to Dehradun. But Khushi insists and requests to not let her go. It becomes more difficult for Ashutosh. Khushi is down with a high fever. Will Ashutosh let her go?

episodesList.title: Khushi Reveals the Truth
episodesList.summary: Khushi ultimately reveals the truth about her relatives. She tells Ashutosh that they make her work all day, do not give her food, and neither do they keep her properly. She begs him to save her.

episodesList.title: A Surprise Awaits Khushi
episodesList.summary: Khushi decides to go to Dehradun instead of staying in Lucknow. Dr. Ashutosh requests Khushi's relatives to keep her with utmost love and care. Ashutosh plans a surprise for Khushi. Watch to find out.

episodesList.title: Khushi Bids Farewell
episodesList.summary: It is time for Khushi to go back to her relatives. They start torturing her right from Lucknow but no one is able to witness that. Ashutosh and Nidhi start missing her as soon as she leaves. But Nidhi gets to know some truth.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Gets to Know
episodesList.summary: Nidhi gets to know from Khushi's grandmother, the truth about her relatives. She feels helpless and calls Ashutosh to inform the police about the fraudsters. They rush towards the station to save Khushi. Will they be successful?

episodesList.title: Finally Reunited
episodesList.summary: Nidhi and Ashutosh try hard to find Khushi, but they are unable to find her. Nidhi gets to know from people and heads towards the jungle. But she gets stuck in a dig hole. Will Asutosh reach on time to save her?

episodesList.title: Diwali Celebration Time
episodesList.summary: Nidhi, Dr. Ashutosh, and family are now tensed as they have to decide something for Khushi. Ashutosh is not ready to let go of Khushi now. So he changes the topic and decides to make this Diwali the happiest one for Khushi. Nidhi, too, plans something for Khushi.

episodesList.title: And the Celebration Continues
episodesList.summary: Nidhi invites some of the interns and doctors to her house for Diwali. They start playing various games as it has always been a ritual at Nidhi's place.

episodesList.title: Anjali Hospitalised
episodesList.summary: Anjali gets hospitalized suddenly when she feels pain in her stomach. Everyone in the family gets concerned and rush to the hospital. Is Anjali in a serious problem?

episodesList.title: The Bitter Truth
episodesList.summary: The shocking news hits everyone deep when they come to know about Anjali's failed pregnancy. Everyone tries to console Anjali and Dr. Ranganath but nothing helps. Khushi finally manages to light up Anjali's mood.

episodesList.title: Khushi's Adoption
episodesList.summary: Nidhi and Ashutosh think of giving Khushi for adoption to Anjali and Dr. Ranganath. Dr. Ashutosh meets Dr. Ranganath to talk about it and he readily agrees. Khushi overhears Nidhi and Ashutosh talking about it. How will she react to it?

episodesList.title: Khushi at Anjali's Place
episodesList.summary: Khushi says a no when asked to stay with Anjali and her family. Everyone tries to convince her and give her various reasons. Finally, she agrees but puts her condition of staying back with them only for a week.

episodesList.title: Dr. Ashutosh's New Trouble
episodesList.summary: Dr. Ashutosh is welcomed with a new stranger in his cabin. He gets annoyed at the new intern as she talks more than required. Anjali decorates a new room for Khushi, seeing which she goes crazily happy.

episodesList.title: Dr. Nidhi vs. Dr. Dubey
episodesList.summary: Dr. Dubey, secretary of Kotnis Hospital, gets angry at Dr. Nidhi for keeping her cabin lights on. Dr. Nidhi starts arguing with Dr. Dubey when he yells at her to follow the rules. Who will win the argument?

episodesList.title: Dr. Ranganath Tries to Bribe
episodesList.summary: Aditi tries to fix things between Dr. Ashutosh and Dr. Nidhi, but he avoids it completely. Later he realizes and looks for Nidhi. Dr. Ranganath tries to bribe Dr.Dubey by offering him his favourite snacks so that he accepts the apology.

episodesList.title: Khushi Becomes Anjalis Assisstant
episodesList.summary: Its been one week for Khushi at Anjali's place. Dr. Ashutosh and Nidhi come to take Khushi back. But instead, they are surprised when Khushi tells them that she wants to stay here for a few days more. Khushi is assisting Anjali in making her designs.

episodesList.title: Allegations on Dr. Ashutosh
episodesList.summary: Dr. Dubey calls for an urgent meeting and calls all the senior doctors in the hospital. He puts allegations on Dr. Ashutosh that he is equally flirting with a female doctor in the hospital. He gets offended and firmly says it is beyond hospital rules. Who is this female doctor?

episodesList.title: Dr. Nidhi Requests Dr. Dubey
episodesList.summary: Dr. Dubey changes the shift timings for all the doctors in the hospital. She goes and apologizes to him for all the mischiefs she had done in the past. As soon as he accepts the apology, Nidhi requests him to not change the timings for all.

episodesList.title: New Rules and Regulations
episodesList.summary: Dr. Dubey sets new rules and regulations for the hospital and its staff. He is determined that each and every member of the hospital will agree to him, as he is doing it for the betterment of the hospital. Will everyone agree?

episodesList.title: Dr. Nidhi Breaks a Rule
episodesList.summary: Dr. Ashutosh gets too busy in the meeting and does not reach home on time. Nidhi gets angry as they miss the movie. Nidhi wants the patient to have his own home-made food which is against the new rule. Will she break this rule?

episodesList.title: Good News for Dr. Nidhi
episodesList.summary: Dr. Dubey informs Dr. Ashutosh that there is going to be a seminar and they have to send a doctor from their hospital. Dr. Dubey selects Dr. Nidhi as the candidate and asks Ashutosh to give her the news.

episodesList.title: Tiff Between Dr. Ashutosh and Dr. Nidhi
episodesList.summary: Dr. Ashutosh gets to know about the rules broken by Dr. Nidhi. He is extremely angry and yells at Nidhi for breaking the rules as it may have affected the patient. He is annoyed with Nidhi's callous behavior.

episodesList.title: Aditi and Dr. Nidhi Get Along
episodesList.summary: Dr. Ashutosh and Dr. Nidhi are not in talking terms with each other because he has yelled at her. Aditi notices Dr. Nidhi in an upset mood and tries to know the matter. Gradually, they get along well.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Prepares Dinner for All
episodesList.summary: Unaware about each other's plan, Dr. Ashutosh invites Dr. Dubey and Dr. Nidhi invitse Aditi for dinner at their home. Nidhi is alone and she has to prepare dinner for all. How will she manage?

episodesList.title: Dr. Dubey Gets Unwell
episodesList.summary: Aditi mixes baking soda instead of salt and nobody is aware that Dr. Dubey is allergic to it. He starts getting rashes all over his body as soon as he finishes his dinner. But Nidhi takes all the blame on herself and this creates a difference between Ashutosh and Nidhi.

episodesList.title: Finally Admitted
episodesList.summary: Nidhi and Ashutosh want to apologize to each other but they are unable to do so. Aditi gives Nidhi an idea of how to say sorry in an innovative way. Finally, they admit their mistakes to each other.

episodesList.title: Dr. Ashutosh Flirts With Nidhi
episodesList.summary: Baba does not feel well which makes Ashutosh concerned about him. Dr. Ashutosh does not leave a space in the room without praising Nidhi. He flirts with her when he sees Nidhi in saree.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Wants to Raise Funds
episodesList.summary: Nidhi disagrees with her colleagues, and comes up with an idea for Dr. Ashutosh regarding fundraising for their new wing in the hospital. Dr. Ashutosh agrees initially but when he sees Dr. Dubey denying it so he also denies it along with him.

episodesList.title: Ashutosh Obsessed With Himself
episodesList.summary: One morning, Ashutosh starts getting obsessed about his looks. He gets concerned if he is gaining weight or not. Does he have to join the gym to get six-pack abs? He starts exercising and gets hurt on his neck. Will he continue gymming?

episodesList.title: Dr. Dubey Defeated
episodesList.summary: Dr. Dubey gets a letter while he is having a discussion with Dr. Ashutosh and Dr. Ranganath. The letter says that the hospital trustee allows the doctors and senior staff to organize a fashion show. Dr. Dubey feels defeated.

episodesList.title: Preparations Are On
episodesList.summary: As soon as all of them get a green card for the fashion show, everyone starts practicing their walks. Dr. Dubey is not happy with this and he yells at everyone to work during their shift hours. Gradually, everyone backs out. Will the fashion show take place?

episodesList.title: Busy Bee, Nidhi
episodesList.summary: Nidhi takes full responsibility for the fashion show. She becomes busy as she has to arrange the decorators, choreographers for the participants, and many more things. She does not get a single minute for anyone.

episodesList.title: Is It a Happy New Year?
episodesList.summary: Nidhi is busy with all the preparations as its the New Year. She realizes it when Dr. Ashutosh wishes her good luck and a better career. She instantly lights the whole room with candles for Ashutosh. Lastly, they get a news that the showstopper met with an accident.

episodesList.title: The Show Stoppers
episodesList.summary: A mishap happens at the last moment when their showstopper does not turn up. Everyone is super tensed as they have limited time. Dr. Nidhi requests Dr. Ashutosh to be their show stopper. Will he agree to this?

episodesList.title: Baba Collapses in the Show
episodesList.summary: Nidhi and her team win a huge sum of money from the charity for their hospital. Dr. Dubey is in shock when he hears the amount. But suddenly Baba collapses in the show and is rushed to the hospital for a check-up. Will he be detected with any disease?

episodesList.title: Baba Diagnosed With Tumor
episodesList.summary: Nidhi's father and Dadi Bua come to visit Baba in the hospital. Nidhi is waiting for the reports and as soon as she receives it, she goes in shock. She is scared as to how to inform Dr. Ashutosh about it. How will Ashutosh handle this news?

episodesList.title: Ashutosh Becomes Restless
episodesList.summary: Ashutosh is unable to handle himself. He is having sleepless nights and becomes restless as he cannot wait for the morning. The next day, he gets to know from neurosurgeons that Baba has only a few months left. This makes Ashutosh panic as this is unbelievable for him.

episodesList.title: Truth Finds Its Way
episodesList.summary: Baba asks Dr. Ashutosh and Dr. Nidhi about his reports. They hesitate to tell him the truth. They lie to Baba about his health condition. But, he is able to witness the truth in Ashutosh and Nidhi's eyes. How will Baba handle this?

episodesList.title: Nidhi Surprises Baba
episodesList.summary: It is Baba's birthday and Ashutosh and Nidhi both are planning something special for him. Nidhi makes some calls and arranges a surprise for Baba. When Ashutosh arrives in the hospital he finds both of them are not there. Will Ashutosh get angry on Nidhi for this?

episodesList.title: Nidhi's Surprise Backfires
episodesList.summary: Ashutosh reaches the temple where Nidhi has planned a surprise for Baba. Initially, he acts normal with everyone but later he gets angry at Nidhi for getting Baba out of the hospital. He asks her to act normal in front of Baba. The reports from London have arrived and it holds the ultimate truth.

episodesList.title: Whose Opinion Matters?
episodesList.summary: Dr. Ashutosh gets to know that Baba also knows about his illness. There is a rare chance that he will live after the operation. The question comes when Ashutosh and Nidhi are on different boats. One wants him to get operated with that little chance while the other wants him to live those few months as Baba wants.

episodesList.title: Dr. Ashutosh's Application Declined
episodesList.summary: Baba wants to stay at home and finally, Dr. Ashutosh also agrees on it. Nidhi wants to stay at home with Baba so she puts up her application for holidays. When Ashutosh also applies for holidays, Dr. Dubey denies it completely.

episodesList.title: A Gift for Anjali
episodesList.summary: Dr. Ashutosh gets a sigh of relief when Baba decides on not getting operated. Nidhi gets upset as she wanted baba to get well by taking a chance. Dr. Ranaganath surprises Anjali by presenting her a new car.

episodesList.title: Decision Has Already Been Taken
episodesList.summary: Nidhi and Dr. Ashutosh inform Baba that he has to take radiation therapy today. But he denies it and is adamant with his decision of not taking it. How will they convince baba to take the radiation?

episodesList.title: Old Is Gold
episodesList.summary: Nidhi asks Baba what he wants in life for them. He wants to cook food for them, so he prepares dinner for all. Baba's friend comes to visit him and they request him to play his old style harmonium. Nidhi and Ashutosh are happy to see their father happy.

episodesList.title: Baba's Lost Love
episodesList.summary: Nidhi tries to convince Dr. Ashutosh to bring ack Baba's lost love so that it helps him to heal a little bit. She sneaks into his room and tries to find information about her. Will Ashutosh agree to get Aradhnaji for Baba?

episodesList.title: Dr. Nidhi's Humble Request
episodesList.summary: Dr. Nidhi lies to dr. Ashutosh that she is going for a friend's wedding but instead goes to Allahabad to contact Baba's friend. Aradhna denies when Nidhi requests her to come along with her as Baba is unwell. What will Nidhi do next?

episodesList.title: It Finally Happened After Years
episodesList.summary: Aradhna changes her mind and comes to Lucknow to visit Dr. Mathur, a.k.a Baba. Nidhi and Ashutosh are shocked to see her. Baba is very happy to see Aradhna and they sit down to solve all their misunderstandings.

episodesList.title: Nidhi's Wish Matters
episodesList.summary: Baba is going for his radiation therapy, but Aradhna tells him that Nidhi wanted him to get operated even when there is a 5 percent chance. Baba gives a second thought to his decision and decides to fulfill Nidhis wish of getting operated. Ashutosh stands against this decision.

episodesList.title: Things Turn Out Bad
episodesList.summary: As Ashutosh stands against everyone's decision, Aradhna tries to convince him but instead gets insulted by Ashutosh as he asks her to stay away from their family matters. Baba gets an attack which leaves him unconscious.

episodesList.title: Do or Die Situation
episodesList.summary: Dr. Ashutosh and Nidhi admit Baba in the hospital as his condition worsens. Dr. Nidhi gets a call from Dr. Vincent that he is still stuck and will not be able to reach India. It's a do or die situation For Dr. Ashutosh as he is the only one now who can operate Baba.

episodesList.title: Operation Day
episodesList.summary: The day has finally when Dr. Ashutosh has to operate his Baba. He dreams that he was not able to save him. Everybody makes him believe that he can do it. But lastly, some mishap happens. Watch to know what happened.

episodesList.title: A Sigh of Relief
episodesList.summary: Ashutosh is successful in operating Baba. Everybody takes a sigh of relief and pray for his better health. Dr. Ashutosh and Dr. Nidhi keep Baba under observation for another 12 hours.

episodesList.title: Dr. Ranganath Accused
episodesList.summary: A week later, Baba is back at home. Everybody welcomes him with good wishes. Dr. Ranganath is asked to reach the hospital immediately. He has been accused by a pharmacy for taking the bribe. How will he remove this false accusation?

episodesList.title: Termination Letter for Dr. Ranganath
episodesList.summary: While coming to the hospital, Nidhi was mobbed by a stranger because of which she gets offended. Dr. Ranganath shows his termination letter to Dr. Ashutosh that he is being fired. Everyone is shocked and decides to complain about it.

episodesList.title: Police Raids Ranganath's House
episodesList.summary: Anjali and Dr. Ranganath are having a tough time. Nidhi comes to tell them what they saw in the hospital's CCTV camera. Suddenly, the police raid Ranganath's house to find the bag which had bribe money. Will the police find the bag and arrest Dr. Ranaganth?

episodesList.title: Nidhi's Secret Admirer
episodesList.summary: Daksh decorates Nidhi's cabin with flowers to impress her but is disappointed when he comes to know that Dr. Ashutosh is her husband. He apologizes to them and offers help to save Dr. Ranganath from the false charges.

episodesList.title: Good Deed or Bad Deed?
episodesList.summary: Daksh contacts the pharmacy company and does a sting operation to get evidence by fitting a camera in his shirt. But unfortunately, one of the employees catch hold of them. Daksh and Ashutosh get into a fight with them. Does Daksh have some personal motive in helping them?

episodesList.title: It's Valentines Day
episodesList.summary: Dr. Ashutosh asks for help from Dr. Ranganath as it is valentine's day and he wants to surprise Nidhi. Ashutosh plans for a romantic date and a surprise for her. Daksh is planning something else on the other hand. Watch the episode to know what happens.

episodesList.title: Daksh's Evil Plan
episodesList.summary: Dr. Ashutosh's car gets stuck while they were heading back for their home. Daksh offers help as he also wants to be with Nidhi on Valentine's day. Daksh asks Nidhi to come along with him as he wants to surprise someone with his gift. They are unaware of Daksh's evil plans.

episodesList.title: Nidhi Unaware of the Truth
episodesList.summary: Daksh plans to get Nidhi in his court. He convinces Nidhi to go with him and narrates her a fake story. Aradhna's daughter finally agrees on getting operated in Lucknow at the Kotnis Hospital.

episodesList.title: Daksh Plans His Own Accident
episodesList.summary: Aradhna gets her daughter to the hospital but everyone feels awkward with Divya's arrogant behavior. Daksh plans his own accident so that he can get Dr. Nidhi at his home. Will Nidhi understand this?

episodesList.title: Twists and Turns
episodesList.summary: Daksh notices Aradhna (who is also his mother) leaving the hospital. He tries to follow her but loses her in the traffic. It seems that Divya has started liking Dr. Ashutosh as she wants to wait for him to return and have dinner with him.

episodesList.title: Deadly Intentions
episodesList.summary: Daksh calls Nidhi in the middle of the night but to his surprise, Ashutosh picks the call. Daksh's father does not believe when he says that he saw Aradhna. He later witnesses her himself and makes some calls to harm Aradhna.

episodesList.title: Shooter on Sight
episodesList.summary: Nidhi is well aware of Divya's intentions. She knows that Dr. Ashutosh is more than a doctor for Divya. This makes her worried. The shooter comes on sight to shoot Aradhna but suddenly Nidhi comes in between and falls on the ground.

episodesList.title: Ashutosh's Master Plan
episodesList.summary: A bullet slightly misses Nidhi but it injures her ear slightly. Ashutosh gets to know from Baba that there was a bullet outside their house. Ashutosh plans something so that he is able to catch the shooter as he might try again.

episodesList.title: Photos That Shock Nidhi
episodesList.summary: Daksh contacts an old acquaintance of his and plots her as Ashutosh's assistant for the medical conference. Daksh shows Nidhi Ashutosh's cozy picture with the girl. How will Nidhi react to this?

episodesList.title: Daksh's Dirty Move
episodesList.summary: Daksh is disappointed when he gets to know that Ashutosh is not getting affected by the girl. He asks her to mix some medicines in his food so that they can blame him for something that he has not done. Senior doctors boycott him from the medical conference.

episodesList.title: Dr. Ashutosh Terminated
episodesList.summary: Dr. Ashutosh is accused of molesting his assistant during the medical conference. The hospital trustees terminate Dr. Ashutosh from his duties and ask him to leave the hospital immediately. Nidhi slaps Daksh as he tried to provoke her against Ashutosh.

episodesList.title: A Strange Call
episodesList.summary: Nidhi and Ashutosh plan something to know the truth. They head towards the meeting but suddenly Nidhi gets a strange call from an unknown person who asks for medical help. Ashutosh's assistant accepts that she lied and gets arrested.

episodesList.title: Dr. Ashutosh Fights Daksh
episodesList.summary: Daksh fake calls Nidhi and asks her to come in an isolated house to take revenge. Nidhi unknowingly gets stuck and is in danger. She calls Dr. Ashutosh to come and help her as Daksh is trying to molest her. Will he reach on time?

episodesList.title: Aradhna and Divya Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Aradhna leaves Ashutosh's house with her daughter Divya without letting anyone know. On the way, their car is stopped by kidnappers who kidnap them as they have been ordered. Who wants Aradhna dead so badly?

episodesList.title: Hospital Welcomes Dr. Ashutosh
episodesList.summary: Everything ended on a good note. Daksh apologizes for his mistake and requests Aradhna and Divya to live with him. Dr. Ashutosh is welcomed back in the hospital and along with that, he is promoted as the MD of the hospital. Will he accept the offer?

episodesList.title: Ashutosh - The Planning Master
episodesList.summary: Dr. Ashutosh decided to take a break from everything and spend some quality time with Nidhi. He calls Dadi Bua to know Nidhi's favorite dish as he wants to surprise her. What is Ashutosh planning this time?

episodesList.title: Nidhi and Ashutosh's Anniversary
episodesList.summary: Nidhi plans a surprise for Anjali s she is expecting a baby. Dadi Bua again discusses with Nidhi that she too should have a child. It's Nidhi and Ashutosh's anniversary and she decides to surprise Ashutosh. What will she give him as a surprise?

episodesList.title: Old Memories Cherished
episodesList.summary: Nidhi and Ashutosh go out for lunch as it is their anniversary. But instead, land up at their favorite tea stall. And cherish all the memories they have spent together in the past year.

episodesList.title: Is the Result Positive?
episodesList.summary: Nidhi doubts that she is pregnant. She does a pregnancy test too and it comes out positive. The deal is who is going to tell the family members that Nidhi is pregnant. But Ashutosh gets a call from the hospital that makes him shocked.

episodesList.title: Everyone Consoles Nidhi
episodesList.summary: Ashutosh breaks the news to Nidhi that the result was false. This news breaks Nidhi's heart and she blames herself for it. Ashutosh makes her understand and calms her down.

episodesList.title: Back to the Hospital
episodesList.summary: Nidhi decides with Ashutosh that they should start going to the hospital. It is becoming difficult for Nidhi to work. She explains her situation to Ashutosh.

episodesList.title: Bonfire Nights
episodesList.summary: Nidhi makes her new duty schedule which keeps her busy the whole day. Ashutosh keeps waiting for her for lunch, then later on in the car. Lastly, they sit together in the night in front of the bonfire and have a wonderful night.

episodesList.title: Restless Nidhi
episodesList.summary: Nidhi again doubts that she is pregnant when she pukes in the night. Right in the morning, she goes to the hospital for the final report. The news is positive and Nidhi tells it first to Anjali. She wants Ashutosh to guess the news.

episodesList.title: All Is Well That Ends Well
episodesList.summary: It is a festive day and the whole house is decorated as it is Holi. Nidhi plans to surprise Ashutosh but instead, he surprises Nidhi by decorating the whole room with cots and toys. They give this happy news to the family in a very dramatic way. Everyone yells in happiness as it is the reason to be happy.

title: Diya Aur Baati Hum
summary:
Diya Aur Baati Hum (transl.  We Are the Lamp and the Wick) is an Indian television soap opera that aired on StarPlus from 29 August 2011 to 10 September 2016 comprising 1,487 episodes. It was produced under Shashi Sumeet Productions starring Anas Rashid and Deepika Singh.
Set on the backdrop of Pushkar, Rajasthan, Diya Aur Baati Hum focused on breaking the stereotypical image of women in rural India by showing the inspirational journey of Sandhya Rathi, whose ambition is to become an IPS officer. She achieves her goal with the help of her husband, Sooraj, by going against all odds.
A sequel series, Tu Sooraj Main Saanjh, Piyaji starring Rhea Sharma and Avinesh Rekhi, aired from 3 April 2017 to 1 June 2018.
plot:
Ambitious and educated, Sandhya Kothari aspires to fulfill her dream of being an IPS officer for her father Arvind. Sooraj Rathi, a partially-educated and simple young master-confectioner is the perfect elder heir to his middle-class traditional family in Pushkar, Rajasthan. Later, Sandhya is shattered as her parents die in a terrorist attack. Her brother Ankur fixes her marriage to Sooraj whose strict mother, Santosh, wants a simple and uneducated daughter-in-law, with the excellent skills of a housewife. So, Ankur lies about Sandhya's education level and hides the truth about Sooraj to her.
Giving up her education and dreams, Sandhya marries Sooraj. Learning the truth about Ankur's lies Sandhya is disappointed and her distant behaviour confuses Sooraj. Despite initial struggles she gradually bonds with Sooraj seeing his Kind and patient nature. As soon as her truth of being educated and not knowing household skills is revealed, Santosh hates her. Sooraj stands up for her and vows to help Sandhya become the daughter-in-law Santosh wants. Sandhya goes through many troubles but manages to win Santosh's acceptance and with time falls in love with Sooraj. She helps Sooraj win an international cooking competition in Singapore and manages to save Pushkar from a terrorist attack. She forgives Ankur who in order to rectify his mistake helps Sooraj learn about Sandhya's IPS dreams. Despite Santosh being against it Sooraj helps her complete her studies and after facing various challenges manages to convince Santosh to accept her dreams.
Sandhya faces challenges in IPS Academy, establishing as an extraordinary police officer. She struggles to balance between her professional duties and domestic responsibilities but with Sooraj help she is successful. Together with Sooraj, Sandhya forms a relationship with underlying love which is put to test after battling Raj Kumar (a terrorist whose allies hijack the plane which Sooraj and Santosh are travelling in) but emerge victorious. She donates one of her kidneys to Santosh battling for life after the attack, a fact which the family later learns. Ankur's daughter Bulbul greatly wishes for a sibling but his wife Ankita miscarries and is unable to conceive again. Sandhya, expecting twins, decides to give their one twin to Ankita. Eventually, she delivers twin sons Ved and Vansh who get kidnapped. In the rescue, Ved is saved and the unfound Vansh is presumed dead, shattering all. A police officer saves and returns Vansh though promptly. Ankur ends his relationship with Sandhya and takes Vansh with him feeling that Vansh can never be truly theirs otherwise.

episodesList.title: Sandhya's IPS dream
episodesList.summary: Even as a child, Sandhya is fearless and intelligent, and aspires for a career in the civil services. Flash forward ten years to a grown up and studious Sandhya, seen preparing for her IPS exam. But her brother Ankur wants to marry her off! Will she knuckle under or stand up for herself

episodesList.title: Sandhya's name in a wedding card
episodesList.summary: Sandhya convinces Ankur that she is not ready for marriage. Meanwhile, Bhabho is worked up about Sooraj’s wedding and wants to get the wedding cards on time. Sandhya shops at a boutique owned by Sooraj’s would be sister-in-law, and by mistake, her name gets printed on the card!

episodesList.title: Bhabo is furious
episodesList.summary: When Mohit plans to arrange an orchestra for Sooraj's wedding, Babho disapproves of it saying it is too expensive. Later, Babho and Sooraj go to the temple to offer the first wedding invitation to God. However, the card bears Sandhya's name! What does God have in mind for Sooraj and Sandhya?

episodesList.title: Bhabho is shocked to see the card
episodesList.summary: Mohit asks Bhabho about the change in the bride's name! Meenakshi sees Sandhya’s name on the card and is shocked. She apologises to the would be in-laws. Later, Sooraj replaces the name on the card. But surely, this 'error' must have some hidden meaning!

episodesList.title: Sooraj buys a gift for Kavita
episodesList.summary: Ankur tells his family that he has got a job in the US. He tells his wife Ankita that he can’t take her along, and she is upset about this. Meanwhile, Suraj goes to a jewellery shop and gets a present for Kavita. Will Bhabho find out about this secret present?.

episodesList.title: Bhabho is angry with Sooraj
episodesList.summary: Although Sooraj dutifully takes on the responsibility of his house, the entire family condemns him for his act. While Bhabho calls him names, his siblings criticise Sooraj. Meanwhile, Sandhya and her family question Ankur about leaving Ankita back in India. However, Ankur’s revelation shocks her!

episodesList.title: Sooraj tries to pacify Bhabho
episodesList.summary: When Sooraj asks Bhabho to eat, she rudely asks him to throw away the jewellery he bought for his fiancé. Meanwhile, Chauhan tips off Arvind and others about an impending terrorist attack and asks them to be careful. Why isn't Sooraj allowed any independence?

episodesList.title: Kanchan dies in the blast
episodesList.summary: A scared Bhabho informs everyone that Sooraj could be at the blast site. Meanwhile, Sandhya’s parents are injured in the blast and taken to the hospital in Sooraj’s truck. Later, a doctor announces that Kanchan is dead. Meanwhile, Sooraj gets a call from Sandhya. Are they going to meet now?

episodesList.title: Sandhya cremates her parents
episodesList.summary: While Sooraj is busy with his wedding preparations, the doctor informs Ankur, Ankita and Sandhya about their parents' death. Later, the siblings cremate the their parents and Sandhya is disconsolate. Will all her dreams for a bright future crumble now?

episodesList.title: The missing bride
episodesList.summary: During the preparations for the wedding, Bhabho and Sooraj share an emotional moment. Later, the family leaves for Ajmer. On reaching the venue, they are shocked to find out that the bride is missing! What a disgrace! How will they accept this humiliation?

episodesList.title: Sooraj Consoles Bhabo
episodesList.summary: Santosh curses the bride’s family for tarnishing their reputation. Later, when Meenakshi offers her food, she refuses to eat. While a heartbroken Sooraj tries to make peace with himself, Sandhya asks Ankur to face the situation with courage.

episodesList.title: The neighbours tease Santosh
episodesList.summary: Sooraj consoles Santosh that the marriage broke for his good as the bride must have been in love with someone else. Later, in a bid to pep him up, Santosh allows Sooraj to open his shop. Meanwhile, Ankur pledges that he will take over his father's responsibilities.

episodesList.title: Ankur under pressure
episodesList.summary: The neighbourhood women tease Sooraj and Santosh about the broken marriage. Infuriated, Santosh tells them that she will get her son married just in 15 days time! Meanwhile, Ankur is shocked to hear that his junior is being sent to the US instead of him. Will he take up a desperate step now?

episodesList.title: Row over Sandhya's marriage
episodesList.summary: Ankur is worried as he does not want to miss an opportunity to work in the US. Later, he tells Ankita that he wants to get rid of all his responsibilities by marrying Sandhya off in 15 days. Is he being selfish? What lies in store for Sandhya?

episodesList.title: Sandhya accuses Ankur
episodesList.summary: Sandhya overhears Ankur talking to Ankita about her marriage. Meanwhile, Santosh asks Kisna to find a match for Sooraj and promises her an expensive gift. Later, Ankita has a fight with Ankur. She too thinks he is being too hasty. In this haste, will Ankur find the right boy for Sandhya?

episodesList.title: Ankur meets Kisna
episodesList.summary: Kisna informs Ankur that Sandhya cannot marry Sooraj as his family is not looking for an educated girl. Meanwhile, Sandhya accuses Ankur of treating her as a burden. Will that change Ankur’s mind? Or will he go ahead with his decision to free himself from this burden?

episodesList.title: Ankur calls Sandhya selfish
episodesList.summary: Kisna persuades Ankur to consider an alliance between Sandhya and Sooraj. She brainwashes him and tells him to lie to Sooraj’s family. Meanwhile, Ankur calls Sandhya selfish for not letting Ankita go with him! What will Sandhya do now?

episodesList.title: Ankur visits Sooraj's shop
episodesList.summary: Kisna informs Santosh that Ankur will be coming to their house to see Sooraj. Ankur visits Sooraj’s shop to buy sweets and gets baffled by the  narrow-mindedness of his family. Will he still want Sooraj to marry Sandhya?

episodesList.title: Santosh meets Sandhya
episodesList.summary: Kisna hides Sandhya’s educational qualifications from Santosh. Later, Santosh meets Sandhya and asks her if she can handle household work. Household work? Has Sandhya ever done any? Is she going to let go of her dream career?

episodesList.title: Sandhya agrees to marry Sooraj
episodesList.summary: After Sandhya's approval, Santosh declares that Sooraj's marriage has been fixed. While Kisna is elated about the happy ending of her ploy, Meenakshi is not that joyful. What is the reason?

episodesList.title: Santosh plans grand arrangements for  Sooraj's marriage
episodesList.summary: Santosh shares her happiness with Sooraj. Santosh instructs everyone to do grand arrangements for the marriage as she wants everyone to be jealous. Family members play with Sooraj and tell him that the bride is not good looking. Sooraj recognizes Sandhya as he sees her photograph. Sandhya leaves for her exam after her pre marital ritual.

episodesList.title: Sooraj’s Pre-marital Rituals
episodesList.summary: Santosh performs Sooraj's pre-marital rituals. While Sandhya struggles to finish her exam on time, Santosh asks Meenakshi to pay a quick visit to Sandhya's house to check if everything is fine. What excuse will Ankur come up with regarding Sandhya?

episodesList.title: Sooraj Leaves To Marry Sandhya
episodesList.summary: When Sandhya saves Santosh’s pride in front of the guests, it impresses her. As Sandhya gets set to marry Sooraj, she apologises to her parents for not fulfilling their dream. Sooraj leaves with his family for the marriage but is he ready to welcome Sandhya into his life?

episodesList.title: Ankita's Fallacy Breaks
episodesList.summary: After Sooraj arrives at the marriage hall with his family, Chaturi reveals in front of Ankita that Sooraj is not a MBA graduate. Will Ankita ask Ankur for a clarification?

episodesList.title: Sooraj And Sandhya Get Married
episodesList.summary: Sooraj gets married to Sandhya. At the time of the marriage rituals, Sooraj promises to take care of Sandhya for the rest of his life but what is going on in Sandhya’s mind?

episodesList.title: Flood in Sooraj’s House
episodesList.summary: During the marriage rituals, Sandhya drops the apology letter that she wrote to her father in the fire. Later, Sooraj's family members panic when they find their house flooded with water. Will Santosh welcome the newlywed couple to her house?

episodesList.title: Santosh Welcomes Sandhya
episodesList.summary: Santosh welcomes Sandhya to her new house. Meenakshi and Chhavi tease Sandhya as Sooraj is waiting for her in his room. Due to the bad state of Santosh’s room, Babasahab and Santosh cannot sleep there. Where will they sleep?
