title: Adaalat
summary: Adaalat (transl. The Court) is an Indian television courtroom drama anthology series about a defence attorney, K. D. Pathak (Karanveer Damyanti Pathak), portrayed by Ronit Roy. The first season of the show premiered on Sony Entertainment Television on 20 November 2010 and ran for five years, ending on 11 July 2015. The show aired 431 episodes in its first season. Adaalat returned for its second season on Sony Entertainment Television on 4 June 2016 and ended on 4 September 2016. The show aired 26 episodes in its second season.
plot:
Adaalat follows K.D. Pathak, a defense lawyer known for his sharp intellect and unconventional methods in the courtroom. The series centers on his efforts to defend clients accused of serious crimes, often taking on cases that appear to be hopeless.
K.D. is characterized by his analytical thinking, attention to detail, and commitment to uncovering the truth. Each episode typically presents a self-contained case in which he exposes flaws in the prosecution's arguments and identifies the real culprit. While he uses creative strategies and at times employs theatrical courtroom demonstrations, his ultimate goal is to ensure that justice prevails rather than simply securing acquittals.

episodesList.title: Superstar Ki Hatya
episodesList.summary: A producer Dhiren Shah is upset with Superstar Rehan Khan. Rehan Khan is shot by Dhiren Shah. Maya, a lawyer is sure that she will win the case as he is in custody and the evidence is clear. But KD aims to uncover the rumours and find the truth. Can KD win the open and shut case?

episodesList.title: Bank Mein Chori
episodesList.summary: Namdev works as a clerk in a bank and was given an amount but he was robbed by a person. The witness to the crime is dead. Namdev loses his job at the bank. Will K.D. Pathak help Namdev to get his job back with dignity?

episodesList.title: C.I.D. Officer Abhijeet Adaalat Mein
episodesList.summary: Inspector Abhijeet is arrested for killing Gangster Zoravar. CID is asked not to interfere. K.D. Pathak comes in to help with a solution. He believes there is a twist in the tale. Will K.D. Pathak succeeded in saving senior CID officer Abhijeet?

episodesList.title: Neend Ki Bimari Ya Qatl Ka Bahana
episodesList.summary: Nirmal Madhok gets killed. He owns a resort with Arjun and his third partner Kailash. Kailash demands for 50% share and Nirmal isn’t okay with it. Arjun is blamed for it. What will K.D. Pathak do to save Arjun?

episodesList.title: Jaadugar Ki Khooni Talwar
episodesList.summary: In a magic show, Lucy the assistant of Magician Marco gets killed with a real sword. Everyone is baffled by it. The other two assistants Sapna and Jagat were present in the audience while this was happening and so was Magician Gogo present in the audience. KD has to save Marco, will he be able to?

episodesList.title: K. D. Ki Jung Supreme Court Mein
episodesList.summary: K.D. Pathak has a case against the Supreme Court regarding the bomb blast in Sunshine's old age home. He has only 36 hours to prove that the accused, Nooruddin is innocent. Will he win the case?

episodesList.title: Qatl Ka Khel
episodesList.summary: In a badminton court, Devindar Sodhi the coach of Sonali Baruah, gets killed. Sonali is taken into custody but doesn't want KD to fight her case. How will this case turn out to be?

episodesList.title: Mukhyamantri Ka Qatil Kaun
episodesList.summary: Jagan is unemployed so Chandu's friend gives him work. He gives him the idea of robbing the bungalow that belongs to the Chief Minister Niranjan Sahai who gets killed and the entire blame is on Chandu. Will K.D. Pathak save Chandu from this crime?

episodesList.title: Jhooth Ka Sach
episodesList.summary: In Stockholm Scam, there were many personalities involved. There were politicians, government officials and other dignitaries. This information is known to Swami Agnidev. He gets killed in a room filled with five people and Trishika is the one found near the body. KD Pathak has a task in hand to save Trishika, will he do what it takes?

episodesList.title: Wafaadar Kutte Tintin Ka Bayaan
episodesList.summary: In a case, Major Shantanu Roy is arrested for the murder of Richard Lobo. The case escalates as a strong defence lawyer has evidence against Shantanu. What will K.D Pathak do now?

episodesList.title: Circus Mein Qatil Kaun
episodesList.summary: In Ringo Circus, Madan's uncle blackmails people. Dolly, Akbar, Babloo, and Zabisco all were upset with him. They fear losing their jobs due to Madan. The owner of the circus, Madan gets killed and Babloo is the only suspect. Will KD be able to save Babloo?

episodesList.title: Qatil Aatma Adaalat Mein
episodesList.summary: A haveli is being converted by Subir and his friend business partner Vikas to a 5-star hotel. There is a rumour that there is a ghost, Ghost Amrapali who is very dangerous and gets killed. Who killed him?

episodesList.title: Qatil Pyaar
episodesList.summary: Valentine’s Day is being celebrated in a club. Manav Karla organised it and invites his friends, Varsha, Vikram, Riya, and Mukul. There is a problem within, where poison is mixed in the drink. People in the club suspect Varsha. Will KD help her out in the case?

episodesList.title: Qatil Boxer
episodesList.summary: In a boxing match, two rivals are onto each other punching. It is Tejas Yadav versus Dharam Kumar. Lavanya bets on Dharam Kumar instead of her boyfriend. But in the ring, Tejas Yadav gets killed. It seems that there were nails used in the gloves. How will KD get down to the case?

episodesList.title: Theatre Mein Qatl
episodesList.summary: While watching a film in a theatre, Deepa is shot. No one knows how, who and why. KD Pathak is up against little to no clues to close the case. How will he do it?

episodesList.title: Giant Wheel Par Qatl
episodesList.summary: Bandiya fears for his life as he is supposed to share important information with Inspector Vishwanath Rana in regard to a big racket of drugs. He wants to be on the Giant Wheel. But gets killed Rana is the suspect. Will K.D.Pathak save Rana?

episodesList.title: K. D. Pathak Zinda Dafan
episodesList.summary: Standing in the graveyard, Flabia Gomes is sad looking at her Aunt Cynthia Gomes's grave. She finds a big crack on the tombstone and urges the people to dig her out. She is shocked by the sight of it. She finds her husband Mario's body was buried. K.D. Pathak receives a call from an unknown person not to fight this case. Will KD Pathak take up the case?

episodesList.title: 345 Kilo Ka Qatil
episodesList.summary: Prince Rudy Singh Dhanora's ex-girlfriend, Sharmila Rathore gets killed in her mansion. Everyone including the investigation officer is questioned in the court of law. Prince Rudy attends the session from home due to being overweight. How will KD solve the case?

episodesList.title: Gumnaam Qatil
episodesList.summary: The flight of K.D. Pathak is delayed. A new flight is sent by J.K. Singhal the founder of Singhal group of companies. In the flight, the Pilot and Writer et killed. The doubt of murder comes on Sheetal as she was present all the time near the murder. Will K.D. Pathak save her friend Sheetal?

episodesList.title: K. D. Pathak Jail Mein
episodesList.summary: Dilawar Singh is to be hung. But before hanging someone mixes poison in his dinner. The whole blame comes from chef Chandan Singh. Chandan's teacher Surbhi takes help from K.D Pathak. K.D. reaches jail to find out the actual reason. Will he save Chandan Singh?

episodesList.title: Lift Mein Qatl
episodesList.summary: In a lift, Mukul Bhagat along with his brother Sanjay and 5 others are moving up. Mukul Bhagat gets killed with a screwdriver in the lift. All the scrutiny goes on his brother. Will KD settle the case?

episodesList.title: Qatil Murti
episodesList.summary: The owner of the art gallery gets murdered. The blame goes on the sculptor, Amrit Nagpal. KD Pathak has a case in hand where he has to save poor Amrit Nagpal. How will KD help him through?

episodesList.title: Iqbal-E-Jurm
episodesList.summary: In a series of events, a famous photographer Jagtap Tiwari gets killed. In retaliation, Father Martin gets arrested. The famous Bharatnatyam Dancer comes to KD to seek help. How will KD get hold of the case?

episodesList.title: Begunaah Ghode Ka Kissa
episodesList.summary: In a racing sport, Shalimar, a horse owned by Thapar loses in it. He orders the stable boy, Charan to kill it. He later even hurts the jockey, Cyrus Dastur. His maid and daughter stop him not to hurt the horse, but he doesn't listen to them. KD Pathak must help Shalimar.

episodesList.title: Jalpari
episodesList.summary: Madhukar Vaidy is a businessman who deals with fish for a living. He isn't a nice man to work with. At a clinic, two women encounter each other. They happen to be the wives of the same man, Madhukar. He gets killed on a boat named Jalpari. One of the wives is accused, will KD help her out?

episodesList.title: Raaton Ka Raja Saamri
episodesList.summary: While shooting for a TV show, a co-actor is dead. Vaibhavi gets killed by a vampire and "The Great Saamri" is arrested for the crime. KD Pathak has a tough case in hand, will he be able to solve the case?

episodesList.title: Kissa Don Ke Khoon Ka
episodesList.summary: The accused in this case is all doomed. The case is open and shut and the prosecution won't leave anything behind. KD has a heavy task in hand and tries to solve the case in the best possible manner.

episodesList.title: Flat Mein Qatl
episodesList.summary: A doctor gets killed in his house next to his fiancé. She seeks KD's help. There are various angles to look at the case. Prior to the death, there was a fight with a neighbour and a witness still lives, who happens to be a thief. How will KD manage the case?

episodesList.title: Kissa Builder Ke Qatl Ka
episodesList.summary: While running a marathon, Rohan Madwa gets arrested. He is accused of killing his girlfriend, Sheena. Things go out of control, as Sunidhi one of Rohan's seeks KD's help in the case. How will KD be able to save Rohan?

episodesList.title: Kissa Builder Ke Qatl Ka
episodesList.summary: On a construction site, Captain Saroj Modakh fights with his best friend Prem Bharadwaj. Prem dies falling from the building. Captain Saro has a reason it seems. Is Prem's murder an accident or a murder?

episodesList.title: K. D. VS K. D.  Part 1
episodesList.summary: This is the most thrilling episode where there is a twin of K.D Pathak committing crimes

episodesList.title: K. D. VS K. D.  Part 2
episodesList.summary: KD Pathak is in jail for the murder. Nothing seems to work for him at this point in time. But help comes walking, that is, Ranawat. Something seems off in the case. They find shocking details of the case. Will KD come out of jail?

episodesList.title: Maut Ka Pyaala
episodesList.summary: A lot goes into committing a crime. But a crime where a woman named Mahulya dies after drinking tea at home. KD has a task in hand, to find the killer and to bring justice to the family. Will the family get justice?

episodesList.title: Samundar Mein Khoon
episodesList.summary: Two divers named, Ramakant and Parag were sent underwater to see what was stuck. They find a net that is stuck underwater. But Parag dies and the whole blame goes on Ramakant. Will KD Pathak solve the case?

episodesList.title: Raaz Angry Colonel Ke Khoon Ka
episodesList.summary: There is a whooping property of 90 crore rupees for Koyal with her uncle Rt. Col. Manek Dhanrajgir is the official caretaker. The Colonel refuses to give money to Koyal as she has not completed 25 years and then the Colonel gets killed. Who killed Rt.Col. Manek Dhanrajgir?

episodesList.title: Super Model Ki Hatya Ka Kissa
episodesList.summary: A Supermodel Neharika is dead. All the suspicion goes to Darji Saleem, as a trophy is found that belongs to Neharika. Darji Saleem is arrested. Is he the murderer?

episodesList.title: Qatil Kaun Part 1
episodesList.summary: While having a debate on the National Television channel, a fight breaks out. There is a call threatening Rajat Roy the host of the show. He gets fatally shot in the abdominal area. Before dying, Rajat Roy mentions Raghuveer's name, and everyone thinks that Raghuveer is the one who shot Rajat Roy. Is he the real killer?

episodesList.title: Qatil Kaun Part 2
episodesList.summary: The case continues as there is another murder. KD Pathak is up against a dreadful killer. He has to figure out what is happening. Will things fall in place for him to investigate?

episodesList.title: Khoon Ki Dastak
episodesList.summary: Urja Seth a psychic who is accused of killing Sonal. She doesn’t understand why she is being accused. She seeks help from KD. Will KD help her out?

episodesList.title: Khoon Ka Rishta
episodesList.summary: A jeweller is dead in his shop, lying on his desk. All the jewellery is missing too. The cops arrest the front desk woman. KD feels to be different. Will KD crack the case?

episodesList.title: K. D. Pathak Ko Chunauti
episodesList.summary: A man with a gun walks into KD's office. He wants KD to save a girl who will be murdered. The killer challenges him to save her. KD fails to do so. What will KD's fate be like?

episodesList.title: Kissa Hostel Suicide Ka
episodesList.summary: A case confuses everyone, where a girl leaves a suicide note and is dead. A professor is arrested on the basis of accusations. KD thinks the professor is innocent. Will KD prove his innocence?

episodesList.title: Pyaar Ke Naam Qatl-E-Aam
episodesList.summary: An actress gets killed by her boyfriend. This is what everyone seems to claim. Her boyfriend is an Underworld Don. He seeks help from KD Pathak. Will KD Pathak help the Underworld Don?

episodesList.title: Murdaghar Khoon Ka Raaz
episodesList.summary: In one case, a nurse, Varsha is heading towards the morgue with a dead body when she hears noises. She seems scared but the next moment, photojournalist Pranav is dead. Who killed him and why?

episodesList.title: Kissa Qatil Shekhar Ka
episodesList.summary: Ria gets arrested in the murder of her husband Saahil. Ria puts the blame for her husband's death on his close friend Shekhar. Security guard Govind discloses that he never saw Shekhar on the premises. Ria claims that he was in Chennai but the evidence proves that he was in the building. Who killed Saahil?

episodesList.title: Comedian Ya Qatil
episodesList.summary: In a strange series of events, comedian Aarti Sinha is angry with  Mr Kishen Chawla who refuses to pay. She to have picked up the scissor but she didn't kill him. Who killed Mr Chawla? Will K.D.Pathak save Comedian Aarti Sinha?

episodesList.title: Kissa C.M. Ki Secret List Ka Part 1
episodesList.summary: There was going to be a revelation with few names with evidence on 'Independence Day from the Chief Minister. These people were involved in the Nandrao land scam. Shooter Makhan kills Journalist Bryan Parreira during a press conference. Shooter Makhan called CM on his cell phone before shooting Bryan and thus CM Rao gets arrested. Will K.D. Pathak succeed in saving the Chief Minister of India?

episodesList.title: Kissa C.M. Ki Secret List Ka Part 2
episodesList.summary: All the evidence is collected by K.D. Pathak. He visits the CM's office. K.D. briefly collects information about CM and inquiries about his daily routine. Will he be able to prove him innocent?

episodesList.title: Masoom Gawah Part 1
episodesList.summary: Paras is a child who has seen his mother, Sudha being killed. The boy's nanny Maria has been arrested. Paras also draws a picture of the lady who resembles the nanny. KD Pathak has a task in hand to save the nanny. Will he be able to?

episodesList.title: Masoom Gawah Part 2
episodesList.summary: There is an attempt to kill Paras. He is safe in KD's office. Inspector Dave finds a truck in the middle of the forest. They find a dead body in it. How will KD Pathak solve the case?

episodesList.title: Letter Bomb Murder
episodesList.summary: A murder takes place, where Rachana Bhasin gets killed. The blame goes on Munshi Shyamchand Srivastava. He is the senior-most employee in her Father's firm. He was also handed over 100 crores. Will KD Pathak be able to save Munshi?

episodesList.title: Chashmadeed Gawah Tota
episodesList.summary: KD Pathak is up against a fortune-telling parrot. Usha Mishra visits K.D.Pathak's office and tell him that her daughter Geeta Mishra will be arrested in the murder of her stepfather Sanjay Madhok. The dead body was found in Sanjay's Lonavala farmhouse. Parrot reveals the truth in the court that Geeta murdered Sanjay. How will K.D. Pathak save Geeta?

episodesList.title: Kissa Taxi Murder Ka
episodesList.summary: Sanjay is found murdered in his house. The sole eyewitness in the case is a Parrot. Based on this, the police arrest Geeta, who is the prime suspect in the case. How will KD Pathak prove Geeta's innocence? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Shraddha 50
episodesList.summary: A Novelist gets arrested in the murder of Industrialist Arjun Kapoor's wife Megha. Her real name happens to be  Pooja. The Novelist Rajiv discloses to K.D.Pathak that Pooja wanted him to keep an eye on her husband and for that, she was ready to pay him 2 lakh rupees per month. WiIl K.D Pathak finds out the real killer of Pooja?

episodesList.title: Mystery Of The Alarm Clock
episodesList.summary: Ramnish the son-in-law of Dr Ashok Sandhu gets murdered. Ramnish's wife  Rashi expresses her doubts. Rashi and Dr Sandhu reveal to K.D Pathak that they haven't killed Ramnish. How will K.D. Pathak prove Dr Sandhu innocent?

episodesList.title: K. D. In Ahmedabad
episodesList.summary: Dakshaben's tiffin is extremely popular in Gujrat Ahemdabad. Khemmji bhai who is a jewellery owner was her regular client to whom she used to sent him food. It was Dakshaben's daily process of sending food to various clients. K.D.Pathak visits Ahemdabad. Thief Ghattu reveals his robbery to cops and also discloses that Dakshaben had send him to robb Kheemji bhai and also promised that she would divide the money. Will K.D. Pathak prove Dakshaben innocent? Who killed Kheemji bhai? Will he solve the puzzlee of real Ghee?

episodesList.title: Pyaar Ya Insaaf Part 1
episodesList.summary: A doctor gets killed in his clinic. A professor gets arrested for it. It is also informed that he was following the professor for 2 years. Will K.D Pathak save the professor?

episodesList.title: Pyaar Ya Insaaf Part 2
episodesList.summary: In this case, KD Pathak gets tensed about the professor who talks about poetry instead of the knife that is used. They find a harmonica in the body of the deceased. KD Pathak is also bound as he is kidnapped, not able to solve this case. What will happen now.

episodesList.title: Black Magic Murder Part 1
episodesList.summary: Dr Firdos Balsara visits K.D Pathak's office with a request to save his close friend Ankit Luthra who got trapped in a murder. Dr Balsara also reveals that Ankit is the murderer but during the murder, he was suffering from black magic and that black magic made him kill his Business Partner Kapadia. The court does not believe in black magic. How will K.D Pathak prove Ankit innocent?

episodesList.title: Black Magic Murder Part 2
episodesList.summary: Dr. Firdos Balsara attacks Ankit in the court with a knife. K.D.Pathak mentions the reason behind Dr. Balsra's act and reveals that he did not have any control over his mind and excatly same thing occured with Ankit. Varun records a solid proof. K.D.Pathak gets a shock when he see's the footage and also calls forensic doctor Rastogi who reveals that a substance was mixed in his water. Will Court believe K.D.Pathak? Who forced Ankit to kill Kapadia? What will K.D.Pathak do now?

episodesList.title: Double Death
episodesList.summary: K.D Pathak is shocked as his assistant Varun tells him that Dr Susheel Bharti called him. Dr Bharti has been dead for the past 3 years. Varun visits his clinic and informs her wife about the incident who later forces Varun to leave. Dr Bharti is already dead in a plane crash so how come his body is found in a Blue Pearl cottage. How will KD solve the case?

episodesList.title: Jhoota Qatil
episodesList.summary: Inspector Dave arrests famous Builder Wadhwa's son Rahul Wadhwa for killing Siddhant Rastogi but Rahul denies the accusations. K.D.Pathak gets shocked in the court as all the witnesses change their statement in the court. Will K.D.Pathak prove Rahul Innocent? Who killed Siddhant Rastogi?

episodesList.title: Ramleela Mein Qatl
episodesList.summary: During the Ramleela play Vimal as Ravan gets killed by Diwakar as Ram with a pointed arrow. Diwakar's girlfriend and Vimal's sister Varsha is shocked as she gets to know that his brother is dead. Director Vijay who has been directing Ramleela for 7 years reveals that he was not good at shooting arrows and also reveals that Vimal was not at all happy with Varsha and Diwakar's affair. Will K.D.Pathak save Diwakar?

episodesList.title: Qatil Dandiya Night
episodesList.summary: It is the night of Navratri where everyone is playing Dandiya. But someone is up to something not so auspicious. There is the murder that takes place. A girl dies and points her finger towards the suspect. But things are not as easy as they seem to be. KD Pathak has a task in hand, to solve the case with earnest.

episodesList.title: Raaz Chauthe Chor Ka
episodesList.summary: Three robbers try to rob a bank. The next day, a robber gets killed. The whole blame goes onto an old man who had nothing to do with the robbery. Will KD Pathak save the old man?

episodesList.title: Faraar
episodesList.summary: Rohan and Mukesh are in the midst of a deal with Harpal about the Crown which has a 50 crore price. Harpal wants that Crown at a small price but Mukesh denies it. When he reaches home, he gets killed. Who killed Rohan and why?

episodesList.title: Dave Hiraasat Mein Part 1
episodesList.summary: Inspector Dave arrests a weapon Smuggler named Manan who later dies in jail and the whole blame for Manan's murder comes on Inspector Dave as few constables and criminals saw Dave brutally beating Manan in the jail. Dave later informs K.D.Pathak but a big trouble arises as K.D.Pathak gets kidnapped just before the case hearing. Will K.D.Pathak succeeded in reaching on time?

episodesList.title: Dave Hiraasat Mein Part 2
episodesList.summary: Inspector Dave gets extremely upset as K.D.Pathak fails to reach on time to save him from the crime which he didn't do but he is completely unaware that K.D. is in trouble. Finally, the Judge reveals his final verdict for killing Weapon Smuggler Manan Srivastav but K.D. Pathak luckily manages to convince the Judge to delay the decision. Will he save Inspector Dave?

episodesList.title: Zindagi Milegi Dobara Part 1
episodesList.summary: A man named Rajiv is found dead in the church with a mangalsutra in his hand that belongs to his mother. Father Pinto informs this to the police and Rajiv's mother is blamed for the murder. But K.D thinks that she is not the killer. Who killed Rajiv?

episodesList.title: Zindagi Milegi Dobara Part 2
episodesList.summary: The case makes KD go back in past. A guy named Aaryan gives him a diary. The diary has many clues which makes the case interesting. KD Pathak is confused. The diary makes him go back to 1991. How will the case take a turn?

episodesList.title: Khoon Ka Jaal
episodesList.summary: A Brazilian wandering spider one of the most poisonous spiders escapes from its shelf as Lab assistant Sushmita accidentally keeps the shelf open. A diamond trader, Pushpesh Kanuja loses his life as a spider bites him. Mayur Panth chief accountant of Pushpesh's diamond trading company reveals that a massive argument took place between Dr Indar and Pushpesh in regards to a land dispute. Who killed Puspesh Kanuja?

episodesList.title: Tunnel Mein Khoon
episodesList.summary: Aarya gets arrested in the murder of her boyfriend Mehul who gets killed on the bus while travelling towards Pune with his friends. Mehul's death occurred due to a pastry which was offered by Aarya to Mehul while they were entering the tunnel. Mehul's best friend Ishan Gupta reveals that he has full trust in Aarya and that she can't kill him instead, he admits that he killed Mehul but does not have any idea about the poison. How did Poison appear on the pastry?

episodesList.title: Dohri Uljhan Part 1
episodesList.summary: A woman is murdered in her home and a painter who worked for her is arrested for it. His girlfriend who firmly believing in his innocence, goes to KD Pathak to ask for his help in proving his innocence. Watch how KD Pathak unravels the case to prove his innocence and find the real culprit.

episodesList.title: Dohri Uljhan Part 2
episodesList.summary: KD Pathak realizes the truth behind Anurag. As Virat taunts Pathak from the cell, he is in a dilemma as to whether save Anurag or help punish Virat. Watch how Pathak tackles this headache of a case.

episodesList.title: Waaris
episodesList.summary: Manohar sethiya a very rich man of the city was trying to find his lost grand daughter who will be the the heir of his property. Kavita and Deepika claims to be his grand daughter. After some days Manohar is found dead in his room. Kavita is accused for the murder. Will K.D. Pathak unfold the mystery of this case ?

episodesList.title: Kathputli Ka Khel Part 1
episodesList.summary: The new Programme head for a prominent channel gets murdered with his own showpiece dagger and the suspect is a ventriloquist who got his programme cancelled. Pathak takes on the case, believing in his innocence

episodesList.title: Kathputli Ka Khel Part 2
episodesList.summary: To save an innocent Shipra, KD Pathak loses the case. After saving her KD Pathak decides to take the case to the high court. How will KD Pathak prove the innocence of his client to the high court?

episodesList.title: Qatil Bawarchi
episodesList.summary: A chef named Vijay is arrested for allegedly murdering his co-worker. KD Pathak gets a call from a mysterious lady to take this case. KD Pathak goes to meet Vijay and decides to take the case into his hands. How will KD Pathak solve this case and prove Vijay's innocence?

episodesList.title: Khel Khel Mein
episodesList.summary: Thakur Ujjwal Singh's death from a snake bite leads to Neelakshi being accused of being an Ichadhari Nagin. KD Pathak defends her against baseless claims, but a twist occurs when Ujagar Singh dies from a snake bite, raising questions about Neelakshi's true identity. Is Neelakshi really the mythical shape-shifting cobra the villagers claim her to be? Watch and find out.

episodesList.title: Naagin Part 1
episodesList.summary: In the previous episode, Neelakshi, accused of being an Ichadhari Nagin, was found in the Haweli where Ujagar Singh died. During the court proceedings, a snake charmer named Bhairavnath spins a story about her past. KD Pathak exposes Bhairavnath as an actor paid to tell the tale. The mystery deepens as someone tries to frame Neelakshi, how will KD solve this superstitious tale and free Neelakshi of the murder charge?

episodesList.title: Naagin Part 2
episodesList.summary: K.D.Pathak shocked to see Nilakshi in the same Haveli where Thakur Ujagar Singh was killed but a major problem arises as Bhairav Baba reveals a real story to court that Nilakshi's mother was a snake whose 'Mani' was stolen from the Jungle by 2 young guys who were none other than Thakur Ujwal and Ujagar Singh, thus he plays an instrument due to which Nilakshi faints. Who killed Thakur Ujwal Singh and Thakur Ujagar Singh? Is Nilakshi Innocent?

episodesList.title: Blackmail
episodesList.summary: A therapist loses a tape containing the therapy session with one of his prominent clients that had a huge secret in it. Panic strikes him as he realizes that his career could be at stake and thus turns to Pathak to help him find it instead of the police.

episodesList.title: Qatil Biker Part 1
episodesList.summary: Faisal, a member of a biker group, is accused of causing Chirag's fatal bike accident due to an oil spill. Faisal's father asks KD for help stating innocence of his son, KD Pathak takes up Faisal's case. As the trial unfolds, Brando gets hit by a truck and implicates Faisal's involvement, raising doubts about the true culprit. The mystery of Chirag and Brando's deaths remains unsolved.

episodesList.title: Qatil Biker Part 2
episodesList.summary: KD Pathak argues that Brando's death was no accident but a premeditated murder. He uncovers crucial evidence linking Chanchal to Chirag's murder, and Yogi reveals his affair with Chanchal. Unfortunately, both Chanchal and Yogi are killed before revealing the killer's identity, leaving KD with a daunting challenge to prove Faisal's innocence in court, as all eyewitnesses are eliminated.

episodesList.title: Qatil Billi
episodesList.summary: A woman seems to take her anger out on a picture of a lady. A party has been hosted by Sweety. Police arrived in the party after getting information about drugs in the party. Everyone is angry on Sweety and she is being blamed for the party getting ruined. Sweety goes to meet Mistry for trying to ruining her party. Mistry is found dead in her home and she is arrested. Sweety shouts at K.D. Pathak for not letting her out on bail.

episodesList.title: Maut Ka Kuwa
episodesList.summary: KD Pathak takes on the challenging case of Sikander, accused of involvement in Toofan Singh's death during a dangerous car stunt. While facing his adversary, Inder Mohan Jaiswal, in court, Jaiswal claims that Toofan was drunk, but the troop's owner, Baljeet Singh, refutes this. As the case unfolds, it is revealed that Sikander had an affair with Baljeet's wife, Mohini. With all evidence pointing toward Sikander, KD decides to visit the murder scene one last time, which leads him toward the real culprit. Watch as KD Pathak uses his wit and instincts to find the man behind the murder of Toofan Singh.

episodesList.title: Qatil Drishti
episodesList.summary: Dhrishti is found with the murder weapon at the crime scene after foreseeing her friend Ira's murder. Niyati Sachdev takes on Dhrishti's defense, and KD Pathak's testimony initially seems to seal her fate. However, KD's revelation of a hallucinogenic drug plot reopens the case, leading to suspicions on Dhrishti's husband, Parth, her friend Navya, and Ira's fiancé, Yug. Watch KD raise the curtain on Ira's murderer and prove Dhrishti's innocence.

episodesList.title: Qatil Judi Huyi Judwaa Part 1
episodesList.summary: Mihika and Maya, who are conjoined twins, find themselves in a murder case involving their uncle, Mamaji, who was poisoned. In a surprising twist, Maya expresses her desire to undergo separation from her sister. When questioned, their mother, Tarika Sharma, admits to being the one responsible for killing her brother. Who murdered Mihika and Maya's Mamaji?

episodesList.title: Qatil Judi Huyi Judwaa Part 2
episodesList.summary: During the court proceedings, Tarika confesses to the murder of her brother, but a significant complication arises when the notes containing her confession get mixed up with other notes from the bed. Subsequently, it is discovered through fingerprint analysis that the incriminating prints actually belong to Jashn.

episodesList.title: Kissa Honour Killing Ka Part 1
episodesList.summary: Suresh and Pinky Prakash marry against their parents' wishes, but Pinky is later found dead, with her father Chand Prakash admitting to the murder. Chand's wife, Rajwanti, turns to K.D. Pathak for help. Can K.D. Pathak save Chand Prakash without any evidence?

episodesList.title: Kissa Honour Killing Ka Part 2
episodesList.summary: Chand Prakash says that he went with an Ax to kill his daughter. Thus, the case takes a twist and later, Sonu says he saw the murder with his eyes but a surprising incident takes place as Mahendra Pratap gets killed. Who is the killer?

episodesList.title: Kissa Masoom Mujrim Ka Part 1
episodesList.summary: Super Model Mandeep Kohli gets brutally killed in her residence and cops are suspecting her boyfriend, Neeraj Mahendru as their conflicts were quite popular in newspapers. Will K.D. Pathak save him?

episodesList.title: Kissa Masoom Mujrim Ka Part 2
episodesList.summary: K.D.Pathak tries to prove that there is a deep connection between Mandeep Kohli, Jagbar Khan, and Dholak's death. K.D.Pathak suspects Ashram's warden, Mahuli who finally reveals the truth that Pawle is a criminal who forcefully makes children beg. Pawle lands in great trouble.

episodesList.title: Qatil Aghori Part 1
episodesList.summary: Amanda and Steven, accompanied by an Indian guide, explore Haridwar for research on the Aghori Baba and his way of life. However, their journey takes a dramatic turn when Chandi Das Baba, a student of Jaganan Maharaj, behaves inappropriately towards Amanda. In response, Chandi Das reaches out to K.D. Pathak for help in protecting Jaganan Maharaj. Will K.D. Pathak come to the rescue of Jaganan Maharaj?

episodesList.title: Qatil Aghori Part 2
episodesList.summary: K.D. Pathak argues Chandi Das's death is not natural, but defense lawyer Panth claims it's a premeditated murder. Jaganan Maharaj's wife, Dulari Devi, admits her animosity towards him and attempts to secure his signatures on her property papers. A Baba's curse predicts K.D. Pathak's drowning in a lake raising the suspense on whether this prediction will come true.

episodesList.title: Substitute Face
episodesList.summary: Sudha faces an accusation of murdering her husband, but upon KD's investigation, it is revealed that the bullet fired from Sudha's gun doesn't match the one discovered in Dinkar's body. Watch how KD Pathak will solve this case.

episodesList.title: Qatil Chor
episodesList.summary: A jewelry store robbery occurred, resulting in the murder of Manav, an employee. KD, upon reviewing the CCTV footage, made a startling discovery: Manav, previously believed to be blind, was not. The question arises: why was Manav pretending to be blind, and who is responsible for his murder?

episodesList.title: Oija Board Ka Khooni Raaz
episodesList.summary: A group of girls residing in a hostel decide to conjure the spirit of Maya, a girl who had tragically taken her own life. The atmosphere becomes tense as Maya seemingly responds to their questions. However, the situation takes a horrifying turn when the girls are startled to discover Mitali's lifeless body hanging outside their window. Who is responsible for Mitali's death?

episodesList.title: Sky Diver Ke Qatl Ka Rahasya Part 1
episodesList.summary: Ranjeev, Surjit, and Anuraag are thrilled about skydiving, but a grave incident unfolds when Ranjeev encounters a parachute failure and plummets 5000 km to the ground, resulting in his demise. Ranjeev was renowned as one of India's top skydivers. Additionally, Pilot Martin meets a tragic end. The question arises: what led to the deaths of Ranjeev and Pilot Martin?

episodesList.title: Sky Diver Ke Qatl Ka Rahasya Part 2
episodesList.summary: K.D. Pathak tells the Judge that he is unable to crack the code which Pilot Martin Perrera said before dying. Later, K.D.Pathak discloses the truth that the water which was present on the flight belonged to Himani's aunty's swimming pool. The code which Martin said was a car's number plate. Who killed Ranjeev?

episodesList.title: Haadsa Ya Hatya Part 1
episodesList.summary: Soni and Kartar are getting married but an incident occurs, someone shoots the groom and Jasmeet Singh gets arrested for shooting him. Later, an unknown person threatens K.D. Pathak not to fight Jasmeet's case but K.D avoids the call and agrees to fight the case. Later, K.D. gets kidnapped. Is K.D. Pathak in trouble?

episodesList.title: Haadsa Ya Hatya Part 2
episodesList.summary: K.D Pathak tells Karamjeet Singh that if Jasmeet is found guilty he will be punished. Later, Jasmeet tells the court that the gun belonged to him and Gurnaam was trying to save him. How will K.D. Pathak prove that the gun does not belong to Jasmeet and Who killed Kartar Singh?

episodesList.title: Khoon Ki Holi Part 1
episodesList.summary: Mr Jamnalal Thappar's son, Gaurang gets arrested as their maid accidentally falls from the terrace. Later, K.D.Pathak agrees to fight the case for Mr Thappar's son but a major problem occurs when the defence lawyer tells the court that Gaurang's fingerprints are found on Mansi's body. Will K.D save Gaurang and Rajsingh?

episodesList.title: Khoon Ki Holi Part 2
episodesList.summary: Mr Thappar informs his family members that he has given 30 lakh rupees to the driver's family members. Ms Shah gets killed who stays right opposite Thappar's house because she saw Mansi's murder. Who killed Mansi and Ms Shah?

episodesList.title: Woh Kaun Thi Part 1
episodesList.summary: A major incident takes place in Kedar Kelkar's house and his wife, Varsha dies and Kedar Kelkar gets arrested. Kedar who is K.D.Pathak's childhood friend tells him that she committed suicide as the door was locked from the inside. How will K.D Pathak prove Kedar innocent?

episodesList.title: Woh Kaun Thi Part 2
episodesList.summary: K.D. Pathak receives a message from Varsha's spirit, accusing Kedar of her murder and warning him to drop Kedar's case or face dire consequences. In response, K.D. Pathak sends Varun to Rajawadi Hospital, where he manages to gather crucial evidence. During the court proceedings, K.D. reveals that Varsha's mother had given birth to twin sisters.

episodesList.title: K. D. Ka Saamna Aadamkhor Se
episodesList.summary: A doctor with psychopathic tendencies is killing people and cannibalizing their brains. Mrs. Usha Mehta alerts the police, reporting that something is amiss with her neighbor, Dr. B.N. Paranjpe, and there's a strange odor emanating from his flat. Upon investigation, the police discover a deceased body in the apartment, initially assuming it to be Dr. Paranjpe. Suddenly, a man arrives, asserting that he is Dr. Paranjpe. Is he the actual murderer?

episodesList.title: Humshakal
episodesList.summary: Pratibha Verma reaches out to K.D. Pathak, seeking assistance in case she faces significant trouble. Following the murder of Detective Anurag Vishwas, Pratibha mysteriously disappears. How will KD Pathak save Pratibha?

episodesList.title: Rajneeti
episodesList.summary: Roshni gets caught in the pub but was soon released as cops comes to know that she is Politician Rajeev Desai's Sister later, Roshni infoms her Brother Rajeev Desai that she wants to get married to Neeraj's Son Rajdeep Mehra who is in the opposition party and he fumes in anger later, inspite of Rajeev Desai's warning Roshni goes to meet Rajdeep and thus he decides to kill Rajdeep but he was shocked to see that Rajdeep was already dead and Rajeev gets arrested. Who killed Rajdeep Mehra? Builder Suresh Jindal, Neeraj, Roshni or Rajeev's assistant? How will K.D.Pathak solve this political matter? Will he save his friend/politician Rajeev Desai?

episodesList.title: Adrushya Qatil Part 1
episodesList.summary: A dispute between a money mogul and a gym owner about the lease money of the very gym leads to the death of the gym owner the very next day and the cause of death by suffocation using a barbell.  The trainer Santosh is being accused of murdering the owner. Luckily KD goes to the same gym and now he has taken this case up. Santosh pleads not guilty. Is a work-out accident or a plotted murder? Watch the episode and find out!

episodesList.title: Adrushya Qatil Part 2
episodesList.summary: Following up on the last invisible man episode, Kim Kapoor gets brutally killed at her own residence. The defence lawyer reads a letter that mentioned that Santosh was short-tempered during his school days and he had attacked his coach with a stump. Dagdu threatens Amjad. How will K.D Pathak prove Santosh innocent?

episodesList.title: Andesha Anhoni Ka Part 1
episodesList.summary: Paloma tells her sister that she saw the killer. Later, cricketer, Joydeep Sen gets arrested in the murder of Nirmal Raizada's wife, Krishna Raizada. Coach asks K.D.Pathak to save Joydeep. Why did Paloma blame Joydeep for killing Krishna Raizada?

episodesList.title: Andesha Anhoni Ka Part 2
episodesList.summary: Continuing yesterday's courtroom deliberations, K.D. diligently gathers all important information, ultimately uncovering the key to the woman's recurring dreams. As the dreams manifest into reality, but the murderer cannot hide from the sight of law. Watch how will KD solve this case?

episodesList.title: Aakhri Fariyadi
episodesList.summary: Surinder is murdered during a play. Rakesh is arrested as he is the prime suspect. A man meets KD Pathak and assures him that Rakesh is innocent and asks him to take up the case. What will be KD's choice?

episodesList.title: K. D. In Daman Part 1
episodesList.summary: Mazhar, a budding cricketer, collapses unexpectedly on the street. Subsequently, an individual disguised in a burkha enters a hair salon and shoots Jagya along with his bodyguard. Jagya happens to be the nephew of Tinkar Bhau, a notorious criminal. Believing that Mazhar is responsible for his nephew's death, Tinkar Bhau abducts Mazhar with the intention of seeking revenge. Watch what happens next.

episodesList.title: K. D. In Daman Part 2
episodesList.summary: K.D. Pathak uncovers that Tinkar Bhau was responsible for the murder of Mazhar's father, Gulam Khan, a decade ago. Presently, Tinkar Bhau suspects that Mazhar seeks revenge, a belief supported by the accumulating evidence. The question remains whether K.D. can rescue Mazhar from Tinkar Bhau's clutches.

episodesList.title: Waaris Ka Shraap Part 1
episodesList.summary: A couple named Amrit and Natasha are going to meet Amrit's uncle. Amrit's uncle is going to give him his property which is worth 70 crores but on the way, someone kills Amrit and Natasha finds his body in the jungle. Who killed Amrit? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Waaris Ka Shraap Part 2
episodesList.summary: Vallabhgarh's Kunwar Abhimanyu Pratap Singh does not have any children that's why he decided to give his property to Amrit, who got killed. Later, someone attacks K.D. in the jungle. Rajmata tells Abhimanyu to give his property to Ranveer. Did Ranveer kill Amrit? Or was it someone else?

episodesList.title: Ichcha Mrityu
episodesList.summary: Debojit, a renowned star, becomes paralyzed after a mishap during a movie shoot. He requests assistance in ending his life through mercy killing. One day, we discover that he has passed away, and all the life support equipment has been turned off. Shumona, his caregiver, is now facing allegations. Who is responsible for Debojit's death?

episodesList.title: Delhi Mein K. D. Giraftaar Part 1
episodesList.summary: K.D. Pathak's childhood friend, Neeraj Marwa, informs him that his wife, Renuka, has been arrested on charges of medical negligence for the death of a patient. Subsequently, Neeraj is murdered, and K.D. Pathak finds himself detained by the Delhi police. How will K.D. Pathak go about demonstrating his innocence?

episodesList.title: Delhi Mein K. D. Giraftaar Part 2
episodesList.summary: Goon forces Varun to say untrue things in court about K.D. Pathak. The court gives K.D. three days to prove he didn't do anything wrong. Usman has a car crash and dies. Now, what will K.D. do? And who's trying to hurt K.D. Pathak?

episodesList.title: Target - Varun Zaveri Part 1
episodesList.summary: Varun Jhaveri, a heart doctor, has been killed. The suspect is his security guard, Gorang. But Gorang claims that there was another person in Dr. Varun's house. As the investigation progresses, KD discovers that there are four people with the name Varun Jhaveri – two are still alive, and two have passed away. When KD arrives at the house of one of these Varun Jhaveris, he is in shock. Watch now what happens next.

episodesList.title: Target - Varun Zaveri Part 2
episodesList.summary: KD is shocked when he sees Vikram Jhaveri's father's dead body. However, when KD talks to Vikram, he claims that his father is alive and resting upstairs. This makes KD suspicious of Vikram. As a result, Vikram Jhaveri is arrested and brought to court.

episodesList.title: Inteqaam Suryakiran Ka Part 1
episodesList.summary: A super-star Surya Kiran is dead. Hemant Reddy is a writer and a film critic who had written against Surya Kiran. The first day of court ends and Bhaskar wants to talk to KD in private and when KD takes him in private to talk, he runs away. KD is in deep trouble as he asked the cops to give them time to talk.

episodesList.title: Inteqaam Suryakiran Ka Part 2
episodesList.summary: Bhaskar got arrested, and he's aware that his actions have caused problems for him. KD is now in a difficult situation. They conduct a dental test, confirming that the body is indeed Surya Kiran's. KD starts to suspect that someone might be using Surya Kiran's identity to hide something. Watch now what happens next.

episodesList.title: Maut Ki Bhavishyavani
episodesList.summary: Astrologer Vaibhav Sharma introduces a fascinating software that offers astrological assistance to people facing serious problems. Afterward, Avni becomes very angry because she thinks her husband wants to divorce her. Astrologer Vaibhav informs K.D. Pathak that, based on his astrological calculations, Pathak's wife is planning to harm him. What action will K.D. Pathak take?

episodesList.title: Asli Naqli
episodesList.summary: During Pooja's mother's funeral, Pooja is feeling really sad. A man approaches her, saying he's her father who had left her and her mother a long time ago. The only person who saw this man, Baldev, was Pooja's older uncle, Joginder. To know if he's really Pooja's father, there's only one way to find out.

episodesList.title: Qatl Ka Aakhri Adhyay Part 1
episodesList.summary: Nikhil is writing a novel and he is telling his sir that he almost completed the novel and he will complete it tonight. Nikhil's wife came to meet KD Pathak because police arrested her husband nikhil.

episodesList.title: Qatl Ka Aakhri Adhyay Part 2
episodesList.summary: Nikhil Mishra is slowly moving towards this case and it's getting difficult for him to prove himself. Another name has come to light in this case and that name is Karan. Stay tuned.

episodesList.title: Qatil Mankahoor Mummy Part 1
episodesList.summary: A group of archaeologists Dr. Joseph, Dr. Vardhav Venkatesh, succeeded in finding the mummy of king Mankahoor which is 4000 years old but a major trouble takes place as Dr. Joseph breaks king Manakahoor's  mask and also reads a message which was written behind the mask.

episodesList.title: Wafaadar Bana Qatil Part 1
episodesList.summary: Another statement comes to light that whoever digs this grave will die. Deaths are happening one after the other and the case is not being solved. Stay tuned.

episodesList.title: Wafaadar Bana Qatil Part 1
episodesList.summary: KD Pathak encounters a case where the dog is found to have killed the owner. Before his death, the colonel had divided the property between the pet dog and his loyal servant.

episodesList.title: Wafaadar Bana Qatil Part 2
episodesList.summary: KD is taking care of the dog and the killer tries to poison the dog. Killer's footprints are all that are left. Why is he trying to kill a dog?

episodesList.title: Qatil Chehra Part 1
episodesList.summary: At the beginning of the episode, we see that a person pushes a policeman and makes him fall down from the building. The police become suspicious of Dr. Ismail and arrest him.

episodesList.title: Qatil Chehra Part 2
episodesList.summary: At the beginning of the episode we see a lot of children wrestling in an arena. Three people come to Akhara and talk to the teacher of that Akhara and give him some offer. Stay tuned.

episodesList.title: Khoon Ki Kushti
episodesList.summary: Tensed Varun reveals K.D.Pathak that one of his colleague Raman Swaroop who is a Private detective is missing and also tells him that he has found his bike on a lonely place, on the other side in Kushti ground, Federation's secretary Jaspal Sandhu introduces Amateur Wrestling federation Chairperson Gaurav Sharma and his secretary Radhika to Janardan and also tells him that he wants to give free training to his students for Olympics and also offers him a job of a head coach, so that they can win the Gold medal and thus Wrestling coach Janardhan agrees. Janardan fumes in anger as he read news of federation's scam and decides to leave the federation thus a major fight takes place between Gaurav and Janardan and Gaurav falls from his balcony thus Janardan gets arrested.

episodesList.title: C.I.D. Viruddh Adaalat
episodesList.summary: When DCP from CID gets accused of killing Rohit and Dr. Salunkhe, KD decides to represent him in the court. As all the pieces of evidence are against DCP, everyone from the CID team suspects DCP to be the murderer. However, they are all taken aback when KD produces a video before them. What does this video contain? Check out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Public Prosecutor K. D. Pathak Part 1
episodesList.summary: Sudhir knocks the door of the house loudly and comes inside and starts packing his things. When Sudhir was asked what he was doing, Sudhir sat down and started crying.

episodesList.title: Public Prosecutor K. D. Pathak Part 2
episodesList.summary: Two people are talking and are saying that now KD Pathak will definitely take them to court. KD asks very difficult questions to his opponent in court.

episodesList.title: Theatre Mein Khoon
episodesList.summary: KD asks very difficult questions to his opponent in court. Two people are talking and are saying that now KD Pathak will definitely take them to court. Both the person is scared of KD.

episodesList.title: Hatya Ya Haadsa
episodesList.summary: A dead body is seen under a car in a parking lot and a lady accidentally drives her car over the dead body. The police have come to the spot and are interrogating with everyone.

episodesList.title: Maut Ka Saaya Part 1
episodesList.summary: Susan's Family are extremely scared and worried for Susan as they have a belief that a spirit has entered in Susan's body later, Father gets arrested thus he advice's K.D. Pathak not to fight his case, there in the court, Susan's family Doctor Pinto reveals Court that he was treating Susan from since couple of weeks and shares a spine tingling incident that took place in Susan's room later, Susan's Mother tells court that Susan started seeing things which they couldn't view and Susan's Boyfriend Vivek too shares a similar incident where he was petrified to see Susan's unique behavior while returning from college.

episodesList.title: Maut Ka Saaya Part 2
episodesList.summary: Father admits in the court that he killed Susan and thus Father is sentenced to 2 years in Prison later, Defense Lawyer wins the case and there in the jail, Father reveals K.D.Pathak that he didn't wanted to put his life in trouble.

episodesList.title: Qatil Saas Part 1
episodesList.summary: Saudamini gets accused of killing her daughter-in-law, Avni. All the pieces of evidence are against her. Even her family believes that Saudamini has burnt Avni alive in the kitchen, as she was not happy with her. With everything else blaming her for the death, Lawyer K.D. Pathak is Saudamini’s only hope. How will K.D. grant her justice?

episodesList.title: Qatil Saas Part 2
episodesList.summary: Ms. Patel reveals K.D. Pathak that she saw Avni's Friend Pramod outside her house when Avni's fire incident took place, there in the court, K.D.Pathak proves in the court that Kitchen's Window was open and the wind was arriving with a full speed due to which Sarju was finding difficulty in cooking food later, K.D.Pathak explains her defense lawyer that a strong man has thrown the match stick on Avni which set her on fire.

episodesList.title: Indradhanush Qatil Part 1
episodesList.summary: Theater Artist Raju Chaurasiya was rehearsing for his play Indradhanush in the City Auditorium in which he is essaying 7 different roles and Actor Samar Tripathy was also present in the auditorium who was standing right behind Raju Chaurasiya later, Raju observes an unknown person escaping from the Auditorium and all the members who were present on the stage observes a hammer in Raju's hand

episodesList.title: Indradhanush Qatil Part 2
episodesList.summary: K.D.Pathak proves in the court that Kitchen's Window was open and the wind was arriving with a full speed due to which Sarju was finding difficulty in cooking food later, K.D.Pathak explains her defense lawyer that a strong man has thrown the match stick on Avni which set her on fire.

episodesList.title: Aakhri Race Part 1
episodesList.summary: The journey of defense lawyer KD Pathak, who wins case after case with sheer intellect, is followed in the courtroom drama series Adaalat. Justice for the innocents can only be served by KD Pathak's eloquence and sheer investigative genius after all other options are exhausted. KD Pathak has never lost a case and has never permitted the conviction of an innocent person. Even when a lot of prosecutors came close to deciphering KD Pathak's code, KD ultimately emerges victorious.

episodesList.title: Aakhri Race Part 2
episodesList.summary: Varun is bound so that the rope will murder him every time the chamber door is opened. When Dave arrives at the spot and opens the door, the sixteenth member of the federation, Zuben,'s body, is discovered. Everyone is taken aback. Zuben was slain by whom? Watch and find out on this episode.

episodesList.title: Chand Par Hatya Part 1
episodesList.summary: A mission to the moon is undertaken by three astronauts. They eventually prepare to launch to the moon. Nevertheless, we learn that there is a disagreement between them and that there is something going on between them. Later, when someone shuts off the oxygen pipe, one of the astronauts, Kumaresh, dies. Was he killed by Adish? Or was it another person?

episodesList.title: Chand Par Hatya Part 2
episodesList.summary: K.D. goes onto the spacecraft to investigate but he gets locked there and someone cut off the oxygen supply. However, K.D. manages to escape. What will happen now? How will K.D save himself?

episodesList.title: Qatil Jaadugar Part 1
episodesList.summary: A magician by the name of Jango is about to embark on a risky performance in which he will be handcuffed and placed inside a large iron trunk. Jango promises that he will survive. Jango is discovered dead later. Zebisco, his assistant, was the last person to be seen next to his trunk. Was it all planned by him? Know more by watching this episode.

episodesList.title: Qatil Jaadugar Part 2
episodesList.summary: A different magician named Bobo Bose calls K.D. who says they know the killer. Later on, we witness Teja dressing up as Jango in an attempt to replace him. Who is the murderer? Can K.D. uncover the true murderer?

episodesList.title: Dacait Ka Insaaf Part 1
episodesList.summary: Lakhori, Subedar Singh, and the rest of the gang are not willing to give up. There is no friendly relationship between the two groups. Azad Singh, The Thakur, killed Subedar's brother. To exact his retribution, Subedar visits the Thakur residence. We observe that Subedar has been arrested by the police for the Thakur's murder. Was Thakur truly killed by Subedar?

episodesList.title: Dacait Ka Insaaf Part 2
episodesList.summary: After being rescued from the court by his fellow dacoits, Subedar has been released. In order to locate and murder Thakur's younger brother, he returns to his home. But when he is jailed there, he finds out that Nathu was complicit in his framing.

episodesList.title: Oh My God Part 1
episodesList.summary: A farmer is taken captive. In a Krishna temple, Baban Rao Shivalkar, a suspended police officer, is abusing Lord Krishna while inebriated and disorganized. Baban and the kids assemble to assault a white ambassador automobile that is about to drive past. We find out that MLA Khurana owns this vehicle. What comes next?

episodesList.title: Oh My God Part 2
episodesList.summary: Baban claims to see and converse with Lord Krishna on a regular basis. By referring to it as divine justice, he asserts that Lord Krishna killed Khurana as retribution for all the evil deeds the man committed. We also saw Baban conversing with Lord Krishna in the cell following the court. Regarding the existence of Lord Krishna, everyone is now perplexed. Is he real, or is someone else acting out this scene? Stay tuned to know more.

episodesList.title: Mental Asylum Mein K. D.  Part 1
episodesList.summary: Maqdoom, a mentally ill patient, loves Salman and constantly mimics him. In his office, Dr. Jain, who was shutting the cabinet and retiring from his position, is discovered dead. He was locking the cabinet, and not many medications were missing. In an effort to learn the truth, K.D. chooses to check into the asylum as a patient. Stay tuned to know more.

episodesList.title: Mental Asylum Mein K. D.  Part 2
episodesList.summary: We observe K.D. searching for hints and proof at the same mental institution. Before going to sleep every night, Maqdoom claims to have a meeting with Salmaan Khan. He finds out that Manikchand Shukla, the man posing as an insane investigator, is, in fact, sound. Who was the mastermind behind it all? Will Kishore's innocence be proven by K.D.?

episodesList.title: Maa Mayanti Ka Khooni Khulasa Part 1
episodesList.summary: Everyone believes that Abheek Shastri, who leaps off his office building, committed suicide because he was unhappy with his personal life, but his wife is certain that he was killed. KD doesn't think the woman who communicates with spirits is real. What's the real story? Was it murder or suicide?

episodesList.title: Maa Mayanti Ka Khooni Khulasa Part 2
episodesList.summary: KD summons Abheek's soul by calling on the woman MAA Mayanti in the court. K.D. draws attention to the fact that they are ventriloquists when we view the spycam film. Pitamber had taken the money, but Sahadev claims he did not kill Abheek. Who is abusing this circumstance and killing Abheek?

episodesList.title: Rajnaitik Hatyare Part 1
episodesList.summary: Archana ends her life by suicide. Her brother Kunal, though, is certain that her in-laws killed her in order to get the dowry. However, Archana's family and the physicians' assistance demonstrate that she was mentally disturbed. Later on, as the Tyagi family is celebrating their win, Kunal enters and points a gun at them, threatening to murder them. Suddenly, there is a blast, and everyone in the Tyagi family is dead, with the exception of Guruji and Nirmal Tyagi, Archana's spouse.

episodesList.title: Rajnaitik Hatyare Part 2
episodesList.summary: After looking into it, K.D. discovers that there is a problem in Neeraj's statement. When Varun gets there, Neeraj has already passed away. Later, Neeraj phones K.D. to tell him the truth. Who put him to death? Stay tuned to know more.

episodesList.title: Navratri Mein Hatya Kaand
episodesList.summary: It's Navratri season now. Here, Durga is pictured enjoying the puja and Garba with her mother and maternal uncle. Later, we witness Durga conversing to Umang while slinking out of her house in the middle of the night and receiving prasad to eat from him as well. Durga is awaiting the arrival of her friends and boyfriend Prateek. Later, she passes out during the dance and is pronounced dead.

episodesList.title: Nakaab Posh Qatil
episodesList.summary: Renowned mime artist Rajdeep is discovered dead in his makeup room, while another mime artist named Viraj is comatose next to him. Raghuvanshi arrives in K.D. with the case of Viraj, claiming that he is innocent and did not murder Rajdeep. When K.D. encounters Viraj in the cell, she resolves to pursue his case. Will Viraj's innocence be proven by K.D.?

episodesList.title: Unjha Ka Shraap Part 1
episodesList.summary: The Rathod family's daughter-in-law is Avni. After locking the door to a room for years, her father-in-law chastises her for opening it. Her father-in-law is discovered deceased later. It is Avni who is to blame. Is it true that she killed her father-in-law in order to exact revenge?

episodesList.title: Unjha Ka Shraap Part 2
episodesList.summary: The case turns more complicate as there emerges proof of supernatural existence. nalini is still fighting the case to plead not guilty. Watch how K.D helps her win the case for her innocence.

episodesList.title: Hatyara Robot Part 1
episodesList.summary: Various scientists are showcasing their discoveries at a boardroom meeting in Pune. A robot created by Dr. Naidu is capable of fixing anything. Dr. Sapra's cell phone is ruined by the RD robot, who is unable to fix it. Dr. Naidu's creation is turned down. Once more, Dr. Naidu brings Ph to see Dr. Sapra, where RD32 electrocutes her. Arrested is Dr. Naidu. K.D. takes the case.

episodesList.title: Hatyara Robot Part 2
episodesList.summary: Various scientists are showcasing their discoveries at a boardroom meeting in Pune. A robot created by Dr. Naidu is capable of fixing anything. Dr. Sapra's cell phone is ruined by the RD robot, who is unable to fix it. Dr. Naidu's creation is turned down. Once more, Dr. Naidu brings Ph to see Dr. Sapra, where RD32 electrocutes her. Arrested is Dr. Naidu. K.D. takes the case.

episodesList.title: Jaiswal VS Jaiswal Part 1
episodesList.summary: Yash Jaiswal, I.M. Jaiswal's identical brother, is charged with killing Agni underwater while scuba diving. Agni is a wealthy businessman who owns a few dive shops. When KD looks into Yash Jaiswal, everything seems to be against him. It is evident from the camera evidence that Yash killed Agni.

episodesList.title: Jaiswal VS Jaiswal Part 2
episodesList.summary: KD presents some evidence that raises questions and puts I.M. Jaiswal under suspicion. There are other suspicions in the meantime, but ultimately, everything comes down to one Jaiswal. Who is it, and how will KD solve this?

episodesList.title: K. D. In Jaipur Part 1
episodesList.summary: After a man named Sinhal is killed, his building watchman Sharfu is taken into custody. To save the watchman, K.D. takes up the case. Even Nevertheless, every piece of evidence points to Sharfu. It dawns on K.D. that Sharfu is not the only person trying to deflect attention from the case; there's more to it than meets the eye.

episodesList.title: K. D. In Jaipur Part 2
episodesList.summary: Inspector Dave and Varun are instructed by Inspector Rukmani to warn K.D. Pathak not to travel to Jaipur since there is a risk to his life. Subsequently, Sunanda informs K.D. Pathak in court that Sharfuddin came to see her. The 'Kada' does not belong to Mr. Sinhal or Sharfuddin, K.D. Pathak informs the court. Baba admits to K.D. Pathak that he has never gone to Mumbai in order to heal one of his followers. K.D. Pathak raises doubt on Baba.

episodesList.title: Ragging Hatyakand Part 1
episodesList.summary: A Senior engineering student Akshat was ragging Junior students in the Hostel. Akshay gives a horrifying task to a Junior Student to visit Catholic Graveyard in a Female's outfit but Akshay's fun turns out to be a worst nightmare for him as Junior Student faints and Warden Tejpal spots Akshay in the Graveyard. Warden Tejpal severely punishes Akshat. Then, Akshat gets murdered on the Hostel's terrace. K.D. Pathak decides to fight the case on behalf of Warden Tejpal.

episodesList.title: Ragging Hatyakand Part 2
episodesList.summary: Advocate I.M. Jaiswal discloses that Pankaj Chaturvedi committed suicide rather than being killed. Vicky's colleague Girish confesses in the court that he spotted Joydeep in the Catholic Graveyard. Joydeep informs K.D. Pathak that he was the owner of the mask that Akshat had on.

episodesList.title: Vishkanya Part 1
episodesList.summary: Rich contractor Randheer Singh is attempting to buy off Ambrish Goyal, the deputy collector for Gajraula. Ambrish rejects him when he sends Phoolchand, his secretary, to handle the transaction. Afterwards, Phoochand is killed, and Ambrish Goyal's wife is held accountable. KD Pathak, will you take their case?

episodesList.title: Vishkanya Part 2
episodesList.summary: The Vishkanya case is still unresolved. Ambrish acknowledges lying to the judge. Ambrish's mother, meanwhile, testifies in court that she witnessed the entire incident and that she trailed Sukanya and Ambrish as they went toward Batuknath's residence. Now, what will happen?

episodesList.title: Hospital Mein Hatya Part 1
episodesList.summary: Jay and Satish Kumar are seriously hurt and need to be admitted to the hospital right away. An unnamed man enters the intensive care unit and turns off Satish's life support while their wives are accusing one another's husbands. KD Pathak defends Jay, who is held accountable for his death. Keep watching to learn more.

episodesList.title: Hospital Mein Hatya Part 2
episodesList.summary: A doctor from T.P Memorial Hospital reveals that Jay was unconscious when Satish's murder took place. However, lawyer I.M Jaisawal is convinced that Jay was just pretending to be unconscious. Will K.D solve this peculiar case? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Voodoo Dolls Ka Mayajaal Part 1
episodesList.summary: Quick succession deaths occur with unrelated individuals. Following an investigation, it was discovered that each victim had received a voodoo doll in the mail. In this instance, a Tantrik is taken into custody by the police; nevertheless, K.D. Pathak steps up to represent him in court.

episodesList.title: Voodoo Dolls Ka Mayajaal Part 2
episodesList.summary: Varun wakes up to a bad dream. Lawyer I. M. Jaiswal shares an incident that took place in U.S.A. Lawyer I. M Jaiswal tries to prove in the court that Black Magic is still practiced. Baba Mogabo admits in the court that he had made Varun's doll but he has not send him. Judge reveals his final decision as Court does not believe in Voodoo and Black Magic. Court sets Baba Mogabo free. Baba Mogabo's Teacher fumes in anger and decides to teach him a lesson through his Black Magic. Baba Mogabo reveals to K.D. Pathak that Kiran had visited his place with a Doll. Baba Mahamarkesh twists K.D. Pathak's Doll. Will K.D.Pathak survive? Will K.D. Pathak succeed in proving in the court that whether these are murders or the effect of Black Magic? Who killed Hemant, Ms.

episodesList.title: X-Mas Murder Mystery Part 1
episodesList.summary: On the auspicious occasion of Christmas, Janet threatens Francis to celebrate Christmas with her or else she might take a drastic step. Francis's Wife Freny residing in Rosevilla gets shocked to see Janet. Francis slaps Janet and Francis's family gets killed. Janet tries to commit suicide. Janet gets arrested for killing the whole family. Janet reveals in the court that after 12 years of affair, Francis had suddenly decided to call off the relationship.

episodesList.title: X-Mas Murder Mystery Part 2
episodesList.summary: K.D. Pathak reveals in the court that just before the murder occurred, Robert Morgan had entered in Rosevilla. Robert Morgan reveals in the court that he was trying to convince Uncle John and Freny from since past 3 years as he wanted to build a Pub on Rosevilla land. K. D. Pathak investigates the house in which the murder had occurred but he fails to find any evidence. Judge reveals the final decision in regards to Janet's case. Will K.D. Pathak succeed in saving Janet? So what do you think will happen next?

episodesList.title: Target 1st Jan 2013 Part 1
episodesList.summary: Mysterious death of 3 people takes place in the city. Inspector Rathore finds a chit and a bottle near all the 3 bodies. K.D. Pathak gets to know that Dr. Meghnath Suryavanshi got arrested in regards to the 3 mysterious murders that took place in the city. Rockford Bank's CEO Gagan Marwah, Senior Air Hostess Sandhya Shetty and Dealer Manjit Singh were Psychiatrist Dr. Meghnath Suryavanshi's patients.

episodesList.title: Target 1st Jan 2013 Part 2
episodesList.summary: Inspector Rathore reveals to Varun that he has checked out the entire area where Ms. Karla was murdered but his team couldn't find anything specific related to the murder. K.D. Pathak questions Ms. Karla's Daughter Soniya about the word Tiger which Ms. Karla wrote on the ground before dying. Soniya reveals to K.D.P athak that Ms. Karla was depressed and puts the blame of her murder on Dr. Suryavanshi.

episodesList.title: Sting Operation Part 1
episodesList.summary: Reporter Julie and Aatish are gearing up for a sting operation that is soon going to take place in Filmmaker Tony Ahluwalia's Farmhouse located in Panvel. Julie enters in Tony's house and thus the most awaited sting operation begins. Tony misbehaves with Julie and Aatish rushes for Julie's rescue. Reporter of Kahlbali News Channel Julie gets murdered in Ahluwalia Farmhouse. K.D. Pathak decides to fight the case on behalf of Tony Ahluwalia as his Wife Ms. Ahluwalia reveals to him that he is innocent. Tony and Julie's footage is played in the court.

episodesList.title: Sting Operation Part 2
episodesList.summary: When K.D. Pathak was about to nab the unknown person in Tony's secret room, he spots Security guard outside the door and starts questioning him. Tony decides to take Minister's help. Vipul reveals to K.D. Pathak that Aatish had send a threatening e-mail to Reporter Julie. Tony gets released from jail. Tony gets a huge shock as his Black Money was missing from his secret room. Security guard reveals that he does not have any clue about Rs. 5 Crore.

episodesList.title: Raazdaar Aankhen Part 1
episodesList.summary: When Ruchika was about to commit suicide, an unknown person shoots Ruchika. Inspector Rathore questions Ruchika's Husband Bhavik, her Father Mr. Garewal, her Manager Anokhilal and Maid Meghna. Bhavik reveals to Inspector that Ruchika owns a licensed Gun. Bhavik informs Inspector that Ruchika was extremely upset about her film career as she was not at all happy with the way the things were working out. Inspector finds a suicide note on Ruchika's desk. Anjali meets Inspector Rathore and informs him that she knows the killer who killed Ruchika. Bhavik convinces K.D. Pathak to fight the case on behalf of  Anokhilal. Will K.D. Pathak succeed in saving Ruchika's Manager Anokhilal? Who is the actual murderer? To know more keep watching.

Despite of being a murder, Ruchika's Husband Bhavik tries hard to prove in the court that it's a suicide. Varun asks for Ruchika's personal diary in which she wrote lots of incidents that took place with her. Ruchika's biggest fan reveals to K.D. Pathak that he knows the truth about Ruchika's death.

Shocking incident occurs in Rishi's house and Kasturi gets arrested for killing Shakuntala. Despite of not killing her, Kasturi admits in front of K.D.Pathak that she has killed her and also requests him not to fight his case. So what do you think will happen next? Who killed Shakuntala?

episodesList.title: Bhagwan Ram Hazir Ho Part 2
episodesList.summary: Although Kasturi is innocent, the circumstances have turned her into a criminal; the note and the fingerprints identify her as the one who killed her mother-in-law. To prove her innocence, her husband is now asking K.D. for help. Watch the full episode to learn more about this case.

episodesList.title: Dost Ka Badla Part 1

After Victor is killed, Kaustabh is taken into custody. K.D. Pathak learns an astonishing fact from Kaustubh. The attorney discloses to the court that Kaustubh is not the owner of the revolver. Gia divulges the phone talks she had with Kaustubh, who was intoxicated, shortly before the murder. A gun seller named Mr. Lobo testifies in court that he gave Kaustubh a gun. Who is the real killer?

episodesList.title: Dost Ka Badla Part 2

Pathak can't remember the name of his client. Kaustubh is accused of killing Ms. Saltana once more. Who killed Ms. Saltana and Victor? Will Kaustubh, K.D. Pathak's client, be saved?

Pathak chooses to defend Sister Jessi in court.

Pathak decides to fight the case on behalf of Sister Jessi.

Will Madhura be proven guilty or innocent in the court? To find out, watch this terrifying episode of Adaalat.

episodesList.title: Khwab Mein Hatya Part 2

Shetty reveals a shocking truth in the court. Hiren too is questioned in the court. K.D. Pathak observes Varun's death in his dream. To know Judges final verdict in regards to Madhura's case, keep watching Adaalat.

Nachiket reveals in the court that he had warned Niyati not to interfere in his personal life. Niyati reveals a shocking truth in the court. K.D. Pathak reads out a letter written by Niyati. Another boat that resembles Nachiket's boat is Adhuna's Step - Brother Pitambar's boat. Anger-filled Tushar accuses Pitambar of killing Adhuna. What will happen to Adhuna's killer? In court, will Bhau and Shankar tell the truth?

Varun as Gulnaaz'z Brother and K.D. Pathak visit Mulkistan to save Sunaina.

Or is he being framed because of his handicap?

Pathak solve the secrets of the enigmatic case of the cursed island?

episodesList.title: Qatil Daayan Part 1
episodesList.summary: Suspecting her to be a witch, a mob of angry villagers barge into Meenakshi's house and burn her alive. Later, Renu meets a gruesome death, which her father believes is due to Meenakshi's spirit. Later, the villagers apprehend Savithri, as they believe that she is possessed. KD Pathak learns about the incident from Varun Zaveri, his assistant. He reaches Jambulgaon and intervenes when the villagers decide to burn Savithri to death. KD dispels the lies and finds Renu's real murderer.

episodesList.title: Qatil Daayan Part 2
episodesList.summary: Varun, KD Pathak's assistant, is attacked and produced before the village council. Bahubali, one of the villagers, is enraged by KD Pathak and Varun, and asks them to leave. Later, KD Pathak questions Bahubali's wife, Mansi, about her visit to a black magician. She admits that she was performing a sacrificial ceremony in the belief that it will help her bear a child. But then, KD Pathak produces a doctor before the village council who reveals that shortly before her death, Meenakshi had visited her clinic to get an abortion, and that Meenakshi was pregnant with Bahubali's child!

episodesList.title: Manav Bhediya Part 1
episodesList.summary: Scientist who was conducting an experiment on Animals gets bitten by a Man Eater who was trapped in his cage. Social Activists for Animals, Sunanda Chatwal gets murdered by the Man Eater. K.D. Pathak decides to fight the case on behalf of the Scientist. Will he be able to save the Scientist?

episodesList.title: Manav Bhediya Part 2
episodesList.summary: Professor Lahiri turns violent and attacks Inder Mohan Jaiswal, the prosecution lawyer. Inder uses this event to prove that Lahiri is a werewolf and he attacked and killed Sunanda Chatwal. However, KD Pathak claims in the court that Lahiri is mentally ill and needs medical treatment. Following the court’s order, Lahiri is admitted to a mental hospital. Subsequently, Lahiri goes missing from the hospital. KD Pathak suspects that Lahiri has been kidnapped by the real culprit. To make matters worse, Lahiri's wife, Neerja, is found murdered with scratch marks of an animal on her body.

episodesList.title: Anjaan K. D.  Part 1
episodesList.summary: KD Pathak regains consciousness and finds himself on a beach in Goa. KD has no memory of how he ended up at the beach and even fails to remember his name. Meanwhile, in a district court in Goa, the judge waits for the arrival of KD. Varun, KD's assistant, informs the judge that KD is not answering his phone. Varun requests the judge to wait a while longer. KD was earlier at a farm house, trying to gather some evidence for a murder case. Later, a sniper tries to kill KD. Before the sniper can find his target, Varun arrives at the spot with the police and takes KD home. Varun's tries in vain to help KD regain his memory. Then, Varun persuades KD to fight Alfred Rego’s case in the court.

episodesList.title: Anjaan K. D.  Part 2
episodesList.summary: Alfred Rego was allegedly in a meeting when George Rego was killed, according to KD Pathak's testimony in court. The prosecution's attorney, Rajnath Salgaonkar, refutes KD's assertions, claiming that Alfred organized George's murder and employed hitmen to carry out his scheme. As he searches for proof, KD remembers that the attackers brought him to Chapora. Next, KD and Varun stumble into another trap meant to murder KD. But KD makes it through and apprehends the hitman. The hitman is shot dead by an unidentified assailant before he can identify George's murderer. The hunt for the shooter is over for KD and Varun. Then, Savio Fonseca calls KD and says he has discovered an important clue regarding the case. When KD meets Savio, he pulls a gun to KD's head and reveals himself to be a killer.

episodesList.title: Qatil Patrakar Part 1
episodesList.summary: Saurabh, a journalist, is accused of murdering Rajesh. During the courtroom proceedings, KD Pathak claims that Rajesh was dead before the arrival of Saurabh. Inder Mohan Jaiswal, the prosecution lawyer, claims that the fingerprints found on the murder weapon are of Saurabh's. Later, KD finds that Sanjana, Saurabh's wife, has kleptomania. He discovers that Sanjana stole a perfume bottle from a shop in which Rajesh was employed. Rajesh used the CCTV footage of the theft to blackmail Saurabh. Later, KD learns that Rupal, Saurabh's colleague, has been promoted. He reasons that Rupal benefited from Saurabh's downfall and suspects her involvement in the murder.

episodesList.title: Qatil Patrakar Part 2
episodesList.summary: KD Pathak learns that Rupal has been murdered. Sanjana suspects that the blackmailer has killed her. Later, the police apprehend Ashok, the blackmailer. Ashok informs KD that Rajesh was dead much before Saurabh's arrival. He claims that Saurabh and Rupal had an affair. When Inder Mohan Jaiswal hears this, he suspects that Saurabh murdered Rajesh to hide his affair with Rupal. After the court hearing concludes, Ashok is shot by an unidentified assailant. During the investigation, KD finds a vital clue which leads him to suspect the hand of Siddharth, Saurabh's boss, behind the murders.

episodesList.title: Qatil K. D.  Part 1
episodesList.summary: K.D. witnesses a girl committing suicide- K.D. and Varun are on their way to work , when young girl, severely injured runs into their car. She claims that she is being hunted by a 'red dog' , who has spared no one. When K.D. tries to reach out to help her, she runs in the opposite direction & is run-over & killed by another car. Who is she? Why was she so terrified of the 'red dog'? Watch to find out.

episodesList.title: Qatil K. D.  Part 2
episodesList.summary: KD Pathak claims that Varun's killer was hiding in the library after the murder took place. But, KD fails to conclusively prove his innocence. The court delivers the judgment and holds KD guilty of murder. The case takes a turn when inspector Dave brings a key witness to the court. Sanjay, a watchman at the library, helps prove KD's innocence. Then, KD calls Seema, a journalist, to the witness box and claims that she is behind the murders.

episodesList.title: Murder On 15th August Part 1
episodesList.summary: During the flag hoisting ceremony on the 15th of August, a politician is shot by a sniper. The politician survives as the bullet hits his arm. Then, Subhangi, who wants to marry Roshan, the politician's son, meets him while he is being treated.
