The politician and Subhangi have an argument, during which the politician suddenly feels breathless and dies. Subhangi is suspected of having murdered him and is arrested. Then, Subhangi's brother meets KD Pathak and persuades him to fight the case. During the courtroom proceedings, the prosecution lawyer proves that Subhangi has anger management issues. As Subhangi was upset with the politician for not letting her marry Roshan, the prosecution lawyer claims that Subhangi murdered the politician. With all the evidence pointing towards Subhangi, will KD Pathak be able to prove her innocence?

episodesList.title: Murder On 15th August Part 2
episodesList.summary: During the trial of Shubhangi for the murder of the politician Hridaynath, Pandey - the politician's personal assistant - informs that Shubhangi was called to the flag hoisting ceremony by Hridaynath. The case takes a surprising turn as Shubhangi claims that she killed Hridaynath. But, KD Pathak dismisses his client's statement. He produces Jayant, a prime suspect in the case, before the court. Jayant confesses that he shot Hridaynath but had no intention to kill him. Then, KD Pathak suspects that Dharam Veer, Hridaynath's father, conspired to kill his son.

episodesList.title: Adrushya Qatil Part 1
episodesList.summary: Prabhakar, a scientist, has invented a formula that makes a person invisible. Shortly before Prabhakar is to reveal it to the press, he is found dead in the laboratory. His assistant, Omi, is accused of murdering him and is arrested. Omi's fiancé, Kavita, persuades KD Pathak to represent Omi. During the courtroom proceedings, inspector Rathore reveals that Mohit had entered the laboratory on the day of Prabhakar's murder but has been missing ever since. Did Mohit steal the formula and murder Prabhakar? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Adrushya Qatil Part 2
episodesList.summary: Mohit, who has consumed Prabhakar's invisibility potion, is apprehended by KD Pathak. Mohit appears in court as a witness for KD. Rajnath Salgaonkar, the prosecutor's attorney, would not take his testimony, though. Nevertheless, Mohit is given the opportunity to speak, and he admits that he did not witness Prabhakar's killer. KD then devises a scheme to apprehend the offender. After assisting Mohit in escaping from detention, he orders Kunal, the main suspect in the case, to be attacked.

episodesList.title: Bandh Kamre Ka Raaz Part 1
episodesList.summary: Aniket, a film director, is making a biopic on underworld don Babu Bhai. After a while, Anikhet gets a death threat from Babu Bhai, and is subsequently found dead. His younger brother, Anuksh, who is mentally challenged, is accused of his murder and is arrested. KD Pathak hears about the case and decides to prove that Anuksh is innocent. Will KD Pathak win this case against all odds? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Bandh Kamre Ke Raaz Part 2
episodesList.summary: K.D. Pathak is threatened by a shooter working for Babu Bhai to recuse himself from the Ankit Mehra murder case. Pathak refuses and helps the cops to nab the shooter, disguised as a journalist. Meanwhile, the finding of a refrigerator that does not work in a panic room baffles the cops and the lawyers. Only three people had been in and out of Ankit Mehra’s house on the night of the murder. Will K.D. Pathak succeed in finding the real assailant among them?

episodesList.title: Zehreela Shadyantra Part 1
episodesList.summary: A famous fashion designer, Rocky Nath, is murdered at his own birthday party. Later, the police find that he was injected with a poison called procydin. The police suspect that Rocky’s fiancé Deepa is involved, as she is a chemist. The case goes to court and Deepa’s father, Mr. Bhushan, appoints K. D. Pathak as his lawyer. I. M. Jaiswal is the prosecuting lawyer and calls-in various witnesses to prove Deepa the killer. Later, it is found that the poison was prepared in his factory.

episodesList.title: Zehreela Shadyantra Part 2
episodesList.summary: Deepa’s father assures K.D. Pathak this daughter did not kill Rocky. During the courtroom proceedings, K.D. Pathak calls Namitha to the witness box. Namitha admits that she did administer an injection to Rocky but it did not contain a lethal solution. It comes to light that Siddharth had ordered Namitha to administer the injection. Questioned, Siddharth pleads his innocence. Later, while watching the footage of Rocky's birthday party, K.D. Pathak learns that the poison entered Rocky's bloodstream through the fumes from the candle. During the court hearing, K.D. Pathak calls Sudarshan Malik, a doctor, to the witness box. Did Sudarshan have a hand in Rocky’s murder?

episodesList.title: Alien Attack Part 1
episodesList.summary: K.D. Pathak learns that a UFO has been spotted in Wardhapur, Maharashtra. K.D. Pathak also learns that Chandu, a resident of Wardhapur. was attacked by aliens. Meanwhile, Chandu finds Steven's dead body near the UFO’s landing site in the forest. The police arrest him for Steven's murder. K.D. Pathak believes that Chandu is innocent and decides to represent him in the court. During the courtroom proceedings, Chandu claims that the aliens killed Steven. Will K.D. Pathak be able to prove Chandu’s innocence?

episodesList.title: Alien Attack Part 2
episodesList.summary: K.D Pathak and his team is in search of an alien who is spreading fear in the city. The alien pays K.D at his hotel but K.D is unfazed by it. Now the suspicion falls on Steven's brother, Tyler. Stay tuned to find out more.

episodesList.title: Khoonkhar Parindey Part 1
episodesList.summary: Hiren, after spending ten years in a mental asylum, is brought home. He was declared mentally unstable after being accused of murdering his family. Hiren once again finds himself in a tough spot as he is blamed for the murder of Supriya and Rupak. K.D. Pathak, convinced that Hiren is innocent, decides to represent him in the court. His adversary, Inder Mohan Jaiswal, the prosecution lawyer, proves that Hiren has anger-management issues, and he was the killer of Supriya and Rupak. Then, Jaiswal produces a key witness, Surveen, who claims that Hiren is pretending to be mentally unstable. The case takes a twist when Surveen is found dead; and Hiren stands accused of his murder as well.

episodesList.title: Khoonkhar Parindey Part 2
episodesList.summary: While trying to gather evidence, K.D. Pathak is attacked by a colony of bats. He goes inside a cave to investigate and finds that someone has been feeding the bats. Then, K.D. Pathak hands over the food samples collected from the cave to a forensic doctor. The doctor informs K.D. Pathak that he found traces of three different chemical substances in the food. K.D. Pathak proves that the culprit trained the bats to attack a person who has been sprayed with the pheromones. With the culprit having meticulously planned the murders, can K.D. Pathak find him and prove that Hiren is innocent?

episodesList.title: Yeti Ka Hamla Part 1
episodesList.summary: A mountain climber, Aakash Kaul, allegedly spots a Yeti, an imaginary being said to inhabit the Himalayas. Two years later, accompanied by fellow climbers, he goes on an expedition called ‘Operation Yeti’ to confirm his suspicion. However, he is murdered and Vicky Mathur, fellow climber, is accused of the crime. K.D. Pathak finds this story on the news and on his assistant’s request decides to represent Vicky in court. In court, Vicky claims that he witnessed a Yeti kill Aakash. Will K.D. Pathak be able to prove Vicky’s innocence in court?

episodesList.title: Yeti Ka Hamla Part 2
episodesList.summary: K.D. Pathak receives a CD in the mail and finds a video with the Yeti captured on camera. The next day, he presents it as evidence in court and calls on witnesses to justify it. However, failing to prove its authenticity, he decides to visit the Himalayas in search of the Yeti. The prosecuting lawyer, Anjali Puri, decides to accompany him to ensure there is no bias. Meanwhile, the police find an encrypted mail on the victim Aakash Kaul’s laptop. Will K.D. Pathak find the Yeti and prove Vicky’s innocence in court?

episodesList.title: Adrushya Maa Part 1
episodesList.summary: The police rescue two young girls from an abandoned cottage in the forest and hand them over to Sarita Gupta, a counsellor. On investigating, they learn that the girls are sisters, Anuradha and Aanchal Patil, who went missing four years ago. The girls’ step father, Suresh, learns about this and decides to kill the sisters. However, he is murdered and Anuradha is accused of the crime. Sarita brings the case to K.D. Pathak and he learns that Suresh was killed by his wife who died 4 years ago.

episodesList.title: Adrushya Maa Part 2
episodesList.summary: Bhagwat, a paranormal researcher, informs K.D. Pathak that the spirit of Anuradha's mother killed her father and claims to prove it before the court. Then, Bhagwat meets Anuradha in the jail. Anuradha seems to be possessed by her mother's spirit and tries to attack Bhagwat. Later, during the courtroom proceedings, K.D. Pathak proves that Anuradha is acting possessed. Is Anuradha the culprit and has she been pretending to be possessed all along?

episodesList.title: Qatil Makkhi Part 1
episodesList.summary: Nayyar is accused of murdering his personal doctor. He claims in the court that the doctor was forced to jump off the balcony by a housefly. Ramesh Shukla, who is a staff at the doctor's clinic, claims that Nayyar pushed the doctor from the balcony. Inder Mohan Jaiswal, the prosecution lawyer, proves that Nayyar has fear of needles and injections. Jaiswal points out that while the doctor was trying to administer an injection to Nayyar, he was inadvertently pushed by Nayyar. Later, K.D. Pathak, who is representing Nayyar, learns of two deaths, which are unrelated to the case. Surprisingly, two people have lost their lives after seeing a housefly. How is the housefly related to the murder case?

episodesList.title: Qatil Makkhi Part 2
episodesList.summary: When a woman encounters K.D. Pathak, she tells him that Sanjana is a housefly in her second life. She discloses that as the train was moving, Sanjana was molested. Sanjana attempted to jump off the train and perished in the process. Later, Sunder Shah and Mohit Patel—who had molested Sanjana—are taken into custody by the police. Sunder passes away while in detention, and Mohit says a housefly killed him. K.D. Pathak provides evidence in court that the housefly is robotic. Now that the reincarnation concept has been debunked, K.D. Pathak is going to reveal who the murderer is.

episodesList.title: Electric Man Part 1
episodesList.summary: Inspector Dave apprehends Kapil, suspecting him to be responsible for the mysterious deaths at a store. Kapil has the ability to withstand high voltage and is even know to conduct electricity. Dave informs K.D. Pathak about Kapil and claims that he is the murderer. K.D. Pathak believes that Kapil is innocent and decides to represent him in the court. How is Kapil's superhuman ability related to the mysterious deaths?

episodesList.title: Electric Man Part 2
episodesList.summary: K.D. Pathak and Inspector Dave find a charred body inside a car. Dave suspects that Kapil, who has escaped from police custody, is responsible for the death. The police arrest Kapil and produce him before the court. During the courtroom proceedings, Kapil inadvertently hits the prosecution lawyer and he collapses on the floor. Later, K.D. Pathak is badly injured after being attacked by a person, who also possesses the ability to conduct electricity. After the attack, K.D. Pathak is almost certain that someone else, and not Kapil, is responsible for the crimes. But, with the culprit proving to be near impossible to catch, can K.D. Pathak capture him with the help of the police?

episodesList.title: Kissa Khoi Yaddasht Ka Part 1
episodesList.summary: A famous actress is murdered and the very next day a mysterious man stumbles into K.D. Pathak’s office claiming that he did not murder his wife. The man is behaving weirdly and keeps pictures of important things, people and locations. He also suffers from short-term memory loss, but has done some work in investigating his wife’s murder. K.D. Pathak decides to take up his case, feeling that he is innocent. Is the man with no memory really innocent or is he trying to cover up a heinous crime?

episodesList.title: Kissa Khoi Yaddasht Ka Part 2
episodesList.summary: Alok suffers another episode of memory loss in the court, and he asks K.D. Pathak to withdraw from the case as he still believes that he might have killed his wife. Meanwhile, K.D. Pathak proves in the court that Sonali has written the love letter to Alok after Shefali’s death, she stole Shefali’s ring, and that she has no love relation with Alok. The mystery further deepens as K.D. Pathak finds out that Shefali and Ritwik were in the same place when the latter was murdered.

episodesList.title: Aadamkhor Ped
episodesList.summary: A mad scientist Doctor Bhaskaran is thrilled by the outcome of his research and experiments on a carnivorous plant. He calls his assistant Avantika to his lab late in the night to share with her the recent development. He asks her to conduct DNA tests on a carnivorous plant as he goes out of his lab after the door bell rings. On his return, he is shocked to find Avantika dead and entangled by twigs and branches.

episodesList.title: Kaal Ka Haiwaan Part 1
episodesList.summary: After a lot of complaints of human shrieks and screams coming from a house in the jungle, police raid the place and find a lot of human remains. They arrest a man whom they suspect to be a cannibal. Meanwhile, K.D. Pathak remembers Varun, who had passed away four months back, on his birthday in his office. However, when he sees the picture of the cannibal on a news channel, K.D. Pathak is adamant that the man in question is none other than Varun.

episodesList.title: Kaal Ka Haiwaan Part 2
episodesList.summary: KD Pathak's assistant meets a doctor to inquire him about Varun. Then, the doctor is bitten by a venomous snake and breathes his last. An unknown assailant attacks KD Pathak's assistant. Later, KD Pathak meets Varun in the prison. Meanwhile, KD Pathak's assistant learns that Varun's death was a deception and Varun is still alive. What is the mystery behind Varun's mental distress and his supposed death? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Horror Hospital Part 1
episodesList.summary: Dr. Sandhya is being sued for the murder of Babulaal, a patient she had operated on to remove kidney stones. Moreover, post-mortem records state that Babulaal's kidneys and urine tube were severed during surgery, which is how he passed away. In spite of all the evidence to the contrary, Dr. Sandhya maintains her innocence. Seeing as how everyone is trying to get her fired, she turns to K.D. Pathak for assistance.

episodesList.title: Horror Hospital Part 2
episodesList.summary: Sharman panics after seeing a dead body walking in the morgue, however, it is later revealed as Varun, who was hiding from Dr. Bhagwat. Later, Varun uncovers a kidney in an icebox which was placed inside a refrigerator inside Dr. Bhagwat's office. K.D. Pathak presents this discovery in the court to support his claim that a racket of acquiring and selling kidneys of poor patients is being run at the Satyavati Hospital.

episodesList.title: Bhootiya Hostel Part 1
episodesList.summary: Mugdha Shetty goes to a college for shooting a horror documentary along with four others. Something goes wrong during the shoot and Mugdha manages to escape from the place. She comes home to Vikas and tries to explain that she had a paranormal experience in that place. Meanwhile, the police arrest her for murder. Mugdha and her husband approach Mr. Phatak. In the court, Mugdha explains the events that took place in the college but the prosecutor accuses her of being the murderer because of her split personality disorder. Phatak thinks that maybe Mugdha is telling the truth and hence decides to send his assistants to check if the college is really haunted.

episodesList.title: Bhootiya Hostel Part 2
episodesList.summary: Mr.Phatak produces Mugdha's medical report to the court and says that nothing is wrong with the medical condition. The court has a special guest who explains what actually happened in the college. the watchman of the college experiences a paranormal activity and approaches the police for help. Phatak's assistants go back to inspect the college and catch the culprit.The next day at the court, after the prosecution of a few members related to the case, the judge comes to a conclusion.

episodesList.title: Bhootiya Bungalow
episodesList.summary: A family moves into their new home. The mother and daughter notice strange activity around the house. One night, the mother murders the father while their daughter witnesses the crime. The mother is imprisoned and her brother reaches out to K.D. Pathak to prove her innocence in court. The daughter, in her testimony, believes that her mother was possessed by a spirit which forced her to commit the crime. However, K.D. Pathak refuses to believe her theory but accepts the challenge.

episodesList.title: Raakh Ka Adi Manav Part 1
episodesList.summary: Arriving in K.D Pathak's office from Bihar, a man named Sarju is in dire need of his assistance. The man confesses that the villagers have been tormented by a monster called Rakesh ever since his grandma passed away. The village priest claims that burning down Sarju's agricultural field—where the demon appears to have taken up residence—is the only way to drive out this monster. This has been approved by the village sarpanch, and Sarju is now hoping that K.D. Pathak can assist him in preserving his crops.

episodesList.title: Raakh Ka Adi Manav Part 2
episodesList.summary: After finding the dead body of Paltan in Sarju's field, along with his sickle, the police arrests Sarju, who pleads innocence. To K.D. Pathak's surprise, the dead body was cremated before a post-mortem could be conducted. However, K.D. Pathak has an ace up his sleeves as he introduces a new evidence in the court. Will K.D. Pathak be able to save Sarju? Who is the man behind Rakash the demon?

episodesList.title: Qatil Pilot Part 1
episodesList.summary: There are rumors of a deceased fighter pilot’s ghost haunting the Jaisalmer airspace. A man with a phobia for flying takes K.D. Pathak’s seat in the business class to rest. The man later complains of seeing a ghost pilot through his window. The young politician who is next to him disagrees and mocks him. Meanwhile, the pilots wonder why it is foggy when it is supposed to be a clear night. Then, the man with the phobia finds himself holding a knife. When K.D. Pathak walks in, he finds the politician dead in his seat, with bloodstains on the knife the man is holding. Will K.D. Pathak be able to solve this scary case?

episodesList.title: Qatil Pilot Part 2
episodesList.summary: Pilots who were heading towards Jaisalmer airspace shocked to see the ghost of a deceased fighter Pilot. K.D. Pathak questions Pilot Soham about the Rum that was found in Airplane's Toilet. The court also finds out that one of the flight attendants mixed a certain drug that made anyone who consumed it to hallucinate. K.D. Pathak gets to know about a love triangle. Will K.D. Pathak and his Assistants be able to see the fighter Pilot?

episodesList.title: Rakht Pisach Part 1
episodesList.summary: Promoolving around KD Pathak, a  suave, sophisticated, witty and yet unconventional lawyer who is known as a 'Houdini' in circles of law because he can get his clients out of the tightest of situations. His success rate of acquittals is 100 percent. But most importantly KD stands not for his client, but for Justice.

episodesList.title: Rakht Pisach Part 2
episodesList.summary: K.D. Phatak loses one of his assistants during the investigation. He goes to the police station and asks for help but the police refuses to register a complaint before 24 hours. The next day, a panchayat takes place in order to decide what punishment should be given to Chandrika. In this meeting, Gauri, Tantrik baba and other members of the village are questioned. K.D. Pathak then decides to go to the jungle himself to see the mysterious creature. He calls the A.C.P for assistance. Will K.D. Phatak find the creature?

episodesList.title: Jaadui Shakti Ka Rahasya Part 1
episodesList.summary: The sight of a head with a parachute attached plummeting from the sky startles the locals. The doctor informs the police that the head is artificial following forensic investigation. The doctor also notices PK's symbol behind the face. The discovery of a dead body that resembled the face that had fallen from the sky gives the authorities still more shock. Parivartan Kumar, a well-known sculptor, is detained. K.D. Pathak chooses to take up Parivartan Kumar's legal battle. Is Jindal a part of this murder? Will K.D. catch Aadesh Chaudhary and Mansookh Kumar's killer. Pathak?

episodesList.title: Jaadui Shakti Ka Rahasya Part 2
episodesList.summary: When Parivarthak Kumar is arrested once again for the murder of two people from the city, K.D. Pathak questions him about the incident. Upon his inquiry, Parivarthak reveals to him that he was at the scene of the crime because of a call he had received from Pathak himself. Shocked, Pathak states that he never made such a call and realises that his client is being framed. As he continues to investigate the matter and defend his client, they draw nearer to finding the real perpetrator.

episodesList.title: Jaadui Shakti Ka Rahasya Part 1
episodesList.summary: A famous magician seeks help from his former guru to expand his powers of telekinesis. His guru however, refuses to help him because of his self-centred behaviour in the past. He however agrees later, when the magician offers a generous donation to the 'Ashram'. Just when he is about to begin his lessons with his guru, he dies in a mysterious fire caused by an unrecognizable force. How did the fire start in a room where the magician was alone? Who started the fire? Will K.D Phatak be able to solve this strange case?

episodesList.title: Jaadui Shakti Ka Rahasya Part 2
episodesList.summary: Swamiji confesses in the court that he killed Chiranjivi through telekinesis. But, K.D. Pathak asks the court for some more time as he thinks that Swamiji is hiding something. When K.D, Pathak tries to talk to the Swamiji about the case, Swamiji refuses him. Pathak's assistants meet one of Swamiji's students who personally went to meet him in jail, just a day before Swamiji's confession. Peshwaji reveals a shocking truth to Pathak's assistants. Did Swamiji really kill Chiranjivi?

episodesList.title: Ichhadhari Nagin: Part 1
episodesList.summary: A group of archaelogical students go on a treasure hunt. They kill a serpent that was guarding the treasure inspite of one of the group members being against the idea. As they were leaving the excavation site, they meet a sorcerer, who warns them that they made a mistake. Later that night, Koel, one of the members from the team gets killed from a snake bite. Everyone suspect Aabha for the death as she was against the idea of killing the snake. When Aabha's boyfriend reaches out for K.D.Pathak for help, a special researcher visits Pathak's office. How will KD solve this case? Is the researcher involved in the killings?

episodesList.title: Ichhadhari Nagin: Part 2
episodesList.summary: After the snake almost bit K.D Phatak in the court, it was captured by the black magician and handed over to Mumbai Veterinary Hospital to test the poison snake. Pathak proves in the court that 3 murders took place while Aabha was in prison and hence, she is not the killer. The snake somehow escapes from the hospital. While investigating more about Maya the researcher, he finds out that something shocking about her. Is Maya involved in the killings?

episodesList.title: Khooni Patang: Part 1
episodesList.summary: Rahul is having recurring dreams about getting killed by a kite. Considering it as a paranormal sign, Rahul decides to do some research on the kite along with his friend Somu. The two of them go to a village nearby to know about the dead kite maker Vishwa. They ask the villagers about the rumours about the kite. The villagers rebuff Rahul and his friend, staying at Vishwa's house, and shoo them away. Rahul decides to take a secret route that leads directly to Vishwa's house and set up their equipment there. And while doing so, Rahul is killed. Did the kite kill Rahul?

episodesList.title: Khooni Patang: Part 2
episodesList.summary: One of the kids in the village gets kidnapped by the killer kite and is nowhere to be seen. The villagers blame K.D Phatak and his interference in the village's matter. K.D Phatak's assistants find an evidence at Vishwa's house that belonged to Priyanka. Priyanka is questioned by K.D Phatak and she confesses that she followed Rahul to keep an eye on him and witnessed the kite kill Rahul. Did Rahul really get killed by the kite?

episodesList.title: Qatil Qaidi: Part 1
episodesList.summary: Satish Tyagi, a criminal, known for his escapes from high security jail, tries to escape again and gets caught for the fourth time. However, a year later, the owner of VSK industries, Mr. VIjay Shankar Kekani is murdered in his house. Surprisingly, Satish's fingerprints are found at a murder crime scene, while he is reportedly still in jail. Rina reaches out to K.D Phatak and asks him to help Satish. K.D Phatak's assistant Sunaina manages to enter the crime scene and sees Satish. Is he really involved in the murder or is he being framed?

episodesList.title: Qatil Qaidi: Part 2
episodesList.summary: Reena reveals to K.D. Pathak that a huge fight took place between Jatin and Satish and when she rushed back to stop the fight, Jatin was murdered. Sunaina tries to collect more information about VSK house but fails. Babloo is called to the balustrade and reveals a shocking truth in the court. This truth helps K.D Phatak to solve the case. Is Satish involved in the killing or was is framed ?

episodesList.title: Mayus Joker
episodesList.summary: A startling event takes place on Palak's birthday when one of the jokers gets killed by another joker. Also dead is Mr. Saxena, who was present on Palak's birthday. Joker Chandu ends up in jail. Aparna, Chandu's mother, begs K.D. Pathak to spare her son Chandu. K.D. Pathak is not inclined to pursue Chandu's case. Behind this horrible crime, who is it? Who took Mr. Saxena's life? Stay tuned in to learn more!

episodesList.title: Humshakal Qaatil: Part 1
episodesList.summary: A woman sees her clone on a street one day, and tries to call out to her, but the latter does not respond. At work, she finds that her clone has already arrived and left, and made decisions completely opposite to what she would have made. The clone even draws a large sum of money from her bank account.The situation worsens when her neighbour is murdered and she is accused of the same. Is there really a clone or is there another layer to this mystery?

episodesList.title: Humshakal Qaatil: Part 2
episodesList.summary: Prosecutor speaks in favour of K.D. Pathak and also tries to prove in the court that Nandita's lookalike has killed her neighbour. Not only K.D. Pathak but Prosecutor is also struggling hard to solve the puzzle of lookalike. K.D. Pathak tries to collect more information about the lookalike theory from Dr. Asthana. Will K.D. Pathak succeed in proving Nandita innocent? To know the conclusion of Nandita's case, watch this thrilling episode of Adaalat.

episodesList.title: Zinda Laash: Part 1
episodesList.summary: James dies in a terrible car accident. His mutilated body is buried in a nearby cemetery.He however returns one night as a zombie. He tells his brother that he didn't die in a car accident but was murdered. He says that the murder was planned and if the death goes unavenged, he will kill everyone. How will K.D Phatak get into this? Will he solve the case? Watch this thrilling episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Zinda Laash: Part 2
episodesList.summary: K.D Pathak's assistant Shravan expresses his doubt on Rishabh, the HR manager at James' company. He also says that he is doubtful on driver Shaker and his brother Arnold. Meanwhile, Vishal Singh gets arrested for killing James. K.D. Pthak comes up with an interesting master plan to prove Vishal innocent. He prosecutes Rita, James' ex wife and finds out the truth about the zombie as well.

episodesList.title: Darr @ The Mall: Part 1
episodesList.summary: Strange incidents take place at the Manglam shopping mall, every no moon night.The mall staff are aware that they shouldnt be lurking around the halls of the venue after dark The night security guard finds a ghastly apparition, floating through the mall galleries, and then witnesses the ghost murdering the owner. Was it really the ghost that murdered him, or is it a ploy that the security guard is hiding behind. Watch, as KD gets to the bottom of it.

episodesList.title: Darr @ The Mall: Part 2
episodesList.summary: Strange incidents take place at the Manglam shopping mall, every 'no moon' night. The night security guard finds a ghastly apparition, floating through the mall galleries, and then witnesses the ghost murdering the owner. K.D Phatak's friend visits him saying an employee from his agency has been arrested. K.D Phatak takes up the case and starts the investigation. Was it really the ghost that murdered the owner, or is it a plot to the case?

episodesList.title: Anaconda Ka Aatank: Part 1
episodesList.summary: A group of tourists set go on a mission to find an anaconda snake in the Amazon rainforest. A popular businessman, Mr. Keshav is also one among them. Keshav refuses to leave the island & his mission despite a few deadly encounters with the snake. He finally succeeds to bring the snake to India with him. Later, he fires his manager who has been working for his company for decades. Keshav gets killed by the anaconda later that evening. Manager Karsan Kapadia becomes the prime suspect. K.D Phatak takes up the case to defend Mr. Kapadia and prove him innocent.

episodesList.title: Anaconda Ka Aatank: Part 2
episodesList.summary: The inspector saves K.D. Pathak as he was about to get killed by the deadly Anaconda. The fear of Anaconda is spreading across the city like wild fire. Keshav had imported the deadly Snake from Brazil. Hospital authorities have found Lavanya's cell phone in Anaconda's stomach during the process of postmortem. Andy reveals a shocking truth in the court. How come there are two different anacondas? Was Keshav's death a murder or did the snake actually kill him?

episodesList.title: Khooni Professor Part - 1
episodesList.summary: A group of Professors get together after a long time to recall their college memories. One of the College Professors, Pritam, wakes up to get some water and hears some noise upstairs. As he follows the noise, he is shocked to see Swaroop's behaviour. He tries to inform his friends Shoojit and Wasim. In the process, Pritam gets killed. Swaroop gets arrested as the prime suspect for the death. Who is behind this crime? Who killed Pritam?

episodesList.title: Khooni Professor Part - 2
episodesList.summary: K.D. Pathak injects BAT Injection in his body to see the effect on the human body and also shares his experience in the court. K.D. Pathak shocked to see his medical reports. Prosecutor interrogates Swaroop's Senior Dr. Triloki Khanna in the court. K.D. Pathak faints in the court. Are Swaroop's Friends involved in the murder? To know Judge's final verdict on Swaroop's case, watch this thrilling episode of Adaalat.

episodesList.title: Mumbai Ki Rangeen Duniya: Part 1
episodesList.summary: An aspiring actress Bindiya arrives to a dance bar with her Film Director Anand Verma. He says that she needs to loosen up and follow the perspective of the dancers in the bar as it would help her role in her upcoming movie. Later that evening, Anand Verma is shot and everyone at the bar finds a gun in Bindiya's hand. Bindiya's ex fiancée Chandan requests K.D. Pathak to save Bindiya. K.D. Pathak gets to know about Chutkan, a casting director in movies. Are Saniya Khosla and Ronak Shrivastav involved in the murder?

episodesList.title: Mumbai Ki Rangeen Duniya: Part 2
episodesList.summary: The case of aspiring Actress Bindiya Mhatare continues in the court. Shravan and Varun are on their way in search of Tape 12. Actress Tanya who was supposed to be in filmmaker Anand's film reveals a shocking truth in the court. Will Bindiya be proven innocent or guilty? To know Judge's final verdict, watch this thrilling episode of Adaalat.

episodesList.title: High Court Bomber: Part 1
episodesList.summary: A Father whose Son is admitted in the Hospital plans to blast a High Court located in Mumbai. Just when he was about to blast the High Court, K.D. Pathak arrives. Some are assuming him as a suicide bomber and some as a Terrorist. Senior Clerk Abhinav who got trapped in the bribe case reveals a shocking truth in the court. Will K.D. Pathak succeed in proving Senior Clerk Abhinav innocent? Will Abhinav blast the Mumbai High Court?

episodesList.title: High Court Bomber: Part 2
episodesList.summary: Pathak has 2 hours to save judge, police, constables and the public who are present in the Mumbai High Court and 2 hours to prove Abhinav innocent. K.D Pathak gets to know that Pappu has died. ACP Rathe arrives in the court. Suvarna reveals a shocking truth in the court. K.D. Pathak has 25 minutes left to defuse the bomb. Will K.D. Pathak succeed or fail? To know Judge's final verdict on Abhinav's case, watch this thrilling episode of Adaalat.

episodesList.title: Ghoori Dyan: Part 1
episodesList.summary: Deepu's dad Kishan goes out one night to get medicines for his cattle. On his way back home, he experiences something spooky and a weird creature appears in front of him. Kishan goes missing after this incident. The zamindar of the village approaches K.D Phatak because the members of the village think that he is involved in this missing case. The next day, the Sarpanch and the other villagers find a bag containing Kishan's belongings.

episodesList.title: Ghoori Dyan: Part 2
episodesList.summary: Prosecutor becomes a target of Witch Ghoori who is spreading fear in the village. Kishan, Chandan and Jagan's belongings were found in Puniya's House and they are missing. Varun also becomes a statue. Shravan finds Nanumal's ring near Varun's statue. New Prosecutor Lekhi also witnesses Ghoori in her House. Will K.D. Pathak succeed in finding Varun? To know Judge's final verdict on Ghoori Dyan's case, watch this scary and thrilling episode of Adaalat

episodesList.title: Rahasya Kale Jaadu Ka
episodesList.summary: KD steps into a case when all is doomed for the accused. All the doors are shut. When the prosecution has prepared a water tight open and shut case where even a blind man can tell that the accused is guilty. But no one can see the case from the angle KD does. He digs fervently for loopholes in the prosecution's case much to their frustration and thinking on his feet, he manages to turn the entire case around.

episodesList.title: Masoom Gawah
episodesList.summary: One of the residents staying opposite to Kaushik Bhatt's building gets an eyeful of Kaushik wrapping up his ex-wife Pehel's dead body. Kaushik gets arrested by Inspector Dave while he was escaping from his society. He reveals in the court that his wife was already murdered when he reached home. On the other hand, Pehel's sister Payal, reveals a shocking truth in the court about Kaushik and Pehel's marriage. K.D. Pathak tries his best to save Kaushik. But, who killed his wife?

episodesList.title: Antriksh mein hatya
episodesList.summary: Two female astronauts Roshni and Alka, are on a mission in space, when Alka hallucinates about her mother calling out to her, loses her grip & almost floats out of control. The two ladies break into an argument over this and refuse to work together. Later, her colleague Roshni apologizes & invites her to go back into space with her. However, the hatch breaks lose & Alka falls into space. Now, Roshni is accused of having opened the hatch deliberately. What exactly happened?

episodesList.title: Rahasyamay Natak: Part 1
episodesList.summary: A fire broke out in Shakuntalam theatre where theatre artists were practicing their play. Entire auditorium is caught under the fire. Moving on, a bunch of actors are excited about their first rehearsal with Director Namrata Upadhayay for her play Shaitaan Ka Khel. During the rehearsal, out of no where, a shadow pops up in the theatre and the next moment, the four artists of the play are found dead. Rumors depict that this play Shaitan Ka Khel is cursed.

episodesList.title: Rahasyamay Natak: Part 2
episodesList.summary: Namrata explains to K.D. Pathak that Narkasur is behind all the murders. Writer Virendra Singh commits suicide, jumping from the Hospital's balcony. K.D. Pathak interrogates Rajesh who had designed weapons for the play 'Shaitan Ka Khel'.Moving further, K.D. Pathak unfolds a shocking truth about Babaji. Prosecutor cross-questions Seema about Viren. Seema finally reveals the truth in the court.

episodesList.title: Gumnam Jahaz Ka Rahasya
episodesList.summary: A group of youngsters, on a holiday are told a horrifying story about a ghost ship that has claimed the lives of many people. Following this story, these youngsters venture out in search of adventure, but are in for a shock. Praful, one of members of the group, gets killed and his body is found near the sea the next morning. Dheeraj, his friend, gets blamed for his murder. KD Pathak pitches in to solve this mysterious case revolving around a ship that is haunted by a ghost who kills innocent people. Watch this thrilling episode to know what happens next..

episodesList.title: Khooni CD: Part 1
episodesList.summary: A horrifying CD takes life of Kirti and Biren gets arrested in Kirti's murder case. Biren shares a shocking incident in the court. Biren reveals in the court that the CD has deadly visuals. How will K.D. Pathak find the killer? Who is behind this heinous crime?

episodesList.title: Khooni CD: Part 2
episodesList.summary: Ms. Modi reveals in the court about a drug which makes you commit suicide. K.D Phatak says that he has the CD with him and asks for permission to play it in the court. There is a sudden change in Anu's behavior after watching the deadly CD. She decides to commit suicide in the court. K.D. Pathak and his assistant Shravan come across Vanshika who got murdered by her Husband. How will K.D. Pathak solve the mysterious case of CD?

episodesList.title: Junglee Manav
episodesList.summary: A group of people are on an adventure trek in a forest & are warned about a 'primitive, jungle-inhabitant'. That night, a young girl is found stabbed to death, with the jungle man looking at her dead body. The man is captured & imprisoned under the charge of the girls murder, but K.D Phatak finds that he could be innocent! Watch this thrilling episode for more.

episodesList.title: Jaudi Maut: Part 1
episodesList.summary: Five men were found dead on the beach. Inspector Dave is shocked to see their dead bodies which were half buried inside the ground. the sixth man was missing. Doctor reveals a shocking truth to Inspector Dave. The owner of Tantra Mantra firm, Urmila gets arrested. Will K.D. Pathak succeed in saving Urmila?

episodesList.title: Jaudi Maut: Part 2
episodesList.summary: K.D. Pathak gets to know that all the five people have died because of consumption of poison. K.D. Pathak drinks poison in the court to prove his facts and feels uncomfortable. K.D. Pathak questions M.L.A Umesh Singh about Kushal and his friends. K.D. Pathak reveals a shocking truth about MLA Umesh Singh. Urmila is questioned by lawyers in the court about Sakura. Who killed Kushal and his friends?

episodesList.title: Asambhav Qatil
episodesList.summary: A young scientist, Badri Singh frantically approaches K.D Phatak claiming that one of his senior colleagues, Padma Shri Srinath Upadhya, has claimed that he would be killed by him in the near future and will be arrested for it K.D Phatak decides to keep a watch on Badri and meets Srinath where he is not treated well and thrown out of the office. K.D Phatak then plans on keeping a close watch on Srinath as well and sends his assistant. Can K.D Phatak save Badri before this prediction comes true?

episodesList.title: Victoria: Part 1
episodesList.summary: Aatmaram gets arrested in the murder of Mr. Furniturewala, the owner of an antique shop. Aatmaram is accused of Furniturewala's murder. Aatmaram's sister approaches K.D Phatak and asks for help. K.D. Pathak firmly decides to fight Aatmaram's case and tries to prove him innocent. Nishit Aggrawal, a worker in Mr. Furniturewala's antique shop reveals a shocking truth in the court. Is Aatmaram the murderer?

episodesList.title: Victoria: Part 2
episodesList.summary: One of prime witnesses of Aatmaram's case, Chandan is declared dead in the Hospital. Shravan and Varun are asked to collect more information about the lamp. Nishit reveals a shocking truth about the argument that took place between Firdos and Kailash. K.D Phatak will find a small detail about the store manager and asks him about it. Will K.D. Pathak succeed in proving Aatmaram innocent?

episodesList.title: Shrapit Khanzar: Part 1
episodesList.summary: A man visits an old palace to see if it can be put to commercial use. He finds an ancient dagger hidden away in a secret room & is fascinated by it. He is told that the dagger is cursed & is sure to claim lives each time it is removed from its scabbard. Watch as KD cracks the mystery behind this curse.

episodesList.title: Shrapit Khanzar: Part 2
episodesList.summary: K.D. Pathak goes in to the skin of the case and also reveals to his assistants Varun and Shravan that there is not 1 but 2 daggers. Varun is having a doubt on Abhay. Who is stealing the ancient dagger from the Museum? Who is stabbing People with ancient dagger?

episodesList.title: Murder at Cricket pitch
episodesList.summary: An aspring cricketer Ranjan gets inside the stadium. One of the players from his team, Gaurav gets arrested. A massive fight had taken place between Gaurav and Ranjan as Gaurav got run out because of Ranjan. Gaurav and Ranjan both wanted to get selected by selectors to play in International Cricket. Sanjana reveals in the court that she saw Gaurav beating Ranjan with the bat. Who killed Ranjan?  Is Gaurav innocent?

episodesList.title: Dhund Ka Rahasya: Part 1
episodesList.summary: Two brothers break into a fight over their inheritance, after paying a visit to their dying father. On their way back, the three brothers are walking through the woods where the two brothers are surrounded by a dense fog, and one brother sees the other being attacked by a spirit-like creature through the fog. He tries to rescue him, but cannot & his brother is eventually choked to death. Their third, brother, who saw the scene from a distance, believed that he saw one brother choking the other to death. Watch as K.D Phatak solves this convoluted mystery.

episodesList.title: Dhund Ka Rahasya: Part 2
episodesList.summary: The story of dense fog continues in the court. Varun and Shravan try to collect more information about Sushant in his Chemical factory. Who wants to conquer Sushant's Chemical factory? What will be K.D. Pathak's next plan to save Sushant? To know Judge's final verdict.

episodesList.title: Khatarnak Fashion
episodesList.summary: Netra, who was one of the models walking on the ramp, gets killed in the green room with a pair of scissors. K.D. Pathak was present in the fashion show and firmly decides to save his client Nilakshi. Nilakshi reveals a shocking truth about the butterfly attack in the green room. The lawyer questions the fashion designer, Pushkar Samrat about the fashion charity event. Who killed Netra? Is Nilakshi really involved?

episodesList.title: Khooni Putla Part 1
episodesList.summary: A young lady arrives at a boutique for an interview with the boutique owner. While she is waiting for her, the lights suddenly start to flicker and one of the mannequins starts to walk towards her. When the boutique owner arrives at the scene, she witnesses the mannequin killing the lady. Later, the watchman reveals that the lady is dead. Pooja explains the horrifying scene to the police. The inspector notices that the CCTV turns off moments before the death of the lady. Pooja gets arrested for the murder of the young lady. Pooja's sister approaches K.D Phatak for help. What happens next? Watch and find out.

episodesList.title: Khooni Putla Part 2
episodesList.summary: A young lady arrives at a boutique for an interview with the boutique owner. While she is waiting for her, the lights suddenly start to flicker and one of the mannequins starts to walk towards her. When the boutique owner arrives at the scene, she witnesses the mannequin killing the lady. Later, the watchman reveals that the lady is dead. Pooja explains the horrifying scene to the police. The inspector notices that the CCTV turns off moments before the death of the lady.

episodesList.title: Khooni Car Ka Rahasya
episodesList.summary: A businessman buys a vintage car. But there is something strange about it. One night, some people in the neighbourhood,spot the car being driven very rashly, but later they realize that there was no driver in the car.

episodesList.title: Khooni Panchhi Part 1
episodesList.summary: K.D Phatak fights an incredible case about a bird that killed a girl. Madhurima, a girl from a small village in Nasik gets attacked and killed by a bird named Sultan. The owner of the bird gets arrested as the police suspect him as the killer. K.D Phatak takes up this case and fights for his innocence.

episodesList.title: Khooni Panchhi Part 2
episodesList.summary: The peculiar case of the bird Sultan continues and one of the assistants of Lawyer K.D. Pathak, Sunaina lands in deep trouble. Pankaj reveals in the court that Sarju Rao, the owner of the bird, had hypnotized Sultan. Will K.D. Pathak succeed in saving Sarju Rao?  Will Sarju Rao reveal the truth in the court?

episodesList.title: Murda Qatil
episodesList.summary: Jayshree Burman gets arrested for killing four people. Her assistant Girish, Investment Officer Anshuman Mehta, and the clients Subodh Pradhan and Sanjay Desai. Jayshree wanted to make a huge deal with her client Subodh Pradhan but she was shocked as she came to know that Subodh agreed to meet her competitor, Anshuman Mehta. Will K.D. Pathak prove Jayshree innocent?

episodesList.title: Yamraaj: Part 1
episodesList.summary: A man is fights on the night of his wedding and his bride is the prime suspect. However, the bride claims that Yamraaj, the Hindu god of death, killed her husband. This case intrigues K.D. Pathak’s curiosity and he decides to fight the case as the opposition lawyer. Will the he be able to prove the bride’s innocence when all the clues prove otherwise?

episodesList.title: Yamraaj: Part 2
episodesList.summary: The case is tried in court and new discoveries are made. New suspects are found in the case, however, they play the blame game which leads to no constructive progress in the case. Meanwhile, K.D. Pathak through his personal investigation finds that the bride was drugged on her wedding night.

episodesList.title: Khooni Khwab
episodesList.summary: A strange incident occurs with Sanjay Sahani as he observes Aryan's murder in his dream but soon Sanjay's dream turns in to a worst nightmare for him as he gets arrested for killing Aryan Jha outside a nightclub. This is humanly impossible. There comes another shock for K.D. Pathak as Monty and Nishi also get killed.

episodesList.title: Doodh Ka Karz Part 1
episodesList.summary: A man’s body is found immersed in a bath tub full of milk. On investigation, the police learn that the crime scene used to be a milk plant which was destroyed by a bomb blast in the past. They also find clues at the crime scene which lead them to the victim’s wife. The victim’s wife also the prime suspect pleads with K.D.Pathak to save her. Will K.D. Pathak be able to prove that the wife is innocent when all the clues prove otherwise? Watch to find out.

episodesList.title: Doodh Ka Karz Part 2
episodesList.summary: During his investigation on the case involving the milk factory, K.D. Pathak survives an attack on his life. Later, it is found that the milk he was given was poisoned. He suspects that the owner of the factory and his son are somehow involved with the case and his poisoning.

episodesList.title: Rahasya 120 Saal Ka
episodesList.summary: Harish Panekar, one of the oldest living man, dies on the day of his 120th birthday. During their investigation, the police find out something strange. They arrest the nurse based on the testimony given by the victim's manservant. K. D. Pathak tracks the case covered by media and finds the nurse innocent and decides to fight the case for her.

episodesList.title: Client in coma: Part 1
episodesList.summary: K.D. Pathak saves the life of a man involved in an accident. However, he later learns from the police that he was a suspect in a case involving the kidnapping of a girl child.  On further investigation, the police find a dead body in the trunk of the suspect’s car. K.D. Pathak decides to fight the case despite all the evidence stating otherwise.

episodesList.title: Client in coma: Part 2
episodesList.summary: Lawyer KD Pathak has taken up a case, where his client is in Coma. Satyapal is accused of abduction of a child. The is very tricky as no major clue is available to prove Satyapal's innocent. Can KD Pathak prove him innocent?

episodesList.title: Hit By Train
episodesList.summary: A journalist is pushed from an over- bridge and her body is found on the railway tracks. Another journalist from a rival news agency is arrested for the murder. K.D. Pathak decides to fight the case as the defence lawyer. However, he is caught off guard when he finds that the prosecution lawyer is a disciple of his teacher. Watch K.D. Pathak fight the case against a worthy opponent.

episodesList.title: Quatil Billi
episodesList.summary: Angel, a pet cat is accused of killing her owner, Deeya khanna, evidence being the teeth marks on the deceased neckline, Mrs D’mello is also found dead under the same circumstances after she agrees to keep the cat at her place. Decision was made to kill Angel using a lethal injection. KD investigates the matter from his own end and decides to take up the case in spite of Dave’s apprehensions and all the other members of the society including Thadani, Vipin, Sandhya and Vilayat.

episodesList.title: Jaal Tantra Mantra Ka
episodesList.summary: Ruchita and Tabassum, high profile ladies are found dead under strange circumstances with cult being performed on them, a famous Ojha Baba is immediately under scrutiny since they were both his followers. All evidence is against him but KD's intuition tells him that there is more to the case than meets the eye. He discovers that both ladies bought the similar bags from the same shop few days before they were killed.

episodesList.title: Royal Murder: Part 1
episodesList.summary: A royal family finds itself in great turmoil after King Mahavendraand Queen Priyambada were found brutally murdered. The prime suspect is the family servant, Santosh but the shadow of doubt also extends to Prateik who, despite the king's disapproval, continued his relationship with one of the family's daughter, Princess Yashodhara. KD succeeds in getting Santosh acquitted as Prateik admits to the crime but strangely the case is far from over. Watch out for more.

episodesList.title: Royal Murder: Part 2
episodesList.summary: K.D. Pathak feels that justice was not served in the Royal family case and pleads with the court to re-open the case. As the case unfolds, the number of suspects increases which includes Raunak, the prince and also the successor to the family, Bharmal kaka, who is struggling with an ugly past, Rano, the king's mistress and the youngest daughter of the family ,Ritambhara, a six year old child. To know more, Watch the conclusion of this interesting case.

episodesList.title: Deshbhakt Ya Deshdrohi
episodesList.summary: KD rescues a young boy, Aman who was being humiliated in the hand of some bullies. He discovers that Aman’s father Samar Sheikh was tagged as a traitor, falsely accused of letting a dangerous criminal Bilawal to escape from his custody. Coincidentally, Samar's grandfather is to be honored this independence day for his contribution to the freedom struggle but he refuse to be a part of the felicitation ceremony as he awaits justice for his family. KD takes up the case in order to protect the honour of this family but the struggle seems to be extremely challenging as an arrogant veteran lawyer with a 40 years of experience, Katiyal stands as a prosecutor , head bent to beat KD at each step. The fact that only Samar had the key to the van door raises suspicion that probably he helped Bilawal to escape. The mystery of how Bilawal escaped in the bracket of 3 minutes from a high security police van running at a speed of 80 km/hr is bugging KD. In the cloud of doubts & mystery how will KD be able to bring back honour to Samar and restore the faith of a freedom fighter on the Independence day?

episodesList.title: Room No 666 Ka Rahasya: Part 1
episodesList.summary: A movie producer is murdered under strange circumstances in his hotel room. The prime suspect in the case is a writer who was reportedly involved in an altercation with the victim prior to his death. When K.D.Pathak is assigned the case, he learns that the suspect had seen a woman set the victim on fire and push him off the building. However, the waiter, who was an eyewitness, claimed otherwise. Was he lying or does this involve the paranormal?

episodesList.title: Room No 666 Ka Rahasya: Part 2
episodesList.summary: Publisher Zubin reveals in the court that Manav had narrated a story which was similar to Rajiv's death. K.D. Pathak questions Zubin about Rajiv's death. A shocking footage is revealed in the court. What had happened 5 years back in room no 666?

episodesList.title: Murde Ki Hatya Ka Rahshya
episodesList.summary: A man is arrested by the police for digging up graves and mutilating their bodies with an axe. On interrogation, the police find that the suspect had dreamt about his brother being dead and was following his orders, received in the said dream, to kill those people.

episodesList.title: Badla Pichhle Janam Ka
episodesList.summary: Vaidik is accused of his father’s death who fell from the terrace. Vaidik tells KD he didn't do it. His father wasn't well so he took his father out to the terrace for some fresh air but did not kill him. However, a video by the prosecution presents shocks everyone. It was shot from the opposite terrace where two girls were recording themselves but in the background, Vaidik is clearly seen pushing his father from the terrace. KD is taken aback. All of a sudden Vaidik accepts that he killed his father but claims that a mystical voice commanded him to do so. The prosecution ridicules this but a psychiatrist upholds Vaidik’s claim. Nityanand would often dream of being on a battlefield and killing an unarmed soldier who he realized was his son from the present life. Vaidik too dreamt the same dream time and again. How can two people dream two halves of the same dream?

episodesList.title: Killer Guitar: Part 1
episodesList.summary: Andy, the bass guitarist of a rock band is accused of the murder of his band member Ryan. Andy being Varun’s cousin, KD Pathak takes up the case. Andy is confident that he will be acquitted, as he knows he has done nothing wrong. To everyone's surprise, Andy is free in the initial trial itself, not just because of lack of evidence but also because the witness that Jaiswal had presented admits to giving a false statement against Andy owing to Jaiswal pressurizing him. Andy is not even thankful to KD. KD starts to play the cursed guitar. What will happen now? Will KD be able to save himself from the curse? Watch to find out.

episodesList.title: Killer Guitar: Part 2
episodesList.summary: The story takes a twist when Zack who was to replace Andy in the group is murdered. Andy is scared and approaches. As the trial ensues, Kamat the manager of the band claims that it's not Andy but the guitar that the victims played and the tune that killed them. To debunk the ‘Cursed Guitar Theory’, Jaiswal asks if anyone would like to play it and one of the people in the court does. Surprisingly, he is murdered too. This shocks everyone. KD smells foul play. Determined to end the outrageous claim, KD eventually himself plays the tune on the guitar in the court. Is KD going to get murdered too?

episodesList.title: Gawah Ya Khooni
episodesList.summary: A Case where a man who lost his memory is found with a novel in hand and lodged in the novel is a bullet. Meanwhile, the cops find the body of a famous Art Dealer in an art gallery. Riddled with 4 bullets, they find five bullet casings around him and realize a fifth bullet was fired but is missing. The two stories connect and before you know it, the cops feel this Amnesiac Man who has a signature beginning with K, is the only link/witness to the murder of the art dealer. The shooter fired at the Art Dealer and one bullet missed and hit this man’s novel.  And this leads to an intricate web of Fake Paintings, Forgeries, Omani Sheikhs and dubious painters who all end up being under the needle of suspicion.

episodesList.title: Deewana Qatil: Part 1
episodesList.summary: The case of a man, Baalam, who claims to love an actress. But he is upset with her as she is married to a businessman. He gives threatening calls to her as she broke his heart. A day later, the actress is found dead with the film reel wrapped around her body. Clearly, the culprit is  Baalam. KD takes up the case as his mother tells him the reason behind his madness for actresses. He had lost his love some years back.

episodesList.title: Deewana Qatil: Part 2
episodesList.summary: Baalam has now found another actress to be mad for, Barkha but there is news that she also is about to get married. He manages to escape from prison and when found, he has the dead body of Barkha lying by his side. The case is complicated when he starts blackmailing KD to get the autograph of an actress, which when KD refuses, Baalam publically confesses that he murdered both the actresses.

episodesList.title: Ek Khoon Char Aaropi
episodesList.summary: Four men in a Sauna with their boss, the owner of the company. One of them is involved in a 15 crore scam which the boss is about to get to know. They had four props a book, a flask, a cell phone and an iPod. Neither is a weapon.  But when the mist of the Sauna clears, the boss is killed with a deep wound impaling his neck.  Only one of the other four could have done it. The cops do their research and arrest Roshan, who is involved in the scam.  But KD feels otherwise.

episodesList.title: Amnesiac husband: Part 1
episodesList.summary: A car with a couple meets with an accident. The husband undergoes a face surgery as it is badly scarred. Also, his memory is lost. After the husband’s face is healed completely, he is taken under arrest on account of drinking and driving. KD takes this case up as the wife and everyone around tells him that the husband never used to drink. The case escalates when it is found that wife had an extramarital affair with a man called Rajat, who is also missing since the same day they met with the accident. The troubles deepen for the husband and story takes a turn when Rajat’s body is found, but everyone is shocked to see that it has the same face as the husband. How would KD crack the case?

episodesList.title: Amnesiac husband: Part 2
episodesList.summary: Kabir is accused of murdering Rajat. K.D. Pathak decides to fight the case and tries all possible ways to save Kabir. The case escalates when it is found that wife had an extra marital affair with a man called Rajat, who is also missing since the same day they met with the accident. The troubles deepen for the husband and story takes a turn when Rajat’s body is found, but everyone is shocked to see that it has the same face as the husband.

episodesList.title: The Challenger
episodesList.summary: A man is accused of setting his cottage on fire with his wife and child inside. A stranger walks into K.D Phatak's office and confesses that she started the fire in the cottage. She further continues to challenge K.D Phatak to prove her guilty in the court. K.D Phatak decides to take the case up but finds clear evidence for the suspect to be at fault. He further finds out that the suspect was involved in a marital affair with Dimple, who challenged K.D Phatak portraying to be Avni. Who is the real culprit?

episodesList.title: Nausikhiya Chor ya Beraham Qatil
episodesList.summary: When K.D Phatak decides to arrange something for Binnymore's birthday, he receives a call from her saying she is at the police station.When he arrives at the police station, he sees her yelling at an officer asking him to release the boy, Pinchu, who she claims to be innocent. At the court, the prosecutor assumes this to be a case of mercy killing but, K.D Phatak thinks otherwise. K.D Phatak continues his investigation to find out that Pinchu has selective Kleptomania.

episodesList.title: Murder In Lift
episodesList.summary: Amathya Patel, a person suffering from Meningnitis is accused of murdering his step-father, Sameer Prasad in the lift. K.D Phatak takes up the case and decides to fight for Amathya as he thinks there was another person present in the lift apart from Amathya and Sameer. At first, the guard of the building is questioned. Later, Natwar the financer and Alex the stuntman are questioned. Who is the killer? Will K.D Phatak solve the case?

episodesList.title: Pran Jaye Par Vachan Na Jaye
episodesList.summary: The night watchman of Nirmal Heights Apartments finds drops of blood on the ground. When he follows the trail, he finds Joginder Kukreja dead body in the car. The police arrest Devika for the murder as she confesses her crime. But the police inspector feels otherwise about her as she is old. He calls K.D Phatak and advises him to take up the case. Devika is certain of not taking help from anyone. What happens to Devika?

episodesList.title: Death of a Super Hero Part 1
episodesList.summary: Gagan, the hero of the serial 'Suryaman' falls off a building during a shoot and dies. Jamshed, the stunts coordinator gets arrested for the murder of the actor. K.D Phatak takes up Jamshed's case and decides to fight for him. Meanwhile, Gagan's daughter thinks that her stepmother is the reason for the death of her father.

episodesList.title: Death of a Super Hero Part 2
episodesList.summary: K.D Phatak continues to fight for Jamshed, the stuntman of Gagan. He calls Hiren, Gagan's lawyer in the witness box for questioning. At the same time, K.D Phatak learns that Gagan's makeup artist has been killed the exact same way he was killed. As Hiren starts answering the questions asked, he mentions about Gagan's broken marriage and his plan to divorce his wife.

episodesList.title: Shakhchunni: Part 2
episodesList.summary: Ashi a village girl gets married to Dishant. Unhappy with his marriage, Dishant decides to sleep separately. One night, he sees his wife jumping from the terrace. But, when he checks the room, he sees her sleeping soundly. Dishant reaches for K.D Phatak's help and explains this issue. The prosecutor accuses Dishant.

episodesList.title: Shakhchunni: Part 2
episodesList.summary: As K.D Phatak continues to dig deeper into the case, he starts to suspect more people. He figures out that the dupatta with Radha's name on it had no burnt marks or any other damage on it; hence, coming to a conclusion that it was a remake. Meanwhile, he stops the baba from cutting down all the mango trees assuming that Radha's soul is trapped in it. Next day at the court, he proves that Ashi was a victim of a certain mental disorder.

episodesList.title: Kadghare Mein Judge
episodesList.summary: Maushir Masalawala gets a sentence of six months in prison for stealing. Shruti, his girlfriend is disheartened and tells him that she's disappointed with him. She further says that their marriage wouldn't be approved by their family as the judge who punished him is her uncle. As days passed, Shruti is excited to be a part of her sister's wedding. While going to help the bride to get ready, Maushir calls her, asking her about their baby. Unfortunately, Justice Chand, Shruti's uncle hears this conversation. Later, everyone in the family finds Shruti dead and are shocked.

episodesList.title: Diwali Special
episodesList.summary: Inspector Dave calls K.D Phatak to inform him that he wouldn't be coming for dinner because he has to take a look at a murder case. K.D Phatak gets curious to find out about the case and meets Vivek Dara. Vivek Dara is the youngest son of Pitambar Dara and is accused of killing his own father. K.D Phatak decides to help Vivek and takes up his case only to find out that their family was a big mess as none of the siblings liked each other.

episodesList.title: Bolta Puppet
episodesList.summary: Ankita Vora's sister finds her at the edge of a cliff holding a knife. She runs to grab her thinking she is going to commit suicide. Soon, she learned that a puppet Anish, Ankita's husband had, had encouraged her to kill her husband. K.D Phatak receives a call from the talking puppet saying that it had murdered Anish. The puppet introduces itself as Harry and video calls K.D Phatak as a proof. K.D Phatak meets Anita and realizes that she is in shock from seeing her husband die. How will K.D Phatak find the culprit?

episodesList.title: Murder at Play
episodesList.summary: K.D Phatak and his team go to watch a play. During the play, they notice that Manas, the actor in lead role is on the ground with a knife pierced through his stomach. While the audience thinks it is method acting, they soon realize that he has actually been injured. Zenia, the actress in lead role gets arrested for the murder as she was the only person on stage with Manas.

episodesList.title: KD Aur Aatma Ka Rahasya
episodesList.summary: While K.D Phatak is at a newsstand buying a newspaper, a strange thing happens to him. He meets a man named Jayant Kirani and starts talking to him about a certain case. Jayant says that a person has murdered the previous night and his wife, Shivani is seen as a major suspect and is arrested. Before going back, he mentions that the person who was murdered was himself. The newspaper seller calls out the K.D. Phatak asking who he was talking to as there was no one around them. The same incident happens that night with K.D as Jayant provides K.D with a clue.

episodesList.title: Swami Ji Ka Qatil
episodesList.summary: Krishna, a disciple of Satyanand is spotted holding a tiki torch and heading towards the pharmacy to destroy the medicines. when another disciple follows him, trying to stop him but seconds later sees the pharmacy on fire. He further notices that Satyanand guruji was still inside the room and is now stuck in a burning room. Krishna gets arrested and is accused of attempt to murder. Satyanand says that he saw Krishna start the fire. The next day, Krishna's mother reaches for K.D Phatak's help and asks him to take the case. How will K.D Phatak be able to help Krishna?

episodesList.title: Mrs. Billimoria Ka Case
episodesList.summary: Billy is celebrating her uncle Rustom's birthday at his house. As the clock strikes 12, Rustom says that he has found out a dirty secret of one of his family members and will reveal it the following day in front of h9is friend, ACP Raud.  That night, Rustom sees someone in a yellow raincoat trying to strangle him. He pushes the glass of water as a sign, creating noise loud enough for his son to rush into his room. Unfortunately, by then the culpirt escapes. The next day, Billy gets arrested. K.D.Phatak for help.

episodesList.title: Anokhi Chunauti
episodesList.summary: Radhe, K.D Phatak's cook is on the phone with K.D Phatak as he hears a knock on the door. He cuts the call in order to attend the door but, doesn't find anyone at the door. He opens the door wondering who it might be as it is pretty late but, to his shock, someone swings a sickle at him. Garuda gets arrested for Radhe's murder. K.D Phatak meets Garuda to tell him that he will be fighting against him to acquire peace to Radhe's soul. But, to his shock, Garuda warns him saying that the court needs proof for everything and he's managed to destroy all the proof.

episodesList.title: KD and the Crazies
episodesList.summary: One night at Shanti Nivas, a mental asylum, a man is found murdered near one of the cells. The victim Tipu, was an attendant at the asylum, who had stolen a patient Drishti's necklace before he was murdered. When his partner finds his dead body, he sees a shivering Drishti sitting next to him with a bloody knife in her hand. The next morning, as Drishti is accused of murdering Tipu, the nurse at the asylum seeks K.D. Pathak's help, knowing that Drishti is innocent.

episodesList.title: Dayan
episodesList.summary: When three notorious girls are electrocuted to at a ladies' hostel compound, the residents in the hostel get worried. A few nights later, one of them, Namrata, manages to escape from the killer's grasp, and is rescued by the security and the other girls. When the hostel attendant, Mona arrives at the scene, Namrata is overcome with fear upon noticing that she resembled the killer. Mona is then accused of and is arrested, causing her to seek Pathak's help to prove her innocence.

episodesList.title: Murder  By Latter
episodesList.summary: Sanjeev Soni, a candidate for the position of Prime Minister in the upcoming elections, is accused of murdering his wife Bhoomika, who was found dead in a hotel suite one morning. Having read a confidential mail addressed to Sanjeev which implied that the latter was cheating on his wife, Bhoomika walked out on him on the day of her demise

episodesList.title: Shiv Ka Shraap Part 1
episodesList.summary: Sanjeev Soni, a candidate for the position of Prime Minister in the upcoming elections, is accused of murdering his wife Bhoomika, who was found dead in a hotel suite one morning. Having read a confidential mail addressed to Sanjeev which implied that the latter was cheating on his wife, Bhoomika walked out on him on the day of her demise. Suspecting foul play, K.D. Pathak resolves to fight for Sanjeev.

episodesList.title: Shiv Ka Shraap Part 2
episodesList.summary: A young man from Jharkhand by the name of Madhav, accuses the god Shiva of having murdered his dear friend Ashish Mitra. The extraordinary claim soon makes breaking news, which reaches the ears of K.D. Pathak. Unable to believe the young man's claims, Pathak decides to investigate the case. Unsure of the authenticity behind Madhav's claims, Pathak visits him in the hospital and learns from him the events of the murder. He then decides to find out the truth and expose the real killer.

episodesList.title: CID vs Adaalat Karmyudh
episodesList.summary: In this second episode of Adaalat; we will to know about the investigation of Meghna murder case. The allegation of murder is on Mahaguru Atyanand and team CID is thoroughly investigating all the details of the case. However, Team CID is made confused by a call from Megha’s number to the ACP. Want to know who is trying to confuse CID?

episodesList.title: Resin Attack
episodesList.summary: Aditi gets attacked by a few strangers in a white car while she was waiting for a bus. She gets hit by the car and falls in hot oil which was next to the bus station and burns her face. When the police question her, she tells them that she's sure that her ex Viraj was behind this heinous act. But the next day,  she goes back to the police station and withdraws her complaint. the next day, she gets attacked again and dies.

episodesList.title: Scare Crow
episodesList.summary: Gagan gets murdered in Kailash's fields and the entire village assumes that the trapped soul in one of the scarecrows in Kailash's fields killed him. Thakur, the village Mukhia bosses over Kailash and demands for his land saying the time period to pay is six months and not two years. Kailash and his wife reach K.D Phatak for help and mention about the scarecrow and the mysterious activities that have been taking place since the death of the Jakir Singh.

episodesList.title: Yaksh
episodesList.summary: Bacchu and Lakhan Singh go to Bhagmati lake to throw garbage. Lakhan decides to stay back and look after the truck as Bacchu goes to the lake to discard the garbage. Bacchu comes across a mysterious creature Yaksha, the protector of the environment. Terrified of what he had witnessed, Bacchu runs to inform Lakhan about the Yaksha but, Lakhan laughs at him which leads to an argument between the two; resulting in Lakhan leaving Bacchu at the disposal site. When he returns after some time, Lakhan finds Bacchu's dead body on the ground. Lakhan gets arrested for the murder and Lakhan's wife reaches for K.D Phatak's help. How will K.D solve this case?

episodesList.title: Outhouse Skeleton
episodesList.summary: Ranveer Ranjha, a pop star gets arrested for the murder of his manager Manish. K.D Pathak takes up Ranveer's case and tries to help him get out of the case. The prosecutor points out that Manish's dead body was found hidden and cemented in one of the walls of Ranveer's guest house. He further continues to say that the Police found a cricket bat which was used to murder Manish along with the body from the same place. How will K.D Phatak solve this tough case?

episodesList.title: Goa Mein Bhootia Car Part 1
episodesList.summary: In this episode of Adaalat, we will get to know about a vintage car which has killed a youth named Savio on the roads of Goa. However, the eye witness of the incident has narrated to the investigating officers that there was no driver inside the haunted car and it was running on its own. Moreover, the owner of the car Mr. Jhilmil is arrested for killing Savio! Want to know more about the case? Then stay tuned in and find out here!

episodesList.title: Goa Mein Bhootia Car Part 2
episodesList.summary: In this episode of Adaalat, Sussane claims that the car is no longer buried under the ground and has escaped. She and her brother claim that the car is now possessed by the ghost of their father and is out for revenge. The four friends Mark, David, Savio and Nikhil were after the car as it is vintage and there are five such cars in the world. They tried to intimidate their father by vandalizing the car that gave James a heart attack. Will the car get revenge? Or is there something else to this case?

episodesList.title: Lohri Special
episodesList.summary: Amanpreet and Sarabjeet elope from their respective homes to start a new life together. Before taking any decision on their own, they meet with K.D Phatak. The couple tells K.D Phatak that they have left their family to start a life together and further explain about their families' rivalry. K.D says that he would take up their case if only they return to their house. He decides to meet Sarabjeet's uncle in prison to find out more about how the conflicts between the families started.

episodesList.title: Murder Sankrati
episodesList.summary: Urmi asks her husband Ankit to stop flying the kite and get ready as they had to go visit her mother and the rest of her family. but, Ankit says that he is least interested to visit them as he is treated as a servant rather than a son-in-law. After reaching their house, Jignesh, Urmi's brother collects a bag of medicines from Ankit and walks away. Seeing this, Ankit says that he hates Jignesh and wishes to see him dead. Minutes later, everyone in the house hears a huge explosion in the terrace. When they rush to see what caused the explosion, they see Jignesh on fire. Suresh and Ankit become the prime suspects. What happens next? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: The Terrorist Part 1
episodesList.summary: Latif, a demolition worker gets caught in Mumbai with a bag containing bombs and explosives. The media says that he was trying to demolish a wall behind an army school near by. Latif's mother visits K.D. Phatak and tells him that someone has tricked her son into this and he is innocent. K.D. Phatak agrees to take up the case and make sure he acquires justice.

episodesList.title: The Terrorist Part 2
episodesList.summary: Latif, a demolition worker gets caught in Mumbai with a bag containing bombs and explosives. The media says that he was trying to demolish a wall behind an army school near by. Latif's mother visits K.D. Phatak and tells him that someone has tricked her son into this and he is innocent. K.D. Phatak agrees to take up the case and make sure he acquires justice.

episodesList.title: Hunch Back
episodesList.summary: Akash has invited his friend on a dinner and it was then Akash’s wife Sonia got brutally murdered. However, now the blame of murder is on Ronak but he is pleading before KD Pathak that he is trapped in this case and wants justice! Want to know more? Then stay tuned in and find out here!

episodesList.title: The Evil Twin
episodesList.summary: A man watching a horror film in his apartment witnesses a murder in the house opposite to him and calls the police. When the police find Sudeep dead on the floor, they see his girlfriend crying next to the corpse. Sudeep's girlfriend gets blamed for the murder and gets arrested.

episodesList.title: Haunted House Part 1
episodesList.summary: Vibhur, Aditi, and his family move into a new mansion in a jungle. As they move in, they start noticing weird activities taking place around them. Vibhur hears some noise from the bathroom of his house and goes to check. He finds the realtor fixing a rusted tap and freaks out. Later, Aditi notices the rude behavior of her neighbor and mentions it to her husband. That night, Vibhur attempts to shoot his stepson but ends up killing the old lady. how will K.D Phatak help Vibhur out?

episodesList.title: Haunted House Part 2
episodesList.summary: In this episode of Adaalat, we will get to know about a double murder which has happened inside a haunted house. Mrs. Dilshad Mistry and Mr. Taneja is killed inside the haunted house which is approximately 100 years old structure. However, the allegation of murder is on KD Pathak’s client Mr. Vibhor Shetty! Can KD Pathak prove his client’s innocence before the honourable court?

episodesList.title: The Apartment Part 1
episodesList.summary: Karan sees two men carrying a heavy trunk into his neighbor's house. He notices that the trunk starts shaking in the elevator and freaks out. Later, he tells his friend about this and both of them decide to sneak into their house. After sneaking in, they witness the Divechas worshipping the demon and are shocked. The two friends go to the police to complain but, fail to show any proof.  The next day, they disguise themselves as electricians and hide a spy cam in the Divechas house.
