Afterward, when Karan doesn't show up, his friend takes it to the police himself. when the police watch the video, they see Karan being stabbed with a knife by his own friend. Karan's friend gets arrested and calls K.D Phatak for help.

episodesList.title: The Apartment Part 2
episodesList.summary: Chetan gets released from the prison but, to his misfortune,  more weird incidents start happening after his release. The Divechas find Karan's body and promise Chetan to bring him back to life.  Later, Inspector Dave finds Karan's dead body inChetan's house and arrests him. Raavi, a common friend of Karan and Chetan says that Chetan suffers from schizophrenia and just then, Chetan has an anxiety attack ad faints in the court room. Are the Divechas really the culprits or is Chetan delusional?

episodesList.title: The Chatroom Part 1
episodesList.summary: Payal gets arrested for the murder of her friend Keith. But, unfortunately, dies of an electric shock. K.D Phatak decides to become a member of the chat room and joins the social networking site. Later, Keith's sister gets a call from his friend asking for a favor.

episodesList.title: Bairagadh Ka Piscaach
episodesList.summary: Kinchuk Das, his friends Gagan Singh and Maadhav are on their way back to the city when they see a woman dressed as a bride and walking towards them in the jungle. They decide to help her out but soon, their car breaks down. They see an old building near by and decide to rest for some time. All of them notice cannibalistic behavior of the owner of the house during dinner. Later, Kinchuk Das is found dead and Kunwar is caught sucking blood out of Kinchuk's body. K.D Phatak decides to fight for Kunwar and take up his case. Is Kunwar a vampire?

episodesList.title: Bairaag Ka Pisaach
episodesList.summary: In Today’s episode of Adaalat; we will get to know that about the investigation of Kingshuk Das murder case and its proceedings in the court room. However, tonight we will get to know that in search of Shukmani; Inspector Dave; is held captive inside the haunted ancestral palace! Want to know more about the evil spirit angle associated with this case?

episodesList.title: The Auto Writer Part 1
episodesList.summary: In Today’s episode of Adaalat, we will get to know about a murder case of Justice Debabrata Shina’s son Bharghav. A lady named Yakshita Manjrekar has called up Justice Sinha to inform him that his son has reached to the world of spirits and doesn’t wants to return back from there. However, she claims that she is able to speak with him and he wants to inform her about his murderers! Want to know more? Then stay tuned in and find out here!

episodesList.title: The Auto Writer Part 2
episodesList.summary: The psychiatrist named Yakshita Manjrekar has convinced Bharghav’s mother that her son wants to communicate with her and she started teaching her the art of communicating with spirits. However, they both went on and informed KD Pathak about the hallucinating fact that they are able to communicate with deceased Bharghav but will KD believe on Yakshita’s theory in this case! Want to know more? Then stay tuned in and find out here!

episodesList.title: Jurassic Jazeera Part 1
episodesList.summary: In Today’s episode; we will get to know about a case where KD Pathak, inspector Dave and a famous businessman Mr. Walia were flying in a private Jet to Chandigarh. The pilot of the private jet has very dubiously took them to an isolated island where Dinosaurs are still found! Want to know the Pilot has done this? Want to know on whose orders the Pilot has put everyone’s life at stake? Want to know more? Then stay tuned in and find out here!

episodesList.title: Jurassic Jazeera Part 2
episodesList.summary: K.D gains the trust of the primitive jungle men by playing a voice recording. Meanwhile, inspector Dave and gang run towards the plane to escape from the T-Rex. Will the group successfully escape from the enormous creature? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Trikon the Magician Part 1
episodesList.summary: KD arrives with the police commissioner to enjoy a magic show. During the show, the magician's assistant disappears while a doctor who went missing 30 years ago, reappears. KD is informed by the comissioner that Dr Prakash had murdered another doctor and gone into hiding 30 years before. But KD is baffled by Dr Prakash's appearance, as he hasn't aged in all these years.

episodesList.title: Trikon the Magician Part 2
episodesList.summary: Vibha gets murdered in a storeroom and Trikon, the magician gets arrested for it. Later, K.D Phatak talks to a man who calls himself V-20 but, K.D Phatak learns that Dr.Prakash is the same person as V-20. Varun and Dave get caught in a fire. Will they be able to escape? Stay tuned to find out.

episodesList.title: Yamraj Qatil
episodesList.summary: In Today’s episode, we present to you a murder case of a young man named Arun; who is allegedly killed by Yamraaj. The prime suspect, in this case, is a Pedestrian named Dev; who is a drug addict. And according to Dev,  he says that he has not killed Arun but rather Yamraaj appeared before him and has killed Arun mercilessly!

episodesList.title: KD in Trouble Part 1
episodesList.summary: In Today’s episode, we will get to about Lawyer KD Pathak receiving a phone call from a woman, who says that he has betrayed her. She alleges that KD Pathak has married her but now after becoming a successful lawyer, he has moved out of the relationship. However; in the middle of an important hearing of a case, Amisha stands up before honorable justice and hands over all the proofs of their marital status! Want to know more? Then stay tuned in and find out here!

episodesList.title: KD in Trouble Part 2
episodesList.summary: The savvy Lawyer KD Pathak has got himself in a very difficult situation. Lawyer Jaiswal is trying his best to prove KD Pathak guilty in a forgery case. However, at the very beginning of today’s court session Lawyer Pathak pleads before honorable Judge for a discussion in his chamber. He says that his childhood friend Amisha is patient of Philophobia and as consequence she is considering him as her husband! Want to know more? Then stay tuned in and find out here!

episodesList.title: KD in Trouble Part 3
episodesList.summary: In this episode of Bipade KD series of Adaalat, we present to you a shocking incident which has left the citizens traumatised. A breaking news comes in that the famous Lawyer KD Pathak has died in a police encounter. A team led by inspector Sawanth has fired bullets on KD Pathak, as he was trying to escape forcefully! Want to know more? Then stay tuned in and find out here!

episodesList.title: KD in Trouble Part 4
episodesList.summary: The goons have pointed a gun on KD Pathak and asks him to shoot his assistant. They are trying to confuse KD Pathak by saying that Gaurav has helped them in finding him. However, KD Pathak understands the game plan of the goons and somehow manages to escape from there. In the meantime, the news of KD Pathak being alive has spread like wildfire in a jungle! Want to know more about this case? Then stay tuned in and find out here!

episodesList.title: Karate
episodesList.summary: KD steps into a case when all is doomed for the accused. All the doors are shut. When the prosecution has prepared a water tight open and shut case where even a blind man can tell that the accused is guilty. But no one can see the case from the angle KD does.  He digs fervently for loopholes in the prosecution’s case much to their frustration and thinking on his feet, he manages to turn the entire case around.

episodesList.title: The Toon Killer
episodesList.summary: Professor Kamath is a historian who runs an academy; he teaches his students about ancient civilization. Apart from teaching history, he secretly offers courses on black magic to his students. However, later in the episode, we will come to know that an aspiring female actor Sana is attacked inside an ice factory.

episodesList.title: The Hanuman
episodesList.summary: In Today’s episode, we present to you a murder case of a wrestler and its proceedings inside the courtroom. Bhima and Jagga are two wrestlers who were competing against each other in a wrestling match organized in their village but accidentally Jagga died while fighting with Bhima.

episodesList.title: Manglik Part 1
episodesList.summary: In this episode of Adaalat, we will get to know about a woman named Uttara, who has come seeking help from Lawyer KD Pathak. Uttara is complaining about her husband Vivek and informs him that her husband wants to divorce her. She even narrates her ordeals to KD Pathak and says that her in-laws are putting a blame on her that she is the only reason behind her family's misfortunes and bad luck! Want to know more? Then stay tuned in and find out!

episodesList.title: Manglik Part 2
episodesList.summary: Today’s episode continues with Uttara recovering from her unconsciousness in the hospital. She questions KD Pathak about her baby which was growing inside her womb. However, on seeing her husband (Vivek) she starts alleging him that he has killed her immature baby by operating her in the hospital! Want to know more? Then stay tuned in and find out here!

episodesList.title: Zanolox Part 1

The fan continuously calls him and stalks him everywhere he goes. Trouble starts when she shows up in the same lift as him and on being stopped harshly by Hussain, she commits suicide in the lift itself and now Hussain approaches KD to prove his innocence in the case.

episodesList.summary: Neha showing her arrogant attitude towards her assistant, the episode takes a sudden turn as Neha disappears from the fashion show. Later, a mannequin that resembles Neha is seeing seated at Raghav Saini's jewellery showroom.

episodesList.title: Dead Again Part 1
episodesList.summary: A girl named Meera has a dream of her husband Manoj Shooting her in the head. When she wakes up the same thing happens as her dream but this time Manoj was holding a fake gun which is actually a lighter. Meera's psychiatrist tells her that this is a warning of a foreseen future. Meera approaches KD Pathak and asks him to save his husband as he will eventually kill her because she killed him in her last life. Watch KD Pathak handling this weird case in this episode.

episodesList.title: Dead Again Part 2
episodesList.summary: The plot thickens as one by one evidences come and they try to make the case more complex. While none of them are able to convince that Meera is not the killer, KD is convinced that Meera has been trapped. What will KD do next to solve this case? Watch to know more.

episodesList.title: Bagh Bahadur Part 1
episodesList.summary: Swara, a simple woman, who works for the protection of Royal Bengal Tigers through her NGO, comes to meet KD Pathak with a complain against Uttam Chawdhary. Uttam had initially given her a part of his land for the purpose of her NGO but, all of a sudden, Uttam had transferred the same land in the name of another person. KD Pathak reads the documents provided by Swara and he assures her that he will help her get back her land as the case is very simple. But things turn severely complicated when Swara goes missing, three days before KD Pathak reaches Kolkata. Upon his arival, KD Pathak is shocked when he learns of her death. Further, a 'bagh bahadur' named Subodh is accused of Swara's murder but KD refuses to accept the fact that an innocent person like Subhodh could have managed to kill Swara. How will KD Pathak provide justice for the innocent one?

episodesList.title: Bagh Bahadur Part 2
episodesList.summary: The case grows more and more confusing as the Man who believes he's a tiger escapes from the lockup and kills a small child named Nandu in the jungle. Manik Chowdhury who is the son of the owner of the land in the jungle also comes into the fold when he is proven to be involved in illegal dealing of animal skin and teeth out of the jungle.

episodesList.title: Bhay
episodesList.summary: The case grows more and more confusing as the Man who believes he's a tiger escapes from the lockup and kills a small child named Nandu in the jungle. Manik Chowdhury who is the son of the owner of the land in the jungle also comes into the fold when he is proven to be involved in illegal dealing of animal skin and teeth out of the jungle.

episodesList.title: Suicide Ya Murder?
episodesList.summary: Rinku a model by profession is in a relationship with Viren, a photographer. Rinku believes that Viren is cheating on her and so they end up having fights very often. Rinku commits suicide when Viren calls off their wedding. She leaves a suicide note blaming Viren for taking this drastic step.

episodesList.title: Supermodel or Killer
episodesList.summary: In Today’s episode, we present to you an investigation and legal proceedings of Jhanvi murder case inside the courtroom. The story begins with former Indian cricket team captain and match commentator Keshav getting missed calls from his wife Jhanvi. When he tries to call her back no one answers to his calls. However, on reaching home; he finds Jhanvi in a pool of blood. The officers while questioning Keshav arrives at a point that a super model and a failed actress Sonika Malhotra was present in his house. Interestingly Keshav discloses that the prime suspect of this case Sonika, is his girlfriend! It will be quiet interesting to know that is Sonika innocent? Or has she murdered Jhanvi?

episodesList.title: Tantric Trisunis Trap
episodesList.summary: In Today’s episode, we present to you the court proceedings and investigation of a murder case of a very young child named Abhi. And, shockingly the blame of Abhi’s murder is on his parents Gaurav and Renuka. However, the story begins with Abhi’s parents consulting a Tantric to improve their pathetic financial conditions. However, after getting frustrated with the Fake Tantric, Gaurav decides to go for a Darshan of Mata’s temple on the Hills of Yeoor Jungles. It’s Gaurav who realizes that his son Abhi has gone missing!

episodesList.title: Builder Murder Case
episodesList.summary: In Today’s episode we present to you the investigation and murder case of a heavy weight Builder, Subhash Divecha. The allegation of murder is on Manas, a Bartender of Dimple bar located in Chembur, Maharashtra. It is Manas father G Shinde, who approaches Lawyer KD Pathak and pleads to save his child from falling a prey of a trap laid by powerful people of the region!

episodesList.title: Hit and Run Case
episodesList.summary: Monty Khanna is a superstar, who do not share a harmonious relationship with his wife Archana. He meets his film producer B. Shetty in during a party. B. Shetty says that due to lack of finances he is unable to produce his upcoming film. In the same party, Monty meets a struggling actor Pawan and leaves the venue. On his way back, his speeding car mows down two innocent people on the street. However, now the blame of accident is on the superstar Monty but his driver Hussain comes forward and declares himself to be responsible for the crime!

episodesList.title: The Jockey
episodesList.summary: In Today’s episode, we are going to deal with the investigation and court proceedings of an industrialist, Mike Bhullar’s murder case. The allegation of murder is on his race jockey, Rumi Dastoor. Mike has a suspicion that Rumi is passing all his crucial information’s to his business rival Khanna. However, Mike has a burden of repaying a bank loan of 2000 crore. On the other hand, Rumi is repeatedly pleading before KD Pathak that he is innocent and has nothing to do with this brutal murder!

episodesList.title: God Man Satyanand Part 1
episodesList.summary: In Today’s episode, we present to you the investigation of spiritual leader Satyananda Murder Case. The story begins, with a young and a beautiful girl Pragya attending a spiritual session of Guru Satyanand.  It is the Guru himself, who insists Pragya to come in his farm house to cure her stammering problem. Pragya and her elder sister Richa went to meet Swami Satyanand but the very next moment we will get to know that the spiritual guru is killed by someone and the blame of murder is on Pragya!

episodesList.title: God Man Satyanand Part 2
episodesList.summary: In Today’s episode, we present to you the investigation and court proceedings of spiritual leader Satyananda Murder Case. Lawyer KD Pathak comes to meet his client Pragya in the lock-up. On seeing her changed behavior, KD Pathak gets a shock. The doctor clarifies that she is a psychitzophrenic patient and lead a dual life. At a given instance she lives the life of Richa and at another she returns to her own character!

episodesList.title: Kalpana's Ailment
episodesList.summary: Mr. Brij approaches Lawyer KD Pathak to prove his daughter-in-law’s innocence before honorable court. He knows very well that his daughter-in-law, Kalpana has murdered his wife Neelima but he still wants to prove Kalpana’s innocence!

episodesList.title: Sixth Marriage
episodesList.summary: Tonight, we present to you the investigation of a murder case of Maharaja Harshvardhan of Shimla. The Maharaja decides to marry for the sixth time, his son Yuvraj Gagandeep is completely against his father’s decision. But, both Meera (Maharaja’s to be sixth wife) and Maharaja Harshvardhan are happy and are planning for their wedding ceremony. Yuvraj reminds his father about the curse which they have on their Haveli but despite of that Maharaja still wants to marry Meera. However, later in the episode, we get to know that Maharaja Harshvardhan is brutally murdered and now the blame of his murder is on his son Yuvraj Gagandeep!

episodesList.title: Ashwatthama's Sword Part 1
episodesList.summary: In Today’s episode we present to you a murder mystery of a journalist based in Mumbai. TV journalist Rohan and his cameraman Sirish are present in an old fort, located some 40 kilometers away from Mumbai. While working on an special story, Rohan get brutally killed by an ancient sword of Ashwatthama. However the attempt to reveal the story behind the existence of a character of an Indian epic story becomes devastating for the security guard of the fort, Bhushan Singh. As, he is arrested on allegations of Rohan’s  murder!

episodesList.title: Ashwatthama's Sword Part 2
episodesList.summary: In Today’s episode, we present to you the investigation of a murder mystery of TV journalist Rohan. Lawyer Jaiswal presents such an evidence before the Honorable court which changes the whole line of investigation of the case. He brings Bhima to the court, whose footprint is found both, in the dark jungles of the old fort area and in the backyards of the police station. He even makes a shocking revelation that Bhima, is the son of Bhushan Singh, the prime suspect and the security guard of an old fort near Mumbai!

episodesList.title: Rahasyamayi Maut
episodesList.summary: In Today’s episode, we present to you the investigation and court proceedings of Jaya murder case. The story begins with a pedestrian spotting a dead body of a woman which is cut into pieces at a sea beach in Mumbai. He informs the police officials about the incident. However, the dead body is identified as of Jaya Awasthi and the prime suspect of the case is her husband Dinesh Awasthi. Meanwhile, Dinesh’s mother has come pleading before KD Pathak to save her son, as she thinks that Dinesh is innocent!

episodesList.title: Black Magic
episodesList.summary: In Today’s episode, we present to you the investigation of Shubham Mehra’s missing case. The story begins with Shubham’s parents appealing on a national television to help them in finding their 4 year old child. They have even announced a huge financial reward for the person informing them about Shubham. In the meantime, a psychic named Bindra comes forward and says that Shubham is dead and his dead body is lying behind the bushes of Virar!

episodesList.title: Operation Vijaypath Part 1
episodesList.summary: In Today’s episode, we present to you the investigation and court proceedings of Karan’s alleged murder case. Captain Datta sends his two brave pilots; Ajeet and Karan on a mission to destroy the intruding forces near Aksai Chin border. In an amazing turn of events, Karan’s fighter jet is hit by a missile and now the blame of his death is on his colleague Ajeet.

episodesList.title: Operation Vijaypath Part 2
episodesList.summary: Ajeet is blamed for the death of his colleague Karan. In a shocking twist, Ajeet’s defense lawyer K. D. Pathak manages to escape death after his plane crashes near the Aksai Chin border. Khurnaak detains K. D. Pathak and holds him as a hostage. On the other hand, Captain Datta pronounces K. D. Pathak dead and appoints a new lawyer for Ajeet. Will K. D. Pathak be able to free himself from the clutches of his kidnapper?

episodesList.title: Will K.D. Lose?
episodesList.summary: In Today’s episode, we present to you the investigation of Boxing champion Dilbar Rana’s Murder Case. While playing a national level boxing championship, Hariyana's boxer Shivpal Dhanda has surprisingly beaten Dilbar Rana. At the end of the boxing match, the referee finds Dilbar Rana dead. Dilbar’s trainer accuses Shivpal of killing Dilbar.

episodesList.title: Janga Devi
episodesList.summary: In Today’s episode we present to you a murder mystery of an Income Tax Officer called Sujoy. Sujoy is married to Akruti Shinde who is a devotee of a self-styled god-woman called Janga Devi. Will K. D. Pathak be able to find the murderer?

episodesList.title: Vikrant Is Dead
episodesList.summary: Vikrant Oberoi is a car racing enthusiast who has never lost any of his races. Once, Aarav Sharma, Raj Kohli and Vikrant Oberoi hit the road for a car race. At the end of the race, Vikrant is found dead in his car. While investigating the case, KD Pathak finds out that Vikrant was killed after inhaling a poisonous gas in his car.

episodesList.title: Pandit Is Dead
episodesList.summary: In Today’s episode, KD Pathak visits a small village in Gujrat and to solve a murder case of a priest called Ashok Mohan. When the priest is found dead in the temple of Udte Bagdev Baba, the villagers blame Dinesh Shah for the murder. While investigating the case, KD Pathak finds out that Dinesh had not killed the priest.

episodesList.title: Magical Parrot
episodesList.summary: In Today’s episode, we present to you an interesting case, where a parrot is suspected in the death of a businessman called Himmat Shah. Himmat dies when a chandelier falls on his body. The parrot Romeo often imitates Hetal’s voice who is Himmat’s wife. Who has murdered Himmat?

episodesList.title: The Parrot's Revenge
episodesList.summary: Saksham is a snake-lover whose goal is to build a snake sanctuary in his town. A local leader has promised him a land to build the sanctuary. However, a goon called Sona Singh Randhawa wants to purchase the same land to construct a housing society. Sona Singh is found dead after being swallowed by a python. The police arrests Saksham to find out the truth of Sona Singh’s death. Will KD Pathak be able to save Saksham?

episodesList.title: Rose Villa Part 1
episodesList.summary: In Today’s episode, we present to you the investigation and court proceedings of Malati’s murder case. Sanjay and Ramona Puri buy a bungalow at the outskirt of a town. Malati works as a maid in Sanjay’s house. Sanjay notices a few paranormal activities in his bungalow. When the police find Malati’s dead body in the house, they arrest Sanjay as the prime suspect.

episodesList.title: Rose Villa Part 2
episodesList.summary: Today’s episode continues with the investigation of Malati’s murder case. KD Pathak enters the basement of Sanjay Puri’s house. He finds a circuit-breaker and a bluetooth speaker in the dark corners of the room. He soon realizes that the alleged paranormal events were actually manmade. Sanjay’s neighbour admits in the court that she had experienced mysterious events in Sanjay’s house.

episodesList.title: Egyptian Mummy Part 1
episodesList.summary: In Today’s episode, we present to you the investigation and court proceedings of Dr. Sen’s murder case. Dr. Sen, who is a renowned scientist, discovers a well preserved mummy in his Egyptian expedition. Ajeet is Dr. Sen’s assistant who has accompanied Dr. Sen in his Egypt tour. Dr. Sen brings the mummy to his house despite Ajeet’s disapproval. When the police find Dr. Sen’s dead body, they accuses Ajeet of murder.

episodesList.title: Egyptian Mummy Part 2
episodesList.summary: Today's episode continues with the investigation of Dr. Sen’s murder case. Adhira finds Dr. Gupta’s dead body in his house. She assumes that the egyptian mummy has killed Dr. Gupta. Varun tells KD Pathak that he is Dr. Sen’s illegitimate son. In a shocking twist, Varun gets murdered by an anonymous person.

title: Gaaner Oparey
summary: Gaaner Oparey (transl. On the Other Side of Song) is an Indian Bengali television serial which aired on Star Jalsha from 28 June 2010 to 16 April 2011. This TV musical marked the beginning of a yearlong celebration of the 150th birth anniversary of the great Indian poet Rabindranath Tagore. The concept was a brainchild of the Indian director Rituparno Ghosh. The songs were all popular Rabindra sangeets. Prosenjit Chatterjee launched an audio CD of its tracks on Mahalaya on 12 October 2015. On account of Rabindranath Tagore's 157th birthday, Star Jalsha added Gaaner Oparey on Disney+ Hotstar on 9 May 2018. It was re-aired on Star Jalsha during the 2020 lockdown period, due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

title: Sasural Genda Phool
summary: Sasural Genda Phool is an Indian television drama series that aired on StarPlus starring Jay Soni and Ragini Khanna. It aired during weekday evenings from 1 March 2010 to 21 April 2012. It is based on the backdrop of Old Delhi.
plot:
Suhana Bajpai is a gorgeous, energetic young woman who lost her mother Vidisha when she was a child. Kamal Kishore Bajpai, Suhana's father, is unable to provide Suhana with sufficient time despite his best efforts. Suhana has a legendary temper and a materialistic mentality as a result of being deprived of his attention and Vidisha's love. In an act of spontaneous anger because of a bad break-up, she accepts to marry anyone Kamal chooses for her.
Ishaan Kashyap is an IT professional who grew up in a joint household and is polite, shy, and good-natured. However, he lacks a partner due to his introverted and awkward personality around women. He gives up and resolves to marry whomever his family determines to be a good match for him.
Kamal Kishore Bajpai and Ishaan coincidentally meet. After observing the Kashyap family's love and kindness, Kamal realises that this is the home that Suhana requires in her life. He requests Ishaan's hand for Suhana in marriage, which the Kashyaps accept. Suhana and Ishaan get married.
However, the marriage gets off to a bad start. Suhana makes it clear to Ishaan that she does not love him, as she is still suffering from the break-up. He decides to allow her time to heal her wounds. Suhana eventually begins to bond with the family, particularly with Shailaja, Ishaan's aunt (called Badi Ma by everyone), whom Suhana admires as the motherly figure she has been lacking in her life. Suhana gradually begins to care for Ishaan as a result of living together. She also learns more about the family with time.
The Kashyaps have several hidden pains and dark pasts. Ishwar Kashyap, Shailaja's ambitious husband and the eldest child of Dadaji and Dadiji, had deserted her and their children - Inder and Panna - for a supposedly bright future in the USA, whereby he remarried a woman named Meera, much to the whole family’s shock. Post this, Dadaji breaks connections with Ishwar and doesn’t consider him as a son of the family. And in order to make up for Ishwar’s absence, his younger brother Alok whole-heartedly sacrificed all his dreams and ambitions to look after his family and cater to their needs. Another dark secret is that Radha, the foster daughter of Dadaji and Dadiji, is still suffering from the pain of being raped by an unknown man on her wedding night. She is unable to heal from her pain as the child born out of that incident, Deepak, has an uncanny resemblance to the rapist. Ilesh (the son of Dadaji and Dadiji’s daughter), Ishaan and Inder's cousin , is perpetually unemployed due to his fun loving, mischievous and laidback attitude, and not interested in working, despite the family’s best efforts, but somehow, Ilesh gets a job with a construction company and earns a lot of money, which raises suspicion in the minds of Ishaan, Alok and Inder. His wife Disha is struggling to conceive. These are the sorrows that make Suhana realize that life is about accepting them and moving on with a smile, whereby she manages to bond well over time with her in-laws and Ishaan’s niece, Meethi.
Still, Suhana doesn't find herself consciously in love with Ishaan, She tries to leave the house but decides to stay and take care of Shailaja after she falls ill from the shock. Each time she mentions leaving the house, she doesn't realise that she is hurting Ishaan very terribly.
Ishaan's childhood friend, Sonali, is invited over to make Suhana jealous. Suhana realizes that she does love Ishaan and eventually confesses her love for Ishaan in front of everyone, and Sonali goes home. Ishaan and Suhana go to Goa for their honeymoon where they bare their souls to one another and come closer. Meanwhile, depressed after losing his job, and being unemployed for three months, Panna's husband Raunak leaves her and his family. He does this so that he can become stable and get a high-paying job again. At this time, Deepak also comes to stay with his family, having settled things with his mother. As time passes in Raunak's absence, the fractured relationship between Panna and her mother-in-law is repaired, leading to the repair in the relationship between the Kashyaps and the Sharmas.
Suhana unexpectedly faints at Holi, leading to the family think that she is pregnant. But they later find out that she is not pregnant but is shockingly suffering from a brain tumor. However, they are overjoyed to later learn that the tumor is completely benign. Suhana undergoes her surgery and is completely healed.
Ishaan meets with an accident. He loses the memory of the past two years of his life, thus forgetting Suhana and his marriage to her. Suhana stays in the Kashyap house as Shashikala, Disha's friend. After being around "Shashikala", Ishaan feels connected to her but cannot pursue her because she is married. During this time, Ishwar returns to India, after failed attempts to contact his family, and one fine day, he bumps into his father and Shailaja, where Dadaji refuses to acknowledge him, and threatens to take action on him, as he tries apologizing to Shailaja.
While the elders of the family get the news of Ishwar's return, Dadiji begs Dadaji to forgive Ishwar, much to the family's shock, thereby compelling Dadaji to take stern action on anyone who tries contacting Ishwar.
After a few hilarious turns, Ishaan decides to marry Shashikala, come what may. At the wedding altar, he reveals that he has regained his memory, thanks to tripping over a bench that Suhana had overturned in a fit of anger. Not much after this incident, a fateful meeting at the temple between Dadiji and Ishwar takes place, where Ishwar begs his mother’s forgiveness but to no avail, where she reminds him that he’s more accountable to Shailaja.
Disha is depressed as she learns of her inability to conceive a child, which comes as a shocker for the family wondering why the matter was hidden from them. Suhana finds a baby girl in the park and brings her home, suggesting that Disha adopt her. Everyone is surprised and touched by this gesture. As the baby named Khushi by the family makes an impact on them, it starts affecting Suhana and Ishaan's married life as Suhana ignores Ishaan to take care of Khushi. But troubles attack the Kashyap family threefold - Ilesh is found guilty of bribery and money laundering. His company refuses to recognize him as an employee. Also, Khushi's birth parents turn up and the family tearfully hands over the baby to her parents. What makes it worse is that the family gets a shocker to know that Ishwar is back in Delhi, from Inder and Panna, after paying him a visit, and Shailaja meeting Ishwar secretly, on Dadiji's insistence, much to Dadaji and Alok's displeasure.
Ishaan expresses his happiness over his promotion and his transfer to Mumbai, and is happy because this is his chance for him to prove himself, as he has been battling for his identity within the family. He is fed up of being treated as a child and kept away from the serious decisions of the family. Ishaan and Suhana move to Mumbai and get to know the Mumbai life. Meanwhile, Ilesh is acquitted and found innocent , with the help of a diary.
In Mumbai, Ishaan meets up with Sonali. Ishaan and Suhana find out that Sonali has married Abhishek, who is obsessive about her. Ishaan finds out that Sonali is suffering abuse because of this. Meanwhile, Ishwar has returned to the Kashyaps. Although no one wants to accept him, he is trying to be forceful with them to accept and forgive him. Panna is pregnant, but Ishwar ruins the joy. Suhana accidentally finds out about Ishwar's return and feels the desperate need to connect to Shailaja. She rushes to Delhi and finds out that Ishwar has conspired against the family to gain ownership of the house, because he wants to sell it, under the pretext of selling Panna’s jewellery. She exposes this to the entire family, leaving them shocked to the core.
Finally, as the family gets closure about this, Dadaji throws Ishwar out of the house and severes ties with him. While Ishaan is furious that everyone knew about Ishwar's return and his conspiracy, but did not let him in on the matter, Dadiji blames herself for Ishwar's deception, and pleading Shailaja to meet him.
Suhana sees Sonali with Ishaan and suspects him of having an affair with her. She leaves him and returns to Delhi. She then brings Shailaja and Alok to Mumbai and they help her find out the truth; that Abhishek was hitting Sonali. Suhana apologises to her and gets back with Ishaan. Upon returning to Delhi, Suhana declares to the family that she wishes to start working. She receives an offer to star in a television show as the lead. Rano, her mother-in-law, is against it, but everyone else supports her. Ilesh accompanies Suhana to the shoot and later enjoys handling and managing her career as her agent. This leads to a disturbance in the family as Rano feels that Suhana is ignoring her wifely duties towards Ishaan, and Disha feels that Ilesh is not getting his due respect from Suhana as her older brother-in-law because of being employed by her. Ishaan also gets egoistic over the fact that Suhana earns more than him and is a star. However, Alok shatters those illusions for him and he realizes his mistake.
In the midst of all this, Sanjana, Suhana's sister, and Deepak fall in love with each other. Deepak tells the truth to Sanjana that he is an illegitimate child and Sanjana accepts it. But she is reluctant to tell the truth to her father. Radha's husband, who sold her to the man who raped her, mocks the engagement ceremony by revealing the truth to everyone, and Kamal Kishore rejects the alliance between Deepak and Sanjana. The young generation of the Kashyaps decides to help Deepak and Sanjana elope, but Radha stops it. Eventually, everyone convinces Kamal and he agrees; Deepak and Sanjana get married. Everyone lives happily ever after.

title: Rishta.com
summary: Rishta.com (transl. Relation.com) is an Indian television series which broadcast on Sony TV on 3 January 2010. The show is produced by  Aditya Chopra under YRF Television. The show was conceived, written and directed by Rishab Seth.
plot: Rishta.com follows business partners, Isha Mirchandani and Rohan Mehra who run a matrimonial agency together. The two are polar opposites and have been frenemies since college. While Rohan is the typical Casanova, aloof, detached and sarcastic, Isha leans towards the more emotional, dedicated and systematic end of the spectrum. Huzaifa Ali, is the CEO of Rishta.com and is perpetually emerging with schemes to cut down costs, much to the chagrin of other employees. The second supporting character, Ruchika is the flamboyant, flirty and fashionable marketing and PR head. Other recurring characters include Isha's laid-back father who shares a close relationship with her. His girlfriend, Naina is 20 years his junior and is also a recurring character.

episodesList.title: Rohit Gupta and Mr. Haldiram's Strange Requests For Marriage
episodesList.summary: Rohan and Isha are polar opposites running a matrimonial agency together, and deal with illogical requests from their clients in very different ways. Rohit Gupta and Mr Haldiram come to the agency.

episodesList.title: Rohan and Isha Encounter a Very Difficult Client
episodesList.summary: Rohan and Isha meet a very difficult client who wants a husband who is richer, more handsome, and generally better than her best friend's groom-to-be.

episodesList.title: Rohan and Isha's Old Friend Searches For a Perfect Match
episodesList.summary: Rohan and Isha's old friend from university, Gaurav, becomes a client of Rishta.com as he is in search of a bride. Rohan and Isha work hard to find the best match for him.

episodesList.title: Isha and Rohan are Dealing With a Very Peculiar Case
episodesList.summary: Rishta.com's new client is a successful, good-natured man, but at 150 centimetres tall he faces a lot of rejection.

episodesList.title: Isha and Rohan's New Client is a Very Demanding and a Orthodox Father
episodesList.summary: Isha and Rohan's new client is an orthodox father who wants the family tradition of choosing a groom for the girl to continue, so he does not bring his daughter along to the Rishta.com office.

episodesList.title: Double Trouble For Rohan and Isha
episodesList.summary: Rohan's childhood best friend Akshat is being forced by his family to get married, so he comes to Rishta.com and Isha finds out that he is gay. Stuntman Niel is looking for a wife who will take care of the household.

episodesList.title: Sameer Malik Shares His Unique Problem With Rohan and Isha
episodesList.summary: Sameer Malik, a former client of Rishta.com, left the girls that Isha and Rohan matched him with for petty reasons. He returns with a request to meet Sunaina Lal again, as he realises his mistake and wants to marry her.

episodesList.title: Rohan and Isha have Got a New Client Who is a Old Widow
episodesList.summary: Mr Halidaram, an old widower, gets potential matches who are younger than him, but things do not seem to work out until Avinash Bansall, the CEO of Shaadi Plus, comes to the rescue.

episodesList.title: New Client At Rishta.com is Misha Who is a Divorcee and Also a Single Mother
episodesList.summary: Misha, a divorcee and single mother, finds it hard to face life all by herself and comes to the Rishta.com office to find a life partner who will love and support her.

episodesList.title: The New Client At Rishta.com is Bar Dancer
episodesList.summary: Isha and Rohan's latest client is a bar dancer, and it is very difficult to find a suitable match for her.

episodesList.title: Rohan and Isha's Fourth Couple That They Helped to Get Married are Having a Divorce
episodesList.summary: Rohan and Isha attempt to save a marriage. Maitri worries that Uday may reject her after their third meeting.

episodesList.title: Kargil War Army Personnel is Afraid Of Getting a Perfect Match
episodesList.summary: An army officer who fought in the Kargil War is afraid that he will not be able to get married because he lost a leg in combat. Isha and Rohan work to help him get over his fear.

episodesList.title: Rohan and Isha Encounter a New Client Who is a Lawyer
episodesList.summary: Rohan and Isha's new client is a lawyer who is very intelligent, but is very shy around women and has trouble approaching them.

episodesList.title: Rohan Forgets a Frustrated Business Man Niel's Case
episodesList.summary: Rishta.com does not find a single match for a businessman when Rohan forgets about his case for six months. A couple in love seek Isha and Rohan's help with their conservative families.

episodesList.title: An Astrologer In Rishta.com
episodesList.summary: Kiran and Gaurav met through Rishta.com, but Kiran suddenly calls off their engagement. Isha and Rohan get a new client who can predict the future, and says she was called to their office.

episodesList.title: Rohan and Isha Get Another Interesting Case
episodesList.summary: A divorced couple registers at Rishta.com to find matches for themselves, but both turn out to be very difficult, with impossibly specific criteria that they look for in their partners.

episodesList.title: Rohan and Isha's New Clients are One Divorced Couple
episodesList.summary: The search for Jui Anand and Akshay Dwivedi's partners still continues, as they never want to take things further with their matches even when the dates go well.

episodesList.title: Wife Wants a Husband to Get Married Again
episodesList.summary: Isha and Rohan meet a Muslim couple who are searching for a second wife, as the first wife has been unable to conceive a baby.

episodesList.title: Husna Gets Confused Between The 2 Prospective Men
episodesList.summary: Rishta.com's new client, Husna, is confused and fickle-minded, and finds she is unable to decide between two prospective men.

episodesList.title: Isha and Rohan are Trying to Find a Suitable Partner For Gunja
episodesList.summary: Isha and Rohan try to find a suitable date for Gunjan's prom night. Both Rohan and Gaurav try to impress an attractive girl in college.

episodesList.title: 41 Year Old Rich Businessman is Searching For a Pefect Match
episodesList.summary: Isha and Rohan have to find a compatible partner for a 41-year-old businessman who is not too keen to get married, but agrees to do so at his mother's insistence.

episodesList.title: Rohan and Isha are Gearing Up to Find a Match For Mona Wazir
episodesList.summary: India Marriages approach Rishta.com with an interesting offer, as the team gear up to find a match for renowned actress Mona Wazir.

episodesList.title: Are Roshan and Sharaddha Perfect Match For Each Other
episodesList.summary: Roshan and Sharaddha, who met through Rishta.com, are having a great time and seem like a perfect match for each other. Sunil, another client, is looking for a match for himself.

episodesList.title: Rishta.com is Offered a Very Nice Business Proposal From Indian Marriages
episodesList.summary: Rohan and Isha consider whether they should accept the business proposal from India Marriages. Things are not going well between Vaibhav and Sapna.

episodesList.title: Heating Argument Between Rohan and Isha
episodesList.summary: Rohan and Isha have a very bad argument that leads to stress and tension between them, and affects their relationship.

episodesList.title: Rohan has Left Rishta.com For India Marriages
episodesList.summary: When Rohan leaves Rishta.com for India Marriages, Isha is very upset and very lonely. Rohan finds it difficult to fit in at his new job.

tagline: Rishta.com follows business partners, Isha Mirchandani and Rohan Mehra who run a matrimonial agency together.

title: Didi No. 1
summary:
Didi No. 1 (transl. Sister No. 1) is a Bengali television game show for women launched in 2010. The show airs on Zee Bangla and airs a special dhamaka episode on every sundays.
It is the second longest-running Bengali television series by episode count. On 3 March 2024, chief minister Mamata Banerjee was invited in the program which eventually made it more popular.

title: Yeh Pyar Na Hoga Kam
summary:
Yeh Pyar Na Hoga Kam (transl. This Love Won't Diminish) is an Indian television drama series starring Yami Gautam and Gaurav Khanna. It aired on Colors TV, and premiered on 28 December 2009. The story is inspired from 2009 Bollywood flick Delhi-6.
The show is based on the love story between Abeer (Khanna) and Leher (Gautam). It was one of the shows that replaced Bigg Boss 3 after its grand finale, the other being Laagi Tujhse Lagan. Its original run ended on 2 September 2010 due to poor ratings.

title: Lapataganj
summary:
Lapataganj – Sharad Joshi Ki Kahaniyon Ka Pata is an Indian television sitcom, aired on Sony SAB from October 2009 to 15 August 2014. The series is based on Sharad Joshi’s novel of the same name.
The show was produced by Ashwini Dheer and directed by Dharam Verma. Joshi's daughter Neha Sharad was the creative head of the show for the first six months.
Lapatagnj starred Rohitash Gaud, Vineet Kumar, Preeti Amin, Sucheta, Shubhangi Gokhale, and the first episode aired on  26 October 2009.
plot:
Based in an imaginary small town called Lapataganj (meaning a lost place), the story is inspired by the writings of Sharad Joshi, who was a Hindi satirist. His wide range of works has highlighted the bitter truth of Indian society with a satirical punch. These stories, while making viewers laugh, also make them empathise with the situations people face in their daily lives.
Lapataganj is a town in some part of India which has been long forgotten by the system. The town struggles daily for basic facilities, yet the people residing there are the happiest of the lot. The show captures the spirit of the common man to lead a happy life against all odds.

episodesList.title: Water Crisis
episodesList.summary: Mukundi and other villagers are tensed as there is again no water supply. The man who has come to see Sureeli for marriage, rejects her because she is dumb.

episodesList.title: Pappu Sneaks Into Sureeli's Room
episodesList.summary: Mukundi starts his day with a fight with Indumati which spoils his mood. Pappu sneaks into Sureeli's room and starts flirting with her.

episodesList.title: The Election Day
episodesList.summary: Everyone in Lapataganj is busy discussing the upcoming elections in the village. There arises a debate over whether or not the women in the village should cast a vote or not.

episodesList.title: Guddu to Write a Love Letter
episodesList.summary: Pappu tells Guddu that he is scared of expressing his love for Sureeli. He decides to pen down his feelings in a letter. He goes around the village asking for a pen and paper.

episodesList.title: Movie Buffs
episodesList.summary: People in Lapataganj are extremely happy to see that there is a new movie to watch. Indu insists Mukundi takes her to watch the movie whereas Pappu tries his best to take Sureeli for the movie.

episodesList.title: The Theatre Shuts Down
episodesList.summary: The local theatre is overcrowded as everyone is too excited to watch the movie which is currently being shown. The theatre manager is devastated after the district collector gives an order to shut down the theatre permanently.

episodesList.title: Malan Devi's Surrender
episodesList.summary: There are announcements made in the village about Malan Devi surrendering herself near the lake. Indu shows a lot of interest in this and asks Mukundi hundreds of questions regarding the same.

episodesList.title: Indu's Wish to See a Dacoit
episodesList.summary: Most of the people in the village travel to watch Malan Devi's surrender. Indu wakes Mukundi up from his sleep, asking him to take her to watch the surrender. Mukundi ends up giving in when he learns that the entire village is going.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Becomes a Scape Goat
episodesList.summary: Seeing Indu trade chocolate to get her work done from their son, Mukundi opposes her act. Mukundi gets stuck between his two bosses as they mistreat him for disrespecting them.

episodesList.title: Neta Pandey's Dilemma
episodesList.summary: Neta Pandey is disturbed after seeing a letter missing from his name outside his house. He begins to look for the person who is responsible for meddling with his name.

episodesList.title: Santosh is In Town
episodesList.summary: Mishri and Kachua are excited to meet Mukundi's brother, Santosh. Mishri makes Sureeli get ready and takes her to meet Santosh with an objective to get them hitched.

episodesList.title: Santosh Flirts With Laali
episodesList.summary: Santosh tries to woo Laali but Mishri takes her to her house just in time. Indu is surprised to see Santosh suddenly showing interest in marriage. He tries impressing Laali all day.

episodesList.title: Finding a Colossus
episodesList.summary: Seeing problems increase at a high rate in Lapataganj, Baba says that only a colossus can save the village. All the villagers start looking for one for the upliftment of Lapataganj.

episodesList.title: Growing Adulteration
episodesList.summary: Indu yells at the milkman for giving her diluted milk and warns him one last time. Other people in the village notice adulteration in certain food items being sold in Lapataganj.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Protests Against Adulteration
episodesList.summary: Mukundi is forced to observe a fast to protest against growing adulteration in the village. The people in Lapataganj aim towards making the local minister take an action against the same.

episodesList.title: Mukundi to Take a Casual Leave
episodesList.summary: As Mukundi is lost in deep thoughts, people around him mistake him for having a toothache. Mukundi is in reality thinking whether he should take a casual leave from work or not.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Gets Threatened
episodesList.summary: Mukundi is kicked out of the ration shop when he asks for sugar. He is also threatened to not open his mouth, otherwise he will be beaten up.

episodesList.title: The Ashamed Minister
episodesList.summary: Everyone in Lapataganj wonders why the minister is ashamed. Indu insists Mukundi takes her to see the ashamed minister. Many people go to visit the minister to find out why he is ashamed.

episodesList.title: Destruction Due to Worms
episodesList.summary: Indu gives Mukundi a task to keep the wheat out for drying as it is attacked by worms. Mishri assigns Kachua a similar task as a few of their food items have caught fungus.

episodesList.title: Struggle to Pass Higher Secondary
episodesList.summary: Indu's uncle is in power and offers to help Chukundi. Pappu tries to impress Indu in order to get his passing certificate through her uncle's source.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Gets an Award
episodesList.summary: Mukundi's honesty gets the rightful reward and is interviewed by the media. Lapataganj is in a mood to celebrate when this news spreads like haywire.

episodesList.title: Miseries Of Marriage
episodesList.summary: Indu and Mukundi are on different note about wedding expenses. Everyone is set for Poonam's marriage when the groom's family starts demanding more dowry.

episodesList.title: Intellectuals Come to Rescue
episodesList.summary: Kachua takes the Politician's speech too seriously. By calling himself an intellectual, he sets out to solve various problems of the residents.

episodesList.title: Mystery Of The Neem Tree
episodesList.summary: A film crew comes across Lapataganj for shooting and finds it ideal. The residents get busy to fill up the dried up lake but the heroine's whims and fancies are elsewhere.

episodesList.title: The Heroine's Demand
episodesList.summary: A film crew comes across Lapataganj for shooting and finds it ideal. The residents get busy to fill up the dried up lake but the heroine's whims and fancies are elsewhere.

episodesList.title: Chaubey From Lena Bank
episodesList.summary: A loan agent arrives at Lapataganj and targets Pappu. Pappu feels Mukundi is the perfect person for Chaubey to pursue and explains about the loan to the residents.

episodesList.title: Every Husband's Problem
episodesList.summary: Mukundi is irritated with Indu's questioning and decides to go to Asansol. The disagreement accelerates when the different residents give their opinions in this regard.

episodesList.title: Hanumanji's Arrival
episodesList.summary: The villagers have their own unique way of worshipping. Pappu and Indu fight over a newspaper that encloses a vacancy for the priest.

episodesList.title: Interview For Priest's Role
episodesList.summary: Pappu is depressed about his voice but with Hanuman's blessing, he recovers. Mukundi suggests to him how to apply for the role of the priest.

episodesList.title: Pappu's Transformation
episodesList.summary: The villagers are shocked to see Pappu's change and dedication towards his profession. Sureeli is heartbroken to know Pappu's decision but still pursues him.

episodesList.title: Vasanti Visits
episodesList.summary: Indu's sister, Vasanti, comes to Lapataganj to visit her. Mishri has lost her goat and files a report. Vasanti and Mukundi team up to preach the villagers about poetry.

episodesList.title: Kachua's Laziness
episodesList.summary: Kachua oversleeps amidst the rush in the morning, so Pappu pulls a prank on him. Mukundi reminds Kachua of all the things he has lost due to his laziness.

episodesList.title: Playboy Pappu
episodesList.summary: Mishri and Kachua go to the river to get water and Pappu uses this opportunity to spend time with Sureeli. Later on, Pappu gets lost in his thoughts of his previous lover.

episodesList.title: Sukumari is In Crisis
episodesList.summary: Pappu is collecting the donation from the villagers when he catches a glimpse of Sukumari. Sureeli starts doubting Pappu but he still sorts out Sukumari's problem.

episodesList.title: Combating Robbery
episodesList.summary: Kachua, Pappu, and Guddu stay at Mishri's place to catch the thieves. Once they catch the thieves, a much bigger problem arises at the police station.

episodesList.title: Mango Desire
episodesList.summary: At times, even the common man wishes to feel special. With a lot of hardship, Lapataganj indulges in cherishing the off-seasonal mango.

episodesList.title: The All Knowing Stranger
episodesList.summary: A stranger arrives at Lapataganj who recognises each and every member of the village. Was he previously a resident too?

episodesList.title: New Age Teacher
episodesList.summary: The old-school preaching needs dusting now, so Mukundi puts his effort to impart his son with few ethics. Mukundi stands against the wrong procedure used by the teachers of today and tries to bridge the gap.

episodesList.title: The Lost Party
episodesList.summary: Pappu is upset as his party has lost the elections. The villagers start debating over the pros and cons of the parties have and how could one win over another.

episodesList.title: New Year
episodesList.summary: In Lapataganj, the new year brings new hopes with water. Mishri's husband decides to return on this occasion and the villagers celebrate their new emerging sun.

episodesList.title: Lapataganj In Competition
episodesList.summary: Mukundi's poetic uncle arrives at Lapataganj and Chukundi is excited to receive gifts. Pappu along with the villagers bet over a kite flying competition.

episodesList.title: Advent Of Mama Ji
episodesList.summary: Ghasita Mamaji's mannerisms are quite unique. The villagers mistakenly perceive him as a stranger trying to steal or spoil their village culture which leads to an attack on him.

episodesList.title: American Guest
episodesList.summary: Indian culture works as an attraction for many tourists from across the world. A tourist from New York, Anuradha visits Lapataganj and the villagers are insane to meet her and know about America.

episodesList.title: Seeing Off The Guest
episodesList.summary: The villagers perform for Anuradha and Indu dresses her up as an Indian woman. Anuradha falls in love with the unity and close bond of Lapataganj. Anuradha and the villagers get upset on parting.

episodesList.title: Gandhijis Glasses
episodesList.summary: A controversy on Gandhiji's glasses getting stolen from the museum. Kachua gets suspected as his glasses have a similar circular frame.

episodesList.title: Coincidence or Politics
episodesList.summary: The residents of Lapataganj are infuriated about an outsider being their leader which leads to a fight. The villagers stand together against the false-telling politicians trying to influence them for mere votes.

episodesList.title: Sugandhilals Umbrella
episodesList.summary: Mukundi's father keeps his umbrella close to his heart. Suddenly, his umbrella gets misplaced. How will Sugandhi find his special umbrella?

episodesList.title: Victims Of Corruption
episodesList.summary: Sugandhi wants to build a school in his village premise and has to visit the government office for permission. Each time Mukundi visits, he has to suffer. Finally, the father-son realise that nothing runs without corruption.

episodesList.title: Shakkarkandi Against Corruption
episodesList.summary: Sugandhi shuts himself till his father is brought to Lapataganj. Pappu and Guddu bring Shakkarkandilal, Mukundi's grandfather. Mukundi with the help of the villagers takes revenge from Dubey.

episodesList.title: How to Pass The Time?
episodesList.summary: Kachua spends his time by small talking to different residents of Lapataganj. Pappu spends time by flirting with Sureeli and pulling pranks. A stranger fools the villagers to start digging their ground to find his ancestral treasure.

episodesList.title: Sugandhi Befriends a Crow
episodesList.summary: Sugandhi sings, feeds and talks to a crow in order to spend his free time. Kachua and Pappu pranks on him to have some fun. Sugandhi feels that his old acquaintance is now a crow.

episodesList.title: Sureeli's Seeker
episodesList.summary: Pappu's nightmare comes true as he sees an intruder, Chimpu with Sureeli. Chimpu organises a dance competition and asks Sureeli to participate, but the whole Lapataganj performs in the competition.

episodesList.title: Pappu Feels Repulsed
episodesList.summary: The competition gets even better when the villagers are engaged in street practice. Pappu removes the tyres of Chimpu's bike due to his insecurity. Sambha tries to hit on Pappu but he refrains.

episodesList.title: Dance Competition At Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Chimpu attempts to impress Mishri and Sureeli which Pappu revolts against. The villagers compete with one another to come to a conclusion.

episodesList.title: Lapataganj On Republic Day
episodesList.summary: Mukundi explains the meaning of constitution to Indu. The villagers perform on the theme of Republic Day and Sureeli emerges as the winner.

episodesList.title: The Smile Week
episodesList.summary: Mukundi's boss announces that they will be celebrating smile day in the upcoming week, where they have to talk to every client with a smile. Mukundi starts practicing for this right away.

episodesList.title: The Wishlist
episodesList.summary: Indu hands over Mukundi a long list of items she needs. When he tries to turn her wish down, she tells him that he never fulfills any of her wishes.

episodesList.title: The Crisis
episodesList.summary: Mishri chucks Pappu out of her house seeing him brush his teeth with Sureeli. Mishri and Indu discuss how there are various things in the village but are actually of no use.

episodesList.title: Winter Takes a Toll On Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: It is a relatively colder day in Lapataganj and everyone is shivering even after covered in layers. Chotu mama freezes after taking a shower from ice cold water.

episodesList.title: Pappu Hates Seeing Sureeli Work
episodesList.summary: Pappu feels bad for Sureeli seeing her sweep the floor and asks her to stop. Mishri assigns him the task of sweeping when she sees this. Pappu passes over the task to Guddu to avoid working.

episodesList.title: A Match Of Kabaddi
episodesList.summary: The men in Lapataganj play a match of Kabaddi against the men of Gumshudaganj, a neighbouring village. After a lot of running and injuries, watch which team wins the match.

episodesList.title: Pappu Gets Injured
episodesList.summary: The game of Kabaddi leaves Pappu seriously injured, leaving Sureeli extremely worried. Right when Sureeli is about to give Pappu a massage, Chotu mama stops her and starts massaging Pappu himself.

episodesList.title: Kabaddi Training
episodesList.summary: Pappu starts selecting eligible people to raise a Kabaddi team in Lapataganj which can compete against other strong teams. All the team members start training for Kabaddi.

episodesList.title: A Tough Game
episodesList.summary: As the Lapataganj team begins to play with their opposition which is the national team, their supporters begin to lose hope seeing them play. They try making a comeback but Guddu gets seriously injured.

episodesList.title: Being a Greater Person
episodesList.summary: The Lapataganj team loses the game on purpose as they did not want to defeat the national team as that would be a loss for them. The national kabaddi team asks people to support all sports along with cricket.

episodesList.title: Indu has a Crush
episodesList.summary: Indu cannot keep calm as her favorite actor, Ramesh Kumar's movie is being shown at the theatre. Mukundi is surprised seeing Indu go gaga over Ramesh Kumar as she sticks his posters in the house.

episodesList.title: Tips For Begging
episodesList.summary: A man asks people in Lapataganj to help him with some money as his wallet has been robbed. They give him tips to beg for money so that he can buy a ticket to his destination.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Sacred Of Going Bald
episodesList.summary: Mukundi gets worried when a few bald men from the village tell him that even he is getting bald. Mukundi sees a dream where he has lost all his hair and Indu is leaving him forever.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Gets a Golden Opportunity
episodesList.summary: Mukundi tells his friends that he has been chosen to deliver a speech on Gandhiji in Gujarat by the postal department. Even though Indu does not insist on taking her along, he wishes to take his family along with him.

episodesList.title: Growing Obsession For Movie
episodesList.summary: Pappu imagines himself nothing less than a hero. Mishri tells Indu that she is going for an English movie so Indu starts demanding Mukundi. Later on, the whole Lapataganj gets inside the movie hall.

episodesList.title: Lapataganj Day
episodesList.summary: On the occasion of Lapataganj Day, the residents perform to celebrate. The politicians argue on land reform policy and plan to extort the residents of Lapataganj.

episodesList.title: Silence is a Virtue
episodesList.summary: Pappu tries to influence Mukundi and Kachua but they, in turn, preach him about silence. Mishri fixed Sureeli's marriage to an influential person from a different village and Pappu goes silent.

episodesList.title: Holika At Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Chotu is against the kids playing with colours and Mukundi argues with Indu on the expenditure of Holi. The women prepare sweets and the village unites to burn the Holika.

episodesList.title: Celebrating Holi
episodesList.summary: Mukundi is fooled by Indu into playing Holi and Chotu still complains about Chukundi hitting him with balloons. Pappu rushes to put colour on Sureeli when everyone else is inclined to celebrating.

episodesList.title: Controversary On Strike
episodesList.summary: Mukundi influences everyone to work more on the strike day. Everyone doubles up their prices for the sake of loss. Chukundi meets with an accident but there is no doctor to be found.

episodesList.title: The Quest For Well
episodesList.summary: The residents wait eternally in front of their village tap. The collector asks them to search for the well in their village. Police start investigating about the lost well.

episodesList.title: Budget Of The Year
episodesList.summary: The villagers worship the Finance Minister for a good budget outcome. Mukundi does a lot of shopping before the budget is released. When the politicians are plotting to increase the budget, the villagers try to keep their savings up.

episodesList.title: Buntys Friendship
episodesList.summary: Pappu's birthday is in a week and his friend from Delhi arrives at Lapataganj. Bunty tries to distance Pappu from his neighbours and also attempts to change his birthday plan. Will Pappu withstand this?

episodesList.title: Lapataganj Under Trial
episodesList.summary: Mukundi and Kachua discuss India's pending development. Pappu catches a man stalking Sureeli and gives it right to him. The politician's maid revolts as she wants to join the party.

episodesList.title: Consistency Of Drought
episodesList.summary: Lapataganj is a drought prone area and the villagers want Mukundi to make the government aware of it. Indu and Mukundi have visitors from a flood prone area. Together, the villagers plot a drama to bring awareness.

episodesList.title: Politicians Amusement
episodesList.summary: Mukundi's letter was rejected so the politician is invited to Lapataganj. The villagers put across their issues to him but still, nothing is resolved.

episodesList.title: Dignified Chotu
episodesList.summary: Chotu finds a bag full of money but has to give it back to Police. Chotu is dignified by the politician for his deed. Pappu decides he also wants to feel respected and takes help from Bajrangbali.

episodesList.title: Media In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: The journalist enquires about the lost idol case. Police refuse to search the idol anymore. The villagers get busy to find the idol all over the area but Chotu takes away the credit.

episodesList.title: Counting The Stars
episodesList.summary: Pappu makes notes for Sureeli to help her pass the exam. Mukundi borrows a phone to have a word with Indu. Pappu imagines him and Sureeli as Mukundi and Indu.

episodesList.title: A Dog's Day
episodesList.summary: Chotu strikes at a dog mistakenly and injures it. Police arrest him for committing the crime and the Dog Minister takes over the case.

episodesList.title: The Suspicious Sneeze
episodesList.summary: The villagers misjudge Chotu's sneeze as something dangerous to their health. What is the reason behind Chotu's sneeze? Is it a box full of spices or a life-threatening disease?

episodesList.title: The Art Of Bribery
episodesList.summary: Mukundi complaints about a politician trying to bribe him. Once the media covers the incident, the party members decide to take a firm step ahead.

episodesList.title: Elizabeth's New Avatar
episodesList.summary: Lapataganj's residents complain about their still old fashioned ways. Elizabeth's evolution makes them amazingly shocked right at his entry.

episodesList.title: Friends Turned Into Enemies
episodesList.summary: Pappu and Guddu are in bad terms and fight it out. Lapataganj gets divided into two due to their differences. Mukundi is stuck in between them.

episodesList.title: Memories Of Indu
episodesList.summary: The villagers are ecstatic to see Indu back in Lapataganj. Mukundi is lost in Indu's thoughts, so the villagers plan to dress up Guddu like her.

episodesList.title: Moneyplant and Cactus
episodesList.summary: The village kids are playing in the ground and Mamaji gets hit on his head. Pappu and his friends start making fun of him. He also tells that he would have been very happy if Mamaji got injured badly and would celebrate by distributing sweets all over Lapataganj.

episodesList.title: Gods Miracle
episodesList.summary: Chotu makes his bed and is ready to sleep. Mishri gets him milk, but then two orphaned kids come and ask for food. When Chotu does not give them his milk, they curse him. Later in the night, someone calls Mishri and she is shocked to witness it.

episodesList.title: Reporters In Hanumanganj
episodesList.summary: People go crazy as they witness Hanuman Ji drinking milk. Everybody comes in Hanumanganj and start worshipping him. Reporters come as they want to cover this astonishing story.

episodesList.title: Amitabh In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Amitabh enters Lapatanganj and all the villagers go crazy. Everyone gathers around him and holds him tightly so that he is unable to leave. Sureeli is a big fan and tries to shower her love for him.

episodesList.title: Mastaana Band In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Mastana Band artists are in Lapataganj in hope that they will get some customers. They play and entertain Pappu who keeps on telling them how bad they are as musicians. Later, they go on a hunt to find customers who want to get married.

episodesList.title: Pappu's Dream
episodesList.summary: Pappu and Gattu are coming back riding on the bicycle. But Pappu has a dream of owning a motorcycle and how he would impress everyone in Lapataganj. He starts dreaming of how famous he will be if he gets a motorcycle.

episodesList.title: Trouble On Everyone
episodesList.summary: Pappu and Gattu find a visitor who falls on the ground suddenly. They tell everyone about this and everyone gets scared how to hide this body. Mukundi gets scared when he sees his father coming back.

episodesList.title: Police Interrupts The Plan
episodesList.summary: Everyone in Lapataganj makes a plan to remove the body from their area. So they take him out of Lapataganj in a procession. But then suddenly, police enters Lapataganj. Will the police find out the truth?

episodesList.title: Kachua is Back
episodesList.summary: Kachus is back in Lapataganj from his trip. Everyone in the area gets excited and gather around him. Mukundi asks Kachua about his journey and gets to know that Kachua had been to jail as well.

episodesList.title: Kachuas Truth
episodesList.summary: Kachua gets beaten by the opposition party. Mishri and Elija put ointment and asks Kachua to take rest. Mishri asks him what did he say such things that he got beaten so badly.

episodesList.title: Vimla's Ghost
episodesList.summary: Mishri comes to a peepal tree to offer sweets to Vimla on her death anniversary. As soon as Mishri leaves, the sweets disappear. A few people in the neighborhood feel the presence of a ghost around them.

episodesList.title: Exorcism Of Chotu Mama
episodesList.summary: Vimla's ghost continues to haunt the entire village. Everyone is scared of Chotu mama as he starts speaking and acting like late Vimla. Chotu is made to sit through an exorcism by an exorcist.

episodesList.title: Disturbed Chotu
episodesList.summary: Mishri and other villagers are worried seeing Chotu collapsed in the middle of the road. The entire day he acts really strange after seeing Vimla with a lantern in her hand, the previous day.

episodesList.title: Kachua Feels Lonely
episodesList.summary: After getting ready in the morning, Kachua leaves for a walk in the village but feels ignored by the people. Due to loneliness, Kachua decides to get married leaving the villagers surprised.

episodesList.title: Mukundi's Plan Backfires
episodesList.summary: Indu starts crying when Mukundi says no to her plea for taking her for a vacation. Mukundi tries to show Indu that he would be in debt if he takes her out, but his plan backfires on him.

episodesList.title: Unwanted Guests
episodesList.summary: Indu cannot keep calm seeing her mother, sister, and brother-in-law, who have come to pay her a surprise visit. Mukundi does not seem pleased seeing guests arrive in his house without any prior notice.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Loses His Calm
episodesList.summary: Mukundi is already sick of the guests, as they are causing him trouble every minute of the day. He later loses his calm when he finds out that his brother-in-law has been taking debt in his name.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Disguises As His Father
episodesList.summary: Mukundi looks for ideas to kick the guests out of his house as they won't leave. Mukundi disguises himself as his father because Indu's mother hates him. He is shocked to see his father in front of him when he is dressed up as him.

episodesList.title: Chukundi Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: While leaving for work, Mukundi falls into a manhole and hurts himself. He fights with the contractor for digging a manhole which might be dangerous for pedestrians. In the evening, Mukundi and Indu are extremely worried as Chukundi goes missing.

episodesList.title: Chukundi Falls Into a Manhole
episodesList.summary: Mukundi goes crazy after hearing Chukundi talk from inside a big manhole. This becomes a matter of concern and as the media comes to cover the incident. After a lot of chaos, Chukundi is taken out of the manhole.

episodesList.title: Fake Currency
episodesList.summary: A fake note owned by Mukundi is circulated around the village before it reaches a policeman. Mukundi gets caught for producing fake currency but the real culprit is somebody else.

episodesList.title: Mukundi to Get Fired
episodesList.summary: Mukundi and Indu get into an argument over who does more work throughout the day. After talking to his boss, Mukundi predicts that he is going to be fired soon. He decides to hide this news from his wife.

episodesList.title: A Surprise For Mukundi
episodesList.summary: Mukundi is frightened after hearing people's stories after they have got fired from their jobs. He is relieved to find out that they have received a new consignment.

episodesList.title: The Pickle Story
episodesList.summary: Mukundi craves for some pickle but is upset to find out that all the pickle in his house is over. Indu, with the help of Mishri, begins to prepare pickle and decides to surprise Mukundi.

episodesList.title: Blood Donation
episodesList.summary: A blood donation camp is set in Lapataganj which excites all the villagers. Indu is adamant about donating blood even though Mukundi is against it.

episodesList.title: Sureeli to Marry a Dog
episodesList.summary: Mishri gets convinced to get Sureeli married to a dog, which according to the priest will clear the fault in her stars. Sureeli cries her eyes out when she finds out that she is going to get married to a dog.

episodesList.title: Pappu Accepts a Challenge
episodesList.summary: Pappu picks up the dog Sureeli is getting married to, and once again asks Mishri if he can marry Sureeli. Pappu accepts the challenge of earning five thousand rupees in a week to get married to Sureeli.

episodesList.title: Pappu Goes to Extremes
episodesList.summary: A reward of five thousand rupees is announced to whoever rides a bicycle for five days straight. Pappu takes up the challenge to fulfill Mishri's condition for getting Sureeli married to Pappu.

episodesList.title: Pappu Refuses to Give Up
episodesList.summary: Pappu is shocked to know that his drink was spiked by Chotu mama so that he fails to finish the challenge. Even after facing extreme troubles, Pappu does not give up.

episodesList.title: Humanity First
episodesList.summary: While everyone falls asleep, Guddu runs behind Pappu providing him moral support. He finally finishes the challenge and wins the prize money. Mishri refuses to stand by her words after learning that Pappu spent the money on someone in need.

episodesList.title: The Box Of Mangoes
episodesList.summary: Mukundi's boss hands him over a box for delivery which he hides and keeps in his house. Indu gets her hands on the box and mistakes it for her birthday gift. Indu gets excited and distributes all the mangoes to the people in Lapataganj.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Stuck In The Police Station
episodesList.summary: Mukundi is taken to the police station as he is the only witness to the cobbler and barber's fight. Pappu tries his best to see Sureeli but Mishri and Chotu always come in his way.

episodesList.title: Cops Look For Pappu
episodesList.summary: Guddu is put behind the bars when a policeman finds him wearing a fake uniform. When Guddu reveals that he was playing a cop to help Pappu, the policemen start looking for him.

episodesList.title: Indu Buys a Television Set
episodesList.summary: Mukundi is rewarded with ten thousand rupees for being the most hardworking employee. Indu claims her right on the money and announces that she is going to buy a television set.

episodesList.title: The Craze For Tv
episodesList.summary: When Mukundi asks the villagers to pay for getting the TV repaired, all of them back off. Once the TV is repaired, he makes sure nobody gets to watch TV in his house and kicks everyone out.

episodesList.title: Pappu Gets Beaten Up By Mishri
episodesList.summary: Indu convinces Mishri to accompany her to watch a film. Even though Sureeli has exams the next day, Pappu takes her to the theatre with him. When Mishri sees Sureeli with Pappu, she beats him up.

episodesList.title: Sureeli Passes Her Exam
episodesList.summary: While Sureeli writes her exam, Pappu and Guddu disguise as women and throw chits at her, so that she passes her exam. Sureeli clears her exam with distinction even though she refuses to cheat.

episodesList.title: The Fancy Fair
episodesList.summary: When Indu asks Mukundi to take her to the fair, he refuses. Pappu takes Sureeli to the fair so that they can enjoy together. Indu takes Chukundi to the fair with her and they have fun.

episodesList.title: Indu Wins an Elephant
episodesList.summary: Indu is enthusiastic to get the elephant home, which she has won as a price at the fair. Mukundi is petrified thinking about how he would take care of the elephant.

episodesList.title: Indu Throws a Feast
episodesList.summary: A minister reaches Mukundi's house with cops to complain against the elephant. Sureeli is on cloud nine after Pappu surprises her with a new cellphone. Indu decides to plan a feast for all her fellow villagers.

episodesList.title: Lapataganj Bids Farewell to The Elephant
episodesList.summary: People in Lapataganj are worried seeing the elephant lie motionless on the ground. They revive with joy when it wakes up in the morning. Indu cries her eyes out when the elephant is taken to the jungle in order to provide it with a safer life.

episodesList.title: The Talking Tree
episodesList.summary: A drunk man from Lapataganj experiences a tree talking to him but nobody believes him. The man takes Pappu to the talking tree and even he is bewildered to see the tree talk.

episodesList.title: The Truth Behind Gyandev
episodesList.summary: Pappu takes Sureeli to the talking tree and it seems to understand everything Sureeli intends to say. Mukundi tells Pappu that the tree knows the questions to all the answers, as it was built where either a school or library used to be.

episodesList.title: Inflation
episodesList.summary: Even after waiting in the long queue, Mukundi and other fellow villagers fail to get groceries. Seeing inflation, Mukundi is anxious. With inflation, every other commodity's rates increase leaving the people of Lapataganj worried.

episodesList.title: Concerns Of The Lapataganj Residents
episodesList.summary: While Tamatarilal and Shakkarchand visit Netaji, the people of the Lapataganj also go to Netaji to get an answer from him. They ask him for his help as the grocery prices are going high.

episodesList.title: Self-grown Vegetables In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Mukundi tries to recite Hanuman chaalisa in the morning while his wife, Indumati offers him breakfast. The residents of Lapataganj start to grow vegetables on their own.

episodesList.title: Pappu Visits Sureeli
episodesList.summary: Mishri is left baffled when she find Charusiya staring at the sky. Mukundi prepares for the upcoming rains. Guttu takes Pappu for a ride in his bicycle to see Sureeli.

episodesList.title: Indumati Waits For Mukundi's Return
episodesList.summary: Kacchua Chacha finds Indumati waiting for Mukundi's return outside her house. While Pappu and Guttu go in search of Mukundi, Pappu dreams of dancing in the rain with Sureeli.
