episodesList.title: Villagers to Handover Their Land
episodesList.summary: An announcement is made in the village that the Minister is going to address everyone's concerns regarding water. The villagers decide to hand over their land to the government.

episodesList.title: Mishri's Bicycle Ride
episodesList.summary: Jal Jal Prathap Sinha, the minister pretends not to recognize Mukundi. Mishri takes a ride, while Pappu dresses up as an Arab in the village. Indumati has prepared tea for Mukundi prior to him asking.

episodesList.title: A Bomb Handed Over to Chotu
episodesList.summary: Mukundi and Elija find it difficult to carry a huge box outside the house. While Pappu tells Mukundi that he has to get tablets for his dad when asked for help, on his return he still finds him hanging around.

episodesList.title: Surili to Say The Three Words
episodesList.summary: Residents of Lapataganj learn about the bomb in the market. Mukundi and Elija go to the police to inform them about the bomb. Mishri locks up Sureeli when she goes to confess her love to Pappu.

episodesList.title: Is Surili Getting Married?
episodesList.summary: Mukundi leaves home for a few days on work. While Pappu goes to visit Sureeli, he learns that a boy's family is coming to see Sureeli. Pappu is upset and says if she can't be his, she can't be anyone else's.

episodesList.title: A Drama to Save Surili
episodesList.summary: Kachua Chacha wakes up in a cart and narrates an incident to Guddu. When the boy's family comes, Elija and the others mislead them to Indumati's house who pretends to be a crazy Sureeli.

episodesList.title: Pappu Goes Shopping
episodesList.summary: Mishri and Indumati buy bangles from the seller. Chotu notices Kacchua Chacha making pots. Chotu brings some jalebis for Sureeli. Pappu shops for Sureeli, Indumati and Mishri.

episodesList.title: The Art Of Sculpting Life
episodesList.summary: Pappu breaks a pot that Mishri Mausi is carrying using a catapult. He buys samosas for Sureeli and goes to meet her. Chotu visits the doctor to get his mouth checked after having hot samosas.

episodesList.title: Mukundi and Indumati's Love Story
episodesList.summary: Pappu gets on top of the house where Sureeli lives and sings a song for her. While Mishri spots him, he manages to escape. Mukundi narrates how he fell in love with Indumati.

episodesList.title: Mukundi and Indumati's Love Story
episodesList.summary: Mukundi continues to narrate his love story. He tells them the hurdles that he had to overcome. Pappu buys some roses for Sureeli and sings for her. Mishri brings Police to take Pappu away.

episodesList.title: Indumati and Mukundi Share a Moment
episodesList.summary: Mukundi tells Pappu how he had to win a battle with the kabbadi men. One time he had to dress up in a burkha to watch Indumati sing and how he used to follow her places.

episodesList.title: Biji Pandey L.l.b
episodesList.summary: Indumati prays for Biji Pandey and makes laddoos for him so that he learns a lesson and studies well. Biji presents his L.L.B marksheet, after which his and Sureeli's wedding preparation begins.

episodesList.title: Fraud Brings Equality
episodesList.summary: Indu is upset that she is leaving Mukundi alone and Mishri assures to take care of him. A fortune-teller attempts to create illusion of a better tomorrow, in minds of the villagers.

episodesList.title: Benefits Of Flood
episodesList.summary: Mukundi gets a duty to host a politician from a nearby district. The shrewd politician thereafter projects his unethical mannerisms.

episodesList.title: Baba's Curse
episodesList.summary: A God-mans entry in Lapataganj gets Mukundi suspicious and he speaks up against it. The Baba in return, holds Mukundi responsible for the upcoming holocaust.

episodesList.title: Life is Uncertain
episodesList.summary: Mukundi explains to everyone that life is short and unpredictable which leaves an impact on their minds. Mishra wants Sureeli to get married to Pappu and Indu's father arrives at Lapataganj.

episodesList.title: Mukundi's First Flight
episodesList.summary: Mukundi gets an offer to fly to Mumbai and whole Lapataganj starts prepping for his departure. Indu demands to go along and Pappu gifts him an outfit.

episodesList.title: Mukundi In Trouble
episodesList.summary: The villagers are enthralled for Mukundi's flight and awaits his return. When Mukundi returns, everyone is intrigued to know his experience.

episodesList.title: Pappu's Planning
episodesList.summary: Pappu decides to start up a business and Mukundi feels he is up to some new prank. Suddenly customers are interested in Suttilal's shop.

episodesList.title: Edification In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Pappu calls the politician for sanctioning his business plans. The villagers start with their complaints regarding the issues they have to face due to sheer negligence.

episodesList.title: Complicated Relationships
episodesList.summary: Indu demands Mukundi to take her out on a trip, so Mishri tells her an incident from her own life. A movie creates ripples among the villagers about the relationship of husband and wife.

episodesList.title: Indu Becomes More Religious
episodesList.summary: Mukundi is shocked to find Indu's interest in religious methods. Mishri, Chotu, and Elija start doubting about Mukundi's intention.

episodesList.title: Pure Love
episodesList.summary: Mukundi's father throws Mukundi out when he hears that Mukundi was with another woman. Mukundi takes Pappu's advice in approaching Indu.

episodesList.title: Mukundi's Promotion
episodesList.summary: On the occasion of Mukundi's promotion, Lapatganj prepares to celebrate together and Mishri cooks and worships for him. Pappu gifts a scooter to Mukundi but there is more to it.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Got a Transfer
episodesList.summary: Indu cries about Mukundi's transfer from Lapataganj.  The whole village gradually decides to move out one by one after hearing the news.

episodesList.title: N.r.i. In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: A laundryman from America visits his village, Lapataganj. Pappu is impressed by the man's get-up and way of life and wishes the same for himself in the future.

episodesList.title: Chunmun Chaubey's Reality
episodesList.summary: Guddu motivates Pappu more towards his aim. Kachua slaps Pappu and explains him about his misdeeds. Police arrive in search of Chunmun Chaubey.

episodesList.title: Pyjama Mystery
episodesList.summary: Chotu keeps bragging about his father always, so Mishri shows their father's pyjama to him. Chotu gives the pyjama to Elija to adjust it according to his size and there starts the drama.

episodesList.title: The Saree Fight
episodesList.summary: Kachua gifts Indu and Mishri two sarees, but both choose the same one. Mishri gets the saree but Indu starts competing on every note with her.

episodesList.title: The Art Competition
episodesList.summary: As Kachua is painting a few pots, there is an announcement for an art competition with a reward of one lakh for the winner. The villagers force Kachua to take part in the competition.

episodesList.title: Pappu Learns His Lesson
episodesList.summary: To teach Pappu a lesson, Kachua, and other villagers act as Britishers and turn Lapataganj into a colony. Pappu realizes what sacrifices the freedom fighters would have made and apologizes to everyone in the village.

episodesList.title: The Five Questions
episodesList.summary: Mukundi suggests his fellow villagers that this time, they should choose their leader by asking them a few questions. They surround a contesting man and ask him five questions.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Down With a Fever
episodesList.summary: When Mishri goes to wake Mukundi up with a cup of tea, he tells her that he is not feeling too well. Chotu mama calls a doctor who tells that Mukundi is down with a fever.

episodesList.title: The Wedding Invitation
episodesList.summary: Mukundi is worried after he receives an invitation for Indu's sister's wedding. He wonders how he can eliminate the extra expenditure for the upcoming wedding.

episodesList.title: A Shocking News For Pappu
episodesList.summary: Everyone is excited for the upcoming festival of Rakshabandhan. Sureeli overhears Chotu mama talk about Sureeli tying a rakhi on Pappu's wrist.

episodesList.title: The Festival Of Rakshabandhan
episodesList.summary: To keep Sureeli from tying a rakhi on his wrist, Pappu lands Chotu in a fight with Mishri. Later, he takes up the responsibility to resolve their fight, so that they spend a memorable Rakshabandhan together.

episodesList.title: The Unknown Letter
episodesList.summary: Mukundi receives a letter from an unknown sender which says that they would be coming soon to collect their money. After he reads out the letter in front of all the villagers, they start wondering who is the sender and who is it addressed to.

episodesList.title: Pappu Blames Chotu Mama
episodesList.summary: Pappu guesses that the letter was addressed to Chotu mama concerning Sureeli's marriage. He blames mama for trying to get Sureeli married to a man who has been already married twice.

episodesList.title: Preparations For Janmashtami
episodesList.summary: Indu is upset as she will not have Chukundi to dress up as Lord Krishna on the occasion of Janmashtami. Mukundi cheers her up and the entire village starts prepping for the festival.

episodesList.title: Independence Day
episodesList.summary: Lapataganj seems different on Independence Day as they get water supply. The villagers with a patriotic mind, celebrate independence, followed by various events.

episodesList.title: Lord Krishna Blesses Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: As the villagers devote themselves to praying to Lord Krishna, they are extremely happy when it starts pouring. Chotu mama experiences intuitions of his own death.

episodesList.title: Sureeli's Competition
episodesList.summary: Sureeli's classmates keep bullying her speech impairment. The bicycle competition is announced in Lapataganj and Sureeli starts preparing for it.

episodesList.title: Sureeli Gets Injured
episodesList.summary: Pappu and Guddu arrange a bicycle for Sureeli but Chotu takes the credit. The villagers get busy in training Sureeli to ride a bicycle.

episodesList.title: The Slow Bicycle Race
episodesList.summary: Sureeli keeps up her training, even with her injury. The slow bicycle race commences but Sureeli's bicycle chain drops in between.

episodesList.title: Ill-fated Sureeli
episodesList.summary: Sureeli gets another chance and will represent her college in the race. Another contestant kicks Sureeli down from her bicycle while the competition is going on.

episodesList.title: Emerging Winner
episodesList.summary: Pappu and Guddu motivate and Sureeli completes the race. Mukundi brings back Pappu's cycle and finally Mishri thanks Pappu for getting her daughter the cycle. Pappu insults Mukundi for using an old bicycle.

episodesList.title: Scooter-attachment
episodesList.summary: Mishri consoles Indu, who is upset about Mukundi buying a scooter. Mukundi and Indu go out for a ride but suddenly the scooter stops working.

episodesList.title: Mukundi's Extravagancy
episodesList.summary: Mukundi is over-attached to his scooter which infuriates Indu. The villagers give their own opinion and dismantle Mukundi's scooter as it's not working.

episodesList.title: Mishris Dying Hopes
episodesList.summary: Mishri eagerly waits for her husband to return from Mumbai. Kachua is in trauma to hear about Putani's return to Lapataganj. Chotu reveals a news, and everyone is shocked.

episodesList.title: Lapataganjs New Amusement
episodesList.summary: Mishri faints on her husband arrival at Lapataganj. Putani's accent astonishes the villagers and they keep on muttering the same way. Putani raises a wave of mixed emotions in Lapataganj.

episodesList.title: Putani Got Fired
episodesList.summary: Kachua is upset as Putani is going to stay for sometime now. Mishri pursues Putani for fixing Sureeli's marriage. Sureeli reads Putani's retrenchment letter.

episodesList.title: Ganesh Chaturthi
episodesList.summary: People in Lapataganj are devoted to praying to Lord Ganesha on Ganesh Chaturthi. Later, they discuss what they would ask for as a wish from Lord Ganesh.

episodesList.title: Ukundi In a Rush
episodesList.summary: Mukundi leaves home in a hurry as an officer is coming to his workplace for an evaluation. Chotu mama plays a prank on Pappu as he believes mama when he says that Sureeli is alone at home.

episodesList.title: Appu Misses Sureeli
episodesList.summary: Pappu is upset that Sureeli has left the town without informing him and misses her all day. Mukundi is scared to tell Indu to change the menu for dinner as he has already handed her over a list of items to be made in advance.

episodesList.title: Suttilal Receives a Legal Notice
episodesList.summary: Suttilal receives a legal notice after he gives Pappu sweets full of ants. He blames Chotu mama for his situation as mama had asked him to do so.

episodesList.title: Elija's Brother In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Elija is on cloud nine as his brother comes to pay him a visit in Lapataganj. He decides to take his brother to see all his friends in the village.

episodesList.title: Elija Ki Kasam
episodesList.summary: Mukundilal struggles to get his wife's clothes stitched, as Elija the Tailor refuses to work because all he wants to do is relax, eat, and get fat.

episodesList.title: The Cleanest House
episodesList.summary: Mishri starts cleaning her house well in advance, so that her house appears to be the tidiest one in Lapataganj. Indu claims to have the most organized house and gets into a fight with Mishri.

episodesList.title: Indu vs Mishri
episodesList.summary: To prove Mishri wrong, Indu makes Mukundi immaculate their house with her. Mukundi is upset as he has been missing work from the past two days.

episodesList.title: Chotu Mama Hunts For Work
episodesList.summary: Chotu mama gets excited after Mishri asks him to get married. She asks him to find a job before getting married. He starts looking for work around Lapataganj.

episodesList.title: Chotus Lottery Controversy
episodesList.summary: Lapataganj is stormed by Chotu's lottery ticket but the problem is he has misplaced it. United by sharing the profit, the villagers get busy searching Chotu's pyjama which has the ticket.

episodesList.title: Solving The Problem
episodesList.summary: Sureeli is back to Lapataganj, Pappu is exhilarated to see her. Meanwhile, Mishri and Chotu plan to get Sureeli married off. Indu is annoyed with Mukundi as he keeps her waiting. Chotu gets fooled by the duo while patroling Sureeli.

episodesList.title: Prospective Groom
episodesList.summary: Sureeli tries to convince Mishri about Pappu's positive aspects. Mukundi advises his colleague on marital life. Mishri breaks down as she can't find Chotu.

episodesList.title: Eloping Plan
episodesList.summary: Pappu plans to elope with Sureeli and asks money from Guddu. Later on, Pappu and Guddu try to influence Indu against Mishri.

episodesList.title: Preparations For Ramleela
episodesList.summary: A mysterious bow is found in Lapataganj and everyone tries to guess its origin. The politician takes donation from the villagers for Ramleela. Villagers start planning the characters they are going to play and get too involved in it.

episodesList.title: Celebrating Ramleela
episodesList.summary: Amidst the ongoing celebration, Lapataganj is in a jovial mood. When the play is about to commence, and villagers start demanding the presence of Ram's character, Mukundi goes missing.

episodesList.title: Broken Bow
episodesList.summary: Villagers donate money for witnessing the bow breaking incident. Chotu tells it was his deed so he deserves all the money. After a lot of altercation, the Ramayan performance starts.

episodesList.title: Will The Celebration Continue?
episodesList.summary: Chotu complains to Mukundi for improving his performance. The villagers get worked-up on hearing that Pappu and Guddu got arrested in a nearby village.

episodesList.title: Ramleela In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: People in Lapataganj take part in Ramleela where Mukundi plays Lord Ram, Indu plays Sita and Pappu plays Lakshman. All the villagers come to see the play.

episodesList.title: Talented Actors In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Mishri playing Surpnakha is against Pappu getting to cut her nose, but gives in eventually. All the actors are happy as they successfully entertain the audience.

episodesList.title: The Women Get Conned
episodesList.summary: Indu, Mishri and other women lose their calm as a holyman claims to double their gold. Without them realizing, the con man escapes with all their gold.

episodesList.title: Chotu Mama Refuses to Wake Up
episodesList.summary: To teach Chotu mama a lesson, Pappu and Guddu pick him up with his cot and place them in the middle of the road. The villagers try their best but fail to wake Chotu up from his sleep.

episodesList.title: The Climax
episodesList.summary: When Chotu mama starts talking a lot, Pappu asks him to shut up. The villagers rehearse for the last scene of the Ramleela, which finally comes to an end after burning the Ravanas statue.

episodesList.title: Green Chilly Eating Competition
episodesList.summary: People in Lapataganj analyse the Ramleela they presented. Chotu mama and Pappu have a green chilly eating competition in front of the entire village.

episodesList.title: Pappu Gets Beaten Up
episodesList.summary: Pappu plans to teach Chotu mama a lesson but his plan backfires on him. Chotu calls the cops on Pappu and the cops beat Pappu up.

episodesList.title: Sureeli Wins Through Cheating
episodesList.summary: Sureeli hands over her award to another girl, as she cheated at the singing competition. Mishri is furious after knowing that Sureeli was lip-syncing to a song playing on the tape recorder.

episodesList.title: Elija, The Boss
episodesList.summary: Elija returns to Lapataganj with his aunt who thinks he owns the entire village. She goes around the village believing everyone is there to serve her.

episodesList.title: Mukundi does The Household Chores
episodesList.summary: Mukundi is sick and tired of doing the household chores as Indu has gone to her parent's house. When the villagers come to help Mukundi, he is reluctant.

episodesList.title: Another Headache For Mukundi
episodesList.summary: Mukundi's family starts staying in his house without any notice and he mistakes his brother-in-law for a thief. Mukundi is taken aback when he informs him that he has got a transfer in Lapataganj and that he would stay with them henceforth.

episodesList.title: Mukundi has Another Wife
episodesList.summary: A woman comes to Lapataganj asking for Mukundi claiming to be his wife. Even though Mukundi turns down all her allegations, she refuses to leave him.

episodesList.title: Bhanumati is a Thief
episodesList.summary: As Mukundi steps out of the house in the night, Bhanumati opens Indu's cupboard and takes all her jewellery. Mukundi sees this and decides to let her reality be known.

episodesList.title: Kachua is Back
episodesList.summary: People in Lapataganj are surprised to see Kachua after very long. When Chotu mama spreads baseless rumours about Kachua, he is furious. He starts beating him up in from of all the villagers.

episodesList.title: Kachua to Change His Name
episodesList.summary: Kachua is adamant about changing his name to get rid of all his problems. The villagers try to change his decision but in vain, even after Chotu apologizes to him.

episodesList.title: A Millionaire In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: When Chotu mama shares his unreasonable dream with his fellow villagers, they laugh at him. A millionaire comes looking for Pappu which gains everyone's attention.

episodesList.title: A Demand For Pappu
episodesList.summary: Mishri and Chotu make Sureeli believe that Pappu is going to get married to another girl. The man from the city is so desperate to get his daughter married to Pappu, that he does not think twice before buying him.

episodesList.title: Chotu is Asked to Find a Job
episodesList.summary: People in Lapataganj are behind Chotu to get a job, but he is reluctant towards their wish. Mishri makes it clear that she can't take care of him anymore as he does not earn any money.

episodesList.title: Chotus Attempt to be an Electrician
episodesList.summary: Learning that Lapataganj would soon have an electric supply, Chotu decides to learn the work of an electrician. Trying to fix things, he creates trouble for the people in Lapataganj.

episodesList.title: Mukundi is Desperate For Indu's Return
episodesList.summary: The postman at Mukundi's workplace while getting retired, tells him that there are a lot of letters which are still undelivered. Mukundi is anxious thinking when would Indu return.

episodesList.title: Indu Abandons Mukundi
episodesList.summary: Mukundi starts crying after reading Indu's letter which says that she would never come back. The entire village is worried after this news spreads and starts giving Mukundi suggestions on how to get her back.

episodesList.title: Suman Visits Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Chotu mama tells his fellow villagers that he is leaving for Golganj to get his niece, Suman to Lapataganj. Sureeli and Mishri are extremely happy to receive Suman.

episodesList.title: Sureeli Plays The Cupid
episodesList.summary: Chotu fixes Sureeli's marriage to Prem Babu, who is actually Suman's lover. But Sureeli is adamant about marrying Pappu. Mishri catches Sureeli making the lovebirds meet.

episodesList.title: Wait For Prem Babu
episodesList.summary: Suman sends Prem Babu a letter through Sureeli, which Pappu perceives differently. Chotu and Mishri await Prem Babu but he is nowhere to be found.

episodesList.title: Suttilal In a Mess
episodesList.summary: Lapataganj's new Development Officer arrives and starts enquiring about the residents. Kanyakumari and Mukundi were college lovers. Mukundi suggests Suttilal the ways to save his shop.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Attempts to Save Suttilal
episodesList.summary: Mukundi's efforts bring colours to Suttilal's life. Kanyakumari and her assistants evade the situation once the journalists intervene.

episodesList.title: Pre-funeral Plan
episodesList.summary: A minister comes to visit Suttilal and threatens him for going on a hunger strike. Different businessmen meet Suttilal to sell their products.

episodesList.title: Suttilal The Thief
episodesList.summary: Mukundi explains his plan to the villagers to get rid of the media. The villagers plot that Suttilal is a thief and Pappu adds up to their drama.

episodesList.title: Patni Aakhir Patni Hoti Hai
episodesList.summary: Mukundilal rejoices as his beloved wife Indumati, finally returns home after spending time at her parents' house.

episodesList.title: Mukkoos Cuckoo
episodesList.summary: Indu is tensed about Kanyakumari's growing closeness to Mukundi. Mukundi comes home late daily, which adds up to Indu's doubts. What will happen when Indu finds Mukundi with Kanyakumari?

episodesList.title: Indu is Shattered
episodesList.summary: Indu decides to go back to her mother's place on finding Mukundi returning home in Kanyakumari's car. The villagers try to convince Indu but its too late already.

episodesList.title: Elija's Wedding
episodesList.summary: Elija takes Chotu's criticism too hard, and gets sensitive about being unmarried. Kanyakumari is annoyed to hear about Indu from Mukundi. Elija beats the drums and swears about getting married in front of the villagers.

episodesList.title: Elija's Sweety
episodesList.summary: Sweety enters Lapataganj and asks Elija to help her out. Elija challenges Chotu that he will get married soon. Guddu is called upon by Elija for advices but Chotu has already manipulated Guddu.

episodesList.title: Elija's Wish to Get Married
episodesList.summary: Elija dresses up in mismatched clothes to impress a girl he has set his eyes on. He intends to get married to her and goes behind wooing her.

episodesList.title: Mishris Dream Come True
episodesList.summary: Mishri dreams about Chotu getting bashed due to his antics and her religious Baba confirms that will happen. Chotu doesn't bother about any of the superstition and goes out to only realize that it turned to be true. Indu saw a terrible dream at the same hour as Mishris, will that also be true?

episodesList.title: Indu's Death Fear
episodesList.summary: Indu is scared and does everything she can for her family to remember her. Guddu lies to Mishri and takes Pappu to feed Sureeli. Chotu stops the lovebirds and snatches away the jalebis.

episodesList.title: Kanyakumari Doesnt Like Kids
episodesList.summary: Indu calls Eliza over and makes him wear numerous rakhis. Indu and Mukundi invite Kanyakumari for dinner but Chukundi ruins the mood.

episodesList.title: Bindwasini At Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Pappu gifts a few bangles to Sureeli and gets caught thereafter. Indu plans that her sister, Bindwasini, is ideal for Mukundi and tries to push them for going for a movie.

episodesList.title: Pappu is In Danger
episodesList.summary: Indu finally reveals everything to her sister, Bindumati. Mukundi has a nightmare about Pappu getting badly attacked and so Indu goes to alert him.

episodesList.title: Indu Gets Jealous
episodesList.summary: Indu is in a hurry to send off Bindwasini home, but Mukundi's statement shocks everyone. The Lapataganj is united once again to help one of their residents.

episodesList.title: Storytellers At Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Chotu amuses the crowd with his father's story. Kachua is back in Lapataganj but nobody is ready to listen to him. So Chotu suggests Kachua newer ways to gain his importance back.

episodesList.title: Kachhua Ki Pooch
episodesList.summary: Kachhua Prasad slaps a Government official after mistaking him for a roadside romeo and immediately regrets it when the officer reveals his identity.

episodesList.title: Kachuas Case
episodesList.summary: Kachua slapped Manchale Yadav and has made things hard for himself. The villagers seek help from Lallan but he refuses to help.

episodesList.title: Lapataganj At Stake
episodesList.summary: The villagers try to convince Kachua for apologising to the government officer but he denies to accept his mistake at all. Lapataganj will be added to a highway and there is no scope for development.

episodesList.title: The Cross Connection
episodesList.summary: Pappu keeps hiding and running from his family to avoid meeting a girl named Duniya. Pappu chooses Guddu as the ideal alternative to send for the date. Duniya likes Guddu and selects him as her prospective husband.

episodesList.title: He Chosen Misconception
episodesList.summary: Chuniya, Duniya's father arrives at Lapataganj to meet Guddu. Pappu is upset to know Duniya has chosen Guddu. Lapataganj gets engrossed in Guddu's celebration.

episodesList.title: Guddus Haldi Ceremony
episodesList.summary: While Lapataganj is celebrating Guddu's haldi, Chuniya Dubey brings a better proposal for Guddu's future. Pappu and Guddu get emotional for this new step.

episodesList.title: Guddu's Wedding
episodesList.summary: The villagers convince Guddu that Lapataganj will always be his. Guddu and Duniya make a perfect couple, but Pappu tries to tease them by getting in between. Lapataganj is heartbroken to witness Guddu's farewell.

episodesList.title: Friends Reunite
episodesList.summary: Pappu is in depression as he still feels Guddu is in Lapataganj. Sureeli goes to another village with her mother. The villagers worry about Guddu's condition, when Guddu arrives at Lapataganj.

episodesList.title: Father's Reminiscence
episodesList.summary: Duniya stands in between of Guddu and Pappu. Chotu finds his father's things in the safe and show it off to the villagers. While Lapataganj celebrates their father's birthday, Chotu takes up a challenge.

episodesList.title: Chotu Gets In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Chotu is worked up to accept this challenge of showing his fathers photograph. Suttilal, Chaurasia and Elija tries to convince him but that starts a new problem.

episodesList.title: Chotu Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: Chotu decides to sketch his father's picture. Mukundi prepares food while Chotu chats with him. The artist who arrives is a professional sketch artist for Police.

episodesList.title: Chotu's Photo In The Newspaper
episodesList.summary: The people in Lapatganj are in shock to see Chotu mama's picture in the newspaper, saying he is no more. During a prayer service, Chotu's presence scares everyone.

episodesList.title: The Army Of Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Chotu mama goes in search for members for the army from Lapataganj. Lallu's return after 6 years excites everyone. Chaurasiya narrates the incident of how Lallu left the village.

episodesList.title: Lallu's Return Awaited
episodesList.summary: Lallu returns to Lapataganj after 6 years. His arrival brings tears in their eyes as he is injured. They all celebrate Lallu's return in Lapataganj, before which he shares his experience.

episodesList.title: A Reward For Lallu
episodesList.summary: A celebration takes place in Lapataganj for Lallu's return and the minister promises him a license for putting up a petrol bunk. Lallu visits the collector along with Mukundi.

episodesList.title: Honeymoon Express
episodesList.summary: An announcement goes around in Lapataganj of a new movie. Indumati tries to convince Mukundi to take her. Guddu and his wife, Duniya too, go to watch the new movie.

episodesList.title: The Husbands are Punished
episodesList.summary: Mukundi, Guddu, and Lallan are put outside the house, as they do not agree to go with their wives for a honeymoon. Chotu brings a smile on Surili's face and makes her laugh.

episodesList.title: Honeymoon Fantasies
episodesList.summary: Bindu, Indumati and Duniya discuss their honeymoon fantasies. Sutti Lal is upset as his wife, Mircha as she is forcing him to take her for the honeymoon.

episodesList.title: Excited Wives Of Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: All the couples are excited as they are finally going for the honeymoon. They discuss the places to visit. Duniya's father lends some money to Guddu to take Duniya for the honeymoon.

episodesList.title: Honeymoon Journey Begins
episodesList.summary: Everyone waits for Thota Ram who has planned the Honeymoon trip. A bus arrives to take everyone to the honeymoon resort. They all have a fun time during the bus journey.

episodesList.title: Pappu Returns to Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Mircha begins to weep as she has left behind her hen in the food joint that they had stopped at. Pappu returns to Lapataganj and wonders where everyone are. All of them arrive at the resort.

episodesList.title: Bonfire Night
episodesList.summary: Elija has his eyes on the receptionist at the resort. The manager takes them around the resort. They all get into the pool and have a bonfire night at the end of the day.

episodesList.title: Elija Gets Slapped
episodesList.summary: As all the couples are having a good time, Elija gets slapped by the receptionist after reading his letter. While Pappu is en route to honeymoon resort, Surili misses him.

episodesList.title: Surili Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: Elija sarcastically explains to Chotu about his conversation with the receptionist. When Surili notices all the couples having a good time, she misses Pappu even more.

episodesList.title: Pappu At Honeymoon Resort
episodesList.summary: Pappu reaches the honeymoon resort and Surili is also found. Everyone leaves to return to Lapataganj. Surili and Pappu have a moment together before the others return.

episodesList.title: Dabang Pandey
episodesList.summary: Biji Pandey finally clears his LLB exam and becomes a lawyer, but no one in his neighbourhood takes him seriously. An upset Biji decides to change his ways and bring an element of 'Dabangayi' in his attitude.

episodesList.title: Is Pappu an Actual Cop?
episodesList.summary: Indu and Duniya try to convince Mishri mausi to get Surili married to Pappu. Pappu later dressed up in police uniform arrives in Lapataganj trying to convince Mishri mausi.

episodesList.title: Dabang Pandey
episodesList.summary: Pappu takes Surili with him to distribute money. The actual police come to catch hold of Pappu. He then confesses the truth saying he was testing everyone's belief.

episodesList.title: Mishri Mausi's Golden Bangles
episodesList.summary: Mishri mausi shows off her new golden bangles. Indumati cries to Mukundi, because he hasn't bought her any bangles. Mausi plans to get Surili married to Suresh.

episodesList.title: Colourful Bangles For Surili
episodesList.summary: Mukundi visits the jewellery store with Indumati to buy bangles for her. Pappu buys colourful bangles for Surili and goes to meet her, the minute Mausi and Chotu leave the house.

episodesList.title: Indumati Throws a Party
episodesList.summary: Indumati calls for a get together to show everyone the bangles she bought. Since Indumati has bought golden bangles, Bindu tries to convince her husband to buy bangles for her as well.

episodesList.title: Pappu's Visit to The Jewellery Store
episodesList.summary: The jewellery store manager comes in search of Mukundi to collect money. Surili too asks Pappu to buy bangles for her. Bindu is excited as her husband arranges for money to buy bangles.

episodesList.title: Muneemji In Search Of Mukundi
episodesList.summary: Mukundi hides from Muneemji. Lallan and Bindu visit Indumati and Mukundi at night. Mishri mausi makes besan laddu for everyone. Mukundi is at the jewellery store again.

episodesList.title: Mukundi In Distress
episodesList.summary: Mukundi is worried thinking about Bindu's money and the bangles. Bindu is excited thinking about her bangles. Before Mukundi returns, everyone is already celebrating for Bindu's joy.

episodesList.title: Indumati In Shock
episodesList.summary: Everyone is shocked as Mukundi doesn't get the bangles. Bindu says that Indumati is jealous of her and leaves. Indu is shocked to find money in her cupboard that Mukundi had kept.

episodesList.title: Indu and Bindu Split Up
episodesList.summary: The ladies in Lapataganj are sad over Indu and BIndu's split up. Sureeli is forced to see a man for her wedding but Pappu intervenes.

episodesList.title: Indu Makes a Blunder
episodesList.summary: Indu makes a big blunder by giving Mukundi's office money to Bindu. Indu cries her eyes out, as Mukundi is nowhere to be seen and spends a sleepless night.

episodesList.title: Indu Observes a Fast
episodesList.summary: Indu in front of Lord Hanuman pleadges that she will not eat or drink anything until Mukundi returns home. Even though her fellow villagers try to make her eat something, she stands by her decision.

episodesList.title: Chotu Believes In Pappu's Prank
episodesList.summary: Pappu and Guddu stick a one rupee coin on Chotu mama's forehead while he is asleep. They later tell him that if the coin sticks for one day, he would become a millionaire.

episodesList.title: Chotu Tries to Woo Chameli
episodesList.summary: As soon as Mishri agrees to get Chotu married, he tries talking to Chameli. Chotu goes to extremes to impress Chamelii but Mishri refuses to take things forward until Chotu finds a job.

episodesList.title: Chotu Demands Money From Mishri
episodesList.summary: Chotu mama goes around the village asking people what work he should be doing. Chotu demands money from Mishri to run a business.

episodesList.title: Mama Ki Pehli Kamai
episodesList.summary: Mama earns for the first time. He sends Surili to tell his mother to look for a suitable person to get married to. Mama's mother decides to meet Lalaji to discuss the same.

episodesList.title: Bura Na Maano Holi Hai
episodesList.summary: The people of Lapataganj get ready to celebrate Holi. Mama Ji dreams of being a part of the unique Holi celebration with the person he loves.

episodesList.title: The Festival Of Colors
episodesList.summary: People in Lapataganj celebrate the festival of colors with great joy and enthusiasm. Everyone thinks Chameli is angry at Chotu for throwing colors at her, but she reveals that she loved it.

episodesList.title: Chotu and Pappu Shake Hands
episodesList.summary: The men in Lapataganj regreat getting a body massage from wrestlers instead of enjoying it. Chotu and Pappu shake hands and promise to not intervene in each other's marriage.

episodesList.title: Chotu is Left Heartbroken
episodesList.summary: Chotu mama is upset as he does not want Sureeli to miss his wedding. Chotu mama is left heartbroken, when he sees another man getting married to Chameli.

episodesList.title: Chotu Bids Chameli Farewell
episodesList.summary: Chameli talks to Chotu mama for one last time, before departing from Lapataganj. Before she leaves, she asks Chotu to sing a song in front of everyone.

episodesList.title: A Test Of Love
episodesList.summary: Indu wonders if Mukundi has stopped loving her as much as he used to. She starts testing his love for her and her belief becomes stronger when he refuses to call in sick for work.

episodesList.title: Indu Doubts Mukundi's Love For Her
episodesList.summary: Seeing Indu doubt his love for her, Mukundi gives in to all her wishes. They get into a fight at the theatre, followed by a few more fights.

episodesList.title: Indu Gives Mukundi a Hard Time
episodesList.summary: Indu asks Mukundi to wrestle with a strong wrestler to prove his love for her. Chukundi tells Mukundi that Indu is planning to leave the house if he does not agree for wrestling.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Agrees to Wrestle
episodesList.summary: Indu announces that Mukundi will be wrestling a sumo in front of everyone in Lapataganj. Mukundi applies for a two months leave at work, thinking he would definitely break his bones.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Panics
episodesList.summary: People in Lapataganj prepare Mukundi for the fight but he starts panicking. Mukundi loses all his confidence seeing the wrestler and is unable to accept the reality.

episodesList.title: Winner Of Love
episodesList.summary: Mukundi loses the wrestling match but wins in his test of love. Indu and Mukundi exchange gifts and share their journey of love.

episodesList.title: Tie Magic
episodesList.summary: Bindu and Lallan fight over a tie and the question of gentleman arises. Two suited men arrive at Lapataganj and they only find Lallan as a gentleman.

episodesList.title: Mukundi, a Gentleman
episodesList.summary: The whole village starts wearing ties as to feel like a gentleman. Even Mukundi suits up in a blazer and tie and Indu is shocked to see him.

episodesList.title: Sureeli's Fast
episodesList.summary: Pappu is excited to have Sureeli back at Lapataganj. Sureeli starts fasting for a day on the suggestion of a Baba, when she hears that Pappu is going to see another woman.

episodesList.title: Mishri Forces Sureeli
episodesList.summary: Mishri prepares Sureeli's favourite food to break her fasting, but she still refrains from having any food. Elija collapses when Chotu slaps him assuming it is Pappu.

episodesList.title: Sureeli's Wrath
episodesList.summary: Mishri and Sureeli finally end their fasting when their town hall clock strikes six but Chotu reveals that the clock was forwarded only to break their fasting. Sureeli starts dancing in front of Lord Shiva in despair.

episodesList.title: United
episodesList.summary: The whole village gathers to feed Sureeli as she denies in anger. Chotu plays a new trick to make Sureeli have her food but fails miserably.

episodesList.title: Fasts For Sureeli
episodesList.summary: Sureeli gets weak without taking any food, even after Mishri's and Chotu's several tries. Mukundi insults Chotu, when he is having food at Suttilal. Lapataganj sits down together to fast till Sureeli doesn't break hers.

episodesList.title: Sureeli In a Severe State
episodesList.summary: A doctor comes to check Sureeli's state and suggests a few remedies. Mukundi finally succeeds in convincing Sureeli to have food for Chukundi's sake.

episodesList.title: Elija In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Mircha finishes all the food at her husband, Suttilal's shop. Pappu teases Sureeli for fasting so long. Elija catches the wrong man thinking as thief and now his life is in danger.

episodesList.title: Elija Tries to Hide
episodesList.summary: Elija hides behinds the bars by slapping a constable, but is announced the winner at a local level tailoring contest. Ghamshyampur's residents get Elija out on bail for bashing him, but Mukundi and Chotu get stuck with them.

episodesList.title: Thakur Brothers In Disguise
episodesList.summary: Elija again slaps a constable for hiding in jail. The Thakur brothers dress up differently to search for Elija. One of them falls for Sureeli and Guddu overhears him. Mukundi catches one of them dressed as a postman.

episodesList.title: New Plan to Find Elija
episodesList.summary: Thakur brothers fail to find Elija and Lapataganj residents feel relieved. Mukundi suggests everyone to stay alert. The brothers plot another way to attack Elija.

episodesList.title: Mama Ji Tries to Bail Elija
episodesList.summary: Mama Ji tries to bail Elija out of jail. Later, a lawyer reaches the police station and bails Elija out. Who sent the lawyer?

episodesList.title: Elija Gets Relieved
episodesList.summary: Chotu plans to escape from Lapataganj till this trouble evades. Mukundi is in deep thoughts to find out a solution for Elija. Mukundi manages to convince the older Thakur and he forgives Elija but the brothers don't.

episodesList.title: Mukundi's Friend
episodesList.summary: Mukundi struggles to get Chukundi ready and Sugandhi arrives. Chukundi reads a letter for Mukundi from his friend. Mukundi makes arrangement and the whole village awaits Prasanna.

episodesList.title: Misconception
episodesList.summary: Prasanna's entry is enjoyed by the villagers, even Chukundi appears really smart to him. Suttilal's samosas are a delight to the guest. But the residents have a misconception about Prasanna.

episodesList.title: Fight to Impress
episodesList.summary: There is a fight over buying samosas at Suttilal's shop. The fight is actually to impress Prasanna, who himself is stressed over the misconception that Mukundi has.

episodesList.title: Prasanna is Tied Up
episodesList.summary: Lapataganj members dream about expanding their means of livelihood. The villagers get united to host a program for Prasanna. Prasanna enjoys their company and fears to reveal the truth.

episodesList.title: Prasanna Finally Discloses
episodesList.summary: The villagers are disappointed to know about the truth of Prasanna as their dreams are shattered. A Hakim arrives at Lapataganj to fool the simple villagers, Mukundi stands against it.

episodesList.title: Neem Hakim's Trickery
episodesList.summary: Pappu has no chance with Sureeli as his plan fails. Lallan and Mukundi argue about silly issues. Elija gets rejected by a woman. Hakim starts plotting new ways to affect the villagers.

episodesList.title: Hakim Gets Some Approval
episodesList.summary: Suttilal and Mircha go to the Hakim for treating their buffalo. Meanwhile, Lallan cannot find his glasses, and Bindu wishes he didn't have to wear them. One-by-one, the villagers visit the Hakim with their ailments.

episodesList.title: Suttilal's Life In Danger
episodesList.summary: Suttilal eats the medicine for his buffalo and falls sick. The villagers start to realize Hakim's medicines are fake. Lallan gets stuck due to his carelessness.

episodesList.title: No Recovery
episodesList.summary: Mukundi saves Lallan from getting beaten up as he isn't wearing his glasses. The villagers discuss and lie about their ailments. Pappu gets beaten up by Mishri when she hears about the medicines he gave her.

episodesList.title: Pappu Ustad a Fraudx
episodesList.summary: The villagers finally reveal to each that there is no sign of recovery. The whole village together confronts the fake Hakim and asks their money back.

episodesList.title: Suttilal's New Problem
episodesList.summary: Lallan's colleagues will visit them, so he asks Bindu to prepare a special menu. Suttilal goes to Mukundi to resolve his problems.

episodesList.title: Suttilal Closes His Shop
episodesList.summary: People in Lapataganj wonder why Suttilal's shop is closed, which is unusual. Suttilal tells them that he would never reopen his shop because people never repay their debts.

episodesList.title: Suttilal's Decision Affects The Villagers
episodesList.summary: Lallan's boss and his wife leave his house after tasting the food they had to offer him. Sureeli tells Pappu that he does not love her anymore as he did not get her jalebis.

episodesList.title: Suttilal to Reopen His Shop
episodesList.summary: Mukundi makes everyone repay their debts they had taken from Suttilal. Suttilal agrees to reopen his shop leaving everyone extremely happy.

episodesList.title: Lallan is Thrown Out Of The House
episodesList.summary: Pappu and Guddu admire a new woman who they notice in Lapataganj. Bindu asks Lallan to stay out of the house until he gets his all three daughters home.

episodesList.title: Bindu Reunites With Her Daughters
episodesList.summary: Lallan's mother asks Bindu to have a son against her will. Bindu breaks down seeing her daughters. Lallan's mother constantly finds faults in whatever Bindu and her daughters do.

episodesList.title: Lalan Ji's Mother Comes Over
episodesList.summary: Lalan Ji's amma has come over. She fusses over her son. Later, Lalan Ji's daughters arrive.

episodesList.title: Daughters are a Gift
episodesList.summary: Mukundi and other villagers try to make Lallan's mother understand how lucky it is to have daughters. She understands only when her grand-daughters save her after her clothes catch fire.

episodesList.title: Sureeli Wins a Dance Competition
episodesList.summary: Sureeli is extremely happy as she has won the dance competition in her school. Chotu mama drags Sureeli home when he ends up seeing Pappu romancing her.

episodesList.title: The Money Order
episodesList.summary: Mishri and Chotu wonder why her husband still hasn't sent across the money order for the month. They are relieved when Mukundi informs them that the money order has come.

episodesList.title: Chotu Blames Pappu For Robbery
episodesList.summary: Mishri gets a shock after learning that Chotu has lost the money somewhere. Chotu blames Pappu for stealing his money which upsets Sureeli.

episodesList.title: Sureeli Breaks Up With Pappu
episodesList.summary: Mishri and her family begin to think about how to generate the money so that they can get through the month. Sureeli goes to Pappu and ends all ties with him.

episodesList.title: Mama Ki Chai Ki Dukaan
episodesList.summary: Mama opens a tea stall. Lalan Ji's wife decides to send their three daughters to Surili, for dance classes. Later, Surili lies when she is asked why she has been feeling low.

episodesList.title: Chotu Plays The Blame Game
episodesList.summary: Chotu mama opens a small tea stall to earn money, whereas Sureeli teaches dance to a few kids to generate money. After losing the next money order, Mama blames it on Mukundi.

episodesList.title: The Only School In Lapataganj Closes
episodesList.summary: Chotu mama takes his coat to Elija and asks him to stitch it back as he was the one to tear it. People in Lapataganj are shocked to learn that the only school in the village is shutting down forever.

episodesList.title: Vs Gumshudaganj
episodesList.summary: Mukundi gets very upset as the only school in Lapataganj closes. Everyone sit together and listen to the protest Mukundi has in his mind.

episodesList.title: Mukundi's Excellent Plan
episodesList.summary: Mukundi put up posters all over Lapataganj with the help of his fellow villagers. He then, openly challenges whosoever has done this, should come up if they have guts in them.

episodesList.title: Mukundi's Father-in-law
episodesList.summary: Mukundi is busy making his son do is homework. Then, suddenly, Bindubasini and Mukundi's father-in-law surprise him. But Mukundi is not at all surprised to see them.

episodesList.title: The Kho-kho Competition
episodesList.summary: There is a Kho-Kho competition taking place between Lapataganj and Gumshudaganj ladies. Laptaganj is in the lead with only one player left, Bindumati. But mishap happens and Bindumati falls down. Will Lapataganj win this competition?

episodesList.title: Kabaddi Competition
episodesList.summary: It is time for a competition between the men. One side is the Lapataganj heroes and the other side are the Gumshudaganj heroes.

episodesList.title: Mishri's Prayer Worked
episodesList.summary: Mishri keeps on praying for the Lapataganj heroes so that they win the Kabaddi competition. By God's grace and everyone's hard work, Lapataganj wins and Sureeli comes running to tell her the news.

episodesList.title: Injured Bindumati
episodesList.summary: Bindumati is still in terrible pain after she hurt herself while playing Kho-Kho. Her mother-in-law asks Lallan to take care of her. He thinks Bindu should be taken to the city for a better treatment.

episodesList.title: Mircha In Pain
episodesList.summary: Lapataganj wins the game of "hide and seek" as nobody can find Chukundi, who is their sixteenth member. Mircha alone can defeat four men in "tug of war" but her hands get burnt.

episodesList.title: Question Of Winning
episodesList.summary: Mircha's condition doesn't stop the villagers from playing for Chukundi's school. The game is going well but suddenly Bacchi gets out and so arises the question of Lapataganj winning.

episodesList.title: Leads
episodesList.summary: Lapataganj is almost on the verge of losing the game as Mukundi is alone on one side of the rope. But a miracle happens and Lapataganj wins the game of tug of war.

episodesList.title: Chukundi's School Resumes
episodesList.summary: Lapataganj donates three lakhs for Chukundi's school. Mukundi leaves for two days but Lallan arrives. The villagers are irritated with the extreme heat and wish for rain.

episodesList.title: The Unbearable Heat
episodesList.summary: Chotu can't hide his feelings for Chameli. Chukundi has got heat rashes and Indu is tensed about him while awaiting Mukundi's return. The food products are high-priced due to the scorching heat and Mircha faints while fetching food.

episodesList.title: Mircha has Heat Stroke
episodesList.summary: The villagers struggle to pick up Mircha but finally, she regains consciousness. One Baba tells them that it will rain in an hour and rather fools them of their money.

episodesList.title: When It Rains
episodesList.summary: Lapataganj assembles to decide a way out, but Chukundi's idea actually clicks in. Finally, it rains in their village and the residents enjoy their snacks.

episodesList.title: Season Of Monsoon
episodesList.summary: Lapataganj is happy but the few miss their other halves. So Sureeli plans to make them happy and engage them in the togetherness of monsoon.

episodesList.title: Sugandhi's Possessiveness
episodesList.summary: Chotu is upset that he couldn't see Chameli when she was leaving. Chukundi argues with Indu that he won't go to school when Sugandhi is in Lapataganj.

episodesList.title: Sugandhi Overreacts
episodesList.summary: The villagers tease Sugandhi when he goes to give Mukundi tiffin and Sugandhi gives it back rightly. Sugandhi starts panicking when Mukundi is late in returning.

episodesList.title: Every Fathers Fear
episodesList.summary: Chotu discusses with others about Mukundi's misbehaviour with his father and starts avoiding him. Mukundi returns home early and realizes Chukundi is missing.

episodesList.title: Lallan Takes Bribes
episodesList.summary: Bindu is back in Lapataganj and has recovered. Bindu tells Indu that Lallan takes bribes. Suttilal gets stuck with Lallan as his papers are not clear.

episodesList.title: Lallan Gets Exposed
episodesList.summary: The whole village talks about Lallan taking bribes. Mukundi confronts Lallan but he takes it lightly. Soon, he gets caught while taking bribe.

episodesList.title: Raid At Lallans House
episodesList.summary: The officials raid at Lallan's house and make a list of essentials he has got through his bribe money. Lallan hides in shame and Bindu explains him to change his ways.

episodesList.title: Unlimited Friendship
episodesList.summary: Lallan takes a new step in his life and announces it in the village. Chotu is scared of dogs and Elija saves him. Chotu and Elija discuss their friendship and get nostalgic.

episodesList.title: Elija Gets a Customer
episodesList.summary: After a long time, Elija gets a customer who asks him to take his measurements. Elija gets super excited and gets into business. After taking all the measurements, the customer says he does not want to get anything tailored. What could possibly be the reason?

episodesList.title: A Piece Of Advise
episodesList.summary: Mamaji and Elija plan to start a business together by selling Elija's aunts chain. But they are shocked to know the truth. They are advised to take loan from the bank and start the business.

episodesList.title: Mama and Elija's New Shop
episodesList.summary: Mama and Elija have opened a new shop. The preparations for the opening are in full swing. What happens when the shop owner tells them that they cannot continue with their plan?

episodesList.title: Sonamals Epic Wecome
episodesList.summary: Sonamal gets welcomed in Lapataganj in an epic way. People tie a fire-cracker along with his pajamas string. And as soon as they light it up, he loses his calm and starts running from one place to another. Everyone laughs while watching him.

episodesList.title: Mamaji and Elija's Partnership
episodesList.summary: Mamaji asks Elija to learn lessons from him for their partnership. And Mamaji explains him their partnership and how they should work together by performing a dance.

episodesList.title: Lallan and Mamas Fight
episodesList.summary: Mama gets into an ugly fight with Lallan as he did not give money for the things he purchased from mama. He starts yelling at him and the whole Lapataganj gathers around. The fight continues to take an ugly turn.

episodesList.title: Indumati Returns to Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Mukundi receives Indumati and brings her back home. She is excited and is surprised to see the changes in Lapataganj. Meanwhile, Lallan starts yelling at Mukundi this time for his money.

episodesList.title: Friends Turn Into Enemies
episodesList.summary: Certain arguments lead to a fight between Mamaji and Elija. The start throwing grocery items on each other and break down the store they started together. Mukundi reminds them of their ethics.

episodesList.title: A Girl Calls Mukundilal Her Father
episodesList.summary: Indumati and Mukundilal meet a young girl outside a temple, who follows them and calls Mukundilal her father. Mukundilal decides to drop her off where they found her, but the other people present there cause a commotion.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Mistaken Again
episodesList.summary: As soon as Mukundi is leaving that girl in the police station, he gets caught by one of the constables. He is asked to take her home with him and not to do this again. Mukundi decides to keep her with him till they find her parents.

episodesList.title: Mamaji In Big Trouble
episodesList.summary: As soon as Sureeli and Mishri come back home they see a girl lying down near Mamaji. They are shocked to see her. Sureeli finds a note that someone leaves for Mamaji.

episodesList.title: Lallanji Conned
episodesList.summary: Pappu and mamaji start having a fight for Samosa. The shop owner gets into trouble, till then the little girl comes and sorts it out. Later, they con Lallanji and eat samosas on his money.

episodesList.title: Against Policemen
episodesList.summary: As soon as everyone sees the policemen, they get concerned if they will have to give Bhagyalakshmi back. Unknowingly, everyone starts protesting against them that they will not hand over her to them.

episodesList.title: Everyone Craves For Mishris Sweets
episodesList.summary: Mishri has started preparing laddoos for kids and others. Indu comes to help her as everyone in Lapataganj loves her laddoos. Mamaji and Elija demand extra sweets to be made as they get finished very early.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Blames Indumati
episodesList.summary: Mukundi comes back home in full anger as he finds the pack of sweets to be empty. Without knowing the actual truth, he starts yelling at Indu and blames her for staeling someones sweets.

episodesList.title: Misunderstanding Prevails
episodesList.summary: Mishri calls Lallanji to talk about something. But he tries to hide his face for what he did. But both are talking about a different topic unknowingly and hence misunderstanding builds up.

episodesList.title: Ration Crisis
episodesList.summary: Mukundi investigates a resident and Indu gets upset that he is out late at night. Mukunda calls an assembly to talk about the smuggling of the ration.

episodesList.title: Putanis Letter
episodesList.summary: The villagers argue over who sent Putani the laddoos as he has written a letter to Mishri telling her about it. Lapataganj celebrates the twelfth anniversary of Lallan and Bindu.

episodesList.title: Black Market
episodesList.summary: Sugandhi talks about how to become self-sufficient. Mircha announces that there is a discount on ration. There is a long queue at the ration shop and the villagers start fighting. Mukundi finds one neighbour smuggling their ration.

episodesList.title: Mishris Special Laddoo
episodesList.summary: Chotu is upset as he didnt even share of the laddoos that Mishri prepared. Mukundi asks help from Chotu to convince Mishri.

episodesList.title: Self Sufficiency
episodesList.summary: Mukundi plots to find out the ration smuggling result but Indu's misunderstanding stops him. Together, the residents of Lapataganj catch the culprit and put an end to the black market.

episodesList.title: Bhaag Elija Bhaag
episodesList.summary: Elija gets into trouble with the relatives of a goon. The goon sends men to find Elija. Elija and Mama get beaten up in front of all the people.

episodesList.title: Sureeli's Fan
episodesList.summary: Sureeli slaps a boy, who is Thakurs brother and he decides to marry her. Singaraganjs Thakur, Bhanu Pratap arrives at Lapataganj to arrange this wedding and the villagers misunderstand.

episodesList.title: Gyaanis Weird Problem
episodesList.summary: Thakur and his brother, Gyaani enter Lapataganj and start creating a fuss. Thakur tells everyone about Gyaanis weird problem of whistling after finish any sentence.

episodesList.title: Pappu's Law Degree
episodesList.summary: Pappu goes to the law college to get his degree certificate. He gets very happy to receive it and starts wondering that this not just a law degree certificate, it is a certificate which will make him get married to Sureeli.

episodesList.title: Angry Sureeli
episodesList.summary: Sureeli gets very angry when everybody says a no for her and Pappu's marriage. She stops eating dinner, Mishri tries to make her understand what is good for her.

episodesList.title: Sureeli On Cloud Nine
episodesList.summary: Sureeli is extremely happy and on cloud nine when Mishri and Mamaji agree on what Sureeli wants. Bindumati comes and both of them share their feelings. Sureeli dreams about herself and Pappu together.

episodesList.title: Elija Teases Suttilaal
episodesList.summary: Elija teases Sutilaal and Mircha Bhabhi and reminds them old days. he keeps insisting Mirja Bhabhi to tell him how she impressed Suttilaal so that he can take that tip and impress some other girl.

episodesList.title: Mishri and Mamaji Threatened
episodesList.summary: Thakur sends his men to threaten Mishri and her family as they said a no for the marriage. Mishri loses her calm and gets scared. Mamaji asks her to wait till morning and then they will asks everyone.

episodesList.title: The Family Lodges a Complaint
episodesList.summary: Surili meets an unexpected guest as she stares out of the bus window. Surili feels weak since she has not eaten anything for a while. On the other hand, Surili's family members are worried about her and lodge a complaint with the police.

episodesList.title: Sureeli and Pappu Run Away
episodesList.summary: Sureeli and Pappu decide to run away from Lapatagnaj as everyone was against them. They come running to a hilltop and decide to make their house their and stay together happily.

episodesList.title: Mamajis Truth Revealed
episodesList.summary: Thakur Singh comes back in Lapataganj and is very angry. Firstly, he asks Mamaji nicely but then yells at him for not saying the truth. He threatens him that he will have to pay for lying to him.

episodesList.title: Mishri and Mamaji Threatened
episodesList.summary: Gabbu Pandey enters Lapataganj in a rickshaw but he does not have the change to give. Then he asks Suttilaal to give the rickshaw person money. He starts with his false philosophy and ends up giving no one their money, as usual.

episodesList.title: Letter From Pappu
episodesList.summary: Finally, Pappu sends a letter to Mishri and mamaji. They ask Mukundi to read it and let them know what is their status. Mishri starts to panic and becomes restless to know what is there in the letter.

episodesList.title: Mishri Loses All Her Calm
episodesList.summary: Mishri does not keep calm as Sureeli is not back home yet. She plans to go and find her anywhere and so packs her bag and is ready to leave. But then Indumati comes and asks her to calm down as Mukundi has already gone to find her.

episodesList.title: Vs Thakur and His Brothers
episodesList.summary: Thakur gets to know that Sureeli is back with Pappu in lapataganj. He comes along with his brothers to take back Sureeli. One after the other everyone starts protecting Sureeli and Pappu.

episodesList.title: Thakurs New Plan
episodesList.summary: Gyaani keeps crying all day long as he cannot stand Sureeli and Pappu together. He begs to Thakur, his brother, to do something or it will be late and Sureeli will get married to Pappu. What will Thakur plan now?

episodesList.title: Pappu Fights Like a Hero
episodesList.summary: As Pappu was about to leave to give the hard-earned money to Mishri, Gyaani and his men stop him and does not let him go. Watch how bravely Pappu fights all the goons and Gyaani.

episodesList.title: The Antaakshari Game
episodesList.summary: Everything ends on a good note and every member of the Lapataganj family is happy. They sit for a competition where they have to sing with the last alphabet is given to them. Everyone is enjoying and are competitive at the same moment.

episodesList.title: Kachua Chachas Protest
episodesList.summary: Kachua Chacha stands on the middle of Lapataganj dressed as Anna and protests against corruption. He tries to influence other people by telling them what is going in the country.

episodesList.title: Celebrations have Started
episodesList.summary: It is time that Pappu and Sureeli are going to get married to each other. The whole of Lapataganj is decorated and the Hadli function has started.

episodesList.title: Indumati Scares Mukundi
episodesList.summary: Indumati starts running from here and there in the house, trying to hide from Mukundi. She starts blushing when Mukundi comes near her to ask something. What could be the news that scared Mukundi so much.

episodesList.title: Men In Disguise
episodesList.summary: All men could not control themselves from not entering the ladies function. So instead they wear saree and do some make-up and enter the function. Watch what happens when they get caught.

episodesList.title: Elija Finds The Solution
episodesList.summary: Pappu's father says that they want to bear the weddings expenses. But Mishri does not agree to it and says that she will bear the expenses as it is her daughters wedding. Both of them start fighting, so Elija comes up with a perfect solution.

episodesList.title: Pappu Weds Sureeli
episodesList.summary: Pappu is mesmerised seeing Sureeli as his bride. After so much chaos, they finally tie the knot and get married to each other.

episodesList.title: Sureeli Misses Her Father
episodesList.summary: Sureeli is extremely upset after receiving her father's letter which states the reason why he wouldn't be able to attend her wedding. Pappu and Sureeli then get busy with their post-wedding festivities.

episodesList.title: Pappu Leaves Without Surili
episodesList.summary: A dance face off takes place between the boys and girls. Pappu finally gets his shoes back from the girls. Pappu had to leave to his house without Surili, after the wedding.

episodesList.title: Pappu Visits Surili
episodesList.summary: Pappu returns to his house upset, and cries to Guddu. He decides to visit Surili the very next day. The contractor who organized the wedding comes to collect money from Pappu's father.

episodesList.title: Mishri Mausis Vows
episodesList.summary: When Pappu goes to meet Surili he mimicks a dog to indicate his arrival to Surili. Mukundi who is upset ove a fight with Indumati, expresses his concerns to Lallan and Bindu.

episodesList.title: Duniya Returns to Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Pappu's father fools the constables saying he is very influential. Guddu is upset and leaves the house. Duniya returns to Lapataganj after receiving a letter from Guddu.

episodesList.title: Pappu's Confession
episodesList.summary: The people of Lapataganj are shocked to see Guddu with another lady. Pappu confesses to have written the letter to Duniya. They thank the lord for his miracles and for reuniting Guddu and Duniya.

episodesList.title: Pappu Bails Out His Father
episodesList.summary: Chotu is shocked to see Lallan involved in prayer like never before. Pappu goes to the police station to bail out his father as his lawyer. Mishri mausi returns to Lapataganj without Surili.

episodesList.title: Mukundi to The Rescue
episodesList.summary: Chotu asks his friends to answer a general riddle. He decides that Mukundi is the smartest. Elija distributes the kulfi that he made. Mukundi saves everyone from the shock received from the fridge.

episodesList.title: Chameli Back In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Lallan returns to Lapataganj with Chameli. Chotu is excited with Chamelis return. Chotu cant take his eyes off Chameli. Chotu shoos away Chotu and the others who keep an eye on Chameli.

episodesList.title: Chotus Wish to Marry Chameli
episodesList.summary: Chotu eagerly waits for Chameli. He informs Mishri that he wants to marry Chameli. Mukundi, Mishri mausi and Elija visit Lallan to talk about Chotu and Chamelis wedding.

episodesList.title: Chotu The Bodyguard
episodesList.summary: Chotu becomes Chameli bodyguard to keep her safe and sound. He escorts her to the temple. Lallan appoints ten bodyguards for himself. Chotu challenges them to whistle the way he does.

episodesList.title: The New Saree Store In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Mukundi is excited as his wife, Indumati is returning to Lapataganj. He prepares tea for Indumati. Bindu takes Indumati with her to visit the new saree store.

episodesList.title: Fight Over Saree
episodesList.summary: The ladies fight over the pending saree gift from their husbands. Pappu gets money as advance for a case and share with Guddu.

episodesList.title: Best Gift In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: The men buy sarees for their better halves by paying almost five times more as the seller dupes them. The women engage in a competition of dressing up the best.

episodesList.title: Culprit In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Chaurasias long term friend arrives at Lapataganj while evading the police. He overhears Mukundi's conversation with the jeweller. Pappu helps Mishri in running errands.

episodesList.title: Thief In Mukundi's House
episodesList.summary: Mukundi announces in front of his neighbors about buying gold earrings for Indu. After the dinner at Mukundi's place, the new guest attempts a robbery.

episodesList.title: Drama On Ramleela
episodesList.summary: Lapataganj is excited for the Ramleela play and starts practicing the characters. Suttilal is stuck in his character of Maharaja Janak and Lallan expresses how lucky is he to have daughters.

episodesList.title: Fight Over Bottle Gourd
episodesList.summary: The play on Ramleela happens successfully, even though, Indu and Mukundi were fighting. The whole village eavesdrops their argument and tries to sort it out.

episodesList.title: Father's Order
episodesList.summary: Sugandhi impresses the villagers with his satirical acting and generates more funds. What will happen when Chukundi forgets to bring the soap Mukundi asked him to get for Sugandhi?

episodesList.title: Pappu's Revenge
episodesList.summary: Mircha requests Suttilal for giving food on loan to Pappu, who is depressed. Mishri performs well as Surpanakha but Pappu is adamant about taking his revenge from her.

episodesList.title: Ramleela In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Ramleela has been organised in Lapataganj and everybody dresses up as different characters. Mamaji and Lallanji go against each other to play their respective roles.

episodesList.title: The War Continues
episodesList.summary: Ramleela act continues as they portray the story. The audience enjoys as it is wartime and everyone playfully hit each other to get in character.

episodesList.title: Husband Problems
episodesList.summary: Mukundi gets up from his nap and does not find Indumati anywhere. He is glad not to find her as he will not have to listen to Indu's rants. But Then Lallanji comes and he gets upset.

episodesList.title: Pappu Gets Slapped
episodesList.summary: While getting down of the train, Pappu hugs Sureeli and gets all romantic. But then he gets slapped as the woman he is hugging is not Sureeli. Pappu gets embarrassed as everyone is looking at him.

episodesList.title: Pappu Apologizes to Bhabau Singh
episodesList.summary: Pappu mistakenly hugs T.T. Bhabausinghs wife. Later he apologizes to Bhabausingh and pleads him to not keep any grudges. He later tells him that he will be going to Mumbai in the same train and that they should keep harmony among themselves.

episodesList.title: Bomb In The Train
episodesList.summary: There is a bomb in the train and everyone gets to know about it. There is chaos as everyone is in panic. Indumati starts crying as she does not want to die. How will everyone get out of this situation?

episodesList.title: On The Way to Mumbai
episodesList.summary: Elija and Chotu miss the train to Mumbai. While finding a way out, they find Sureeli and Pappu also stranded on Laxmanghat station. On realising a shop has similar clothes as Chotu does, they manage to catch the thief that sells their bag.

episodesList.title: Finally Mumbai
episodesList.summary: Chotu and Elija finally come out there hiding. The truck driver agrees to take them to the next station, Igatpuri. The villagers give a surprise to Mishris husband.

episodesList.title: Life At a Resort
episodesList.summary: The villagers are on an emotional rollercoaster to stay at the resort. The couples enjoying themselves but Sureeli leaves Mishris room at late night.

episodesList.title: What is a Pool?
episodesList.summary: Pappu and Sureeli spend some time alone but Pappu is annoyed with Mishris decision on delaying. The women are confused to see a swimming pool at their resort.

episodesList.title: Mumbai Experience
episodesList.summary: Lapataganj residents travel around Mumbai and experience different and newer aspects of life. They indulge in variety of food and sea bathing.

episodesList.title: The Real Reel
episodesList.summary: Lapataganj residents gear up for the witnessing the shoot. Indu's act scares Mukundi and Bindu. Pappu plans to spend time with Sureeli and convinces Guddu.

episodesList.title: The Cake Fight
episodesList.summary: Shooting begins but the heroine is forgetful of her dialogues so Indu interrupts which starts a fight between the heroine and her. On apologising, the film crew selects Indu as their new cast.

episodesList.title: Departure From Mumbai
episodesList.summary: Indu rejects the plea on Mukundi's choice but gets upset. Lapataganj residents feel heavy-hearted as they have to leave and coax Mishris husband to come along with them.

episodesList.title: Dumb Goon
episodesList.summary: The Bhais of Mumbai arrive at the resort to have a word of resolvement with Mishris husband. The villagers tackle it and board the train on time.

episodesList.title: Elija's Rani
episodesList.summary: Mirchas sister, Rani arrives at Lapataganj. Pappu threatens Mishri and Chotu for keeping Sureeli apart. Rani plans to get closer to Elija but he is perplexed.

episodesList.title: Chotu Cries In Pain
episodesList.summary: Chotu mama is cries in pain as Mishri applies a hot pack on him. Mukundi is surprised to see Indu return from her parents house in a week.

episodesList.title: Elija's 35th Birthday
episodesList.summary: It is Elija's 35th birthday and he starts missing his mother as Indu wishes him birthday just like her. People in Lapataganj try to make his birthday as memorable as possible.

episodesList.title: Rani Tries to Help Elija
episodesList.summary: Rani claims to be Elija's wife in front of the lawyer. Even though all the people stand by Ranis word, Elija reveals the truth saying Rani isnt his wife.

episodesList.title: Elija Stands By His Decision
episodesList.summary: The fellow villagers at Suttilals shop try to talk Elija into not getting married but his decision of marrying Rani remains stern.

episodesList.title: Mukundi is Too Busy
episodesList.summary: Indu is upset with Mukundi as he is too buy to take her out for a movie. Elija decides to meet Ranis parents and take Indu along with him.

episodesList.title: Indu Doubts Mukundi
episodesList.summary: Indu cries in front of Mishri as she finds two movie tickets from his pocket. Mishri suggests Indu gives Mukundi unconditional love so that he never thinks about any other woman.

episodesList.title: Indu Humiliates Mukundi
episodesList.summary: Happy with his work, Mukundi's boss lets him leave for home early. As soon as he reaches his house, Indu is waiting for him with the movie tickets she found in his pocket.

episodesList.title: The Villagers Approach an Exorcist
episodesList.summary: Chotu mama's word becomes more powerful when three other people from Lapataganj see the witch. They call an exorcist to get rid of the witch from their village.

episodesList.title: Chotu to Leave Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: The witch tells Chotu that he made a mistake calling the exorcist and that it has upset her even more. Mukundi suggests Chotu mama leaves Lapataganj to eliminate such thoughts from his head.

episodesList.title: Pappu Tastes His Own Medicine
episodesList.summary: Pappu and Guddu are petrified when the witch talks about taking them with her. Mukundi and Elija then reveal that it was their plan to teach Pappu a lesson.

episodesList.title: Duniya Welcomes Her Friend
episodesList.summary: Duniya is extremely happy as she receives a letter from her friend, Gudia saying she is coming to visit her. While Guddu's father yells at him, Gudia sees him getting humiliated.

episodesList.title: Duniya Wants Guddu to Leave Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Chotu and Elija make fun of Lallan as he fails to answer any riddles they throw at him. Learning that Guddu again went to meet Pappu against her wish, she asks him to leave Lapataganj and move to Kanpur with her parents.

episodesList.title: Duniya Refuses to Eat
episodesList.summary: Duniya refuses to eat anything until Guddu agrees to leave Lapataganj. Bindu asks Lallan to find a job for Guddu so that he does not have to leave Lapataganj.

episodesList.title: Guddus Farewell
episodesList.summary: Pappu along with the entire village bid Guddu farewell, before he leaves for Kanpur with Duniya. As they are about to leave, Duniya's father arrives at Lapataganj.

episodesList.title: Bindu Kicks Lallan Out Of The House
episodesList.summary: Lallan and Bindu get into a heated argument after which she kicks him out of the house. Mukundi asks Indu to talk to Bindu and resolve her fight with Lallan.

episodesList.title: Lallan Moves Into Mukundi's House
episodesList.summary: Lallan has a hard time finishing the household chores without Bindu. The next morning, Lallan arrives at Mukundi's house with his luggage and decides to stay with him.

episodesList.title: Bindu Refuses to Forgive Lallan
episodesList.summary: Mishri and other women ask Bindu to forgive Lallan and go back to her house. Even though Lallan tries to apologize to Bindu, she refuses to forgive him.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: Indu starts crying in front of the villagers when Mukundi does not return home till late in the night. Mukundi, after returning, reveals that he stayed the night in an abandoned house to avoid sleeping with Lallan's snores.

episodesList.title: Chotus Statement Hurts Sutti Lal
episodesList.summary: Sutti Lal overhears Chotu's statements against him and warns Pudina not to lend Chotu anything. Sutti Lal is fuming in anger because Chotu lied to him.

episodesList.title: Chotu Gets Arrested
episodesList.summary: Guddu tells Pappu that Duniya doesn't want to see them together. While Duniya arrives at Sutti Lal's stall, Guddu and Pappu hide from her. The police arrest Chotu.

episodesList.title: Chotus Truth is Out
episodesList.summary: After Chotu gets arrested, Mukundi along with the others, goes to the station to bail him out. Biji Pandey aka Pappu, visits the station to bail out Chotu.

episodesList.title: Mukundi's Missing Bicycle
episodesList.summary: Mukundi wakes up early to polish his bicycle and make it shine. Indumati is excited as she is going for the fair with Mukundi. Mukundi realises that his cycle is missing.

episodesList.title: Indumati Consoles Mukundi
episodesList.summary: Indumati is upset and angry because Mukundi returns home late and because of him she couldn't go for the fair. Everyone is shocked to learn that Mukundi's cycle is missing.

episodesList.title: Indumatis Prayers For Her Husband
episodesList.summary: Mukundi is worried thinking about his cycle. Indumati stands on leg and prays to god hoping that her husband's cycle will be found sooner.

episodesList.title: Mukundi's Bicycle is Found
episodesList.summary: Lallan buys the cycle from the man who stole from Mukundi without being aware of it. Indumati notices that the cycle which Lallan gets, is infact, Mukundi's cycle.

episodesList.title: Indumati Recognizes Mukundi's Cycle
episodesList.summary: While Indumati recognizes her husband's cycle, he pretends not to. Pappu, Guddu, and Chotu mama visit Mukundi at night. Indumati and Bindu get into and argument again.

episodesList.title: Mamajis Fathers Stories
episodesList.summary: Mamaji sits with his gang in Suttilals shop and has a gala time. They all praise him for making them laugh. Then Mamaji tells them stories about his father how he also used to make everyone laugh.

episodesList.title: Robbery At Lallans House
episodesList.summary: This time it is Lallanjis cycle that gets stolen. Bindumati witnesses it and informs Lallanji about it. He gets shocked as for how can someone steal his cycle. On the contrary, Indu finds a cycle in her porch. What is the matter?
