episodesList.title: The Cycle Truth is Out
episodesList.summary: Indumati decorates the cycle as she is happy to get it back. But Bindumati claims that it is their cycle. Mishri supports Indumati as she knows it is their cycle. Everyone asks the stranger to tell the truth.

episodesList.title: Mishri Mausi Shocked At Chotus Behaviour
episodesList.summary: Chotu along with a friend go to meet Shanti who they refer to as a sanyasi. Chotu wants to attain sanyas and gain peace, when he returns home, Mishri mausi is shocked at his behaviour.

episodesList.title: Mishris Unending Concern
episodesList.summary: Mukundi comes back home from the office and relaxes until Mishri comes running asking for help. She is concerned as Chotu is not behaving normally. Mishri starts being superstitious.

episodesList.title: Irritating Mamaji
episodesList.summary: Mamaji decides to take renunciation and calls up a local meeting with the villagers. Everyone starts getting irritated as he is protesting for everyone to follow his path.

episodesList.title: Chotu Becomes a Sanyaas
episodesList.summary: People of Lapataganj are shocked looking at Chotu trying to be a sanyaasi. Elija and the others also follow Chotu's steps in becoming a sanyaasi.

episodesList.title: Mishri Out Of Control
episodesList.summary: Chotu, Elija, and two other villagers, have finally thought of going to a sacred place, out of daily life. Mishri starts to panic and goes out of control. Mukundi has lost all hope in Mamaji.

episodesList.title: Lohri Celebrations In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Shanti Lal and his wife arrive in Lapataganj. Chotu fails to recognize Shanti Lal. The people of Lapataganj celebrate Lohri with Shanti Lal and his wife.

episodesList.title: Medical Camp In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: There is a free medical camp happening in Lapataganj. Mishri takes Surili with her to visit the doctor at the camp. The doctor informs them that Surili is likely to get her voice back.

episodesList.title: Mishri Mausi Wins a Prize
episodesList.summary: Mishri mausi wins a prize. Mukundi spots Pappu and Guddu going for a movie. Guddu visits Mishri mausi's house. Suttilal gets worried seeing Radhe walk towards his stall.

episodesList.title: Chotu Fails to Get Money
episodesList.summary: A sewing machine vendor comes to Lapataganj selling his company's products and Elija seems interested. Chotu goes to collect Mishri's money but doesn't get it. Radhe again visits Suttilal.

episodesList.title: Surili Gives Pappu The Good News
episodesList.summary: Guddu visits Chotu in Lapataganj. Guddu meets Surili and spends time with her. Pappu gets excited as he learns that Surili might get her voice back.

episodesList.title: Lallan Tries to Borrow Money
episodesList.summary: Lallan and Mukundi fall off the cycle. Chotu, yet again, leaves the office without getting Mishri mausi's money and meets the minister regarding the same.

episodesList.title: A Call For Mishri Mausi
episodesList.summary: Mishri mausi along with the people of Lapataganj, visits the officer who has to give them money. Mausi gets a call from the nurse saying they will prepare for Surili's operation.

episodesList.title: Contribution For Sureeli's Operation
episodesList.summary: Mishri starts crying as she tells her fellow villagers that she needs one lakh rupees to get Sureeli operated for her to speak again. People in Lapataganj decide to contribute as much as they can for Sureeli's operation.

episodesList.title: Sureeli Loses All Hope
episodesList.summary: People in Lapataganj try their best to raise money for Sureeli's operation. After learning that the money has to be deposited in the hospital within a week, Sureeli loses all hope.

episodesList.title: Lallan Gets Robbed
episodesList.summary: Chotu mama tells Elija that he is planning to rob someone in order to raise money for Sureeli's operation. In the night, both of them mug Lallan after his salary day.

episodesList.title: Mishri Beats Chotu Up
episodesList.summary: Mishri beats Chotu up after she learns that he was the one to mug Lallan. Elija explains the reason behind Chotu's wrongdoing which makes everyone in Lapataganj emotional.

episodesList.title: Kundan Challenges Pappu
episodesList.summary: Mishri apologizes to Chotu for hurting him. Kundan Singh Kushwaha challenges Pappu openly in front of everyone and announces a fight after three days in Lapataganj.

episodesList.title: Pappu Starts Training
episodesList.summary: Mukundi's father arrives in Lapataganj to give Pappu tips for how to fight. After a lot of bargain, he starts training Pappu for the fight.

episodesList.title: Appu Deals With Pain
episodesList.summary: Pappu suffers various injuries and pain while training for the fight. The day of the fight arrives, and everyone in Lapataganj roots for Pappu and motivates him.

episodesList.title: The Fight Day
episodesList.summary: Kundan Singh and Pappu begin their fight with the wooden strip and it is a close competition. In the process, Pappu gets hurt terribly and starts bleeding.

episodesList.title: Pappu Defeats Kundan Singh
episodesList.summary: As Pappu defeats Kundan Singh, the entire village of Lapataganj jumps with joy and excitement. Sureeli and her family then leave for Lucknow to get her operated.

episodesList.title: The Operation is Successful
episodesList.summary: Sureeli is admitted to the hospital and soon taken to the operation theatre. After the operation, the doctor tells the family that Sureeli will begin to talk, but gradually.

episodesList.title: Pappu to Move In With Sureeli
episodesList.summary: People in Lapataganj celebrate the happiness of Sureeli's successful operation. Mishri is so happy with Pappu that she allows him to move into their house and live with them.

episodesList.title: Sureeli Opposes Pappu's Actions
episodesList.summary: Pappu is on cloud nine when he gets to spend time with Sureeli. Mishri opposes Pappu romancing Sureeli and stops him every time he touches Sureeli.

episodesList.title: An Ancient Object
episodesList.summary: A few people, while digging up a spot in Lapataganj, find an ancient statue. When an archeologist comes and examines the statue, it is found to be of great importance.

episodesList.title: Mukundi and Indu Become Homeless
episodesList.summary: In order to find the missing part of the statue, the archeologist plans to dig Mukundi's house up. Mukundi and Indu become homeless as all their belongings are removed from their house.

episodesList.title: Pappu Befriends Mr Chedi
episodesList.summary: Mukundi overhears the labours talk about how Mr. Chedi has been getting random places dug for years. Pappu acts friendly with Mr. Chedi to get the truth out from him.

episodesList.title: The Missing Part
episodesList.summary: After Mr. Chedi finds the missing part, he is on cloud nine. Pappu calls the media in Lapataganj to cover this story.

episodesList.title: Indu's Mother Falls Ill
episodesList.summary: Mukundi and Indu are relieved to be finally back in their house and live every moment. As Indu's mother is ill, Indu goes to visit her for two days.

episodesList.title: Mircha Loses Her Memory
episodesList.summary: After Mircha trips and falls unconscious, a doctor comes to check her up. Once she wakes up, she seems to have forgotten everything and starts acting like a kid.

episodesList.title: Elija Romances Rani
episodesList.summary: People in Lapataganj try to get Mircha's memory back by reminding her of various things. Elija takes advantage of the situation and romances her sister. Rani.

episodesList.title: Mircha Plays With Kids
episodesList.summary: Mircha plays around with all the kids in Lapataganj. The cops feel that Suttilal have been troubling Mircha and arrest him.

episodesList.title: Suttilal Gets a Bail
episodesList.summary: People in Lapataganj blame Chotu mama for Mircha and Suttilals condition. They then go to the police station to get Suttilal out of the lock up.

episodesList.title: Mircha Regains Her Memory
episodesList.summary: Chotu is filled with remorse and decides to take care of Mircha. While playing, Mircha faints and when she wakes up, she regains her memory.

episodesList.title: Suttilal Distributes Sweets
episodesList.summary: Suttilal distributes sweets in Lapataganj in the joy of Mircha regaining her memory. Pappu is scared seeing Sureeli and wonders what he would do if she loses her memory.

episodesList.title: Mishri Stands Between Pappu and Sureeli
episodesList.summary: Mishri asks Sureeli and Pappu to maintain distance. She then adds that Sureeli cannot live with Pappu unless her father comes and visits them.

episodesList.title: Pappu Kidnaps Sureeli
episodesList.summary: Pappu and Guddu cover themselves and enter Mishris house with an intention to kidnap Sureeli. Mishri and other villagers are worried as Sureeli is nowhere to be seen.

episodesList.title: Mishri Worries For Sureeli
episodesList.summary: The cops come to Lapataganj and investigate everyone closely to find out who is responsible for Sureeli's abduction. Sureeli is kept in a secluded room with her mouth and hands tied.

episodesList.title: Pappu and Guddu Rethink Their Decision
episodesList.summary: Pappu covers his face and changes his voice while feeding Sureeli. Pappu and Guddu are nervous seeing how big of a deal Sureeli's abduction has become.

episodesList.title: Sureeli is Missed
episodesList.summary: Mishri and other villagers try and do the best they can in order to get Sureeli back. Sureeli is stunned to see that Pappu is the one who kidnapped her.

episodesList.title: Pappu Loses Sureeli
episodesList.summary: Seeing the people in Lapataganj worry about Sureeli, Pappu is filled with remorse. All of them are taken aback when he tells them that he had kidnapped Sureeli but now he has lost her.

episodesList.title: Sureeli Comes Back
episodesList.summary: Pappu attempts to hang himself in front of the people of Lapataganj as he is unable to take the pain. As soon as he tries to do it, he sees Sureeli and stops.

episodesList.title: Bhagyalaxmi does Indu Proud
episodesList.summary: Indu is extremely happy after Bhagyalaxmi tells her that she has won an essay competition in her school. Indu goes around the village praising her daughter.

episodesList.title: Bhagyalaxmis Real Parents
episodesList.summary: Mukundi hides the fact that Bhagyalaxmis real parent shad come to take her. When Mukundi meets her real parents, he is stunned after seeing the evidence they have to show.

episodesList.title: Indu is Devastated
episodesList.summary: When Mukundi finally reveals the truth to Indu, she is devastated. She cries all day thinking about having a life without Bhagyalaxmi.

episodesList.title: Bhagyalaxmi Leaves Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Everyone in Lapataganj come together to celebrate Bhagyalaxmi's birthday and her last day with them. Indu and Mukundi bid her a farewell with a heavy heart.

episodesList.title: Distortion Of Facts
episodesList.summary: Chukundi refuses to eat unless he sees Bhagaylaxmi. After talking to Indu, Mukundi realizes that there has been a distortion of facts and reports it to the policeman immediately.

episodesList.title: Fake Parents
episodesList.summary: Indu and Mukundi along with the policemen track down Bhagyalaxmi and the cops arrest her fake parents. People in Lapataganj are extremely happy to see Bhagyalaxmi back in their village.

episodesList.title: Lallan Needs a Promotion
episodesList.summary: Lallan tells Bindu how desperately he wants a promotion as he might not get one for the next two years.

episodesList.title: Lallans Consolation Prize
episodesList.summary: Lallan faints when he learns that he has received a mixer grinder as a consolation prize. People in Lapataganj stand in a queue in front of Bindu's house to get various items grinded.

episodesList.title: Lallanji Misunderstands
episodesList.summary: A bank person comes to Lapataganj to give the notice. But he forgets the route Mishri told him and lands up in front of Lallanji's house. Lallanji misunderstands Mishri and does not stop yelling.

episodesList.title: Not a Good Day
episodesList.summary: Indu and Bindu have kept everything ready and are waiting for the men to come and then start the ceremony. But the men return with bad news. What is the bad news?

episodesList.title: Finally The Promotion
episodesList.summary: Finally, it is the day when Lallanji gets promoted and Mamaji brings the good news to Mishri. Lallanji invites everyone for celebrations.

episodesList.title: Mamajis Friendship
episodesList.summary: Mamaji gets up in the morning and leaves for a cup of tea with his friends. But instead, Mishri gets him the tea. He denies it as he wants to have it with his best friend, Elija and have some fun.

episodesList.title: Mamaji has Made The Decision
episodesList.summary: Mamaji has become self-obsessed and has firmly decided that he will get married for the third time. Mishri is unhappy with this decision and warns him to think all over again.

episodesList.title: Mamaji Mind-blown
episodesList.summary: A family comes to meet Mamaji and Mishri for Mamaji's marriage. Mamaji is very excited to see the girl and as soon as he sees her, he is mind-blown and wants to get married immediately.

episodesList.title: Denial Hits Hard
episodesList.summary: Mamaji loses his calm when he gets to know that the girl denied for marriage. He meets the girl's uncle who gives him the bitter truth that he is not a match for his niece.

episodesList.title: Things Turn Out Bad
episodesList.summary: Mamaji dreams about him and Chutki romancing and spending the best time. Everybody gets ready for the function, the next morning. They all keep waiting for the bride's side people to come, but no one turns up.

episodesList.title: Anything For Friendship
episodesList.summary: Mukundi and Mamaji spy on the people who denied for the marriage. They want to catch them and make them learn a lesson for whatever they did. With smartness, they plan a plot to get a hold of them.

episodesList.title: Ladies Talk
episodesList.summary: Mishri and Indumati are having a gala time with each other as they talk about Mamaji. They start laughing when they discuss if Mamaji still wants to get married.

episodesList.title: Chukundi Faints
episodesList.summary: Everyone is busy doing some or the other work in Lapataganj and suddenly Chukundi faints. Indumati starts crying and panics. What happened to Chukundi?

episodesList.title: Mukundi Prays For The Future
episodesList.summary: Elija and Mamaji are collecting donation money from people to make an umbrella for Hanuman Ji. Mukundi, on the other hand, prays for the betterment of childen and their education in Lapataganj.

episodesList.title: Happiness For All
episodesList.summary: Mukundi comes running back home with good news. He tells Chukundi and Indu that he will now be able to go back to school. This happened as Mamaji helped him by giving all the donation money.

episodesList.title: Bittoo Boss In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Lapatagnaj residents get excited when they see Bittoo Boss. Initially none recognised him, but later everyone started appraising them.

episodesList.title: Run, Elija Run
episodesList.summary: Mamaji makes Elija run a long way and he gets tired. Elija pleads him to stop, but he keeps running and asks him to run as well, as it good for the health and mind.

episodesList.title: Mukundi In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Mukundi is having a leisure when he suddenly remembers that he forgot to get ornaments for Indumati. When Indumati asks him about those earrings, he fails to reply.

episodesList.title: A Sting Operation?
episodesList.summary: Indumati is still angry with Mukundi and is not talking to him. Mukundi tries to woo her and uplift her mood, but it is a waste. A person comes with a hidden camera and records Mukundi and Indu's conversations.

episodesList.title: The Game Of Clone
episodesList.summary: Mukundi is against the builder's tactic of buying Lapataganj. So the builder abducts Mukundi and Churma Bhopali goes home in his place.

episodesList.title: Churma's Crisis
episodesList.summary: Churma struggles to play it cool at home and office. Indu is elated to find the earrings and doubts about Mukundi's indifferent behaviour.

episodesList.title: The Hidden Side
episodesList.summary: Churma's push up challenge leaves the whole village stunned. Guddu's father breaks down in front of Churma asking for his money back.

episodesList.title: In Threat
episodesList.summary: The villagers one by one agree to sell off their lands. Mukundi gets caught once again while trying to escape. Pickpocketer at the theatre threatens the villagers.

episodesList.title: Churma is Surrounded
episodesList.summary: Churma fights with the pickpockets and rescue back their lost money. Mukundi finally hears about his look-alike at Lapataganj. The whole village catches hold of Churma, who is trying to run away.

episodesList.title: Mukundi's Birthday
episodesList.summary: The villagers celebrate Mukundi's birthday by presenting Churma with different unique gifts. Mukundi, on the other hand, gets a cake from Govardhan.

episodesList.title: Change Of Fate
episodesList.summary: Churma brings the legal papers for their land. Lapataganj residents start dreaming about their better future. Govardhan tells Mukundi about the changing story of Lapataganj.

episodesList.title: Churma V/s Govardhan
episodesList.summary: The villagers are about to sign the papers, when Mukundi enters and exposes Govardhan. Churma makes a dynamic entry.

episodesList.title: Look-alikes Team Up
episodesList.summary: Mukundi and Churma tell their story and impress the residents of Lapataganj, but only Indu is able to recognise the real Mukundi. Elija wishes he too can have a wife like Chotu did.

episodesList.title: Elija's Perseverance
episodesList.summary: Elija is missing Rani but Mircha is still not agreeing to marry them off. Elija with help of his neighbours attempts to pursue Mircha.

episodesList.title: Gujarias Eyes
episodesList.summary: Mircha is infuriated with Elija's failed attempts and it only gets worse. Chameli arrives with her friend, Gujaria and Lallan is having sleepless nights.

episodesList.title: Widows Rule Over Lallan
episodesList.summary: Lallan is terrified with Gujaria and feels that Chameli is also helping her. He wishes that Gujaria gets married to Elija.

episodesList.title: Famous Tailor
episodesList.summary: Gujaria's unique way astonishes the Lapataganj residents. Elija has suddenly attained a fame and lot of customers arrive at his shop. Gujaria calls Elija for lunch and Chotu also joins in.

episodesList.title: Prospective Groom
episodesList.summary: Mircha and Lallan fight over feeding Elija for lunch. Finally, Lallan tells the villagers about Gujaria's reality and that Elija is a government recognised tailor.

episodesList.title: Quest For New Cycle
episodesList.summary: Mukundi needs to buy a new cycle but is comptemplating it. Bhagyalaxmi announces that Chukundi got selected in a recitation competition.

episodesList.title: Chotus Competition
episodesList.summary: Chukundi is keeping away the change he should return back. Chotu and Chukundi compete on instant rhymes. Pappu plots against Chotu's love story.

episodesList.title: Chukundi is The Winner
episodesList.summary: Mukundi is tensed to find money in Chukundi's pocket. Chukundi wins the competition and brings laddoo for his family.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Questions Chukundi
episodesList.summary: Chukundi starts sweating when Mukundi asks him what he was doing near the lottery man. Mukundi learns that Chukundi has received a thousand rupees from the minister.

episodesList.title: Chukundi Blamed For Gambling
episodesList.summary: Mukundi is so angry that he pushes Chukundi out of the house. The people in Lapataganj are shocked to hear that Chukundi has started gambling.

episodesList.title: Chotu Mesmerized By Chameli
episodesList.summary: Chotu Mama is mesmerized after seeing Chameli and soon faints due to the injury on his forehead. Indu shares her wish of visiting Singapore to Mukundi.

episodesList.title: Indumatis Singapore Dream
episodesList.summary: Indumati keeps jumping around from here to there in happiness. Chukundi asks the reason for her happiness and she finally breaks the news of her going to Singapore with Mukundi.

episodesList.title: Pappu's Advice to Chameli
episodesList.summary: Chameli tries to comfort Mamaji but does not get any response. Instead when Elija comforts him, he readily accepts it. Seeing this, Chameli gets upset and then Pappu gives her the best advice.

episodesList.title: Lallanji Gets Angry
episodesList.summary: Chameli does not stop cying. Lallanji comes yelling that Chameli has left him helpless and that he cannot show his face to anyone. He gets upset as Chameli wrote that letter to Mamaji.

episodesList.title: Chamelis Philosophy Backfired
episodesList.summary: Chameli's stupid friend, Duniya, asks her to throw the plant again on Mamaji so that he gets his memory back. Everyone starts screaming for applying this philosophy without using brain.

episodesList.title: Lallan Doubts Chotu
episodesList.summary: Chotu expresses his feelings to Chameli. Lallan and Pappu bargain on the damage amount. Lallan tells the villagers he has fixed Chameli's marriage.

episodesList.title: Case On Pandey
episodesList.summary: Chotu revolts in his original form against Chameli's marriage. Elija and Chotu has to apologise to Lallan for their misdeeds. The doctor gets extremely irritated at Pappu for forging the case.

episodesList.title: Ration Tension
episodesList.summary: Indu is tensed and is adamant to suffice the month with the ration. The whole village buys ration in plenty as they find it inexpensive.

episodesList.title: Indu's Savings
episodesList.summary: Indu has lunch at Mishri's house and avoids spending too much ration to fulfil her plan of saving money. Mukundi is bored of having brinjals and now wants bitter guard.

episodesList.title: Indu Helps Elija
episodesList.summary: Bhagyalaxmi wants to have mango and Indu gets tensed as it is expensive. Indu decides to avoid washing clothes every alternate day. Lallan arrives at their place to have breakfast.

episodesList.title: Elija is Proud Of Indu
episodesList.summary: Indu helps Elija when his cousin sister's prospective groom comes to see her. Indu finally opens up about using up all her ration to treat the guests.

episodesList.title: Letters to Lover
episodesList.summary: Chameli hates Chotu and so he gets depressed. Gujaria wants to meet and know about Elija's whereabouts. Chotu sends a letter to Chameli and leaves her confused.

episodesList.title: Gujaria has a Misconception
episodesList.summary: Chukundi and Bhagyalaxmi teach Indu to speak English. Gujaria forces Elija to write a letter to her mother and Chameli realizes that Elija only wrote the love letter.

episodesList.title: Gujarias Desire
episodesList.summary: Gujaria is head over heels for Elija but he doesn't feel the same for her. Suttilal is scared as to Elija is supposed to get married to Rani and informs this to Mukundi.

episodesList.title: Rani or Gujaria
episodesList.summary: Elija promises Mukundi that he wants Rani only. Chameli misguides Gujaria telling Elija is the one for her. Elija is terrified of Gujaria's approach.

episodesList.title: Letter For Chameli
episodesList.summary: Chameli charges Elija in front of the village enquiring about the love letter. Chotu expresses that the letter was for Chameli from his side, only written by Elija.

episodesList.title: Letter Trouble
episodesList.summary: Lallan confronts Elija with the letter, misunderstanding him. Finally, when Lallan hears about the truth behind the letter, he threatens him about the police. Chotu finds the letter but gets scared to see Gujaria.

episodesList.title: Police At Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Chotu enjoys time at Lallan's place at night. Elija is about to get arrested when Chotu asks for evidence, the change of evidence makes the situation even worse.

episodesList.title: New Threat
episodesList.summary: Elija's customer, Kallu dada refuses to pay for the clothes and attacks him. The villagers together throw him outside Lapataganj. Tufan Singh, a criminal arrives at the village, searching for Lallan.

episodesList.title: Slipper Thief
episodesList.summary: Lallan rescues a person, who apparently is a slipper thief, Tufan Singh. The police announced that he is getting a reward for catching the thief. The villagers stand together for defending Lallan, after hearing his story.

episodesList.title: Riend In Burqa
episodesList.summary: Chameli's new friend in burqa, Jamila arrives at Lapataganj. Chotu and Elija try to enquire about her, but somehow Chameli manages. At PWD office, Lallan's colleagues are talking behind his back, when suddenly he emerges.

episodesList.title: Burqa Confusion
episodesList.summary: Chotu and Elija inform Lallan that Tufan Singh came to visit him. The duo works out to bash away Tufan but there is a confusion with the burqa and they beat up Lallan in place of Tufan.

episodesList.title: Abduction
episodesList.summary: Chotu promises to take care of Chameli when Tufan's letter stuns them all. Lallan is lazy and doesn't want to look for his sister, so Chotu is prepared with a plan.

episodesList.title: Lallan In a Sack
episodesList.summary: Chameli runs away from Tufan's capture and Chotu brings the wrong sack to him. Tufan comes to Lapataganj and is upright in front of Lallan.

episodesList.title: Kachua Found to be Dead
episodesList.summary: People in Lapataganj are shattered after the cops tell them that they have found Kachua's dead body. The clothes and other things found are identified as Kachua's.

episodesList.title: Kachua is Back
episodesList.summary: After finishing Kachua's last rites, all the villagers are stunned to see him. He then tells everyone where he had been all the days of being found to be missing.

episodesList.title: Homeless Kachua
episodesList.summary: Kachua and his fellow villagers fight for the former's house but to no avail. So, they head to the police station to file a complaints.

episodesList.title: Dead or Alive
episodesList.summary: There arises a confusion about who actually own Kachua's house. Kachua then works towards proving that he is Kachua and is alive.

episodesList.title: Kachua Under Arrest
episodesList.summary: Kachua is put inside lock up after he attacks a policeman. Kachua finally gets ownership of his house and is proved to be alive.

episodesList.title: Take It Easy
episodesList.summary: Seeing Mukundi walk with his bicycle instead of riding it, almost everyone in the village asks him the reason. After telling everyone that one of the tires is punctured, he loses his calm when Chotu asks the same question and starts beating him up.

episodesList.title: Pappu Misbehaves
episodesList.summary: Mirza Taiyyab gets furious when Pappu starts praising his daughters. Later, Pappu even misbehaves with Indu which makes Mukundi angry.

episodesList.title: Thoughtful Indu
episodesList.summary: Indu points out how Mukundi always gets her clothes, even though his clothes are all worn out. Indu feels that she does not do enough for Mukundi and expresses her wish of doing something great for him.

episodesList.title: Embarrassed Chotu
episodesList.summary: Pappu is mesmerized seeing Mirza Taiyaab's daughter's faces for the first time. Chotu mama is embarrassed to step out without a mustache.

episodesList.title: Indu Gifts Mukundi a Scooter
episodesList.summary: Indu surprises Mukundi with a scooter which would make his commute to work much easier. When they go out for a ride, the scooter skids and they have a fall.

episodesList.title: Indu Learns How to Ride a Scooter
episodesList.summary: Pappu while teaching Indu how to ride a scooter, crashes after he sees Mirza Taiyyab's daughters. After a couple of days, she finally learns how to ride.

episodesList.title: Pappu's Twin Brother
episodesList.summary: People in Lapataganj are mind blown seeing Pappu's twin brother. Indu starts crying when she learns that the brother sold her scooter.

episodesList.title: Eijji Scams People
episodesList.summary: Indu loves Pappu's gesture of collecting money from people to buy her a new scooter, which his brother sold off. Guddu is stunned to find out that it is Eijji Pandey who has been taking money from people and not Pappu.

episodesList.title: The Real Pappu
episodesList.summary: When both Pandey brothers claim to be Pappu, Guddu after getting a slap from both of them recognizes who the real one is. Indu is on cloud nine to see her scooter with Mukundi.

episodesList.title: The Superman
episodesList.summary: Elija returns to Lapataganj wearing Superman's costume. In his attempt to fly, Elija experiences a fall and hurts himself.

episodesList.title: Movie Buffs
episodesList.summary: Eijji buys twenty-five tickets for the Superman movie leaving Guddu muddled. Indu insists Mukundi takes her for the movie and miss work.

episodesList.title: Eijjis Marketing Skills
episodesList.summary: All the shows for the Superman movies are house-full and people in Lapataganj are depressed when they don't get a ticket. Enters Eijji, who sells the tickets for a much higher rate than what he bought them for.

episodesList.title: Movie Time
episodesList.summary: People in Lapataganj sit and enjoy the Superman movie together. Eijji gets a shock when he realizes that he has held Mirza Taiyyab's hand instead of his daughters.

episodesList.title: Eijji Becomes Superman
episodesList.summary: After Silent Baba calls Eijji Superman, lightning strikes him and he disappears. People in Lapataganj are bewildered to see Eijji flying up in the sky.

episodesList.title: Superman
episodesList.summary: Eijji becomes the Superman for Lapatagnj people and everyone starts asking for help. Indumati asks him to get groceries for her. Everybody is astonished to see Eijji like this.

episodesList.title: New Mummy In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: A car enters Lapataganj and people are surprised to see it. Three men in a black dress get off the car. The leader is portrayed as mummy by his followers and is unknown to everyone in Lpataganj.

episodesList.title: Mamaji Jumps Off
episodesList.summary: Mamaji stands right on the top of the house to jump. He thinks that he is a Superman and he will be able to fly in the air. But he falls off and gets badly hurt.

episodesList.title: Superman Saves It
episodesList.summary: The bad people are about to forcefully take away Lapataganj's Hanumanji. But in the nick of time, Superman comes and blocks their way. Watch how superman fights the bad guys and save the idol.

episodesList.title: Nagging Wife
episodesList.summary: It is a bright sunny day and Mukundi calls Indumati as he is leaving for the office. But like all other women who nag to their husbands, Indu also starts nagging Mukundi that he does not take her anywhere for holidays.

episodesList.title: World will End
episodesList.summary: Mukundi, Indumati, Mishri, Mamaji, and others are sitting glued to the television. They sit to watch the news where they will get to know that the world might come to an end. Will the world come to an end?

episodesList.title: Mirja Striked With Lightening
episodesList.summary: It is a stormy night and everyone's headed to home. Suddenly, there is thunder and lightning in the sky and Mirja is striked with the lightening. Sutilaal comes running to save her.

episodesList.title: Bad News For Mishri
episodesList.summary: Mamaji comes home crying, Mishri gets tensed as to what could have possibly happened. But he does not stop crying and gathers all the Lapataganj people inside his house. After hearing the news, Mishri's heart breaks and she starts crying.

episodesList.title: Tribute to Rajesh Khanna
episodesList.summary: Kachua Chacha gives a tribute to Rajesh Khanna by singing his iconic song. And he makes everyone in Lapataganj sing as well. Everyone melodiously sings his songs and pays tribute in their own way.

episodesList.title: Pappu's Apology to Mishri
episodesList.summary: Pappu visits Mishri's house and asks her to accept his apology. He actually feels bad for what he did to her and does not want any grudges before the world ends. He promises to be her child in the next life.

episodesList.title: The Time has Come
episodesList.summary: The earth gets divided into two halves in Laptaganj. One set of people on one side and the rest on the other side. Everybody is devastated to see such a scenario and prays for their best. Is it a dream or reality?

episodesList.title: Brother-sister Relationship
episodesList.summary: Mishri tells Mamaji that she will accept anything from him only when he gets it with his own hard earned money. Mamaji gets upset as he does not want to work. Mishri makes him understand that it is necessary to get respect from everyone.

episodesList.title: Mamaji Brings The Good News
episodesList.summary: Mamaji comes home with a piece of good news that PWD has called him for a job interview. Mishri gets super excited and starts praying for his good health and wealth.

episodesList.title: Chotu Gets Kicked Out
episodesList.summary: Mishri beats Chotu mama up because he was kicked out of PWD. Kachua suggests Chotu does something that he loves so that it does not feel like work.

episodesList.title: Chotu Receives a Big Order
episodesList.summary: While Suttilal is away, Chotu mama receives a huge order for sweets and savouries. Even though Suttilal disagrees to take the order, Chotu insists he does so, so that he can make some money.

episodesList.title: Chotu Regrets
episodesList.summary: Mishri is ashamed of Chotu and asks him to stay away. Mukundi gives Indu a ride around Lapataganj. A collector arrives at Lapataganj, with an emerging hope to solve their problems.

episodesList.title: Chotu, The Rickshaw Driver
episodesList.summary: Mukundi urges the collector to have a word with Chotu. The collector convinces Chotu to not drive rickshaw anymore and try other better ways to earn his livelihood.

episodesList.title: Chotus Bravery
episodesList.summary: Chotu is severely injured but still successfully carries collector Tripathi to the nearby hospital to save him. Due to this act, Chotu is awarded an amount of ten thousand rupees.

episodesList.title: Independence Day Celebrations
episodesList.summary: Mishri does the honour of hoisting the flag. Chukundi questions his father that why the citizens give more importance to the freedom fighters only on Independence Day and not on other days.

episodesList.title: Indu's Birthday
episodesList.summary: Missing Indu returns back to Lapataganj after few hours as Mukundi has forgotten her birthday. Two buffalos are additions to her, gifted by her father. But Mukundi gets annoyed with the presence of Phoolbati.

episodesList.title: Cunning Kallu
episodesList.summary: Phoolbati is the new milk supplier in Lapataganj as the whole village gets enthralled to see her. Mircha is in dilemma with Indu's decision as Suttilal's business is running in loss.

episodesList.title: Eid In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Mukundi wakes up his children early on Eid and shouts at Indu for being obsessed with Phoolbati. Pappu's flirting has reached new heights.

episodesList.title: Mukundi's Nightmare
episodesList.summary: Parmanand Pandit assures Mukundi and Indu that he will sort out their disputes. But their problems only get worse so Indu shifts to Lalganj, forever.

episodesList.title: Indu Leaves The House
episodesList.summary: Kallu is happy after learning about Indu and Mukundi's fight. Mishri calls Indu's parents house and asks her to come back but Indu refuses.

episodesList.title: Kallus Truth is Out
episodesList.summary: Eijji brings Kallu's truth in front of everyone which makes everyone angry. The reason behind Indu and Mukundi's fight comes out and Indu returns to Lapataganj.

episodesList.title: Indu Chases Mukundi
episodesList.summary: Soon after coming back to Lapataganj, Indu chases Mukundi with a wooden stick, thinking Mukundi is getting remarried. All the villagers plan to get Indu and Mukundi married once again.

episodesList.title: Mukundi to Marry Indu Again
episodesList.summary: Mukundi agrees to get married to Indu once again. Everyone in Lapataganj starts preparing for the couple's big day.

episodesList.title: The Big Day
episodesList.summary: After a lot of convincing, Mukundi's father agrees for Mukundi and Indu's remarriage. The couple dresses up for their big day, helped by their friends.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Dying to Meet Indu
episodesList.summary: Mukundi wakes up with a dream where he has already married Indu. He starts missing her and tries his best to see her, but Mishri does not let him.

episodesList.title: Eijji's Plan Backfires
episodesList.summary: Eager to see Indu, Eijji suggests Mukundi bursts a bomb in Mishri's house. The plan backfires as the bomb hurts Chotu mama and makes Mishri extremely angry.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Disguises As a Salesman
episodesList.summary: When two people selling bangles ask for Mishri's address, Eijji and Mukundi take up their look so that Mukundi gets to see Indu.

episodesList.title: Bindu Tries to Help Mukundi
episodesList.summary: Mishri and other villagers are angry seeing Mukundi's disguise to see Indu. Bindu tells Mukundi that she can help him meet Indu but she puts forth a condition.

episodesList.title: Chotu is Against The Wedding
episodesList.summary: Mukundi's boss, after seeing his work, talks about his promotion. Chotu mama tells Elija that he will not let this wedding happen as Eijji has challenged him.

episodesList.title: Ladies Sangeet
episodesList.summary: The celebrations begin by Ladies Sangeet where all the women sing and dance with joy. Seeing Guddu and Eijji at the celebration, the ladies are furious and start beating them up.

episodesList.title: Haldi Ceremony
episodesList.summary: While praying in front of God, Indu and Mukundi talk about how close the distance has brought them. Later in the day, Mukundi has his haldi ceremony.

episodesList.title: Chotu Tries to Stop The Wedding
episodesList.summary: Amidst all the celebrations, the Women's Commission intervenes and defame Mukundi for getting married for the second time. People in Lapataganj later find out that the confusion was deliberately created by Chotu mama.

episodesList.title: Indu Weds Mukundi
episodesList.summary: After all the hustle, Mukundi finally gets to see his bride all dolled up for him. They are extremely happy and recreate their wedding vows all over again.

episodesList.title: Just Married
episodesList.summary: People in Lapataganj sing and dance to entertain the newlyweds. Later, Mukundi gets romantic with Indu on their first night but their children wish to sleep with them.

episodesList.title: Lallan has a Fall
episodesList.summary: Lallan trips and falls while running behind Mukundi, asking him for a lift. Bindu complains to Indu about the same.

episodesList.title: Lallan Buys a Car
episodesList.summary: Lallan becomes a laughing stock as he wears a rodent red coat. He then goes to buy a second-hand car accompanying Eijji.

episodesList.title: Super Excited Villagers
episodesList.summary: Bindu and other villagers are super excited to see Lallan with a car. People laugh at him when they see him push the car the next day.

episodesList.title: Lallan Chains His Car
episodesList.summary: Lallan is so paranoid after seeing a man trying to steal his car, he locks his car using chains. In the morning, he asks people to help him push the car so that it starts.

episodesList.title: A Corpse In The Car
episodesList.summary: People in Lapataganj are taken aback when Mishri tells them that Lallan's car has a corpse in the back seat. They immediately inform the cops who come to investigate the case.

episodesList.title: Lallan Behind The Bars
episodesList.summary: Lallan is put behind bars in the charge for having kept a dead body in his car. Bindu cries her eyes out when the cops refuse to bail him out.

episodesList.title: Car Thief
episodesList.summary: Eijji and Guddu, along with the villagers, catch hold of Panna Boss trying to steal Lallan's car and the diamond. The police intervenes at the right time to help the villagers.

episodesList.title: Indu's Decision
episodesList.summary: The villagers are perplexed at Indu's decision of standing as the Village Chief against Bahadur Singh. Mukundi is shocked to see the villagers support Indu in her decision.

episodesList.title: Speech By Indu
episodesList.summary: Bahadur Singh is tensed with his opponent in the election. Sugandhi tells Chukundi to write down a speech for Indu, and Salima helps Indu to prepare her speech. Indu messes up the speech, so she speaks out of her heart.

episodesList.title: For Indu
episodesList.summary: Mukundi is against Indu and lashes out at her but Sugandhi comes to rescue. The minister gets Mukundi's change of posting sanctioned, while Lapataganj is eagerly waiting to vote for Indu.

episodesList.title: Minister's Teacher
episodesList.summary: Indu's opponent tries to instigate Chotu against Indu by luring him. Mukundi avoids Indu after her big decision and tries to explain her about the dirty politics. Sugandhi's efforts to cancel Mukundi's transport brings colours.

episodesList.title: Indu V/s Chotu
episodesList.summary: Indu's supporters stand up for her, which is evidently more than Chotu's. Bahadur Singh plots to use bribe and bitter gourd as their means to win the election.

episodesList.title: Elections At Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Indu is demeaned by Bahadur Singh, as he tries to get her in trouble and accuses Mukundi of black money. Still, Lapataganj supports them and Indu comes out with flying colours.

episodesList.title: Indu, The New Chief
episodesList.summary: Indu wins the election against Bahadur Singh. Chotu gets zero votes, as he votes for Indu. Lapataganj is overjoyed in celebrating Indu's win. Mishri struggles to read the letter sent by her husband.

episodesList.title: Haunted School
episodesList.summary: Mircha and Suttilal fight over payment, so Elija and Mishri intervene. Mishri wants to open the Gandhi Vidyalaya, but a stranger warns them about the place. The villagers gather to find out the mystery of this place.

episodesList.title: Behind The Doors
episodesList.summary: After Gandhi Vidyalaya's door open, two villagers try to go inside the place at night and get thrown away by a wave of energy. Mishri attempts to find out and gets herself into trouble.

episodesList.title: Mishri's Change Of Fate
episodesList.summary: Vivek, the lawyer arrives to inform Lallan that he cannot expand his place. Mishri saves Lallan from his crisis and the villagers are in shock with her transformation. Chotu tries to find out about Mishri and gets attacked by her.

episodesList.title: Bhavani Shankar's Ghost
episodesList.summary: Rajjo tells the villagers about the ghost who wanted to get everyone educated. The villagers finally understand that Mishri is possessed. The villagers start studying in front of Mishri and soon enough the goons arrive in search of the sacks.

episodesList.title: Chota Babbar In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Chota Babbar interrogates the villagers about the sacks. Elija also gets possessed and teach the goons a good lesson. The villagers start getting scared of each other.

episodesList.title: Right to Education
episodesList.summary: Mukundi thinks Indu is possessed when she triess teaching her children. Lallan is clueless with the ghosts and cannot sleep. Chotu sells talisman to the villagers which Mukundi opposes and Indu promises to make Bhavanis unfulfilled wishes come true.

episodesList.title: Kachuas New Trend
episodesList.summary: Finally, there is a teacher for Gandhi Vidyalaya and it will reopen. The goons try to flame up the school but Bhavanis ghost prevents them. The villagers get prepared for school and their new teacher astonishes them.

episodesList.title: Dacoits At Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Chotu tries to scheme Suttilal but they catch him red-handed, so he tells them a story about a dacoit, Jalim Singh. The arrival of the dacoits leaves the villagers in a trauma.

episodesList.title: Chotu Becomes a Dacoit
episodesList.summary: Chotu confronts the chief dacoit, Kroor Singh. Mishri breaks down when the dacoits take Chotu along with them, presuming his origin is from their same clan. The villagers file a report but there is still no hope.

episodesList.title: Mirchas Love For Suttilal
episodesList.summary: Mishri's dream of Chotu as a dacoit keeps haunting her. When the dacoits come to take Suttilal, Mircha attacks them so the daciots carry them both back to their den.

episodesList.title: Confectioner In Demand
episodesList.summary: Mircha and Suttilal prepare food for the dacoits but to their horror all food gets vanished as Mircha has all of the food. The police are unable to get them back and the dacoit chief gets irritated with Mircha.

episodesList.title: The Spy In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Mirza is shocked to know Guddu's awareness. The villagers bash up Suttilal assuming him as dacoit. Suttilal acts as a middle man to inform the dacoits and they soon arrive at Mukundi's post office.

episodesList.title: Curse The Spy
episodesList.summary: The villagers curse the spy, as the dacoits have all the information about Lapataganj now. Mircha keeps the dacoits in control with her violence. Lapataganj residents get ready to attack the dacoits as they have had enough.

episodesList.title: Failed Attempts
episodesList.summary: The dacoits arrive and the villagers fail to stop them. Suttilal almost expresses that he is the spy. The dacoits attack PWD office and take Chaurasia from Lapataganj.

episodesList.title: Against Spy
episodesList.summary: Chotu strangles Suttilal while comparing him as the spy. Lallan is devated after the dacoits loot him. The villagers get busy to find out the spy.

episodesList.title: Suttilal Gets Caught
episodesList.summary: Elija plan to feed and get the dacoits unconcious fails miserably when Kachua has the food in their place. Mukundi realises that Suttilal calls Kroor Singh.

episodesList.title: Confronts Suttilal
episodesList.summary: Suttilal reveals that he has done it all for Mircha's safety. Suttilal with the help of the villagers places bait for Kroor Singh to have Mircha back. The dacoits get to see the women power of Lapataganj but there is a twist in the story.

episodesList.title: Women Empowerment
episodesList.summary: Elija plans to feed something and make the dacoits unconscious, but fails miserably when Kachua has the food in their place. Mukundi realizes that Suttilal calls Kroor Singh.

episodesList.title: Chotu's Chameli
episodesList.summary: Chotu wants to get married to Chameli and expresses that to Mishri. Bindu pesters Lallan to think about Chameli's marriage. Finally, Chotu proposes Chameli.

episodesList.title: Drama Of Love
episodesList.summary: Chameli accepts to marry Chotu when he falls unconcious. Lallan is still not sure about their relationship and opposes their marriage.

episodesList.title: Stuborn Lallan
episodesList.summary: Chameli is heartbroken and tells Mishri about Lallans decision. Chotu requests Mukundi to convince Lallan along with Mishri. Lallan is determined so Chotu comes in front of a bike.

episodesList.title: Court Marriage
episodesList.summary: Chotu makes Chameli sign the registry papers to go against Lallan. Its Pudinas birthday, Lapataganj celebrates his birthday when Chotu discusses his love for Chameli in front of Lallan.

episodesList.title: Chotu V/s Lallan
episodesList.summary: Chotu and Lallan curse each other as they plot to ruin each others plan. Chameli is stuck as Lallan isnt leaving for office, Chotus plan fail one after another.

episodesList.title: Mircha Comes to Save
episodesList.summary: Chotu seeks help from Mircha so she teams up with Elija to save Chameli from Lallan patroling. Lallan somehow manages to find out Elija's pretense.

episodesList.title: Chameli has to Make a Choice
episodesList.summary: Lallan rushes outside to find Chameli and stop her from marrying Chotu. Lallan threatens the couple that he will commit suicide.

episodesList.title: Lovers In Pain
episodesList.summary: Chotu refrains from intaking any food, and only drinks black tea in an alcohol bottle. Chameli drinks the poison that Lallan was about to and realizes it is honey. Chotu and Chameli are about to get married when Mini-Chotu visits Lapataganj.

episodesList.title: New Kid In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Lambodar Prasad a.k.a. Tilu comes to tell that he is Chotu's son and Chameli is devasted to see him. Mishri is excited to see her nephew in Lapataganj. Chukundi and Bhagyalaxmi befriend Tilu as he feels lonely.

episodesList.title: Chotu Loves His Son
episodesList.summary: Tilu plans to reunite his father with Chameli and targets to pester Chameli in various ways. Tilu befriends Chameli gradually and Chotu is excited to see them.

episodesList.title: Tilus Try
episodesList.summary: Chotu is sad on hearing the news of Chamelis wedding so Tilu pretends to read her hand to bring the estranged couple close again. But Chameli still avoids talking to Chotu.

episodesList.title: Chameli On a Date
episodesList.summary: Chameli goes for a movie where Lallan accompanies her, Tilu and Chotu also join them. Two strange fellows try to molest her and Chotu retaliates.

episodesList.title: Chotu and Chameli
episodesList.summary: Tilu's plan fails but he finally speaks out the truth. Chotu and Tilu are about to leave Lapataganj, but on everyone's request, Lallan makes a life-changing decision.

episodesList.title: Brother-sister Day
episodesList.summary: Lallan visits Chameli to celebrate this togetherness of siblings. Bhagyalaxmi celebrates the day with Chukundi and Tilu. Chukundi gets bullied at the school and follows Tilu's suggestion.

episodesList.title: Chukundi's Expulsion
episodesList.summary: Golu loses the challenge he put forward to Chukundi. Police arrive at school to investigate who broke the lock and Golu starts blackmailing Chukundi.

episodesList.title: Golu's Blackmailing
episodesList.summary: Chukundi requests Chameli to prepare halwa for Golu. But, Golu starts demanding more. So, Chukundi decides to tell everything to Mukundi.

episodesList.title: Tilu Wants to Study
episodesList.summary: Tilu pesters his father to get him admitted to a school. Golu and Chunnu-Munnu get punished for the same homework. Golu orders Chukundi to get a shirt for him and Chukundi requests Elija to help him out.

episodesList.title: Chukundi's New Classmate
episodesList.summary: Chotu gives a treat to the villagers for Tilu joining the school. Chukundi is stuck as Golu and Chunnu-Munnu increase their demand on knowing that Mukundi will get a reward.

episodesList.title: Golu Gets Exposed
episodesList.summary: Chukundi's teacher loses his money so there is a search conducted at the classroom, revealing all the antics of Golu. Mukundi returns back home early with his reward and goes to Chukundi's school.

episodesList.title: Chotu Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: Mukundi struggles to manage the household chores and balances it well with office work. Indu is back and excited to see her husband and son get prizes. Chotu is missing since the morning and so Mishri loses her cool.

episodesList.title: Chotu In News
episodesList.summary: The voxpop says Chotu challenged Tinku, the thief to come to Lapataganj. Tinku, simultaneously accepts his challenge and arrives at Lapataganj. Alongside, Mishri, the constable also visits at the same time, and takes the information about the villagers.

episodesList.title: Tinkus First Failure
episodesList.summary: Lallan shares safety tips with his neighbours as he still fears the threat from Tinku. Mishra, on the other hand takes measurement of Lallans house. Tilu starts doubting Mishras behaviour.

episodesList.title: Robbery At Elija's
episodesList.summary: Tinkus robbery attempt fails at Lallans and Chotus place. Indu calls for an assembly to discuss about and gather money for Ruksanas ailment. Tinku steals the full cash amount at Elija's place.

episodesList.title: Tinku Mishra
episodesList.summary: Chotu shows the villagers a jackpot that is Tinku lying unconscious at Gandhi Vidyalaya. Mishra constable is actually Tinku thief. Chotu reveals he could catch Tinku only with Tilu's help.

episodesList.title: Bindu's Calling
episodesList.summary: The men at Lapataganj are elated to know that their wives are going for a pilgrim tour. Mukundi is upset and doesn't want Indu to go. Chotu pesters Mishri for extra money. Inspector Devidas Singh enters, who is an ardent follower of the Goddess, and a feminist.

episodesList.title: Dancer At Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Guddus friend, Bhimsen, Nautanki wale arrives at Lapataganj. The villagers convince Lallan to pay him and pursue Mukundi to attend the function. Devidas hears about the dancer and decides to take an action against Lapataganj.

episodesList.title: Misson : Women
episodesList.summary: Chotu asks help from Lallan as Inspector Devidas tries to intervene in their village function. Suttilal asks Elija to dress up as a woman once again. Lallan pretends to be a woman for saving all the men of Lapataganj.

episodesList.title: Women Of Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: The new Daroga appointed catches men disguised as women of Lapataganj in their absence and gives an ultimatum of 2 days to get the women back. Mamaji and his son manage to get samosa in the absence of women in town.

episodesList.title: Men In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Mukundi and all the men of Lapataganj try to reach their wives and women who are out of town. Suttilal has a scary dream of getting beaten up by the Daroga and other policemen as the ultimatum gets closer.

episodesList.title: Women Back In Town
episodesList.summary: People of Lapataganj are about to leave the village as the Daroga comes in time to stop them from running away from him and to arrest them. Kachua chacha manages to get the women back and rescue the men of Lapataganj.

episodesList.title: Moustache, Pride Of Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Mukundi's coleague Mishra ji gets praised for his looks before he gets his moustache shaved and made is fun of. Meanwhile Suttilals mausaji comes in town for a visit and is angry over people without a moustache.

episodesList.title: Fake Moustaches In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: To impress his Mausaji Suttilal gets a fake moustache for himself. Tilu gets a fake moustache too and as a prank puts it on her buaji who unknowingly roams around in the village before being caught and so does Suttilal.

episodesList.title: Moustaches In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Pudina chacha decides to solve the moustache problem by taking off mausaji's moustache using a prank. Mukundi plays hide and seek with his children. Mausaji's old enemy visits Lapataganj and as revenge wants to shave the moustaches of everyone present in Lapataganj.

episodesList.title: Indumati Saves The Village
episodesList.summary: Suttilal tries to save Mausaji from the enemies and Indumati arrives inbetween to save Sutilal from the beating and helps save the village. Mukundi has a strange issue where his left eye doesnst stop blinking which is a sign of something bad coming his way.

episodesList.title: Bad Time For Mukundi
episodesList.summary: Mukundi is troubled by the fact that his salary is gonna arrive a month late. Elija lost a needle and goes to Mukundi for help. Mamaji's wife is back after a long time and is upset that she was away for a long time.

episodesList.title: Elija's Gift to Mukundi
episodesList.summary: Elija feels bad that Mukundi burnt his hands because of him so he decides to get him a present which makes everyone excited. Suttilal finds all his samosas to be bitten from the top and Mamaji decides to act as a detective and solve the crime.

episodesList.title: Mamaji Caught As Spy
episodesList.summary: Mamaji decides to get a cooker for himself and Kachua chacha advises him to get one with an ISI mark and writes it on his arm. The Commissioner gives the Daroga info that a spy from ISI has entered the village, and they catch Mamaji instead.

episodesList.title: Policemen Get Punished
episodesList.summary: The policemen try to punish the captured Mamaji which goes wrong and end up hurting themselves. Mukundi, Kachua chacha, and Elija go to the same police station in search of Mamaji and find him.

episodesList.title: Mamaji and Lallan Fight
episodesList.summary: Mamaji and Lallan have a fight and are upset with each other, so mamaji stops talking to other people as well. Indumati and co decide to end this fight and take several measures.

episodesList.title: Mamaji, Jijaji Friends Again
episodesList.summary: Indumati and Bindumati decide to haunt Mamaji and Jijaji with scary stories to resolve their fight. Indumati dresses as a witch and scares both of them off and asks them to stop fighting and come back together.

episodesList.title: Makundi Teaches His Chilldren
episodesList.summary: Makundi and Indumati teach their children how to write a letter and recieve one at their home from their children. Mamaji is mad at mausiji that she didn't bring Chameli along with her and Tilu.

episodesList.title: Biji Bhaiya is Back
episodesList.summary: Indumati and Bindumati compete  over who has the better curtains and fight over about whose place is Chachiji going to stay over. Biji bhaiya comes to the Lapatagnj after a very long time.

episodesList.title: Indu and Bindu Compete
episodesList.summary: Indumati and Bindumati compete again and get sofa sets for their places for whose is better. Tilu hears Biju bhaiya and blackmails him about telling Buaji everything.

episodesList.title: Bijji Pandey is Rich
episodesList.summary: Bijji Pandey astonishes every one at the tea stall with his behaviour. He uses a hundred rupee note to hold the hot cup of tea at Suthilals shop and walks away after a show stunt. Mukundi on the other hand is tensed about money. Bijji pandey trains Indumati and Bindumati to carry western clothes and walk in heels, in the Mumbai style. The villagers are surprised looking at them flaunt their new style.

episodesList.title: Where will Sudha Chachi Stay?
episodesList.summary: Indumati and Bindumati are in competition to welcome Sudha Chachi to their respective homes. They push their husbands out of their homes so they get used to sleeping outside, while Sudha Chachi stays at home. Mausi tries to make Indumati understand that she need not fight with her sister. Indumati plans to get a dress stitched for Chachi and so does Bindumati. Busy Pandey creates confusion by pitching in details to both of them.

episodesList.title: Indumati Loves Bindumati
episodesList.summary: Sudha Chachi arrives and everyone gathers around to welcome her. Indumati and Bindumati fight yet again to keep her in their homes. Mukundi explains the reason of the fight to Sudha Chachi. Sudha Chachi reminds them of their childhood days and of the love they had for each other. The two sisters felt sorry for being envious of each other and hugged each other with love.

episodesList.title: Shiek Visits Suthilals Shop
episodesList.summary: Busy Pandey fools Suthilal and eats everything he has prepared in the shop. While the villagers are going to punish him, his twin brother, Eji Pandey arrives in the village and tells them that he will teach them to celebrate New Years' in the city-style. The very next day, a gang of his friends reaches Lapataganj to celebrate their New Year.

episodesList.title: New Year Party At Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: The villagers are excited for the modern New Year party. They get new clothes stichted and are in prep to look the best for the New Year party. Indumati also presents a jean to Mausi for the New Year which she refuses to take and returns it back.

episodesList.title: Rocks New Year Eve
episodesList.summary: Villagers gather along dressed for the party, dance on bollywood numbers and welcome the New Year. The gang of boys then decide to leave for Kanpur post mid night, they are warned by mausi to grab some rest. The next morning the gang returns in an ambulance with a cop after meeting with an accident.

episodesList.title: Party Boys Meet With an Accident
episodesList.summary: The villagers make the boys promise to be responsible for celebrating any occasion. Mukundi comes back home but decides to leave again. While Indumati is reminded that the water at home is over. Indumati and Bindumati are worried about the scarcity of drinking water.

episodesList.title: Furious Elija
episodesList.summary: The scarcity of water troubles everyone at the village. Elija looses his cool and takes a brick in hand to break the local tap. The villagers try to stop him. Suddenly, there is electricity and water supply in the village. Indumati questions the incident and party elect arrives to inform the villager that the party head is planning to visit Lapataganj.

episodesList.title: Ministers Visit to Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: The minister arrives to discuss the issues faced by the vilagers. Mukundi warns Indumati to not attend the discussion and to stay away from politics and politicians. She is furious about not being able to attend the discussion.

episodesList.title: The Corrupt Politicians
episodesList.summary: The politicians fight among themselves and create a chaos. Suthilal and his wife make many sweets and present it to the party, hoping to earn out of the discussion programme. Though the politicians lie about providing a payment and show them out.

episodesList.title: Innocent Public is Fooled
episodesList.summary: The politicians are not interested in discussion or resolving any issues. The spend time lazing around and so a dancer is called to entertain and motivate them. The politicians enjoy the dancers performance in the tent while the villagers are fooled with an audio played of a political speech outside the tent.

episodesList.title: Common Man Strives For a Good Life
episodesList.summary: The politicians create a chaos in the village and leave. The power and water supply too are disconnected as the politicians leave from the village. The villagers decide to live happily anyway with the light of their love and affcetion for each other. The serial signs off talking about the ironic life of a common man.

episodesList.title: Chameli Runs Away From Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Mukundi and other villagers wake up in the morning to fill water when they see Mamaji bathing under the tap. Elections are about to take place in Lapataganj. Sureeli finds a note from Chameli quoting that she ran away with Radhesham out of Lapataganj.

episodesList.title: Mataji Visits Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Mataji who is a political candidate visits Lapataganj to listen to the problems faced by the villagers. Many problems like scarcity of water and electricity are expressed by the villagers to Mataji. Kachchua chacha gives a whole speech on how politicians make fake promises and leave the villagers hanging in the middle only for votes.

episodesList.title: Lapataganj Celebrates Patni Diwas
episodesList.summary: Elija clicks a picture of Suttilal and Mircha who celebrate Patni diwas. Mamaji goes searching for Chameli and ends up beating a guy thinking about Chameli. Mukundi and Indumati have a fight and she warns of calling her mom at her place to stay.

episodesList.title: Mamaji Gets Pranked
episodesList.summary: Mukundi is still upset from Indumati and goes to work without lunch. Bijji Pandey pranks Mamaji by giving him a soap which causes itching with the motive to meet Sureeli.

episodesList.title: Indumati Throws Mukundilal Out
episodesList.summary: Mukundilal sleeps on the bed and Indumati insists him to sleep on the floor. When Mukundilal doesn't agree with her she throws him out of the house.

episodesList.title: Kacchua Irritated With The Mobile Phones
episodesList.summary: Kacchua Chacha is irritated with everyone in Lapataganj because of their phone addiction. He tries to talk to many of them but fails to catch their attention as they lost on their phones.

episodesList.title: Kacchua Meets With an Accident
episodesList.summary: Kacchua meets with an accident and is taken to the hospital. There is nobody to attend him or take him home. Indu reaches the hospital and gets emotional about the busy lives of people.

episodesList.title: Mukundilal Visits Kacchua Chacha
episodesList.summary: Indu is upset and shouts at everyone about their ignorance. Mukundilal visits Kacchua Chacha at the hospital and is still busy over the phone.

episodesList.title: Kacchua Runs Away From The Hospital
episodesList.summary: Kacchua is tired of telling each of his visitors the story. Mishri too decides to visit him, he gets frustrated of narrating his tale and chooses to run away from the hospital.

episodesList.title: Rainy Season Knocks Lapataganjs Door
episodesList.summary: In this episode, Bablu is trying to explain Dablu that what are the benefits of the rainy season. Meanwhile, in Lapataganj people are not aware that rainy season can be a big problem for them.

episodesList.title: Mukundilal Becomes a Postman
episodesList.summary: Mukundilala read the letter in front of Lapataganj's people, what is in the letter, who is visiting Lapataganj's this time. Who is the special guest?

episodesList.title: Babuji is Alive
episodesList.summary: Lallan forgets to pick her wife Bindumati from the railway station and when she reached Lapataganj, she throws him out of the house.

episodesList.title: Mama and Lallan Get Punished
episodesList.summary: Babuji gives punishment to Chotu mama and Lallan for throwing a stone at him.

episodesList.title: Babuji's Birthday Celebration
episodesList.summary: Lapataganj is going to celebrate Babuji's birthday for the first time. But why Babuji doesn't want to celebrate his birthday?

episodesList.title: Babuji Gets Angry On His Birthday
episodesList.summary: People of Lapataganj threw a surprise birthday party for Babuji, but Babuji was not happy at all. What is the reason behind Babuji's anger?

episodesList.title: Chukku and Dolly
episodesList.summary: People in the town start noticing Chukku and Dolly looking at each other. They talk about how fast kids are these days. Elija tries to baby Chukku in front of Dolly. Chukku tries to go to Dolly's shop but his mother stops him. How will Chukku approach Dolly?

episodesList.title: Chukku Approaches Dolly
episodesList.summary: Chukku approaches Dolly and gets slapped. He thinks of ways to tell dolly how he feels. Pandeyji dances with Surili and ends up getting beaten by her mother. Chukku draws a heart in his book and was about to be caught by Mukundilal.

episodesList.title: Chukku and Dolly's Love Story
episodesList.summary: Chukku buys snacks from Dolly's shop often without paying to see her. Chukku takes Mukundilal's scooter without asking and takes Dolly and Tilu for a ride. Mukundilal finds out and scolds Chukku.

episodesList.title: Everything is Revealed
episodesList.summary: Dolly's father tells Mukundilal that Chukku comes to the shop often and buys things from the shop in order to see Dolly. Mukundilal tries to discipline Chukku but the people of Lapataganj defend him. Pandeyji reads out the love letters he wrote to Surili 9 years ago.

episodesList.title: Chukku Writes a Love Letter
episodesList.summary: Chukku struggles to write a love letter for Dolly. Mukundi teaches him to write a letter on mother, he replaces the word mother to Dolly in the letter. However, he fails to give it to her.

episodesList.title: Chukku Gets Caught
episodesList.summary: Mukundilal sees Chukku's love letter and says that it looks like its written by a doctor. Mukundilal reads out Chukku's letter in front of everyone. Dolly likes it a lot. Chukku is scared and hiding. Everyone looks for him.

episodesList.title: Suttilal's Good News
episodesList.summary: Suttilal, Mircha, and Pudilal visit Mukundilal to share the good news. Everyone gathers around to listen to what Suttilal has to say. What can be the news?

episodesList.title: Suttilal's New Shop
episodesList.summary: Suttilal opens a samosa shop. Everyone comes to bless him. Babuji visits Suttilal's new shop. Just when everyone is celebrating happiness, someone new enters. Who is this new guest?

episodesList.title: Suttilal has a Rival
episodesList.summary: Gappu Singh opens a fast food shop near Suttilal's shop. It's a rainy day. Everyone comes to check out his shop. Gappu Singh bribes Mamaji with free food. But instead, Mamaji invites everyone else over to have free food.

episodesList.title: Suttilal Becomes a Vendor
episodesList.summary: Suttilal becomes a vegetable vendor. Mukundilal and the others feel bad for him. Gappu Singh makes fun of Suttilal's condition. Pandey visits Gappu Singh's shop and gets money in order to leave the business.

episodesList.title: Clash Between The Shop Owners
episodesList.summary: Business is slow in Suttilal's shop so they use different techniques to improve the business. Elija drinks tea from Suttilal's shop and finds a fly in the tea. Will the business grow in the new shop?

episodesList.title: The Brawl Between Suttilal and The Gang Leader
episodesList.summary: Gappu Singh and Suttilal start brawling, as everyone gathers around them. Pappu intervenes and makes a scene. Gappu Singh bribes Pandeyji with money again.

episodesList.title: The Closed Shop
episodesList.summary: Suttilal's shop is closed. Some people feel bad for Suttilal and decide not to eat in the new shop. Pandey visits the new shop multiple times and collects money.

episodesList.title: Showdown Between The Shop Owners
episodesList.summary: Gappu Singh and Suttilal start fighting in front of the whole village. Mukundilal intervenes in order to settle the fight. Pandeyji arrives and Gappu Singh bribes him again. Will Mukundilal be able to stop them?

episodesList.title: Pandeyji's Kind Gesture
episodesList.summary: Pandeyji lends money to Suttilal to reopen his shop. Suttilal and a few others search for the lost money in the ground. Chukku asks for money from Mukundilal but he denies. Chukku keeps pleading to him. Will Mukundi give him the money?

episodesList.title: Lapataganj Needs a Doctor
episodesList.summary: Mircha calls everyone to look at Suttilal's smoked face. Mukundi and others gather around to sort the problem. Pandey tries to lure Sureeli out of her house and ends up getting caught. Mukundi decides to meet Mantriji.

episodesList.title: The Hunt For Rats
episodesList.summary: Mantriji comes up with a scheme and tells the people of Lapataganj to catch all the rats and in exchange get 50rs for each rat. Everyone starts hunting for rats. The fight starts to earn more money.

episodesList.title: Pandey's Attempt to Meet Sureeli
episodesList.summary: Pandey asks Tilu about who is there in Sureeli's house. He then asks money from Chukku, he denies it as he does not have any. Pappu Pandey then fools Pudina and steals sweets from Suttilal's shop for Sureeli.

episodesList.title: Cash In Storage Room
episodesList.summary: Mamaji eats from Suttilal's shop and refuses to pay. But Mamaji left his bag in his shop and now Mircha has it. Mamaji tries hard to get back his bag, so he breaks into the storage and steals rations. Mamaji and Elija make a shocking discovery.

episodesList.title: Catching The Culprit
episodesList.summary: Mamaji and Elija find cash in the ration and inform Mukundi. Mantriji comes to the village with his wife. Mukundilal and others gather around and reveal the cash hidden in the storage shop. They confront Mantriji and capture everything on camera.

episodesList.title: Bindumati's New Look
episodesList.summary: Romance is in the air for all the villagers. Bindumati gets romantic and also changes her look. Lallanji gets surprised to see Bindu's new look. Lallanji gets scared and asks her to be normal.

episodesList.title: I Love You
episodesList.summary: Mishri gets a letter from someone. It's a rainy day and Lallanji gets beaten by the ladies of Lapataganj, and swears not to say the words I LOVE YOU to anyone. Bindumati takes care of his wounds.

episodesList.title: Lallanji In Search Of True Love
episodesList.summary: Indu, Mishri, and Mircha reveal to Lallanji that they don't love him anymore. All the females residing in Lapataganj get angry with Lallanji and some of them rush to beat him too. How will he solve this problem?

episodesList.title: Villagers Propose Lallanji
episodesList.summary: Not only Chaurasiya but all the villagers of Lapataganj are proposing to Lallanji, but this apparently does not go down too well with him and he gets confused. Lallanji receives flowers from all the female members of Lapataganj. Will Mukundi solve Lallan's problem?

episodesList.title: Lallanji On Everone's Watchlist
episodesList.summary: Bindumati gets a huge shock as Mamaji proposes Bindumati on behalf of Lallanji but this apparently does not go down well either. Bindu decides to leave Lapataganj and Lallanji.

episodesList.title: Lallanji Proposes to Bindumati
episodesList.summary: Lallanji proposes to Bindumati and all the villagers of Lapataganj are trying to persuade Bindumati and also explain to her that Lallanji immensely loves her. Just when Bindumati was about to leave Lapataganj, Lallanji says loving words.

episodesList.title: What You Sow So shall You Reap
episodesList.summary: Baba Hawaijahaj reveals to Mama that if he works hard, he will get rewards for the same but Mama fails to understand. Mama tries to help all the villagers so that he can get heavy rewards. Will this be helpful for Mama?

episodesList.title: Mukundi Gets Scared Of Mamaji
episodesList.summary: Villagers of Lapataganj get a huge shock as they come to know about Mama, so they decide to pay him the last visit. Panic occurs in Lapataganj as they see Mama alive. Why is Mukundi scared of Mama?

episodesList.title: Bansi Chacha Shares His Painful Journey
episodesList.summary: Mama could not bear Bansi Chacha's pain so he firmly decides to help him out. Chukundi and Bhagyalakshmi try to cheer up Bansi Chacha as he was extremely upset. Will Bansi Chacha share his painful journey with Mukundi and Indumati?

episodesList.title: Bansi Chacha and Elija Faints
episodesList.summary: Mukundi urgently calls doctor Tripathy as Bansi Chacha faints and also takes a look at the letter which Mama finds in his pocket. Major trouble takes place as Eilja faints too. Who will take responsibility for these two?

episodesList.title: Bansi Chacha Falls
episodesList.summary: Bansi Chacha falls ill and Mama gets upset. Mama succeeds in persuading villagers to donate money for Bansi Chacha's operation. What will be the villagers' final decision and will they agree to it?

episodesList.title: Mama Collects Funds
episodesList.summary: After lots of hard work, Mama finally succeeds in collecting money for Bansi Chacha but he has some other plans. Will Bansi Chacha take all the money and escape from Lapataganj?

episodesList.title: Bansi Chacha Feels Guilty
episodesList.summary: All the villagers of Lapataganj get a huge shock as they come to know that Bansi Chacha escaped with all their money. There in the hospital, Bansi Chacha feels guilty. Will Mama forgive him for what Bansi Chacha did?

episodesList.title: Eijji Pandey Offers a Lift to Misri
episodesList.summary: Biji ka Pran-Babloo & Dabloo deliberate over the concept of izzat or respect. Eijji Pandey offers a lift to Misri Mausi on his bike, Katrina, but the villagers think that he has arrested her. When the confusion is over and done with, Misri Mausi invites Eijji over to dinner, which does not go down well with Biji as he has already had a bad day. What happens next?

episodesList.title: Biji Gets Romantic With Surili
episodesList.summary: Biji is extremely excited to watch a movie with Surili and also gets romantic with her. Indumati fumes in anger and also reveals to Easy that she saw him with Surili. Will Easy reveal the truth to Indumati and Biji?

episodesList.title: Biji Challenges Ejji
episodesList.summary: Lapataganj villagers are extremely upset with Biji and also decide to avoid him. Biji challenges Easy. Will Biji succeed in proving his point?

episodesList.title: Biji and Guddu are Seeking For Cases
episodesList.summary: Biji and Guddu firmly decide to work but both of them get a huge shock as they see the scene outside the office. Will Biji get work? What has destiny planned for Biji's future?

episodesList.title: Biji Earns Rs 10,000
episodesList.summary: Biji gives the wrong statement in the court and earns Rs. 10,000 for Surili. Will Surili accept Biji's money? What will be Biji's next step?

episodesList.title: Ishwarchand Challenges Biji Pandey
episodesList.summary: Biji reveals to his lawyer colleagues that he has agreed to fight Ganeshi's case. Ishwarchand challenges Biji Pandey in the court. Will Ganeshi be proven innocent or guilty? Who will win the case?

episodesList.title: Eijji Pandey's Final Warning
episodesList.summary: Judge sends Ganeshi for 2 days in police remand. Inspector Easy Pandey gives a final warning to Ganeshi and also insists him to reveal the truth. What will be the Judge's final verdict? Will Biji find out the truth?

episodesList.title: Inspector Eijji Pandey Slaps Laxmi Seth
episodesList.summary: Biji fights with goons in Lapataganj. Elija, Mama, and Suttilal become constables and visit Kanta Prasad's haveli to prove Ganeshi innocent. Will Elija, Mama, and Suttilal succeed in collecting evidence against Kanta?

episodesList.title: Grand Welcome Of Lawyer Biji Pandey
episodesList.summary: Seth Laxmi Narayan reveals a shocking truth in the court. Kanta Prasad sends goons to teach a lesson to Biji for fighting a case against him. Easy Pandey saves his brother, Biji Pandey. Is there a surprise?

episodesList.title: Chotu Mama Falls Asleep On Theater's Roof
episodesList.summary: All the villagers of Lapataganj are trying hard to wake up Chotu Mama who is sleeping on Delight Cinema's roof. Mausi fumes in anger. Mukundi as Lord Krishna gives knowledge to Chotu Mama as Arjun.

episodesList.title: Chotu Mama In Search Of Lord Krishna
episodesList.summary: Chotu Mama gets highly inspired by Geetaji in which Lord Krishna has beautifully explained brave warrior Arjun the truth of life. Chotu Mama becomes Arjun. Will Chotu Mama be able to find Lord Krishna?

episodesList.title: Blue Baba Arrives In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Mukundi gets angry with Chotu Mama as he fought with Lallanji. Netaji Khauram introduces Blue Baba to all the villagers of Lapataganj. Is this Netaji Khauram's evil plan? Will Mukundi find out the truth?

episodesList.title: Blue Baba's Speech
episodesList.summary: America return Blue Baba spreads knowledge to the villagers in English. Villagers are highly impressed by Blue Baba as he repeatedly keeps on saying those 3 magical words. How will Mukundi find out the truth about Blue Baba?

episodesList.title: Blue Babas Master Plan
episodesList.summary: Mukundi is strictly against these Babas who fool people but found Blue Baba unique. Will the villagers of Lapataganj come to know about Blue Babas master plan? Will Inspector Ejji Pandey find out the truth?

episodesList.title: Suttilal Becomes Blue Baba
