episodesList.summary: Mamaji tries to reveal the truth to the villagers about Blue Baba but none of them believe him. Mama firmly decides to raise the blue curtain and spill the truth.

episodesList.title: Villagers Get Crazy For Blue Baba
episodesList.summary: All the female members of Lapataganj are extremely upset as Blue Baba decides to leave Lapataganj. But still, Blue Baba requests the villagers to vote for him.

episodesList.title: Don Jagpal Singh In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: All the villagers of Lapataganj are shocked to see Don Jagpal Singh. They capture Lallanji as a hostage. Kachua Chacha explains the truth of life and motivates others. Ejji Pandey has a task to be completed.

episodesList.title: New Refrigerator In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Chukundi is trying unique ways to impress Dolly. Lallanji gets angry with Mamaji because of his behaviour. All are super excited about the new refrigerator in Lallanji's house.

episodesList.title: Loans Fever
episodesList.summary: Mukundi is in a  big shock as Indu buys a new refrigerator. Mausi welcomes the new refrigerator in Mukundi's house but a major trouble takes place. The refrigerator turns out to be a defective one. How will Mukundi deal with this?

episodesList.title: Indu Tries to Jump From The Balcony
episodesList.summary: Indumati tries out unique ways to persuade Mukundi to buy a brand new refrigerator and when he denies, she tries to jump from the balcony. How will Mukundi deal with this?

episodesList.title: Mukundi is Not Confident
episodesList.summary: Mukundi and Indu welcome their new refrigerator in Lapataganj and also invites the villagers to take a look at it. Mukundi is not confident about the loan he has taken. Mukundi has to look after his father too.

episodesList.title: Sugandhilal Admitted In Hospital
episodesList.summary: All the villagers of Lapataganj are trying to cure Sugandhilal who has been shivering for a long time. Sugandhilal is urgently rushed to the hospital, as things get out of hand.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Fails to Repay The Loan
episodesList.summary: One of the Employees who collects the amount of loan from the customers, troubles Mamaji.  Mukundi fails to repay the loan amount. Will Mukuni and Indu get any help from Sugandhilal?

episodesList.title: Friendship Over?
episodesList.summary: Mamaji and Eilja have become best friends forever. They are stunned to see Genda Gorakhpur, who has recently arrived in Lapataganj. How long will Elija and Mamaji's friendship last?

episodesList.title: Genda Gets Attention
episodesList.summary: Elija and Mamaji are trying their best to impress Lallanji's relative Genda. Will Genda get impressed by Elija or Mamaji?

episodesList.title: Genda's Search For a Groom
episodesList.summary: Mamaji and Elija fool Genda by giving their own description to Genda as she is looking for a perfect groom. Elija and Mamaji both are trying their best to impress Genda. Will Genda find her perfect groom in Lapataganj?

episodesList.title: Elija and Mamaji Gets Romantic
episodesList.summary: Elija and Mamaji both are trying their best to impress Genda. They start being romantic and try all means to woo her. Genda does not give much importance to them. Will their hard work go in vain?

episodesList.title: Elija Gets Romantic With Genda
episodesList.summary: Elija is extremely excited about expressing his love for Genda. A massive argument takes place between the two best friends as they come to know that both have fallen in love with the same girl. Who will solve Elija and Mamaji's problem?

episodesList.title: Fight Between Mamaji and Elija
episodesList.summary: A massive argument takes place between Elija and Mamaji. Elija and Mama slap each other. Mukundi and Indu try to stop their grand fight. The whole village is going to know about their love interest.

episodesList.title: Yellow Flowers and Possession
episodesList.summary: Elija forgets the gift in front of the statue but Mamaji comes up with something. He gives Genda the gift and wishes her a happy birthday. He gives her a yellow flower and something weird happens.

episodesList.title: Who will be The Bodyguard?
episodesList.summary: Mamaji starts chasing Elija and Mausi stops him. Both of them are at each other's throat. They visit Mukundilal's house to talk to him. They are competing against each other to become a bodyguard to Gendha. Who will be the bodyguard?

episodesList.title: Elija, The Bodyguard
episodesList.summary: Lallanji introduces Elija as the bodyguard. Elija guards Gendha as they walk through the town. Mamaji gets furious at the sight of Elija taking care of Gendha and attacks him.

episodesList.title: Elija vs The Goons
episodesList.summary: Mamaji attacks Mausi instead of Elija. Mamaji confronts Lallanji and asks him why he chose Elija to be the bodyguard and not him. Some goons attack Genda. Will Elija be able to fight them and protect Genda?

episodesList.title: Friendship Blooms
episodesList.summary: The goons start attacking Elija and Mamaji intervene and starts fighting the goons. Both of them fight together but Gendha does not choose either of them as her bodyguard.

episodesList.title: Sajini Arrives
episodesList.summary: Dolly wants to go to Mumbai and become an actress. Sajini arrives with Dolly's father and he agrees that hell get her the tickets. Dolly practices pose in front of everyone and pester her father to get her the tickets to Mumbai.

episodesList.title: Dolly's Dream
episodesList.summary: Chukku is sad about Dolly trying to leave for Mumbai. Dolly is distracted by the attention she gets from the customers in the shop. She argues with her father and insists on going to Mumbai again and again.

episodesList.title: The Stranger
episodesList.summary: A stranger visits Dolly's shop and tells her that he's met a lot of actors and actresses. He tells her that he's going to Mumbai the next day and asks her to join him so that she can also act. Dolly writes a letter and disappears. Everyone starts looking for her everywhere.

episodesList.title: Dolly is Back
episodesList.summary: Chukundi and Chotu follow Dolly and manage to rescue her from the guy who plans to take her to Mumbai. Dolly comes back to her village and accepts her mistakes and regrets them. Lala gets mad at her for leaving all of them.

episodesList.title: A Thief Enters Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Mishri Mausi finds a guy in Indumati's house trying to steal slippers. Seeing her, the thief tries to run away. When caught by Mishra Mausi and other villagers, he then tries to defend himself by making up stories and fooling them.

episodesList.title: Lallanji Gets Super Excited
episodesList.summary: Lallanji goes back home to Bindumati all excited and tells her that he will be soon promoted. Bindumati is not bothered at first, but then Lallanji makes huge promises of getting her expensive things and building a house for her.

episodesList.title: Lallanji In Search For an Onion
episodesList.summary: Lallanji is desperately in need of onion and Bijji Pandey helps him to get one. While Bijji gets one from Sureeli's house suddenly a guy on the bike passes by him really fast and crushes the onion on the way. Seeing this Lallanji faints there itself.

episodesList.title: Auction For Onions
episodesList.summary: Bijji Pandey gets a piece of information about an auction taking place for onions. In order to help Lallanji to get hold of some onions, he reaches there and takes part in the auctions.

episodesList.title: Bidders Become Frauds
episodesList.summary: A couple of people who were bidders in the auction come at night to steal onions from the one who won the auction and has 10kg onions. Lallanji catches the people in the act and beats them up in front of the villagers.

episodesList.title: Bablu Leaves His House
episodesList.summary: Bablu claims that his father doesn't trust him and that is the reason he left his house. When Dablu comes and asks Bablu for the reason he tells him that he got a movie ticket which features the whole of Banaras and asks him to get a ticket for Banaras.

episodesList.title: Bijji Gets Rid Of His Sins
episodesList.summary: Bijji Pandey is told by Kachchua Chacha to get rid of his past life sins away by doing good deeds. Guddu tells him to do that by making other people happy and helping the ones in need. Bijji then goes around the village looking for people in need of it.

episodesList.title: Ghost In Suttilal's Shop
episodesList.summary: Suttilal, Mircha and Pudina are worried about a ghost's presence in their shop. Lallanji meanwhile goes to Suttilal's shop and takes some snacks with him. Seeing Lallanji go out of his shop safely makes Suttilal's relieved.

episodesList.title: Suttilal's Father's Ghost
episodesList.summary: Bijji Pandey and Guddu come to Suttilal's shop for some jalebis when a voice comes cursing them and asking them to pay first, only then they will be served sweets. Hearing that, Bijji and Guddu turn to Suttilal and question his audacity to talk to them in that manner.

episodesList.title: Buttilals Strong Decision
episodesList.summary: All the villagers roam around dancing their problems away with Buttilal's photo frame. Hearing their problems, Buttilal decides that the sweets in his shop would now be sold at the old price that was cheaper.

episodesList.title: Villagers to The Rescue
episodesList.summary: Yadavji comes to Suttilal's shop in search of Buttilal as he needs sweets for his daughters wedding. Suttilal and the other villagers come to his aid and also to help Yadavji in making his daughters marriage a successful one.

episodesList.title: Mukundilal Gets His Head Shaved
episodesList.summary: Mukundilal's father asks Mukundi and Chukundi to get their head shaved for religious purposes. Both Mukundi and Chukundi are adamant about not getting their heads shaved as people would make fun of them and stop respecting them.

episodesList.title: A Visit to Ganga
episodesList.summary: Mukundi and family along with Mamaji and Elija go for a trip to visit the holy Ganga. Mukundi's father explains everyone the importance of the river Ganga and how pure and blissful it is.

episodesList.title: Indumati Enjoying Holy Ganga
episodesList.summary: Indumati sits near the shores of Ganga admiring the beautiful river. Mukundi and Chukundi join her when she tells them that she misses her daughter Bhagyalaxmi.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Convinces His Father
episodesList.summary: Indumati brings a picture of her and a bald guy to show her father and he starts making fun of the bald guy and gets mad at Indumati for getting a picture clicked with a stranger. She wants him to realize that the bald guy is none other than Mukundilal.

episodesList.title: Mukundi and Chukundi Run Away
episodesList.summary: Thinking of a way out from getting their heads shaved, Mukundi and Chukundi run away from the Ashram. Elija tries to stop them but is unable to.

episodesList.title: In Search Of Mukundi
episodesList.summary: After Mukundi and Chukundi run away from the Ashram, Elija and Mamamji go looking for them all over town. The villagers get the news of Mukundi and Chukundi missing and pray for them coming back.

episodesList.title: Mukundi and Chukundis Disguise
episodesList.summary: Mukundi and Chukundi, as a way of hiding in town after running from the ashram, disguises as priests. Babuji and Indumati go in search for them but are difficult to find because of the disguise.

episodesList.title: Mukundi and Chukundi Return
episodesList.summary: Mukundi and Chukundi return back to their family, as Mukundi realizes when he loses Chukundi a night ago and how difficult and painful it was to find him back. The villagers are about to go in search of both of them but all of a sudden they return back to the village.

episodesList.title: Munna Arrives In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Indumati tells Mukundilal that Munna will visit and stay with them for a while. Indumati and Bindumati are very excited about his arrival. Mukundilal meets with a small accident with a stranger.

episodesList.title: Munna Saves The Day
episodesList.summary: Two chain snatchers ride on a bike and snatch Mircha's chain and were about to run away. The villagers tried to stop them but couldn't, until Munna arrives and beats them up.

episodesList.title: Munna Gets Presents
episodesList.summary: Munna gets presents for Chukundi and Bhagyalaxmi. He gets them a story reading device but Chukundi takes that away and doesn't let Bhagyalaxmi use it which makes her very sad.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Intimidated By Munna
episodesList.summary: Mukundilal is intimidated by Munna's presence as everyone around him praises Munna. Indumati asks Mukundilal to get sweets for Munna from Suttilal's shop.

episodesList.title: Diwali Celebrations In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Bijji Pandey goes to meet Sureeli and makes fun of Mausiji who gets a beating after that. Munna gets litres of milk delivered for him and eats a lot at Suttilal's shop.

episodesList.title: Wrestling In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Indumati's father who is also Munna's wrestling trainer visits her place. He trains all the villagers for a day and is disappointed by Mukundilal. Mukundilal challenges Munna for a fight.

episodesList.title: Mukundilal V/s Munna
episodesList.summary: Mukundilal faces Munna in a wrestling fight. Everyone thinks the fight is one-sided and expects Munna to win the battle, however, tables are turned during the match.

episodesList.title: Babuji Returns to Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Sajni bua listens to sad songs early in the morning which annoys Mukundilal.  Babuji comes back home all of a sudden and all the villagers gather around asking the same questions to him including Lallanji who gets a beating after that.

episodesList.title: Babuji Hospitalised
episodesList.summary: Babuji is at the hospital and the doctor says that Babuji wont be able to survive for more than ten days. Indumati and all the villagers are sentimental of the fact and don't believe that Babuji wont survive.

episodesList.title: Lapataganj Sad About Babuji
episodesList.summary: People of Lapataganj are sad about receiving the news about Babuji. Mamaji, Suttilal and Pudhina all are sad while Bijji Pandey comes back to the village after a couple of days and receives the news himself.

episodesList.title: Villagers Prepare a Funeral
episodesList.summary: People of Lapataganj prepare a funeral for Babuji and discuss it amongst themselves when Babuji walks in all of a sudden. To hide the truth from Babuji everyone makes up a lie that Lallanji had a dream about dying so the funeral is for him.

episodesList.title: Singer At Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: People of Lapataganj invite a singer for the funeral. The singer asks the people of Lapataganj to bring the person for whom the funeral is taking place for and accordingly he is gonna perform for them.

episodesList.title: Babujis Last Night
episodesList.summary: Mukundi and Indumati go to Babuji as they feel its his last night as said by the doctor. Next morning they try to wake up Babuji and he doesn't move for a while and when he does it was Chukundi sleeping in Babuji's place.

episodesList.title: Babuji Survives
episodesList.summary: The politicians of Lapataganj had prepared a whole speech and a feast on account of Babuji's death. The villagers then meet up with the politicians and give them the news which makes them angry.

episodesList.title: Indumati Learns English
episodesList.summary: Indumati tries to learn English from her daughter Bhagyalakshmi. Mukundilal and Chukundi make fun of her English and laugh at her. Bablu and Dablu go to their chacha to clear their doubts.

episodesList.title: Mamajis Treat
episodesList.summary: Mamaji on account of her first late Wife's birthday treats everyone with a samosa and a cup of tea at Suttilal's shop. Mamaji and Mukundilal then advice Bijji to find a job and start working.

episodesList.title: Tilu and Chukku Protect Sureeli
episodesList.summary: Bijji Pandey comes at Sureeli's place to meet her when he sees Tilu and Chiku with wooden sticks in their hands guarding Sureeli and letting him meet her. When Bijji doesn't go, they both start attacking him and make him go away.

episodesList.title: Bijji and Sureeli Run Away
episodesList.summary: Mausiji and Mamaji find a note from Sureeli and Bijji stating that they both are going away. The villagers go to the police station to file a report where the police attendant is Bijji's brother Ijji.

episodesList.title: Sureeli and Bijji Get Married
episodesList.summary: Sureeli and Bijji are back to get married. Elija feels emotional about him not being married. Mausiji is sad because Sureeli's father wont make it to the wedding.

episodesList.title: Strange Things In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Mircha and Suttilal head home at night when they see a strange aircraft in the sky causing strong winds and storms which causes Mircha to faint and Suttilal worried.

episodesList.title: Alien In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Mircha is stunned as she witnessed a spaceship in Lapataganj. The minister arrives to inform them about an aliens presence in Lapataganj. Bhagyalakshmi meets the alien on the way back home from school.

episodesList.title: Bhagyalakshmi Brings The Alien Home
episodesList.summary: Bhagyalakshmi encounters the alien and decides to take the alien home. She meets Eji Pandey on the way back home and she lies to him that people tried to steal her books and moves on.

episodesList.title: Bhagyalakshmi is Friends With Akka
episodesList.summary: Bhagyalakshmi brings the alien home and is friends with alien, Akka-Bakka. Indu is scared of the alien initially but everyone becomes friendly to the alien and introduces him to the people of Lapataganj.

episodesList.title: Akka
episodesList.summary: Akka-Bakka meet and greet the people of Lapataganj but run away from there to an abundant old furniture factory. Everyone follows him to find an alien family there. They bring the family to the village.

episodesList.title: Mamaji Takes The Alien Avatar
episodesList.summary: Mamaji comes to Lapataganj in the avatar of an alien and everyone believes him to belong with the other aliens. While they head to sleep in the night, Mamaji figures that they are fake aliens and tells everyone in the village about it.

episodesList.title: Minister Deals With The Aliens
episodesList.summary: The minister's people hit the family that faked to be the aliens. They break down confessing that they are farmers who lost their land and were desperate to have a decent meal, the minister gets furious but Mukundi reminds him of his duties.

episodesList.title: Mukundi has a Bad Day
episodesList.summary: Mukundi leaves home fighting with Indu, witnesses an accident. When he heads to launch a complaint at the police station he finds out about the dangerous Goldie Yadav. Goldie Yadav also gets arrested.

episodesList.title: Bhagyalakshmi Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: Mukundi involves in conflict with Goldie Yadav. But gradually, Goldie Yadav gets away from the jail. Goldie calls Mukundi and warns him about the future. Mukundi then receives a call of Bhagyalakshmi's disappearance.

episodesList.title: Mukundis Family In Danger
episodesList.summary: Bhagyalakshmi returns and informs everyone that a man told her to go to the warehouse to meet her father. Goldie Yadav is determined to scare Mukundi from being a witness. The family goes missing after someone tries to burn his house.

episodesList.title: A New Punjabi Family
episodesList.summary: A new Punjabi family comes to Lapataganj. The people of Lapataganj fail to recognize that it is Mukundi's family in a Punjabi avatar. They have changed their looks in order to stay safer before the court hearing.

episodesList.title: Goldie Visits Mahender
episodesList.summary: Goldie hears of the new Punjabi family who has moved to Mukundi's home. He visits to threaten them and Mukundi gets hit on the head. The villagers are worried and apologize for not being able to recognize them.

episodesList.title: Guptas As South Indians
episodesList.summary: People of Lapataganj are sad as they read the letter Mukundi and his family leave behind before leaving the village. Mukundi's family returns as a new south Indian family in place of them. Mukundi tries to make Indumati jealous by dancing with another woman.

episodesList.title: Mamaji Returns
episodesList.summary: Lapataganj is busy spending time with the south Indian family. They visit the Gupta's while Mukundi gets irritated about it. Mamaji returns home with a donkey.

episodesList.title: Mukundi's Father is Worried
episodesList.summary: Mukundi's father comes to Lapataganj and finds him missing and gets to know about the incident of Goldie. He is worried about Mukundi, but the family gets emotional and opens up about their reality.

episodesList.title: Lalanjis Niece In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Chukkundi is involved in a fight while a beautiful girl walks in Lapataganj. She calls herself as Lily Vajpayee. Lallanji introduces her as Leelavati, his niece.

episodesList.title: Chukkundi Loves Lily
episodesList.summary: Chukkundi is lost and dreams about Lily. The next morning Lily and Chukkundi brush while looking at each other. Lily gives him a riddle to solve. There is a debate that is happening over love.

episodesList.title: Chukkundi Tries to Impress Lily
episodesList.summary: Chukkundi wears a suit to impress Lily but she puts up another obstacle. Chukkundi cries about the troubles he has in his way. Lily spends time capturing pictures on her phone. Chukkundi is very happy about the romantic time they spend together.

episodesList.title: Chukkundi and Lily Go On a Date
episodesList.summary: Chukkundi takes Lily to the market and she opens up about the troublesome rich boy who had created troubles for her during the college days. The boys find them and both of them escape.

episodesList.title: Lallanji's Elder Bother
episodesList.summary: Lallanji's elder brother shows up in Lapataganj and Chukkundi introduces himself. He gets furious looking at Chukkundi's chemistry with his daughter, Lily.

episodesList.title: Lallan V/s Kallan
episodesList.summary: The brothers fight over who is the better one. The better one will be decided by a rickshaw race. Both are injured but they care for each others pain more than ones own.

episodesList.title: Kallan Gives a Party
episodesList.summary: Kalanji gives a party to the people of Lapataganj. Everyone thanks him and he expresses the reason for the party. Kalanji felt the selfish person he had become because of the city life and hence repented at the party.

episodesList.title: Sureeli Gets a Letter
episodesList.summary: Sureeli gets a letter to go to Nagpur. Biji Pandey promised her that he will come along, Mishri requests Ejji Pandey to come to Nagpur. The brothers start having a tiff with each other on this issue.

episodesList.title: Bijji and Sureeli's Vacation
episodesList.summary: After Sureeli's exam in Kanpur, Bijji and Sureeli escape from Mamaji's sight and head out to explore Kanpur. However, some guard holds Bijji and take him away somewhere.

episodesList.title: Bijji is a Nawab
episodesList.summary: The guards take Bijji Pandey to a palace and tell him that he belongs to their family and is the Nawab they have been waiting for since so many years.

episodesList.title: Bijji Overhears The Truth
episodesList.summary: Biji eats his meal in the Nawab style. Nawab's mother realizes the innocence of Bijji Pandey and tells him the truth about the Nawab family. How will he react to this story?

episodesList.title: Biji Pandey As Nawab
episodesList.summary: Biji Pandey decides to save the queens from the cruel Nawabs. Bijji takes over as the Nawab of the Palace and rules over everyone so that he is able to protect the others.

episodesList.title: Biji Enjoys Being a Nawab
episodesList.summary: Bijji Pandey tries to escape from the palace for a while as he wants to hunt, but is informed that hunting has now been banned. He is then stuck in a situation where two old queens try to seduce him.

episodesList.title: Ejji Saves Bijji
episodesList.summary: The Nawabs capture Bijji Pandey and threaten to kill him. Ejji Pandey finds out about them and comes to the rescue. He arrests the evil Nawabs and passes on the property to their wives.

episodesList.title: Mukundilal's Honesty
episodesList.summary: Colleagues of Mukundi plot against Mukundi because of his honesty. Mukundi prays to God to give him the strength to be the same honest man. Mukundi leaves to work but is caught up with a bad body itching.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Becomes The King
episodesList.summary: Mukundi manages to reach the office with a clean shirt. They come up with the plan of a drama and Mukundi is made the king.

episodesList.title: The Crown Caught On Lallanjis Head
episodesList.summary: Lallanji visits Mukundi's house and wears the crown meant for the play. The crown is fit tight on his head and he is unable to remove it, despite trying it several times. Mukundilal loses his cool on losing the crown.

episodesList.title: Lallanji Gets Suspended
episodesList.summary: Mukundilal fumes in anger as he gets to know that Lallanji has worn his prestigious Mukut and also tries to find a solution as he has to wear the Mukut in the play Mukutraj. PWD star Lallanji talks rudely with his Boss and thus he gets suspended. How will Mukundilal solve his and Lallanji's problem?

episodesList.title: Mukut Unlucky For Lallanji
episodesList.summary: Mamaji calls one of his closest friends, Chunnilal who happens to be Bade Babu's mukut designer. Chunnilal gets to know that the mukut is worn by Lallanji and not by Mukundilal. Lallanji reveals that the mukut has proved to be unlucky for him as he can't remove it and above all he gets suspended.

episodesList.title: Thieves Attempt to Steal
episodesList.summary: Two thieves arrive in Lapataganj to steal Lallanji's golden mukut but little do they know about heavy trouble which is waiting for them. They both fail to remove the mukut and Lallanji is found unconscious in the middle of the village. Will the villagers catch the thieves?

episodesList.title: Bade Babus Confession
episodesList.summary: Lallanji essays the role of Maharaja Shersingh and all the esteemed guests are highly impressed by Lallanji's acting skills. Bade Babu reveals a shocking truth to Mukundilal. Will Mukundilal forgive Bade Babu?

episodesList.title: The Local Politician Arrives
episodesList.summary: The local politician arrives in Lapataganj to announce that the school will be reopened, and will also provide education for adults who want to learn to read and write. But who is this Miss Mary? Join the excitement with the residents of Lapataganj in this episode.

episodesList.title: Grand Welcome Of Miss Mary
episodesList.summary: All the villagers of Lapataganj are stunned to see Miss Mary who will be their new teacher. Miss Mary is warmly welcomed by all the villagers. It seems that Elija, Chukundi and Mamaji have fallen in love with her. Will Miss Mary succeed in achieving her goal?

episodesList.title: Miss Mary has Moved to Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Miss Mary has moved to Lapataganj in an attempt to straighten out the education system in the town. She is going out of her way to discipline the laid-back townfolk. How will they take this?

episodesList.title: New Students In Marys Classroom
episodesList.summary: Love is in the air for Elija, Chotu Mama, Chukundi, Suttilal and Phudina as a new teacher has arrived in Lapataganj to educate them. Miss Mary surprised to see new students in the classroom and also requests them to leave. The ladies of Lapataganj are highly impressed by Miss Mary's dressing style and wishes to be stylish like her.

episodesList.title: Wonder Woman, Mary
episodesList.summary: Miss Mary dances all around the village and introduces herself and she tells everyone that she is here to stay. Three goons stop Mary's way and tease her.

episodesList.title: Mausi Becomes Super Stylish
episodesList.summary: All the villagers of Lapataganj are extremely upset as Mary is leaving. The villagers are stunned to see Mausi's new look as she becomes super stylish and also apologizes to Miss Mary. Will Mary forgive Mausi?

episodesList.title: Elija Becomes a Detective
episodesList.summary: Elija has become a detective to find out the wife who is planning to kill her husband in Lapataganj. Elija doubts on Mircha as she was getting angry on Suttilal. Will Elija find out the truth?

episodesList.title: Miss Marys Accident
episodesList.summary: Elija has covered almost all the places in Lapataganj and has also enquired about every couple but still, he has not managed to find out who that woman is who is planning to kill her husband. Mukundi, Elija and Chotu Mama have a plan.

episodesList.title: Chukundis Love Letter
episodesList.summary: With the help of Miss Mary, Chukundi succeeds in writing a love letter for his huge crush, Lilavati. Elija is shocked to see Mircha with an unknown man in Lapataganj. Elija firmly decides to save Suttilal's life. Who will solve the confusion?

episodesList.title: Suttilal Gets Frightened
episodesList.summary: Suttilal is afraid of his wife and Elija also reveals to Mukundilal and Mamaji that Mircha wants to kill Suttilal. Mircha is extremely angry with Suttilal's suggestion of marriage. Who is planning to kill Suttilal?

episodesList.title: Miss Marys Master Plan
episodesList.summary: The villagers share Suttilal's problem with Miss Mary and she comes up with an interesting plan to find the truth with the help of her team. Suttilal is afraid of Mircha's brother. Suttilal too believes that Mircha wants to kill him.

episodesList.title: Mircha Reveals a Shocking Truth
episodesList.summary: Mircha gets a huge shock when Suttilal reveals her that someone was planning to kill him in Lapataganj and also tries to prove it with the help of Elija but this apparently does not go down too well with Mircha.

episodesList.title: The Stone Man
episodesList.summary: Mukundi and Indu are worried after learning the news about a man who hits people with a stone when they are asleep and escapes. People in Lapataganj are in terror after listening to this news.

episodesList.title: A New Twist
episodesList.summary: There is a new twist this time, people of Lapataganj are in fear because there is someone who is creating problems for the villagers. Who is this guy, who is creating problems for the villagers?

episodesList.title: Mamaji Gets Arrested
episodesList.summary: Gappu Singh confronts Mamaji and arrests him. Mausi gets worried as Mamaji ends up in prison. Elija and Mukundilal go to visit Mamaji in prison and give him some food. What will happen to Mamaji?

episodesList.title: Encounter With The Mystery Man
episodesList.summary: Eliza dresses up and tries to catch the man who throws stones at night. Suttilal, Mircha and Elija encounter the mystery man. Mamaji is released from prison. Everyone suspects Mary. Who is the mystery man?

episodesList.title: Mystery Man Revealed
episodesList.summary: People start leaving Lapataganj because they are scared of the mystery man. Mamaji suspects Mary and follows her. Everyone plans to go out at night and catch the mystery man. Pudina is the bait and the mystery man appears.

episodesList.title: The Master Plan
episodesList.summary: Mamaji gets slapped by Mary. Mamaji, Elija, Suttilal and his wife tell everyone about previous night's events. Mary tells everyone her family background. All the town's people join together and plan to catch the mystery man.

episodesList.title: The Plan Execution
episodesList.summary: All the people of Lapataganj dress up like the mystery man and execute the plan they made with Mary. The policeman arrives and rounds up all the people to catch the mystery man. Who do you think is the mystery man?

episodesList.title: Caught Red-handed
episodesList.summary: Mukundilal arrives at the right moment and catches the mystery man. Everyone is shocked as the mystery man reveals his face. The mystery man also reveals the reason behind his deeds. After catching the culprit everyone is happy and safe.

episodesList.title: The Water Problem
episodesList.summary: Everyone in the town gets sick after taking a bath or drinking the water. They get together and discover that the water is polluted. How will they solve this problem?

episodesList.title: Price Hike Each Time
episodesList.summary: After finding out that the water is polluted, Mukundi and the others take the problem to Nethaji who tells them that he'll send the tanker. Raja babu arrives in Lapataganj with the water tanker. But the tanker price increases everyday.

episodesList.title: The Tanker and The Lake
episodesList.summary: Every day the price of water supply increases and the people of Lapataganj decide not to get water from the tanker. Mukundilal and Indu go to fetch water from the lake and discover something and end up getting beaten.

episodesList.title: Water Crisis Again
episodesList.summary: The local minister after watching how the villagers are wreaking havoc due to the water crisis gives in and takes an initiative to solve the problem.

episodesList.title: Elija Seeks Blessings
episodesList.summary: Elija gives a good news to everyone and wishes to get married as soon as possible. He seeks blessings from Mukundi, Indumati and Mishri. Mukundi tries to tell Elija that a man is happy if he is unmarried.

episodesList.title: Elija's Dream Shatters
episodesList.summary: Elija's truth comes out that he is totally different from the picture that was sent to the girl's family. They find out the truth and insults Elija as they refuse to accept him. Everyone starts questioning Elija why he lied.

episodesList.title: Chotu to Find Elija
episodesList.summary: Elija gets kidnapped by a group of people. Nobody in Lapataganj is aware of it. Chotu realizes it later and shouts to gather everyone. No one has any information about Elija.

episodesList.title: Elija In Gujarat
episodesList.summary: Strangers take Elija to Gujarat to get him married to one of their girls. He is excited as he always wanted to get married. Elija starts following the instructions that he has been asked to follow.

episodesList.title: Decision has to be Made
episodesList.summary: Mishri and Mamaji reach Gujarat to save Elija from getting married. But then he is stuck as the opposite party pleads him to get married. When Elija refuses, they point the gun on him and scare him.

episodesList.title: Elija Against Chotu
episodesList.summary: Chotu starts liking Kokila and decides to get married to her. Elija, on the other hand, stops him from getting married to Kokila. What is the reason that Elija is stopping him ?

episodesList.title: Chotu Gets Cheated
episodesList.summary: The celebration has started and everyone is excited about the wedding. Chotu is very happy and wants to enjoy his life. But when Chotu sees Kokila, he faints and does not want to wake up. What did Chotu see?

episodesList.title: Lapataganj In Shock
episodesList.summary: Everyone in Lapataganj eagerly waits to welcome Chotu and his wife. Indumati is super excited and starts welcoming them with all the rituals. As soon as Bindumati unveils Kokila's face, everyone in Lapataganj stands shocked.

episodesList.title: Raoji and Kokila's Marriage
episodesList.summary: Raoji reveals that he and Kokila love each other. Everyone is surprised but happy at the same time. They get married immediately and Mamaji, Eliza and Mausi return to Lapataganj. Eliza shares a piece of good news. What could it be?

episodesList.title: Lazy Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: All the people of Lapataganj feel very lazy and yawn the whole day. Mary suggests an idea to make the people feel refreshed. Someone new comes to Lapataganj.

episodesList.title: The Argument About The Fence
episodesList.summary: Bubblyji, Lovelyji and the others are now staying in Lapataganj. They start arguing and everyone gathers around. What are they arguing about? And how will they solve it?

episodesList.title: The Permission Letter
episodesList.summary: Lallanji and Mukundilal decide to help out Bubblyji and Lovelyji. They go to meet Murali Babu and discover something about Raja Babu. Mausi faces some issue at her house. What could it be?

episodesList.title: The Brave Ladies Of Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Everyone is gathered in front of Mausi's house. Mukundilal and the others return and share the news about the permission letter. All the ladies of Lapataganj go to meet Murali babu and start quarrelling.

episodesList.title: Nethajis Sudden Visit
episodesList.summary: The ladies return and hand over the permission letter to Bubbly Singh and Lovely Singh. Nethaji visits the people of Lapataganj and informs them about the race. Mukundilal and Indumati start quarrelling.

episodesList.title: The Exhibition
episodesList.summary: Lallanji comes to town with a car. Everyone is getting ready to go to the exhibition. Nethaji cuts the ribbon and inaugurates the exhibition. Everyone comes to the exhibition to check it out.

episodesList.title: Miss Mary's Stalker
episodesList.summary: The people of Lapataganj have fun at the exhibition and play different games. Raja babu plants a small bomb but it blows up on his face. Mary falls down but a stranger catches her. The stranger happens to be stalking her for a long time.

episodesList.title: The Grand Circus
episodesList.summary: Bubbly and Lovely rehearse for the circus. All the people of Lapataganj come to see the circus. Everyone watches the circus with great excitement.

episodesList.title: Men vs Women
episodesList.summary: The people of Lapataganj divide themselves into two groups and compete against each other in various games. Mary's stalker appears again and helps Mary to make sure that the women win the competition.

episodesList.title: Lakhan Saves The Day
episodesList.summary: The men get on the twister and later Lakhan notices something wrong with the twister. He tells the operator to stop the ride but it is so fast that it cannot be stopped.

episodesList.title: Grand Prize Stolen
episodesList.summary: Throughout the day Lakhan helps Mary win all the games without her knowing. Mary wants to win the grand prize. But Lakhan steals it while the lights are out. What will Lakhan do now?

episodesList.title: The Bike Sport
episodesList.summary: Lakhan gives the stolen prize to Mary. The next day everyone comes to the exhibition again. They start quarrelling with each other there itself. Later, Lakhan agrees to participate in the bike sport.

episodesList.title: The Arm Wrestling
episodesList.summary: Lakhan does amazing bike stunts in front of everyone.  Meanwhile, the wrestling match starts and all the Lapataganj women are against a lady and the men against the hefty man.

episodesList.title: Winner Of The Grand Prize
episodesList.summary: Elija defeats the man. Mukundilal receives the prize on behalf of all men. A fire starts at the exhibition and Lakhan goes into the fire to save Mary, but something falls on Lakhan and he faints on the spot.

episodesList.title: Lakhan The Inspector
episodesList.summary: Mary loses her phone and goes to file a complaint at the police station. But they refuse to file one. Lakhan gets mistaken as the inspector. He scolds the others for not taking the complaint made by Mary.

episodesList.title: Dolly Returns to Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Chukku gets into trouble with a girl. Everyone defends Chukku. Mukundilal scolds and beats Chukku in front of everyone. Someone stops Mukundilal from beating Chukku. Who could it be?

episodesList.title: Dolly's Big Break
episodesList.summary: Dolly fights her way in to meet the director. She acts in front of him and he proclaims her the star of the movie. The shooting starts. Back in Lapataganj, Chukku gets into trouble.

episodesList.title: Dolly Returns to Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Chukku gets into trouble with a girl. Everyone defends Chukku. Mukundilal scolds and beats Chukku in front of everyone. Someone stops Mukundilal from beating Chukku. Who could it be?

episodesList.title: The Fake Inspector
episodesList.summary: Dolly tells everyone about her acting career. Everyone is happy for her. Lakhan who is still acting as the police comes to Mukundilal's house to see Mary.

episodesList.title: Mary's Smart Move
episodesList.summary: In order to impress Mary, the policeman presents a number of cellphones in front of her. When she reveals that she already has her phone, his plan backfires.

episodesList.title: Dolly is In a Movie
episodesList.summary: Dolly is the center of attention for everyone in Lapataganj as her movie is going to release. Together, they go to the theatre along with Dolly to watch her on the big screen.

episodesList.title: Heatbroken Dolly
episodesList.summary: Dolly rushes out of the theatre crying as she is hardly seen in the movie. Lallan calls up the director to question him regarding Dolly's part in the movie.

episodesList.title: Elections On Head
episodesList.summary: As elections are on head, the politicians distribute sweets in the Lapataganj village. The villagers are surprised seeing an actress contest for elections in Lapataganj.

episodesList.title: Dirty Politics
episodesList.summary: People in Lapataganj are unable to decide who to vote for in the elections. All the contesting politicians try to convince the villagers to vote for them.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Refuses to Vote
episodesList.summary: Mukundi is upset as he fails to convince Indu to cast a vote for the elections. When Mary asks him to accompany him to cast his vote, he refuses.

episodesList.title: The Election Day
episodesList.summary: Lallan is taken under arrest for illegal voting. Mukundi is relieved to see Indu vote and follows her to cast his vote as well.

episodesList.title: Bajrang Dreams About Mary
episodesList.summary: Bajrang follows Mary around as soon as she leaves her house. At the police station, he day-dreams about her all day.

episodesList.title: Bajrang Sneaks Into Mary's House
episodesList.summary: Bajrang enters Mary's house without her consent and tries initiating a conversation. In the night, he sneaks into her house with an intention to rob.

episodesList.title: Dolly's Suggestion to Bajrang
episodesList.summary: Dolly suggests Bajrang to start maintaining a distance from Mary so that she gets attracted to him. He sets up his workplace in the middle of Lapataganj so that he can lay his eyes on Mary all day.

episodesList.title: Bajrang's Plan Backfires
episodesList.summary: Mary is injured when Pappu's plan goes wrong and a bomb blasts in her room. Seeing Mary in a pathetic condition, Bajrang runs away.

episodesList.title: Chotu Makes Bajrang Furious
episodesList.summary: Bajrang is furious after finding out that Chotu was responsible behind giving him an electric shock. He loses his calm on seeing Chotu tries to beat him up.

episodesList.title: Mary is Impressed
episodesList.summary: Chukundi teaches Dolly how to ride a scooter but she gives everyone around her a hard time. Mary is impressed by Bajrang as he stops the scooter at the right time saving many people's lives.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Against Corruption
episodesList.summary: Mukundi yells at a man who tries to bribe him. He humiliates the corrupt man in front of everyone in Lapataganj. Seeing his loyalty, Lallan gets into a deep thought.

episodesList.title: Lallan Suspended From Pwd
episodesList.summary: When Lallan's boss talks about his suspension from PWD, he is devastated. When the villagers celebrate his fifteen years in PWD, he is silent and loses his ability to think.

episodesList.title: Lallan's Lie is Caught
episodesList.summary: Lallan lies at home saying that he is going to the office but has nowhere to go. Chotu goes to PWD for some work and is shocked to find out that Lallan has been terminated on the account of corruption.

episodesList.title: Lallan Accused Of Corruption
episodesList.summary: Lallan is suspended from PWD on the allegations of corruption. He is depressed and disturbed about the accusation. He gives up on life and decides to commit suicide.

episodesList.title: Cucumber Seller Blackmails Lallanji
episodesList.summary: A cucumber seller who figured about Lallanji's suspension blackmailed him to sell his cucumbers. Lallanji shares this with his Lapataganj friends. Mama ji heads to take care of the cucumber stall to teach the seller a lesson.

episodesList.title: Lallan Tries to Suicide
episodesList.summary: Lallan is humiliated and decides to suicide. However, he isn't able to find a way to do so. Mukundi catches him on one of his trails and yells at him to not do so. He warns everyone in Lapataganj to keep an eye on Lallanji.

episodesList.title: Lallan's Chacha Lashes Out
episodesList.summary: Lallan's Chacha visits him and finds out that Lallan has lost the job. He furiously leaves for which Lallan is depressed yet again. He continues to think of ways he can suicide.

episodesList.title: Lallan's Innocence is Proved
episodesList.summary: Lallan ji fearlessly slaps a corrupt politician, looking at his fearless and strong nature people of Lapataganj thoughtfully went on with enquiring the allegations posed at him. Lallan is proved to be innocent and the culprit is caught.

episodesList.title: Minister's Revenge
episodesList.summary: One of the ministers intends to take revenge from Mukundi and so heads to Lapataganj and informs them of a Hanuman temple that is coming up in order to preserve the heritage with a wicked plan.

episodesList.title: Homeless Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: The minister has the wicked plan of breaking homes of Lapataganj residents and construct a big grand temple in its place. Mukundi, Mausi and Elija are to leave their homes and village.

episodesList.title: Elija Fights Back
episodesList.summary: Elija is furious about losing his shop and home and so decides to step on the bulldozer and not let it break any building. The police comes down to the rescue.

episodesList.title: Sand Fight In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Mary mistakenly throws a sand ball on Lallanji which he in turn mistakenly throws on Mukundi, the scene changes soon into a sand fight among the villagers.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Gets Into Trouble
episodesList.summary: Champa texts Mukundi on his mobile to meet her outside his house, but then she takes his mobile and sends a text to herself to make it seem as if Mukundi asked Champa to meet her. Indumati catches Mukundi and Champa talking and giggling late at night.

episodesList.title: Panchaayat In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: To solve Mukundi and Champa's case, the villagers decide to have a panchayat to decide who is truthful and who isn't. The villagers defend Mukundilal of not being a liar but an innocent, honest man.

episodesList.title: Angry Young Man, Chukundi
episodesList.summary: Chukundi gets to know about the allegations that have been put on Mukundi. He is super angry and comes running towards Champa to harm her. Mukundi tries to control him but Chukundi's rage reaches new heights. He has promised himself that he will not spare Champa.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Gets Suspended
episodesList.summary: Indumati cannot bear the news that Mukundi has been suspended from his office. She insists that she will talk to the higher authorities. Mukundi calms her down as nothing can be done now.

episodesList.title: Chukundi's Plan
episodesList.summary: Chukundi, Elija, Lallanji and Chotu decide to find the truth and so they plan to play the same game with the culprit. They reach her house in disguise and force her to listen to their fake plan.

episodesList.title: Bablu's Conversation With Dablu
episodesList.summary: Bablu and Dablu sit together to have a general conversation. But Dablu has a question for Bablu as he wants to know why kids get scared when they look at Bablu. Bablu does not understand that kids are scared because of Dablu's horrifying looks.

episodesList.title: Indumati Supports Chukundi
episodesList.summary: Mukundi teases Chukundi when he shows so much concern towards Mukundi. Indumati gets angry and starts yelling at Mukundi. She supports Chukundi and scolds Mukundi for spoiling her life as he does not believe her as well as Chukundi.

episodesList.title: Chuku's Examination Day
episodesList.summary: Indumati freaks out when she sees Mukundi and Chukundi sleeping instead of getting ready for examination. It takes Mukundi time to get back into his senses as he has not slept trying to teach Chukundi.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Slaps Chukundi
episodesList.summary: Chukundi comes dancing and tells everyone how good was his paper. Everyone is celebrating Chukundi's happiness except Mukundi and Indumati. Mukundi slaps Chukundi as Indu found out that Chukundi had leaked the paper a day before the examination.

episodesList.title: Chukundi Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: After being slapped, Chukundi gets upset and leaves the house without getting noticed. Indumati realises it later that Chukundi is not in the house. Everyone looks for Chukundi but does not get any news about him. Where is Chukundi?

episodesList.title: Chotu Steals The Diamonds
episodesList.summary: Mukundi's boss has given him a small pouch with diamonds. While returning home, mid-way Chotu steals the diamonds and run somewhere. Mishri is not ready to accept this.

episodesList.title: A Sigh Of Relief
episodesList.summary: Mukundi comes back home after a complete day of disappearance. Indumati is furious and questions where he was. Mukundi lies to her about being with a friend all night to avoid more confusion.

episodesList.title: Chotu or Raju?
episodesList.summary: The police have been hitting the thief in and out. Mishri and Elija reach the police station to rescue Chotu. But when they ask the police to stop hitting Chotu, the person addresses him as Raju. Who is Raju?

episodesList.title: A Lot Of Confusion
episodesList.summary: Raju runs out of the jail and the policemen follow him to some extent and then they lose his tracks. But instead, they come across Chotu who had been hiding for a while. Will Chotu be able to save himself?

episodesList.title: Gola Don In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: Gola don is in Lapataganj with his gang. He got the news that the diamond is in Lapataganj and he has made the plan to steal it. But unknowingly, Chotu enters the house where the Gola don is residing.

episodesList.title: Don Interrogates Chotu
episodesList.summary: Chotu makes them believe that he is Raju but the don wants 100% proof. So he starts interrogating Chotu and asks him the code that he was assigned.

episodesList.title: The Ominous
episodesList.summary: Dablu asks Bablu why did he not go to the wedding that he was supposed to. Bablu tells him the ominous things that happened because of which he was asked not to come to the wedding.

episodesList.title: Suttilal's Shop On Stake
episodesList.summary: Customers complain to Suttilal after having his samosas. One of the customers gets angry and warns him that he will be complaining about him in the police station. Mirja blames Chotu for it.

episodesList.title: Indumati's Aspirations
episodesList.summary: No one in Lapataganj is crossing their doors as instructed by the priest. Indumati prays and aspires to make Mukundi a big officer in life. She insists that she will make him the prime minister one day with her prayers.

episodesList.title: Suttilal Gets a Big Order
episodesList.summary: With Baba's blessings, everyone's work is going great in Lapataganj. Suttilal gets the biggest order as he is to serve a number of people who will be attending a birthday party.

episodesList.title: Lallanji Finally Gets a Long Tie
episodesList.summary: Lallanji is super happy to get Bindumati back from her home. He elates in happiness and gives all credits to his long tie. Pappu is confused as he does not understand what is going on.

episodesList.title: Confused Pappu
episodesList.summary: Mishri welcomes Pappu with all her heart back to her house. Pappu is confused as he is not able to understand if anyone knows his truth or not. Elija does not understand Mishri's behaviour.

episodesList.title: Dablu's Infinite Questions
episodesList.summary: Bablu tells Dablu about the robbery news that took place in another village. Dablu starts asking questions and wants to know where are those stolen jewellery kept.

episodesList.title: Goons In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: The robbers come to Lapataganj to hide as they were being chased by the policemen. For their safety, they dig a hole near Suttilal's shop and put the stolen jewellery in there and leave from Lapataganj.

episodesList.title: Suttilal and Mircha's Lie
episodesList.summary: Suttilal finds the jewellery that was hidden near his shop. He and his wife decide not to tell this to anyone and keep the treasure to themselves. Mirja lies about the jewellery that she is wearing.

episodesList.title: Everyone is After The Treasure
episodesList.summary: Everyone in Lapataganj is praying and hoping to get the treasure. No one knows about the treasure that Suttilal has. One member from each family is busy in digging to find the treasure.

episodesList.title: Goons are Back
episodesList.summary: The goons that left their stolen jewellery in Lapataganj are back, but this time in disguise. They have come back to know where are the pieces of jewellery, so they start questioning everyone.

episodesList.title: Lapataganj At Gunpoint
episodesList.summary: The robbers get very angry when no one tells them about the jewellery. They gather everyone around and point gun at each one of them. Will everyone tell the truth to save themselves?

episodesList.title: Saved Surprisingly
episodesList.summary: The robbers lose their calm and control and take Suttilal and his wife in their hands. Suddenly, the politicians come protesting and asking for votes. Everyone takes a sigh of relief as they feel they are saved.

episodesList.title: Mishri Hits The Goons
episodesList.summary: Mishri hits the goon's father and he faints. She gets scared and starts telling that she did not do it intentionally. Everyone tries to wake him up by doing something or the other.

episodesList.title: Dolly In Pain
episodesList.summary: The leader of the gang is angry and he decides to harm Suttilal and equal all that he has lost during all this time. Dolly is in pain after eating something unhygienic. How will everyone take care of her?

episodesList.title: Suttilal Gets Arrested
episodesList.summary: Everyone blames Suttilal and Mirja for giving them stale food and for which they get food poisoning. The policemen come and arrest Suttilal for selling poisonous food.

episodesList.title: Suttilal In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Suttilal is forced to shut his shop. He is accused of selling food that is dangerous for consumption. The police is trying to help them out but find no edge in the case. Mukundi then recalls and gives a lead to the police.

episodesList.title: Suttilals Case Solved
episodesList.summary: Suttilal is depressed and wishes to give up on life after losing his shop. Mukundi comforts him. The police finds the culprit, Tappu pailwan is found guilty and arrested. Everyone gathers to celebrate with him.

episodesList.title: Mukundi has a New Boss
episodesList.summary: Mukundi has a new female boss at work. She is quite impressed with his work and asks him to have lunch with her. They also spend a lot of time with each other after work. Indumati is busy waiting for him at home.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Fakes a Friend
episodesList.summary: Mukundi comes back at home after a complete day of disappearance. Indumati is furious and questions where is was. Mukundi lies to her about being with a friend all night to avoid more confusion.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Brings The Fake Friend
episodesList.summary: Mukundi tries to arrange for a friend so Indumati doesn't check on him. He gets a friend and introduces him to Indumati. However, the same guy whom he mentions shows up.

episodesList.title: Mukundi's Boss Comes Home
episodesList.summary: Mukundi's boss comes to Lapataganj  in search of Mukundi. Indumati gets excited and welcomes her home, Mukundi cuts her out when she tries to apologise for the previous night and hides what happened that night from Indumati.

episodesList.title: Mukundi Confesses The Truth
episodesList.summary: Madam looks at the clip Indumati was wearing and asks her to return it. Indumati tells her that Mukundi got it for her and demands to know the truth. Mukundi confesses he lied because of Indumati's habit of doubting on him.

episodesList.title: Return Of Chammeli
episodesList.summary: Chammeli returns to Lapataganj. Mausi is angry with her and does not appreciate it. Mamaji opens a chat store and tells Mausi that Chammeli returned with the condition that Mamaji has to start working.

episodesList.title: Rich Man In Love With Dolly
episodesList.summary: A rich man has fallen in love with Dolly and visits Lapataganj everyday. He buys everything for everyone and distributes it among the poor. Dolly and the villagers are astonished.

episodesList.title: Dolly Signs a Movie
episodesList.summary: A director visits Lapataganj and asks Dolly to work in a movie. Dolly gets super excited. The next day everyone waits for the hero. Nanhe turns out to be the hero of the movie and the shooting begins.

episodesList.title: Nanhe is Jealous
episodesList.summary: Nanhe and Dolly are shooting the movie. Dolly is able to give a better shot with Chukku. Nanhe is angry and jealous of Dolly and Chukku's friendship.

episodesList.title: Nanhe and His Father Worried
episodesList.summary: Nanhe's father comes to Lapataganj and tells him to stop the shoot. They are shocked about the withdrawal of nine crores from their bank account. Chukku comes in at the same time in a lavish car.

episodesList.title: Nanhe Learns a Lesson
episodesList.summary: Chukku rents a car and comes in a suit to teach Nanhe a lesson. Nanhe is furious and leaves from there. Chukku reminds him that he can't buy friendship or love with money before he leaves.

episodesList.title: Bijji Pandey Becomes a Lawyer
episodesList.summary: Biji Pandey fights a case and becomes a government lawyer, After which, he wishes to take his wife home. Mausi however, refuses to let Surili go to Biji's home.

episodesList.title: New Guest In Lapataganj
episodesList.summary: There is a new guest Mukundi and Indumati await. Bulbul looks exactly like Surili and so everyone is confused but Mukundi clarifies that Bulbul just looks like Surili but isn't her.

episodesList.title: Biji Flirts With Bulbul
episodesList.summary: Bulbul goes around Lapataganj and Biji follows her and tries to flirt with her. Mukundi and Indu head to hit Biji when she stops them saying that she very well knows to take care of such boys.

episodesList.title: Biji Wants to Marry Bulbul
episodesList.summary: Biji Pandey falls in love with Bulbul and wants to marry her. Mukundi objects as Biji is married, he is asked to divorce Surili to be able to marry Bulbul.

episodesList.title: Biji Divorces Sureeli
episodesList.summary: Biji brings in divorce papers to Mukundi and Bulbul starts crying as she herself is Sureeli, Biji tells her he knew her reality and that is why he did it.

episodesList.title: Lalanji Fights With Suttilal
episodesList.summary: Lalanji had his boss come over for evening snacks. His boss gets very upset about the stale samosas and leaves. Lalanji gets angry on Suttilal for such a dish.

episodesList.title: Work Swap Between Suttilal and Lalanji
episodesList.summary: Suttilal goes to Lalanji's office and meets Bade Babu who tells him that his name is Raj Kumar. While Lalanji goes to Suttilal's shop, both of them do worst things at each other's work. What will happen to them?

episodesList.title: Suttilal and Lalanji Suffers
episodesList.summary: Suttilal and Lalanji swap houses with each other. Both of them don't feel comfortable in their houses. They pretend in front of each other and act as if everything is fine.

episodesList.title: Stubborn Suttilal and Lalanji
episodesList.summary: Mukundilal and Elija go to visit Sutti Lal where he is working as Raj Kumar. There they see that he is not doing good work. Meanwhile, Bade Babu visits Lapataganj to visit Sutti Lal's shop where Lalanji is working as Sutti Lal.

episodesList.title: Trouble In Work
episodesList.summary: Mukundilal advices Sutti Lal to go back to his shop but Suttilal is stubborn. Both of them suffer at each other's workplace. Food Inspector comes to inspect Sutti Lal's shop because of unhygienic food sold by Lalanji and Suttilal gets into trouble.

episodesList.title: Back to One's Own
episodesList.summary: Bade Babu finally figures out that Raj Kumar is Sutti lal. Everyone is shocked. And Lalanji ends up getting Sutti Lal's shop closed. They apologize to each other and go back to their own job and house.

episodesList.title: Increased Vegetable Price
episodesList.summary: The vegetable vendor comes to Lapataganj to sell vegetables but sells them for a very costly price. Each day each vegetable's price increases and decreases. The people are confused. Some people buy costly vegetables but some cannot afford it. What will the people do?

episodesList.title: The Brave Indumati
episodesList.summary: Indumati and the others join together and decide not to buy vegetables from the vendor. They chase him out of Lapataganj. So the vendor comes back the next day with more men. What will they do now?

episodesList.title: Indumati's Plan
episodesList.summary: Indumati comes up with a plan to distract the men and snatch the vegetables. They start dancing to distracting the men and take the vegetables. They even call someone important to help them stop the goons.

episodesList.title: Chukku's Alert About The Event
episodesList.summary: Chukku alerts everyone in the village about the event and everyone is excited. What could the event be? Is it something good or will it again bring sadness in Lapataganj?

episodesList.title: The Couple Dance
episodesList.summary: Mukundilal, Indumathia and Mausi return back to Lapataganj. Everyone is rehearsing for the couple dance. Everyone pairs up and goes home. Mausi doesn't have anyone.

episodesList.title: The Day Of The Event
episodesList.summary: Mausi is sad that she doesn't have anyone to participate with. Everyone is busy preparing and decorating for the event. Mukundilal hosts the flag. All the couple dance one by one. Someone gives a letter to Eliza. What could be written in the letter?

episodesList.title: The Best Couple
episodesList.summary: All the couples are done with their performance. They danced in the rain. Eliza will now announce the winner. The winner will get the title of The Best Couple. Who will be the winner?

title: Autograph
summary:
Autograph is an Indian Malayalam-language teen drama television series that aired on Asianet from 5 October 2009 to 6 April 2012. The series delves into the high school and college lives of five close friends who are known as "Five Fingers" and explores themes of friendship and relationships.
At the 2011 Asianet Television Awards, it received several accolades, including Best Director (Sujith Sunder), Best Screenplay (Anil Bass), Best Editor (Joby Pannapara), Best New Face – Female (Shaalin Zoya), and Best Actress – Character (Sona Nair). The show was re-telecast on Asianet Plus during the 2020 COVID-19 lockdown, though it was quickly replaced by the Malayalam-dubbed Mahabharat (2013–2014).
plot:
The first season centers on James, Rahul, Sam, Nancy, and Mridhula, a group of high school students known as Five Fingers. The story begins when Rahul and Mridhula witness a murder committed by businessman Chandra Kumar "C.K." and his henchman Stephen Gomez. At school, the group begins a rivalry with a new student, Deepa Rani, whose mother, Sethu Lekshmi, later becomes the principal. After vacation, Five Fingers are wrongfully accused of killing their schoolmate Rosy, but their innocence is proven when Stephen, the true culprit, is arrested with help from their friend Jyothi. Later, C.K. illegally releases Stephen, who—with Deepa's help—attempts to murder Mridhula but accidentally kills Jyothi. Concerned about legal consequences, Deepa turns against C.K., who then tries to kill her; however, Five Fingers manage to save her. She reveals the truth behind Jyothi's murder to the group, while James learns from Sethu Lekshmi that he is C.K.'s stepbrother. Meanwhile, C.K. enters a by-election and kills Stephen to safeguard his political reputation. During C.K.'s TV interview, Five Fingers manipulate the broadcast to expose him, resulting in his failure and arrest for Stephen's murder.
The second season is set in a law college, where Five Fingers—now with Deepa replacing Mridhula, who moves to the United States—gets involved in a series of conflicts with 4 the People, a gang of fifth-year LLB students led by Mahendran. Later, a new party is formed by Five Fingers, who go on to win the college union election, further escalating their rivalry with the gang. When rumors of an affair between his sister Priya and James surface, Mahendran forces her into an arranged marriage with his cousin Prakash Madhavan, a convicted criminal. However, the marriage is called off, and James's unexpected death impacts Deepa's mental health. She recovers with Dr. Premkumar's treatment and, alongside her friends, begins investigating the cause of James's death. However, when James, presumed dead, returns alive, Deepa is found missing, and C.K. emerges as the prime suspect. But, James and his friends discover that Deepa was kidnapped and murdered by Stephen, who was also presumed dead. After capturing James, Rahul, and Sam, Stephen holds them in his custody, but the trio manages to escape. The season concludes with C.K. killing both Stephen and his henchman Ram, after which James and his friends discontinue their course due to Deepa's absence.
tagline: The first season centers on James, Rahul, Sam, Nancy, and Mridhula, a group of high school students known as Five Fingers.

title: Ek Veer Stree Ki Kahaani – Jhansi Ki Rani
wikiTitle: Ek Veer Stree Ki Kahaani – Jhansi Ki Rani
summary: Ek Veer Stree Ki Kahaani – Jhansi Ki Rani ('Story of a brave woman – Queen of Jhansi') is an Indian historical drama based on the life of Lakshmi Bai, the Rani of Jhansi. The series was directed by Jitendra Srivastava and written by Rajesh Saksham, Ila Dutta Bedi, Malavika Asthana, Mairaj Zaidi and Virendra Singh Patyal. It premiered on 18 August 2009 on Zee TV with Ulka Gupta playing young Queen Lakshmi Bai. On 8 June 2010, the story moved on several years and Kratika Sengar portrayed the Queen from there on. The last episode aired on 19 June 2011, completing 480 episodes. This show replaced Maayka serial time slot.
plot:
14 years old Manikarnika "Manu" lives with her father, Moropant Tambe, a pandit in the Bithoor court of Peshwa Baji Rao II and Nana Saheb. Manu is trained in the art of war by Tatya Tope. She despises the British rule of India and combats against it. Manu is a thorn in the side of Manson, a British official.
Soon, she marries the king of Jhansi, Gangadhar Rao Newalkar. The court of Jhansi is headed by Raghunath Singh and Narsingh Rao. Her name changes to Lakshmi Bai, and her life changes drastically with various plots to separate and kill her and the King. At Jhansi a servant, Moti Bai, collaborates with British officer Captain Fraser but changes sides after realising her mistakes. Meanwhile, the three evil sisters-in-law of the King, Sukku, Lachchu and Jankibai also hatch various plots teaming up with the Britishers headed by Lord Dalhousie for capturing the throne of Jhansi but fail. Lakshmi Bai takes the form of Kranti Guru to combat the Britishers which everyone in the palace including the king is unaware of except some. Samar Singh initially being a dacoit turns good because of Lakshmi Bai and becomes one of her major support system in combating the Britishers. King Gangadhar and Queen Lakshmi Bai starts becoming closer understanding each other after various misunderstandings. When the British officer Marshal kills Prachi, Bajirao's little daughter, he is killed by Lakshmi Bai in revenge. When the King discovers that Kranti Guru is Queen Lakshmi Bai, he is angered while their relationship deteriorates. He agrees with a British officer that Kranti Guru will not be accused of Marshal's death if he hands over Queen's friend, Samar Singh. When Queen saves Samar, the King being furious gives her an ultimatum of either being a Queen in the palace or a rebellion leaving the palace. Lakshmibai demands him to accept both of her forms, the King not being ready for it, she leaves. She sees the British mistreating the villagers which was before a part of Jhansi. She takes an oath of not leaving the place until the villages are freed from the British and starts to live there with the name Rani without unveiling her real identity, persuades them to fight while she finds Samar Singh there and also comes across Karma who wants to kill the king for which British officer Captain Martin promises Karma the leadership of the villages if he works for them. Karma starts suspecting Lakshmibai.
Years passed but Lakshmi Bai and Gangadhar miss each other. While Gangadhar is in search of her, she hopes that her oath would be fulfilled soon and the King would accept both of her forms. Karma is saved by Lakshmibai after being betrayed by Marshal, who becomes an ally of her. Martin challenges Lakshmi Bai who was disguised as a man named Raja to fight against a mad man to retrieve the villages under Gangadhar's spectation. Her true identity is exposed to everyone. Gangadhar apologizes and accepts Lakshmi Bai, takes her back. Martin retires, and is replaced by Captains Malcom and Ross.
After several failed attempts to kill the King, Captain Nelson kills Ross and frames Samar Singh and hanged while Lakshmibai attempts a lot to prove his innocence. Rani visits Baji Rao, who is severely ill in Bithoor; he dies while Manson tries to conquer Bithoor Fort. Rani fights victoriously, and cuts off Manson's leg. She gives birth to Damodar Rao, and adopts Anand Rao. Nelson kills Damodar, Ali Bahadur kills the King and Captain Hamilton is sent to Jhansi to subdue it. Rani renames Anand Damodar and wages war against the East India Company against the backdrop of the Indian Rebellion of 1857. Hamilton pits Jhansi and the city of Orchha against each other; Orchha's queen, Ladai Sarkar, is sympathetic to the British and holds a grudge against Jhansi. Ladai Sarkar gets hold of Tatya Tope, Raghunath Singh and Ghaus Khan, captures them, and locks them up in her palace but Rani Lakshmi Bai frees them and wins the battle. The victorious Rani returns to a conquered Jhansi, which she reclaims after threatening the life of the 1st Earl of Dalhouise. Nelson frames her for the death of the king of Mot, and when Ladai Sarkar (the king's sister-in-law) captures Rani he betrays Sarkar. The queens become allies in prison, and after Rani escapes she kills Nelson. Queen Victoria sends General Hugh Henry Rose, who helps Hamilton capture Prince Damodar, as a replacement. After Rani saves her son's life she kills Hamilton; Hugh Rose's army attacks Jhansi Fort, where many of her loyal followers and allies including Guass Khan, Karma, Moropant Tambe, Jhalkaribai, Ladai Sarkar and Kashi die. Bithoor is conquered while Nana Saheb flees to Nepal.
Before the final battle Tatya Tope brings his army for Rani Laxmibai's aid. Rani Laxmibai leaves her fort and goes to Gwalior along with her army. In Gwalior she fights her final battle where she is betrayed by the Prime Minister of Gwallior. In the final battle, Raghunath Singh in an attempt to divert the Britishers is shot dead. During the course of battle, Rani Laxmibai is severely injured when the British general repeatedly stabs her in the abdomen with a sword. Later she is shot in the stomach. She also suffers a head wound. She hands over Damodar Rao to Tatya Tope and tells him to safeguard the prince before taking on the Britishers for one final time. Moments before her death she tells a villager to burn her body so that the British will not touch it.

title: Idhayam
summary:
Idhayam (transl. Heart) is a 2009 Indian Tamil-language soap opera on Sun TV. A prime-time serial, it was broadcast from 10 August 2009 to 3 February 2012 at 7:30PM (IST) and 10:00PM (IST) for 627 episodes.
The show is produced by Sathya Jyothi Films, directed by B. Nithyanandam and written by Annakill R.Selvaraj. It was also aired in Sri Lanka Tamil Channel on Shakthi TV.
plot: Prasad rapes Nandhini in a forest by spraying chloroform out of lust. A few years later she is about to marry Shankar, Prasad's friend, much to Prasad's surprise. He still lusts and wants her as his mistress. But his heart suddenly changes, and he gets an urge to marry her. Nandhini's mother-in-law Kalyani is against his wish and make sure he cannot even touch her shadow. As possessive and chauvinist husband Shankar disowns Nandhini for losing her virginity before their marriage.

title: India's Got Talent
summary: India's Got Talent is a televised Indian Hindi language talent show series and is part of the Got Talent franchise. The program is produced and distributed by Fremantle and Syco Entertainment. The show aired on Colors TV until season 8. Since season 9 the show is airing on Sony Entertainment Television.

title: Pavitra Rishta
summary: Pavitra Rishta (International title: Sacred Relationship) is a 2009 Indian Hindi-language soap opera produced by Ekta Kapoor of Balaji Telefilms that aired on Zee TV from 1 June 2009 to 25 October 2014 starring Ankita Lokhande, Sushant Singh Rajput, Hiten Tejwani, Asha Negi, Shakti Arora, Rithvik Dhanjani and Karan Veer Mehra in lead roles . It is an adaptation of Tamil television series Thirumathi Selvam. It is the third longest-running Indian television series of Zee TV.
plot: Homely and hard-working Archana Karanjkar marries Manav Deshmukh, a mere mechanic. They gradually come to support and fall in love with each other, despite their respective families being at loggerheads, as Manav’s mother, Savita, lied to Archana’s mother about his profession. Manav's brother Sachin dies in an accident while his fiancée, Shravani, is pregnant, and Manav is asked to take Shravani's responsibility. Archana and Manav divorce for the future of Shravani's unborn child, and Archana leaves Mumbai to complete her higher education.

title: Na Aana Is Des Laado
summary: Na Aana Is Des Laado (lit. Never Come to This Country, Dear Girl) is a 2009 Indian Hindi-language soap opera that premiered on 9 March 2009 on Colors TV and finished on 27 July 2012, reaching a total of 870 episodes. The show portrays various social evils practiced in India. It is sixth longest-running Indian television series of Colors TV. A sequel series titled Laado 2 - Veerpur Ki Mardani premiered on Colors TV in 2017.
plot:
Veerpur, is a village that still practices female infanticide. Bhagwani Devi, the Sarpanch of Veerpur forbids females birth by any of her servants or daughters-in-law or the woman of Veerpur. Sia Singh stands against her. To silence Sia, Ammaji uses her son Raghav to woo and wed her. But he falls in love with and supports Sia against Ammaji. Other pregnant women in Veerpur try to escape. Raghav and Sia save a number of female infants.
Sia becomes the Sarpanch, as she is voted from majority of female population in Veerpur. Ammaji's real daughter Amba, enters and unites with Ammaji who turns Raghav and Sia out. They return when Sia is pregnant in spite of Ammaji's attempts to terminate her pregnancy. As later Ammaji's old enemy Bhanupratap attacks, Sia dies while delivering twin girls, Dia and Jahnvi. Raghav dies in a fire. The twins separate—Dia lives with Ammaji and Jahnvi with Amba.

title: Dance India Dance
summary:
Dance India Dance (also called by the acronym DID; tagline: Dance Ka Asli ID D.I.D.) is an Indian Hindi-language dance competition reality television series that airs on Zee TV, created and produced by Essel Vision Productions. It premiered on 30 January 2009. Here the judges are called Masters and Mithun Chakraborty was called Grand Master (until season 6). Season 7 premiered with a different concept. This show is a remake of the Bengali show Dance Bangla Dance which premiered on 2007. After 3 successful seasons of Dance Bangla Dance, Zee TV remade this show for all-over Indian participants.
The show features a format where dancers from a variety of styles enter open auditions held in Indian metropolitan cities to showcase their unique style and talents and, if allowed to move forward, are then put through mega-audition rounds of auditions to test their ability to adapt to different styles. At the end of mega audition, the top 18 dancers are chosen as finalists who move on to compete in the competition's main phase where they will perform solo, duet and group dance numbers in a variety of styles in competition for the votes of the broadcast viewing audience which, combined with the input of a panel of judges, determine which dancers will advance to the next stage from week to week.
The show features a variety of Indian cultural and international dance styles ranging across a broad spectrum of classical, Contemporary, Bollywood, Hip-hop, Jazz, Kalaripayattu, Salsa, and Musical theatre styles, among others, with many sub-genres within these categories represented.  Competitors attempt to master these styles in an attempt to survive successive weeks of elimination and win a cash prize and often other awards, as well as the title of India's Best Dancer - CJ. The show is choreographed by Indian choreographers, such as Mudassar Khan, Marzi Pestonji, Tanuj Jaggi and Mini Pradhan. The show has won several television awards for Most Popular Dance Reality Show.
createdBy: Ashish Golwalkar, Ranjeet Thakur, Bimal Unnikrishnan
