title: Kitani Mohabbat Hai
summary:
Kitani Mohabbat Hai (How Much I Love You) is an Indian soap opera which aired on Imagine TV from 19 January 2009 to 25 September 2009. Kitani Mohabbat Hai 2 started airing on 1 November 2010. Season 2 is not a continuation; it stars the same leads in a different story.
Season 1 was launched at Krishna Cottage in Mumbai days before the premiere.
plot:
This tale of pure love begins as Arjun, the son of business tycoon DK Punj, is shown confined in a jail. He refuses to seek his release on bail. Ganga Rai, a young lawyer, is determined to find his story out. Arjun emotionally reveals the past.
Arjun meets and falls in love with Aarohi Sharma, a simple aspiring singer from Shimla. Her father Hariprasad runs a Gurukul, her widowed sister-in-law Purvi, and her sisters are Antara and Sur. As Hariprasad retires, Aarohi is assigned as Arjun's associate to support her family. Materialistic and arrogant, Arjun doesn't treat her well, as being the son of a separated couple, he hates his mother and so all women. Aarohi continues to stand up to him, which attracts Arjun and softens his heart towards her, and they gradually develop feelings for each other.
Meanwhile, their ties are strengthened as Salil Mittal, Arjun's best friend and the son of D K Punj's business partner, whose family live with the Punjs, falls in love with Purvi and marries her against his family's wishes.
During this, Arjun finds out that Aarohi's mentor and mother figure is his mother, Savita, who abandoned him in childhood. He feels betrayed by Aarohi as he believes that she is plotting with his mother to break his heart. As a result, he breaks off their alliance, only to find out it was his father's fault that his parents separated. During the time that he is unaware of the truth, he constantly taunts and insults Aarohi and makes her feel worthless. After Savita tells Arjun the truth, he wishes to reconcile with Aarohi, but they meet in an accident.
After recovery, Aarohi goes to Mumbai to pursue her music career. Arjun also, leaves his wealth and his family behind to support Aarohi in her new journey. He protects her in Mumbai and clears her path whereas Aarohi feels like he is there to ruin her opportunities. Aarohi soon meets Karan. Her family supports her relationship with Karan, but she still loves Arjun. After an incident in which Arjun rescues Aarohi from a building which caught fire, the two reconcile and are finally happy again. However, this doesn’t last long.
Arjun’s father, D K Punj, scared of having another middle-class "greedy" woman in a wealthy family, reveals to Aarohi that Arjun is adopted and blackmails her with this long-kept secret to leave Arjun. Aarohi thus accepts Karan's proposal to marry her to protect Arjun from the “truth.” When Arjun finds this out, he kidnaps Aarohi from her wedding venue, and her family rushes to rescue her. Her father falls from the terrace and dies in the scuffle, and Arjun is blamed and arrested for his murder.
As Arjun finishes his narration, the show leaps to the present, and Ganga Rai begins to try proving him innocent to prevent his hanging. She finds Aarohi, who is now a famous singer who goes by “Akshita Hariprasad”, and asks her to help Arjun, but she refuses. Meanwhile, Salil's mother, Padmalakshmi Mittal, has footage of that night and accidentally misplaces it in some packages. Aarohi receives the CD, which proves Arjun's innocence and rushes to save Arjun, and is successful, but unfortunately does not meet him.
Both of them leave for Shimla, where they first met, and wish to retire there from a life of chaos. As Aarohi runs towards the train, Arjun reaches his hand out to her, like the first time they met, and they unite. The last scene shows them marrying happily ever after.

title: Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai
summary: Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai (transl. What Is This Relationship Called?), also known by the initialism YRKKH, is an Indian Hindi-language romantic family drama television series that airs on StarPlus and streams on Disney+ Hotstar. It premiered on 12 January 2009 and is the longest running Indian television soap opera. The series is produced by Rajan Shahi under Director's Kut Productions. It previously starred Hina Khan, Karan Mehra, Shivangi Joshi, Mohsin Khan, Pranali Rathod, Harshad Chopda, and Shehzada Dhami. Currently, it stars Samridhii Shukla and Rohit Purohit.
plot:
Akshara and Naitik are a happily married couple blessed with their two children – Naksh and Naira. As times throws them challenges like Naitik slipping to coma and Akshara handling business and little Naksh in his absence, them getting his father Rajshekhar married to his doctor Devyani, a domestic abuse survivor, after the death of his biological mother Gayatri, them getting ousted from home after Naitik's uncle Mahendra dies and raising the children away in Cape Town and setting up their successful restaurant business and their return to home after several years, Naksh's passionate relationship with Nayantara and the heartbreaking breakup at wedding altar and a teenaged Naira fleeing to Rishikesh due to a misunderstanding regarding her friend's death and coming back home after several years, their love and understanding surviving these tests of time.
As Akshara dies in an accident, the story moves forward with grown up Naira and Kartik. Misunderstandings tests their love as Naira battles with a brain clot and infertility after the death of their first child while Kartik battles to create his own identity as he gets to know about his biological mother Saumya dying due to her mental illness and his father Manish and step-mother Swarna hided this truth from him and his sister Keerti so that they doesn't form wrong interpretation for their mother and Swarna sacrificed her own son Shubham for same. Kartik and Naira get blessed with a son Kairav and a daughter, also named Akshara but Naira dies in an accident and a depressed Kartik meets Sirat, a boxer and Naira's lookalike who immediately bonds with his little children as a mother. They eventually fall in love and marries and get blessed with a daughter Aarohi. However their deaths causes a strain in relationship of the sisters as the truth about Naira and Sirat gets revealed turning Aarohi possessive for her mother.
Story now moved forwards with now grown up Akshara, an aspiring and passionate singer and Abhimanyu. After initial confusion around Aarohi being the prospective bride, the two gets married while Aarohi too marries Abhimanyu's half-brother Neil. But tragedy strikes when a pregnant Aarohi loses Neil and a depressed Abhimanyu blames Akshara for it and divorces a pregnant Akshara who eventually finds solace with Abhinav in Kasauli and gives birth to her son Abhir and starts practicing her law. Soon Abhinav dies only to be revealed that Akshara is pregnant with his child. Akshara and Abhimanyu decides to reconcile but Aarohi's death banishes them from the family for the sake of Aarohi's daughter Ruhi. Soon Akshara is left all alone once again when Abhimanyu and Abhir too die and she dedicates her life to her daughter Abhira in Mussoorie.
Story moves forward with now a successful lawyer Akshara raising her final year law aspirant daughter Abhira. Soon Abhira clashes with Armaan, Akshara's former mentee who highly regards Akshara as his idol while Akshara too regards him as her best student. Abhira's stalker Yuvraj killing Akshara forces Abhira and Armaan to get married only to reveal that Armaan was in love with now grown up Ruhi who married his half-brother Rohit on his behest. Soon both couples fall for each other while Ruhi offers to be a surrogate to Abhira and Armaan's child after they lost their first child while saving Ruhi's son Daksh while Abhira and Armaan leave home as Armaan's biological mother Shivani is being revealed alive and was kept away from him as his father Madhav married her against family and treated Armaan as an outsider throughout his life for same. But the happiness is short lived as Shivani and Rohit die in a blast and the couple faces challenges again as Armaan faces anxiety regarding the unborn child and fears that it's fate will be same as his childhood around the family and raises their only daughter Maira as a single parent away from Abhira in Mount Abu but repents and reconciles with her after Geetanjali, who forcefully married him dies while trying to kill them. Then the couple faces challenges raising Maira when his client Meher's driver's daughter Vani enters the scene and due to Armaan's step-mother Vidya and Meher's created misunderstandings Abhira goes away with Vani renaming her to Mukti for years. As Meher dies, the misunderstandings get cleared and the family reunites by adopting Mukti but their happiness is short lived as Armaan battles with brain tumour. As he defeats his tumour the couple battles new challenges while resuming their law practice after a pause along with the teenaged girls now entering their college lives.
The series also parallelly focuses on the stories of Akshara's brother Shaurya with her best friend Varsha, her cousin Anshuman with Jasmeet, Naitik's sister Rashmi, a survivor of domestic abuse raising her daughter, also named Gayatri alone and finding love again in Sameer and his cousin Nandini's story with his best friend Mohit as they navigate raising their adopted son Yash and biological son Anmol and also on Devyani's children Naman with Karishma and Muskaan with Alok. The second generation parallelly focuses on story of Naksh with Keerti, a domestic abuse survivor, as they navigate through a second chance in love while Gayatri's story too with Kartik's youngest uncle Samarth and Anmol's story with Kartik's cousin Mansi. The third generation parallelly focuses on story of Aarohi, also a doctor and Neil along with Kairav with Abhinav's sister Muskaan. The fourth generation parallelly follows the stories of Ruhi and Rohit along with cousin sisters of Armaan, Charu and Kiara with Abhir who turns out to be alive and Armaan's cousin brothers Krish and Aryan with Tanya and Disha respectively.

episodesList.title: Akshara is suspicious of Varsha and Shaurya
episodesList.summary: To Akshara's relief, Rajshri stops pressurising her to marry. Meanwhile, she becomes suspicious that Varsha and Shaurya are more than just friends. She starts keeping an eye on them. Will she find out the nature of the relationship between the two?

episodesList.title: Akshara celebrates Gangaur
episodesList.summary: Akshara decides to fast on the day of Gangaur. She and the other women of the family make an idol of Shankarji. Meanwhile, Dadi and Gopi Dadi talk about the sacrifices Gopi Dadi has made for the family. In the meantime, Varsha and Shaurya spend time with each other.

episodesList.title: Akshara decides to marry
episodesList.summary: Akshara decides that she is ready to marry and her family members are happy to hear this. Meanwhile, Varsha finally admits to Akshara that she is in love with Shaurya. How will Akshara react?

episodesList.title: Varsha reveals her love for Shaurya
episodesList.summary: Akshara counsels Varsha and asks her to talk to Shaurya about marrying him. Varsha tells her fiancé that she is in love with Shaurya. Meanwhile, preparations for Akshara's marriage are on in full swing.

episodesList.title: Varsha's mother stops her from going to college
episodesList.summary: Shankari tai informs Rajshri that Varsha's fiancé has refused to marry her and that Varsha is hurt by the rejection. Akshara tells Dadi it was planned by Varsha. Meanwhile, Varsha's mother stops her from going to college. What will Varsha do now?

episodesList.title: Shaurya apologises to Varsha
episodesList.summary: The women in the family buy sarees for the marriage. Dadi asks Rajshri to also buy a saree for Shaurya's wife. Meanwhile, Shaurya apologises to Varsha for not supporting her and professes his love for her in front of his father. How will the family react to Shaurya and Varsha's relationship?

episodesList.title: Varsha's mother meets Vishambhar
episodesList.summary: Dadi is elated when Akshara tells her about the relationship between Shaurya and Varsha. However, Akshara is worried about Varsha. Meanwhile, Varsha's mother comes to meet Vishambharnath and Rajshri. Will Vishambharnath finally consent to the marriage?

episodesList.title: Akshara chooses her husband
episodesList.summary: Family members tease Akshara as she is confused about which boy to choose when Rajshri gives her an album with photos of prospective grooms. Finally, with Varsha's help, she makes her choice. Meanwhile, Vishambharnath has also selected someone for Akshara!

episodesList.title: Akshara is unhappy
episodesList.summary: Vishambharnath is excited about Akshara's engagement but she is not happy with the person her parents have chosen. However, she decides to compromise and obey them. Rajshri learns of her dissatisfaction and tries to tell Vishambharnath.

episodesList.title: The groom's family likes Akshara
episodesList.summary: Rajshri is scared to tell Vishambharnath that Akshara does not like the groom as Vishambhar announces that the groom's family likes her and are ready for marriage. Shaurya informs Dadi about Akshara's unhappiness. What lies in store for Akshara?

episodesList.title: Akshara likes Rituraj
episodesList.summary: Akshara likes Rituraj and Rajshri is happy with her choice. Shankari assures Vishambharnath that Rituraj belongs to a good family. However, all the ladies give Akshara different advice regarding how she should behave with Rituraj and she finally asks for Dadi's help.

episodesList.title: Akshara and Rituraj meet
episodesList.summary: Akshara and her family meet Rituraj and his family and she likes him. However, they are too shy to talk to each other in front of their families and thus talk to each other in private. Akshara is still nervous and speaks very softly.

episodesList.title: Akshara gets ready for marriage
episodesList.summary: Akshara and Rituraj go for a walk and she tells him that she wants to be a singer. Varsha teases Akshara and her family member are extremely happy about her impending marriage.

episodesList.title: Vishambharnath is happy with Rituraj
episodesList.summary: Vishambharnath approves of Akshara's marriage with Rituraj. Akshara is happy with Rituraj. The preparations for marriage are on in full swing. However, Rajshri tells Varsha that she should not come to meet Akshara often. What will Varsha do?

episodesList.title: Varsha asks Akshara to meet Rituraj again
episodesList.summary: Akshara asks Dadi, Chachi, Dhaniya and Rajshri about their love stories. Rajshri narrates her story. Meanwhile, Varsha tries to find out if Akshara really likes Rituraj and convinces her to meet him once again. Does Akshara really love Rituraj?

episodesList.title: Akshara meets Rituraj again
episodesList.summary: Family members prepare for Shaurya's engagement. Meanwhile, Varsha and Akshara make an excuse and meet Rituraj. Akshara is very nervous about the meeting. Should she have listened to Varsha?

episodesList.title: Shaurya and Varsha get engaged
episodesList.summary: Dadi and Rajeshwari tell Shaurya that he is engaged to Varsha for his entire life. Kunwar promises to make the same jewellery for Varsha and Akshara. Akshara is praised by the guests who have come for Shaurya's engagement.

episodesList.title: Rituraj's family reject Akshara
episodesList.summary: Akshara is depressed when she learns from Rajshri and Shankari's conversation, that Rituraj's family has rejected her. She daydreams of Rituraj while dancing in Shaurya's baraat. Varsha and Shaurya perform the wedding rituals. What will happen to Akshara?

episodesList.title: Vishambharnath learns the truth
episodesList.summary: Varsha's wedding goes on smoothly. Rajshri goes through the wedding rituals even though she is depressed about the decision of Rituraj's family. Vishambhar also becomes furious after learning about the rejection.

episodesList.title: Akshara tells Dadi that she met Rituraj again
episodesList.summary: When Rajshri tries to console Akshara, she says that she already knows about the rejection. Dadi is shocked when Akshara reveals that she met Rituraj, but asks Akshara not to mention it to her father. What will Akshara do now?

episodesList.title: Varsha feels guilty
episodesList.summary: Rajshri tells Vishambharnath that Rituraj's family rejected Akshara because she had wanted to be a singer. Vishambharnath asks Shankari to demand an explanation from Rituraj's family. Varsha feels guilty because she had instigated the meeting with Rituraj and now Akshara is lying to save her.

episodesList.title: Akshara tries to apologise
episodesList.summary: Akshara is upset after hurting her parents. Omi and Dadi try to convince Vishambharnath and Rajshri that Akshara is innocent. Dadi tells Akshara to personally apologise to Vishambharnath. Will Vishambharnath forgive Akshara?

episodesList.title: Anil asks for an increment
episodesList.summary: Vishambharnath breaks his fast and forgives Akshara, but feels guilty for not understanding her. Dadi gets emotional when Akshara hurts herself. Meanwhile, Rajshri requests Varsha not tell her mother about Akshara's rejection.

episodesList.title: Vishambharnath is missing
episodesList.summary: Varsha's mother and her friends become upset as Shaurya doesn’t accompany Varsha for the 'pag phere ki rasam' but Varsha convinces her mother that she is very happy at her in-laws’. Meanwhile, Rajshri and Akshara are tense after Vishambharnath leaves the house. Where did Vishambharnath go?

episodesList.title: Varsha and Akshara are upset
episodesList.summary: Varsha and Akshara are upset as Varsha's mother is made to wash Shaurya's feet as part of a ritual. Vishambharnath returns home to Rajshri after Akshara finds him at the temple and apologises. Dadi plans to have Satya Narayan puja at home.

episodesList.title: Shankari Tai predicts the future
episodesList.summary: Rajshri gives the keys of the house to Varsha, explains her responsibilities and invites the neighbours to Varsha's 'mooh dikhai'. Shankari Tai plays a game of chausar with Varsha, Dhaaniya and Akshara, and predicts their future. What did Shankari Tai predict for Akshara?

episodesList.title: Shaurya's rant
episodesList.summary: Vishambharnath and Rajsri are worried for Akshara. Shankari Tai informs them that another groom's family is coming to see Akshara on the occasion of Holi. Meanwhile, Varsha tries to cheer up Shaurya but he rants at her. Why did Shaurya rant at Varsha, but later realises his mistake?

episodesList.title: Akshara agrees to meet the groom
episodesList.summary: Rajshri is delighted when Akshara tells her that she is ready to meet the groom. On the day of Holi, Shaurya and Varsha enjoy each other's company. Anshu paints Bhola's face with gulal. Bhola mistakenly puts colour on Sulekha. What will Sulekha do?

episodesList.title: Akshara agrees to meet the groom
episodesList.summary: Rajshri is delighted when Akshara tells her that she is ready to meet the groom. On the day of Holi, Shaurya and Varsha enjoy each other's company. Anshu paints Bhola's face with gulal. Bhola mistakenly puts colour on Sulekha. What will Sulekha do?

episodesList.title: Shankari Tai's lie
episodesList.summary: Shankari Tai gets drunk and tells Akshara that she lied about her future but Varsha tells Akshara not to believe her. Akshara tells Vishambharnath that she does not want to meet Naitik alone. Why did Shankari Tai lie to Akshara? What did she foresee?

episodesList.title: The Singhania family arrives
episodesList.summary: Akshara is nervous and tells Varsha that she cannot become a good wife but Varsha encourages her. Vishambharnath welcomes the Singhania family. How will the first meeting between Naitik and Akshara pan out?

episodesList.title: Akshara has no answers
episodesList.summary: After Akshara serves tea to Naitik, Vishambharnath asks Varsha to take the two to the terrace so that they can talk alone. However, Akshara is still nervous and does not answer Naitik's questions. What will Naitik do?

episodesList.title: Vishambharnath does not agree
episodesList.summary: Naitik tells his mother he thinks that Akshara does not like him. Shankari Tai informs Rajshri that Naitik wants to meet Akshara. Though Vishambharnath does not agree, Dadi asks Varsha to arrange the meeting. Will Vishambharnath know that his orders have been disobeyed?

episodesList.title: Dadi arranges a second meeting
episodesList.summary: Bhabhima confronts Gayatri for not consulting her about the marriage. Meanwhile, with Naitik wishing to know Akshara better, Dadi decides to arrange a second meeting. Later, Rajarshi informs Vishambharnath that they have called Kunwar Sha and Dadi tells Akshara about Kuku Narang.

episodesList.title: Akshara is stunned to see Naitik
episodesList.summary: Varsha gets worried when Shaurya comes to know of Naitik's meeting with Akshara. However, Dadi asks Akshara to get ready after Varsha tells her of the plan. She is stunned to see Rishika bring Naitik to the room. Will this second meeting yield results?

episodesList.title: Akshara and Naitik fight
episodesList.summary: Akshara and Naitik argue about Aishwarya Rai and Katrina Kaif. Family members overhear the argument and stop their fight. Rajshri asks Akshara to apologise and Gayatri taunts Naitik. Will Akshara and Naitik bond?

episodesList.title: Naitik decides
episodesList.summary: Akshara tells Varsha about Naitik's rude behaviour and Naitik talks to Mohit about her. Meanwhile, Rajarshi does not tell Vishambharnath about the argument as he gets ready to announce Naitik's decision. Will Naitik agree to marry Akshara?

episodesList.title: Is Akshara ready?
episodesList.summary: Naitik agrees to marry Akshara and the family members are in a celebratory mood. However, Shaurya tells them to ask Akshara’s opinion and Varsha tries to find it out. Vishambharnath and Rajshri also want to know Akshara’s opinion. Is Akshara ready to marry Naitik?

episodesList.title: Akshara decides
episodesList.summary: Akshara is tense about Naitik's proposal. They try to learn each other's opinion about their marriage with Mohit and Varsha's help. Rajshri tells family members that Akshara has made a decision about the marriage. What is Akshara's decision?

episodesList.title: Family obligations
episodesList.summary: Vishambharnath asks Akshara to continue her studies. However, at the college, the lecturer questions Akshara and Varsha for being irregular. Meanwhile, Raj Shekhar Singhania asks Naitik to join the family business. Will Naitik join the business?

episodesList.title: Naitik and Akshara meet
episodesList.summary: Naitik wants to meet Akshara. Varsha convinces her and takes her to the meeting spot. Naitik introduces Mohit and Rishi to Akshara and Varsha spends some time with her. Meanwhile, Dadi praises Rajshri for her marital life with Vishambharnath.

episodesList.title: Naitik and Akshara go on a date
episodesList.summary: Naitik and Akshara go to a resort on a date. Naitik orders vanilla ice-cream on and talks about his dream girl. Meanwhile, news of this date does not sit well with Bhola. Later, Varsha seeks help from Shaurya but is upset at his behaviour. Will Shaurya be able to convince Varsha?

episodesList.title: Akshara and Varsha return late
episodesList.summary: Naitik asks for Akshara's phone number as they wait for Varsha at the college. Later, Varsha and Mohit ask Akshara and Naitik respectively about their date. Akshara talks about her date with Varsha, and are questioned by Rajshri for returning home late. Will Rajshri know about the date?

episodesList.title: Awaiting the first call
episodesList.summary: Rashmi seeks help from Naitik to complete her college project. Later, Rajshri teaches household work to Akshara but she burns her hand while cooking. Meanwhile, Akshara waits for Naitik's call as Varsha asks her to call him. Mohit, too, convinces Naitik and asks him to speak to Akshara. Will Naitik agree? Who will make the first call?

episodesList.title: Varsha's advice for Akshara
episodesList.summary: Rashmi talks about Naitik's behaviour to Raj Shekhar Singhania and Naitik apologises. Meanwhile, Varsha reminds Akshara about her exams and asks her to study and teases her on seeing her exam notes. What has Akshara written on the exam notes?

episodesList.title: Ananya is missing
episodesList.summary: Dadaji asks Rajshekhar to inform Vishambharnath about the time for the Tilak ritual. Akshara talks with Varsha about her confusion regarding the exams and rituals. She practises writing answers fast, and tries to read as much as possible. Will Akshara be able to prepare for the exams?

episodesList.title: Trouble in the exam hall
episodesList.summary: Kaveri is surprised to learn that Akshara wants to come for the Tilak ceremony. Naitik gives Shaurya’s phone number to Gayatri but Dhaniya answers the phone. Meanwhile, Akshara and Varsha write their exam. However, the examiner refuses to accept their papers.

episodesList.title: Akshara skips Tilak rites
episodesList.summary: Dadaji becomes upset as he comes to know that Akshara will attend the Tilak ceremony. However, Naitik asks Akshara not to come to the Tilak ceremony as Dadaji will not like to break any marriage ritual. Meanwhile, Bhabhima does not want Akshara to continue with her education. Will Akshara be able to continue her studies?

episodesList.title: Akshara won't study further
episodesList.summary: Varsha tells Dadi that Naitik stopped Akshara from going to Tilak ceremony. The Singhania family members put Tilak on Naitik’s forehead and bless him. Meanwhile, Dadaji tells Naitik that he cannot approve of Akshara’s college education. Naitik tells Dadaji that Akshara does not want to study further.

episodesList.title: Varsha fails
episodesList.summary: Akshara is delighted to see her name in the result board. However, Varsha fails in the exam. Upon Akshara's requests, her teacher agrees to take Varsha's exam once again. Meanwhile Akshara comes to know that Naitik does not want her to study further. How will she react?

episodesList.title: Akshara's education is a problem
episodesList.summary: Bhabhima tells Dadaji that Akshara wants to study after marriage, but he does not agree. Dadaji orders Raj Shekhar to ask Akshara's family to stop her studies. Mohit tries to convince Naitik that she should continue her studies after marriage. Will Naitik allow Akshara to study?

episodesList.title: Varsha wants to drop out
episodesList.summary: After Dadaji asks him to take responsibility of their family business, Naitik requests Dadaji to allow Akshara to study after marriage, but receives a scolding. The Maheshwari family, meanwhile, is shocked to learn Varsha does not wish to continue her studies.

episodesList.title: Naitik drops Akshara home
episodesList.summary: Varsha gets emotional while giving her notes to Akshara. Naitik tells Mohit that he has requested Dadaji to allow Akshara to continue her education. After college, Naitik stops Akshara, and convinces her to let him drop her home. How will the family react when they learn this?

episodesList.title: A case for education
episodesList.summary: Akshara is delighted when Naitik wishes her well for the exam. Varsha is happy when Omkarnath gifts her honeymoon tickets. However, Shaurya is shocked to learn that Varsha has quit college and asks Akshara to convince her to complete her studies. Meanwhile, family members try to convince Dadaji to allow Akshara to study.

episodesList.title: Naitik wants to meet Akshara
episodesList.summary: While, Varsha and Shaurya pack for their honeymoon, Naitik is delighted that Dadaji has agreed to Akshara's education after marriage. He asks Akshara to meet him inside the college library. Akshara is upset as Rajeshwari wants to accompany her to the college. How will Naitik and Akshara meet?

episodesList.title: Varsha refuses to study
episodesList.summary: Naitik arrives at Akshara's college to meet her but she comes with her mother. However, with the help of Akshara's friend, he still manages to speak with her. Meanwhile, Shaurya asks Varsha to prepare for her examinations, but she does not want to. Will Varsha study?

episodesList.title: Varsha cannot find Shaurya
episodesList.summary: Rajshri is worried about Akshara's health. Mohit calls Akshara's house to talk to her but Rajshri picks up the phone. Meanwhile, Dadaji scolds Naitik for reading a book on the dining table. Later, Varsha is tensed when she does not see Shaurya after waking up. Where did Shaurya go?

episodesList.title: Nandini's arrival
episodesList.summary: Naitik and Akshara meet at college and he reads her a book. Meanwhile, Rashmi tells Akshara that she calls Rajshri 'Bhavana'. Bhabhi Maa informs that Nandini is coming. Gayatri requests her not to tell Nandini about Naitik's marriage. Will Nandini know the truth?

episodesList.title: Nandini is upset
episodesList.summary: Nandini is upset that she was not told anything about Naitik's marriage. Nandini's mother tells her that she was not informed so that she does not get upset at Naitik, being the younger one, getting married first. Meanwhile, Naitik waits for Akshara at the college. Akshara's friends tell her that she should make him wait.

episodesList.title: Akshara is upset at Naitik
episodesList.summary: Kaveri feels sad that her daughter, Nandini, is unmarried and consoles her. While Nandini still retains the same affection for her family, she is upset, due to which Naitik cannot go to meet Akshara.

episodesList.title: A misunderstanding
episodesList.summary: Nandini is excited about Naitik's marriage and wants to meet Akshara. However, Naitik is upset that he could not meet Akshara. He starts messaging Akshara hoping that she might not be angry with him. Meanwhile, Shaurya and Varsha pretend to not know each other. What is wrong between Shaurya and Varsha?

episodesList.title: Shaurya invites Varsha
episodesList.summary: Nandini feels that she could not make her parents happy. She also wants to help Naitik and Akshara in their exam preparations. Meanwhile, Shaurya expresses his feelings to Varsha and invites her to stay in his room. Will Varsha agree?

episodesList.title: The wrong gift
episodesList.summary: Nandini and her family members visit Akshara. Naitik calls up Akshara and asks her to impress Nandini. Rajshri and her family members buy anklets for Nandini and greet Naitik's family. They are shocked to see Nandini on a wheelchair, and realise that they have chosen the wrong gift for Nandini.

episodesList.title: Nandini likes Akshara
episodesList.summary: Nandini likes Akshara and her family and wants to help her with her studies. In more good news, the Maheshwari family comes to know that the Singhania family is suitable for Akshara. However, Naitik gets tense when Vishambharnath receives his calls. Meanwhile, Shaurya convinces Varsha to write her exams.

episodesList.title: Dhanya likes Bhola
episodesList.summary: Rajshri gives permission to Naitik to talk to Akshara. Nandini explains Akshara's subject to Naitik but he is tense after learning Akshara's subject is different. Meanwhile, Shaurya helps Varsha in her studies. Dhanya likes Bhola, and asks Dadi for her hand in marriage. Will Dadi agree?

episodesList.title: Naitik suspects Akshara
episodesList.summary: Dadaji scolds Naitik for sleeping late, and then gives him some office work, which worries Naitik. Later, Naitik and Mohit reach the college library to meet Akshara, but see her with another boy. Naitik gets suspicious. Who is the boy?

episodesList.title: Dhanya agrees to marry a widower
episodesList.summary: Akshara is upset with Naitik for suspecting her after seeing a boy helping her pick books. Everyone is shocked to hear that Shankari has brought a proposal for Dhanya. The alliance is with a widower who has 2 kids. Dhanya accepts the proposal. Why does Dhanya agree when she likes Bhola?

episodesList.title: Dhanya is upset
episodesList.summary: Both Naitik and Akshara are sad about their argument. When Naitik's family plans to purchase jewellery, Nandini wants a special one for Akshara. Meanwhile, Dhanya weeps thinking about her future. Rajshri and others think that they should allow Dhanya to get married and it would be unfair to send Dhanya with Akshara. What will happen to Dhanya?

episodesList.title: Shankari leaves a message
episodesList.summary: Shankari compels Akshara to go shopping with Naitik's family. Later, when Naitik and Mohit enter Akshara's room, she starts screaming. Meanwhile, Shankari leaves a message for Rajshri and family. What is the message?

episodesList.title: The Singhania family's rules
episodesList.summary: Naitik meets Akshara and he apologises for his behaviour. Later, when the Maheshwari family arrives at the Singhania house to select wedding jewellery, Rajshri begins to worry on seeing the family's many rules. Will Akshara be able to adjust to the Singhania family?

episodesList.title: Akshara must to learn to cook
episodesList.summary: Anshuman demands halwa from Akshara and Rajshri tells her to learn to cook and prepare the dish. Rajshri also asks Dhanya if she would like to stay with Akshara after Akshara's marriage or wants to get married. Dhanya asks for some time. What will Dhanya decide?

title: Agnihotra
summary: Agnihotra (transl. Healing Fire) is an Indian Marathi language television series which aired on Star Pravah. It is directed by Satish Rajwade and produced by Shrirang Godbole under the banner of Indian Magic Eye Productions. It premiered from 27 November 2008 and ended on 30 April 2010.
plot:
The Agnihotri clan has had an important tradition to follow- looking after the upkeep of the auspicious Agnihotra, a special fire enkindled for generations, ever since fire was not easy to come by/make. This traditionally enabled the Agnihotri family to attain prominence in society as a revered and respected household, abundant with knowledge of traditional Hindu rituals and a centre for wisdom and respect.
This story follows the Agnihotris of Guhagar, settled in Nashik since long back, spearheaded by the patriarch, Vinayak (Appa) Ganesh Agnihotri, a respectable figure in the city and the upholder of a staunch tradition of worshipping Lord Ganesha along with the Agnihotra.
Appa has seen the decline of the city people depending on the Agnihotra as fire making became ever so easier over the past few generations, but Appa has kept the city close with a knack of bonding people together, thanks to his knowledge of Ayurveda and his generous and caring nature. However, Appa has also seen his children, Chintamani, Mahadev, Rohini, Shripad, Usha and Dinesh drift apart from one another due to differences, something which he predicted in his astrological predictions.
In the present day, Chintamani's Elder Son, Neel Agnihotri finds out about his family's history, his grandfather's mysterious yet pragmatic personality and the enigma surrounding the Wada from his uncle, Mahadev. Fascinated by learning about his clan's history, Neel sets out on an adventure uncovering uncomfortable truths, some pertaining to the family and their differences, while some being about their traditional Lord Ganesha Idols, all of which have been given to all the separate Agnihotri siblings.
While on the hunt for the answers to these mysteries, Neel encounters a host of problems and surprising truths, many of which test the acceptance, tenacity, understanding and personal biases of the reuniting Agnihotris. As Neel looks for the answers to many of his questions, he finds help from unknown sources, many of which lead him to shocking revelations.

title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
summary: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah (transl. "Taarak Mehta's Inverted Spectacles"), often abbreviated as TMKOC, is an Indian sitcom and comedy based on the weekly column Duniya Ne Undha Chasma by Tarak Mehta for the magazine Chitralekha. Produced by Asit Kumarr Modi, it is one of the longest-running television series in India. The series premiered on 28 July 2008 on Sony SAB and is also digitally available on SonyLIV.
plot:
The series is set in Mumbai and follows the lives of the residents of Gokuldham Co-operative Housing Society, a diverse community with people from different cultural and regional backgrounds.
Most storylines focus on an individual, a family, or sometimes the entire society as they encounter and resolve various problems. The characters frequently support one another and celebrate festivals together, highlighting their close-knit bond.
A recurring theme centers on Jethalal Champaklal Gada, who often finds himself in comical situations and troubles, with brief moments of relief before new challenges arise.

episodesList.title: Taarak Mehta Introduces Himself And Society Members
episodesList.summary: Taarak Mehta introduces himself and the society members of Gokuldham Society starting with his wife, Anjali Mehta, followed by his dear friend, Jethalal Champaklal Gada, who always lands in some or the other problem. Jethalal gets a horrifying dream in which all the members of Gokuldham society are blaming Jethalal for Tapu's mischief that he does every day in the society. What will be the Judge's final decision? Will Jethalal find a unique way to solve his never-ending problem?

episodesList.title: Jethalal's Son Tapu Decides To Spend His Holiday
episodesList.summary: Jethalal's son Tapu decides to spend his holiday playing cricket in the premises of Gokuldham society but soon, the game lands young Tappu in trouble. Irked by the damage done by Tapu to their property, the society members approach Jethalal Gada for a solution to this problem. What will Jethalal do?

episodesList.title: Tapu Has Been The Worry Of Jethalal
episodesList.summary: More than the society members, Tapu has been the worry of Jethalal. He has finally decided to do something about it and decides to take Tapu with him to his shop. But will that actually be a solution to the problems? Will Tapu work at Jethalal's shop?

episodesList.title: Daya Approaches Taarak Mehta For Help
episodesList.summary: Tapu lands Jethalal Gada into yet another trouble as he makes an Inspector believe that he has been hired as a child labourer in Jethalal's shop. The Inspector presses charges of indulging into child labour on Jethalal and incarcerates him for the same. On learning of this news, a worried Daya approaches Taarak Mehta for help. Will Taarak be of any help in the matter?

episodesList.title: Jethalal In Huge Trouble
episodesList.summary: Tapu has decided to take full revenge from his own father for his mother's tears. This complete family drama has put Jethalal into huge trouble. He is now concerned about his son's behaviour and decides to do something about it. What conclusion will Taarak Mehta and Jethalal reach to? Will Taarak help his dear friend Jethalal?

episodesList.title: Champaklal Gada Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: Tragedy befalls on Jethalal's family once again when his father, Champaklal Gada, goes missing from the railway station. Concerned about her father-in-law's safety, Daya approaches the media for help. Will their search end on a good note? Where is Champaklal after all?

episodesList.title: Champaklal Gada Gets A Grand Welcome In Gokuldham Society
episodesList.summary: It is time for celebrations as Champaklal Gada is coming back to Gokuldham society. Tapu welcomes him with excessive zeal and society members greet him with utmost pleasure. But how does everybody come together when a problem strikes? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Mumbai Is Hit By Heavy Rains
episodesList.summary: As Mumbai is hit by heavy rains, the residents of Gokuldham Society are struck by varied kinds of problems. In the meanwhile, Tapu and his friends decide to play football in the rain.  Anjali is worried as she is unable to reach her husband in this bad weather. Watch this episode to see how the children's decision to play outside the society compound causes panic among the parents.

episodesList.title: Jethalal Is Thrown In An Unlikely Situation
episodesList.summary: All the parents of the Gokuldham society are delighted on their children's safe return. Meanwhile, Jethalal's father is struggling to adjust to the ways of city life. Infuriated by the insults flung at him by Bhide, Champaklal walks out of the society and goes missing. Watch this episode to see the various problems arising from Champaklal's barbaric ways.

episodesList.title: Champak Chacha Returns Home
episodesList.summary: Bhide has been well accounted for and held responsible by the Gada family for Champaklal's plight. His apologies are not working and the only solution left now is that Champak chacha returns home. Will this problem receive a permanent solution?

episodesList.title: Mobile Phones Could Be Called  Best Friends
episodesList.summary: If technology is a boon or a bane, the answer is yet to be decided. Champaklal gets a new phone for his day to day communication but he gets very much involved with it. Meanwhile, Bhide mocks Jethalal while he is on the way to his shop. Will Champaklal land himself into some trouble because of the new mobile phone?

episodesList.title: Mr Bhide Is Concerned By Sonu's Friendship
episodesList.summary: Bhide is concerned because of Sonu's friendship with Tapu and decides to use the occasion of Rakshabandhan to put this matter to rest, once and for all. However, Bhide's plan has got Jethalal worried. Why is he worried? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Gokuldham Society Celebrates Rakshabandhan
episodesList.summary: Gokuldham Society is all set to welcome the festival of Rakshabandhan with a bang. While Daya is busy with preparations, Jethalal is dreading being tied a rakhi by Babita. The event is exclusively being covered by Rita Reporter from Kal Tak. Watch this hilarious episode to know about Jethalal's pain.

episodesList.title: Jethalal Gets Kidnapped From Work
episodesList.summary: Jethalal gets kidnapped from his shop. When he doesn't return home for a long time, Nathu Kaka goes to Jethalal's house to tell Daya that Jethalal left his phone and tiffin at the shop. When Taarak goes to Daya to comfort her, they get a call from the kidnappers. What will they do now? How will they save Jethalal?

episodesList.title: Champaklal Informs His Son's Abducters
episodesList.summary: Jethalal has been abducted by a bunch of thugs who seek ransom in lieu of releasing him. However, Champaklal informs his son's abductors that he does not have money to pay as ransom. What awaits Jethalal's fate now? Will they kill him if the ransom is not paid?

episodesList.title: The Men Want To Celebrate The Festival Of Janamashtmi
episodesList.summary: The members of Gokuldham especially the men want to celebrate the festival of Janamashtmi. What is the plan that Jethalal has up his sleeve? Who is he scared of? How do the other male folk plan to implement Jetha's plan? Will everything go according to the plan?

episodesList.title: Champaklal And Tapu Successfully Foil Jethalal And His Friends
episodesList.summary: Champaklal and Tapu successfully foil Jethalal and his friend's plans to gamble with money. On the eve of Janmashthami, the men of Gokuldham Society challenge the women to break the sacred earthen pot. Will the women successfully complete this challenge? Find out in this episode of Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashma.

episodesList.title: Tapu Lands In Trouble In School
episodesList.summary: Tapu lands in trouble in school and the Principal summons Jethalal to his office to discuss his son's frivolous ways. Scared of notifying his father about the same, Tapu convinces Champaklal to meet the Principal as his father. However, Tapu's plan goes horribly wrong when Jethalal and Champaklal both turn up in the Principal's office. What will be Tapu's fate?

episodesList.title: Jethalal Approaches Chingur Baba For Help
episodesList.summary: Fed-up of his father and son's shenanigans, Jethalal approaches Chingur Baba for help. The Baba provides him with a remedy and a hopeful Jethalal returns home to do as instructed. However, the next morning it is Jethalal who is a changed man and not his father and son. How did this happen?

episodesList.title: Humour is very good for the health
episodesList.summary: It is indeed said that humour is very good for health. But what if it becomes dangerous? Jethalal's behaviour becomes very humorous and all the society members are making fun of him. How do people take advantage of his situation? Will Tarak Mehta be able to solve it?

episodesList.title: Ganesh Utsav In The Society
episodesList.summary: Females of the Gokuldham Society plan to keep a fast for their husbands but when Jethalal is thrown in an unlikely situation, he wants to return the favour by making all the men keep the fast instead. Will he succeed?

episodesList.title: Gokuldham is trying to celebrate Ganesh Chathurti
episodesList.summary: Gokuldham is celebrating Ganesh Chaturthi and is trying to make the festival as pure as possible. What do Champak Chacha and the Tapu Sena have in mind? What is Jethalal and Taarak's plan? What will happen when their wives find out?

episodesList.title: The Kids Of The Society Are Very Excited
episodesList.summary: The kids of the society are very excited at the occasion of Ganesh Utsav, but their excitement is short-lived when no one in the society is ready to donate the sufficient funds. At that time, an unlikely hero emerges. Who is the hero? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Gokuldham Society is all set to celebrate Ganesh Chathurthi
episodesList.summary: Gokuldham Society is all set to celebrate Ganesh Chathurthi with all its might, but someone is missing. Who is it? While Madhvi and Jethalal are exchanging laddus, Jethalal builds up a scheme. What is it about? Moreover, what has terrorism got to do with all this?

episodesList.title: Wacky Society Is Thrown Into Another Strange Situation
episodesList.summary: As the celebrations of Ganesh Utsav continue, Gokuldham society is thrown into another strange situation. There is a bomb scare in the society. How will the society members solve it?

episodesList.title: The Feeling With Which One Celebrates The Festival
episodesList.summary: The festivity is all about one's truth. The feeling with which one celebrates the festival. In this aura of festivity, will every member of Gokuldham society speak the truth? If yes, will this truth be good to hear? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Ganesh Ustsav continues with fun and laughter
episodesList.summary: Another day of the Ganesh Utsav continues with fun and laughter. Tapu and gang come up with another idea for an event and the whole society gets busy with it. What competition is it? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: A Hasya Kavi Sammelan Is Organised On The Ocassion Of Ganesh Chathurthi
episodesList.summary: A Hasya Kavi Sammelan is organised on the occasion of Ganesh Chathurthi. Tarak Mehta has taken the responsibility to host the event. What humorous turn of events would take place, when Bhide recites his poem? How will Jethalal take revenge? Will it be the way he expected? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Jethalal, Daya and Baccha Party's unbelievable performance
episodesList.summary: The fun and celebrations of the Ganesh Utsav continue as the Hasya Kavita competition continues. Jethalal, Daya and the Baccha Party give great performances but who will win the surprise prize? Watch this episode of Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashma to find out.

episodesList.title: Daya Intervenes The Session
episodesList.summary: Tarak Mehta, Jethalal and Bhide, are distressed by their wive's behaviour. What reasons do all of them have? What happens when they share their feelings? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Helpless Husbands Of Gokuldham Society
episodesList.summary: All men of society are upset with their respective wives. They are trying to find a way to cope with it when they meet Gobachari who runs a Patni Pidith Sang. Will the men get brainwashed by him? What new trouble will this bring to society? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Gobhachari's Book On Marriage And Relationship
episodesList.summary: Husbands and wives will forever continue with their little fights and problems. But what happens when the husbands decide to solve these problems? What other problems emerge? Can one book be the solution to all their problems?

episodesList.title: Gobachari Inspires The Husbands At Gokuldham
episodesList.summary: Gobachari inspires the husbands at Gokuldham to create a list of demands from their wives. The list results in an all-out war between the husbands and wives with each party out to embarrass the other. What will be the consequences of the war be?  Will it be resolved?

episodesList.title: Gokuldham Members Are Enraged At Jethalal And Warn Him
episodesList.summary: Bhide gets furious on Madhavi as she had invested in Sunder's scheme. Bhide and other friends make a plan to meet Jethalal and enquire about Sunder. They get enraged at him and warn him saying they can lodge a complaint against him in the police station. Jethalal shares his problem with his best friend Taarak Mehta and returns the money of the society members as he suggested.

episodesList.title: Jethalal Is Fed Up Of Tapu Watching Television All Day
episodesList.summary: Jethalal is worried about Tapu's obsession with the television. He has a plan to get rid of this. What is his plan?  How will he deal with such a nuisance?

episodesList.title: Television Is Becoming A Crazy Problem
episodesList.summary: Television is becoming a crazy problem amongst the children and it is the parents who get disturbed by it. What similar problem is Jethalal facing at home? How does he plan to approach it? Is Tapu going to sit back? What cable war will it start? Watch this episode to know about the fight between Tapu and Jethalal?

episodesList.title: Jethalal's Plan To Cut Down On Tapu's Cable Watching
episodesList.summary: In order to cut down on Tapu's cable watching, Jethalal gets the child lock activated on his television so that only the spiritual channel can be viewed by his son. How does Tapu manage to get his daily dose of cable? How does the entire neighbourhood react to this? Will Tapu outwit Jethalal?

episodesList.title: The Children Revolt Against The Child Lock
episodesList.summary: The children revolt against the child lock control by deciding to give up their clothes, an effect of the overdose of watching spiritual channels on TV. This causes panic amongst the parents. Will the parents be able to convince the children to wear clothes? Will the child lock issue be resolved?

episodesList.title: Daya Is Super Excited About The Garba Celebrations
episodesList.summary: The festival of Navratri is round the corner and everyone wants to play Garba. How will Daya take the responsibility to make the Garba a success? Is Jethalal happy with his wife's excitement? How does Tapu Sena prepare for Garba?

episodesList.title: Daya Wants To Go To Ahmedabad And Celebrate Navratri
episodesList.summary: While everyone is excited about the celebrations of Navratri, Jethalal is not. Daya wants to celebrate Navratri in Ahmedabad. What were Jethalal's plans for Navratri that will not be met now? How does he still try to make them work? How will Tapu try to stop him? Find out in this fun-filled episode of Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashma.

episodesList.title: Gadas To Celebrate Navratri In Ahemdabad
episodesList.summary: The Gada's have decided to celebrate Navratri with Daya's family in Ahemdabad. Tapu is sad about missing out on the Navratri excitement at Gokuldham Society. Will he formulate a plan to wriggle out of going to Ahemdabad? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Jethalal Excited About Learning Disco Dandiya
episodesList.summary: A man arrives at Jethalals shop to get some change. Jethalal arrives at his shop and mistakes him for a customer and gives him a free pair of dandiya sticks. He grins to find out that there are four passes for a dandiya party for him. On the other hand, Daya has called over her friends to help her decide what attire and jewellery to wear for the next nine days of Navratri. Meanwhile, Jethalal is excited to go for the dandiya party along with Babita.

episodesList.title: A Goon Threatens Bhide, Sodhi And Jethalal
episodesList.summary: Everyone is horrified to find out that the goons have a gun. Tappu, who is standing at the balcony, comes up with a plan and throws a dandiya stick at the goon's hand.  After the problem has been averted, all continue their celebration and play Garba. Further, Anjali expresses her suspicion on Mohan's announcement of the expensive prize of a trip to Singapore for the winner of the Garba competition. Who will win it?

episodesList.title: Taarak Begins The Disco Dandiya Competition
episodesList.summary: Taarak begins the competition and asks the Hathi couple to come and perform their act. Following them is Sodhi's and then the Iyers. After the Iyers performance, Bhides perform followed by the Mehtas and Gada's. Finally, Jethalal's father comes on to the stage and performs. Tappu joins his grandfather in his riveting dance performance. Watch this fun-filled episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Taarak Talks To The Audience About The Human Organ Trafficking
episodesList.summary: Anjali finds Taarak coughing and asks him to go to a doctor and get himself checked. When Taarak refuses to go, she suggests him to go and visit Dr Hathi. Taarak then talks about human organ trafficking that is taking place in some hospitals. Will Taarak recover?

episodesList.title: Shaikh  Offers A Warning To Jethalal
episodesList.summary: Jethalal is walking home and thinking about Sheikh's offer and also thinks where he'll get the kidney from. Jethalal discusses this with his friend Taarak Mehta. What will Taarak suggest him?

episodesList.title: Jethalal In Search Of A Kidney Donor
episodesList.summary: A worried Jethalal prays to God and asks him to find a kidney donor for him. Jethalal spots  Sodhi in the garden talking to someone on the phone and discussing some money issue. He approaches him and informs him about the extravagant amount of money that he will receive in return of one of his kidney. Will Sodhi take the offer?

episodesList.title: An Enraged Jethalal Threatens Bhide
episodesList.summary: An annoyed Jethalal reaches the colony compound and calls out to Bhide. He threatens him to take revenge on him for his mischief. Taarak comes and drags Jethalal along with him to his home and tries to convince him of doing the right thing but in vain. Jethalal wakes up to a nightmare when Daya comes to his aid. Daya urges Jethalal to visit Dr Hathi and get a medicine for his headache.

episodesList.title: Jethalal And Shaikh Are Waiting For Badri Nath's Final Answer
episodesList.summary: Daya finds her father in law pacing in the room awaiting someone. On enquiring, her father in law reveals that he has called Badri Nath. When Badri Nath arrives, Champak lectures him against selling his kidney for money and promises to get him the money required for his daughter's operation. On the other hand, Jethalal is with Shaikh having a gala time and awaiting Badri Nath unaware of the turn of events. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Daya Instructs Jethalal To Clean The House On Diwali
episodesList.summary: Anjali is cleaning the house for Diwali and asks Taarak to get rid of some of the books from the house. Taarak explains to her the importance of books. On the other hand, Tappu and his friends along with Abdul are decorating the colony for Diwali and discussing their plan of firecrackers when one of their friends brings the previous years crackers. Jethalal is horrified by the crackers and he scolds the children. What will Jethalal do?

episodesList.title: Bhide Outsmarts Jethalal
episodesList.summary: Bhide outsmarts Jethalal and clicks his photograph in his servant state. An enraged Jethalal runs after Bhide. Taarak approaches Jethalal and enquires the problem but is left in splits to know the story. Champak finds Jethalal and drags him back home. Further, the ladies get together and shop for Diwali. At the shop, Nattu informs Jethalal about a scheme he thought for Diwali. What scheme has he come up with?

episodesList.title: Jethalal Confronts Daya About Buying Bomb For Tappu
episodesList.summary: Daya and the other ladies of the colony decide to go shopping for Diwali. Jethalal returns home and confronts Daya about buying a bomb for Tapu. He then reveals to her the events that occurred at the shop in the afternoon, when his father walks in and scolds him. On the other hand, Bhide is worried as Diwali is approaching and none of his students has paid the fees. How will Bhide celebrate his Diwali?

episodesList.title: Jethalal's Irksome Behavior
episodesList.summary: Bhide is scared and holds Jethalal responsible for his condition. Champaklal gets tired with Jethalal's irksome behaviour. Jethalal asks Daya for the money, which he had given before, but gets upset with her behaviour. He is surprised to see Bhide's changed behaviour. Natu Kaka asks Champaklal why Jethalal has not reached his shop. Bhide is tensed while a woman reaches his house and places a big order for pickle to Madhavi.

episodesList.title: Taarak Mehta Feels Lonely On Diwali
episodesList.summary: Taarak Mehta feels lonely as Anjali is not with him on the occasion of Diwali. Jethalal is facing stinginess and is unable to fulfil his family's requirements. Bhide and other friends are upset about inflation. They decide to do a Laxmi Poojan and ask Jethalal to contribute. Will Jethalal be ready to contribute? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Champaklal Celebrates The New-Year With The Children
episodesList.summary: Champaklal celebrates the occasion of new-year with the children. Jethalal gets tired of Daya's behaviour. Bhide tries to tease him while he goes to repair Daya's sandals. Jethalal gets upset when Daya informs him that Sunder is coming. Will Sunder bring in any more trouble in Jethalal's life?

episodesList.title: The Gada Family Is Going Out Of Their Limits To Welcome Daya's Brother
episodesList.summary: Daya's brother Sunder is coming to Gokuldham Society and the Gada family is ready to receive him. Jethalal is not at all happy with this. Sunder has not turned up yet and Jethalal gets a call from Natu Kaka to come to the shop. Will Sunder come? What new troubles is he going to bring in Jethalal's life?

episodesList.title: Sunders New Scheme
episodesList.summary: Panic ensues as Sunder's bag is missing and the blame comes on Jethalal's head. Sunder calls his mother in Ahmedabad who tells him that his bag is in Ahmedabad and is not lost. Natu Kaka books a flight ticket for Jethalal as Daya tells him to get Sunder's bag from Ahmedabad. A lot of money has been spent on Sunder and Jethalal is not comfortable with this. What will happen next? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Jethalal Is Apprehensive About Sunder's Scheme
episodesList.summary: Jethalal is apprehensive about Sunder's scheme and warns him that he shouldn't involve Gokuldham society members in his plan. Sunder meets the society members and tells them about his scheme. Then he meets the women and shares his scheme with them. He does his best to fool them off their money. Daya also lauds her brother before them and takes guarantee of their money. Will the scheme work?

episodesList.title: Jethalal Is Suspicious About Sunder
episodesList.summary: The women of Gokuldam try to arrange the money through all means possible. Daya tries to make Taarak Mehta understand as to how her husband's best friend will not earn money. Bhide tries to tease his friends as they have allowed their wives to invest in Sunder's scheme. The women invest in this scheme as Sunder had promised them a high return. Jethalal also has to invest in the scheme because of Babita but is suspicious about Sunder.

episodesList.title: Jethalal Worries About Sunder Committing Some Fraud
episodesList.summary: Babita is excited about her investment and asks Jethalal for Sunder. Jethalal worries about Sunder committing some fraud with the society member's money. Komal and other friends meet Daya, but she is worried about Sunder being kidnapped. Taarak Mehta is also pensive regarding Sunder. All the women are upset about Sunder and worried about their investment money. Jethalal tries to make Babita understand. Where is Sunder?

episodesList.title: Gokuldham Members Are Enraged At Jethalal
episodesList.summary: Bhide gets furious on Madhavi as she had invested in Sunder's scheme. Bhide and other friends make a plan to meet Jethalal and enquire about Sunder. They get enraged at him and warn him saying they can lodge a complaint against him in the police station. Jethalal shares his problem with his best friend Taarak Mehta and returns the money of the society members as he suggested. Meanwhile, Sunder reaches society.

episodesList.title: Sunder Gives Them A Surprising News
episodesList.summary: Daya and other Gokuldham society members get surprised when Sunder turns up. Jethalal gets enraged at him. Meanwhile, Sunder gives them surprising news. Bhide and Iyer meet Jethalal as they want to invest their money again. Daya and other friends discuss the television serial deeply. But, something goes wrong while they are watching the serial. What goes wrong? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Tapu's Strike Against His School Authority
episodesList.summary: Daya is angry as repeated episodes are being telecast on the television. Madhavi is also upset about this as there is a strike after a dispute between the union members and the producers. Daya and her friends decide to conduct a havan to solve this problem as Daya is slightly superstitious. As the havan completes, Rita reporter informs them that the strike has been called off. Meanwhile, Tapu makes a plan to solve his problem. What is his problem?

episodesList.title: The Principal Summons The Parents
episodesList.summary: Bhide and Sodhi want to meet the principal, but Jethalal is scared of Bhide coming to know about the leader. Rita tries to telecast this news on live TV, but Jethalal doesn't allow her to do so. Meanwhile, Bhide and Sodhi reach there. The principal gets tensed after seeing the struggling behaviour of Jethalal and Bhide. What will happen to Tapu?

episodesList.title: Tapu And His Army Are Not Ready To End The Strike
episodesList.summary: Komal gets enraged at Goli and asks to end the strike, but she is shocked at his behaviour. Bhide takes Tapu's frustration out on Sonu. Jethalal wants to share the problem with his best friend, Taarak Mehta. Champaklal goes to school with them. He tries to explain to Tapu and the other children about the unfair nature of their demands. Will Tapu listen to Champaklal?

episodesList.title: Daya Plans To Celebrate Her 25th Wedding Anniversary
episodesList.summary: Jethalal has to go to a social convention, but he wants to rest at home. She gets suspicious as Jethalal pretexts with her saying he wants to enjoy the Sunday with his friends. Tapu's friends reach at home while Jethalal is resting. He tries to scare them away. Meanwhile, Babita reaches there and Jethalal gets scared of someone catching them together alone in the house. Will someone catch them?

episodesList.title: Jethalal Is Disturbed By The Presence Of Two Ladies
episodesList.summary: Jethalal is alone at home and he is encountered by the presence of various women, one of them is Sweety. Will Jethalal be a true husband? Who is Sweety? Find out in this episode of Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashma.

episodesList.title: Sweety Threatens To Commit Suicide
episodesList.summary: Jethalal tries to explain something to Champaklal and Daya as they believe he is having an affair with Sweety. Sweety threatens to commit suicide. Jethalal asks Nattu Kaka to prove his innocence, but something goes wrong. Bhide and Sodhi reach Jethalal's home as Bhide is suspicious about the whole situation. Champaklal and Daya get shocked when Sweety gives them the proof of their affair. What proof does she have?

episodesList.title: Tapu Finds Proof
episodesList.summary: Tapu finds proof of his father's affair with Sweety. Jethalal tries to explain to Daya and Champaklal that he is innocent. Tapu makes a plan to find out the truth. Will Tapu succeed in his plan? Will Jethalal be proved innocent?

episodesList.title: Daya Accidently Insults Jethalal
episodesList.summary: Jethalal is worried when he sees Babita tensed and believes it’s because of Iyer. Daya accidentally insults Jethalal while he is talking to Babita. Champaklal gets surprised when his old friend, Premji, and his wife reach Gokuldam and invite them for their daughter's marriage. Jethalal doesn't want to go with them and talks to Champaklal about this. Will Champaklal agree?

episodesList.title: Champaklal Decides To Get Tapu Married
episodesList.summary: Champaklal is worried whether Tapu will run away to get married or will he seek his consent. Champaklal decides to get Tapu married and tells Daya about his decision. Daya believes Champaklal is suffering from a disease. Jethalal gets shocked when he comes to know about Tapu's marriage. What will Jethalal do?

episodesList.title: Tapu Decides To Marry
episodesList.summary: Jethalal gets shocked when Champaklal informs him about Tapu's marriage. He shares his problem with Taarak Mehta. He then tries to explain to Champaklal that child marriage is illegal.  Tapu has an idea while playing pretend-marriage with dolls. He decides to marry as he wants a bicycle. Tapu's friends also want to marry when they come to know about Tapu's marriage. Bhide holds Jethalal responsible for this. What will Jethalal do?

episodesList.title: Sonu's Marriage Proposal For Tapu
episodesList.summary: Gokuldham Society members meet Jethalal and get furious with him for their children's problem as they want to marry. Jethalal shares his feeling with them as he is also against their marriage. Daya gets misunderstood as Bhide had come with Sonu's marriage proposal for Tapu. Champaklal gets ready to get them married. Will Champaklal succeed?

episodesList.title: Bhide's Final Answer
episodesList.summary: Bhide and Madhavi get shocked when Champaklal and Daya meet them regarding Tapu's proposal for Sonu. Bhide gets enraged and insults Champaklal. Daya feels upset as Bhide has insulted them and rejected their marriage proposal. Bhide discusses this with Sodhi and Taarak Mehta and wants to lodge a complaint in the police station. Jethalal is also tensed as he is against Tapu's marriage. How will the problem of Tapu's marriage be solved?

episodesList.title: Daya Is Excited For Tapu's Marriage
episodesList.summary: Daya is excited about Tapu's marriage and invites Madhavi for the ceremony. All the rituals are going on and the women dance. Jethalal is tensed as he is against this marriage, making Chamapklal angry. Meanwhile, Daya and her entire family get surprised as Sundar reaches there with his neighbours. Jethalal gets shocked when he comes to know about this. How will Jethalal solve this?

episodesList.title: Gada Convinces Everybody For Tapu's Marriage
episodesList.summary: It is celebration time for the entire Gokuldham Society as the Gada family manages to convince everybody for the marriage of their child Tapu. Taarak Mehta is caught in a battle of wits. He cannot decide whether to follow his morals and avoid this child marriage or as a friend be a part of it? Watch this episode to find out Taarak's take on this?

episodesList.title: Tapu's Marriage Rituals
episodesList.summary: The marriage rituals are going on with full groove and everybody is supposedly very happy. The rituals are complete and a new journey will start from here. Jethalal is not happy with all this. Will he be able to solve this problem?

episodesList.title: Jethalal Tensed In Tapu's Marriage
episodesList.summary: To start a new happily married life, everyone in the family needs to be happy. But out of all people, Jethalal is the only one who is tensed. When Jethalal's life seems to be happy, there are problems galore that come his way. Sundar has left the hotel, without paying the bills and like always Jethalal has to pay it off.  The new bride at home has got problems with Jethalal snoring. Find out what happens to Jethalal now.

episodesList.title: Daya Has Entered A Quarrel
episodesList.summary: Jethalal and Tapu for the first time have figured that they talk to their wives alike, have tea alike, work alike and think alike. Meanwhile, Daya has entered a quarrel with the entire society with relation to her daughter-in-law who is supposedly being targeted. What is the problem and why have the police been called?

episodesList.title: Jethalal Watches Tapu's Marriage
episodesList.summary: It turns out that Jethalal has been seeing a dream of Tapu's marriage for a long time and all the events have just been too disturbing for his liking. But his only fear is that these events might actually turn out to be true. Jethalal tries to fool around with the father of the girl so that he says a no for marriage. Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Jethalal Has Smelled Trouble
episodesList.summary: Jethalal has smelled trouble after calling H.K. Gandhi and has taken more trouble by calling up his own father in a different voice trying to call off the wedding. Meanwhile, the two families decide that Tapu and Chutki should once at least meet each other. What will happen when they meet?

episodesList.title: Taarak Is Against Child Marriage
episodesList.summary: The Gada and the Gandhi family have decided to meet each other and Jethalal is getting tensed day by day. Taarak Mehta has been called to oppose the idea of child marriage. Will Taarak be successful?

episodesList.title: Lohri Is Round The Corner
episodesList.summary: The Gada family has finally managed to tell Gandhi, family, about the confusion and matters, are likely to be solved now.  Lohri is round the corner and the Punjabi's are in a full groove. Sodhi's family relatives have decided to visit him on Lohri. But there are more reasons for Sodhi's excitement, find out what they are and how does Roshan react to them?

episodesList.title: Sodhi Has Lied
episodesList.summary: Sodhi likes to party all the time. But more than that, he is a family man and likes to keep his wife and children happy. Sodhi has lied at his house and gone to his friend's party. He ends up drinking a lot at the party and has not reached home till late night and Roshan is tensed. What condition is Sodhi in and what happens when he reaches Gokuldham?

episodesList.title: Drunk Roshan Singh Sodhi
episodesList.summary: Roshan Singh Sodhi has been absolutely drunk and he is not being allowed back in his house. He tries absolutely crazy things to get back in his house. Will they work? How does excessive consumption of alcohol be a problem for him? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Sodhi's Efforts
episodesList.summary: Sodhi's efforts to seek the attention of his wife are beginning to take a new high and he has decided to not come down from the building's roof. What will happen if he does not come down? Will Roshan forgive him?

episodesList.title: Celebrations Of Lohri In Gokuldham Society
episodesList.summary: When the festivals are around the corner, people become very excited. Sodhi's relatives from Punjab have decided to convert Gokuldham society into a mini-Punjab. The celebrations of Lohri are taking their shape. Find out how Gokuldham prepares for Lohri and Uttaran?

episodesList.title: Gokuldham Society Is In Mood For Celebrations
episodesList.summary: The entire Gokuldham society is surrounded by festivity and everyone is in the mood for celebrations. The celebrations of Uttaran are coming straight from Gujarat and Sundar has sent a parcel straight from Gujarat for the Gada family in Mumbai. Find out how these celebrations take place when a mini-India resides in Gokuldham.

episodesList.title: Kite Flying Competition Between Jetha And Sodhi
episodesList.summary: The festival of Makkar Sakranti is a huge success, and Gokuldam learnt a message about love. Jetha and Sodhi are having a really tight competition. It is time for the golden kite. The tensions are high and Bhide is supporting Sodhi heavily. Who will win this competition? Will anybody sit on the donkey? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Dr. Hathi Has Lost 30 Kilos Of Weight
episodesList.summary: Dr Hathi has lost 30 kilos of weight, supposedly and Daya decides that her husband too should lose weight. Jethalal has to go to sleep without food and Daya has also locked the kitchen. Jetha is becoming desperate to have some food. He calls up Bhide to place an order with Madhavi. Bhide gets extremely upset with Jetha for calling him late in the night. The next morning, Jetha has no food in his tummy. How will Jetha's problems be in front of the entire society?

episodesList.title: Dr. Hathi Gets Stuck In Auto Rickshaw
episodesList.summary: Dr Hathi eats after he has gained 30 kilos of weight. The entire Gokuldham has formed a human chain to pull Dr Hathi out of the auto-rickshaw. Without any result or any ideas, they decide to pull off the rickshaw's top and take Dr Hathi out. Bhide comes up with a plan to pull him out. What is the plan? Will it be successful?

episodesList.title: Clash Of Plans
episodesList.summary: Dr Hathi tries to get customers in his clinic but is still unsuccessful. Jethalal finds himself unaware of the importance of 26th January. Bhide gets upset by the adult knowledge levels in Gokuldham Co-operative Society and decides to have a meeting for the same. The wives get together and decide to stand up for themselves in front of their husbands for their picnic plan, and the kids also decide on an alternate plan for 26th January. Whose plan is going to work?

episodesList.title: Taarak Declares A Cultural Dance Program
episodesList.summary: Bhide is tensed as all the women want to enjoy Republic Day on their own. Tapu and his friends want to celebrate Republic Day as they wish. Taarak Mehta tries to explain to them and declares a Cultural Dance Program on this occasion. All the couples practice for the dance competition. Who will win the competition? Find out in this episode of Taarak Mehta ka Ooltah Chashma.

episodesList.title: Special Guest In Gokuldham's Cultural Dance Program
episodesList.summary: All the couples are excited as Gokuldham Society members have organized a cultural dance program on the occasion of Republic Day. Taarak Mehta welcomes their special guest and judges. Who is the special guest of the occasion?

episodesList.title: Winner Of Gokuldham's Cultural Dance Program
episodesList.summary: Gokuldham Society members show their cultural performance as they have organized a cultural dance program on the occasion of Republic day. Taarak Mehta sings a song on the request of Jethalal and other society members. Jethalal and Daya have been declared the winner of the competition. But, another society member opposes the judge’s decision. Will the judges change their decision?

episodesList.title: Babita Suggests Jethalal To Exercise
episodesList.summary: Taarak Mehta gets annoyed with the society members behaviour. Bhide and other society members start feeling guilty for what they have done. Jethalal gets annoyed with Daya's behaviour. Meanwhile, Champaklal gets angry at him. Babita suggests Jethalal should exercise. Daya and Champaklal get surprised with Jethalal's changed behaviour.

episodesList.title: Jethalal Starts Dieting
episodesList.summary: Jethalal decides to start dieting as Babita has suggested. But he could not help it after seeing delicious food for dinner. Daya and Tapu wish Jethalal would watch a movie with them as Sundar has acted in that film, but Jethalal is not ready to do so as he is excited to exercise with Babita. Tapu has a plan to make Jethalal watch the movie. What is the plan?

episodesList.title: Jethalal Is Excited To Go For Exercise With Babita
episodesList.summary: Jethalal is scared when he sees his family in search of Champaklal's sandal as he had worn his sandals in excitement while going for exercise with Babita. Babita suggests Daya and other friends that they should also exercise. Bhide worries for the new generation as they are computer savvy and discusses this with Sodhi and Dr Hathi. Will Jethalal face any problems while exercising?

episodesList.title: A Burglar Snatches Jethalal's Mobile
episodesList.summary: After facing many difficulties, Jethalal is ready to start his exercise with Babita but is surprised when he finds Babita doing Yoga. Meanwhile, a burglar snatches his mobile. Jethalal tries to chase him and catch him. Bhide and Sodhi make fun of him and tease him. Jethalal tells Champaklal about this but gets annoyed with Daya. Meanwhile, Tapu reminds him they have to go for a movie.

episodesList.title: Jethalal And His Family Reach The Theatre
episodesList.summary: Jethalal and the entire family reach the theatre to watch the movie in which Sundar has acted. While returning, Jethalal gets shocked when he comes to know about the taxi strike. Tapu asks his grandfather to donate blankets to beggars. Jethalal gets surprised when he sees Babita at his home. How will Jethalal react to this surprise?

episodesList.title: Daya Gave Away Jethalal's New Pants
episodesList.summary: After seeing Jethalal get capital gains out of the charity work, the others also decide to work around a profit generating model for themselves. Champaklal is extremely pleased with the children and Abdul for helping him out with the donations. Meanwhile, Jethalal finds out that Daya gave away his new pants to charity. Will the others be successful in earning money through donations, like Jethalal?

episodesList.title: Blanket Donation Fraud
episodesList.summary: Everyone is furious over the blanket donation fraud. Champak Chacha discovers what the beggars actually require. Jethalal's wife kills his romantic mood, after which he goes to his shop to discover that his father has taken away cash which was earmarked for a client.

episodesList.title: Champaklal Gets Arrested
episodesList.summary: Jethalal tries to get back the money from his father which he refuses. Meanwhile, Champaklal gets arrested. Why does he get arrested? Has he committed a fraud?

episodesList.title: Police Abduct Bapuji
episodesList.summary: There's a new thief in town at the Adarsh Nagar colony. The police abduct Bapuji mistaking him to be a most wanted criminal, Natwarlal. Meanwhile, Tapu reaches home and informs Jethalal and Daya about the same. Will Bapuji be rescued in time? Will Jethalal manage to rescue his father? Find out in this hilarious episode.

episodesList.title: Champaklal In Jail
episodesList.summary: Dr. Hathi finds out about Champaklal through the news and informs everyone. Everyone decides to go and get him back. Meanwhile, Jethalal's client comes to ask for the cash. Daya is worried about her husband and father-in-law. Will they be successful in getting Champaklal out of jail?

episodesList.title: Real Thief Confesses His Crime
episodesList.summary: Champaklal and the others get into a tiff with the news reporter at the police station, and later on the real thief comes and confesses his crime. Will Champaklal get out of jail now? Find out in this episode.
