episodesList.title: Veer & Bansari Take Center Stage
episodesList.summary: Champak Chacha entrusts Veer and Bansari with the honor of performing the Mukh Dikhayi ceremony, declaring that they represent the future of Gokuldham Society.

episodesList.title: One More Surprise From Bhide
episodesList.summary: The renovation work is finally complete, and everyone is happy to see the new Gokuldham Society. But Bhide has one more surprise waiting for everyone.

episodesList.title: Gokuldham Gets A Surprise Guest
episodesList.summary: As Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah celebrates 18 glorious years, everyone shares their heartfelt thoughts. Just then, Asit Modi announces a special guest, leaving everyone excited to find out who it is.

episodesList.title: Spider-Man In Gokuldham
episodesList.summary: The residents of Gokuldham Society warmly welcome Spider-Man. His presence fills everyone with joy as he interacts with each member.

episodesList.title: Celebrating Memories Together
episodesList.summary: Gokuldham relives some of the most memorable moments from Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah, bringing back old memories and special emotions.

episodesList.title: Bhide's Unexpected Problem
episodesList.summary: The Gokuldham men's group praises Bhide for the successful renovation, but he suddenly reveals that a new problem has arisen. What could it be?

episodesList.title: Bhide Gets A Surprise Gift
episodesList.summary: After the Purush Mandal praises Bhide for the society's renovation, the Mahila Mandal and Tapu Sena plan a special surprise for him at his house.

episodesList.title: Bhide In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Everyone praises Bhide's management, but new renovation charges leave him stressed. Will he protect his promise to society members?

episodesList.title: Bhide's Tough Decision
episodesList.summary: After learning he owes the contractor an extra ₹5 lakh for the society's renovation, Bhide tells Madhavi, who urges him to seek Taarak's help. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Bhide Gets Pranked
episodesList.summary: A prank on the society's renovation budget leaves Bhide stressed and confused as Gokuldham members enjoy his hilarious reactions.

episodesList.title: Madhavi's Pickle Order
episodesList.summary: Jethalal learns that his friend wants Madhavi Bhabhi's pickles. Soon, the Bhide family gets busy preparing and delivering the order.

episodesList.title: Bhide's Pickle Delivery Hassle
episodesList.summary: Bhide heads to the market for lemons and chillies, while Madhavi seeks Roopa's help. Can the Bhide family complete the order on time?

episodesList.title: Bhide Family's Big Win
episodesList.summary: The Bhide Family successfully delivers all pickle orders on time and receives great feedback, leaving Bhide delighted with their achievement.

episodesList.title: Madhavi's Pickle Trouble
episodesList.summary: Madhavi fears a piece of her bangle broke in the pickle. Tapu Sena panics as Bhide faces an FDA raid. Will it be found, or will FDA charges follow?

episodesList.title: Gokuldham Stands By The Bhide Family
episodesList.summary: Madhavi’s pickle licence is at risk, prompting Gokuldham Society members to unite and help the Bhide family overcome the crisis.

episodesList.title: Duplicate Pickle Scandal
episodesList.summary: A counterfeit of Madhavi's pickle product hits the market, leaving the Bhide family in trouble. Will the FDA uncover the truth?

episodesList.title: Bhide & Family Win The Pickle Case
episodesList.summary: It's a relief for the Gokuldham society as the truth behind the duplicate pickle unfolds.

episodesList.title: Popatlal's Bride
episodesList.summary: Abdul sparks total confusion among Chachaji and the Mahila Mandal after spotting Popatlal carrying a bride in his arms.

episodesList.title: Popatlal Manifests His Bride
episodesList.summary: Popatlal manifests his future wife with a statue and asks the Purush Mandali to choose a photo to showcase.

episodesList.title: Bhide Becomes Popatlal’s Target
episodesList.summary: The Mahila Mandal helps Popatlal choose a photo and reveals Bhide’s role. Later, Popatlal playfully scares Bhide at the soda shop.

episodesList.title: Bapuji’s Chain Disappears
episodesList.summary: Madhavi’s earrings go missing, followed by Bapuji’s gold chain. The compound springs into action, but can the missing chain be found?

episodesList.title: Goli Finds A Surprise
episodesList.summary: The search for Madhvi’s earrings turns chaotic as Goli discovers money and sweets, but the earrings remain missing and the house becomes a mess!

title: Radhaa Ki Betiyaan Kuch Kar Dikhayengi
wikiTitle: Radhaa Ki Betiyaan Kuch Kar Dikhayengi
summary: Radhaa Ki Betiyaan Kuch Kar Dikhayengi (Hindi: राधा की बेटियां कुछ कर दिखाएंगी) is an Indian soap opera which aired on NDTV Imagine in February 2008. The series was produced by DJ's a Creative Unit.
plot:
The show narrates the story of a widow Radha, and her three capable daughters - righteous and sensible Rohini (Meethi), bold and energetic Ragini (Ginni), and shy Ruchi (Chhutki) - who migrate to Mumbai from Meerut. The sisters are unlike each other and aspire for different careers but support each other through life.
Rohini wants to be a fashion designer, Ragini wants to pursue modelling, and Ruchi wants to be an astronaut. They struggle to find their place in the big city of Mumbai.
Rohini finds herself constantly put down by her competitive colleague, even though her choices and ideas are better. Ragini lies about her financial status in her college to fit in, and is busted. Ruchi fails to get into college because of her quiet nature, but is helped by her friend Adi.
When their mother sells her jewelry to get a nice gift for a relative's wedding, the sisters enroll themselves in a dance competition, win it, and repurchase the jewelry. They also save the Roshan Villa, where they live, from auctioning away. As their previous acquaintances return, the sisters find it difficult to deal with their problems but manage to win through in the end.

title: Megala
summary: Megala is a 2007-2010 Indian Tamil-language soap opera that aired on Sun TV from 4 June 2007 to 25 April 2008 Monday through Friday at 19:30 (IST) and from 28 April 2008 to 23 April 2010 at 18:00 (IST). It ran for 729 episodes. It had been receiving the highest ratings of Tamil serials and received high praising from viewers. The show starred Gayathiri, Deepan Chakravarthy Yugendran, Vadivukkarasi, Kuyili, Shreekumar, Rajkanth and Bhavana Samanthula. The show was produced by Metti Oli serial fame Cine Times Entertainment Siddhiq and directed by Vikramathithan. It replaced Anjali.  It was also aired in Sri Lanka Tamil Channel on Shakthi TV.
plot:
The story of a couple, Kalaiyarasu and Thilaga, who have five children. Kalai's sister Shanmuga Vadivu alias Vadivu lives with him and Kalai is totally devoted to Vadivu and does all that she says. Vadivu (Vadivukkarasi) tries to separate the couple as she does not like Thilaga. Mehala born to this couple and Vadivu hates that, convincing Kalai to disown her from the family. Hence Mehala (Gayathiri) is brought up in her grandparents home and Thilaga often visits to the home with her other kids. Mehala is very fond of her other siblings.
One day, due to a quarrel between Thilaga and Vadivu, Mehala hits vadivu and she got fainted. By seeing this, Mehala thought she died and ran away from home. She runs to various places and continue with her studies with the help of her friends. When Mehala was on the run, she saw an old man trying to commit suicide and she saves him from committing that. Mehala works as an assistant to a lawyer upon completing her education. Meanwhile, she tries to search for her family back.

title: Kasturi
summary: Kasturi is an Indian soap opera that aired on STAR Plus channel from 23 April 2007 through 31 March 2009. It starred Shubhangi Atre and Karan Patel in the lead roles. The soap opera was created by Ekta Kapoor and was produced by her production company Balaji Telefilms.
plot:
Kasturi is a story that revolves around the life of Kasturi Chawla, a young woman from a middle-class background. After completing her university education, she begins working for Robbie Sabharwal, a spoiled and arrogant rockstar who is immensely popular.
At first, Robbie and Kasturi clash due to their contrasting social classes, values, and morals. However, as they spend more time together, they develop feelings for each other and profess their love. Unfortunately, their relationship does not last long as a misunderstanding arises, causing Robbie to believe that Kasturi is cheating on him with his best friend, Raunak.
Following their breakup, Raunak proposes to Kasturi, and after some hesitation, she accepts. On the day of their wedding, Robbie discovers that he misunderstood Kasturi and Raunak's relationship. He apologizes and begs Kasturi to reconcile, but she rejects him, citing his constant lack of trust.
Raunak and Kasturi's wedding is followed by a series of events in which Robbie tries to sabotage their relationship. However, his attempts backfire, bringing Raunak and Kasturi closer. Tragically, Raunak dies in an accident, leading Kasturi to believe that Robbie is responsible. Seeking revenge, Kasturi marries Robbie under the pretense of moving on and makes his life living hell. Robbie ends up in a coma, seemingly confirming her victory. However, Kasturi is shocked when she encounters Raunak, who is alive and well in Malaysia.
Raunak reveals that he had been manipulating Kasturi all along. He resented Robbie's fame and popularity and wanted to hurt him by marrying Kasturi and framing Robbie for murder. Raunak's accomplice turns out to be Robbie's sister, Shivani, who despises Robbie and is in love with Raunak. They inform Kasturi that their plan now involves killing Robbie to inherit his wealth.
Kasturi returns to India and learns that Robbie despises her for making him suffer for a crime he didn't commit. However, circumstances lead to Robbie and Kasturi reuniting, but Raunak continues to torment Kasturi as she is the only one aware of his true intentions. More twists and turns follow, including the revelation that Robbie's aunt, Maasi, is colluding with Raunak. Kasturi is shot and falls off a cliff, losing her mental balance.
Robbie allows Kasturi to stay in his house, but she behaves like a child and has no memory of her past. Eventually, Raunak's true nature is exposed to everyone, and he is sent to prison. However, Maasi's involvement remains unknown. Another accident restores Kasturi's sanity, and she and Robbie reunite once again.
During the preparations for their wedding, a businessman named Kabir Dhanrajgir enters the story. Kasturi discovers that a significant portion of Robbie's property has been sold with Kabir's involvement. He blackmails her, demanding that she marry him to rectify the situation. On the day of her wedding, Kasturi leaves Robbie and marries Kabir.
Robbie resorts to self-destructive behavior to cope with his pain, while Kasturi realizes that Kabir is a kind-hearted man but struggles to connect with his children. Robbie discovers that Kabir is a murderer who killed his three previous wives and tries to rescue Kasturi from the situation. Kabir dies by falling off a cliff, and Kasturi learns the truth after his death.
Robbie wishes to marry Kasturi again, but his mother, Devika, blames Kasturi for ruining his life. Feeling rejected, Kasturi leaves without informing anyone and goes to live with her friend, Sanchi. Robbie searches for Kasturi but is unable to find her, leading him to confront his mother about their separation. Kasturi starts working in the office of Gayatri Devi, where she meets three brothers—Abhi, Ajay, and Adwit—and helps them with their problems. Robbie, deeply saddened by thoughts of Kasturi, receives encouragement from his father to resume his singing career.
The story culminates with an event organized by Kasturi's employers, where they request Robbie to perform. Kasturi is present at the event, and as Abhi calls out to Robbie, he confesses that he has stopped singing. In that moment, both Kasturi and Robbie realize their feelings for each other. Ultimately, Kasturi and Robbie reunite in marriage, and everything falls into place.

title: Dance Bangla Dance
summary:
Dance Bangla Dance is a Bengali reality show program, which airs in Zee Bangla. It was later remade in Hindi as Dance India Dance. It first started on 6 April 2007, following Dance India Dance by Mithun Chakraborty, who had been the show's host from the beginning.
This show has made national record in 2012 by Limca Book of Records for making 100 non-stop episodes in the sixth season.
According to a news article published in Anandabazar Patrika, Ananda Plus on 6 December 2013, the 2014 season would not be judged by Chakraborty. title: Kayamath
summary: Kayamath (transl. Doomsday) was an Indian soap opera that aired on Star Plus. The show started airing on 19 February 2007, replacing Kahiin to Hoga, and ended on 12 March 2009. The show emphasized how relationships change over time. It starred Shabbir Ahluwalia, Panchi Bora, Jay Bhanushali, and Sanjeeda Sheikh in lead roles.
plot:
Brought up in the lap of luxury, Neev Shergill and Prachi Shah are oblivious to the harsh realities of life. Neev and Prachi's childhood friendship blossoms into love. On the other hand, friends turned lovers Milind Mishra and Ayesha Mehra have lived in poverty all their lives.
Prachi and Ayesha become close friends. Meanwhile, Prachi's brother Alaap starts a relationship with Milind's sister Sukriti. Things turn ugly between Prachi and Milind's families when Alaap humiliates Sukriti and dumps her after a one-night stand.
Prachi is about to marry a man named Varun but he turns out to be a fraud. Finally, as Neev and Prachi are about to be married, it is revealed that Prachi and Ayesha are half-sisters. Prachi's father Inder had an affair with Ayesha's mother Amrita but left her for his wife Premlata and their daughter Prachi. Amrita became mentally unstable but Inder could never accept Ayesha.
Ayesha begins to resent Prachi. She takes over the Shah family's business empire and blackmails Neev into marrying her. Shortly after they get married, Prachi discovers that Inder's death was not an accident but a murder.
Milind, who had moved to Turkey for work, re-enters as a millionaire. To teach Ayesha a lesson as well as to make Prachi pay for Alaap's misdeeds, he presents Prachi with a deal: he will help her find her father's murderer if she agrees to marry him. Prachi accepts. Milind and Prachi's marriage leaves Neev and Ayesha devastated. Milind uses Prachi to make Ayesha jealous, but when alone, mistreats her. Slowly, Milind starts respecting and caring for Prachi. Ayesha constantly attempts to create misunderstandings between them by implying that Prachi is cheating on him with Neev. Neev discovers Ayesha manipulated Prachi into breaking up with him and wants her back but she refuses. Milind and Prachi confess their feelings and consummate their marriage.
Prachi learns of Sukriti and Alaap's illegitimate son, Ritvik and brings the child home and pretends to be his mother. This infuriates Milind and he takes the matter to court. The two nearly get divorced, but the truth comes out just in time. A desperate Ayesha now decides to murder Prachi but Milind is hit by the car and he suffers partial amnesia forgetting Prachi is his wife. Ayesha forces Neev, who has ended his marriage with her, to marry Prachi so that Milind can be hers but before any wedding, Milind's memory returns and he and Prachi reunite. A dejected Ayesha finally gives up.
A businesswoman named Mallika falls for Milind. Ayesha warns her to stay away from Milind and Prachi. One night Mallika brings Milind to her uncle's farmhouse and spikes his drink, making him pass out. Ayesha shows up and in the ensuing scuffle, Mallika stabs and kills Ayesha. Prachi learns that she is pregnant but, before she can tell Milind, she finds out that Ayesha has been murdered and Milind is arrested for it.
Mallika forces Prachi to leave Milind to help free him. Prachi agrees and leaves Milind to catch a train. In the meanwhile, Milind is released. He figures out that Mallika is responsible for Prachi's sudden decision to leave him. He tries to stop Prachi but in vain. Prachi reaches Kolkata and meets a Bengali couple - Proteek Dasgupta and his wife Panchi, who are travelling with their infant. Panchi hears out Prachi's story and urges Proteek to convince her to stay with them. Milind drives off to the station where Prachi's train is supposed to arrive. Upon reaching there, he and the Shahs come to know that there has been a blast on the train and assume Prachi is dead.

title: Maanada Mayilada
summary:
Maanada Mayilada is an Indian dance competition show airing from 2007 till 2015 on Kalaignar TV. The show was conceived, produced and directed by noted choreographer Kala Master. She is also one of the judges and the only constant judge throughout the show. Other judges have been Brinda, Khushbu, Rambha, Namitha, Simran, Mumtaj, Sudha Chandran, Meena. Prashanth and Srikanth. Sanjeev and Kiki Vijay have been the hosts for all seasons.
The choreographers for this dance show include Prem Master, Anthony Master, Rajesh Master, RameklkMaster, Chandru Master, Raghu Master, Sandy, Mani Master, Tamil Master, Bala Master, Nantha. Maanada Mayilada has alternative choreographers and sometimes the choreographers help each other during the seasons.
tagline: Maanada Mayilada is an Indian dance competition show airing from 2007 till 2015 on Kalaignar TV.

title: Kana Kaanum Kaalangal
summary: Kana Kaanum Kaalangal (transl. Era of Dreams) is a Tamil drama soap opera that aired in Star Vijay, Monday to Thursday, from 30 October 2006 to 28 April 2009.  It was the first soap in Tamil television that focused on school life. Due to the success of the show, a sequel called Kana Kaanum Kaalangal Kallooriyin Kadhai was made. Later another sequel to the serial called Kana Kaanum Kalangal Kalloori Saalai was also made. Both the sequels focused on college life. It was re-aired on Star Vijay Super from 16 January 2017, Monday through Friday at 8:00PM.
plot: The story is set in school revolving around 12 students, separated into 2 groups. The plot details the rivalry between these 2 groups and the consequences of this. Everyday happenings of the student life are portrayed in this series to very minute details like healthy competition, fights, family matters, ego, jealousy, love and friendship.

title: Kasthuri
summary: Kasthuri is an Indian Tamil-language soap opera that aired on Sun TV from 21 August 2006 and later a show named 'Madhavi' took the time slot of this serial on 19 April 2010. It shifted to the 11.30AM slot. This serial was replaced by Kanmaneeya and again shifted on 13 December 2011, telecast for 1,532 episodes. The show starred Easwari Rao, Niya, Latha, Delhi Ganesh, Shyam, Neelima Rani, Aparna and Nithish among others. It was produced by Balaji Telefilms Ekta Kapoor and Shobha Kapoor, and had various directors. It also aired in Sri Lanka on the Tamil channel on Shakthi TV. It is an official remake of blockbuster Telugu series Kalyanee which aired on Gemini TV.
plot:
The story of a village girl who marries a groom from the city. Ram is the groom and wants a modern and educated wife. While he and his parents come to this village to see Kasturi, unknowingly he sees another girl who is fairer near the well of the house. Thinking that she is Kasthuri (Easwari Rao), Ram says OK for the marriage, and they arrange the marriage. On the date of marriage, Ram is shocked to see the real Kasturi very dark in color and not educated or looks modern. However, there is no choice for him other than to marry Kasthuri (Easwari Rao), so he marries her. Later he brings Kasturi to his residence in Chennai, Tamil Nadu.
Ram later identifies the girl he had seen in the village, gets in touch with her, and hides the truth that he is married to Kasturi and marries that girl. There is a friend of Ram who is very polite and responsible. He helps Kasturi and her father to reunite with Ram again. The entire serial showcases how Kasthuri (Easwari Rao) solves all the problems when she is alone without Ram.
tagline: The story of a village girl who marries a groom from the city.

title: F.I.R.
summary: F.I.R. is an Indian television sitcom produced by Edit 2 Productions that aired from 31 July 2006 to  23 January 2015 on SAB TV.
plot:
F.I.R. is an acronym for first information report, a document that the Indian police prepares for each case to be investigated.
F.I.R. is centered on a Haryanvi female police officer named Chandramukhi Chautala and her three subordinates, Head Constable Gopinath Gandothra, Constable Mulayam Singh Gulgule, and Constable Billu, who later joined the Chowki. The show depicts their lives as they try to solve every case which comes to their police station Imaan Chowki, Ravanpur.
The show also features romantic storylines between Chandramukhi Chautala and each of the police station's chief inspectors, Hanuman Prasad Pandey, Raj Aaryan and Bajrang Pandey.

episodesList.title: Imaan Chowki
episodesList.summary: Officers at Iman Chowki are worried that an extremely honest Police Officer is getting posted there and all their corruption will come to an end. But a local thief, who gets mistaken for inspector Bajrang Pandey, takes over the role in the Police station and continues his role as an imposter. Watch how the station reacts to this fake inspector only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Fir Registration
episodesList.summary: As soon as the locals in the area hear that the new inspector offers 50 rupees for filing a report, a huge mass gathers around the station. People are waiting in lines just to get their FIR registered. Will our fake inspector manage to continue his lies? Watch now on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Woman Beats a Man
episodesList.summary: A man rushes into the station to file a report against a woman who was beaten by her. He seems terrified at the idea of this woman. He claims that he by mistake splashed some dirt on her and in return she beat him black and blue. Who is this woman who beat up this civilian? Watch this hilarious episode now only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Brahmachari Bajranj Pandey
episodesList.summary: Sub Inspector Chandra Mukhi Chautala finds out that Bajrang Pandey isn't as Brahmachari as he portrays. She sees him in a dhaba drinking beer and eating non vegetarian food. Our imposter inspector does a good job of covering all this up and escapes the drilling. Watch as hilarity ensues on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Mission Laila Majnu
episodesList.summary: Officers at Imaan Chowki decide to do an operation of highest priority. They decide on cracking down on couples in the park and call it mission Laila Majnu. How will this war against love turn out for our honest officers? Watch now only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Inspector Gulgule
episodesList.summary: The two havaldaars at Imaan chowki are worried that they have no respect in the eyes of the local public and need to up their game to get what they deserve. They formulate a plan to climb up the social hierarchy. How will the plan turn up for Gopi and Gulgule? Watch exclusively on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: The Lost Buffalo
episodesList.summary: A man loses his buffalo called Mandakini and goes to the Police station to file a complaint. Gandotre and Gulgule get super confused at the man's story and ask himto file a report after 24 hours. Will this man be able to overcome the bureaucracy and file his report? Watch now on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Explosives In a Vegetable
episodesList.summary: An evil Villain has a plan to put explosives in a vegetable and use it against the civilians. Our team of efficient police officers is close by and keeping a close eye on all strange objects from strangers. Will our Inspector's love for Kaddu prove to be costly? Watch the entire episode on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Badnaam Imaan Chowki
episodesList.summary: Our officers at Imaan Chowki are tensed that a recent survey has ranked their Chowki as the most inefficient Chowki in the country. Inspector Bajrang decides to make drastic changes and change the Chowki's reputation. They decide to crack down on all illegal activities. Watch now on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Passport Verification
episodesList.summary: A family comes to inquire about their update on the passport verification but our officers are in no mood to work. After taking a bribe of 400 rupees, the file finally moves a little forward. How does this entire experience pan out for the family? Watch now only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Diwali At Imaan Chowki
episodesList.summary: The officers at Imaan Chowki are upset at the idea that they have to be out on duty during the Diwali celebrations. They had promised their family members that they would be home but the inspector orders them that there are threats according to the commissioner and everyone has to be on high alert. How will Diwali go for our bravehearts? Watch entire episode on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Honey is Missing
episodesList.summary: Famous Model Tara comes to file a report because Honey is missing. The officers at the Chowki are confused as to who and what is this honey and how is it missing. Our inspector's heart starts to flutter after seeing Tara. Will our officers be successful in finding Honey? Watch now on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Gopi's Nephew
episodesList.summary: Constable Gopi's nephew comes to visit him at the station. He wants him to save him from Eve teasing charges. He reminds uncle that his uncle too must have made a mistake in his past, so he must protect him this time. Will patriarchy win or can the man finally file his report against his wife's harassment.

episodesList.title: Lage Raho Chandramukhi
episodesList.summary: Sub-Inspector Chautala and Inspector Hanuman go out and watch a movie together. The movie of their choice seems to be Lage Raho Munna Bhai. The movie makes a huge impact on  Sub Inspector Chautala. She goes around and apologizes to all the criminals she beat up in the past. How long will this nonviolence last?

episodesList.title: The Forgetful Dancer
episodesList.summary: Our officers raid an illegal dance bar. They get hold of one of the dancers who pretends to be crazy and forgetful. She claims that she was kidnapped and that she doesn't remember anything after that. Officers take her to a mental Asylum to get an expert opinion on her. Watch the entire episode only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Kuku’s Missing Chicken
episodesList.summary: A man named Kuku comes into the police station to file an FIR. He complains that his chicken has gone missing and insists that Jokila wrote his report. It appears he has a soft part for Jokila. Will the man find his chicken? Watch now only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Terrorist Mix Up
episodesList.summary: A man's father goes missing and he comes to the police station to file a report.  Here he finds out that a famous terrorist was also on the run. Constable Gulgule takes the photos and gets them printed. Will the police be able to find the terrorist and the missing father? Watch now on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: The Queen’s Speech
episodesList.summary: The Maharani and her translator come to the police station to file a complaint. The translator announces that the Maharani had an accident and has since lost her speech. But she was there to report her missing necklace worth 70 lakhs. Will they be able to retrieve it? Or our inefficient police officers stall on this call too.

episodesList.title: Man With No Arms
episodesList.summary: A man with no arms walks into the police station to file a report about his missing vest. Sub-inspector Chautala finds it the most tempting moment to lech at Hanuman Prasad and check him out physically. Watch as this hilarious episode unfolds on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Hanuman Prasad’s Challenge
episodesList.summary: Sub-inspector Chautala and Inspector Hanuman get into a gender debate where Hanuman insists that there will be a report where a man will come and complain about his wife-beating him. Fortunately for him, exactly that happens and a man comes in to file an FIR against his wife. How does this affect the challenge? Watch now only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: The Inspection
episodesList.summary: Commissioner Mukhtar Singh sends a letter to the officers at Iman chauki saying that he would be coming there for an inspection. This creates fear amongst all the officers. They fear that their corruption will get busted and Hanuman is worried his truth will be revealed. Watch how the team deals with an honest strict officer like Mukhtar.

episodesList.title: Con Man Asthana
episodesList.summary: A famous con man has been troubling the city. He marries young women, takes their jewellery and absconds. The police department receives complaints about him but they get a bigger shock when the famous Asthana challenges them openly through a letter. Can our officers catch this seasoned criminal? Watch now on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: The Teasing Ghost
episodesList.summary: Mr.Cheda comes to the police station with a complaint that a ghost has been teasing his wife. The officers in our Chowki don't know how to deal with this unusual situation. They make Makkhan Singh practice on Inspector Chautala but the commissioner walks in on them. Watch this hilarious episode on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Gulgule has Cancer
episodesList.summary: Gulgule gets his report and finds out that he has intestine cancer. He becomes a changed man hearing this news. Gulgule begs Pandey to marry Chautala as his last wish. But before anything could happen, Chautala has to tell the truth. What was Chauatala's truth? Will marriage finally happen? Find out in this episode of FIR.

episodesList.title: Pandey Meets Nakaab Queen
episodesList.summary: Chautala wants to dance with Pandey. Gulgule arrests Onetwo who was making videos of ladies on the street. Indrajeet Chadha comes as Onetwo's lawyer with his bail. Pandey request Onetwo to introduce him to Nakaab Queen. Chautala comes up with an idea to complete her dream of dancing with Pandey.

episodesList.title: Not a Doctor
episodesList.summary: A doctor comes to file an FIR for his missing mobile phone. Upon investigation, the mobile phone is found out in his last patient's stomach. The doctor operates on him again but time forgets the handcuffs. The patient needs third surgery. Will he agree to get operated by the same doctor?

episodesList.title: Banana Peel
episodesList.summary: A man slipped on a banana peel, comes to the police station to ask for compensation from the man before whose house he slipped. Gulgule brings two men in because the peel was facing in two directions. Both men refuse to pay. What will Chautala do? Find out in this episode of FIR.

episodesList.title: Sweets Sweets
episodesList.summary: Ram Kathailu comes to the station to complain that someone has opened a sweets shop with the same name 'Ram Tahilu' right in front of his shop and he is losing business. Chautala asks them to prove themselves. But she must end this confusion. How will Chautala figure out the real and the fake?

episodesList.title: About Marriage
episodesList.summary: Chautala's father arrives at the station and asks for only one thing, for her to get married. Chautala reveals that she likes Pandey for her groom. Pappu comes to the station to file an FIR against a man who has broken a 20-year-old promise. Watch this episode to find out what happens next.

episodesList.title: Chautala Resigns
episodesList.summary: Chautala gets into trouble after beating up the forest mister's driver. She quits the job and gets arrested. She finds herself sharing the same cell as Tappu. Tappu gives Chautala the offer to join his gang. Will Chautala switch sides and join Tappu's gang? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Treasure
episodesList.summary: When everyone in the station is enjoying their non-veg mean a man named Gauri Shankar brings a treasure box in. A man from the Nawab family who is also the owner of a chicken shop arrives a complaint about his missing hen. Chautala gets and idea to find out what is inside the treasure box.

episodesList.title: Printing Error
episodesList.summary: Pehalwan Dharti Pakad Khade Khade comes to Imaan Station with his problem, he keeps getting calls from hundreds of people inquiring about Dillon. All this started because of a printing error. Pehalwan and his uncle are troubled by this and seek help from Chautala.

episodesList.title: Chautala Dreams Of a House
episodesList.summary: W Developer comes to file an FIR on his tenant who is living in his flat for the last five years without paying any money. Chautala and her subordinates find this as a perfect opportunity to skim some money for themselves. Watch this episode to find out who they solve the case and get themselves some extra money.

episodesList.title: Valentine's Day
episodesList.summary: Everyone in the station is excited about Valentine's Day. Chautala asks Pandey out but he refuses. Two men come into the station to complain about their son and daughter respectively being involved in love and ask for help from the police. Will Chautala help the love birds or separate them? Will Chautala be always alone? Find out in this episode of FIR.

episodesList.title: Chandrika Sherawat
episodesList.summary: Chandrika Sherawat, a famous actress visits the Imaan Chowki for her training and Pandey has fallen head over heels for her. Everyone in the station is giving her all the attention and Chautala does not like this. She plans to do something that will reveal the true motives of the actress.

episodesList.title: Gopi Aur Hanuman Ki Anbhan
episodesList.summary: Head constable Gopi and Hanuman have a verbal altercation which leads to Gopi wanting to resign. Meanwhile, a tensed civilian has been making rounds of Iman Chowki to file his report against the corrupt builders, who forgot to put a bathroom in his flat. Watch as the team struggles to solve his problem.

episodesList.title: Hanuman's Stupidity
episodesList.summary: A troubled individual comes to the Chowki with his friend to file a complaint. He says that a drunkard has been troubling his servant and his wife every night. The Police summon the man and the man reveals that he has been doing so to force the complainant out of the house. He offers money in return for Chandramukhi and her officer's favours. Will Hanuman again spoil their plan or will the complainant be forced out his house? Watch entire episode one Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Puncturewala
episodesList.summary: A famous businessman comes with a doubt that the puncturewala infront of his house purposely puts nails around his shop to puncture vehicles. Is he right in his assumptions and doubts? Or is it just insecurity? Watch as the team dives deep into the case. Watch exclusively on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Laalchi Hanuman
episodesList.summary: A worried rich business man comes to file a report against his to be son in law, who impregnated his daughter and ran away. This gives an idea to Inspector Hanuman, as he offers to father the child. This comes as a shock to everyone as he was supposed to be a Brahmachari. Will Hanuman now quit his job and become a rich son-in-law? Watch entire episode on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Holi Hai!
episodesList.summary: Its Holi time and everyone is super excited to celebrate it. Chandramukhi wants to celebrate it with Maakhan but he refuses straight away. This upsets Chandramukhi and she along with Gopi and Gulgule, plan something to trick Inspector Hanuman on the day of Holi. What is the plan? Only one way to find out.

episodesList.title: Say No to Dowry
episodesList.summary: A case of Dowry comes up at the Police station. A father and her daughter come up to file their report against the Grooms family.Chandramukhi gets overly involved in the case and is on a mission to get the wife justice. Watch as Chandrmukhi fights a cause on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Imaan Chowki is Sold
episodesList.summary: Golu Bakdi comes inside the police station and tells everyone to empty up the police station but later on, he comes to know that the person who sold him the police station was a thief and he is Hanuman's best friend. Chandramukhi puts both of them in jail. Will Hanuman Prasad and Guru be able to run?

episodesList.title: Missing Son
episodesList.summary: A mother complaints about her missing son Vijay Kumar. Chandramukhi promises that she will get her son. But later on, she comes to know that her son his dead. Will Chandramukhi find out the truth?

episodesList.title: Hanuman Prasand and The Burning Coal
episodesList.summary: A prisoner has been shifted to Chandramukhi's police station. Chandramukhi tries to impress Hanuman Prasad but she fails to do so, and takes out her anger on that prisoner. A baba comes and tells Hanuman that if he walks on burning coal Chandramukhi will get better. Will Hanuman Prasad walk on the burning coal?

episodesList.title: Married Woman
episodesList.summary: An astrologer tells Chandramukhi that she has the yog of getting married to the one she loves but she has to keep him away from the married woman. Meanwhile, a married woman calls at Imaan Chowki to file an FIR.  What will Chandramukhi do?

episodesList.title: Friendhsip Day
episodesList.summary: Gulgule has plans for friendhsip day and has some idea where he tells Chandramukhi to buy a ring and put it on Hanuman Prasads finger and this is how she will get married . Will Gulgule's plan work?

episodesList.title: An English Woman
episodesList.summary: A man arrives at the Imaan Chowki with his wife and daughter in law to lodge a complaint against his son whose planning to leave his daughter in law and marry an english woman. Will the officers at Imaan Chowki help him or add to his misery?

episodesList.title: Gulgule's Plan
episodesList.summary: A man arrives at Imaan Chowki to lodge an F.I.R that he was kidnapped and was forced to spend the night with a girl, listening to this Gulgule has a plan for Chandramukhi regarding how she can marry Hanuman Prasad. What is Gulgule's Plan?

episodesList.title: Late Night English Movies
episodesList.summary: A man lodges a complaint at Imaan Chowki against the cable man regarding the english movies that are played on TV late at night. But Hanuman Prasad Pandey is in favour of the cable man. How will Chandramukhi be able to sue the cable man?

episodesList.title: The Serial Killer
episodesList.summary: A man lodges a complaint against a shopkeeper for selling him shoes of different sizes. Officers at Imaan Chowki are tensed to know that a serial killer is on the loose and has killed a police personnel. Will they be able to find that serial killer? Tune in to find out!

episodesList.title: Hamuman Prasad's Due
episodesList.summary: A man lodges a complaint at Imaan Chowki against Hanuman Prasad Pandey that his dad's debt of Rupees One Lakh is due and he has to clear his dad's debt. How will Hanuman Prasad Pandey clear the dues? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: No More F.i.r
episodesList.summary: A man arrives at Imaan Chowki to lodge a complaint that he has seen a murder but Chandramukhi insists that she will not write the F.I.R because if there is one more F.I.R written in Imaan Chowki the Chowki will be closed. Will Chandramukhi solve the case?

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi Weds Hanuman?
episodesList.summary: A Jyotish arrives at Imaan Chowki and tells Hanuman Prasad that if he marries Chandramukhi he will become rich and prosperous, the same Jyotish also informs Chandramukhi about her future. What is the prediction done by the Jyotish?

episodesList.title: Hero Hanuman Prasad Pandey
episodesList.summary: A producer comes to lodge a complaint about an actor in his film and promises Hanuman Prasad to cast him as the hero, Chandramukhi tries her best to convince the producer not to cast Hanuman in his film. Watch the episode to witness what happens next.

episodesList.title: The Pinch
episodesList.summary: A man comes to the police station to lodge a complaint against the person who has pinched his wife in the Mela. Chandramukhi Chautala and team start investigating. Watch the episode to witness the case unfold.

episodesList.title: Lovers and The Postman
episodesList.summary: A boy and a girl who love each other, write letters to each other but the postman also loves the girl and never delivers the letters, they both get separated and the postman starts to get romantic with the girl. The boy comes to the station to lodge a complaint against the postman.

episodesList.title: Fraud Builder
episodesList.summary: Akhtar Armaan a shayar comes to file an F.I.R against a builder who sold him a flat located on the 20th floor but the building has a lift only till the 6th floor, because of this his wife leaves him. Watch the episode to know how Chandramukhi deals with this case.

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi's Oath
episodesList.summary: A man arrives at Imaan Chowki to lodge a complaint against his oppressive wife and he encourages Gulgule to stop Chandramukhi from slapping him. Chandramukhi takes an oath that she will never slap Gulgule. Will Gulgule be able sustain without Chandramukhi slapping him?

episodesList.title: Hanuman Insults Chandramukhi
episodesList.summary: Its Diwali time, Chandramukhi plans to get Hanuman Prasad to lit the joint rocket so that they will be united in the future. Hanuman Prasad comes to know about the plan and insults Chandramukhi. How will Chandramukhi deal with this insult?

episodesList.title: Exploitations Of a Boss
episodesList.summary: A man comes to the police station to lodge a complaint against his boss who is a woman, that she exploits her powers as a boss and tries to seduce him in the office. How will Chandramukhi deal with this unusual case? Tune in to find out.

episodesList.title: Fraud Employee
episodesList.summary: A business man lodges a complaint against his employee that instead of delivering the money at its destination he has bought properties for a girl. The business man suggests an idea to Hanuman Prasad to get his property back. Watch the episode to know what is the business man's idea?

episodesList.title: Training The Pickpocket
episodesList.summary: A man arrives at Imaan Chowki with the complaint of a pickpocket who tries to steal his wallet, Chandramukhi decides to get the pickpocket trained by Hanuman Prasad with an ulterior motive. What is Chandramukhi's motive?

episodesList.title: Lucky Customer
episodesList.summary: Two auto rickshaw drivers arrive at Imaan Chowki with a customer and they are fighting with each other for the customer as he is lucky. How will Chandramukhi solve this dispute? Tune in to join the laughter ride!

episodesList.title: Chopra Ka Jhopda
episodesList.summary: A man named Chopra comes to the police station to file a complaint against the builder who wants to forcefully build a shopping mall on his land. Watch the episode to know how Chandramukhi and team solve this case.

episodesList.title: Faulty Shampoo
episodesList.summary: A man comes to the police station to file an F.I.R against the owner of a shampoo manufacturer, as the man has lost all his hair due to the usage of the shampoo manufactured by his company. Watch the episode to laugh your hearts out!

episodesList.title: The Garbage Girl
episodesList.summary: A man arrives at the Imaan Chowki to file a complaint against a woman who throws garbage on him everyday while he's leaving for work, due to this he is about to loose his job since his boss requires him to wear spick and span clothes.

episodesList.title: 3 Days and No Night
episodesList.summary: A person comes to lodge an F.I.R against Raju Travels as he had booked a trip and Raju travels had booked the hotel only for 3 days and not the night due to which he had to sleep on the road with his wife. Chandramukhi and Hunuman Prasad are solving the case in their own unusual way.

episodesList.title: The Lost Girl
episodesList.summary: An actor named Karan comes to the police station to lodge an F.I.R as his girlfriend named Kavita is lost while they were roaming around in Ravanpur. Will they make a mockery of the case as usual?

episodesList.title: Get Married Chandramukhi!
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi's father comes to the police station to convince her to get married and he starts getting men to the police station for her to choose. Her father keeps on blackmailing to convince her. How will Chandramukhi get out of this situation?

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi Wants to be Famous
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi comes to Hanuman Prasad with a Mangal Sutra, but Hanuman rejects her saying he will marry someone who is famous. Chandramukhi decides that she will become famous anyhow. Tune in to witness Chandramukhi's road to fame.

episodesList.title: Naagin Chandramukhi
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi comes to know that Hanuman Prasad is afraid of snakes, Chandramukhi tries to scare hanuman by dressing in a naagin dress with the motive to convince him to marry her. Will Hanuman Prasad give in?

episodesList.title: Landlord and The Tenant
episodesList.summary: A landlord wants to lodge a complaint against his tenant about him not paying the rent on time and the landlord gets a shock everytime he rings the bell of the tenant's apartment. Watch the episode to witness all the confusion and laughter!

episodesList.title: Pehelwaan Billu Bilori
episodesList.summary: A wrestler storms the police station and threatens Hanuman Prasad to kill him because he eve teased his girlfriend, Chandramukhi plans to get Hanuman Prasad attacked by the wrestler with an ulterior motive. What is Chandramukhi's motive? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Akade Pakde
episodesList.summary: A man comes to the police station to file a complaint against a man who instead of dropping him to his wedding destination kept on driving for 4-5 days due to which he missed his wedding. How will Chandramukhi and team solve this baffling case?

episodesList.title: Prabhhu Ki Leela
episodesList.summary: A man comes to the police station to lodge a complaint against a man named Prabhu who wants to kill him since the man doesn't want Prabhu to marry his daughter. Watch the episode to witness the case unfold in detail

episodesList.title: Hakdaar
episodesList.summary: Two couples file an F.I.R that one of their relative had died a few years ago and his property will go to his son when he gets married, the two couples bring two different men each claiming that the man they have brought is the one whose entitled to the property.

episodesList.title: Golden Class Tickets
episodesList.summary: A man comes to the police station to file a complaint that he bought expensive movie tickets expecting privacy but the person who sold them the tickets showed him the movie on a DVD player. Watch this hilarious episode now!

episodesList.title: Chaatwaala
episodesList.summary: A lady comes to the police station to file a complaint against a Chaatwala and a Doctor, whoever eats Chaat from the Chaatwaala has to immediately go to the doctor on account of stomach ache. What would be Chandramukhi and team's course of action now?

episodesList.title: Tendua
episodesList.summary: A man comes to file an F.I.R against a builder who has given him a flat in a forest area, where the buyer is facing problems because of the intruding animals, even a Leopard. Chandramukhi Chautala sends Hanuman Prasad to catch the Leopard.

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi Chautala Ka Darr
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi informs Hanuman Prasad through Gulgule that she shot an inspector in the past for spitting paan on her shoes, the next day Hanuman by mistakely spits Paan on Chandramukhi's shoes. Watch the episode to know what happens next.

episodesList.title: Lambi Race Ka Ghoda
episodesList.summary: A man comes to file an F.I.R against a horse owner that he sent the horse used in Race Courses at his marriage, as a result the horse ran away as soon as he sat on it on the day of his marriage. Watch the episode to witness the team solve this hilarious case.

episodesList.title: Kiss In The Tunnel
episodesList.summary: A man with his wife comes to the police station to lodge a complaint against two suspected men, one of them has kissed his wife while they were on a train journey. With the excuse to solve the case Chandramukhi plans to kiss Hanuman Prasad. Will she succeed in her intentions?

episodesList.title: Role Play
episodesList.summary: A struggling actor arrives at the police station to lodge a complaint, Chandramukhi gets an idea to make the actor play her husband to make Hanuman Prasad jealous. Will she succeed or will she be caught in the act?

episodesList.title: Jimmy Jabaaz
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi arrests a famous killer Jimmy and tells him to stay away from Hanuman Prasad. Jimmy breaks free from the police station and challenges Chandramukhi that he will kill Hanuman Prasad in the next 24 hours. Will Chandramukhi be able to save Hanuman Prasad?

episodesList.title: Dil Nahi Lagta
episodesList.summary: A man comes to file an F.I.R. against an agent who promised to send him to Dubai for a better job but that agent cheats and sends him to Madh Island. The agent lures Hanuman Prasad by promising him that he will send him to Dubai if he lets him go. Will Chandramukhi be able to stop Hanuman Prasad?

episodesList.title: Pyara Haanthi
episodesList.summary: A man comes to file an F.I.R against one of the pet company's owner that he has sent him an Elephant instead of a little pet he applied for. Company's owner defends himself by saying that the man had applied for a 'Pyara' pet so he sent him an Elephant named "Pyara". Watch the episode to witness all the confusion and fun!

episodesList.title: Murkh Baalak
episodesList.summary: A school teacher arrives at the police station to lodge a complaint against his student who harasses him by asking stupid questions. How will Chandramukhi and team deal with this case? Tune in to find out.

episodesList.title: Sautan Ki Saheli
episodesList.summary: Hanuman Prasad arrives at the Imaan Chowki after an absence of two days, on asking he doesn't answer clearly and says he's been in the mountains. Chandramukhi gets an idea to harass Hanuman Prasad. What is this idea?

episodesList.title: Budhapa
episodesList.summary: Hanuman Prasad reveals that he is 65 years old. A Saint had given him some medicines to look younger, but now as that Saint has died and all his medicines are over, Hanuman Prasad starts ageing. How will Chandramukhi deal with this?

episodesList.title: Manchali
episodesList.summary: A man comes to file an F.I.R for his missing wife. Chandramukhi plans to go out on a hilll station with Hanuman Prasad but he's reluctant. Will Chandramukhi be able to convince hanuman Prasad? Will the man find his wife?

episodesList.title: Khandaani Chappal
episodesList.summary: While travelling in the train a man looses one from the pair of his khaandani chappals and on the advice of the co passenger he threw his socond chappal as well but later he found that the first chappal is in the train itself, he wants to lodge a complaint against the co passenger for making him loose his Khandaani chappal.

episodesList.title: Kaamwaali Baai
episodesList.summary: Hanuman Prasad hires a woman for domestic help and develops romantic relations with her, this makes Chandramukhi jealous and she decides to enact a role play where she hires a domestic helper to make Hanuman Prasad jealous.

episodesList.title: Ugly Hanuman
episodesList.summary: Hanuman Prasad tells Chandramukhi that he is very handsome and she is nothing in comparison to him. Chandramukhi sends some girls to tell Hanuman Prasad how ugly he is, he gets very upset and decides to commit suicide. How will Chandramukhi save his life?

episodesList.title: Dheeraj Neeraj
episodesList.summary: Dheeraj comes to file an F.I.R that he's been working at Trivedi's house since he was a child because he loves Trivedi's daughter Utawli. But now Trivedi has fixed her marriage with someone else. Will Chandramukhi be able to get justice for Dheeraj?

episodesList.title: Lihaaz
episodesList.summary: Madan comes to file an F.I.R. against a man Lalit that whenever he goes out with his wife Katili, Lalit is already present there and greets his wife, one day Lalit takes 2 Lakh rupees from Madan and escapes. Watch the episode to witness the case in detail.

episodesList.title: Simple Dimple
episodesList.summary: A man named Seedhe comes to file an F.I.R. against his wife's friend Dimple that his wife Simple is  playing cards and gambling all the time with Dimple and she doesn't care about him. Chandramukhi thinks of a unique strategy to deal with the case.

episodesList.title: A Night Well Spent
episodesList.summary: Ishwar comes to file an F.I.R. with his daughter Reena against Appu Utawla that Appu had spent a night with Reena in a locked lift, so now Appu has to marry Reena. Appu defends himself saying that he didn't do anything wrong that night and he's already engaged. How will Chandramukhi solve this case?

episodesList.title: Faraar Furtili
episodesList.summary: A man Sandeep comes to file a complaint that he is married to a girl named Furtili whose a sports lover. She ran away a few days back and hasn't returned yet. Will the efficient officers at Imaan Chowki help Sandeep get his wife back?

episodesList.title: Kutta
episodesList.summary: Three neighbours come to file an F.I.R. against their 4th floor neighbour Kaushal that he's brought a dog and they are really scared of the dog since he bites them and steals milk and newspaper from their house. Watch the episode to witness Chandramukhi solve the case.

episodesList.title: Raaju Rangeela
episodesList.summary: Raju comes to file an F.I.R against his father's friend Tappu that he forces him to wear colourful clothes, Tappu comes to the station and informs that it was Raju's fathers's last wish to see Raju wear colourful clothes. How will Raju get justice now?

episodesList.title: Khandaani Mooch
episodesList.summary: Mitthu comes to file an F.I.R against Guddu that he has cut half of his Khandaani Mooch because of that he couldn't go to fix his marriage date, Guddu tells Chandramukhi that it was by accident. How will Mitthu get back his Khandaani Mooch?

episodesList.title: Bechara Dulha
episodesList.summary: A man Kapil comes to file an F.I.R against a Bus Driver and a Conductor as he was planning to go to fix his marriage but the Driver isn't starting the journey and he can't go by a private vehicle since his uncle fights with him everytime he books a private vehicle. Watch the episode to laugh your hearts out!

episodesList.title: Pyareji
episodesList.summary: A watchman of a society comes to file an F.I.R against Pyareji Gulati and Pyareji Gahlot that they got a love letter from a girl addressed to the name Pyareji. So now both the Pyarejis are fighting in the society over who the letter belongs to. Which Pyareji does the letter actually belong? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Coolie
episodesList.summary: A Coolie comes to file an F.I.R. against Gappu that Gappu is not paying him after he has helped him with the luggage, Gappu tells that everytime the Coolie keeps his luggage in the wrong train. Watch the team of efficient officers at Imaan Chowki solve this case.

episodesList.title: Apsara
episodesList.summary: A woman, Apsara comes to lodge a complaint against her husband Madan as he doesn't give her any attention and he is having an extra marital affair, Madan tells that he was deceived into marrying her. What happens next? Tune in to find out!

episodesList.title: Tasalli
episodesList.summary: A landlord comes to file an F.I.R that he had rented his house to a married couple and the wife has stolen valuables from the house and ran away, the husband tells that they weren't married and were just pretenting to be married to get the apartment. How will Chandramukhi find the woman whose stolen the valuables?

episodesList.title: Gulgule Ka Promotion
episodesList.summary: Hanuman Prasad makes Gulgule dance in front of a lady, he feels insulted and is about to resign. Chandramukhi feels jealous seeing Hanuman flirt with the lady so she makes a plan to stop Gulgule from resigning and teach Hanuman a lesson in one go. What is this plan?

episodesList.title: Barsaat
episodesList.summary: Hanuman Prasad refuses Chandramukhi to dance outside in the rain with her because he is scared of rain. But on a rainy night she finds Hanuman Prasad enjoying with another girl. What will she do now? Tune in to find out.

episodesList.title: Ajnabee Dost
episodesList.summary: Rimpi Singh wants to marry a woman but her condition is to make her brother happy, so Rimpi cooks food for his to be brother in law but two men claiming to be his friends eat the food everyday but Rimpi says these men are strangers to him and because of them he's unable to marry the woman he loves.

episodesList.title: Rakhi
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi asks Hanuman Prasad about their relationship but he gives a confusing answer, Gulgule gives an idea that she should tie rakhi to Hanuman Prasad to make him confess his true feelings. Will the plan work or make things worse for Chandramukhi?

episodesList.title: Old Couple
episodesList.summary: Gulgule gets an old couple to the police station because they spent the night on a bench, the man Sweety Singh tells them that they thad to spend the night outside because their son Tommy threw them out of their house. Tommy is called for an inquiry. Watch the episode to witness the case in detail.

episodesList.title: Jolly and Polly
episodesList.summary: Jolly to impress his wife Polly took her to a posh hotel, but the sealing of the room they had booked leaked all night, due to this he felt humiliated in front of his wife and now he wants the manager of the hotel to compensate them. Will he get his compensation?

episodesList.title: Kaala Rang
episodesList.summary: Sundar comes to file an F.I.R. against Babloo that last year on Holi Babloo had coloured his face black and because of that Sundar is unable to fix his marriage with Tinni as her father wants her to marry someone with a fair complexion. Watch the episode to witness our beloved officers solve this problem.

episodesList.title: Baal Ki Khaal
episodesList.summary: Keshav wants to file an F.I.R against one of the famous hotels and their staff because he found strands of hair in his food and on complaining he was forced to pay the entire bill. Will Keshav get his justice? Tune in to find out.

episodesList.title: Umraao Jaan
episodesList.summary: Munni and Umraao Jaan come to file an F.I.R. against an unknown thief who stole Umraao's valuable necklace gifted by Rai Bahadur in one of the gatherings. Chandramukhi calls all the people who were present at that gathering to investigate the case. Will Chandramukhi catch the thief?

episodesList.title: Yaadaasht
episodesList.summary: Illu electrician comes to seek help from Chandramukhi because his girlfriend accidently got an electric shock from him and in that accident she lost her memory. Now Chandramukhi plans to give an electric shock to Hanuman Prasad until he loses his memory. Why is she doing this? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Vichitra Ka Charitra
episodesList.summary: Kalpana comes to file an F.I.R. against her husband Anokhe's best friend Vichitra that while they were shopping in a Mall Vichitra eve teased her but Vichitra defends himself by saying he meant to compliment the Mall and not her. Whose telling the truth? Tune in to find out.

episodesList.title: Intuition
episodesList.summary: Ramesh comes to file an F.I.R. against Tillu that he gives wrong intuitions to him and asks for money to give the right intuitions, Chandramukhi arrests Tillu and asks him to give a wrong intuition to Hanuman Prasad. What's on Chandramukhi's mind? Watch this episode to join the laughter ride.

episodesList.title: Tarzan
episodesList.summary: Vimal comes to file an F.I.R against a guy who he had seen last night hanging and dancing on his daughter's window, Chandramukhi investigates and finds out that Kimi and the guy are lovers and she alerts Kimi that he is a fraud but Kimi is blinded by love. Will Chandramukhi be able to save Kimi from being mugged?

episodesList.title: Tinki Ka Saajan
episodesList.summary: Saajan wants to marry Tinku's sister Tinki but Tinku is objects because Saajan has failed to prove his birth certificate to Tinku and Municipal Corporation is refusing to produce a birth certificate to him as Saajan was born in a train between U.P. and M.P. How will Chandramukhi be able to help Saajan?

episodesList.title: Illu Izzatdaar
episodesList.summary: As soon as Chandramukhi enters the station, a mysterious figure wearing a Burqa rushes in. Everyone is surprised to see that the person under the veil turns out to be a man named Illu Izzatdaar. He is here to file an FIR against a woman who allegedly has been teasing him. Chandramukhi calls the woman for questioning but she denies the allegation. How will Chandramukhi solve this bizarre case? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Magic Lamp
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi gets irritated when she finds Hanuman Pandey reading an erotic magazine. Consequently, Hanuman Pandey gets his hands on a magic lamp and a genie comes out of it. What will be Hanuman Pandey's wish from this Genie? Keep watching to find out.

episodesList.title: Car Dealership
episodesList.summary: A man named Chintu Chatwal, lodges a complaint against a car dealer named Sharma and Sharma for failing to deliver a car he booked from them, even after nine months of booking it. He further reveals that the dealers might have sold off his car to some other buyer, without his consent. What will happen next? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Film Shoot
episodesList.summary: A man named Bhasker wants to file an FIR against a Producer that rented out his Bungalow for a film shoot. But it turns out that he has been living there for 30 years and hasn't been paying the money on time. What will Chandramukhi do when the producer refuses to leave?

episodesList.title: Tillu-billu
episodesList.summary: Tillu comes to the station to file an FIR against an unknown person that rings his doorbell every morning while he is sleeping. When Tillu goes to open the door, this person slaps him and runs off before Tillu can identify him. How will Chandramukhi figure out the identity of this unidentified person? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Lawyer’s Case Against Chandramukhi
episodesList.summary: A lawyer comes to file an FIR against Chandramukhi. Because of her fast driving his clothes got wet, he ran his scooter into a person standing at the bus stop and because his clothes were all dirty, he lost the first case of his life. How will Inspector Chandramukhi Chautal tackle an FIR against her own self? Keep watching to find out.

episodesList.title: Matrimonial
episodesList.summary: A man by the name of Nattu comes to the police station to file an FIR against his wife. He found his wife on a matrimonial site but apparently, after his marriage, he realized that she wasn't the same good looking girl from the photos that he saw and approved of. Now his wife doesn't want to leave him. How will Chandramukhi help him? Stay tuned to find out.

episodesList.title: Lost Love
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi raids Genda Gadrili's mehfil and finds Hanuman Pandey there. Hanuman Pandey tells her that he was looking for his lost love. Chandramukhi calls in a doctor to check on him. The doctor confirms his claim and says that he is looking for the love of his past life. What will be Chandramukhi's response to this ridiculous situation?

episodesList.title: Abandoned Car
episodesList.summary: Gulgule asks Chandramukhi if he can sell off a car that has been parked in the police station area and no one has inquired about it for many years. Chandramukhi permits him to do so. But Inspector Gulgule has his own reasons for selling off the car. What does he plan to do with the money he will get? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Gopi's Sister In Law
episodesList.summary: Satya comes to the police station to file an FIR against a girl that stole his scooter at an anniversary function. However, this girl turns out to be Gopi's sister in law and he pleads with Chandramukhi to help save her from a police case. What will Chandramukhi do in this difficult circumstance? Only one way to find out.

episodesList.title: The Missing House Help
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi asks Gulgule to entertain her with a dance. At that moment, Devendra Dostana comes, seeking help from the police to look for his house help that left his job and ran away a couple of days ago, without any notice. Watch this episode to find out more.

episodesList.title: Bank Loan
episodesList.summary: A man by the name of Munnu wants to file an FIR against a Bank Executive, Lokesh Loaner. Lokesh promised Munnu a loan of 40 Lakhs from the Bank against a down payment of 10 Lakhs so that Munnu could buy a flat. However, it has been very long since he applied for the loan and it hasn't been granted yet. Watch the full episode to find out more.

episodesList.title: Bad Landing
episodesList.summary: Uttejit comes to file an FIR against Sharma and Verma. He claims that both of them crashed through the roof of his bedroom on his wedding night. As a result of this incident, his hand got fractured. Stay tuned to find out more.

episodesList.title: Gopi’s Inspection
episodesList.summary: Gopi loses one of the most important criminals from the lock-up. The police commissioner finds out and sends inspector Chhatwaal to look into the matter. How will Chandramuki help Gopi? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Hit and Run
episodesList.summary: Utkarsh enters the station to file an FIR against an unknown person that hit him on his head when the lights went out during his marriage. He suspects his mother in law the most. Chandramukhi recreates the same scene to understand the case better. Will she catch this unknown assailant? Find out by watching this episode.

episodesList.title: Ruchi The Tv
episodesList.summary: Prasanna comes to the police station to file an FIR against his neighbour, Ayyash. In the middle of the night, when Prasanna was watching TV, Ayyash was busy hammering a nail on the wall on the other side. Because of this, Prasanna's TV got heavily damaged. What will happen next? Watch this hysterical episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Gajju and Rajju
episodesList.summary: Ved comes to lodge a complaint against Gajju and Rajju who have been forcibly trying to get their sister married to Ved. They are a family of crooks, that is why they want their sister to marry someone as smart and innocent as Ved. How will Chandramukhi handle such a crazy case? Keep watching to find out.

episodesList.title: The Wedding Suit
episodesList.summary: Babloo wants to file an FIR against Jhumman Tailor as he ruined the suit that was supposed to be his wedding suit. His father in law, who is very particular about things, had especially given him the cloth to get the suit stitched. Will Babloo get justice? Stay tuned to find out more.

episodesList.title: Missing Bride
episodesList.summary: Nattu who got married when he was a child, wants to file an FIR against his father in Law who is not ready to send his daughter to him, even after he has turned into an adult. It turns out that the daughter is not with the father in law and ran away a few months ago. What will Chandramukhi do now to solve the case?

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi’s Engagement
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi catches Raj Aryan trying to steal a rifle from the police station. However, she comes to know that her Tau is coming to fix her marriage and is bringing the guy of his choice along with him. How will Chandramukhi get out of this difficult situation?

episodesList.title: Seat Exchange
episodesList.summary: A married couple faced some problems during their train journey and have come to the police station to seek their help. What is the problem they faced? Can Chandramukhi help them? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Burnt Car
episodesList.summary: A man named Chintu comes rushing into the police station to file an FIR. His new car, which he dearly adored was burnt down by a stranger. He himself did not see it happen but his neighbour told him what happened. What will happen now? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Dhobi and The Dhoban
episodesList.summary: Pappu comes into the station with a Dobhi and the Dhobi's wife. Pappu claims that the Dhobi beat him black and blue for no reason while the Dhobi claims that Pappu was teasing his wife. Which one is telling the truth? Keep watching to find out

episodesList.title: The Lift
episodesList.summary: Shyam comes to file an FIR against an unknown person who hit his wife while both of them were travelling in a lift with their friend. Chandramukhi immediately calls everyone who was present in that lift. Will she catch the culprit? Only one way to find out.

episodesList.title: Khanna and Khanna
episodesList.summary: Chotte comes to file an FIR against two doctors who claimed that the liquid they gave to Chotte, could increase his height within three months. But that clearly did not work out for him and now he is seeking the police's help. Are the doctors at fault? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Doctor’s Golden Watch
episodesList.summary: A doctor claims that his compounder, Julum stole his golden watch from him. However, the compounder has an entirely different story to tell. Which one is telling the truth? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Ram and Prakash
episodesList.summary: Ram comes to the police station with Prakash and wants to file an FIR against him. According to him, Prakash promised to marry Ram's daughter a year back but has been putting it off in the name of building a career first. Find out more about this case by continuing the episode.

episodesList.title: Car Delivery
episodesList.summary: Pinchu Paidal approaches Imaan Chowki to file a complaint against the car dealer from whom he purchased a car. Pinchu alleges that the car was badly damaged when he received it and the dealer is refusing to take responsibility for it. What will Chandramukhi do with this case? Find out right here.

episodesList.title: The Poet's House
episodesList.summary: Bhartendra Bhatnagar comes to file an FIR against the contractor Tiwari, who refuses to finish the interior work of the house for over a year and isn't ready to leave the house either. Find out more about this case by watching the episode.

episodesList.title: Ranjeet Rangeela
episodesList.summary: Ranjesh Rangeela wants to file an FIR against Manohar Boot House for selling him a mismatched pair of shoes because of which, his wedding got cancelled. How will Chandramukhi handle this case? Find out by watching the episode.

episodesList.title: Aaryan Wants Attention
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi is arguing with Raj for bringing his son into the police station when a man comes to register a fir. Raj acts as if he is ill to seek attention from her. Will Raj get Chandramukhi's attention or not? Find out in this episode of FIR.

episodesList.title: Aaryan and Tinku
episodesList.summary: Lattu Lalwani comes to the police station to get an FIR registered but before he can do so, he gets a beating from Chandramukhi Chautala for flirting with her.  Meanwhile, Aaryan asks the snake charmer for his snake Tinku. What tricks is Aaryan going to play now? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Gulgule Plays Smart
episodesList.summary: Constable Mulayam Singh tricks Inspector Aaryan by telling him that he can set him up with Chandramukhi and takes a leave. Meanwhile, an FIR is registered wherein a man complains about a photographer who stalks into his house. Aaryan goes to Chautala and tells her that he spent the night with another woman but Chautala does not pay attention.

episodesList.title: In Love With The Monkey
episodesList.summary: A father walks into Imaam Chowki with his daughter and complains about a monkey being in love with his daughter. He is troubled by this and wants Chabdramukhi Chautala to help him. Will she help him out or not? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Jalota and His Driver
episodesList.summary: Inspector Aaryan is, as usual, trying to flirt with Chandramukhi by telling her that they should go home together as they stay nearby. Meanwhile, Jalota comes to file an FIR against his driver. What has the driver done?

episodesList.title: A Warning Letter For Chandramukhi
episodesList.summary: A kid is playing in Aaryan's office whose mothers name is Chandramukhi. Aaryan is upset and feels that Chandramukhi has wronged him. Aaryan tells Chandramukhi that he has got a letter from the commissioner against her and tells her to not hit people without any reason.

episodesList.title: In-laws vs In-laws
episodesList.summary: Mr Khandaani walks into Imaam Chowki along with his son and registers a complain wherein he does not want to get his son married in Kanpur but his in-laws reject. Meanwhile, the inlaws also come to tell their side of the story. How will Chautala solve this case?

episodesList.title: Election Time
episodesList.summary: While Aaryan is daydreaming, Chandramukhi comes to inform him about the upcoming elections and tells him to make arrangements. Meanwhile, a politician Mannu bhaiya comes to file an FIR against Ratan Rastogi as he feels he is a fraud who is troubling him so that he backs out from the elections. Will Chautala solve this case?

episodesList.title: Gulgule Acts Dead
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi Chautala walks into the police station furious over Inspector Aaryan. Gulgule tells her a plan to get rid of Aaryan. Meanwhile, Gulgule faints after hitting his head with the wall. Chautala confronts Aaryan over Gulgule's injury. Will she be successful in sending Aaryan away from the police station?

episodesList.title: Plastic Surgery
episodesList.summary: A postman from the courier service comes to complain about a doctor who does plastic surgery on him and changes him into another man. The doctor is called in the chowki. How will Chautala solve this case? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Gopi Sweeps The Floors
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi Chautala walks in with a criminal called Rocky who has been wanted for a very long time. Meanwhile, Aaryan sits on chewing gum and blames Gopi for the same and punishes him. What punishment does Gopi get? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Gopi is Crying
episodesList.summary: Gopi is crying in the police station when Chandramukhi enters as he is troubled by his wife over his sister-in-laws marriage. Aaryan sees it as an opportunity and flirts with her. A complainant comes to file an FIR over his marriage. Will Chautala help him out?

episodesList.title: Zinda Dil Wants to Commit Suicide
episodesList.summary: Gopi walks in the police station with a man who was trying to commit suicide. The man named Zinda Dill says that he loves a girl whose father wants him to buy a car and only then will he get her daughter married. How is Chautala going to solve this issue?

episodesList.title: Amit and Amita Nigam
episodesList.summary: Amit Nigam comes in looking for Chandramukhi Chautala to file an FIR. He complains about his account where he is not able to take out money from his own bank account. Will Chautala solve the case? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Commissioners Relative is In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Gulgule is showing his dancing skills when a man walks in the police station asking them to file an FIR against Pappu Pilpile for breaking his car windshield due to coconuts. But Pappu Pipile is commissioners relative. Will Chautala file an FIR or not?

episodesList.title: Gulgule Eats Aaryan's Tiffin
episodesList.summary: Gulgule eats Aaryan's tiffin which Aaryan's mom had specially sent for Aaryan. Chautala scolds and hits Gulgule for doing this. Now Gulgule plans that he will get Aaryan beaten up by Chautala but how? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi's Weakness
episodesList.summary: Gulgule is given a punishment of dancing throughout the day for acting smart. A man walks in to file an FIR against a toothpaste company for false advertisements. Meanwhile, Aaryan tries to impress Chandramukhi by showing her his strong teeth. Will he be able to impress her?

episodesList.title: Corner Seats
episodesList.summary: Kanwar comes with this case against the ticket checker of andhkaar cinema who despite the hall being completely empty, did not allow Kanwar to sit with his to be wife together on corner seats. Chandramukhi asks Lachar to now let them sit together this time when they come to watch a film. But next day he again comes to complain? How will Chautala save this case now?

episodesList.title: Jignesh is Not Allowed
episodesList.summary: A Gujarati couple comes to Imaan Chowki and complains about their dog Jignesh who is not allowed to stay in the flat.  Apparently, the landlord doesn't approve of the dog as his wife left him because of a bitch she was fond of. What will Chandramukhi do now? Will they be allowed to keep Jignesh with them? Find out in this episode of FIR.

episodesList.title: Cheap Chandramukhi
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi is annoyed due to Aaryan and asks Gulgule for ideas to get rid of him.  Gulgule tells Chandramukhi that if they make her character cheap and frivolous, then Aryan would naturally start avoiding her. Gulgule tells Aryan that Chandramukhi is a shame on the department because she is a part-time mujra dancer in the nights after her duty. Will Aaryan believe him or not?

episodesList.title: Struggling Singer Inder
episodesList.summary: Inder comes complaining about someone who threw a stone with a love letter for his wife and the stone hit his forehead. On being asked, there's only this one person who he knows is seen regularly with his wife, called Gautam, and is Inder's tenant and a struggling singer. Will Chandramukhi find the culprit?

episodesList.title: Unknown Man
episodesList.summary: A man is  beaten-up along with a property agent and comes to Imaan Chowki and complains that he has just purchased a new house from this agent and a man comes every day and beats him without any reason. Chandramukhi calls him to the police station to hear his side of the story. Who is at fault? Find out in this hilarious episode of FIR only on Sony Liv app.

episodesList.title: Bodyguard
episodesList.summary: Inspector Aaryan becomes Chandramukhi's bodyguard after getting to know that Bullet Bhaskar has escaped from prison. Chautala had captured him years ago and he had mentioned about revenge. Everyone at the Imaam Chowki is alert. Will Bhaskar attack Chandramukhi? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Stalker Alert
episodesList.summary: A man comes to Imaan Chowki with his wife's sister and complains that every day, whenever he is going to drop her to college a man, follows them. Chandramukhi gets on the case to trap the man.
