episodesList.title: Garba
episodesList.summary: Gopi and Gulgule want to play dandiya but Chandramukhi assigns them duties at a Garba event. The next day two men come to the chowki to file a complaint against each other where one feels that the other hit him when the lights were off. How will Chandramukhi solve this case? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Jhakki Ki Chakki
episodesList.summary: A  couple with their neighbour come to Imaan Chowki with the complaint that the person whom they gave the first floor of their house uses Chakki machine 24hrs a day and that is why they can't sleep and his wife has to go to the neighbour's place to sleep every day. How will Chautala solve this case of a weird tenant? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Shomu Chinnoy Ka Bhoot
episodesList.summary: Raj Aryan tells Chandramukhi that he wants someone like her in his life and asks her for dinner, but Chandramukhi tells him that it is his first night duty at Imam chowki so he should first finish the work. An upset Chandramukhi comes out and slaps Gulgule who immediately comes up with the plan of scaring Aaryan with Shomu Chinnoi's ghost. What will happen next? Find out in this episode of FIR.

episodesList.title: Oonth Gaya Roonth
episodesList.summary: Two brothers with a camel rider come to Imaan chowki where the elder brother says that camel took his wife away in the desert and they cannot find her now and want police to help them locate her. Camel rider says that he cannot help as the brothers were talking in such a manner that the camel got upset with them and ran away with the lady. How will Chautala solve this rather mysterious case of a camel being upset?

episodesList.title: Gulgule Gives His Resignation
episodesList.summary: Imaan Chowki is planning to celebrate Gandhi Jayanti and for this Chandramukhi has asked Gulgule to get a big photo frame of Gandhi Ji. Gopi asks Gulgule whether he has got the frame or not to which he says that he has many things to do and is then scolded by Chautala. Fed up with the humiliation Gulgule gives his resignation. What will Chandramukhi do now without Gulgule?

episodesList.title: Fake Currency
episodesList.summary: Gopi brings a couple to the chowki and tells Chandramukhi that they have been caught using fake notes. On being asked as to where they got the notes from, the man says that he got it from his in-laws' place who invited them for the marriage of a cousin. Is this a racket of fake currency? Find out in this episode of FIR.

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi's Marriage
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi is fed up of Raj who is again talking to her about marriage. Gulgule comes up with an idea and tells Chandramukhi to get a fake husband and kids so that Aaryan stops flirting with her. Will Chautala take Gulgule's advice? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: A Friend In Need is a Friend Indeed
episodesList.summary: A man comes to Imaan Chowki and complains that he helped a friend years back by giving him a lift and now that friend gives him lift every day even when he does not want it and he yells at him and takes him anytime for the drive. What suggestion will Chandramukhi give this man?

episodesList.title: Sweet Tooth
episodesList.summary: A halwai comes to Imaan Chowki to file an FIR against a man who had come to his shop to buy sweets for 5000 people only on the condition that he will keep making sweets until the family members approve of it and then will he get the contract. Will Chautala deliver justice?

episodesList.title: Warm Coat
episodesList.summary: A man comes to Imaan Chowki with a complain that in urgency to go at a cold place he purchased a coat from a shopkeeper who charged him 3 times the actual cost and that coat cannot stop one from feeling cold. Chandramukhi summons the shopkeeper. Will she prove the shopkeeper guilty? Find out in this episode of FIR.

episodesList.title: Gulgule Becomes a Dancer
episodesList.summary: Aaryan is flirting with Chandramukhi when Gulgule comes up with a plan. He comes dressed up as a dancer and complains about her husband. Will Aaryan get to know Gulgule's tricks? Find out in this episode of FIR only on Sony Liv app.

episodesList.title: Buffallo
episodesList.summary: A man comes to Imaan Chowki with the complaint that he purchased a while buffalo from a trader who claimed that his buffalo will give 50ltrs of milk daily and it has been so long that he purchased the buffalo and it has not given a single litre of milk. How will Chautala deliver justice? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi's Transfer
episodesList.summary: Imaan Chowki is celebrating Diwali while Aaryan flirts with Chautala. Gulgule is also annoyed at Aaryan and decides to a plant a bomb under his chair to which Chandramukhi declines. Commissioner comes for a visit and the bomb explodes. Who planted the bomb? What will be the fate of Gulgule, Chandramukhi and Gopi?

episodesList.title: Adal Lo Badal Lo
episodesList.summary: A man comes to file an FIR against Adal Lo and Badal Lo who have taken his car and put it on sale. Chandramukhi summons the owners and begins her investigation. Will she solve the case? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Acp Action Pandey
episodesList.summary: Gulgule complains in the Discipline Department of police about Indisciplined Raj Aryan. They send ACP Action Pandey who is a dwarf to look after the matter and punishes Raj but falls for Chandramukhi. How will Chandramukhi get out of this? Watch this episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Troubled In-laws
episodesList.summary: An old couple comes to Imaan Chowki and complains that their Daughter in Law has damaged their goodwill in the society, as she goes to a pub with other men and she doesn't wish to be with her husband.  The couple is called next day for the investigation. Will the case get solved?

episodesList.title: Patthar Ki Lakeer
episodesList.summary: A man comes to Imaan chowki and complains that he applied for an ad in the newspaper named Patthar ki lakeer for the matrimonial column but his name has appeared in the death column while a dog with his name and address has been printed on the matrimonial column. How will Chandramukhi clear the confusion? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Behrupiya
episodesList.summary: Imaam Chowki is in for a shock when Chandramukhi leaves them in between and a girl who looks exactly like her appears at the station. Where did Chandramukhi go? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Foreign Trip
episodesList.summary: A lady comes crying to Imaan chowki as her husband is about to leave her and go abroad. She asks Chandramukhi for help and Chandramukhi comes up with a plan to stop the husband from going abroad. What is the plan? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Baba Po Po
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi is very upset as Raj wants to marry her. He has been getting such advice from a saint named Baba Po Po. Gulgule comes up with a plan and disguises himself as Baba Po Po and tells Raj that if he marries Chandramukhi, he will die on the same night. What will be Raj's decision now?

episodesList.title: Dog Lover
episodesList.summary: A man comes to complain about his wife saying that she loves their dog more than him. Chandramukhi and Gulgule take 20,000 from the man and tell him a plan. Will the plan be successful? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Wanted Dacoit
episodesList.summary: Raj Aryan catches the son of a famous dacoit who is also a dacoit. Police are looking for the main dacoit but Raj tells Chandramukhi that through him he will catch his father, but after repeated attempts of trying to know about the whereabouts of his father, Raj Aryan fails. Will Chandramukhi help find the dacoit? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Aaryan's Maun Vrat
episodesList.summary: Gulgule is annoyed with Aaryan and comes up with a plan to shut Aaryan's mouth for 12 hours. He calls a pandit to the chowki to tell this to Aaryan. Will Gulgule's plan be successful? What if Chandramukhi finds out?

episodesList.title: Can't Say a No
episodesList.summary: A man comes to Imaan Chowki and complains that a new neighbour has come who is using everything of their house and he is unable to say a no to him as his father died because a lady said no to him and father told him to never say a no to anyone. How will Chautala solve this case?

episodesList.title: Gopi's Brother-in-law
episodesList.summary: Gopi is crying in the chowki as his brother-in-law has sold a camel to a man by telling a lie. He asks Chandramukhi to not file a Fir but Chandramukhi denies. After a lot of persuasions, Chautala agrees. Will she save Gopi's brother?

episodesList.title: Gambling
episodesList.summary: A vegetable vendor comes to Imaan Chowki to file a complaint against a lady who took vegetables but did not pay the money to the vendor. She is called in at the chowki and Chautala investigates her. Will she deliver justice to the vegetable vendor? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Gulgule is Punished
episodesList.summary: Aaryan punishes Gulgule for his misbehaviour. Frustrated by this, Gulgule plans an act of revenge where he calls the senior inspector to monitor Raj. What is Gulgule's act of revenge? Find out in this episode of FIR on Sony Liv app.

episodesList.title: Food Eating Neighbour
episodesList.summary: A man comes to Imaan Chowki and complains that his neighbour comes to their place every day and eat all the food at home. But Chautala has a solution. What is the solution? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Raj's Unexpected Children
episodesList.summary: Gulgule's sister leaves her 4 children to Gulgule and asks her to take care of them. Gulgule gets an idea and tells Chandramukhi about it.  They tell Raj that four children have come claiming to be his children. How will Raj react to this? Find out in this hilarious episode of FIR.

episodesList.title: Raj is a Child
episodesList.summary: Raj Aryan gets to know that Chandramukhi loves children and cant take anything against children. He thinks of yet another plan to get close to Chandramukhi and this time by behaving like a 5-year-old child. Will Chautala start liking him?

episodesList.title: Kid Teaches a Lesson
episodesList.summary: A man comes to Imaan Chowki complaining about his son who addresses him with his name instead of calling him papa. Chautala gives the father a solution but the kid outsmarts him. Chadramukhi now talks to the kid, who gives the reason for doing so. What is the reason? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Actor's Agreement
episodesList.summary: A man comes to the chowki complaining about a producer who had signed a contract with him wherein the man was supposed to play the main lead of his film but from the past 1 and a half years is made to be a servant at the producer's place. Chandramukhi summons the producer. What happens next? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Wedding Bells
episodesList.summary: A baarat comes to Imaam chowki to complain about the band who does not show up at the wedding day and due to this their inlaws cancel the wedding. They ask Chautala for justice. Will she deliver it? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Gopi's Birthday
episodesList.summary: Everyone at Imaan chowki is getting ready for celebrating Gopi's birthday, Raj tells Gulgule and Gopi not to celebrate in the chowki and work, due to which Gopi gets angry and yells at Raj. Annoyed by this, Raj gets him transferred. What will happen to Gopi now?

episodesList.title: Brothers
episodesList.summary: Two pehalwaan come to Imaan Chowki to complain about a man who comes every day to ask for their sister's hand for marriage despite their denial. Chautala calls the man in the chowki. Watch this episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Split Personality Disorder
episodesList.summary: A man comes to chowki with his wife and complains that his wife beats him up every night. Wife denies and says this is not possible.  Gulgule says that the wife is suffering from a split personality disorder and ask the couple to come to chowki the next day where they call a doctor. What will the doctor reveal?

episodesList.title: Nazar Ka Dhoka
episodesList.summary: A man comes to the chowki with the complaint that he got himself a pair of spectacles a few days back and after wearing them he went to see a girl for getting married and felt that she is slim but on the first night when his wife removed his glasses, he felt that she is extremely fat and he complains about the optician who made such spectacles.

episodesList.title: Kaamwaali Zyada Pyaari
episodesList.summary: A woman walks into Imaam chowki to complain about his husband who is controlled by their maid. The maid tells the man about everything from his food to his clothes. Chandramukhi summons the husband and the maid and gives a plan to the wife to resolve the issue. What is the plan? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Disconnected Phone Line
episodesList.summary: The phone line at Imaan Chowki is disconnected as Gulgule did not pay the bill amount that was given to him. He gave the same amount to a director who was to launch him in a music album but has now run away with the money. Will Imaan Chowki's phone get to working again?

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi's Fake Boyfriend
episodesList.summary: Gulgule comes to chowki with a fracture in his hand and tells Gopi how bravely he was fighting with a few guys who were after a few girls and due to that his hand suffered a fracture to which Chandramukhi reveals that his wife informed her that due to bad flooring Gulgule slipped and broke his hand.

episodesList.title: Fair and Lovely
episodesList.summary: Raj tells Gulgule to walk and go to a station 3 km away from theirs. Gulgule is annoyed by this and seeks revenge. When Chandramukhi brings a man to the chowki and tells that he is not letting his daughter marry her love as the man is of dark complexion, Gulgule gets an idea for revenge. What is his idea now? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Khujli Waali Ring Ceremony
episodesList.summary: A man comes to Imaan Chowki with his friend and complains that after the ring exchange ceremony with his fiance he has been experiencing itching and that is why the girl's parents are not letting the marriage happen and claims that itching started after the ring ceremony. Was there something in the ring? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Grandfather's Last Wish
episodesList.summary: Raj Aaryan comes across a case where a man comes to the chowki and tells him that he wanted to fulfil his grandfather's last wish of getting married. He had called a fake pandit but a real pandit comes and he gets married. How will Aaryan solve this case?

episodesList.title: Catering
episodesList.summary: A man along with his relative comes to chowki and tells that he arranged a party on his marriage anniversary and for that he invited 100 people and out of that 75 turned up but the caterer is charging him for 150 plates.  How will Chautala solve this case?

episodesList.title: Gulgule is Useless
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi tells Gulgule that he is of no use. Gulgule tells her that he will handle the next case that comes to the chowki. Will Gulgule be successful in solving the case? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Circus Ka Sher
episodesList.summary: A man comes to Imaan Chowki and complains about a lion entering his house when he was out watching a film. He tells them that a circus is taking place nearby so the lion must have run from there. Chanramukhi summons the ringmaster. Where did the lion come from? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Ghost House
episodesList.summary: A man comes to chowki and complains that he purchased a house a few days back and a witch stays in that house. Someone keeps on crying the whole night and says that this is a ghost house. Is there a ghost? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: A Play That Goes Wrong
episodesList.summary: A man and a tabla player come to Imaan Chowki to complain that during a sequence in the play, a fake knife was supposed to be used but a real one was used instead. Due to this, a girl is now in the hospital. How will Chautala serve justice? find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Boring Husband
episodesList.summary: A man comes to Imaan chowki along with his wife and complains that whenever he is with his wife, she sleeps or throws things at him. Chandramukhi asks the lady who has no answer. How will Chautala solve this case?

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi is a Vamp
episodesList.summary: Gulgule as usual tries to play his tricks to get rid of Aaryan and this time he tells Aaryan that Chandramukhi is a vampire. He does this to create fear in Raj's mind so that he stops following Chandramukhi? Will he be successful in his attempt or will he get caught by Raj?

episodesList.title: New Year's At Imaan Chowki
episodesList.summary: Imaan Chowki is getting ready for New Year's eve but Raj wants to go to a private party with Chandramukhi. She declines this offer as she has already made commitments to Gopi and Gulgule. An angry and annoyed Raj comes up with a plan to cancel the party. What is the plan? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Music Lover Wife
episodesList.summary: A man comes to chowki and complains that he recently got married but his wife spends most of her time in the bathroom and especially when his neighbour from the other side is singing songs. How will Chandramukhi solve this case?

episodesList.title: Do What The Heart Says
episodesList.summary: A man comes to Imaan chowki and complains that his father is forcing him to be a cricketer but his wish is to be a painter. Chandramukhi asks Gulgule and Gopi to call his father who was a famous cricketer of his time. Will Chautala convince the father? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Sunil and Gavaskar
episodesList.summary: A man named Sushil Sharmile comes to Imaan chowki and complains that a group of people make him play khoko forcefully and take his clothes off and make fun of him every day. Chautala calls Sunil and Gavaskar to the chowki who tell that this man only tells them that he wants to play. Who is telling the truth?

episodesList.title: A Game Of Kabaddi
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi accepts the challenge of playing kabaddi. Sunil and Gavaskar call their team members who are fierce. Seeing this Raj, Gopi and Gulgule gets scared. What will Chandramukhi do now? Will she defeat them or will she get defeated?

episodesList.title: Tinku Tamanna
episodesList.summary: A man comes to Imaan Chowki and complains that he was the winner of a game show called Tinku ka swayamwar and they got engaged during the show but as the show got over Tinki disagreed to marry him. Chandramukhi asks for the producer and Tinku to come to chowki. Will she convince Tinku to marry the man?

episodesList.title: Mushayra
episodesList.summary: A Ghazal singer comes to the chowki and complains that a bar manager asked him to sing songs in his bar as per the customers wish and he thought he will be able to show his talent and will be able to earn too. Chandramukhi finds this very cheap and tells Gulgule to call the bar manager at the chowki. Will she resolve it?

episodesList.title: One Sided Love
episodesList.summary: A couple with their son comes to chowki and complains that it is their son's marriage in three days time but they missed their train due to the enquiry officer of the railway department who misguided them about the train. Chandramukhi calls the officer who tells that the couple could not understand what he was saying and they thought that the train got cancelled. How will the case be solved?

episodesList.title: Udhaari
episodesList.summary: A couple comes to the chowki and complains that due to a confusion between them they gave their neighbour a loan worth Rs 1,00,000 and it has been a year and the man is not returning the money. They ask Chautala to file an FIR so that they can get their money back.

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi Ki Judwaa - Part 1
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi lashes into the chowki and shouts on Raj for calling her for no use since morning. While Gopi and Gulgule are on night duty, a woman enters the chowki asking for help from her in-laws. Gopi and Gulgule are in for a shock as the lady looks exactly like Chandramukhi? How is this possible? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi Ki Judwaa - Part 2
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi disguises herself as Shital and gives a tough time to her Mama Mami. Bittu, their nephew has now come for their rescue. Meanwhile, Shital in the disguise of Chandramukhi is tackling the goons at the police station.

episodesList.title: Manchli Ka Kaata
episodesList.summary: A man named Liptu Bhatt comes to the chowki to file an FIR against a man. While Liptu was having a bath in the lake a man caught him in his fishing rod and dragged him up to 1 km. Chautala summons the fishermen. How will justice be served?

episodesList.title: Neighbour Trouble
episodesList.summary: A couple comes to the chowki to complain that whenever they go away from the house, their neighbours puncture their car tyre. They ask for justice. How will Chautala solve the case?

episodesList.title: Daku Mangal Singh
episodesList.summary: Gulgule fills in Aaryan's ears against Chandramukhi and he gets influenced. Meanwhile, Commissioner has come to the Chowki and tells Chandramukhi to catch Daku Mangal Singh but Aaryan comes in the middle and says that this case should be given to him and not Chandramukhi. Who will get the case? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi to The Rescue
episodesList.summary: Mangal Singh has captured Gopi, Gulgule and Aaryan. He calls up Chandramukhi challenging Chandramukhi and gives her 24 hours to save them. Will Chandramukhi save them or will they get killed? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Rai Sahab At Imaan Chowki
episodesList.summary: Gulgule is sitting on Aaryan's chair. He enters and scolds Gulgule and tells him that he will trouble Gulgule for the next 30 years. An irritated Gulgule tells this to Chandramukhi who slaps him. Meanwhile, a girl comes to complain about Rai Sahab that he harassed her.

episodesList.title: Rai Sahab has Fallen In The Trap
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi lays a trap to catch Rai Sahab. She tries to mould Rai Sahab in her words and calls him to the chowki. Will Chandramukhi prove him guilty?

episodesList.title: Pre Holi At Imaan Chowki
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi and Aaryan get into an argument where Aaryan tells her to take things a little easy. He reminds Chandramukhi that Holi is coming to which Chandramukhi says that instead of playing, they need to take care of the city and do their duty.

episodesList.title: Holi Hai
episodesList.summary: The commissioner is called to the chowki and the case is also solved where Chandramukhi finds out that the wife has thrown the balloon herself as she wanted her husband to play Holi with her. Meanwhile, Chautala plays a trick where Raj ends up throwing colour at the commissioner. What will be his fate now?

episodesList.title: Jugambo
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi catches the international terrorist Jugambo and brings him to chowki. She slaps him and he challenges her that she will have to pay for all this. While Chandramukhi is away, Jugambo runs away and also captures Chautala's colleagues. Will Chautala save her colleagues?

episodesList.title: Jugambo vs Chautala
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi accepts Jugambo's challenge of coming to his den and rescuing her colleagues. When she reaches there, she is hurt badly. How will she rescue them? Will her fate be the same as theirs? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi is a Psycho Killer
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi is very upset with Raj and decides to teach him a lesson. With Gulgule's idea, she acts of being a psycho killer so that Raj gets scared and runs away but Raj finds out about their plan. What will be the fate of Chandramukhi and her colleagues at Imaan Chowki?

episodesList.title: Ise Apna Hi Samjho
episodesList.summary: A couple comes to the chowki and complains that their car was in the garage and is stolen. Their driver has gone to his village. Chandramukhi asks Gulgule and gopi to find out and get the driver at the chowki. Has he stolen the car?

episodesList.title: Raj Ka Pichla Janam
episodesList.summary: Raj calls Chandramukhi to his cabin urgently and tells her he is not well. Gulgule tells her that Raj was saying cheap things about her and comes up with a plan that they should make Raj visit his past where Chandramukhi was a prostitute. Will Gulgule's trick work?

episodesList.title: Lost Sons
episodesList.summary: An old woman named Raseeli Rastogi comes to the chowki and complains that 25 years back his sons were lost in Yadav ki baraat.  Chandramukhi calls Yadav to the chowki and interrogates. Will she find her missing sons?

episodesList.title: Suicide
episodesList.summary: Gopi gets a man to the chowki with a fractured hand and tells that this man jumped on him. The man says that his intention was to suicide but Gopi came in. Chandramukhi asks as to why he wanted to suicide to which the man tells that he is upset with his mother in law who has created so many differences between him and his wife. How will Chandramukhi solve the case? Find out in this funny episode of FIR.

episodesList.title: Invisible Raj
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi is angry at Raj for flirting with her. She gets annoyed with Gulgule as he is not getting any idea to get rid of Raj. Gopi comes in late as he was watching Mr India. Gulgule comes up with a plan where he convinces Raj that he can be invisible. Will Raj get convinced? Find out in this episode of FIR.

episodesList.title: Cylinder Chor
episodesList.summary: A couple comes to chowki and complains that even after booking a cylinder they never get their cylinder and the guy sells it to someone else in black. Chandramukhi asks the guy to be called to the chowki who tells that he went to the couple's place but no one opened the door, so he sold the cylinder to someone else. How will Chandramukhi catch the fraud that is happening?

episodesList.title: Raj Becomes a Criminal
episodesList.summary: Gulgule goes to Raj and tells him that Chandramukhi loves all those who are involved in criminal activities and tells him that she went for dinner with a criminal. Raj gets excited hearing this and he commits a crime. Will Chandramukhi go for dinner with him or not?

episodesList.title: Kite Champs
episodesList.summary: A man comes to the chowki to file a complaint against his neighbours because of whom his moustache has been cut into half. The neighbours are called at the chowki. How will the case be solved?

episodesList.title: Gulgule's Masterplan
episodesList.summary: Gulgule comes up with a plan to get rid of Raj when he sees that a lady has brought her daughter to the chowki and the daughter is a dancer at a bar. What is his plan? Find out in this episode of FIR.

episodesList.title: Mysterious Girl
episodesList.summary: A man comes to Imaan Chowki and complains that at 2:30 am in the morning he received a message on his phone written I love u too and on reading that his wife threw him out of the house and he slept outside the whole night and has now come to chowki to complain against that girl who sent him the message. Will Chandramukhi find that girl?

episodesList.title: Raj is Suspended
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi is beating a man badly because he is drunk. She tells Gulgule and Gopi that she hates people who drink. Gulgule gets an idea and tells Raj that Chandramukhi loves people who drink and because of this Raj gets drunk. How will Chandramukhi deal with it now?

episodesList.title: Watchman Issues
episodesList.summary: A man comes to Chowki along with his sister in law and complains against his watchman stating that even after knowing that he is the owner of the house, the watchman never lets him get inside the house and asks for details including his name and calls his wife to confirm. How will Chandramukhi solve this? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Saas Bahu Ke Jhagde
episodesList.summary: A man comes to the chowki and complains against a lady and her mother in law that when they were in the lift they argued about something and the argument led to a physical fight and he had to face the heat. Chandramukhi summons them to the chowki. Watch this episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Father's Second Marriage
episodesList.summary: An old man comes to Imaan chowki who was a history teacher and wants Chandramukhi to bring his son back to the right track who is in love with a prostitute and who is wasting all his money and time on her. How will Chandramukhi convince the son?

episodesList.title: Gulgule's Towing Company
episodesList.summary: A man comes to the chowki and complains that his car was towed away from his house and he wants some action to be taken against the towing company and the owner turns out to be a partner of Gulgule and both of them own this towing company. Will Chandramukhi take any action or not? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Gulgule has Cancer
episodesList.summary: A couple comes to Imaan Chowki and complains that their daughter is missing and they fear that her husband has killed her and they are sure about this as they got a letter which justifies that her husband killed her and want the man to be taken into custody and punished for his offence. Chandramukhi summons the husband.

episodesList.title: Husband is Guilty
episodesList.summary: Gulgule has taken the blame of the murder as he gets to know he has cancer but Chautala saves him in time. Now they conspire against the husband so that he reveals the truth. How will they do it? Find out in this episode of FIR.

episodesList.title: Gulgule's Car
episodesList.summary: A tensed Gulgule comes to the chowki and tells that he hit someone with his car today but the man didn't die and he ran away and believes that no one saw him, just then-commissioner comes to chowki with a fractured hand and tells that while crossing the road in the morning a car hit him and he noted down the number of the car and wants Chandramukhi to find out the culprit who in actual is Gulgule. How will Chandramukhi solve this?

episodesList.title: An Affair Gone Wrong
episodesList.summary: A man comes to the chowki and complains that when he was going in the morning, the guy on the third floor threw a cup of tea on him. The person is called to the chowki who tells that tea was pathetic, hence he threw it and didn't realise that someone was downstairs. What punishment will Chandramukhi give this man?

episodesList.title: Angry Wife
episodesList.summary: Two friends come to the chowki and one wants to file a complaint against his wife who doubts that his affair is going on with some other girl as she saw him on a scooter with her. Chandramukhi calls the wife at the chowki to make her understand, but will she understand? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Aam Aadmi Ka Swayamvar
episodesList.summary: A man comes to the chowki and tells that he participated in a game show Aam Aadmi ka Swayamvar and he was ensured that all the girls are of good character but he can't marry as the girl is a prostitute. Chandramukhi summons the producer. How will he bring him to justice?

episodesList.title: Minister's Relative
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi gets a call that the opposition leader is missing. She is worried thinking about it and in the meanwhile two men come to the chowki where one complains against the other that when he was working in his shop the other man ran into him on his scooter. The man is called to the chowki and the investigation begins.

episodesList.title: Shaapit Girl
episodesList.summary: A man comes to Imaan Chowki and complains that mama and mami of the girl whom he is in love with are not letting them get married. Chandramukhi asks Mama and Mami to be called to the chowki. Will the two lovers unite?

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi's Mother At Imaan Chowki
episodesList.summary: Aryan proposes to Chandramukhi and asks why can't she be good friends with him. Chandramukhi tells that her mother told her that a boy and girl can never be friends and her mother will decide a partner for her.  How will Raj react?

episodesList.title: Mundan Ceremony
episodesList.summary: A man comes to the chowki along with his neighbour and complains that when the mundan ceremony of his neighbour's son was going on, a power cut happened and the barber cut his hair instead of the kid. The man has come to Imaan Chowki for justice. How will Chandramukhi solve this case?

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi Becomes a Dancer
episodesList.summary: A man comes to Imaan chowki and tells that he was engaged to a girl long back in his village and after that, the girl left the village and came to the city with her mother and father. She has denied to marry him now and she wants to be a dancer. Gulgule tells her that if she loses the dance competition then she will have to marry the man. The girl is set against Chandramukhi in the competition. Who will win?

episodesList.title: Dance Competition
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi starts preparing for the dance competition. Gulgule becomes her teacher. Will Chandramukhi defeat the girl and win the competition? Will the man get to marry his love? Watch this episode to find out on Sony Liv app.

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi is Arrested
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi catches a smuggler who offers her some money to leave him or be on his side otherwise his brothers will not leave her and make sure that she will suffer big time. Will Chandramukhi accept the offer?

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi vs Smuggler
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi is caught for smuggling drugs after the smugglers get her arrested. She runs from jail. Where did Chandramukhi go? Is it her trick to catch the smuggler?

episodesList.title: Beauty Patch
episodesList.summary: A woman is crying sitting in a park at night where Gulgule is passing by and he notices this and goes to her asking the reason. She starts shouting resulting in people thinking that Gulgule is the reason for her crying. Next day Gulgule brings her to the chowki. What is the reason of her loneliness?

episodesList.title: Beauty Lies Within
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi plans a trap with the help of Aryan, Gopi and Gulgule and fakes her love for the man. Will this attempt of Chautala bring the man to justice? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Gopi's Lie
episodesList.summary: Gopi gets a call that his parents will be coming, but after listening to this news he is not happy, because he has lied to his parents that he is a big doctor. Gopi asks Chandramukhi to help him. Will she help Gopi in this lie?

episodesList.title: Gopi's Truth
episodesList.summary: Gopi's parents come to know about the truth that their son is not a doctor, but a constable. His father gets a shock after listening to this news. What will happen next? Find out in this episode of FIR.

episodesList.title: Bhoot Hai
episodesList.summary: A passenger comes to ask Chandramukhi for help, as he says that while he travels in the bus during the night there is a ghost who always keeps frightening the passengers, but nobody believes him, so Chandramukhi sends Raj Aaryan to look into the matter. Will Raj Aryan be able to solve the matter?

episodesList.title: Nothing Such As Ghost
episodesList.summary: Raj Aaryan gets psycho after seeing the ghost. Chandramukhi comes to know that there is no such thing as a ghost, so she herself becomes a ghost just to solve the case. Will she be successful?

episodesList.title: The Case Of "a"
episodesList.summary: 2 brothers have a problem with each other because their father has left a big property in one of his son's named "A". Now both of them don't know in whose name their father has left the property, as of both of their names start with letter A. How will Chandramukhi be able to help them?

episodesList.title: Missing Susheel
episodesList.summary: A man named Susheel complaints about a pan shop owner who teases his wife, but the pan shop owner says that he is an innocent man. Susheel's friends comes in the next day complaining that Susheel is missing and the pan shop owner is the suspect. How will Chautala solve this case?

episodesList.title: Troublesome Mama
episodesList.summary: A lady named Vandana comes to complain about her mama because he keeps on abusing her. Chandramukhi tries to help Vandana, but mama tells Chandramukhi that she can't interfere as she is not a family member. How will Chandramukhi be able to help Vandana?

episodesList.title: Mama is Taught a Lesson
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi has a plan in her mind. She becomes the younger daughter-in-law of mama's house, but after seeing this mama doesn't keep quiet and he plans to kill Chandramukhi. What will be Chandramukhi's fate?

episodesList.title: Power Of Attorney
episodesList.summary: A man complaints about how his employee cheated on him and named all his property in his name. The employee comes to the office and says that it's not his fault as the power of attorney is in her name. What will Chandramukhi do now?

episodesList.title: The Employee is Taught a Lesson
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi gets herself dressed in a Chinese dress just to teach the man a lesson to get the property back. She falls in love with the culprit. Will this solve the case?

episodesList.title: Property Issues
episodesList.summary: Two ladies complain that a man cheated on them by selling a factory to them saying that the factory is worth 50 lakhs. They have paid him 25 lakhs and the remaining is left but the man asks for more. How will Chautala solve this case?

episodesList.title: Naari Shakti
episodesList.summary: The man challenges Chandramukhi that if she is brave enough then she has to fight his watchman and get the keys from him. Will Chandramukhi be able to fight that man and defeat him and give the lady's their money back?

episodesList.title: Terrorist On The Run
episodesList.summary: Everyone in the chowki is celebrating Independence Day. Commissioner comes in the chowki and gives them the news that they are shifting a very serious terrorist attacker in their chowki, and by morning they will shift him to another chowki. The responsibility is given to Raj Aaryan as Chandramukhi is ill and the terrorist escapes. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi and Her Colleagues
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi pleases the Minister that if there is anyone who could help her to catch the terrorist it's Raj Aryan, Gulgule and Gopi. Will Chandramukhi be able to find the terrorist with the help of her colleagues, or will she fail?

episodesList.title: Gulgule Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Gulgule arrests a smuggler's, right-hand man. But later the smuggler kidnaps Gulgule and makes a deal with Chandramukhi to leave his man for Gulgule, but Chandramukhi denies the proposal and tells him to kill Gulgule. What will be Gulgule's fate?

episodesList.title: One For All and All For One
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi manages to release Gulgule from the smugglers. Will Gulgule continue to help Chandramukhi or will he help the smuggler? Find out in this episode?

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi's Best Friend's Marriage
episodesList.summary: A schoolmaster comes in the chowki to meet Chandramukhi, as he used to teach Chandramukhi in her school times.  He tells Chandramukhi that his daughter Durga who happens to be Chandramukhi's childhood friend is getting married. As the ceremony begins, the boys' parents ask for a dowry. Will Chandramukhi be able to help her best friend?

episodesList.title: Sting Operation
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi finds a way to teach them a lesson. She places a hidden camera insides Durga's jewellery and tells them that they are ready to pay the dowry amount. Listening to this news the boys' parents are very happy, but they are unaware of the sting operation. Will they fall in the trap?

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi's Reincarnation
episodesList.summary: Gulgule arrests a man for drawing Chandramukhi's painting, but he says that he has not drawn her painting.  It's Vallabghad's Raj Nartaki's painting and he also tells her that it's her reincarnation. Will Chandramukhi believe this?

episodesList.title: Plan Against Raj Aaryan
episodesList.summary: Raj Aaryan backs off and tells Chandramukhi that he can't do it, so they find another way to make Raj Aaryan insult the commissioner.  Chandramukhi tells Raj Aryan that he does not truly love her, and if he wants her then he has to insult the commissioner. Will raj Aryan insult the commissioner and will Chandramukhi be able to succeed in her plans?

episodesList.title: Raj Troubles Chandramukhi Again
episodesList.summary: Raj Aryan teases Chandramukhi. She gets angry and decides to teach him a lesson. A tailor comes just to measure Gopi and Gugule's dress so he can make a new one, and he also tells them that next week Mahila Saptah is going to be organised and he has to make their dresses to, listening to this Gugule gets an idea. What is his idea now?

episodesList.title: Pickpocket
episodesList.summary: Gopi arrests a pickpocket for robbing his purse but Chandramukhi is not interested as she is quite fed up of Raj Aryan.  Gulgule sees the pickpocketers and gets an idea. What is his idea now?

episodesList.title: Naughtymukhi and Chandramukhi
episodesList.summary: Gulgule and Chandramukhi plan to fool around with Raj Aaryan as he is constantly troubling Chandramukhi. Gulgule comes up with a plan and tells Raj that Chandramukhi has a twin sister Naughtymukhi. How will Raj react to this?

episodesList.title: Fake Eye Drop
episodesList.summary: As Chandramukhi is not able to get out of the problem, a man comes in and tells her  that he's not able to see because the doctor had not given him the proper eye drop. Listening to this, Gugule gets an idea. The news is spread that there is a virus going on that affects only the eyes and they also say that they have the eye drop that can prevent it.

episodesList.title: The Contract Marriage
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi's uncle wants her to get married and he has also chosen a groom. Chandramukhi knows that guy is acually eyeing her uncle's property. Gulgule gives the idea to Chandramukhi that she should do a contract marriage with Raj Aryan. On getting the proposal, Raj Aryan gets excited and says yes to the marriage.

episodesList.title: Baigan Ka Bharta Fiasco
episodesList.summary: Raj Arayan tells tau that he wants his wife to make baigan ka bartha, so tau orders chandramukhi to make it. Chandramuhki is worried because she doesn't how to make it but Gulgule says that he knows to make it. Later on as the dinner is served neither Raj Aryan nor Chandramukhi is able to eat it as it is too spicy, Meanwhile tau comes to  the dining table to eat and everybody is in a state of shock.

episodesList.title: The Bharta Remade
episodesList.summary: As tau starts to eat Chandramukhi is tensed as to what will tau say to her. However, we see that Tau eats the entire dish without any hesitation, Seeing this Chandramukhi is full of remorse and promises tau  that she will make the bhaigan ka bartha with her own hands. Will Chandramukhi be able to make the bhaigan ka bartha with her own hands as she had promised or will she again take Gulgule's help?

episodesList.title: The Bedroom Dilemma
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi makes bhaigan ka bartha with her own hands and this time even tau likes it and he says that he's very proud of her. Later on Raj Aryan comes to sleep in Chandramukhi's bedroom she refuses him and tells him to sleep inside the kitchen. Will tau be able to find out that they are actually not married as the couple are not sleeping together?

episodesList.title: The Mangalsutra Lie
episodesList.summary: As tau gets suspicious abut the relationship between Chandramukhi and Raj Aryan they decide to fake togetherness by dancing together. Seeing this tau is convinced that all is normal. However, later on Energee and Banergee come to Chandramukhi's place and ask her as to why she is wearing mangalsutra and sindoor as she's not married. Chandramukhi explains that she had lied to her tau about her marriage but as she turns we see that tau is standing in front of them.

episodesList.title: Respect Your Elders
episodesList.summary: Everybody is shocked as tau is standing in front of them. Just when they were about to confess tau removes cotton from his ears and he tells them that he couldn't listen to anything. Everybody is releived. Later on we see tau entering the chowki and he complains that he should respect the elders just like Chandramukhi and his son-in-law. The Commissioner on hearing this is shocked.  Will he suspend both of them?

episodesList.title: Husband Wife Troubles
episodesList.summary: The Commissioner is angry as he didn't know about the marriage. Chandramukhi convinces him that they are just acting to solve a case. Meanwhile the complainant tells Chandramukhi that her husband yelled at her mother again. Later on the lady's mother comes to Chandramukhi's place and gives her a bottle. She is shocked to see that it's a bottle of sleeping pills.

episodesList.title: Taming The Arrogant Husband
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi tells the lady that it's time that her husband learnt a lesson. She places a bomb in his car and she arrests him on charges of being a terrorist. The husband is made to realize that he's done a huge mistake and he tells his wife that from now on even her mother could stay at her place. Later on as Raj Aryan gets a phone call from his mom which tau is about to pick up as he is close by. Will tau pick up the phone and will he come to know the truth?

episodesList.title: The Godhbharai
episodesList.summary: As tau picks up the phone luckily the line gets cut and the secret of their 'marriage' remains intact. Later on Chandramukhi's neighbourhood comes to invite her and her family for godhbarai. As the godhbharai function is going on the neighbourhood's servant sees a gold bracelet lying on the floor, as she tries to pick up the bracelet someone thinks that that she was stealing it. Will Chandramukhi arrest her?

episodesList.title: Fraud In Sports Quota
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi tells her that she won't arrest her as she is confident that the servant hadn't commited the crime. During their interaction Chandramukhi comes to know that despite the servant's daughter being good in academics the admission to college was denied by the principal. Later on as the principal comes to the chowki he tells her that the person he had given admission is through sports quota. Will Chandramukhi be able to give the servant's daughter justice?

episodesList.title: Bribe For Admission
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi realises that the principal has taken a bribe for giving the admission on sports quota. She challenges the student to run a race against her and the winner will get the admission. The principal makes Mini to sign a contract and she does so without reading it. As the race starts we see that instead of the boy it's someone else who'll be running the race. Chandramukhi postpones the race by three days in order to train Mini.

episodesList.title: Ready, Set, Go!
episodesList.summary: Mini's training gets a huge setback as she faints and is diagnosed with asthma. As the race starts, Chandramukhi tells the father and the principal that she's Mini and shows them the proof.  As the race is about to begin, Vijaynder's father adds some poison capsules in Chandramukhi's drink. Despite that Chandramukhi wins the race before fainiting.

episodesList.title: Aryan Saves Chautala
episodesList.summary: The principal and Vijaynder's father assume that Chandramukhi is dead but they are in for a shock as Raj Aryan had changed the poisonous drink just in time. Later Chandramukhi is forced to observe Karwachauth fast for her husband's long life. As she refuses, her tau steps in and makes her promise that she will observe this fast.

episodesList.title: The Karwa Chauth
episodesList.summary: Everybody is busy making the dishes for the karwachoth. Chandramukhi tells tau that she has to go to the chowki to solve a case and tells everybody to come to the chowki to celeberate mehandi. She confronts Raj Aryan and tells him to leave his friends but he doesn't like this and tells her that he's willing to leave his wife for his friends as to they are more valuable for him.

episodesList.title: Trouble On The Road
episodesList.summary: As Imarthi's husband and his friends are traveling, they see a body lying on the road and they stop. As Imarthi's husband  tries to help him out the man gets up and puts a knife on his throat. The thief tells his friends to remove all the valuables but his friends refuse to do so. Seeing this he's quiet shocked as he had left his wife for them. Now he realizes his mistake.

episodesList.title: The Spendthrift Wife
episodesList.summary: A man complains that his wife's needs are more than what he can afford with his salary and his overtime.So Chandramukhi calls his wife to the chowki to counsel her. However, the wife says that if her husband is not able to buy what she wants then he's of no use. Chandramukhi tries to teach her lesson by telling her to sell her husband for one crore to which she agrees.

episodesList.title: Inspector Buys a Husband
episodesList.summary: As we have seen in the previous episode that Chandramukhi pays one crore rupees just to teach his wife a lesson. She sends Gopi to rob her. The wife comes to the chowki complaining that she has been robbed and Chandramukhi tells her to write the F.I.R and she'll take some action. She tells Gulgule to flirt with his wife while she's out. Gulgule even succeds in doing so.

episodesList.title: The Spendthrift Wife -part 3
episodesList.summary: The wife is fed up because she's been robbed and harassed, She tells Chandramukhi that she has learnt her lesson. She requests her to give back her husband and they leave happily. Chandramukhi gets a call from tau that Raj Aryan's mother has arrived. She is shocked at this development and rushes back home. She is relieved to find that it is some other lady.

episodesList.title: The Dirty Politics
episodesList.summary: A lady tells Chandramukhi that she's standing in the elections as the politicians are corrupt and don't care for the poor. In response the politician and his goons bash up the lady's husband and break his arm. The wife gets upset and she says that she'll withdraw her name from the elections, However, Chandramukhi comes up with an idea to trap the politician.

episodesList.title: Incorruptible Inspector
episodesList.summary: Chandramuhki is standing in the elections, The politician's secretary  sends her a box of sweets which she accepts. C.I.D officers come to arrest Chandrmukhi for accepting bribe as the box was full of money. But Chandraukhi turns the table on them and makes the politician's secretary confess the truth.

episodesList.title: The Festival Fiasco
episodesList.summary: A man complains about his neighbour that he does not celebrate the festivals according to the calendar i.e. he plays holi on diwali and so on. Chandramukhi  teaches  him a lesson by arresting him for eve teasing. Later on,  Raj Aryan tells Chandramukhi that he has maintained a diary about their fake marriage. He threatens her that he will show this diary to tau.

episodesList.title: The Stolen Necklace
episodesList.summary: A lady complains about a missing necklace and she tells Chandramukhi that it is because of the watchman who sleeps during duty time  that this has happened. The case is solved by Chandramukhi who finds that it is the channewala who was behind this theft. Later on tau announces that he his going back to Haryana. Aryan calls Chandramukhi "jaanu" so, she warns him that now that the tau has gone and the contract is over.

episodesList.title: The Carrom Maniacs
episodesList.summary: A man comes to the chowki complaing about the two guys who stay near his building.They play carom the whole day and have even brain washed his wife. Chandramukhi calls them to the chowki and challenges them on a game of carrom. She wins the game and sends both the guys to jail.

episodesList.title: The Holiday Planner Cheat
episodesList.summary: A holiday planner dupes his client by promising him a stay in a hotel with the view of Himalaya. He lodges a complaint in the Chowki against him. When Chandramukhi calls  the holiday planner he says that his name is Himalaya and his client could see him the whole day! Chandramukhi decides to teach him a lesson.

episodesList.title: The Duplicate Chandramukhi
episodesList.summary: As Chandramukhi takes a round a man amed Vicky comes in front of her jeep and tells her to save him from being killed. Later on in the episode we see that his chacha is behind the whole thing as he wants to kill vicky for his property . The twist in the story comes when it is found that there is  a duplicate Chandramukhi who is in the lock up.

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi Captured
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi falls into the trap set by Chacha and is called to a remote location and given chloroform. The idea is to get the duplicate into the chowki, kill Vicky and put all the blame on Chanramukhi. Will Maria, the duplicae, be able to succeed in her evil plans?

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi Replaced
episodesList.summary: Maria has reached chowki posing as Chandramukhi. Just as she was about to kill Vicky, Raj Aryan enters and saves him. She says that she's was just checking out whether Vicky was alert. However, when Chacha calls the duplicate Raj Arayn, Gopi and Gulgule come to know the real facts.

episodesList.title: There can be One Chandramukhi
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi unties herself and replaces herself with Maria. Later on she even tells Vicky the whole truth but Raj Aryan and team don't believe in her. She wins their trust after a fight where she defeats all of them. Together they trap Chacha and make him confess about the motive behind the plan to kill Vicky.

episodesList.title: Honeymoon Trip Fiasco
episodesList.summary: A man named Rakesh comes to the chowki complaining against the travel agent who had planned their honeyoon trip. His tickets were booked as an infant and when the travel agent is questioned he explains that rakesh's wife is responsible for this because she was continuously calling her husband ' bachhe ho tum',Chandramukhi investigates and finds an estranged lover behind this honeymoon trip fiasco.

episodesList.title: The Guru Ghantaal - Part 1
episodesList.summary: A man comes to the chowki complaining that his guru ji has cheated him by making him sign a contarct in which it is written that he has to marry one of his daughters and take care of rest of his 3 daughters. Chandramukhi has  plans to teach guruji a lesson.

episodesList.title: The Guru Ghantaal - Part 2
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi sends Gulgule in disguise to beat up guruji which forces him to come to the chowki to lodge a complaint. Chandramukhi tells him to be his student and learn how to defend and fight back. As dakshina she asks guruji to marry his daughter to a 115 year old man. Both guruji and his daughter are shocked and realise their mistake.

episodesList.title: The Chivalrous Station Master
episodesList.summary: A station master and a passenger come to the chowki with their complaints. It has so happened that when he had asked the station master if he could come in and take some rest he was refused but when his wife does the same request it is accepted. Later on Gulgule convinces Raj Aryan to behave like a coolie as Chandramukhi loves coolies. They make a video clip of his antics.

episodesList.title: The Ghost Who Wants The Chowki
episodesList.summary: The ghost of Daddy John, who has been cremated beneath the chowki, roams around at night. Chandramukhi calls Gulgule and Gopi idiots for believing on ghosts. However, one night they actually meet Daddy John with a violin singing a melodramatic song to scare them. Chandramukhi decides to check it out herself.

episodesList.title: The Ghost Of Daddy John
episodesList.summary: Not just Chandramukhi but even the police commissioner is convinced that they had seen the ghost of Daddy Jhon. Raj Aryan gets full power to do anything in this case and he decides to sell the chowki. Daddy John's son agrees to buy the chowki and despite Chandramukhi's protests, the deal is finalized at an extremely low cost!

episodesList.title: The Chowki Shifted
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi and her colleagues shifting out of the chowki, to a new under construction site, which is Raj Aryan's idea of a new chowki. Chandramukhi with the help of a doctor specializing in ghosts crack the case and find  Daddy John, son John, son-in-law, gambling inside the chowki which was now turned into a club of sorts.

episodesList.title: Back In The Chowki
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi goes herself with colleagues to get back the chowki  but they refuse to get intimidated as they have done everything legally with proper signature on contract papers. So Chandramukhi decides to play the game their way. The false news of her death is flashed and as a ghost she begins scaring the fraudsters until they confess their guilt.

episodesList.title: Secret Of The Snoring Husband
episodesList.summary: Kamlesh Kamseen comes to the chowki complaining that a lady who is his neigbour always keeps slapping him when he is going to office. Her bizarre explanation is that her husband snores the whole night and leaves early in the morning. So she takes her frustration at her neighbour. Chandramukhi finds out that the husband is having an affair with his secretary and that's the reason why he's trying to frustrate his wife as he wants to leave her.

episodesList.title: The Husband Taught a Lesson
episodesList.summary: To teach the errant husband a lesson Chandramukhi dresses as a secretary and she enters the office and asks him for a job. Along with Raj Aryan and team they even manage to dupe him and make him sign a contract as well as a blank cheque. After a lot of twists and turns he comes to the chowki to register a complaint where Chandramukhi convinces the businessman that his wife loves him.

episodesList.title: Sehri Babu Forgets His Village Love
episodesList.summary: A pahadan comes to the chowki complaining that a sehri babu whom she loved and subsequently married did not return back and even refused to recognise her when she went to town to meet him. Chandramukhi investigates and finds that his elders, who were against the marriage, make him drink a medicine for memory loss.

episodesList.title: Mausi and Mausa Trapped
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi has planned a trap for mausa and mausi so that the simple village girl gets her husband back. Raj Aryan dresses as a lady and dances in front of mausa to entice him while Chandramukhi clicks his pictures. A series of comical events follow and finally the truth comes out and all ends well for the family\.

episodesList.title: The Disappearing Brides
episodesList.summary: A man comes to the chowki complaining that he his afraid of getting married as in his area continuously eight brides have disappeared during the marriage ceremony and no one has a single clue. Chandramukhi decides that she herself will be there to protect the bride. However the bride is kidnapped. What is worse even Raj Aryan, who dresses up as a bride to nab the culprits, gets kidnapped.

episodesList.title: Raj Aryan Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Raj Aryan has been kidnapped The commissioner gives chandramukhi 48 hrs to find Raj Aryan or else she has to leave the job.Chandramukhi's investigations reveal that the master mind behind all this is the Sarpanch of the village itself. She plans to lay a trap for him.

episodesList.title: Trap For The Kidnappers
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi dresses herself as a bride to trap the kidnappers but she fails as the kidnapper knew  what was happening. She changes her strategy and calls up the sarpanch to the chowki where she is dressed up as the Sarpanch's wife and makes him reveal his entire crime.

episodesList.title: The Husband With All The Vices
episodesList.summary: A lady comes to the chowki and complains that her husband has all the vices like drinking, gambling and watching mujra, and that too along with his mama. On making enquiries Chandramukhi is convinced that it is really so. She then conjures up a plan and even plays the role of Jummalina to woo the husband mama duo in order to teach them a lesson.

episodesList.title: The Waitlisted Baraat
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi gets  a complaint of a barat continuously waiting outside the bride's house for two days and even playing the band but the daughter is refusing to give her consent for the marriage. She convinces the groom side that the bride is getting ready for the big occassion. Her investigations reveal that the bride is in love with someone else who happens to be a fraud.

episodesList.title: The Fraud Lover
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi dresses up provocatively and entices the fraud lover with her charms. She falls for her and is lured to come to the police chowki where he confesses that he was actually not in love with the bride. All this was being recorded and is shown to the bride who realises her mistake and agrees for the marriage.

episodesList.title: The Fraud Magician
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi arrests a fraud magician but later comes to know that he was doing this to break his wife's superstitions  as she was under the influence of a fraud baba doing fake magic. She calls the fraud baba to the chowki and in the process learns some of his tricks and later plans to use it herself to impress others and the fraud baba.

episodesList.title: Chadramukhi The Magician
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi shows the fraud baba a few of her tricks. The baba calls her to the ashram and tells her that her magic is fraud. She agrees but to trap him talks about stealing a bracelet worth five crores. The baba does so only to realise that he had been lured into the trap by Chandramukhi who then goes on to expose the fraud baba before others.

episodesList.title: The Guest House Thief
episodesList.summary: A man comes complaining to the chowki that his jewellery worth Rs 50 lakhs has been stolen from a guest named Decent Guest House where he stayed overnight. Investigations reveal that there was another couple and a photographer who had stayed in the Guest House. As chandramukhi goes through the photographs she sees a man's shoes behind the curtains.

episodesList.title: The Guest House Fraud
episodesList.summary: Investigations reveal that the shoes behind the curtains belonged to  Raj Aryan who happened to be in the guest house. Chandramukhi tells the guest house owner that she'll deal with the necessary paperwork to get his money from the insurance company for his lost jewellery. Later on, we come to know it's the owner himself who's the real thief and it was all part of Chandramukhi's plan just to know the truth.

episodesList.title: The Coward Husband
episodesList.summary: A man complains that while he was driving through a heavy traffic a man came near his car and hit him. Chandramukhi tells them to leave as it was a misunderstanding. This incident is repeated again and Chandramukhi says that again it was a misunderstanding. The third time the man comes crying saying that his girlfriend has left him, as she was embarrassed that he couldn't protect himself!

episodesList.title: The Serial Hitter
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi calls the guy who had repeatedly hit the complainant and his girlfriend to the chowki. Here they all manage to arrange a fight between the two inside Raj Aryan's cabin. In the ensuing comical confusion, Chandramukhi hits the woman's current boyfriend and announces that her ex-boyfriend had actually hit thereby, bringing them back together. All's well that ends well.

episodesList.title: The Lazy Husband
episodesList.summary: Paudha Patwardhan comes to the chowki complaining that his wife is so much under the spell of a lady called Sheela Shandhar that she does whatever Sheela does. The problem is Sheela hits her lazy husband regularly because of which her wife also does the same thing. This is a very difficult case to resolve but the Chowki team does it with its usual comical ways.

episodesList.title: Innocent Man Declared Terrorist
episodesList.summary: A hilarious mix up happens when Chandramukhi catches a terrorist and gives his photo to Gulgule to make multiple prints and display it throughout the city. However, this photo gets mixed up with the photo of a man who had come to the chowki for passport verification. The man obviously is all worked up as his colleagues and society members now think him to be a terrorist. Chandramukhi calls up his parents and tells them that it was her colleague's fault and she promises that she will take care of everything.

episodesList.title: Commissioner Held Hostage
episodesList.summary: The comical goof-ups happen in this episode too as Chandramukhi plans to redeem the image of the innocent man. She plans a fake rescue mission where the real terrorist is supposed to be caught by the innocent man. However, in the confusion, the Commissioner walks into the situation and is held hostage by the terrorist and that too with a real gun. Chandramukhi however salvages the situation.

episodesList.title: The Foreign Bahu
episodesList.summary: A foreign returned son comes along with his girlfriend whom he intends to marry. The shocked parents refuse to accept a foreigner as their bahu. Their point is that she has no idea about Indian culture. All efforts of Chandramukhi fail until a massive argument erupts amongst the family members inside the chowki. The father gets an attack and is saved in the nick of time by the foreigner girl who happens to be a doctor. All's well that ends well and the family agrees for the marriage.

episodesList.title: Film Producer Taught a Lesson
episodesList.summary: A film producer goes back on his promise to give an aspiring singer a break. So Chandramukhi poses as a singer and the producer is manipulated to get into a fight with Raj Aryan whose death is faked. Now the singer is dressed up as a lawyer and promises to save the producer if he honours his commitment to give him a break in his film.

episodesList.title: The Whistling Chimpanzee
episodesList.summary: A couple comes to the chowki complaining that the chimpanzee in the zoo had whistled when his wife had started dancing in excitement. Later on again the couple comes to chowki complaining that this time the chimpanzee had pinched her wife. Chandramukhi decides to investigate this strange behaviour of the Chimpanzee who is indulging in eve-teasing.

episodesList.title: The Empty Zoo
episodesList.summary: On not finding any animals in the zoo, Chandramukhi becomes suspicious. She is told by the zoo owner that all his animals had gone off to sleep. She manages to kidnap a chimpanzee only to realise that it is a human being and they are also made to perform in the circus. They lay a trap for the zoo owner and get him arrested.

episodesList.title: Mystery Of The Prank Calls
episodesList.summary: Two friends come to the chowki complaining about prank calls one of them gets. The caller also knows about his weakness for sweets. After a few hilarious goof-ups, Chandramukhi calls them and says that the prank caller is in love with his sister. On hearing this his friend confesses that he is the one who is guilty and reveals everything.

episodesList.title: A Paanwalaa's Debt
episodesList.summary: A paanwala and a man come to the chowki. The paanwala complains that he was slapped by his customer who also agrees and says that the paanwala asks too many questions while making his paan. The next time they both come and now it is the paanwala who has beaten his customer for writing a love letter to his wife. Chandramukhi finds the real reason and solves the case.

episodesList.title: The Kabilaa's Lost Prince
episodesList.summary: The head of a kabila had lost his son long back and had now himself passed away leaving a lot of wealth behind. His people believe that the Prince has a tattoo on his back. Gulgule decides to make a tattoo on his back, claim all the jewellery so that the ten lakh rupees that had accumulated against electricity charges of the chowki can be paid off. Chandramukhi cautions him.

episodesList.title: Gulgule vs Crocodile
episodesList.summary: Gulgule's plan badly backfires as the Kabila has organized a swimming competition between him and a crocodile to cross-check if he indeed is a genuine Prince. Chanramukhi finds out that the in-charge of the kabila is a fraud. She dresses up as a tribal girl and entices him to marry her. In the process, he is exposed and Gulgule is also saved and rescued.

episodesList.title: Mystery Of The Laughing Wife
episodesList.summary: A husband comes to the chowki to complain that her wife is always laughing even on serious matters. Chandramukhi investigates and finds out that she is doing it deliberately so that she can elope with her boyfriend who actually happens to be more interested in her jewellery. After a mock gunfight and a fake death, the husband-wife duo is united and their marriage saved.

episodesList.title: Stuck In a Ticket Counter
episodesList.summary: A man comes to the chowki with a ticket counter with his hand stuck inside it. The owner says that this counter cannot be broken as it was made by his great grandfather. Gulgule gives the idea that he should go on a fast for a week after which his hand will be thin enough to come out of the hole. But a week later the problem still persists.

episodesList.title: The Sports Loving Wife
episodesList.summary: A man complains about guys playing in front of his building. It so transpires that his wife, who is a sports-lover, actually cheers for them. The guys playing tell Chandramukhi that there is no law preventing them from playing. Gulgule tells the man that he should also play with the boys but very soon he comes back to say that he was beaten up by the boys.

episodesList.title: Team Without Chandramukhi
episodesList.summary: The guys are called to the chowki by Chandramukhi. They deny the charge that they had beaten up the guy and whatever happened was all part of the game. In order to teach them a lesson, Chandramukhi challenges them for a game that they accept. Just when she has to leave, the commissioner calls her and the team now has to play without her.

episodesList.title: The Team Cheated?
episodesList.summary: As Raj Aryan and co start to play the game they are on the verge of being defeated as the guys keep on cheating. Just then Chandramukhi enters the game and they easily manage to defeat them. It is then that the guys reveal that the lady actually used to give money and food to play in front of the building.

episodesList.title: Fake Baba's Fake Spirit
episodesList.summary: A man comes and complains that his wife and mother-in-law are in the clutches of a fake baba who claims that he has transferred his late father-in-law's spirit into a living person. Chandramukhi makes Raj Aryan kidnap the mother-in-law and then declare her dead. She now pretends to house her spirit and goes on to solve the case of the fake baba.

episodesList.title: The Scheming Husband
episodesList.summary: A man complains that his wife always does the opposite of whatever he tells her to cook. However, the wife denies the charges and calls her husband a liar. Chandramukhi tries to help them to bridge their communication gap but it does not yield any results as the husbanD once again complains that his wife did not go for a movie with him but instead went with a friend.

episodesList.title: The Secret Agenda
episodesList.summary: Gulgule finds out the husband is doing all this with a sinister purpose. He even has a girlfriend and they are together plotting to get the property transferred in his name. Chandramukhi lays a trap for them, alienates his girlfriend from him by threatening her with a jail term and exposes his devious plans.

episodesList.title: When a Parrot Predicts
episodesList.summary: A man comes to the chowki and hands over a parrot saying that the owner is cheating the public by making false predictions by using it. The team decides to have some fun and trap Raj Aryan. They make the parrot say that he has to change into a woman to impress Chandramukhi. Raj dresses up as a woman and is dancing when the commissioner arrives. Seeing Raj in such a condition he suspends him temporarily.

episodesList.title: The Painter's Revenge
episodesList.summary: A person comes to complain in the Chowki that a painter who was supposed to make his portrait had painted a donkey instead. Chandramukhi finds out that during the struggling days of the painter the man had humiliated him and made him work like a donkey. She gets convinced about the painter's plight and decides to teach the person a lesson.

episodesList.title: The Painter Learns About Art
episodesList.summary: All agree that instead of painting they will take a photo of the person. Chandramukhi fools the person as the photo taken is again of a donkey. They decide to settle the matter once and for all by deputing an African painter to paint his portrait. Again the painting is that of a donkey as this time Chandramukhi, dressed as an African painter, once again fools the person. She teaches him a lesson never to underestimate young struggling painters.

episodesList.title: The Eve Teasers
episodesList.summary: Two college girls come to the chowki complaining there are 2 guys who are teasing them by the name coffee and chocolate. Chandramukhi is unable to take any action as they are related to the local MLA and the commissioner orders chandramukhi to release the guys. She decides to leave her job and pursue further studies. She enrolls in the same college and creates a rift between the two boys.

episodesList.title: The Bike Race
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi tells them to have a bike race and whosoever wins will be her boyfriend. It so transpires that all of this was a plan to trap the boys and had the clearance of the Commissioner also. The boys are booked for rash driving and causing an accident that has led to death. The MLA is shocked as Chandramukhi threatens to call journalists photographers. He regrets their entire behaviour and assures that the boys will follow the right path in the future.

episodesList.title: Mausam Beiman Hey
episodesList.summary: A man comes to complain that his girlfriend is getting anonymous calls saying that mausam beiman hai. Actually, his name is Mausam Manchanda and because of this, his girlfriend thinks that he is a cheat. After failing to convince his girlfriend Chanramukhi decides to investigate as to who is behind this prank call and she is surprised to find a woman doing this from a phone booth.

episodesList.title: Chulbull Pandey is Here?
episodesList.summary: They catch a woman who had been making prank calls. She reveals that Mausam Manchanda is a big fraud who cheats innocent girls. Chandramukhi decides to pay him back in his own coin. She dresses up as Chulbul Pandey and first saves Mausam's sister and then spins a hilarious web around him so that he is taught a lesson to never mess with innocent girls.

episodesList.title: The Romantic Ghost
episodesList.summary: A man comes and complains that his daughter is troubled by a ghost who is in love with her and wants to marry her. The girl too is guilty because she had slapped the boy for his indecent proposal and had later died. Chandramukhi smells something fishy and so using a baba lures the so-called ghost to appear and when he does then she, dressed up as a lady ghost, declares that she is in love with the ghost. The game is thus exposed in a very comical way.

episodesList.title: The Case Of Three Baraati's
episodesList.summary: A man's marriage gets canceled because only three barati's had come from the village although they had committed that 250 would come. The groom's father tells Chandramukhi that the remaining 247 could not come because they were prevented by a village strong man Birju Bhaiya with whom he had an argument. Chandramukhi decides to teach him a lesson in her own unique style.

episodesList.title: The Dowry Seeking Advocate
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi and her team teach a dowry seeking greedy advocate a lesson. He was demanding a scooter from his in-laws. Chandramukhi tells them to buy one and Gulgule riding with him forces him to run over a snake. He then declares that it was a Cobra and a Nagin will now take her revenge. The Nagin is none other than Chanramukhi herself and she forces the dowry seeking advocate to beg for mercy !!

episodesList.title: The Lover On a Bicycle
episodesList.summary: A man and his sister-in-law complain that while they were jogging a guy dashed against them deliberately with his cycle. This is again repeated after some days. Chandramukhi finds out that not just the cyclist but even the girl was in love but since he was poor, the permission was being denied by her jija ji. She decides to help them get married.

episodesList.title: The Boss Trapped
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi comes to know the jija is interested that his saali marries his boss as he is rich and has high contacts. Chandramukhi traps the boss and accuses him of stealing diamonds. On the advice of Gulgule he puts the blame on the jija who is now called to the chowki. The poor cyclist however comes to his rescue and decides to take the blame on himself. This is a huge eye-opener to the jija.

episodesList.title: The Funny Pranksters
episodesList.summary: When two guys make fun and laugh at others a couple comes and complains. Chandramukhi tries to counsel them but they arrogantly say that there is no law that can prevent them from making fun of others. Chandramukhi decides to teach them a lesson and tell them to make fun of a particular man. Little do they realise that they have been trapped to make fun of the commissioner!

episodesList.title: Husband With a Memory Loss
episodesList.summary: A wife demands compensation of Rs.25 lakhs against her neighbors because when they were hammering a nail a brick fell on her husband's head leading to memory loss. What is worse the husband has now started calling his wife as his sister. Chandramukhi senses that there is something fishy about the entire incident and decides to solve the case in her own unique way.

episodesList.title: Search For a Boxer Jija
episodesList.summary: A man is prevented from marrying his lady love because her three boxer brothers want their sister to marry a boxer. Chandramukhi fails to convince them and so decides to solemnise their marriage without the knowledge of the brothers. The boy refuses to do so on grounds of principles and now Chandramukhi is forced to arrange a boxing match against the three brothers.

episodesList.title: Boxer Chandramukhi
