episodesList.title: Chautala's Master Plan to Arrest Modak Thief
episodesList.summary: Billu and Gopi are enjoying the atmosphere of the village but this apparently does not go down well with Chandramukhi. Gopi once again comes across the Lavani Girl and gets scared. Chandramukhi reveals her master plan to nab the thief. Has Chandramukhi caught her? Who is she?

episodesList.title: The Modak Mystery Continues
episodesList.summary: Gotya and his family wait outside the temple waiting for the gates to open for his wedding, but soon discover that his bride has been married off to someone else. Just then, Chandramukhi arrives disguised as a foreign tourist. Will she discover who the real 'Modak Thief' is, in this disguise?

episodesList.title: Gangubai
episodesList.summary: Mukesh Mehta and his wife Lalita file a police complaint against a thief who robbed valuable belongings from their house. Couple is surprised to see Gangubai in Imaan Chowki. Billu and Gopi are shocked to see Gangubai who looks similar to Chandramukhi. What is the secret of Gangubai? Watch this hilarious episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Commissioner Gets Robbed By Gangubai
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi gets a huge shock as Commissioner reveals to her that Gangubai robbed him. Chandramukhi observes Gangubai's footage and gets surprised to see her looks. Star cast of Youngistaan, Actor Jackky Bhagnani and Actress Neha Sharma arrive in Imaan Chowki to explain the importance of vote. Will Gangubai get arrested? To know more, watch this hilarious episode of F.I.R.

episodesList.title: Chautala Gets Arrested
episodesList.summary: Gangubai is spreading fear of robbery in Rawanpur. Chandramukhi becomes Gangubai to arrest Gangubai and prove her innocence but a major problem arises as she gets arrested by Billu and Gopi in Imaan Chowki. Chandramukhi is in jail. How will Chandramukhi prove to Commissioner that she is not involved in stealing valuable belongings from people?

episodesList.title: Highway Ka Rahasya
episodesList.summary: After Gangubai, Chandramukhi comes across yet another case of the secret of highway. A couple from Attara files a police complaint against a landlord who doesn't allow them to fill the water from the well. Instead of Highway, Gopi arrives in a Garden. Where has Gopi landed? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Gangubai Visits Imaan Chowki
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi walks into Imaan Chowki, dressed as Gangubai, but Billu and Gopi fail to recognize her. She gives them an earful for their negligence and tells them about her new plan to catch this cunning lady-thief. Will she succeed?

episodesList.title: Rajkumari Kamalchakshuni In Imaan Chowki
episodesList.summary: Billu and Gopi are shocked to see Chandramukhi as Rajkumari Kamalchakshuni and also assume that she is on a mission to crack the highway case. A group of Theatre artists performing Mythological plays reveals a shocking truth to Chandramukhi. What is the secret of Highway?

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi Ka Mahila Suraksha Abhiyaan
episodesList.summary: A College Student named Meera, studying in Allahabad University files an eve teasing complaint against 2 Boys Prem and Chappu Chopra who not only follow Meera but also tease her in the bus that she travels. Chautala takes strict actions against Prem and Chappu. To know Chautala's next move, watch this hilarious episode

episodesList.title: Prem and Chappu Get Arrested
episodesList.summary: Chautala gives a unique solution to Meera to get Prem and Chappu out of her way but instead of Prem and Chappu, Gopi and Billu land in deep trouble. Prem and Chappu Chopra get arrested but Chautala still has a doubt on Chaturvedi. How will Chautala solve Meera's never ending problem? Watch this episode to find out!

episodesList.title: Chautala Urgently Calls For a Press Conference
episodesList.summary: Commissioner tells Chautala to urgently leave Prem and Chopra as they have high connections with ministers. Chautala firmly decides to teach an unforgettable lesson to Chaturvedi so she calls a press conference. What happened in the press conference? Watch this hilarious episode.

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi Bani Chitrakar
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi meets an old friend, a banker, who pursues dancing in her free time. She encourages Chandramukhi too to pursue her childhood hobby of painting. Her colleagues however are a little concerned about her new passion. Watch this hilarious episode to find out why.

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi's Unbelievable Painting
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi Chautala has become an Artist and is also working hard towards the same in Imaan Chowki. Chautala fumes in anger as Gopi and Billu get highly impressed by Chautala's unbelievable painting. Chautala is expecting a Guest in Imaan Chowki. Who is he? Watch to find out!

episodesList.title: 2 Francis In Imaan Chowki
episodesList.summary: Painter Chandramukhi is surprised to see 2 Painting Teachers Mr. Francis in Imaan Chowki. Billu falls in love with Mr. Francis's Daughter. Chautala comes up with her unique plan to find out who the real Mr. Francis is. Will Chautala succeed? Who is Mr. Francis? Watch to find out!

episodesList.title: Chunav Chunav
episodesList.summary: Bantu Tandon files a police complaint against 2 Boys who work with a local politician. Bantu reveals to Chautala that he spoke the truth about the politician and they have warned him that he will not be able to marry. Chautala continues to teach lessons to Women on self-defence. How will Chautala save Bantu Tandon? Watch to find out!

episodesList.title: Bajrang Pandey Returns
episodesList.summary: Not only Gopi and Billu but Chautala is also extremely excited to meet their Senior Inspector Bajarang Pandey. Chautala gets a huge shock as she observes a woman named Jaanu who was accompanying Pandeyji. Gopi and Billu welcome Pandeyji in Imaan Chowki but even they are shocked to see Jaanu. Is Pandeyji married to Jaanu? Will Gopi and Billu find out the truth?

episodesList.title: Bajrang Ne Mari Entriyaan
episodesList.summary: Chautala seems sulky upon meeting Bajrang Pandey as she has learnt that he is now married. Bajrang however, doesn't seem to understand why she gave him such a cold welcome. Is he really married? Watch this episode to find out

episodesList.title: Shaadi Tut Gayi
episodesList.summary: While Chandramukhi is teaching self defence to women, a father and daughter come to the chowki to file a complain that whenever she is about to get married, someone puts in a small chit that questions her character and hence, she is not able to get married. How will Chautala solve this?

episodesList.title: Marriage Proposal For Manjri
episodesList.summary: To find out who is becoming a barrier for Manjri in her marriage, Billu, Gopi, Chautala and Bajrang Pandey come up with an interesting plan to nab the person who doesn't want Manjri to get married. Will Chautala's master plan work? Who is he? Watch to find out!

episodesList.title: Chandu Reveals a Shocking Truth to Chautala
episodesList.summary: Chautala urgently calls Manjri's family members to Imaan Chowki and also insists all of them to remove their shoes. Chautala and Senior Inspector Bajrang Pandey find the unknown person. Who is he? Why does he not want Manjri to settle down? Watch to find out!

episodesList.title: Jhangia Baniyaan Gang
episodesList.summary: AC Nigam and Kamla Nigam residing in Janta Nagar, Raawanpur files a police complanit against Jhangia Baniyaan Gang as a robbery occurs in their house. Another Woman also comes up with the same issue. How will Chautala arrest the gang? Watch to find out!

episodesList.title: Bajrang Struggles to Get a Train Reservation
episodesList.summary: Bajrang Pandey is extremely upset that he is unable to make a train reservation for his mother. Meanwhile a new criminal, 'Jangiya Banyan' is wreaking havoc in town. How will Chandramukhi solve the case while Bajrang tries to make a train reservation?

episodesList.title: Gopi's Encounter With Hunter
episodesList.summary: Public takes the initiative to nab Jhangia Baniyaan Gang and they succeed too but unfortunately Gopi gets caught. Gopi plans to take a leave for a day. Will Chautala approve his leave? Will they succeed in nabbing Jhangia Baniyaan Gang? Watch to find out!

episodesList.title: Yeh Flat Kab Banega
episodesList.summary: Sumo is helping out Chautala in finding the missing link of Jhangiya Baniyan Gang. One of the members of Jhangiya Baniyan Gang gets arrested and thus Chautala finds the entire group. A Couple gets caught by Gopi in a Police Jeep. Mr & Mrs. Teda share their flat problem with Chautala. Who is Chandan? Will Chautala solve their flat issue? Watch this hilarious episode to find out!

episodesList.title: Builder Patel and Patwardhan Fight In Imaan Chowki
episodesList.summary: Mr and Mrs. Tedha are staying in Imaan Chowki since they don't have a house as their builder has defaulted on the deadline. Mr. Tedha's Father arrives in Imaan Chowki to meet their Children. Builder Patel and his Business Partner Patwardhan fight in Imaan Chowki. Chautala gets angry with them. Will Senior Inspector Pandeyji express his feelings for Chautala?

episodesList.title: Patwardhan and Patel's Master Plan
episodesList.summary: Gopi takes Patwardhan and Builder Patel to a restaurant to solve their problem but Gopi, Chautalala, Gulgule and Billu are not aware of Patwardhan and Builder Patel's master plan. Chautala doubts on both of them. Senior Inspector Bajrang comes up with an interesting plan. Will they succeed in finding the truth?

episodesList.title: Chit Chor
episodesList.summary: Chautala teaches an unforgettable lesson to Builder Patel and Mr. Patwardhan in Imaan Chowki as she helps them in cracking a huge deal by introducing them to one of her client. Mr and Mrs. Tedha are excited to shift to their new house. There comes another case for Chautala. A robbery occurs in Aashiq's House and thief leaves a message too.

episodesList.title: Chit Chor Investigation Continues
episodesList.summary: A man files an FIR stating that someone has been harassing him by leaving 'chits' at his doorstep everyday. Chautala has his neighbour questioned for this but finds that she too is being harassed by the same person. Who could this sadistic criminal be?

episodesList.title: Gopi and Billu's Master Plan to Nab Chit Chor
episodesList.summary: Chautala comments on Billu and Gopi's brilliant idea of nabbing Chit Chor who is stealing valuable belongings from innocent people's houses. Chuatala and Bajrang as Rampyaari Dhoban and Rampyaare Dhobi arrive in the building. Will Chautala and Bajrang's plan work?

episodesList.title: Bahadur Reveals a Shocking Truth to Chautala
episodesList.summary: Chautala comes up with an interesting plan to nab the thief (Chit Chor) of the building as he steals valuable belongings from that particular building. Bahadur of the building reveals a shocking truth to Chautala.

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi Online
episodesList.summary: Chautala's 3 biggest fans arrive in Imaan Chowki with Red Roses to prove their love for Chautala. Chautala sends a message daily on her official police page. Senior Inspector Bajrang's mother has arrived in the city to meet Chautala. Will Chautala find out the truth?

episodesList.title: Chautala's Online Account Gets Hacked
episodesList.summary: Chautala once again gets angry with her crazy fans as they are ready to fulfil all her wishes in Imaan Chowki. Chautala is shocked to see her look alike in online. Senior Inspector Bajrang is upset with Chautala. Who has hacked Chautala's account?

episodesList.title: Chautala's Suspension Orders
episodesList.summary: The Commissioner reveals to Chautala that she will soon get suspended from the post of Inspector and from Imaan Chowki as well. Chautala asks for 24 hours to prove that she is innocent and also finds an important clue in the graveyard.

episodesList.title: Birthday Mein Baj Gaya Band
episodesList.summary: Mr. Chaman walks into Imaan chowki to file an FIR against 3 of his friends because of whom he doesn't want to celebrate his birthday. The reason being that the birthday bumps they give him later leave him with a severe back injury.

episodesList.title: Aaj Chutti Hai
episodesList.summary: On Labour Day, all the constables of Imaan Chowki firmly decide not work and serve the country. However, this apparently does not go down too well with Senior Inspector Bajrang and Chautala. Gopi and Billu refuse to work on Labour Day. How will Chautala make Billu and Gopi work? Will Bajrang come up with an interesting plan?

episodesList.title: Bas Main Ho Gaya Bebas
episodesList.summary: A Maths Professor files a police complaint against a Bus Conductor for not giving him a change despite having it with him. Chautala gets angry with the Bus Conductor. However the bus conductor reveals a shocking truth to Chautala in his defence. How will Chautala solve the case of Bus Conductor and Professor? Who is Sana?

episodesList.title: Hum Achhe Padosi Hai
episodesList.summary: Patti files a Police complaint against his neighbour Behra in Imaan Chowki. Chautala and Senior Inspector Bajrang pose as Mr and Mrs. Robert and try to solve Patti's problem. What will happen to Mr. Behra?

episodesList.title: Phone Message Phone
episodesList.summary: Paro Mehta files a police complaint against her husband who is ignoring her and giving more importance to his cell phone. Businessman Chaman Mehta arrives in Imaan Chowki. Chautala teaches an unforgettable lesson to Mr. Mehta. Meanwhile, will Bajrang ever be able express his feelings to Chautala?

episodesList.title: Chunnu Chaatwala
episodesList.summary: Gappu and Chappu rush to Imaan Chowki to file a police complaint against Chunnu Chaatwala. Ms. Gappu and Ms. Chappu who love to eat chaat are asked to meet Chautala urgently. How will Chautala solve the case of Chunnu Chaatwala?

episodesList.title: Jewellery Lut Gayee
episodesList.summary: A jeweller Kapadia and his manager Dimple come into the police station to complain of a necklace worth Rs.20 Lakhs being stolen from their shop. They even claim to have a CCTV recording of the burglary. Will Chautala help them find the criminals?

episodesList.title: Mahila Police
episodesList.summary: Famous Heroine Chandani Chauhan's Sister Sunita Chauhan requests Chautala to help her in finding Chandani's personal diary in which all her personal details were written in great details. Chandani's hair dresser Heena arrives in Imaan Chowki. What will be Chautala's plan to find Chandani's personal diary?

episodesList.title: New Mahila Police In Imaan Chowki
episodesList.summary: A new Police Inspector Pinky Tiwari closely working with Chautala in Imaan Chowki on Chandani's case. Gopi and Billu are suspended from Imaan Chowki. Chautala questions heroine Chandani's make-up artist Julie about the personal diary. Will Chautala and Pinky's plan work?

episodesList.title: Driver and Sunita Get Arrested
episodesList.summary: Chautala and Pinky go on the sets pretending to be reporters. They offer Julie and Chipakpal twenty lakh rupees for juicy gossip with proof in return. Someone calls Chautala for the money in exchange of money. Pinky sees Chipakpal and Julie exchanging bags. They are brought to chowky. Here Chautala reveals that culprit is none other than Chandani's sister Sunita and her boyfriend Chipakpal. They are arrested.

episodesList.title: Kishore Kumar Paan Khilayega
episodesList.summary: Mrs.Puglet lodges an FIR against her husband for visiting a night club. Mr.Puglet explains that he was attacked by a person wearing singer Kishore Kumar's mask and forcefully feeding him paan. Chautala does not believe him, warns him and send him home. Later that night, Gopi is attacked in same way. Chautala comes to know about the paan shop named Kishore pan shop.She starts her investigations in full earnest.

episodesList.title: Mujhe Arrest Karlo
episodesList.summary: Atta tries to get arrested couple of times and Chautala keeps on warning him and leaves him. Finally fed up she asks him about his problem. He tells her that he is trying to save himself from his wife and mother-in-law who keeps on making him work all day when they party.Chautala decides to teach them a lesson.

episodesList.title: Napoleon Ka Dastana
episodesList.summary: A historian reveals to Chautala that the golden gloves belong to the King of France, Napoleon Bonaparte. Chautala tries to get in touch with the one of the members of the Museum located in France. How will Chautala solve the mysterious case of Napoleon's antique Gloves?

episodesList.title: Secret Of Napoleon's Daughter
episodesList.summary: Chautala is hell bent on getting to the bottom of things and learn the truth. Chautala firmly decides to crack the code of Napoleon's Golden gloves and also decides to visit France. Who is Emily? What is the secret of Napoleon's daughter?

episodesList.title: Napoleon Ki Beti
episodesList.summary: A strange man walks into the chowki one day & tells Chautala that she may be the reincarnation of Napoleon's daughter. Chauatala refuses to believe it at first but also promises to keep this a secret upon the man's request. Gopi & Billu start to sense that she is probably hiding something.

episodesList.title: Bijli Ka Bill
episodesList.summary: Everyone is gathered around Inspector Chautala and are shocked with the electricity bill that has been on the rise for no apparent reason. A teacher, Chaukan Ojha, arrives at the station with a similar issue that the inspector is facing at the station. He claims that all he has at home is a table fan and a bulb. They figure out that Pappu Power is the company that provides power to their homes. The owner of the company is summoned for questioning.

episodesList.title: Bijli Bill Fraud
episodesList.summary: The cops at Imaan Chowki are flabbergasted by their electricity bill for the month. They are shocked as they have done nothing that could have caused such a huge increase in the bill! Is there foul play at work? Watch this hilarious episode to find out!

episodesList.title: Do Dilon Ke Khel Mein
episodesList.summary: Chautala gets angry with Gopi and Billu as they are not proving to be of a great help to Chautala in Imaan Chowki. Chef Navin Khanna files a police complaint against his neighbour Chandani who is insisting him to cook delicious items. Has Billu found his new love?

episodesList.title: Dabbawala Rejects Billu's Marriage Proposal
episodesList.summary: Billu is extremely happy and over-excited as he has finally found his true love in the dabbawala's daughter Chandani. Dabbawala rejects Billu's marriage proposal but this apparently does not go down too well with Chautala and Bajrang. Will Chautala and Bajrang's master plan work?

episodesList.title: Billu's Sacrifice
episodesList.summary: Chautala is shocked as constable Billu insults Dabbawala in Imaan Chowki. Chautala praises Billu as she gets to know about Billu's grand sacrifice. A strange case of Lift comes across Chautala. Ghanshyam Ghamandi and Ghanghor Ghamandi living in Mohabbat Appartment file a police complaint against an unknown person who writes shocking messages inside the lift.

episodesList.title: The Lift
episodesList.summary: Ghanshyam Ghamandi and Ghanghor Ghamandi living in Mohabbat Apartment file a Police complaint against an unknown person who writes shocking messages inside the lift. Ghanshyam expresses his doubts on Ex-Secretary Mr. Chaturbhuj. Who wrote message in the lift? Who is revealing the truth about Mr and Mrs. Ghamnadi in the lift?

episodesList.title: Roothna Manana
episodesList.summary: Pandey tries to woo Chautala, she is unsure of how to respond to his affection. When she finds out that roothna-manana is a way of courtship, she decides to try it out on Pandey. Is it going to work or is it going to backfire on her?

episodesList.title: Band Baja
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi Chautala comes across a strange case in Imaan Chowki. A Bride's Father files a police complaint against the Groom on the wedding day as they missed the scheduled Mahurat of marriage. Chautala gets angry with the band members. Will band members reveal the truth to Chautala?

episodesList.title: Search For Dulhan Tunni
episodesList.summary: Chautala, Gopi and Billu are in search of Dulhan Tunni and also interrogate the band members. Gopi and Billu get badly beaten up. Chautala teaches an unforgettable lesson to band members. Who is Tunni? Will Tunni reveal the truth to Chautala? Watch to find out.

episodesList.title: Secret Of Dulhan
episodesList.summary: Chautala and Bajrang make sure that there is no interruption in the wedding and also come up with an interesting plan to find out the secret of the dulhan. Constable Golu requests Chautala to forgive Dulhan. What will be Chautala's final decision? Watch to find out.

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi Ka Hungama
episodesList.summary: Chautala fumes in anger as Traffic Police Pinky Tiwari apologizes to Jhunnu, Babloo and Bunty. Chautala gets to know about Jhunnu's rash driving. Jhunnu and his gang arrive in Imaan Chowki but Chautala fails to arrest them. How will Chautala teach a lesson to Jhunnu and his gang? Watch to find out.

episodesList.title: Gopi and Billu Get Caught By a Traffic Police
episodesList.summary: Constable Gopi and Billu get caught by Honest Traffic Police Pinky Tiwari for breaking the signal. Babloo and Bunty get badly beaten up by Chautala. How will Chautala teach a lesson to Jhunnu? Watch to find out.

episodesList.title: Hamirpur Express
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi Chautala teaches Jhunnu a very unforgettable lesson with the help of Bajrang Pandey, Gopi and Billu. Chautala comes across yet another strange case of Hamirpur Express. A scientist files a police complaint against a thief who has stolen his chemical. Scientist reveals to Chautala that his chemical should not get injected in Human's body.

episodesList.title: Chemical Thief's Escape Plan
episodesList.summary: The scientist reveals to Chautala that the chemical thief is planning to escape from Rawanpur Junction. The scientist and Chautala rush to the railway station to find out in which train the chemical thief is travelling. Will Bajrang become chemical thief's next target?

episodesList.title: Vitamin D
episodesList.summary: The scientist comes up with an interesting solution to solve the itching problem of all those passengers who are travelling in Hamirpur Express. Chautala manages to get inside the running train. Bajrang is shocked to see Chautala's medical reports. Is the doctor hiding something from Chautala?

episodesList.title: Chautala's Classical Attempt
episodesList.summary: Billu, Gopi and Bajrang reveal a shocking truth about Chautala's classical performance. Musician Panchhi files FIR against Ruchi for selling him a sitar in the name of tabla. But even in front of Chautala, Ruchi is not ready to accept that it is sitar and not tabla. Bajrang takes extra care of Chautala as she seems to be unwell.

episodesList.title: Chautala Forgets Her Identity
episodesList.summary: Guttan Uncle and Baby Chautala - Jwalamukhi Chautala pretends to have forgtten who she is and acts out different personalities like a baby or an exotic dancer in front of the IGP. Why is she doig this? Who is she after?

episodesList.title: Chatri Chor
episodesList.summary: Gappu Gaviya files a police complaint against an Umbrella Thief as his mother-in-law's prestigious umbrella gets stolen. Who is stealing innocent people's umbrella and why?

episodesList.title: Chimpu Man In Rawanpur
episodesList.summary: The case of Chatri Chor continues and Chautala comes across a sketch of Chimpu Man so she urgently calls the cartoonist who has designed Chimpu Man. Chautala doubts on the contractor who is repairing Imaan Chowki's roof. How will Chautala find out the truth about Chimpu Man?

episodesList.title: Diamond Trader Jamnadas is Missing
episodesList.summary: Chautala warns contractor Mishra to wind up Imaan Chowki's work within 24 hours. Chautala recollects a 20 year old case of a diamond trader Jamnadas who is missing and so are  his diamonds. Chautala has a plan to crack the code of Chatri Chor.

episodesList.title: Chautala Gets to Know About Chatri Lover
episodesList.summary: Chautala gets to know about a mental patient who is in search of an Umbrella. Chautala has almost cracked the code of Umbrella's broken handles. Why is this mental patient stealing umbrellas of innocent people and breaking handles?

episodesList.title: New Female Constable In Imaan Chowki
episodesList.summary: Billu is surprised to see a new Female Constable Meena Ganpat Rao Godbole in Imaan Chowki. Senior Inspector Bajrang Pandey firmly decides to express his feelings to Chautala. Will Bajrang propose to Chautala?

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi Chali Nepal
episodesList.summary: Commissioner's school friend Seth shares his problem with Chautala in Imaan Chowki and also requests her to bring her daughter back to Chitputiya Ganj from Kathmandu for marriage. Will Chautala succeed in finding Seth's Daughter?

episodesList.title: Secret Of Koma Thapa
episodesList.summary: A Boy and a Girl are keeping an eye on Chautala in Imaan Chowki and also inform their Boss in Nepal about Koma Thapa. Sr. Inspector Bajrang is eagerly waiting for the 5th day as he has to say those three magical words to Chautala. Who is Koma Thapa? Whats is the secret of Koma Thapa?

episodesList.title: Bhanu Mishra's Master Plan
episodesList.summary: Bhanu Mishra and her partner come up with an interesting plan to find out the truth about Chautala and Koma Thapa. Gopi and Billu are shocked to see a female vegetable seller in the Market. Will Chautala come to know about Koma Thapa?

episodesList.title: Koma Thapa Gets Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Chautala gets kidnapped from the Hospital by Bhanu Mishra and her partner. Chautala reaches Nepal and also gets to know the secret about dairy and Koma Thapa. What is the secret hidden in the dairy?

episodesList.title: Daily Soap
episodesList.summary: Producer and Director of a popular daily soap serial file a missing complaint of their two heroines who have mysteriously gone missing. Chautala decides to find out the truth. To know Chautala, Billu, Bajrang and Gopi's master plan?.

episodesList.title: Chautala's Unforgettable Daily Soap Scene
episodesList.summary: Chautala has become a lead star of a popular daily soap serial and also mesmerizes the crew and her co-actors with her stunning performance. Director and Producer rush to Imaan Chowki to file a missing complaint of yet another member from their team. Who is she? Will Chautala find out the truth?

episodesList.title: Chautala Doubts On Daily Soap's Hero
episodesList.summary: Chautala comes up with an interesting plan and casts Billu as a woman in her ongoing serial. Chautala expresses her doubt on the lady who is playing the role of mother-in-law and on the hero of the serial as well. How come members of the crew are going missing?

episodesList.title: Mother In Law Vanishes From The Set
episodesList.summary: Chautala is shocked as she gets to know about the third person vanishing from the set of a daily soap serial. Chautala expresses her doubt on the cameraman. Is he involved in daily soap case? To know more about Chautala's strategy, watch this hilarious episode.

episodesList.title: New Hero In Daily Soap
episodesList.summary: After two people missing from daily soap set, Producer and Director reveal to Chautala in Imaan Chowki that now their Hero is also missing. Chautala gets to know a shocking truth about the Hero. Daily Soap people have found a new Hero. Will Bajrang be able to express his feelings

episodesList.title: Gopi and Chautala Get Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Instead of Chautala, Gopi gets kidnapped from Daily Soap set. A frustrated Bengali Director is torturing all those people who have vanished from the set and is forcing them to obey his orders. Chautala too gets kidnapped. How will Chautala solve the case of Daily soap serial?

episodesList.title: Jhapad Yoga
episodesList.summary: Kaushalya from Kanpur reveals to Chautala that she is having a doubt on her husband Mr. Singada of having an affair. Chautala gets to know about a Baba and his unique exercise Jhapad Yoga. To know more about Chautala's master plan and Jhapad Yoga., watch this highly amusing episode of F.I.R.

episodesList.title: Peru Kho Gaya
episodesList.summary: Musibat Mishra and her Husband lodge a police complaint against their neighbour Premika who not only calls Mr. Mishra a dog but also treats him like a dog in the society. Shayar Premika reveals the truth about Peru. Where is Peru? Who is Peru?

episodesList.title: Chautala, Gopi and Billu's Unique Case
episodesList.summary: For the first time ever in the history of F.I.R., Chautala, Gopi, Billu and Bajrang solve the case in front of an audience. A Couple files a Police complaint against a Doctor who forgot to remove the cell phone from his stomach. Chautala comes up with an interesting plan of Preeto in Imaan Chowki.

episodesList.title: Bajrang's Code Word
episodesList.summary: Mulayam Singh Gulgule who has created a record of getting slapped by Chautala returns to Imaan Chowki. Members present in Imaan Chowki get scared as Senior Inspector Bajrang reveals his new code word. A Bride and Groom's Family arrive in police station with their unique problem. Chautala conducts marriage in Imaan Chowki. Will Billu find his Bride?

episodesList.title: Billu Becomes Doctor
episodesList.summary: Billu has fallen in love with a doctor's daughter and has told her that he is a doctor too. He convinces Chautala to transform Imaan Chowki into a Nursing Home. But when Daughter and he father come, Billu's plan doesn't work. Later a couple comes to chowky with a complaint against a thug Tutu Tamaatar who  teases women in their area. She gets the thug to the chowky and challenges him with an arm fight. She wins and puts Tutu Tamaatar in jail.

episodesList.title: Shayar-e-mehfil In Imaan Chowki
episodesList.summary: Chautala's best friend reveals to her that it is becoming extremely difficult to convince her boyfriend Geet's family for marriage. She helps her with her marriage problem. Later, a couple lodges a complaint against a travel agency. They had asked travel agent to book for 5 days stay in hotel and they booked for day time only and he and his wife had to sleep on the road during the night. Chautala helps him get a compensation trip from the Agency and the case is solved.

episodesList.title: Likhit Lakhotiya's Bhadku Tonic
episodesList.summary: Likhit's wife rushes to Chowky to file a police complaint against her Husband as she observes a sudden change in her husband's behaviour. Likhit Lakhotiya reveals to Chautala about Hakim Saab's Bhadku Tonic. To know more about Chautala's unique plan, watch this hilarious episode.

episodesList.title: Shocking Shock to Gopi
episodesList.summary: Gopi gets a huge shock after listening something on the phone call. Chautala, Billu and Gulgule are shocked to see Gopi in this state. What has happened to Gopi? What did he hear on the phone call? Watch out for more. Don't miss your favourite hilarious show.

episodesList.title: Kissa Tabeez Ka
episodesList.summary: Gopi and billu find a way to reduce Chautala's anger. They meet a baba who claims that if Gopi and Billu buy a locket from him and wear, she will never get angry at them. Gopi and Billu buy the locket and to their surprise every time she is about to get angry they show the locket and she gets pacified.What is the secret of the locket?

episodesList.title: Dulhaniya Ki Problem
episodesList.summary: A man comes and complains about his wife Dulhania who never smiles and neither allows him to smile because of which his life has become hell. Now Chautala and her whole team come together to find a unique solution to solve Dulhaniya's case.

episodesList.title: Chautala Ka Beta
episodesList.summary: Senior Inspector Bajrang Pandey is extremely happy as he has successfully managed to make a fool of Gopi and Billu but this apparently does not go down too well with Chautala and she comes up with an interesting plan to teach a lesson to Bajrang. Gopi, Billu and Bajrang are shocked to meet Chautala's son.

episodesList.title: Gopi Celebrates Raksha Bandhan
episodesList.summary: An emotional moment takes place between Gopi and Billu as they celebrate the auspicious occasion of Raksha Bandhan. Parents arrive in the Chowky to solve their Daughter's marriage problem. Mother and father both have selected two different grooms for their daughter. How will Chautala solve Sunita's problem? Will Sunita marry Ramesh Goyal or Ramesh Gupta?

episodesList.title: Gopi's Close Friend Satvinder
episodesList.summary: Gopi's plan to get a holiday by lying to meet his close friend Satvinder flops as Chautala makes Gopi confess that he does not have any such friend. Bajrang is hit accidently by Gopi on his head and suffers from temporary amnesia. Chautala revives his memory. Later a colony watchman comes with a person named Sharma. He files a complaint against Sharma for beating him every morning. Later Chautala finds out from Sharma the reason behind the beating.

episodesList.title: Bajrang Ki Mamiji
episodesList.summary: Bajrang requests Chautala to cool down as his Mami is arriving from his village to check Bajrang's post  as someone has spread a rumour that he is a Constable. Gopi and Billu, like always, are again late in office. How will Bajrang stop Chautala from getting angry?

episodesList.title: Pyaar Ka Popcorn
episodesList.summary: Sanju and his Wife Simi lodge a police complaint against Seema and also share their problem. Simi tells Chandramukhi that her husband is shocked after watching a romantic movie Pyaar Ka Popcorn. Will the owner of the DVD shop Babloo land in deep trouble? What is their secret?

episodesList.title: Deewana Becomes a Huge Pain For Cinema Owner
episodesList.summary: Cinema owner lodges a police complaint against Deewana who started destroying his cinema. Deewana is extremely fond of suspense movies. Deewana reveals to Chautala that he stopped the screening of the movie when the suspense was about to be revealed. How will Chautala solve the case?

episodesList.title: Secret Of Expensive Painting
episodesList.summary: The most expensive painting gets sold for Rs. 4 Crore. Manager of Tasveer Tanatan Exhibition reveals to Chautala that her face is similar to the girl which appears in the most expensive painting. The painting is painted by Manhoos Manchanda. What is the secret of the most expensive painting? Who is the thief?

episodesList.title: Bunty Bhaiyya's Master Plan
episodesList.summary: Pushpa files a police complaint against her husband Anand Amarpremi's younger brother Bunty. Bunty made Anand Aamarpremi sign on all the property papers without informing Pushpa. Will Bunty land in deep trouble? Why did Bunty fool Anand Aamarpremi?

episodesList.title: Tunnu Tandon Ki Bike
episodesList.summary: Coach Tunnu Tandon files a police complaint against his mechanic for destroying his bike. Mechanic reveals to Chautala that he found sugar in the petrol and he didn't destroy his bike. Chautala reveals her plan to Mechanic and Tunnu. Tunnu's students get caught and reveals a shocking truth. Will she find the main culprit? Watch to find out.

episodesList.title: Criminal Chapadganju In Imaan Chowki
episodesList.summary: Commissioner asks Inspector Chautala to stay alert as a deadly criminal Chapadganju in on the loose. Chapadganju isn't scared of the inspector and warns her. Gopi and Billu overhear the inspector's conversation with Chapadganju when she is indirectly talking about ways to get out of jail.

episodesList.title: Mr. Tatola Ka Tota
episodesList.summary: Kangal Bank at the Chapadganju chowk gets robbed. Meanwhile, Lallan and Lalli Khatola register a FIR against their neighbour's parrot named Tatola. How will the inspector deal with the situation. Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Billu's Bucket Challenge to Gopi
episodesList.summary: A letter arrives at the station saying that every chief inspector's face will be inked in the coming days. Bajrang Pandey meets with an accident and breaks both his arms. Another letter arrives that says Bajrang's face will be inked the next day. Chakli comes to the chowky with a complain about a monkey who wants to marry her.

episodesList.title: Inspector Gora Becomes Kala
episodesList.summary: Chakli is worried about the monkey and Chautala suggests that she stay at the station till they can solve the case. Inspector finds some clues to the ink and tracks down the man who makes them. The inspector comes back to the station to a surprise.

episodesList.title: 3 Monkey Thieves In Raawanpur
episodesList.summary: Kishore and Kishori arrive at the station to register FIR against three monkeys who robbed their house. Inspector Chautala questions the manager of a circus about the monkey they had and couldn't find any leads. Mrs. Pammi Walia, wife of a scientist, informs the team that his husband has a formula that makes people beahve like animals.

episodesList.title: Gopi, Billu and Gulgule Get Caught By Monkeys
episodesList.summary: Inspector Chautala finds out that the scientist had moneky hormones stolen from him. She immediately suspects that the case has some connection with the circus. Meanwhile, Gopi, Gulguler and Billu get beaten up by the monkets while where were selling noodles. The inspector devises a plan.

episodesList.title: Billu's Plan to Trap Monkey Thieves
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi  comes across a group of monkeys and chases them away. The next day she arrests Jugnu Dresswala, who had a monkey's costume in his shop, claiming that it has something to do with the monkeys that were bothering her earlier. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Roselina Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: Tumhari Tiwari comes with a complaint that her sister Rosalina is missing since last night. She tells Chandramukhi  that her sister was having affair with Dhadkan Kumar. Chandramukhi  tries to get information from him by acting as Maria, the dancer but nothing comes out of him. Chandramukhi  gets a letter from her family that they are sending a boy's family to her with marriage in mind. She tries to show her violent streak to them, expecting them to say no. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Chautala As Maria Performs In Diamond Club
episodesList.summary: In this episode, Chandramukhi  as Maria meet the club's owner Mr. Rai. She starts working there as a singer and dancer. While performing at the club, the Hooda family who had come to see he, watches her performing and decide to do Chandramukhi  and their son's engagement. Later Chandramukhi  comes to know that Rosalina had call from her cell on her other phone which is missing now. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Bajrang Gets Suspended
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi  comes to know that Rosalina's other phone is with Dhadkan Kumar and he tells her that She was supposed to meet him on Gulmohar Road in her car and from there only she's missing. Later Chandramukhi  makes a plan with Bajrang to get rid of the Hooda family. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Chautala's Plan to Find Out Raisaheb's Intention
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi  finds out that Rosalina is with Babu Fisherman. She finds that someone had pushed her from hill top in the river. She then finds a cuff link which fisherman found in Rosalina's hand. While performing at the club, Chandramukhi  notices some evidence. What will she do next?

episodesList.title: Bajrang Reveals Commissioners Secret
episodesList.summary: In this episode, Chandramukhi  matches the cuff link to Rai's coat. She confronts him but he has proof that he was somewhere else when Rosalina was pushes from Hill top. Someone is shown putting on Rai's coat. Chandramukhi  herself plans to get rid of Hooda family. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Roselina's Shocking Statement
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi gets rid of Hooda family. She later catches a man who was shown wearing Rai's coat. In chowky, he is revealed to be Rai's twin brother who was kept hidden by his manager from him. Rosalina had heard Manager and twin talking about getting rid of Mr. Rai so they had attacked her. What will they do now?

episodesList.title: Commissioner Confesses to Clicking a Selfie With Joker
episodesList.summary: Rati comes with a complaint about her husband being beat up by a joker and joker taking selfie with him. Chandramukhi  thinks that this joker matter is really getting serious. Later Gopi sees Billu wearing the Joker mask. He suspects its Billu who is hassling people using Joker's mask. What will they do now?

episodesList.title: Inspector Chautala Sets Out to Jokergunj
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi  goes to the library to find a book on Joker's psychology. Librarian tells her that the book had come 30 years back but is not read by anyone since then. He also tells her about a place called Joker Gunj about 30 km from Rawanpur. Gopi sees Billu trying out Joker's mask. Later even Gopi is beat up by Joker and his selfie taken. What will they do now?

episodesList.title: Billu Goes Missing In Jokergunj
episodesList.summary: When Chandramukhi  reaches Joker Gunj she sees all the people dressed in joker with mobile in their hands. They come to know that whoever takes the pic in joker's attire over there, they turn into joker. They go and stay at Joker Gunj's guest house. Later in the night Billu has an encounter with the joker. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Curse On Jokergunj
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi  comes to know from a joker that the village Sarpanch was the one who had asked everyone to be a joker and he is the only person who is allowed to move out of the village. His father had tried going out of village but he never came back. Chandramukhi  searches Sarpanchs' place and finds an old man locked up over there. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Shaadi Nahin Barbaadi Dot Com
episodesList.summary: Charandas Chaurasiya and his daughter comes with a complaint against a matrimonial site. Charandas had selected one NRI boy for his daughter, named Sanjeev, who robbed all the jewellery and money from them after engagement and disappeared. title: Lakshmi
summary:
Lakshmi is a 2006–2008 Indian Tamil-language soap opera that aired on Sun TV from 24 July 2006 to 24 November 2006 and 27 November 2006 to 13 June 2008 for 500 episodes.
The show starred Meena, Vijay Adhiraj, Lakshmi Gopalaswamy, Mohan Sharma, Chetan, Saakshi Siva It was produced by Home Media, director by Sundar. K. Vijayan and R. Balaji yadav.
plot: Focusing on caste-discrimination in India, this is the story of a Brahmin Intelligence girl (Meena) who falls in love with a boy (Vijay Adhiraj) from the so-called lower caste.
tagline: Focusing on caste-discrimination in India, this is the story of a Brahmin Intelligence girl (Meena) who falls in love with a boy (Vijay Adhiraj) from the so-called lower caste.

title: Left Right Left
summary: Left Right Left is an Indian television series that aired on SAB TV. The show was directed by Anshuman Kishore Singh and produced by Tony Singh and Deeya Singh under the banner of DJ's a Creative Unit. The series' second season ended on 26 September 2008.
tagline: Left Right Left is an Indian television series that aired on SAB TV.

title: Star Singer
summary: Star Singer is an Indian music reality television competition broadcast on Asianet. The show features contestants aged 15 to 35, who compete based on their singing talent and stage presence. From Seasons 1 to 7, viewer voting was conducted via SMS, with audience votes contributing partially to contestant advancement. Starting with Season 8, voting shifted to Disney+ Hotstar, the official OTT platform of Star Network. The competition includes a panel of judges comprising prominent figures from the Malayalam music industry, who evaluate performances and assign scores throughout the contest. In 2009, a spin-off titled Star Singer Junior was introduced, focusing on younger participants.
tagline: Star Singer is an Indian music reality television competition broadcast on Asianet.

title: Penn
summary:
Penn (transl. Girl) is a 2006 Indian Tamil-language soap opera that aired Monday through Friday on Sun TV from 27 February 2006 to 24 November 2006 for 195 episodes.
The show starred Seetha, Meera Vasudevan, Delhi Ganesh, Ajay Rathnam, Viji Chandrasekhar, T. V. Varadarajan, Subhalekha Sudhakar and Dr. Sharmila. It was produced by Aniksha Productions, director by C.J. Baskar. Penn focuses on the hardships that women face in their life.
plot: The story of Ranganayaki (Seetha) a woman who heads a business empire and Deepa (Meera Vasudevan) is inducted into the family business. Ranganayaki has three kids (bharani, karthik). Kasi is Ranganayaki's driver. On her way from the temple, Ranganayaki encounters deepa jumping into the river, rescues, and admits her in the hospital.
tagline: The story of Ranganayaki (Seetha) a woman who heads a business empire and Deepa (Meera Vasudevan) is inducted into the family business.

title: Kasamh Se
summary: Kasamh Se (English title: The Promise) is an Indian soap opera produced by Ekta Kapoor for Balaji Telefilms. The show aired on Zee TV from 16 January 2006 to 12 March 2009, when the series ended due to cost issues. The story is about three sisters: Bani, Piya and Rano.
plot:
Three Dixit sisters; Bani, Pia, and Rano are different but are close to each other. They live in Mount Abu. After their father's death, the three sisters go to Mumbai to live with Jai Udai Walia, a ruthless business tycoon who knew their parents. Jai falls for Pia, but she loves Jai's employee Pushkar Shukla and is more interested in Jai's wealth. Their marriage is arranged but on the wedding day, Pia elopes with Pushkar. To save the Dixit family's honor and mostly persuaded by Jai's cunning sister Jigyasa, Bani takes Pia's place at the altar and marries Jai. Jai is initially furious, but falls for Bani as time passes. They kiss after a family function arranged by Jai's friend Roshni. Meanwhile, Jai's nephew (Jigyasa's younger son) Sahil falls for Rano and they get married.
Though Pia is married to Pushkar, after an argument with Pushkar she becomes interested in Jai's wealth and tries to steal him from Bani. Once Jai goes on a business trip, Pia follows him, spikes his drink, and sexually assaults him. This leaves Jai shaken.
On Bani and Jai's one-year anniversary, it is revealed that Pia is pregnant with Jai's child. Bani goes into trauma but later forgives them. Pia gives birth to a son, Veer, while Rano gives birth a son, Varun. Sahil is killed and Pia frames Bani for his death and blackmails Jai: he can either let Bani spend life in jail or testify that she is mentally ill and she can spend only five years in a mental hospital. Jai, who is left with no option, rules that Bani is mentally ill and she is sent to a mental hospital.
At the hospital, Bani gives birth to twins Krishna and Atharva but they are taken away by Jai. Bani escapes from the hospital and is rescued by a man named Aparajit Deb, who takes her under his wing. He takes an interest in Bani and offers her to come with him abroad so she can get away from her past. Bani agrees but promises that she will return for her children.

awards.work: Jai Udai Walia and Bani Jai Walia

tagline: Three Dixit sisters; Bani, Pia, and Rano are different but are close to each other.

title: Baa Bahoo Aur Baby
summary:
Baa Bahoo Aur Baby (colloquially known as BBB or B3; transl. Mom, daughter-in-law and Baby) is an Indian television dramedy series that aired in prime time on StarPlus between 2005 and 2010 with a total of two seasons. The series was produced by Hats Off Productions and centered around a fictitious Gujarati Thakkar family living in Parla East, Mumbai.
After the end of the first season, the second season was brought in August 2009. However, it was not well received and went off the air on 22 February 2010.

title: Saarrthi
summary:
Saarrthi is a Hindi drama television series broadcast on Star Plus and produced by Asit Kumarr Modi under Neela Tele Films Private Limited. It aired from 8 November 2004 to 15 February 2008 and contained 708 episodes. The story is a reworking of the Hindu epic, the Mahabharata, detailing the conflict between two brothers and their families in contemporary India.
The drama serial premiered on 9 November 2004 and aired Monday through Thursday. In August 2007, Saarrthi began airing on Fridays as well.
plot: The story and characters are adapted from Mahabharata which is a story of conflict between two half-brothers – Mansen and Siddhartha (Dhritarashtra and Pandu) – and their families. The lead, Bhoomika (Subhadra), and her husband Arjun (Arjuna), portray the eternal couple who try to bring peace between the warring families. Along with them is Manasvi (Draupadi) who becomes the center of a conflict between two brothers Satya (Yudhishthira) and Suraj (Karna).While the antagonists are Shifali (Bhanumati), and her husband Yuvraj (Duryodhana).

title: Sarabhai vs Sarabhai
summary: Sarabhai vs Sarabhai is an Indian Hindi-language television sitcom that aired on STAR One from 1 November 2004 to 16 April 2006 and on Disney+ Hotstar from 15 May to 17 July 2017 for two seasons in 80 episodes altogether. The show was directed by Deven Bhojani and produced by Jamnadas D. Majethia and Aatish Kapadia under the production banner of Hats Off Productions. Starring an ensemble cast of Satish Shah, Ratna Pathak Shah, Sumeet Raghavan, Rupali Ganguly, and Rajesh Kumar, the show revolves around the Sarabhais, a quintessential upper-class Gujarati family living in the upmarket neighbourhood of Cuffe Parade in South Mumbai. The family members include the matriarch, Maya; her husband, Indravadan; their two sons, Sahil and Rosesh; Sahil's wife, Monisha; Indravadan and Maya's son-in-law, Dushyant; and Indravadan's brother-in-law, Madhusudan Fufa. Regarded as being ahead of its generation in terms of its concept, writing, and average viewership ratings at the time of its initial release, the show ultimately has gone on to become a cult classic.
plot:
Sarabhai vs Sarabhai portrays the lives of the Sarabhais, a quintessential upper-class Gujarati family living in the upmarket neighbourhood of Cuffe Parade in South Mumbai. The matriarch of the family is Maya, a snobbish woman who always tries to maintain her high-society status. Her husband, Indravadan, is an indolent, insensitive and mischievous man, who enjoys teasing his wife and other family members. The couple has two sons and a daughter; Sahil, Rosesh and Sonia. Sahil is a cosmetologist and is quite calm, wise and noble as compared to other characters, while Rosesh is an aspiring poet and actor who often makes everyone cringe with his eccentric poetry and acting as well his peculiar and amusing voice. Sahil is married to Monisha, a middle-class Punjabi girl who constantly tries to fit in with her wealthy in-laws. Maya's socialite attitude and Monisha's middle-class habits always lead to conflicts and Indravadan's playful nature only increases them, while Sahil deals with his own personal and professional challenges.
Indravadan and Maya's son-in-law, Dushyant Painter, and Indravadan's brother-in-law, Madhusudan Fufa, are also part of the family. The gadget-freak Dushyant, married to Indravadan and Maya's psychic daughter, Sonia, is an electrical engineer, who has a morbid fascination for various electronic machines. He always irritates the family by explaining different theories about different gadgets and using Rosesh for each demonstration. Dushyant's catchphrase is "I'll explain!" and does not understand sarcasm which leads to humorous situations. On the other hand, the deaf Madhusudan Fufa, married to Indravadan's older sister, Ilaben, usually does not acknowledge the fact that he cannot hear and refuses to use a hearing aid. He is a former freedom fighter who repeatedly asks questions and blames others for speaking softly. Madhusudan Fufa interrupts almost always during conversations with his catchphrase "Hain?" and his misinterpretations are particularly bothersome to Indravadan.
Comedy and conflict ensue in the daily events occurring in the Sarabhais' lives and much of the mother-in-law humour in the show is derived from the shallow interactions among the city's elite and their perceived notions of the shortcomings and failings of middle-class society. The show has a cult-like status among all the Indian sitcoms.

episodesList.title: Meet the Sarabhais
episodesList.summary: Sahil Sarabhai has run away from his house and has reached at a beach in Goa, away from his bothersome family. There, he meets a novelist, Nagesh Iyer. After a brief interaction, the story moves to Mumbai, where Sahil's family is introduced. By-and-by, Sahil describes past glimpses of each member of his family, thus describing their character traits. Finally, Nagesh ends up writing a book on Sahil's life. The latter takes this as an opportunity to show his family, about his obsession towards their incorrect behaviour towards each other. The attempt fails, and the family becomes even worse. Meanwhile, the episode ends on a note that the book is a hit, and Sahil MIGHT be running away, once again.

episodesList.title: Dr Acharya to the Rescue!
episodesList.summary: Maya is preparing a cake for her birthday. Indravadan comes in and teases her. On Sahil's arrival, Indravadan immediately reminds his son that his wife's birthday falls on the same day as that of Maya. Sahil lands in a dilemma as he commits to both Monisha and Maya, but cannot have dinner with both of them at a single time, keeping in mind the rivalry between the two women. Meanwhile, as Sahil plans to take Maya for lunch, on the pretext of taking her to the doctor (Dr Acharya), Indravadan comes up with a piece of false news, stating that Dr Acharya is a killer, who has murdered three of his patients. That way, Monisha is worried and creates even more chaos by ending up at Zodiac Bistro, where Maya is having lunch with Sahil. Sahil, on the other hand, has already asked his friend to pretend to be Dr Acharya. The result is that the fake and the real doctor, who has been purposefully called on by Indravadan, both end up at the Bistro, wreaking havoc. The confusing situation is handled by Sahil, who spills the beans that how he was unable to spend time with both the women of the house. At home, an emotional resolution takes place, and the episode ends with both the couples going for dinner at Zodiac Bistro. Guest Star: Gireesh Sahdev

episodesList.title: The family gets cricket fever

When Monisha claims that she has won the bet, Maya refuses to accept it. They argue about it.

episodesList.title: Tiger Ya Tota?
episodesList.summary: The episode starts with Maya holding a party to collect fund for the poor, by drinking wine. Meanwhile, Sahil's younger sister, Soniya, predicts a woman in Sahil's life. This enrages Monisha, who investigates and catches him with Kiran a.k.a. Shama. Meanwhile, Indravadan is also having an affair with another woman. His secret phone calls make Maya suspicious of her husband. Later, both the women complain about the respective extra-marital affairs of their respective husbands. However, both fake the case, claiming that they were simply trying to show the women how a tiger might behave. The episode ends with Sahil still being flirted with by Shama, and Indravadan gets a new phone, showing that he might indeed be having an affair with another woman, whom he calls by the name Sullu.

episodesList.summary: Maya challenges Indravardhan to a Scrabble competition when he makes fun of her when she wins a competition. Indravadan trains with Sahil's help and finally wins the competition.

episodesList.title: Maya Moves in with Monisha
episodesList.summary: Maya's sister, Vidheesha is coming to Mumbai. Monisha forces her to stay in her house. Maya wants to clean Monisha's house and plots to enter her house. Indravadan hears her and asks Monisha to spoil the plan by doing pest control. Finally Maya fakes illness and moves to Monisha's house. Indravadan fakes her report to scare her. Finally Vidheesha cancels her plan and Maya moves back to her house.

episodesList.title: Rosesh is in Love!
episodesList.summary: Roshesh falls in love with a high society girl, Maggie, who likes her pet more than Rosesh. She is vegan and Rosesh decides to do as she says. Maya is upset and then scolds him. Rosesh fights and leaves the house. Finally they broke up due to some issues with the pets and Rosesh returns home.

episodesList.title: Tit for Tat, Indu
episodesList.summary: Maya and Sahil play a prank on Indravardhan. Sahil helps Indravadan to prepare a drink and it is served to Dinesh who visits them for a chess match. Dinesh drops dead and everyone blames Indravadan for it. Ila Behen, Madhu Phoopha and Sarita arrive, they try to hide the fact that Dinesh is dead. When everything fails, Indravadan gets very tensed and Maya tells him that it was just a prank.

episodesList.title: Indu's new friend, Cookie Sharma
episodesList.summary: Maya treats Indravadan like a child and belittles his attempts to be romantic. While jogging, he meets actress Cookie Sharma. He is attracted to her and invites her to lunch. He tells Sahil that he is falling in love with Cookie. Sahil asks him to speak to Cookie. Indravadan discovers that Cookie sees him as her father. Heart-broken he comes home. Meanwhile Maya discovers hidden cookies at home and is upset with Indravadan. When he comes home, she asks him about Cookie, but he thinks she has found out about Cookie. Finally Indravadan realises that she is talking about Cookie and tell her that he needs some romance in their life. She agrees. ---- Guest Star: Mandira Bedi

episodesList.title: Sonia's Vision Cause Chaos
episodesList.summary: Soniya makes a prediction about a woman's death with name starting with 'M' by 6:00 pm. The person will associated with glass and something black. Both Maya and Monisha are terrified.

episodesList.title: Rosesh gets Psychoanalysed
episodesList.summary: Rosesh has insomnia and it drives all the others crazy.

episodesList.title: Maya and Monisha wager a bet
episodesList.summary: Maya makes a bet with Monisha that men can't remember important dates. Then Maya sets to prove it.

episodesList.title: Sahil's New Car
episodesList.summary: Sahil buys a brand new Coyote car and Monisha and Maya fight to drive it first. On Indravadan's suggestion, Monisha takes out the car without telling Sahil and does an accident. Maya wanting to drive first cooks up a story about a sick child to drive the car. Rosesh while practicing for a beggar's role drops his lotta on the car. For the damage done by Monisha, Sahil blames Rosesh. Monisha confesses and Sahil forgives her.

episodesList.title: Indravadan on a Health Spree
episodesList.summary: Indravadan has borderline cholesterol problem and it is up to Maya to make him lose his flab and cholesterol. Maya forces him to exercise and Indravadan tries to get out of it. Finally he decides to work-out and becomes a health freak.

episodesList.title: How Sahil met Monisha
episodesList.summary: Maya explains to Dushyant how Sahil and Monisha met and how they fell in love and married. Sahil meets Monisha when asks for a lift. Then they become friends. But Maya arranges for Sahil's marriage with Sarita's daughter Priya.

episodesList.title: Sahil and Monisha getting Married
episodesList.summary: Monisha is also engaged to a vet. Later she realizes her feelings for Sahil and their marriage gets fixed.

episodesList.title: Who is Dinky?
episodesList.summary: Monisha finds Sahil's diary and discovers an affair. Sahil convinces her that he is innocent. ---- Guest star : Manini Mishra

episodesList.title: Séance to connect to Baa
episodesList.summary: The building's lease papers are missing, so the building is about to be demolished. Soniya and her friend bring Ba's spirit in Monisha's body to find the papers.

episodesList.title: Baa Possesses Monisha
episodesList.summary: Sahil discovers that the whole spirit thing is a prank by Indravardhan and Monisha. He then decides to play a prank on them.

episodesList.title: Khichdi with Sarabhai – Part 1
episodesList.summary: Indravadan to invite Jayashree to his house for celebration of the International Family Week. He decides to invite Maya’s cousins also. ---- Crossover: Khichdi

episodesList.title: Khichdi with Sarabhai – Part 2
episodesList.summary: Indravadan to invite Jayashree to his house for celebration of the International Family Week. He decides to invite Maya’s cousins also. ---- Crossover: Khichdi

episodesList.title: Rosesh's Poetry Publication
episodesList.summary: Rosesh publishes a book of 110 poetries, Sahil and others criticize him. At last Sahil realises his mistake and motivates Rosesh to improve his poetry talent.

episodesList.title: Maya Hosts Baldev Singh
episodesList.summary: Maya invites Swaroopa and her husband Baldev Singh to her house for a party and ends up taking care of their spoilt doggy Dipender for a day.

episodesList.title: Rosesh-Indu fight over a Girl
episodesList.summary: Indravardhan and Rosesh decide to become friends.

episodesList.title: Sarabhais and Sunehri
episodesList.summary: Maya reluctantly agrees help a destitute girl as a maid to her house. She robs them. ---- Guest star : Mallika Sherawat

episodesList.title: Dushyant and his unhelpfulness
episodesList.summary: Maya's mobile is defunct and flashbacks to the time when he repaired the fridge to convince Monisha why she should not tell Dushyant about it.

episodesList.title: Nilima and Sahil
episodesList.summary: Sahil and Monisha fight due to lack of Sahil's interest in Monisha. The reason for his inattentiveness is a crazy patient, Neelima Verma.

episodesList.title: Maya and her maids
episodesList.summary: Maya scolds her servants and they leave. The replacement smells and steals. Radhabai and Vittal also have troubles with alternate employment. Maya misses her old servants and hires them back.

episodesList.title: Sudhanshu paints Maya
episodesList.summary: Tired of playing mother and housekeeper, Maya decides to go out and when she returns, she has invited an upcoming artist, Sudhanshu, to her house, whose exhibition she went to see. ---- Guest Star : Parvin Dabas

episodesList.title: Maya and Sudhanshu
episodesList.summary: Maya is ready to leave the house with Sudhanshu, but Sudhanshu is doubtful if she can leave Indravadan. ---- Guest Star : Parvin Dabas

episodesList.title: Maya and Rationalism
episodesList.summary: Maya has bet with Indravadan that she can make fool of Sahil.Which results in Monisha threatening to leave the house but Sahil not stopping her to.

episodesList.title: Monisha's speech on Maya
episodesList.summary: The society is celebrating daughter-in-law day and Baldev proposes that Monisha should speak about her mother-in-law. Maya gets anxious about her speech.

episodesList.title: Sahil and Monisha to move to Delhi
episodesList.summary: Sahil and Monisha plan to shift to Delhi. Maya is scared that Sahil will become middle-class so she tries to stop them.

episodesList.title: Rosesh in a movie, Naya Don
episodesList.summary: Sahil is jealous of Rosesh when he gets a film offer. He is also upset because no one cares that he is being awarded for his sunscreen lotion.

episodesList.title: Monisha and Sahil's unromantic life
episodesList.summary: Monisha complains that Sahil is not romantic to her and their intimacy is lost. Maya decides to intervene and help. Sahil listens to a famous romantic poem by Anamika Thapar which boosts his hormones. Finally, Monisha and Sahil make love.

episodesList.title: Indravadan offends Dr. Siddharth
episodesList.summary: Indravadan makes fun of a famous hypnotist invited by Maya and in return the hypnotist hypnotises Indravadan to become Maya hilarious consequences follow. ---- Guest star : Makrand Deshpande

episodesList.title: Indravadan in a Hypnotized state
episodesList.summary: Indravadan is finally out of hypnotism. He makes fun again, so the hypnotist makes him Rosesh. ---- Guest star : Makrand Deshpande

episodesList.title: Maya, Monisha and Antakshari
episodesList.summary: Maya and Monisha play Antakshari as a challenge. Their friends help them. ---- Guest star : Roop Kumar Rathod and Sonali Rathod

episodesList.title: Baldev and Sarupa's marital problems
episodesList.summary: Sarupa wants a divorce and Baldev does not. They come to Sarabhais for help.

episodesList.title: Rosesh is kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Rosesh is kidnapped for ransom and Indravardhan decides to bargain. When Rosesh finds out, he refuses to come home.

episodesList.title: Monisha, the Millionaire
episodesList.summary: Monisha's uncle Jaspal dies leaving behind expensive paintings and antiques for Monisha. Maya is outraged and tells Monisha to make use of the money by giving it to charity and not wasting it on discount sales. So they have a bet. If Monisha donates all the money and paintings she got from her uncle, Maya will donate 5 lakhs.

episodesList.title: Indravadan writes a play
episodesList.summary: Indravadan writes a play to show Maya that he can do something constructive. The actors goof up and the audience just laugh at them.

episodesList.title: Indravadan's 55th Birthday
episodesList.summary: As a birthday wish Maya gives Indravadan his bachelorhood. Sahil, Rosesh and Indravadan shift to Sahil's flat. Maya and Monisha stay in Indravadan's flat. The wish becomes disastrous when everything goes wrong.

episodesList.title: Helping Sharman Kapadia
episodesList.summary: Sharman, Sahil's cousin causes his friend's dad to have a heart attack three days before his wedding. When the police look for him, he decides to hide at Indravadan's house.

episodesList.title: Rosesh's Fake Marriage
episodesList.summary: To escape an arrange marriage with Ajanta (Sarita's niece), Rosesh confesses to Maya that he has a wife, Rita and a son, Daksesh.Maya is horrified by the news but afterwards she gets to know that it is a lie and proposes that Rita and Rosesh should get married officially.

episodesList.title: How Indravadan met Maya
episodesList.summary: The story of how Maya and Indravadan met in a party and fell in love.

episodesList.title: Maya, Monisha and Local Elections
episodesList.summary: To save her new pet, a goldfish, Monisha decides to stand against Maya in the society's general election. Sahil, on the other hand, is going out so he can avoid the elections. The results declared are that it is a tie but then Sahil comes and votes for Maya. Monisha is not disturbed because one night before the elections she gave her fish some Paneer and it died.

episodesList.title: Rosesh tries to get adopted
episodesList.summary: Rosesh discovers that Maya wanted to abort her 3rd child (Rosesh). So he decides to advertise for new parents.

episodesList.title: Monisha's date with Patang Kumar
episodesList.summary: Monisha wins a contest and TV actor Patang visits her home. Sahil is jealous because Monisha is smitten and Patang flirts with her. ---- Guest star : Aamir Ali

episodesList.title: Indu-Rosesh's Poetry War
episodesList.summary: Rosesh challenges Indravardhan to a poetry competition.

episodesList.title: Monisha dreams of Maya
episodesList.summary: Maya loses her memory and becomes middle-class. Monisha loves it.

episodesList.title: Rosesh causes an accident
episodesList.summary: Rosesh hits a man and runs. Some social activists demand his arrest.

episodesList.title: Indravadan apologises to Sahil
episodesList.summary: Indravadan makes fun of Sahil publicly and they have a fallout.

episodesList.title: Indravadan Ousted from his home
episodesList.summary: Tired of Indravadan's childish activities, Maya throws him out of the house.

episodesList.title: Nayesha and Jugal's wedding
episodesList.summary: Maya's sister Nayesha and Monisha's cousin Jugalkishore visit. They fall in love.

episodesList.title: Indravadan–Rosesh wager a Bet
episodesList.summary: Indravadan tries to prove to Rosesh that women are always suspicious.

episodesList.title: Rosesh in love with Youyou
episodesList.summary: Rosesh falls in love with Youyou Khilawala. But Maya hates her mother. So he leaves the house to get married.

episodesList.title: Rosesh returns home
episodesList.summary: Rosesh breaks up with Youyou and returns. Maya tries to find him a bride.

episodesList.title: Kissme at the Sarabhais
episodesList.summary: Madhubhai's niece Kissme comes to live with Maya and Indravadan. Rosesh gets very friendly with her.

episodesList.title: Yamraj comes for Indravadan
episodesList.summary: Indravadan is visited by Yamraj. Maya begs and tries to save his life. This is later revealed to be a prank staged by Ramesh Shirke, from Rosesh’s theatre company, as a surprise for their wedding anniversary.

episodesList.title: Treasure Hunt Time
episodesList.summary: Sahil is invited by cricketer Vishal Guha for a party with a partner. Maya and Monisha fight to accompany him

episodesList.title: Monisha becomes sophisticated
episodesList.summary: On Maya's insistence, Monisha becomes sophisticated

episodesList.title: Monisha threatens suicide
episodesList.summary: Monisha decides to commit suicide. Maya celebrates.

episodesList.title: The Midas Chant's Magic
episodesList.summary: Dushyant gives Sahil an African Chant to recite. After that everything, Sahil wishes happens. ---- Guest Star : Parmeet Sethi

episodesList.title: Brides for Rosesh
episodesList.summary: A psychic predicts that Rosesh should marry within a month or he will have to wait for 51 years. Rosesh freaks out

episodesList.title: Crystal Ball Time
episodesList.summary: Another psychic show the Sarabhais their future in a crystal ball. All comes out to be good till they receive a shock for their future in the following 7 years. ---- Guest Star : Rohitash Gaud and Siddhartha Jadhav

episodesList.title: Monisha Ki Mannat – 1
episodesList.summary: The Sarabhais are stuck in a bus on the edge of a cliff. In the flashback, on Sonya's tarot card reading, Monisha explains that she has vowed to pay visit to the shrine of Matkadharbaba for the marriage of Rosesh. Before boarding the bus, Rosesh meets his love-at-first-sight Jasmine.

episodesList.title: Monisha Ki Mannat – 2
episodesList.summary: Monisha gets Arnab out of the bus through window and he brings some villagers. They help them get out of the bus. Later Rosesh gets stuck on a bridge but Sahil saves him. Sarabhais visit the shrine of Matkadharbaba and fulfills the vow.

episodesList.title: Rosesh Gets Married
episodesList.summary: Rosesh decides to marry Jasmine without consent of Maya. Maya disapproves their marriage and tried to stop it with fake prophecy by Sonia. Jasmine announces pregnancy.

episodesList.title: Papa don't preach, says Sahil
episodesList.summary: Arnab's teacher complains that Arnab brings mobile in school. Sahil blames Indravadan from spoiling Arnab. Sahil and Indravadan starts to argue.

episodesList.title: Indu's antics
episodesList.summary: Sahil insults Indravadan for being reckless and unsuccessful. Everyone motivates Indravadan to open an antic shop. Arnab asks Sahil to apologize to Indravadan.

episodesList.title: Man of the hour, Kachcha Kela
episodesList.summary: No one purchase anything from Indu Antic shop. Dushyant who is later joined by Monisha and Jasmine, accuses Kachcha Kela for robbing something but is proved wrong. Sahil gets happy as the first day of the shop goes flop. ---- Guest Star: Aatish Kapadia

episodesList.title: Jasmine, Maya locks horn
episodesList.summary: Maya asks everyone to write their true feelings on paper chits on the World Honesty Day. Everyone's printed chits are put in the Bowl.

episodesList.title: Maya vs Sahil
episodesList.summary: There are very bad comments for Maya written on the chits. Maya finds out it was Sahil as the chits were printed from his tablet. However, Maya finds out that it was Rosesh who had written about Maya. ---- Guest Star: Aatish Kapadia

episodesList.title: Bahu Machhar Beta Khachhar
episodesList.summary: Rosesh and Jasmine do a drama serial. The director insults Rosesh and Jasmine feels bad and quit the serial with Rosesh. Maya and Rosesh shoot an advertisement with Prahlad but Prahlad doesn't like Rosesh's acting. ---- Guest Star: Jamnadas Majethia and Vishal Gandhi

episodesList.title: Monisha–Sahil, Divorced?
episodesList.summary: Monisha and Maya goes to Arnab sports day and he gets misplaced. Monisha says that if Arnab will come home, she will leave Sahil forever. After Arnab gets home back, Monisha take Arnab with him and goes to her village, leaving Divorce papers for Sahil.

tagline: Sarabhai vs Sarabhai portrays the lives of the Sarabhais, a quintessential upper-class Gujarati family living in the upmarket neighbourhood of Cuffe Parade in South Mumbai.

title: Indian Idol
summary:
Indian Idol is an Indian Hindi-language singing reality competition on Sony TV. It is an Indian version of the British show Pop Idol  and is part of the Indian Idol series. It has aired on Sony Entertainment Television since 2004.  Originally produced by Miditech Studios and its iconic producer-brothers, Niret Alva, Nikhil J Alva and Nivedith Alva, the series was an instant success. The brothers produced the first 5 seasons of the series and were instrumental in laying the foundation for its future success.
Indian Idol's production and taping take place in Mumbai, Maharashtra. It broadcasts on Saturdays and Sundays and digitally airs on SonyLIV application.

title: Home Minister
summary: Home Minister is an Indian Marathi reality game show which aired on Zee Marathi. It began airing on 13 September 2004. It is Zee Marathi's first longest-running Indian television show in Marathi language.

articleSections.title: Concept
articleSections.text: The format of the show consists of the host Aadesh Bandekar, visiting the homes of women in different cities of Maharashtra and playing various games with them. He is affectionately called "Bhauji" which translates to Brother-in-law. The show also has a segment where Aadesh Bandekar chat with the women and their families. At the end of every episode, the winner of the games receives Paithani saree from him.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text:
Jitendra Joshi was replaced as the show's regular anchor in 2009 while Aadesh was contesting for the Maharashtra State Assembly election. He hosted the season Navvadhu No.1. In 2011, Nilesh Sable replaced Jitendra in 2011 and hosted the season Jaubai Jorat.
The series again premiered on 14 January 2011 replacing Sade Made Teen. The show stopped airing temporarily on 1 May 2010 with a total of 1616 episodes due to the Maharashtra State Election and it started again with new season.

title: Kadamattathu Kathanar
summary: Kadamattathu Kathanar is an Indian Malayalam-language supernatural drama television series that originally aired on Asianet from 2004 to 2005. The series was rebroadcast on Asianet Plus beginning in March 2016. Prakash Paul portrayed the title character of Kathanar.
plot:
Kadamattathu Kathanar, also known as Kadamattathachan ("Father of Kadamattom"), was a legendary 9th-century Oriental Syriac priest of the Kadamattom Church, one of the oldest surviving churches in Kerala associated with the Saint Thomas Christians. He is traditionally believed to have possessed supernatural powers.
Although said to have learned sorcery from a mysterious source, Kathanar was believed to perform most of his feats through divine power, invoking the Holy Spirit through prayer, which made him invulnerable to other sorcerers.
The series portrays his exorcisms of ghosts and evil spirits, including the well-known legend of Kalliyankattu Neeli, a vampiric Yakshi that haunted a Kerala family who sought Kathanar’s help.
