title: Anandham
summary:
Anandham is a Tamil soap opera that aired on Sun TV. It is a prime time serial. The show premiered on 24 November 2003, airing Monday through Friday. The show stars Sukanya, Brinda Das, Delhi Kumar and Kamalesh. The show is produced by Sathya Jyothi Films director by T. G. Thyagarajan.
It was also aired in Sri Lanka Tamil Channel on Shakthi TV. The show last aired on 27 February 2009 and ended with 1,297 episodes.
plot:
Anandham is a family drama with elements of business rivalry, romance, murders, and other intrigues typical of Tamil soaps interwoven into it. However, unlike the stereotypical Tamil tear-jerker, Anandham depicts successful, independent-minded women rather than women battered by husbands and mothers-in-law. The patriarch of the family – Radhakrishnan or RK – is an eminent industrialist whose blissful existence is threatened by a series of events involving his four children. Much of the first part of the serial revolved around two of RK's daughters-in-law. Shanthi, a widow with a child and married to RK's second son, Karthik, is the quintessential do-gooder in the serial but much of her early days were consumed by her struggle for acceptance within the family.
Shanthi's tribulations were multiplied by the other daughter-in-law in the family, Abhirami, who had hoped that Karthik would marry her younger sister. (Actress Brinda Das, who plays Abirami, turns in a superb performance as the arch-villain). Abhirami had married into the RK family primarily to seek revenge on behalf of her late father, who had led her to believe that he had been wronged by RK in business. Soon, Abhirami began to wreak havoc on the RK family, stripping it of its family home and wealth. The tragedy of losing his family home sent RK into an ashram, where his character began to mellow. Subsequently, he reconciled with Shanthi and later accepted the remarriage of Madhan, who worked up the courage to dissolve his enforced marriage to Abhirami and return to his first love, Rohini.
A little more than a year into the serial, Abhirami, increasingly estranged from her more righteous brother and sister, discovered that she was an adopted child. A good part of the serial since that discovery involved Abhirami and her real parents trying to determine the identity of one another. Abhirami's real parents were separated from the time she was a baby. Her mother, Muthulakshmi, had left her father, the shady businessman Shankarapandian, after discovering that he had murdered someone for business gain. Muthulakshmi lost her child while trying to save herself from pursuers sent by her husband and subsequently moved to Malaysia. She has now returned in a new avatar as the business magnate Charulatha. A year on, Abhirami has reunited with her father. But her mother, who has long been yearning to be reunited with her daughter, now steadfastly refuses to accept a devious daughter.
In the latest phase of the serial, which has since been extended beyond its originally scheduled end date, the focus is again on the gathering storm in the lives of the RK family. Madhan cannot come to terms with the fact that his wife Rohini chose to pursue her ambition of becoming a bank manager and accepting a transfer to Tirupathi while his mother was lying comatose. Rohini's inability to return to Chennai in time for her mother-in-law's funeral added further distance between husband and wife. Rohini has since relocated back to Chennai, fearing Shankarapandian's efforts to reunite his daughter Abhirami with her former husband.
Meanwhile, two new characters have been introduced, Manisha, the former girlfriend of Karthik while he was on army duty in Kashmir, and Rocky, their son born out of wedlock and now living in an orphanage in Chennai and closely cared for by his aunt, Karthik's sister Anitha. As in every long-running serial, there are many sub-plots and supporting characters in this serial. But the sub-plot that stands out the most and led to a spike in the serial's popularity ratings involves a romance revolving around the character of Assistant Commissioner Durai, popularly known as A C Durai by the huge fan following that the hunk Saakshi Sivaa has garnered through the role. Durai is a conscientious police officer whose blind devotion to duty cost him the affections of his girlfriend Priya, who was subsequently adopted by the RK household, allowing for the seamless switch from the main story to the sub-plot. After about half a year of estrangement, the couple reunited and were set to tie the knot when jealousy set in—Priya misinterpreted Durai's relationship with an undercover police officer, Jamuna, masquerading as Shankarapandian's long-lost daughter. Durai then decided to put the marriage in abeyance until Priya gained sufficient trust in him. In the latest twist in the romance, Priya tries to demonstrate her maturity through self-sacrifice. She tries to persuade Durai to marry Jamuna, whose husband-to-be was killed by a vengeful Shankarapandian on the day of their intended marriage.

title: Kolangal
summary:
Kolangal (transl.  The Patterns) is an Indian Tamil-language soap opera. It aired on Sun TV from 24 November 2003 to 4 December 2009 for 1,533 episodes.
It starred Devayani in the lead role along with Deepa Venkat, V. Thiruselvam, Ajay Kapoor. Other cast included Mohan Sharma, Sathyapriya, Abhishek Shankar, Subhalekha Sudhakar, Nalini, Vanitha Krishnachandran, Srividya Mohan, Manjari Vinodhini, Kuyili, Bombay Gnanam, Dwarakish Giri, Auditor Sridhar, Joker Thulasi, Bharathi, Bharathi Neelima Rani, Devadarshini, Priyadarshini and Dhivyadharshini. It was remade in Hindi as Maayke Se Bandhi Dor, which aired on StarPlus.The show was retelecasted at the same channel from February 9, 2026, at 10:30 AM.
plot:
The story mainly revolves abound Abi and her life which changes due to the people around her. Abi is a hard-working, ambitious woman with strong beliefs, and Aditya is her business rival and half brother. Abi with her mother, Karpagam, maternal uncle, two sisters, Anandhi and Aarthi, and brother, Manohar, leads a healthy life though she tries to keep herself happy because she has had a dark past.
Her father had abandoned her family and married another woman, Kanchana, the mother of Aditya, and has settled as a business tycoon. Abi initially marries Bhaskar but the relationship becomes abusive. Her mother-in-law, Alamelu tortures her constantly. Eventually, Aadhi lures all Abi's close family members and turns all her family members against her.
Abi divorces her husband and starts a new life. She starts a new company but is given competition by her stepbrother Aditya Eeswaramoorthy whom he considers as her as sworn rival. Abi escapes from her brother's tortures and puts an end to his injustice.
In the last scene, Abi with the help of her good friend Tholkappiyan leads a peaceful and hermit life. Abi starts to help an orphanage, thereby ending what she couldn't do to help herself, and wishes to be dear among the orphans even though they are not known to them. She leads a victorious life with the help of 2 friends, Tholkappiyan (Thols) and Usha, Aadhi's wife.

title: Kahiin to Hoga
summary: Kahiin To Hoga (transl. Will be Somewhere) is an Indian soap opera which aired on StarPlus from September 2003 to February 2007. The show was created by Ekta Kapoor of Balaji Telefilms and starred Aamna Sharif, Rajeev Khandelwal and Gurpreet Singh. The show is based on the 1813 novel Pride and Prejudice by Jane Austen.
plot:
Kashish, Mahek, Mouli, Kanan and Charu are five sisters living in Shimla. Their father, Prof. Sinha, is an idealistic college teacher. One day, Kashish accidentally hits a car belonging to Sujal Garewal, a rich, young businessman. Later, she goes for a job interview to his office. She assumes that she will not get the job, but Sujal hires her. Sujal works for a business enterprise started by his father, Chetan Garewal, in partnership with close friend/brother-figure Lalit Raheja. The Raheja and Garewal families live in the same house. Sujal's best friend is Lalit's son, Piyush. Sujal has a spoilt and arrogant younger brother, Rishi, who flirts with both Mouli and Mahek. Piyush's younger brother, Varun, secretly loves Mahek.
Kashish and Sujal eventually fall in love with each other as they grow even closer since seeing each other daily at work. She writes a love letter to him and leaves it on his desk. Rishi, who dislikes Kashish, sees the letter and deliberately puts Piyush's name on it. When Piyush sees the letter, he thinks that Kashish likes him and begins to feel the same way for her. Lalit and Prof. Sinha decide to get Piyush and Kashish married. Meanwhile, Sujal and Kashish verbally profess their love for each other. Kashish assumes she is about to get engaged to Sujal. On the day of the engagement, Kashish is shocked to see Piyush as her fiancé. But she decides to stay quiet to prevent humiliation for her family. However, Sujal sees the letter with Piyush's name on it and thinks that Kashish is cheating on him. He cuts all ties with her and is heartbroken. Amidst all this, Mahek gets pregnant with Rishi’s child unbeknownst to everyone. The families plan their engagement but in a sudden turn of events, the Sinha family are embarrassed as the pregnancy truth come to light. Rishi despises a plan to break the engagement as he only used Mahek. Mahek is thrown out the house by Prof Sinha and he cuts all ties with her. Varun supports her.
Akshat Shergill, an old friend of the Sinha family, enters the scene. His entry is followed by the arrival of his mother Reva and elder brother, Swayam. Akshat starts working in the R&G company and becomes a good friend and ally of Sujal, whilst he's also a good friend to Kashish. He learns of Kashish and Sujal's past and of Sujal's unconditional love for Kashish and hopes to bring them together to give Kashish a new life. Akshat and Charu soon fall in love with each other. Mahek gives birth to a son. Varun soon confesses his love for her and proposes but she refuses as she doesn't want to be in a relationship again. But later accepts as she realises is willing to sacrifice everything for her and her son who she names Roshan. Sujal arranges their marriage much to Rishi's dismay. As Mahek begins to live in the Raheja/Garewal household, Rishi flirts with her and grows close to their son. He finds out that he has real feelings for Mahek whilst she despises him and he tries to separate Mahek and Varun but is thwarted each time. Mouli falls in love with Rishi again and leaves her house to live with him. Prof. Sinha cuts ties with her for good. After some time, it is revealed that Piyush's death was not an accident. The car crash was deliberately caused.
Kashish begins to suspect Sujal of killing her husband and starts believing the false evidence planted against Sujal. With Kashish failing to realize this as a ploy against Sujal and her, Kashish begins deeply hating Sujal and wants to seek revenge. To punish him, Kashish decides to marry Sujal and live close to him to get access to his home and business and to destroy him. Kashish and Sujal do not consummate their marriage after Kashish asks Sujal to give her time. Unaware of Kashish's hatred for him and of Kashish's intentions of not taking this marriage seriously, Sujal respects her decision and assures her to take as much time as she needs. Kashish begins to lay many obstacles in Sujal's path personally and professionally. However, despite trying to hurt Sujal and as time passes by, she finds herself getting attracted towards Sujal again and is drawn to him. The more Kashish tries to shake her revived attraction for Sujal, the stronger she finds herself being pulled towards him. Much to Kashish's dismay, she finds herself fantasizing about Sujal and wanting to get close to him, whilst being torn apart by her commitment to hating Sujal and to seek revenge. To punish herself for thinking that way, Kashish causes a major accident to happen to Sujal and herself as a final showdown where she is ready to lose her life, if it also claims Sujal's life, thus exacting her revenge on Sujal. She fails the breaks of the car that Sujal and she travel in and refuses to jump out of the vehicle to save herself, despite Sujal's multiple pleas and prompting.
Sujal jumps out of the car in the nick of time, whilst the car falls down a steep cliff and erupts into flames immediately. Sujal is devastated and believes he has lost Kashish, but finds relief after he sees her lying unconscious yet deeply wounded close to the bottom of the cliff. Eventually a badly wounded Sujal saves the life of a seriously wounded and unconscious Kashish. In the process of Sujal saving Kashish's life, Sujal ends up with deep abrasive wounds himself. Kashish and Sujal survive the deadly ordeal. When recovering from the accident, Kashish stumbles upon Sujal's diary and learns of Sujal's intense love for her and learns from everyone around her of Sujal's valiant efforts to save her life, while risking his. Kashish feels guilty, is moved and breaks down upon seeing Sujal's wounds. When Kashish sees Sujal nursing to his deep wounds, she offers to aid him. Upon seeing Sujal's wounds that he obtained whilst saving her life, Kashish breaks down in a perplexed Sujal's arms. Kashish and Sujal consummate their marriage. Kashish later regrets letting her emotions and love for Sujal come in the way of her extracting her vengeance.
As Kashish's love for Sujal increases, in order to stop herself from losing track again, she expedites framing Sujal in the SG Enterprises' case and gets him arrested on New Year's Eve. Kashish is secretly heartbroken over Sujal's arrest. Rishi exposes Kashish as the culprit behind Sujal's arrest, and Kashish confesses to her part. While the entire Raheja and Garewal house is shaken by Kashish's betrayal and of her false understanding of Sujal as Piyush's killer, Akshat, Rishi and Kashish's sisters take Sujal's side and are determined to prove him innocent. Kashish has a heated argument with Sujal in jail, wherein she reveals to Sujal her motive behind marrying him. Sujal challenges Kashish to accept that she still loves him and has always only loved him. Kashish is shaken.
Eventually, Kashish begins learning of clues that point towards Sujal's innocence and is startled. To find out the truth, Kashish goes to Piyush's accident spot and learns from a local, the first hand account of how things played out on the day of Piyush's death and Sujal's numerous efforts to save Piyush's life. Kashish having finally learnt the truth breaks down from guilt and remorse. She rushes to the courthouse to interrupt the proceedings and prevent Sujal from getting sentenced. Sujal however to Kashish's shock, confesses to being guilty in the SG Enterprises' case.
Kashish learns from Akshat that Sujal always knew of Kashish's intentions to destroy him and yet surrendered himself to the authorities so that, she is not jailed on account of falsely framing Sujal. Learning this, Kashish is deeply ashamed of herself and of what she put Sujal through. Kashish repents and bitterly weeps before Sujal, who instantly forgives her. Kashish and Sujal reconcile in the Jail. Sujal yet again confesses his love for her, while a teary-eyed Kashish reciprocates this time.
Eventually, Kashish teams up with Akshat and Rishi to free Sujal and Sujal wins the case. With everything back to normal, Sujal and Kashish reunite and rekindle their love and passion for each other. Kashish is now deeply in love with Sujal again and becomes his loyal ally and partner. Vasu who believes that Kashish reconciled with Sujal for the money and to live a wealthy life, gets Sujal arrested again but in the charge of Piyush's murder this time. Kashish is heartbroken and so is the entire family except Vasu. Kashish vows to prove Sujal innocent and to set him free, to live a life with him again.
Eventually, Archie turns out to be Piyush's murderer. Archie was jealous of Sujal's love for Kashish and wanted to get rid of her, but Piyush died in the car crash meant for his wife. With the misunderstandings out of the way, the love between Sujal and Kashish is rekindled. It is revealed that Reva is Chetan's first wife and Swayam and Akshat are Sujal's half-brothers. Swayam is an evil person who starts creating problems for Sujal and his family. Mouli finds out about Rishi's flirtatious behavior behind her back and wants to return home but her father refuses. But the sisters forgive her. She begins to live in another house alone.
On his way to meet Kashish, Sujal has an altercation with some criminals, falls into a river and is presumed dead. (With this, the exit of Rajeev Khandelwal takes place) Kashish and the family are heartbroken and Kashish yearns for Sujal. Hoping against hope, Kashish prays that he is alive somewhere and has survived the ordeal and would return to her, though everyone considers him dead. Sujal survives but loses his memory and undergoes reconstructive surgery. He gets a new face and is known by the name Tushar (played by Gurpreet Singh). He is taken care of by Dr Archita. Tushar soon meets and falls in love with Kashish, not knowing that she is his wife. Kashish feels a sense of familiarity with Tushar and is intrigued by him, but suppresses any feelings because of her love for her dead husband Sujal. Charu soon grows attracted to Tushar and eventually falls for him after misunderstanding Kashish and Akshat to be getting married. Kashish has Tushar marry Charu, and then finds out that he is Sujal. Kashish is heartbroken upon realizing that Tushar is her very own Sujal whom she has loved and missed as much. But given the circumstances, Kashish tells him to stay with his new wife and her sister Charu, seeing how Charu is happy with him and from the guilt of being the reason for Akshat and Charu's separation.
Sujal is defiant and resists Kashish in her pleas. However, Sujal eventually tries to fulfill the duties of a Husband to Charu, for Kashish's sake. Sujal soon separates from Charu when he discovers that she had played tricks to get him. He tries to get close to Kashish once again but Charu is pregnant and ill and has to be in a wheelchair after landing in an accident. Kashish finds out she too is pregnant by Sujal after a one-night stand and immediately regrets it but Sujal is happy. It is then revealed that Charu was faking her illness in order for Sujal to grow closer to her but the truth comes out and everyone shuns her. Kashish and Sujal then reunite. During a party Charu commits suicide leaving Akshat in despair but it is rumored that she was mysteriously killed. Mouli falls for and marries Siddharth, the brother-in-law of a rich man named Shabbir Ahluwalia.
Sujal looks forward to a new life with Kashish. But she learns that the secret of her sister's death can be found within the Ahluwalia family. So, Kashish marries Shabbir Ahluwalia in order to find Charu's killer. Disappointed and heart broken, Sujal wants revenge from Kashish. So he pretends to romance Gayatri, Mr. Ahluwalia's daughter, who works with him. Kashish becomes jealous; although she knows that Sujal is only seeking revenge from her. Mr. Ahluwalia learns about the murderer but is soon killed; Kashish is sent to jail, and Kashish's father is killed. Varun and Mahek get divorced because of mutual differences. She also learns she is pregnant with his child. Mahek marries Rishi to ensure she obtains custody of Roshan, whilst, Varun falls for and marries Shivangi, Mr Ahluwalia's youngest daughter. Soon, Rishi turns over a new leaf and begins to care for Mahek and they start to love each other again. Kashish learns that Siddharth murdered Charu, Mr. Ahluwalia, and Prof. Sinha.
Soon after, Kashish, Rishi and Mahek move to a new town to start afresh. There, they meet Abhishek Chauhan, a navy officer and a look-alike of Piyush (who is later found to be his identical twin). Abhishek is a widower with a young daughter, Sneha. Kashish, Mahek and Rishi begin living happily until Swayam returns. Soon, Rishi dies while saving Sujal which leaves Sujal and Mahek heartbroken. Swayam threatens Kashish that he will frame Sujal for Rishi's murder. To save Sujal, Kashish has to leave him forever. So, she agrees to marry Abhishek. But Abhishek realizes that she is making a sacrifice. He has Sujal and Kashish marry each other. Swayam's evil plans to frame Sujal and harm the Garewals fail. He is killed by Mahek after he stole her child and for killing Rishi.
Five years later, Kashish and Sujal are seen living happily together. Mouli is also there. Abhishek and Mahek, too, are married and living with their children.

title: Jassi Jaissi Koi Nahin
summary: Jassi Jaissi Koi Nahin (transl. There is no one like Jassi) is an Indian soap opera which aired on Sony TV from 1 September 2003 to 4 May 2006. The series was an adaptation of the Colombian drama Yo soy Betty, la fea.
plot:
Based largely on the show, Yo soy Betty, la fea, the show follows the life of Jasmeet Walia known as Jassi (Mona Singh) who is a plain-looking young woman from a middle-class family in Mumbai. Jassi is a sincere worker and has been working to support her family. She is naive but intelligent. She has always been supported and encouraged by her father, grandmother (Bebe), and her close friend Nandu (Gaurav Gera) but she has faced rejection largely from society simply because of her looks. Jassi somehow lands her dream job at Gulmohur, a big fashion empire. She is appointed as the secretary to Armaan Suri (Apurva Agnihotri) and after a rough start soon becomes indispensable at work. She falls in love with Armaan but keeps her feelings to herself.
The show follows how Jassi becomes successful at Gulmohur but must face difficulties and trouble created by several people unhappy with her success, one of whom is Armaan's arrogant girlfriend Mallika (Rakshanda Khan). She is forced to disappear when things get too murky and is saved by businessman Purab Mehra (Samir Soni) who eventually becomes responsible for Jassi's makeover so she can hide her real identity and avenge the wrongs done to her and her family. Meanwhile, Armaan falls in love with Jassi, and while mourning her disappearance, is inexplicably attracted to her alter ego Jessica Bedi. In the end, Armaan and Jassi unite and gain control of Gulmohur.

In the board meeting, an argument takes place between Armaan and Aryan. For the first time, two reports are presented in front of the board. Whose report will the board approve?

episodesList.title: Marriage Proposal For Jassi
episodesList.summary: Jassi's aunty comes with a marriage proposal for Jassi. Jassi's mom is happy to hear about the proposal and asks Nandu to help her to convince Jassi for marriage. Jassi confronts Pari on the report stealing issue. What will Jassi's reaction be on learning about the marriage proposal? Will Pari accept to her crime?

episodesList.title: Boy Coming Home to See Jassi
episodesList.summary: Armaan has a doubt on Pari stealing the reports and not working on it herself. Jassi's family is very excited about the proposal. Pari is worried as she has to make new plans and give it to Armaan in 2 days. Will Jassi know about the boy? Will Jassi agree for marriage?

episodesList.title: Armaan and Malika's Horoscopes Don't Match
episodesList.summary: Jassi's mother is very upset with Jassi's behaviour. Jassi tells her mother about her dreams and aspirations. Malika and Arman get their horoscopes matched. Jassi also starts working on making the new plan. Will Pari steal her plan this time as well?

episodesList.title: Jassi's Father Goes to Gulmohar
episodesList.summary: Jassi and Nandu work on the financial plan throughout the night. Armaan is very angry as no one has come to the office on time. Meanwhile, Jassi sprains her leg on the way and Armaan shouts at Jassi which her father overhears on the phone and leaves for Jassi's office in anger.  What will happen when Jassi's father reaches Gulmohar?

episodesList.title: Armaan is Upset About The Reports
episodesList.summary: Angry Jassi's father reaches Gulmohar and asks for Armaan. The security guard refuses to let him in or call Armaan. Meanwhile, Armaan is angry and tells Pari about removing her and Jassi both from the job. Jassi gets scared about knowing that her father has come to the office and wants to meet Armaan. Will Jassi's father meet Armaan?

episodesList.title: Jassi Gets Her Job Back
episodesList.summary: Armaan is going through the financial report of Gulmohar when he realizes about the losses. He talks to Jassi about her plans for the company without realising that he has already fired her. Armaan offers the job back to Jassi. Will Pari be surprised knowing about Jassi's report?

episodesList.title: Armaan's Plan Gets Finalised
episodesList.summary: Jassi gets a shouting from Aryan at the reception area. Jassi tells Armaan that she saw Aryan in Armaan's office the night before. Why had Aryan come to Armaan's office? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Jassi's Tarot Card Reading Reveals Her Love
episodesList.summary: According to the tarot cards there is someone special in Jassi's life. Jassi denies of liking or knowing someone who likes her. Armaan discusses the plan with Raj. Jassi's mind is hovering with thoughts of her liking Armaan. Does Jassi really have feelings for Armaan?

episodesList.title: Nandu Gets Married
episodesList.summary: Jassi is surprised to see the name initials of her lover. Later her friend tells her that the initials she is looking at is wrong and her lover's name initial is N. That's when Nandu calls Jassi and gives her the news of his wedding with Jassi. Will Jassi say yes for the marriage?

episodesList.title: Jassi and Maria Go For a Party
episodesList.summary: Jassi goes to a party with Maria without informing her family. Her family is tensed as Jassi has not yet reached home. Jassi's father calls at Gulmohar and asks for Jassi and her friend tells him that she has gone out with Maria. Will Jassi stay at the party or leave for home? What will be her parent's reaction when she reaches home?

episodesList.title: Jassi's Father Tells Jassi to Stop Working
episodesList.summary: Jassi's father opens the door for her. He is very furious because she went to a party without informing him. He tells Jassi that she won't be going to the office from tomorrow. Will Jassi listen to her father? Will she go to Gulmohar again?

episodesList.title: Jassi Gets Her First Salary
episodesList.summary: Jassi's friend hands over a confidential envelope to her and makes her sign the register stating that she had received the envelope. After opening the envelope Jassi sees her first salary cheque. She buys gifts for everyone as she gets her first salary but her father is upset? Will Jassi's father forgive Jassi?

episodesList.title: Armaan Goes For a Vacation
episodesList.summary: Jassi's father comes in the morning to wake her up for work. Armaan is late to office and Jassi talks to all the clients on his behalf. Raj's Secretary tells Jassi that Raj and Armaan both have gone on a vacation along with Pari and Mallika. Will Jassi also reach the holiday destination?

episodesList.title: Jassi Reaches The Vacation Spot
episodesList.summary: Armaan scolds Malika for not informing him about the bank loan. Armaan tells Jassi to come along with him for lunch with Mr Kapoor to which Malika objects. Jassi is very insecure about the way she is looking at to top it off, Pari and Malika make her feel worse. Will Jassi attend the lunch or not?

episodesList.title: Jassi Gets Promoted
episodesList.summary: Armaan and Jassi leave for the business lunch. Armaan promotes Jassi from his secretary to his assistant. Armaan drops Jassi back to her place. Jassi gives the good news to her family. What will be Malika's reaction after she finds out about Jassi's promotion?

episodesList.title: Malika Comes to Know About Jassi's Promotion
episodesList.summary: Malika is upset with Armaan for promoting Jassi. Armaan catches Pari listening to their conversation at the door. Pari also starts questioning Armaan on Jassi's promotion. Armaan shouts at Jassi for telling everyone about her promotion. Will Armaan forgive Jassi for her mistake?

episodesList.title: Jassi Told to Tamper With Reports
episodesList.summary: Jassi informs Armaan and Raj that they have not been able to achieve the targets to which Raj and Armaan tell her to tamper with the reports and not show this information. Will Jassi listen to Armaan and tamper with the reports?

episodesList.title: Rumour Of Armaan Taking Jassi For Dinner
episodesList.summary: Armaan's parent's question Malika about their relationships. Malika tells them that Armaan's behaviour towards her has changed. Jassi is running a high fever but she continues to worry about her work. Raj gets a call from Armaan and tells him about a rumour of Armaan going for dinner with Jassi. Is Armaan really going for dinner with Jassi? What will Malika do now?

episodesList.title: Armaan Comes to Jassi's House
episodesList.summary: Armaan and Raj are discussing as to how to pacify Jassi. Meanwhile, Nandu confronts Jassi and teaches her some business tactics. Armaan sends in a letter for Jassi through Pari but she gives it to Malika. How will Malika react? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Mallika and Jassi's Gifts Interchange
episodesList.summary: Jassi comes back to work which pleases Armaan. Jassi's mother and father fight over a shopping list when Armaan calls them to notify that Jassi will be coming back home for the Diwali celebration. Later, Armaan's family initiate Diwali prayers in the office and settle differences between Malika and Armaan.  Just when things are settling down between the two, new trouble arises. What is the trouble?

episodesList.title: Gulati Hacks Jassi's Computer
episodesList.summary: Gulati intends to hack Jassi's computer files to know what's cooking between Jassi and Armaan. Meanwhile, Jassi and Nandu alter the passwords and file names. Maddy asks Armaan to come to the office and on the other hand, Pari, as usual, confuses Jassi as she wishes to barge into her cabin. Will Jassi fall into Pari's trap?

episodesList.title: Jassi Blamed For Being Irresponsible
episodesList.summary: Jassi's computer gets spoilt. Armaan gets angry with her when Pari intrudes, telling them that the engineer is on his way. Jassi rushes to him and tries to get her computer set right. Meanwhile, Gulati surprises Aryan with the news of fooling Jassi in order to chalk out some secret data from her system.

episodesList.title: Jassi's Computer is Fixed
episodesList.summary: Everyone in the office accuses Jassi of being irresponsible. Jassi's colleagues get their heads together to find a solution to her problem. The board members are busy having lunch and meanwhile, Jassi and her colleagues get the computer fixed. She notifies Armaan about this and he quickly comes to the technical room.

episodesList.title: Armaan Wants Jassi to Take Charge
episodesList.summary: Jassi manages to take the printouts in time to save the meeting from being cancelled. Gulati scolds the engineer for being so negligent towards their plan. Meanwhile, Armaan tells Jassi to give the presentation in front of the board members. She is scared at first but boldly manages every condition in the board meeting.

episodesList.title: Armaan Nominates Jassi
episodesList.summary: Gulati is asked to leave Gulmohar. Armaan fumes in anger on seeing him in the office and asks him to leave. At Gulmohar, Armaan familiarizes everyone about Gulati's intentions and nominates Jassi for the Vice President's position. This stimulates Aryan and Malika and they show reluctance towards Armaan's decision. What will be Jassi's fate?

episodesList.title: Jassi Gets Ready For Cocktail Party
episodesList.summary: Maddy insults Jassi in front of everyone. Meanwhile, Armaan and Raj discuss buying cheap fabrics for economic benefits. Jassi objects in between and suggests some other options keeping in mind Gulmohar's reputation. Armaan tells Raj that Jassi will accompany them to the cocktail party which worries him.

episodesList.title: Armaan Signs a Deal
episodesList.summary: Armaan and Raj are shocked to see Jassi's avatar. Moments later, they reach the venue and are warmly welcomed by the host. A lady catches Armaan's attention and he drools over her beauty. Meanwhile, Pari reaches Aryan's office for a private meeting and on the other end  Armaan, Jassi, and Raj sign a deal with Shehnaaz and buy good quality fabrics from her company.

episodesList.title: Balwant Loses His Job
episodesList.summary: Balwant drives everyone crazy at home. Nandu offers to help but Balwant shunts him away. Meanwhile, Armaan makes plans with Mandira unaware that Mallika is already there at his apartment. Moments later, Balwant angrily informs his mother and wife about losing his job. Its a tough time for Jassi's family.

episodesList.title: Jassi : The New Signatory
episodesList.summary: Jassi makes a sweet dish in the morning for Guru Purab when she realizes she is late for work. She rushes to the office unaware about the tension going on in her house. In the office, Armaan informs Raj that Jassi will be the authorized signatory. Later, she accompanies Armaan to the bank where he introduces Jassi to the bank manager as a replacement signatory for Gulati.

episodesList.title: Shantanu Meets Jassi
episodesList.summary: Mallika scolds Armaan for going to the bank with Jassi. Armaan, in order to pacify her, organizes lunch and asks Pari to take care of the arrangements. Pari is shocked to see Shantanu and Jassi going for lunch together. Maddy and Mallika are busy choosing a model for their collection when Armaan suggests Mandira's name.

episodesList.title: Nandu Tells Jassi About Balwant
episodesList.summary: Jassi meets Shantanu in a restaurant and is shocked when he asks her to work for his company and manipulate Armaan's company.  Meanwhile, Armaan, Raj, and Jassi plan their budget unaware about Jassi's tensions. Nandu adds more tension in Jassi's casket by informing her about her father losing his job. How will Jassi handle all this?

episodesList.title: Pari and Aryan's Secret Meeting
episodesList.summary: Balwant calms Jassi informing her that he is planning some business ideas with Nandu. Aryan shows up at Pari's house which shocks her. He comes to know about Pari's economic conditions and makes her uncomfortable. She informs him about Shantanu and Jassi meeting. On the other hand, Jassi tells Nandu about Shantanu's deal.

episodesList.title: Armaan Signs a Deal With Lavanya
episodesList.summary: Pari and Maria fight over Raj. Meanwhile, Gulati shows up at Shantanu's office to draw some information from his mouth regarding Gulmohar. Jassi is lost in thoughts when Armaan interrupts her asking her to fix a meeting with the clients. He questions her again on discovering her behaviour. She notifies him about Shantanu lessening the budget by ten per cent. What will Armaan do now?

episodesList.title: Jassi is Lost In a Dream World
episodesList.summary: Armaan is grateful to Jassi for making the deal possible with Lavanya. Meanwhile, Shantanu calls her to inform about her first commission check and she freaks out. Later, her colleagues tease her with Armaan's name not realizing she is already in thoughts about how she will spend fifteen lakh rupees. She dreams about gifting her father a company, treating her friends in an expensive hotel and travelling the world with her mother. Will Jassi fulfil her dreams?

episodesList.title: Balwant Finds Out About Jassi's Deal
episodesList.summary: Gulati gossips about Jassi and Shantanu's deal with Aryan. They also record Shantanu's call where he mentions that they'll pay thirty lakhs to Jassi. Meanwhile, Jassi's father catches her talking to Shantanu about her commission money and assumes that Jassi is doing something wrong. How will Jassi's father react to this?

episodesList.title: Jassi Notifies Armaan About Shantanu's Offer
episodesList.summary: Aryan reaches Gulmohar to reveal the truth about Jassi. But before he can tell Armaan and the board about Jassi's doing, she notifies him beforehand about Shantanu's offer. During the meeting, Aryan tries his best to prove his point against Jassi but his plan backfires as Jassi has already proved her loyalty.

episodesList.title: New Company In Jassi's Name
episodesList.summary: Armaan shows his trust in Jassi and her honesty and increases her salary from eight thousand to straight twenty thousand.  Armaan also orders her to help him in opening a new company. Mallika, on the other hand, complains to Armaan's father about giving the whole office responsibility to Jassi. She influences Armaan's parents opposite Jassi. Jassi comes back home and shares the good news with her family.

episodesList.title: Vasundhara Supervises Gulmohar's Promotions
episodesList.summary: Jassi is shocked to hear Armaan's idea of opening a new company and that too in her name. Meanwhile, Mallika calls Vasundhara Rao for Gulmohar's upcoming fashion show promotion work. Vasundhara shows up at Gulmohar for inspection and warns Armaan about the press.

episodesList.title: Jassi Gets a New Cabin
episodesList.summary: Gulmohar is gearing up for the fashion show. Amidst such chaos, Armaan shifts Jassi to a new cabin. Maddy is uninformed about the low-quality fabrics that have been used. Are Jassi, Armaan and Raj taking the right decision of not informing Maddy?

episodesList.title: Armaan is Very Nervous
episodesList.summary: Armaan is worried as he is taking a big risk by using low-quality fabrics. Vasundhara introduces him to Alan, the international designer. Meanwhile, Jassi and Raj manipulate Maddy and distract him from checking his designs before the fashion show. Will Maddy find out?

episodesList.title: Maddy Gets Fired
episodesList.summary: Armaan asks Maddy to leave the company. Maddy demands an explanation for the low-quality fabrics. Mallika bashes Jassi and blames her for manipulating Armaan. Vasundhara asks Armaan to apologize to Maddy if he wants to save Gulmohar's reputation. Will Armaan apologize?

episodesList.title: Armaan Apologises to Maddy
episodesList.summary: Jassi goes to a resto-bar with her colleagues to celebrate the success of the fashion show. Coincidently, Armaan reaches the same place searching for Maddy. Meanwhile, Viru mixes alcohol in everyone's drinks. Jassi's father is worried as she is late. Will Jassi's father find out about the party?

episodesList.title: Armaan and Maddy Keep Conditions
episodesList.summary: Maddy accepts Armaan's apology, tossing over a bet and keeps his conditions in front of him. Armaan, on the other hand, also keeps his conditions before Maddy in case he wins the bet. He also pacifies Mallika and convinces her to come back to Gulmohar. Will Mallika come back?

episodesList.title: Jassi : The Temporary Chairman
episodesList.summary: Jassi apologizes to her father for drinking in the bar. Armaan and Mallika confess to Armaan's parents that they are planning to tie the knot post the Hong Kong trip. Armaan tells Jassi that in his absence she'll be the temporary Chairman. Will Jassi take up the opportunity?

episodesList.title: Armaan Leaves For Hong Kong
episodesList.summary: Armaan informs everyone about Jassi being temporary in charge of the whole office in his absence. This news does not go down too well with anyone except Raj. Jassi, on the other hand, is very nervous as she has got a huge responsibility on her shoulders. Will she manage it?

episodesList.title: Aryan Seems Curious
episodesList.summary: Bindiya and Maria get into an argument with Pari for coming late to the office. Pari asks Manchanda to deduct Bindiya's salary but Jassi crops in as their saviour and warns Pari to stick to her own business. She also completes the formalities required to register a new firm and takes Nandu's help in this.

episodesList.title: Sales Reports are Negative
episodesList.summary: Jassi goes to the bank to meet the manager and is shocked to see the sales reports. The sales reports are not up to the mark as what she and Armaan had planned. Meanwhile, Aryan shows up in Jassi's office and expresses his desire to see the sales reports.

episodesList.title: Tough Time For Gulmohar
episodesList.summary: Jassi informs Armaan about the sales reports and asks him to come back as soon as possible. Pari calls Aryan and informs him about Armaan coming back to India. Meanwhile, Armaan and Raj come to the office and are tensed to see the sales reports. Will Jassi help save Gulmohar in time?

episodesList.title: Nandu Smells Something Fishy
episodesList.summary: Armaan decides to take a loan from Jassi's new company Kohinoor. He also realizes that Maddy has quit the job again and somehow manages to convince Maddy to come back to the office. Nandu, on the other hand, smells something fishy about Armaan's plans.

episodesList.title: Maria Loses Her Job
episodesList.summary: Maria in order to make Pari jealous tries to get close to Raj. Raj fumes in anger due to all this and asks Maria to leave the job. Maddy pacifies Pari and Jassi handles Maria. Meanwhile, Armaan and Jassi are finding solutions to their budget problems to maintain their goodwill in the market. Will they succeed in that?

episodesList.title: Raj Ditches Pari and Maria
episodesList.summary: Jassi tries her luck in convincing Armaan for not firing Maria. Armaan, on the other hand, makes Raj understand asking him to apologize to Pari to prevent her from going to Aryan for sympathy. Will Raj listen to Armaan?

episodesList.title: Viru Saves The Day
episodesList.summary: Manchanda takes Maria to a resto-bar when Viru comes in time to save Maria. Armaan invites a friend for dinner in his cabin and asks Jassi not to come out from her cabin. He leaves the office in the night and forgets about Jassi. The whole night Jassi stays in the office and her father fumes in anger waiting for her in the house.

episodesList.title: Gurinder Meets Jassi
episodesList.summary: Armaan feels guilty for making Jassi stay in the office for the whole night. Gurinder is busy working out when Jassi mistakes him to be a stranger barging in her house. He, on the other hand, gets a shock to see Jassi.

episodesList.title: Manchanda's Day Out
episodesList.summary: Jassi and her colleagues complain against Manchanda. Armaan directly talks to him and he acts innocent. Pari doesn't quit and informs Raj about Aryan coming to her rescue. Gurinder opts to stay at home and wait for Jassi but she does not want to go for the wedding function with him.

episodesList.title: Mallika is Back
episodesList.summary: Mallika is back from Hong Kong. Armaan orders Jassi not to reveal about the sales reports to Mallika. But Maddy tells this to Mallika and she fumes in anger. She questions Armaan and commands to meet him and Raj in the conference room.

episodesList.title: Mallika Takes Charge
episodesList.summary: Mallika wants Maddy to design a new collection. She scolds Armaan for being so careless towards his company and taking undue advantage of his position. How will Armaan tackle this?

episodesList.title: Bindiya is Out Of Control
episodesList.summary: Armaan is not able to tackle such a big loss. All the buyers are giving back the products to Gulmohar as there are no sales that are happening. Later, Leena comes to Gulmohar for a modelling assignment. Bindiya notices her and fumes in anger. Why does Bindiya get angry?

episodesList.title: Kohinoor to Save Gulmohar
episodesList.summary: Mallika fights with Armaan as she feels he takes her for granted. Pari, on the other hand, is upset because of Raj. Armaan and Jassi make new sales plans. Bindiya is still upset as Leena got the job in Gulmohar. Will Armaan and Jassi succeed in making new plans for Gulmohar?

episodesList.title: Gulmohar Collection Failed
episodesList.summary: Nandu stops Jassi from supporting Armaan. Mallika is all set and looking forward to her marriage with Armaan but he upsets her every time. Bindiya and her girl gang are up to some mischief in the office to bring Reshma down. Maddy and Raj also enter into a heated argument pertaining to Maddy's new collection. What will the fate of Gulmohar be? Watch this episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Aryan's Uninformed Visit to Gulmohar
episodesList.summary: Aryan shows up at Gulmohar without informing anyone. Jassi tries to inform Armaan about Aryan's presence but he ignores her call. When he sees Aryan in the conference hall, he fumes in anger and insults him in every possible way but Aryan is no less as he, on the other hand, blasts at Armaan asking him about the sales reports.

episodesList.title: Jassi's Friends Hatch a Plan
episodesList.summary: Mr Walia volunteers to help out Jassi and Nandu as an accountant and also help out at home. Meanwhile, Jassi's friend predicts her future is going to be bleak. How will Jassi tackle this situation? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Balwant Feels Armaan Went Against The Law
episodesList.summary: Nandu tells Jassi's father Balwant, that Armaan had taken a loan of 10 lakhs from Kohinoor. Balwant, on the other hand, feels that Armaan went against the law. How will Jassi react to this? Watch this episode to know.

episodesList.title: Raj Flies to Bangkok
episodesList.summary: Jassi suggests Armaan to consult with Mallika and Maddy before deciding on any supplier. Raj, on the other hand, flies to Bangkok to book the deal but Armaan lies to Mallika and Maddy that Raj is in Singapore to meet the supplier. Meanwhile, Maddy reminds Armaan to dress up like a girl to his party as per their bet. What will Armaan do?

episodesList.title: Suppliers From Bangkok
episodesList.summary: Jassi is looking for some good suppliers and comes across one such supplier who is ready to go by their demands but somehow Jassi feels that this supplier is spooky and is misleading them as he is exporting Chinese Silk from Bangkok. Is Jassi on the right track?

episodesList.title: Bank Rejects Armaan's Loan Proposal
episodesList.summary: Jassi discusses their supplier-deal with Nandu. Nandu asks Jassi to stop Armaan from finalizing the deal with the Bangkok suppliers. Jassi informs Armaan that the bank has rejected their loan proposal. Armaan gets hassled up and reaches the bank. Will he get the approval?

episodesList.title: Armaan Dresses As a Lady Bird
episodesList.summary: Maddy eagerly waits for his party and his awaited bet with Armaan. He brings a girly outfit for Armaan, asking him to wear that dress at his party as Armaan lost the bet. Armaan asks Jassi about cross-dressing which shocks her. At the party, Maddy leaves no chances to insult Armaan. How will Armaan deal with this?

episodesList.title: Armaan is Miss Hawa Hawai
episodesList.summary: Armaan goes to Maddy's party dressed as a girl. There, a photographer clicks his photos and he urges to leave. Maddy forces Armaan to dance with him in the party and tells him that his screen name is Miss Hawa Hawai. How will Arman react to the insult?

episodesList.title: Armaan, a Damsel In Distress
episodesList.summary: Jassi realizes that a ladylike figure running behind her taxi is none other than Armaan himself.  She rescues him and escorts him to Gulmohar. But trouble strikes back again and Jassi is left with no choice but to let Armaan tag along with her to her house. Will Armaan get caught at Jassi's house.

episodesList.title: Jassi Hides Armaan In Her House
episodesList.summary: Jassi hides Armaan in her living room. Balwant becomes suspicious that someone is in his house. Armaan hides under the table to save himself from Jassi's father. Will he get caught? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Armaan Gifts Jassi a Car
episodesList.summary: Armaan gifts a car to Jassi. Jassi jumps in excitement and steps on Armaan's foot. She also daydreams of her going on a long drive with Armaan. Viru brings the samples in Armaan's cabin, but Jassi is still lost in her dream world.

episodesList.title: Trishala Gets to Know The Truth
episodesList.summary: Pari tells Mallika that Jassi does not share Armaan's information with anyone. Mallika asks Trishala to find out about Armaan. Jassi requests Trishala to hide the lie from Mallika. How will Mallika react when she finds out that Armaan has lied again?

episodesList.title: Mallika Fires Jassi
episodesList.summary: Mallika fumes in anger and shouts at Jassi, as she thinks Jassi told Armaan about Pari being her spy. Pari, on the contrary, informs everyone that she never went to Jassi's cabin to spy. Mallika, in anger, asks Jassi to leave the company.

episodesList.title: Armaan Fires Pari and Hires Jassi Again
episodesList.summary: Armaan gets to know that Mallika has fired Jassi. He fires Pari instead of asking her to leave Gulmohar. Hearing this, Pari pretends to faint. Jassi, later, surprises everyone by showing her new car. Will Jassi accept the offer again?

episodesList.title: Police At Gulmohar
episodesList.summary: Police catch the driver of the truck that has the fabric materials. Meanwhile, Viru is praying that Armaan doesn't find out about the damage he is done to his car. The girl gang at Gulmohar is mocking Pari for her pregnancy but she surprises everyone by coming to the office. Jassi is trying to get in touch with the concerned person for their consignment who informs her that the consignment has been confiscated by the police. Will Jassi catch hold of the consignment?

episodesList.title: Police Interrogate Jassi
episodesList.summary: Police interrogate Jassi for ordering fabric from smugglers. While the girl gang of Gulmohar thinks it's all for publicity.  Jassi handles the tricky situation with confidence. How will she get out of this? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Armaan Holds an Emergency Meeting At Gulmohar
episodesList.summary: When the news of fabric smuggling by a big fashion house comes out, Armaan and Raj hold an emergency meeting with Mallik and Maddy about their fabric requirement. Will Armaan save his company?

episodesList.title: Jassi is Grateful For Her Father
episodesList.summary: Jassi explains to Armaan that even though her father's expectations precedes her, she couldn't have achieved what she has without his help and love. Jassi feels really proud of her father for raising  her up.

episodesList.title: Jassi and Nandu Get In a Fight
episodesList.summary: Jassi and Nandu's friendship is put to test when Nandu accuses her of changing after she got a job at Gulmohar. Has Jassi really changed? Will she save her friendship? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Raj Wants to Leave Gulmohar
episodesList.summary: Raj decides to leave Gulmohar after a fight with his dear friend, Armaan. Jassi asks Armaan to talk Raj out of leaving, but, he refuses to listen to her. Will Raj take his decision back?

episodesList.title: Jassi Surprises Nandu
episodesList.summary: Jassi visits Nandu at his house while he is sleeping and surprises him. Both forgo their differences and become friends once again. Watch this episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Jassi's Love For Armaan Grows
episodesList.summary: Armaan gives Jassi a rose when he drops her off at her home. Elated by his actions, Jassi treasures the rose and falls into her dreamland. Has Jassi's feeling for Armaan become stronger?

episodesList.title: Jassi Lifts Armaan's Mood
episodesList.summary: Jassi makes Armaan laugh unintentionally when his mood had turned sour. She cherishes the fact that she could make him laugh and wonders if it's a turning point in their relationship. Does Armaan also have feelings for Jassi?

episodesList.title: Armaan Stuck In a Pickle With His Father
episodesList.summary: Armaan's father is disappointed with him when he learns their old collection had failed. Armaan is put in a pickle with his father because he wouldn't tell him the truth about their company. How will Armaan resolve the issues with his father?

episodesList.title: Valentines Day Celebrations At Gulmohar
episodesList.summary: While some of the workers at Gulmohar eagerly celebrate Valentine's day, few, like Raj and Mallika, are annoyed by all the decorations and excitement the day brought along with it. Will they create any trouble to will they celebrate along with the others? Watch this episode to find out only on Sony Liv App.

episodesList.title: Jassi Loses Her Diary
episodesList.summary: Jassi loses her dairy at Gulmohar and is afraid someone at the office would find it before her and read it. She is hesitant when the girl gang of Gulmohar offer their help to find it. Will she find her diary?

episodesList.title: Nandu's Girlfriend Meets His Mother
episodesList.summary: Nandu gets nervous when his girlfriend asks to meet his mother. Even though he tries hard to avoid the meeting, it occurs eventually. Will Nandu's mother approve his girlfriend? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Jassi is Excited About Tirshala's Predictions
episodesList.summary: Trishala reads tarot cards and predicts Jassi will receive two bad news but something good will happen after it. Jassi is excited about the good part but is nervous about the bad news. What will the good and the bad news be?

episodesList.title: Jassi is Left Heartbroken
episodesList.summary: Jassi is delighted when she is invited to a dinner party by Armaan but her joyous mood turns sour after Armaan's announcement. What announcement does Armaan make? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Gulmohar Prepares For Armaan's Engagement Party
episodesList.summary: Armaan entrusts Jassi to organize a surprise party for his new fiance Malika amidst lawyer and legal work. Jassi, broken-hearted, fulfils her duties with a smile on her face. How will Jassi overcome the loss?

episodesList.title: Girl Gang Of Gulmohar Uncover a Mystery
episodesList.summary: Maithali's exercising turns more interesting when she and the girl gang of Gulmohar uncover a mystery, while Jassi is busy handling Armaan's engagement party. What is the mystery? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Nandu Attempts to Handle a Crisis
episodesList.summary: Nandu evades Balwant's questions while he tries to get in touch with Jassi. Armaan reconciles with an old friend to get away from his engagement pressure. What happens next? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Armaan's Plans Derail
episodesList.summary: Armaan's plans change when he discovers Nandu had made a mistake with dates. He successfully convinces his family and fiance to prepone his engagement dates. How will Mallika react to this? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Jassi Surprised By Uninvited Visitor
episodesList.summary: Jassi rushes to work as per Armaan's orders but is surprised by an uninvited visitor. She quickly thinks on her feet and avoids a disaster. Who is the uninvited visitor? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Day Of Pari and Raj's Engagement
episodesList.summary: Pari and Raj's engagement is a very small affair. The girl gang of Gulmohar waits excitedly for the truth to come out. Will the truth be revealed? What will be Raj's reaction when the truth is out? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Last Minute Preparations For The Engagement Party
episodesList.summary: Jassie and the girl gang of Gulmohar rush to organize Armaan's and Malika's engagement party at the last minute while Pari plots her revenge on them. Will Pari be successful?

episodesList.title: Disaster Averted
episodesList.summary: Armaan helps avert a disaster that Pari was plotting. Jassi and gang work day and night to prepare food for the party. Will they manage everything in time?

episodesList.title: Armaans and Malika's Day Of Engagement
episodesList.summary: Jassi reluctantly agrees to attend Armaan and Malika's engagement party after he invites her and the gang but everything goes awry at her home. How will Jassi feel at the engagement?

episodesList.title: Malika Isn't Happy On Her Special Day
episodesList.summary: Mr Shah visits Gulmohar for the inventory while everyone else is at the engagement party. Jassi's happiness at accomplishing the task vanishes after Malika confronts her. What did Malika tell Jassi?

episodesList.title: Mr. Shah Finds Evidence to Ruin Armaan
episodesList.summary: Mr Shah finds evidence that Jassi and Armaan know each other very well. He calls Raj and asks him to meet the following day to discuss the course of his inventory list. Will Shah ruin Armaan? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Armaan and Gulmohar In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Raj and Armaan try to handle the situation at hand without Jassi's help. Jassi refuses to face Armaan after recent events. Will the tiff between Armaan and Jassi grow or will it get resolved? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Armaan and Raj Look For Jassi
episodesList.summary: Armaan and Raj fail to locate Jassi and discuss important details about the lawyer. Mr Shah demands Jassi but Jassi is nowhere to be found. Where is Jassi? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Jassi Helps Hide Rohan From The Police
episodesList.summary: Jassi and her grandmother mistake Rohan for a thief and the manager call the police. But, after hearing Rohan's story, Jassi decides to help him instead. How will Jassi help Rohan?

episodesList.title: Jassi Learns The Truth About Rohan
episodesList.summary: Jassi confronts Rohan's supposed father about him mistreating his son, but, is left shocked when she learns the truth about both of them. What is their truth? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Jassi Rethinks Her Actions
episodesList.summary: While helping Rohan and Purab get along with each other, Jassi rethinks about her decisions to leave work without informing Armaan and running away from her problems. Will she take this step? Find out in this episode only on Sony Liv app.

episodesList.title: Gulmohar Tries to Survive Without Jassi
episodesList.summary: Maddy is enraged when the materials bought for the show isn't of quality and demands he gets the right materials from Malika. Armaan and Raj are informed about the board meeting where they have to decide Jassi's fate at Gulmohar. What will be her fate? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Armaan Learns Of Jassi's Love For Him
episodesList.summary: Raj tells Armaan that Jassi is in love with him and suggests that he should take advantage of the fact and coerce her into coming back to Gulmohar. Will Armaan take this step?

episodesList.title: Armaan Goes In Search Of Jassi
episodesList.summary: Armaan visits the hotel Jassi was staying at but he is misled by Rohan. Jassi decides that it's time to go back home and leaves for home with Bebe. Will Armaan convince Jassi?

episodesList.title: Jassi Returns to Gulmohar
episodesList.summary: Jassi returns to Gulmohar and faces consequences for her actions. Armaan and Raj are shocked to see a very different Jassi who stands up for herself. Will this new Jassi bring in fortune to Gulmohar? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Malika to Organise a Fashion Show
episodesList.summary: Malika adamantly refuses to include Jassi in organizing the fashion show for Gulmohar, while Jassi handles the situation with Mr Shah. How will the new Jassi face the rather stubborn Malika?

episodesList.title: Trishala Reads Armaan's Future
episodesList.summary: Raj convinces Armaan to let Trishala predict his future by reading tarot cards. He is blown away by her predictions and tries to follow her suggestions. What predictions did Trishala make for Armaan?

episodesList.title: Balwant Receives a Call Letter
episodesList.summary: Balwant receives a call letter as a reply to the job he had applied in Jassi's name. He wants his daughter, Jassi, to quit Gulmohar and join a better company. Will Jassi quit Gulmohar for Balwant?

episodesList.title: Raj's Failed Attempts
episodesList.summary: Raj tries convincing Armaan to act as if he's in love with Jassi to have her stay in Gulmohar. When that fails, he tries to become friends with her himself. Will Armaan be successful in keeping Jassi at Gulmohar?

episodesList.title: Jassi is Appointed to Organize The Fashion Show
episodesList.summary: Mallika and her brother Aryan appoint Jassi and the girl gang of Gulmohar to organize the fashion show and enjoy seeing Jassi and rest of them run around trying to manage everything. Will Jassi manage to organise the fashion show with her girl gang? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Jassi Thinks She's Attending a Meeting
episodesList.summary: Raj lies to Jassi about attending a meeting and gets her to meet with Armaan for dinner at a restaurant. Jassi is disturbed by Armaan's drunken behaviour. How will Jassi handle drunk Armaan?

episodesList.title: Armaan is Hungover
episodesList.summary: After a very drunken night, Armaan finds himself at Malika's house the next morning. Malika isn't happy about the fact that her fiance and his assistant were out late at night and drinking. How will Malika react to this? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Crisis At Gulmohar
episodesList.summary: On the day of their biggest fashion show, Jassi and the girl gang of Gulmohar have to handle one crisis after another while Mallika and Pari hope they fail. Will Jassi succeed? Find out in this episode only on Sony Liv app.

episodesList.title: Paris Modelling Opportunities
episodesList.summary: Jassi convinces Maddy to ask Pari to model in Gulmohar's fashion show. Pari is overexcited by the opportunity and prepares for the show. But will she prove to be a good model for the show?

episodesList.title: Gulmohar Basks In Success Of Their Fashion Show
episodesList.summary: Jassi and other employers of Gulmohar are overjoyed at the success of their latest fashion show. Aryan and Malika dislike the fact that Jassi is getting all the credit for the fashion show. Is Armaan happy with the success? Will he and Jassi resolve their issues?

episodesList.title: Armaan Angry With Jassi
episodesList.summary: Armaan and Raj watch Jassi and Nandu celebrating the success of Gulmohur's fashion show and get furious. Armaan tells Raj to behave and wait for the right opportunity to strike back. What does Armaan have in his mind?

episodesList.title: Armaan Insults Jassi
episodesList.summary: Raj tells Armaan that he shouldn't have behaved roughly with Jassi as she could takeover Kohinoor and would go to Singapore leaving Armaan behind. Armaan doesn't think that's a possibility and believes that Jassi would come back to the office as usual. Will Jassi come back? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Armaan's High Hopes
episodesList.summary: Jassi wakes up in the morning and as usual, starts getting ready for the office, when she realizes that she has quit the job. Armaan and Raj are waiting for Jassi in the office. Will Jassi come back to Gulmohar after all that she went through?

episodesList.title: Jassi In a Fix
episodesList.summary: Jassi finally leaves Gulmohar and Kohinoor. Armaan still misunderstands her and thinks she is favouring Nandu. Meanwhile, Maddy and Pari are up to something fishy. Balwant is happy and thinks about renovating his house when Jassi shows up and feels guilty for hiding all the information from his family. Will she disclose everything to her family?

episodesList.title: Purab At Jassi's Home
episodesList.summary: Jassi is surprised to see Purabh in her house but her father suspects Purab's intention and starts interrogating him. Meanwhile, Raj and Armaan are planning to postpone courts hearing. What is Purab up to?

episodesList.title: Aryan's Offer to Purab
episodesList.summary: Jassi goes to meet Hansmukhi for an interview. Meanwhile, Raj and Armaan reach Jassi's home. Aryan meets Purab and asks him to take over Gulmohur as he feels Armaan is incompetent in managing the company. What will be Purab's reply?

episodesList.title: All Eyes At Armaan
episodesList.summary: Armaan shows up at Jassi's home and smells something fishy. Jassi's father gets mad at Armaan. Purab is amidst some thoughts. It seems he is getting fond of Jassi. Pari, on the other hand, is in her own fairytale world. Will Purab take over the company? Watch this episode to find out only on Sony Liv app.

episodesList.title: Billu is The New Target
episodesList.summary: Armaan and Raj are planning to target Jassi's father this time to save Gulmohar. Purab is intruding too much in Jassi's life. He apologizes for not being able to come for dinner. Nandu is jealous of Purab. Jassi gets a job at IFI.

episodesList.title: Rapid Fire Game
episodesList.summary: Armaan is trying to get too close to Jassi's father. He and Raj have a lot of plans in their mind. Meanwhile, Jassi reaches her new office where Pari tries to befriend her. But Jassi finds it difficult to fit in with Pari's group. Aryan  as usual troubles Pari again. Will Jassi be able to find her space in this new environment?

episodesList.title: Armaan Shocked to See Purab With Jassi
episodesList.summary: Armaan pacifies Balwant and talks him into convincing Jassi to join Gulmohar again. But Jassi denies and expresses her wish to join Hansmukhi Maam's company. Purab finds out that Jassi works for Gulmohar and asks her to meet him at a cafe. Armaan and Raj follow Jassi and are shocked to see her with Purab.

episodesList.title: Purab Makes Jassi Happy
episodesList.summary: Purab tries to control Jassi. His closeness bugs Nandu out as he feels his best friend was drifting apart. He talks to Balwant about this, which puts him in deep thinking. Armaan, on the other hand, is worried about Gulmohar. Purab takes Jassi for a ride to the sea link which lightens her mood.

episodesList.title: Aryan In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Jassi is upset because of Armaan. Balwant pesters her to go back to Gulmohar and help him out. Jassi's friends are upset because of her leaving Gulmohar but are happy for her at the same time. Meanwhile Aryan eagerly waits for a fax. What is it that he is waiting for? What does the fax contain? Watch now on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Aryan is Selling Gulmohar's Shares
episodesList.summary: Armaan finds out that Aryan is behind all the mess. He also realizes that Aryan is selling off Gulmohar's shares. Jassi, Rohan and Nandu are having a good time in the park. Meanwhile, Purab asks Jassi about Aryan's character. Later, Armaan, Raj and Mallika pester Pari to say the truth and she reveals that Aryan is selling Gulmohar to Purab Kohli.

episodesList.title: Rohan Comes to Mumbai
episodesList.summary: Jassi asks Purab to bring Rohan to Mumbai as he was on vacation. Jassi is very happy to see him and so is everyone else. Meanwhile, Armaan and Raj are tensed as they sense that someone was selling Gulmohar's shares. Later, Rohan takes everyone for a picnic. His idea is to bring Purab and Jassi together. Will Rohan succeed in doing so? Will Jassi fall in love with Purab?

episodesList.title: Armaan Stalks Purab
episodesList.summary: Armaan and Raj stalk Purab on the internet. They try to find his location and follow him around. Armaan also bashes Pari for lying to them all this while. Jassi is surprised as Rohan has gone back to his hostel without meeting her. Armaan follows Purab's car to find out what's really happening. Watch now On Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Purab is In Love
episodesList.summary: Armaan bangs Purab's car to see him face to face and get some information from him. Raj is upset with Armaan for damaging his car. Purab comes home injured and Jassi comes to his rescue. It appears Purab wishes to confess his feelings for Jassi. Is Purab is in love with Jassi?

episodesList.title: Jassi Reaches Ifh
episodesList.summary: Jassi reaches her new office IFH. Her new boss seems delighted to see her. While all this is going on, Jassi somehow recalls her moments spent in Gulmohar. Purab meets Jassi on the way. Mallika blasts Pari for being disloyal to her and their friendship.

episodesList.title: Jassi Doubts Purab
episodesList.summary: Raj flirts with Pari so that he can draw out some important information about Aryan and Purab. Raj is shocked to see that the documents have Purab's signature on it. Meanwhile, Purab confesses his feelings to Jassi which leaves her amazed. She is lost deep thoughts now. Jassi decides to help Armaan. Armaan notifies her that someone is trying to sell Gulmohar and has joined hands with Aryan.

episodesList.title: Misunderstanding Between Jassi & Purab
episodesList.summary: Jassi fights with Purab accusing him of taking undue advantage of her emotions and friendship. She also misunderstands his love for her and blames him for playing games with her just to acquire Gulmohar. Aryan finds out that Armaan knows about his and Purab's deal. Nandu calms Jassi down. Meanwhile, Purab meets Armaan and threatens him to take away Gulmohar.

episodesList.title: Aryan's Smart Move Lands Armaan In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Armaan calls for a board meeting where he and Raj decide to unfold Aryan's wrongdoings in front of everyone. It shocks his father to hear the news that Aryan tried selling Gulmohar to someone. But somehow, Aryan's smart moves backfires and affects Armaan's plans. What is Armaan going to do now? Watch now on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Gulmohar or Ifh?
episodesList.summary: Once again, Jassi proves to be Armaan and Raj's savior. Hansmukhi reaches Gulmohar to support Jassi and clear her confusion as to which company to choose. Purab is leaving Mumbai and is very sad as things are not good between him and Jassi. He cancels his deal with Aryan to take over Gulmohar. Gulmohar or IFH, which company will Jassi choose to work for?

episodesList.title: Purab Leaves a Letter For Jassi
episodesList.summary: Armaan's father settles things down between Aryan and Armaan. Mallika is upset with Aryan and gets into a fight with him over the Chairman's position. Purab leaves a letter for Jassi outside her house, feeling guilty about ruining their bond. Meanwhile, Aryan warns Mallika against Armaan's antics. Will Mallika support his brother or choose to stay with her love, Armaan?

episodesList.title: Armaan's Fort Of Lies
episodesList.summary: Jassi asks Armaan to tell the truth to his father about Kohinoor and Gulmohar's conditions. He enters his father's cabin but hesitates. He prefers not to tell him the truth and decides to lie about his breakup with Mallika. Jassi on the other hand, is under the impression that Armaan has revealed the truth to his father. Arman, doesn't seem to realise the fact that to conceal one lie, he has to tell many more lies.

episodesList.title: Balwant Faints
episodesList.summary: Armaan is up to something and is trying his luck to pamper Jassi as much as he can. Jassi's girl gang is having a gala time at lunch. Meanwhile, Balwant goes job hunting but gets rejected as he doesn't meet the age criteria. This affects him deep inside. He gets an attack and collapses. Will he be okay? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: Karan Kapoor's Cartoon Craze
episodesList.summary: Everyone is going gaga over Hum Tum cartoon characters. Some find these cartoons meaningful and some take it as a joke. Jassi's girl gang is also drooling over these characters, trying to draw out some meaning out of it. Jassi writes a letter to the maker of this cartoon, Karan Kapoor. He replies to her letter through this cartoon strip which bugs her out completely. Will Karan Kapoor come to meet Jassi?

episodesList.title: Jassi Meets Karan Kapoor Aka Saif Ali Khan
episodesList.summary: Jassi goes gaga over Armaan again. She gifts a soft toy to Armaan, but he gets annoyed after seeing that. Later, Jassi fumes in anger on reading Karan Kapoor's cartoon strip and decides to teach him a lesson, unaware that he is already waiting for her in Gulmohar's cafeteria. She quarrels with him and wins the debate.

episodesList.title: Ms. Yana, Armaan's New Catch
episodesList.summary: Armaan and Raj attend a fashion show where Armaan spots a beautiful girl and invites her to a party. Meanwhile, Mallika plans a surprise trip for Armaan. Armaan and Jassi go out hunting for a party spot exclusively for Ms.Yana. Coincidentally, Mallika also books the same place for Aryan's birthday. What will Armaan do now? Watch now on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Aryan's Birthday Party
episodesList.summary: Armaan wants to meet Yana and books his tickets for Singapore. Mallika unfolds her surprise in front of Armaan revealing she had booked tickets for Paris but he denies her proposal. He insists on taking Jassi to Singapore with him. Will Balwant allow Jassi?

episodesList.title: Singapore It Is!
episodesList.summary: Nandu agrees to go to Singapore with Jassi and Armaan. Balwant also heaves a sigh of relief. Nandu's excitement is beyond words. Armaan, Jassi and Nandu reach Singapore. Jassi thanks Armaan for giving them this opportunity. Meanwhile, Aryan brainwashes Mallika against Armaan's antics.Watch this exciting episode only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Armaan's Secret Shocks Jassi
episodesList.summary: Armaan calls Yana. She asks him to meet at Santosa Bay. Armaan introduces Jassi & Nandu to Yana. Yana enjoys Nandu's company more than Armaan's. It seems Armaan has a competitor now. Later, Jassi pesters Armaan to share whatever was disturbing him. He opens up and reveals his secret, requesting her not to tell anyone! What is this secret? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: Jassi Dreams About Armaan
episodesList.summary: Jassi dreams that Armaan has denied his marriage with Mallika and holds her hands. Meanwhile, Armaan is confident about his deal with Yana. Is Jassi slowly developing feelings for Armaan? How does this dream affect Jassi's behaviour with Armaan? Watch now exclusively only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Jassi Puts On Make Up
episodesList.summary: In Singapore, Jassi puts full on makeup and presents herself infront of Armaan and Yana. After being ridiculed, Armaan tells here how beautiful she was even without the makeup. He mentions how pure Jassi's heart was. He hints that there was someone who he really thinks understands him from the inside. Will Jassi's heart Melt after listening to all this? Watch now Only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Jassi Gets In On Armaans Plans
episodesList.summary: Jassi gets to know Armaans true intentions with Yana. He tells here that their plan was failing. Mallika on the other hand eavesfrop on Raj and hears him reveal Armaans intentions. She calls him immediately. Watch what happens next only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Mallika and Armaan Fight
episodesList.summary: Jassi gets shamed for using the company expenses for travel. An attempt to break her will. Meanwhile, Armaan and Mallika get into a terrible fight where the situation excalates so much that Mallika takes off her engagement ring. All of this was witnessed by Jassi, who hid behind a door and saw it all. Watch now ony on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Nandu's Dreams
episodesList.summary: Nandu dreams about doing a complete make over and change his style, he dreams about being a dapper young man. Armaan too gets grilled on his Singapore trip and is asked to provide all the details of his trip. Meanwhile, Mallika threatens Jassi to stay away from their relationship and insults her byt calling her an over ambitious middle class girl. Watch as the drama unfolds only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Fianancial Review
episodesList.summary: The Girl gang is still upto mischief as they fake an interview. Armaan gets grilled more and is told that there will be a financial review.  This scares Armaan, as looking into the books would mean the sexrets about Kohinoor will surface. How does Armaan deal with this issue? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: The Megastore
episodesList.summary: Armaan announces that Gulmohar should open a Mega store to increase its revenues; however the pressure of Financial review is also not out of the question. Meanwhile Jassi thinks to herself that no matter what Armaan feels, there's nobody who loves him more than Jassi. Will Armaan be able to execute his plan for a Megastore? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: Jassi Save a Kid
episodesList.summary: Jassi receives news that her father didn't get a heart attack, it was a unique mixture of gas and anxiety. Meanwhile, Jassi is running late for her board meeting at four. On the road she sees a kid getting hit by a car, almost killing him. Who was driving that car? How do the dots connect? Watch now exclusively on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Rich and Obnoxious
episodesList.summary: As it turns out, the woman who was driving the car and almost hit a baby, was infact the big client Gulmohar was counting on. She gets humiliated by Jassi on the road and holds a grudge against her. When she comes in for the meeting, she makes sure that Jassi understands who the boss was. How does Jassi get out of this mess?

episodesList.title: Jassi's Presentation
episodesList.summary: Jassi is worried about her presentation. Her father walks in and helps her make it; he motivates her to stand up for herself. Jassi tells Armaan that she was the one who almost got hit by the car and would appreciate it if someone else gave the presentation.  Will Armaan agree with Jassi? Watch now only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Jassi Humiliated
episodesList.summary: Jassi finishes her presentation with the help of her father. But she gets humiliated because by the client. She gets lectured on how bad her work was and how she doesn't have a future in the company. She suggests Jassi to get married. How does Jassi react to the humiliation? Watch as the drama unfolds on Sony LIV

episodesList.title: Jassi and Armaan Work Together
episodesList.summary: Jassi and Armaan start working on the news Presentation. This presentation would make or break the future of Gulmohar. Will Jassi and Armaan be able to pull off the impossible? Watch exclusively on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Tribute to Balvinder
episodesList.summary: As Jassi finishes her presentation she wants Billu's name at the beginning as he was the one who started it all. She wants the world to know that her father is the one who started it all and without him she would be nothing. Moments lead up to her presentation. How does it go? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: Missed Oppurtunity
episodesList.summary: The moment arrives and the name of the person who is supposed to give the presentation is taken. Unfortunately for Jassi, it wasn't her name. It was Mallika's name that was taken. How does this affect Jassi and her confidence? Watch now to find out. Exclusively on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Jassi Steps Aside
episodesList.summary: Jassi make it a point to step completely away from Armaan's life. She writes in her journal and expresses herself. Armaan too tells ker to keep away from situations where she would be of no use. How does Jassi fix the Suri family and save Gulmohar?

episodesList.title: Jassi Comes Up With a Plan
episodesList.summary: Jassi is convinced that a marriage counselor should be a priority for Armaan. She feels only a thirdperson perspective can save Mallika and Armaan's wedding. But how to convince someone to go for counseling when they don't want to? Watch now to find out. Onlyn on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Marriag Counseling
