episodesList.summary: Mallika and Armaan go for the counseling and have a terrible session. The counselor grills them and gets to the point where he concludes that Armaan isn't fond of Mallika. How does this session affect the couple? Watch now to find out only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Armaan Agrees to Try Again
episodesList.summary: Armaan finally agrees to reconsider his decision. He promises to give his and Mallika's relationship, a second try. Nandu tells Jassi not to interfere with someone else's life. Jassi makes it clear that she wishes the best for Armaan and just wants to see him and Mallika happy. Meanwhile, Purab calls Jassi and they have a brief talk.

episodesList.title: Another Party
episodesList.summary: Mallika and Armaan decide to throw a party celebrating them getting back together. At the party Mallika demands her ring and Armaan tries to avoid the question. Everyone comes to know that Purab is coming back. But why now? Is he upto something?  How does Jassi react after what had happened? Watch now only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Armaan Confesses
episodesList.summary: Armaan gets to know that Jassi was the one who set up the counselor. Nandu in the party,  tries his best to look impressive to the crowd. After knowing all this Armaan walks upto Jassi and opens his heart up. He tells her that he doesn't like Mallika and it is Jassi that he loves. How will Jassi react to this confession? Watch now only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Armaan Confesses His Love
episodesList.summary: Armaan confesses his love to Jassi. It is unbelievable to her. He asks her to reply with what she feels. She is still in shock. Will she confess her feelings too? How does this change the entire dynamics of the work culture? Watch this exclusive episode now on Sony LIV to find out.

episodesList.title: Raj Supports Armaan
episodesList.summary: Armaan proposes to Jassi, but Jassi does not give him a reply which upsets Armaan. Raj makes him understand that if Jassi gets confused and chooses someone else, Armaan will lose his love. Will Jassi confess too? Or is Raj just trying to misguide Armaan? Watch now to know what Jassi's answer is.

episodesList.title: Jassi Feels Jealous
episodesList.summary: Jassi feels disheartened when Mallika snatches the bouquet Armaan got for her. These little things bug Jassi a lot and she feels jealous. Armaan is excited to witness Jassi's reaction. Armaan and Raj sit back to get ideas. Will Armaan and Raj be able to execute their plans? There's only one way to find out.

episodesList.title: Jassi and Girlfriends
episodesList.summary: Jassi is having fun with her girl friends. They all get together to enjoy and make fun of others. Jassi is happy as she is also having a gala time.

episodesList.title: Jassi Gets Bed Full Of Chocolates
episodesList.summary: When Jassi wakes up, she finds her bed to be full of chocolates. Even her bedroom seems to be filled with chocolates. She feels the happiest and starts thinking about Armaan. What will her excitement make her do next? Who sent Jassi these chocolates for Jassi? Watch now to find out exclusively on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Jassi Meets Armaan At Midnight
episodesList.summary: Jassi calls Armaan late in the night as she wants to talk to him. Armaan gets concerned if Jassi is okay. But Jassi gets impatient and heads straight out for Armaan's house. Does she have a surprise for Armaan? What work does she have with him so late at night that she has to go to his place? Watch another episode of Jassi's adventures exclusively on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Jassi is On Cloud Nine
episodesList.summary: Jassi plays a prank on Armaan by calling him late at night. She just wants to play with him. Everyone in the house cannot understand Jassi's excitement. Will everyone come to know her secret love? Watch now as Jassi comes to terms with her emotions.

episodesList.title: Purab Stops Jassi's Way
episodesList.summary: Purab comes in Jassi's way as she is about to enter the office. He yells at Jassi as he was trying to contact her but couldn't reach her. Armaan gets angry seeing Jassi with Purab. How does Armaan handle this situation? Watch another episode of Jassi's adventures, exclusively on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Nandu is Curious
episodesList.summary: Jassi recalls all her conversations with Armaan and dances in happiness. Nandu is in deep thought and feels that he and Jassi can do things bigger and better. But he laughs at Jassi as her dressing sense wasn't the best. Nandu gets curious about what is going on with Jassi. Watch now only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Cold War Between Aryan and Raj
episodesList.summary: Raj finds Jassi in Aryan's cabin. He gets tensed if she has said something to him or not. But when Aryan comes, he starts questioning Raj. This questioning turns into a heated debate. Did Jassi open her mouth in front of Aryan? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: Purab Tries to Teach a Lesson
episodesList.summary: Purab is playing a game with Armaan and his company. No one knows that he has hired someone from their rivals, who is keeping a close eye on everyone, their moves, and motives. Basically, Purab wants to teach Armaan a lesson and hence the elaborate planning. Will Armaan be able to call Purab out on this conspiracy?

episodesList.title: Jassi has to Share a Cabin
episodesList.summary: Purab is still unsure why Armaan is treating Jassi as such a Valuable asset. His doubts are leading him to believe in a major conspiracy. Will he be able to unearth the truth? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: Purab Bribes Raghini
episodesList.summary: Purab thinks that Armaan is doing something wrong in his business. And he wants to save Jassi from him. He feels that this is a good enough reason to bribe his friend Ragini, to keep an eye on her. Is Purab right or will he be proven wrong? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: Raghini Makes Jassi Conscious
episodesList.summary: Ragini tries to convince Jassi that she is over-qualified for the job. Meanwhile, Maddy goes mad about the fashion show. While talking, Ragini asks Jassi about her and Armaan's love affair. Jassi gets conscious and tongue-tied. How does Jassi get out of this tricky situation?

episodesList.title: Jassi Witnesses Purab & Ragini
episodesList.summary: Jassi finds Ragini and Purab talking to each other. She is shocked to see that they know each other. Will she be able to know the reason behind why are they together? Or will Jassi and Purab make an excuse to get out of the situation? Watch now exclusively on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Raj and Ragini Spend Time
episodesList.summary: Raj and Ragini are together at his place. Ragini is on a mission to bring out the truth. But Raj is unaware of this idea of hers. Meanwhile, Jassi is concerned about what will she do if Raj reveals the truth to Ragini. How does she deal with this insecurity? Watch exclusively on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Jassi Confronts Purab
episodesList.summary: Jassi confronts Purab, and she gets to know the truth. Purab shows his concern towards Jassi and explains that he did all of this to save her from Armaan. Will Jassi believe Purab? Or will the trust between them break forever? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: Mallika is Petrified
episodesList.summary: Mallika gets to know about Jassi and Armaan. She is very disappointed as she did not know about all this. She questions Armaan if her love was not enough for him. What will Armaan say? How does he get out of this situation? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: Jassi does Not Accept Armaan
episodesList.summary: Jassi asks Armaan to go back to Mallika. She gives him an explanation that she does not want to come in between them. Armaan rejects Jassi's demands and refuses to go back. Can Jassi convince him? Will Armaan go back to Mallika? Watch now on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Raj and Armaan's Enactment
episodesList.summary: Armaan goes crazy when Jassi leaves him by rejecting him. He starts throwing things and expresses anger. Raj tries to make him understand that this is important for their business and he should get his act together. How does Armaan react and deal with this reaction? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: Jassi Sets Up a Date
episodesList.summary: Armaan sets up a date because Jassi insisted on doing so. But it becomes clear that he does not want to go with Mallika. He starts making excuses to avoid Mallika. Will Jassi be able to set up everything? Who will Arman go with? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: Nandu and His One-sided Love
episodesList.summary: Nandu is upset that his so-called lover does not understand his love. He thinks that he is being rejected just because he is not good looking and rich. Will he be able to overcome self-doubt? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: Nandu and Purab's Argument
episodesList.summary: Nandu bumps into Purab where he goes for a job interview. He denies working there as he thinks Purab is a part of the company. This leads to a heated argument between Nandu and Purab. Watch as the drama unfolds only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Nandu and Jassi Get Into Argument
episodesList.summary: Nandu and Jassi get into an argument about the job. Armaan makes his way into Jassi's house to announce something major. The entire family is thrilled and are eagerly waiting for him. Meanwhile, Purab congratulates Nandu for rejoining his company.

episodesList.title: Jassi's Family Celebrates Raj's Birthday
episodesList.summary: Armaan lies that it is Raj's birthday in order to give their plan a head start. And everyone in Jassi's family celebrates his birthday. Raj feels embarrassed because of Armaan's stupid idea. Does the family finally get to know the truth? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: Mallika Keeps an Eye On Jassi
episodesList.summary: Armaan hates it when Mallika puts allegations on Jassi. But then she discloses that Jassi is meeting Purab secretly outside the office. How will Armaan react to this? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: Purab Faces Jassi's Allegations
episodesList.summary: Jassi shouts at Purab and points out his bad deeds as he has been doing this all the time. She gets angry and spills out everything bad she had about Purab. Purab defends himself saying he did all for her. How does Jassi react to his defence? Watch this and more only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Aryan is Curious
episodesList.summary: Aryan gets curious about the cheques. As far as he knows, all transactions for Gulmohar were direct, so this cheque made no sense to him. He confronts Jassi and asks her about the cheques, Jassi avoids the questions and diverts attention towards Armaan. Will Aryan come to know whats happening in Gulmohar?

episodesList.title: Jassi is Unaware Of The Surprises
episodesList.summary: Jassi is disappointed as Armaan forgets her birthday. She is hurt as she gets scolded for someone else. She thinks she should start thinking about herself. She does not know that everyone has kept surprise for her.

episodesList.title: Jassi's Birthday Surprise
episodesList.summary: It is Jassi's birthday, and she has got a bag of surprises waiting for her. Her office colleagues throw a party for her and even her family has thrown a party that awaits her. Jassi's mom invites Armaan too. Will he come for Jassi's special day? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: Jassi's Realisation
episodesList.summary: Purab is actually concerned about Jassi. He even tries to make her understand that she is being played. But she does not trust her anytime. Later, she runs after Purab as he goes back from her place without wishing her. How does Purab react to this? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: Mallika's Overexcitement
episodesList.summary: Mallika and Aryan remember their childhood days. Everyone is excited about Armaan and Mallika's wedding. Armaan seems tensed regarding Jassi. Raj tells him to calm down. Jassi informs Armaan that Aryan is the mastermind behind all the chaos and not Purab. Mallika derides Jassi on her birthday which upsets her. Later, Purab and Armaan try to pacify Jassi in their own sweet ways.

episodesList.title: Jassi Finds Out
episodesList.summary: Purab is anxious for Jassi and is trying his level best to take her out of Armaan's emotional trap. Pari unknowingly reveals the news to Nandu about Armaan and Mallika's wedding. Nandu is concerned for Jassi now. Armaan and Raj plan to send Jassi on a field trip to keep her away from Mallika and Gulmohar. Jassi is unaware of all this!

episodesList.title: Jassi Rejects The Loan
episodesList.summary: Jassi finds out about Armaan and Mallika's wedding. She gets upset. Purab comes to meet Jassi which surprises Armaan. Meanwhile, Aryan warns Armaan, Raj, and Jassi. Jassi stops Armaan from taking a big step but Armaan asks her to trust him. Jassi comes to know that Armaan has taken a big loan against his house and company. She refuses the loan which bugs Armaan.

episodesList.title: New Ceo Jassi
episodesList.summary: Jassi always wishes the best for Gulmohar but Armaan and everyone else takes her wrong. Meanwhile, a few guests visit Jassi's place. Pammi Bua is confused to see Jassi's appearance, but Jassi manages the situation well. Stress still rules her mind. Next morning, Armaan talks her into endorsing the contract, supporting her. Will Jassi be up for the task?

episodesList.title: Gogi Needs Training
episodesList.summary: Mallika fumes in anger thinking about how Jassi has gone on leave without completing her task. Armaan calms her down but is worried as to how to tell everyone that Jassi is the new CEO. Purab shows up at Jassi's place. Mallika comes up with a new plan to enhance Gulmohar's business. Armaan is highly impressed to see her involvement.

episodesList.title: Gogi Likes Simi
episodesList.summary: Bebe and Jassi's Mother are interested in Purab and Jassi's marriage. Meanwhile, Gogi comes back home and refuses to marry Monika. Mallika takes a lot of interest in the official work now. Gogi shares his problem with Jassi. Later, Billu comes to know as to why Gogi refused to marry Monika. Gogi has developed a fondness towards Simi. Will Jassi & Purab be able to help Gogi?

episodesList.title: Mallika & Aryan are Surprised
episodesList.summary: Jassi refuses to sign a five lakh rupees cheque which bothers Armaan. Simmi agrees to marry Gogi and everyone jumps in excitement. Gogi and Simi's meeting ends on a good note. Mallika is busy handling the new assignment for Gulmohar. Armaan is tensed as usual. Later, Jassi's realizes that Gogi's ride has been pre-booked by someone else. Purab comes to their rescue.

episodesList.title: Armaan Tells His Father
episodesList.summary: Armaan informs Mr. Gupta about Jassi being the CEO. Raj asks Armaan to tell his father about it. Aryan, on the other hand, is up to something fishy. Later, he mistakenly reveals the whole mess in front of his father. Armaan's father calls for an urgent board meeting the next morning. What do they discuss in the meeting? Watch exclusively on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Urgent Board Meeting
episodesList.summary: Armaan's father calls for an urgent meeting. Aryan is nowhere to be seen. The meeting shall decide whether Jassi will be made the CEO or not. Meanwhile, Jassi notifies her girl gang that she is the CEO for six months but gets a shock when Armaan's father reveals the true facts in front of her. What will the board members decide?

episodesList.title: Aryan's Vote
episodesList.summary: Armaan and Raj's answer is in Jassi's favor but Armaan's father and mother's decision is against Jassi. Everyone is waiting for Aryan's vote now. Jassi is also in a dilemma. Billu and Purab cheer up Jassi's mood. Next morning, Aryan's vote will decide Jassi and Gulmohar's fate! Will his vote be in favor of Jassi?

episodesList.title: Nandu's Notification Shocks Jassi
episodesList.summary: Jassi comes home and reveals the news to everyone. Everyone jumps with excitement, be it her family or friends. Mallika still doesn't know about this news. Later, Nandu informs Jassi about a new assignment which will help them double their profits. Nandu's revelation leaves Jassi in a shock. How does Jassi react? Watch exclusively on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Jassi Misunderstands Purab
episodesList.summary: Jassi's term as Gulmohar's CEO begins. She calls for a meeting where she wants Armaan and Maddy to be there as well. Armaan fumes in anger. Maddy resigns on learning that he has to work under Jassi, but takes back his resignation for some reason. Jassi's suggestions and rules are appreciated by everyone. Later, Jassi and Purab enter into an argument, after which Jassi leaves.

episodesList.title: Sheetal is In Town
episodesList.summary: Purab and Jassi resolve their issues and settle down on the same thing. Bindiya, Maria, and Viru give their suggestions to Maddy for Sheetal's wedding. Maddy gears up to put his creativity into action. Jassi is very happy. Mallika expects Armaan to receive Sheetal at the airport. He, as usual, is late and Sheetal leaves in anger.

episodesList.title: Purab Gets The Contract
episodesList.summary: Sheetal does not like the ill-treatment she received at Gulmohar House but she definitely liked their concept for her wedding collection. She reaches Purab's office and is highly impressed with their gestures and hospitality. She agrees to give the contract to them but chooses to go by Gulmohar's concept. Purab informs Jassi about this. She is shocked at first and asks Purab to refuse this proposal.

episodesList.title: Ambuja Presentation
episodesList.summary: Sheetal is waiting eagerly for the presentation to start but Armaan is running late again. Sheetal tells Jassi, that even two minute wait was a long time for someone like Sheetal. Will Gulmohar be able to bag this contract and make a deal with the Ambujas? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: Face Off
episodesList.summary: Sheetal Ambuja asks Purab and Armaan to showcase their collection to her and whosoever's collection catches her eye, will get the contract. Both the parties give in their best. Jassi tries to put in a little more effort into it. Whose collection will Sheetal choose?

episodesList.title: Mallika is Back
episodesList.summary: Gulmohar gets the contract. Armaan doesn't seem to be happy and takes this on his ego. Aryan mocks Armaan. Mallika informs Armaan about her homecoming. She comes to know about Jassi being the CEO when she reaches Gulmohar. Meanwhile, Jassi gets a shock to realize that her parents are thinking of her and Purab's wedding.

episodesList.title: Mallika vs Jassi
episodesList.summary: Armaan is up to something fishy, and Mallika is not comfortable working under Jassi. Meanwhile, Nandu and Jassi's mother tries to convince her to think about Purab and her relationship. Will Jassi give it a thought? Watch now to find out. Only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Press Conference At Gulmohar
episodesList.summary: Armaan's father organizes a press conference at Gulmohar. Pari informs Mallika about it. Armaan and Mallika are handling it in their own way when a journalist interrogates them about Jasmeet Walia. Jassi answers all their questions with ease but leaves when asked to comment about her and Purab's relationship. Later, Purab takes Jassi out for dinner.

episodesList.title: Jassi is In News
episodesList.summary: Journalist Samar troubles Jassi and follows her everywhere. Journalist Gehenna tries to find out the truth as well but in a positive way. Armaan has something on his mind and is planning a big game. Mallika looks around for evidence in the whole office. Samar reaches Jassi's home and questions her parents as well. The press reporters are all after Jassi!

episodesList.title: Jassi Finds Everything Unfair
episodesList.summary: Since Jassi has been troubled a lot by the press reporters, her friends want to take revenge and bring her life back on track. Jassi is disappointed as she gets this in return, despite doing so much for the company. Will she lose all will to fight for a losing cause? Watch how Jassi deals with the pressure. Only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Reporters Target Armaan
episodesList.summary: Reporters enter the company without permission. But this time Armaan is their target. Jassi overhears what Armaan says to Mallika in order to mislead the reporters. What will Armaan do? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: Purab Meets Jassi's Parents
episodesList.summary: Purab comes to meet Jassi's parents. He tries to make them understand that they should not be embarrassed with all the news. But being a family, they all are concerned for Jassi. Watch as the drama unfolds. only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Nandu Shares His Feelings
episodesList.summary: Armaan is not able to understand his feelings for whatever he has done for Jassi. He thinks that he has overdone it, which is why so many problems are happening. Meanwhile, Nandu shares his feelings for Jassi with her. Is Nandu serious? How does Jassi react to Nandu's feelings? Watch now on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Jassi's Problems Increases
episodesList.summary: Jassi shares her problem with her father, telling him that there is someone in the office who doesn't have the company's best interest in mind. Purab comes to tell his story. But seeing Jassi so tensed, he gets concerned. How does Jassi deal with this situation? Watch now on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Everyone Blames Armaan
episodesList.summary: Armaan does not understand why Jassi is avoiding him. Nandu surprises Jassi by giving her company during her lunch breaks. Meanwhile, Jassi's friends get together and discuss the situation and end up blaming Armaan for all the chaos. Will normalcy return in the office? There's only one way to find out.

episodesList.title: Who is The Real Culprit?
episodesList.summary: Jassi realizes that Armaan is playing tricks with her. The girl gang also tries to notify her about this. She confronts Armaan and charges him for all the mess, but he remains quiet. Purushottam Suri calls for an urgent board meeting regarding Gulmohar's draft cheque, which goes missing. Jassi accuses Armaan at first but eavesdrops Viru exposing the real culprit's name to the girl gang and apprehends that Armaan is not at fault. Who is the culprit then?

episodesList.title: Jassi Apologizes to Armaan
episodesList.summary: Armaan feels sad that everyone thinks ill of him. The girl gang decides to apologize to him. Mallika tries to find Armaan but is unable to find him anywhere. Jassi apologizes to Armaan. Later, Purab shows up at Jassi's place and Jassi agrees for the alliance.

episodesList.title: Armaan Acts Pricey
episodesList.summary: Mallika talks to Purushottam about Armaan, and he assures her that Armaan is not avoiding her. Aryan warns Mallika about Armaan. Mallika cancels the dinner date with Armaan and Armaan brings the food for his office employees. Armaan comes to know about Jassi's alliance. She invites Armaan for a small party and he refuses.

episodesList.title: Armaan Wants to Meet Jassi Alone
episodesList.summary: Jassi regrets saying yes to Armaan for an after-dinner meet. Meanwhile, the girl gang is happy to learn about Purab's popularity. Jassi shares a secret with Bindiya and Maithili and Mallika asks Armaan to go to a new restaurant with her, but he refuses. Pari on the other hand is brainwashing Mallika. Watch exclusively on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Jassi's House Party
episodesList.summary: The girl gang reaches Jassi's place for the party. Armaan also leaves for her home. Mallika and Pari follow Armaan's car. Meanwhile, at Jassi's place, everyone has a gala time with Jassi and her family. Armaan and Purab, coincidentally meet in a gift shop. Watch now on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Party is Over
episodesList.summary: Billu gets emotional and shares these emotions with Purab. Purab, on the contrary, is very happy to have met this beautiful family. Jassi informs her mother and Bebe that she has to meet Armaan after the party. Billu meets Armaan in the driveway and forces him to come home and enjoy the party. Everyone is happy to see Armaan.

episodesList.title: Purab is Uncomfortable
episodesList.summary: Armaan takes Jassi for a cup of tapri chai. Purab spots both of them together. Mallika also doubts Armaan's intention of going to Jassi's place. Purab is lost in deep thoughts. Mallika mocks Jassi in the office hallway.  Purab is uncomfortable with Armaan's constant interference in Jassi's life.

episodesList.title: Armaan is Changing
episodesList.summary: Armaan lectures Jassi about her and Purab's bond in a positive way. Viru informs Jassi that the computers have crashed and the data is not traceable. Armaan pitches in to help. It seems Armaan is changing his ways and is showing a keen interest in Gulmohar's goodwill. Is Armaan really changing, or he has some evil plans?

episodesList.title: Classic Megastore Contract
episodesList.summary: Purab and Jassi resolve their issues. Armaan calls Jassi and Informs her about a new Classic Megastore contract and asks her to read it the next morning. Jassi informs Purab about this and his company 3T Fashions, take their steps back from bidding for this contract.

episodesList.title: Jassi Seems Disturbed
episodesList.summary: Gulmohar and 3T Fashion houses are gearing up to prepare a proposal for Classic Megastore. Both the fashion houses are called for a meeting. Meenakshi, the managing director of Classic Megastore is overwhelmed to see Purab. This does not go down to well with Jassi! Watch as the drama unfolds on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Meenakshi is After Purab
episodesList.summary: Mallika and Raj discuss that there are high chances that Meenakshi might give the contract to Purab since they know each other for a long time. Meenakshi and Purab meet. Purab notifies Jassi about his and Meenakshi's bond. Billu, on the other hand, is getting hyper to book Jassi and Purab's engagement date.

episodesList.title: Jassi is Ms. Misfit
episodesList.summary: Meenakshi gives a gift to Purab. This does not go down too well with Jassi and she gets upset. Meenakshi reaches Gulmohar Fashion House for a meeting. She is impressed with Jassi's presentation but indirectly mocks her down. Later, at Purab's place, Meenakshi tries to flirt with him, but Purab knows his limitations.

episodesList.title: Purab's Mystery Girl
episodesList.summary: Meenakshi gives the contract to 3T Fashion House. Everyone insults Jassi over this. Purab urges Meenakshi to giveaway the contract to Gulmohar. She also shows her excitement to meet Purab's mystery girl. Purab invites her to the Diwali party and asks her to meet his mystery girl there itself! Will this work out for Purab? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: A Silly Mistake
episodesList.summary: Purab invites everyone for the Diwali party. Everyone shows excitement. Jassi is a bit nervous about her looks but she still manages to hold a happy face at his party. Purab is excited to introduce Jassi as his future wife at the party. But Meenakshi pops up and people mistake her to be his mystery girl.

episodesList.title: Meenakshi Upsets Jassi
episodesList.summary: Meenakshi is shocked to know that Jassi is the mystery girl. She announces in front of the audience about Jassi and Purab. Jassi and Purab's first dance also doesn't go well. Meenakshi insults Jassi in front of Purab and she leaves the party crying. It's an awkward moment for Jassi! Watch how Jassi deals with the situation.

episodesList.title: Gulmohar Warehouse On Fire
episodesList.summary: Jassi is hurt because of Meenakshi's words. She doubts her own looks which lowers her self-confidence. She mentions all of this in her secret diary. Purab is worried as to why Jassi took everything to heart. Meenakshi tries to call Purab, but he avoids her calls. Nandu pacifies Jassi and makes her smile. Later, Armaan informs her that Gulmohar's warehouse is on fire. Will Gulmohar be okay?

episodesList.title: Meenakshi Makes an Offer
episodesList.summary: Jassi calls for an urgent board meeting. She is equally upset about the warehouse news as they couldn't save any consignment. Armaan is in tears as well. Jassi and others decide to work together and solve this problem. Later, Meenakshi meets her and offers a contract to recover the present losses Gulmohar is going through.

episodesList.title: Jassi Refuses Meenakshi's Offer
episodesList.summary: Everyone believes in Jassi and her caliber to save Gulmohar from such a crisis. Jassi calls Nandu to take his advice. Pari brainwashes Mallika again. Mallika pacifies Armaan but  Armaan breaks into tears again. Everyone is upset with Jassi for refusing Meenakshi's offer. She is in great tension again! Watch now exclusively on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Purab Leaves Jassi
episodesList.summary: Jassi is in a dilemma. On the other hand,  Purab is worried about the situation too. Jassi decides to take the project which Meenakshi had offered. Balwant scolds Jassi and urges her to talk to Purab. Meenakshi gives the contract to Jassi and appreciates her hard work. Later, she goes to Purab's house but gets a shock as Purab leaves. How does she react? Watch now on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Jassi Makes a Big Mistake
episodesList.summary: Jassi makes a big mistake this time. It seems she is not careful about anything. Mallika htells her that she will very soon lose everything, be it Purab or Gulmohar's CEO-ship. Bindiya and Maithili also get caught by the police. Aryan comes to know Jassi's mistake and is eagerly waiting for something big to happen at Gulmohar House.

episodesList.title: Jassi Thinks She is The Problem
episodesList.summary: Jassi is unable to understand why things are going wrong with her. She blames her destiny as she loses the person whenever she gets close to that person. She blames herself for everything wrong happening in her family. How does Jassi get out of this guilt?

episodesList.title: Mallika and Aryan On The Same Boat
episodesList.summary: Armaan gets funds for the company, but Aryan disapproves of it. He blames Jassi for signing the cheque despite knowing the truth. Mallika also defends Aryaan and stops Armaan from doing stupid things. How does Jassi feel about this mess? There's only one way to find out. Watch now on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Everyone Awaits Purab
episodesList.summary: Celebrations are at the doorsteps in Jassi's family. Everyone except Jassi's mom is happy. She is tensed what if something bad happens? Jassi recalls whatever was written in the letter. Will Purab show up? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: Purab Breaks The Engagement
episodesList.summary: Armaan motivates Jassi as she has always motivated others. Even Raj tries to uplift her mood. Raj is not aware that Purab denied the engagement. Armaan tries hard to make Jassi smile. Watch as the drama unfolds on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Armaan Asks Jassi Out
episodesList.summary: Jassi misunderstands everything and everyone. She feels that Armaan is just showing his sympathy. Armaan asks Jassi to spend a day with him. But Armaan this time actually wants to spend time with Jassi. Will Jassi go out with him? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: Jassi Stays Out Late At Night
episodesList.summary: Armaan shows his gestures to Jassi. He surprises her with candles, soft toys, and dinner. She feels happy and enjoys the moment. But she forgets to inform her parents that she will be late. The whole family is tensed. Does Jassi get in trouble? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: Jassi Thanks Armaan
episodesList.summary: Armaan and Jassi get close just in flow. Meanwhile, Mallika calls Armaan and asks him to come to her. By that time Jassi disappears. Maria and Veeru spend their own time in a restaurant. Jassi thanks Armaan for whatever he did for her. Watch the full episode on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Armaan and Raj's Bad Intentions
episodesList.summary: Raj and Armaan discuss about what they are doing with Jassi. Armaan realizes that if Jassi comes to know that they used her to save Gulmohar, she will not be able to handle herself. Will Armaan be able to hide this? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: Mallika Unhappy With Armaan's Ignorance
episodesList.summary: Mallika and Armaan get into a heated argument. Mallika again starts ranting about their love. Maddy meets an old friend who is a great model. Maddy mocks Pari in front of everyone, which embarrasses her a lot. Watch as the drama unfolds on SinyLiv.

episodesList.title: Mallika & Jassi's Meet Up
episodesList.summary: Mallika takes Jassi out for lunch. They have a one-to-one talk with each other. Mallika asks Jassi to stay away from Armaan as that is hampering her and Armaan's relationship. Will Jassi listen to Mallika and back down or will she put her foot down? Watch now only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Jassi Finds The Truth
episodesList.summary: Jassi finds letters that Raj had written to Armaan. Those letters list tactics on how to influence Jassi. Jassi is heartbroken when she finds out that all of this was just a lie. She feels shattered. How does Jassi deal with this heartbreaking truth? Watch now exclusively on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Jassi Keeps a Proof
episodesList.summary: Jassi behaves indifferently with everyone. She takes a printout of all the letters that Raj had written to Armaan. Jassi lies to her friends and everyone questions her about it. Armaan is angry with Jassi because she let Netra go.

episodesList.title: Everyone Consoles Jassi
episodesList.summary: Maddy overhears when everyone is making fun of him. Jassi is found crying in the corner and she does not want to talk to anyone. Jassi is not able to stop her tears. How will she handle all of this? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: Jassi Locks Herself
episodesList.summary: Jassi decides to leave the job. But she is adamant about leaving the company. She is questioned about her and Armaan's relationship. She wants herself to be locked in a room for days and avoid all the attention. Will she be able to cope up with the pressure? Watch now only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Jassi Recalls Armaan's Tricks
episodesList.summary: Jassi illustrates the whole scenario to Nandu. And Nandu tries to comfort her. She recalls all the moments Armaan tried to come close to her. She keeps breaking down while recalling all of it. Will Jassi be okay? Watch now on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Did Jassi Love Blindly?
episodesList.summary: When Nandu scolds Jassi, she explains how people go blind in love. Jassi is unable to understand how could she be so stupid and not see what was happening. Jassi shows the letters to Nandu. How does Nandu react? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: Jassi Misbehaves With Everyone
episodesList.summary: Jassi misbehaves with all her friends. She replies rudely to everyone in the office. She keeps insulting her looks in front of all. She explains how she could not sleep all night. She is scared if every night is going to be like this. How does Jassi get out of this?

episodesList.title: Jassi's Lesson
episodesList.summary: Jassi hears her friends talking about men and relationships. She now wants to teach Armaan a lesson, something that he will remember for the rest of his life. Armaan gets furious at Jassi when he finds out she is worried about Kohinoor and Nandu. What does Jassi do? What is her plan? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: Jassi's Date
episodesList.summary: Jassi had a dream where she slaps Armaan in front of everyone. Nandu and Jassi have planned and exciting event. Mallika sends Pari as she wants to check on Armaan and wants to know what he is doing, but she isn't allowed to enter. Nandu enters the event as Jassi's date.

episodesList.title: Armaan's Jealousy
episodesList.summary: Armaan grabs Jassi by her hand and pulls her to a corner intending to talk to her. Jassi does not like Armaan's behaviour and refuses to talk to him. She also makes it clear that she will be going out with Nandu. Armaan gets extremely jealous and is furious on them for treating him this way.

episodesList.title: Jassi's Games
episodesList.summary: Armaan is angry with Jassi for not coming for dinner and instead of going with Nandu. Jassi keeps Armaan on his toes by playing games with him. Armaan gets irritated by her behaviour and tries to bully her, but Jassi does not take any mistreatment the way her past self would and puts Armaan in his place. Nandini has joined hands with Gulmohar and Armaan is happy to have her on board with the team.

episodesList.title: Guarantee Papers
episodesList.summary: Nandu and Jassi are coming up with a strategy to tackle Armaan and Raj so that they do not get trapped in their emotional blackmail. Mallika comes back from Goa to shock Armaan by informing him about Jassi's relationship with Nandu. Nandini tries to make Jassi feel better, but she is very upset.

episodesList.title: Nandu's Mercedes
episodesList.summary: Nandu and Jassi buy a new car. They flaunt their car in front of Gulmohar which shocks Pari and Mallika. Jassi's girl gang is very excited to see her new car. Pari tries to flirt with Nandu to get his attention. The girl gang leaves no chance to mock Pari and irritate her.

episodesList.title: Armaan's Suspicions
episodesList.summary: Mandira Bedi shows up at Gulmohar's house. She also educates Jassi about confidence and women empowerment. Armaan and Raj discuss Nandu and Jassi's ongoing so-called relationship. Jassi overhears their conversation. Mallika wishes to spend some quality time with Armaan.

episodesList.title: Jassi In a Mercedes
episodesList.summary: Jassi will never be able to forgive Armaan and Raj. At home, Jassi gets into an argument with her father. Armaan dreams of Jassi in Mallika's presence, this leaves her shocked. Pari is all set to meet Nandu. Jassi shows off her new car to her colleagues. Armaan, Mallika, and Raj are shocked to see Jassi in a Mercedes.

episodesList.title: Jassi is Determined
episodesList.summary: Raj's mind is again at work and he comes up with a plan for Armaan to convince Jassi. Jassi, now mentally stronger, is determined ot not let Armaan influence her decisions any longer. Who will be successful and who will give in?

episodesList.title: Armaan Goes Crazy
episodesList.summary: Armaan is determined to prove Jassi his love for her. But Jassi believes that 'ignorance is bliss' and goes back home. Armaan loses his composure and insists that Jassi should stay back.

episodesList.title: Armaan Offers a Partnership
episodesList.summary: Armaan asks Jassi to prepare a balance sheet with altered numbers. He wants to fake company's financial situation in order to save it. He also offers Jassi a partnership. Will she go do the unethical task and take the partnership?

episodesList.title: Jassi and Nandu's Date
episodesList.summary: Jassi and Nandu go out to a restaurant as a date. Armaan, coincidentally is also there, but Jassi ignores his presence and carries on. This annoys Armaan and he starts drinking. Will Armaan create a scene? Or is this Jassi's trick?

episodesList.title: Mallika is Excited For Wedding
episodesList.summary: Mallika is over the moon with her wedding. She plans a grand ceremony with all the best things and no compromises. She gets terrified when she sees Armaan drunk and out of control.

episodesList.title: Armaan Becomes a Drunkard
episodesList.summary: Armaan shouts on top of his voice and tells Raj how heart-broken he was to see Jassi and Nandu together. He can not understand Jassi's behavior and carries on drinking.

episodesList.title: Does Jassi have Feelings?
episodesList.summary: Nandu comes to receive Jassi outside her office. But then she asks him to stop acting, as she does not want to continue this act as she does not want to hurt Armaan anymore.

episodesList.title: Nandu and Armaan's Fight
episodesList.summary: Nandu and Armaan get into a dramatic fight. Armaan hits Nandu, as he cannot see Nandu and Jassi together. The drama takes place in front of all office colleagues. Maddy insults Armaan a lot.

episodesList.title: Jassi Taunts Armaan & Raj
episodesList.summary: Armaan overreacts as Jassi does not prepare fake balance sheets. She smartly taunts Armaan and Raj by saying what they are doing is unethical and illegal. Will Raj understand her indication?

episodesList.title: Armaan is Devastated
episodesList.summary: Aryan and Mallika plan to bring out the truth Jassi has been hiding. Aryan somehow managed to get information about Kohinoor and tells the truth to everyone. Armaan is shocked and devastated.

episodesList.title: Gulmohar's Fashion Show
episodesList.summary: It is a big day for Gulmohar as they have their fashion show. This show has to be a hit for the company to survive. It is a big day for everyone as well.

episodesList.title: Jassi Ultimately Decides
episodesList.summary: Nandu is upset with Jassi as he is unable to forget the moments they shared. Jassi decides to return everything she got from the company after the board meeting. Nandu tries to make her understand for a last time.

episodesList.title: Armaan is Terrified
episodesList.summary: Mallika insults Jassi and Jassi snaps back to her. She also reveals that after the board meeting, she will quit the company. Everyone is eagerly waiting for Jassi to come so that they can begin with the meeting. Jassi reveals the facts to everyone. Armaan and Raj are terrified.

episodesList.title: Jassi Notifies The Truth
episodesList.summary: Aryan tells the truth to everyone and reveals that Gulmohar is currently making a big loss. He also reveals the fact about Kohinoor, which is under Jassi's name. Armaan and Aryan get into a fight. Jassi explains everything and notifies that the last page has her signed resignation as well.

episodesList.title: Mallika Stands Shocked
episodesList.summary: A new chairman will be decided on Gulmohar. Armaan is asked to resign from his post. Jassi goes to her room and packs her things. Mallika urges to go through her things to be sure Jassi doesn't take away anything important. Jassi shows Mallika all the things and tells her about Armaan and Raj's schemes.

episodesList.title: Jassi Leaves Gulmohar
episodesList.summary: Mallika cancels her plans to marry Armaan. Purushottam and Ila are very upset. Armaan confesses his love for Jassi and wishes he could spend his life with her. Raj is very surprised. Jassi rushes and packs her clothes as she has to leave for Mauritius with Nandini for the VLCC Fashion Show.

episodesList.title: Armaan is Injured
episodesList.summary: Mallika confronts Armaan and narrates everything whatever Jassi told her. She is heart-broken due to Armaan actions. Armaan, on the contrary, leaves her and rushes to see Jassi. On the way to the airport, Jassi witnesses Armaan having accident.

episodesList.title: Jassi Helps Armaan
episodesList.summary: Jassi is dumbfounded to she see Armaan being attacked by a group of gangsters. Armaan is injured and bleeding. Jassi takes him to the hospital against her will.

episodesList.title: Nandu Misbehaves With Armaan
episodesList.summary: Armaan reaches Jassi's home but finds no one as everyone went to the airport to drop Jassi. Jassi's father does not let Armaan know where is she. Nandu's behaviour towards Armaan is rude.

episodesList.title: Jassi's Trip to Mauritius
episodesList.summary: Jassi goes to Mauritius with her friend for a fashion show. She gets to know that Armaan visited her family when she calls them. Jassi is unaware that the fashion show is organised by Purab. How will she react when she finds out?

episodesList.title: Jassi Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: Purab and Jassi bump into each other at the fashion show in Mauritius. Jassi feels uncomfortable to meet Purab at the event. She runs away from the place and is nowhere to be seen.

episodesList.title: Purab Comes Jassi's Way
episodesList.summary: Nandini is concerned about Jassi as she does not want to look pretty. She consults a friend and asks for her help to convince Jassi. Jassi is enjoying her time in Mauritius, suddenly Purab stops her on the way. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Nandu Replaces Jassi
episodesList.summary: Jassi does not want to take Nandini's help and denies all her assistance. Armaan calls Jassi's house as she was supposed to attend a meeting. But no one tells him the truth. Nandu is ready to take Jassi's place in the meeting.

episodesList.title: Purab Saves Jassi's Life
episodesList.summary: Jassi gets lost in her thoughts and does not realise where she is going. While walking, lost in her toughts, she reaches the edge of the shore where taking another step would drowned her. But surprisingly, Purab was there to catch and save her.

episodesList.title: Jassi Gets a Haircut
episodesList.summary: Nandini is hell-bent to help Jassi. So she takes her to the parlor and gives Jassi a new haircut. Purab gets concerned as he cannot find Jassi. He can't believe his eyes to see Jassi with her new hairdo.

episodesList.title: Armaan Misses Jassi
episodesList.summary: Jassi has a strong intuition that Armaan needs her. She leaves the party abruptly and secludes herself from others. Armaan misses Jassi and keeps on drinking.

episodesList.title: Jassi and Purab Spend Time
episodesList.summary: Jassi and Purab spend quality time in Mauritius. Jassi has started liking her current quality of life. Raj tries to make Armaan understand that Jassi has changed, but he is not ready to accept it.

episodesList.title: Mallika is Fed Up
episodesList.summary: Mallika is tired of Armaan's behavior as he keeps on murmuring about Jassi.

episodesList.title: Purab is Awe Struck
episodesList.summary: Purab is waiting for Jassi in the hotel's lobby. Jassi transforms herself and puts on a saree. Purab compliments her as he finds her very beautiful. It is a special day for Jassi.

episodesList.title: Jassi Wants to Go Back
episodesList.summary: When Purab gives Jassi a token of appreciation, she feels humiliated. She insults Purab in front of the whole media. She insists that she wants to go back home.

episodesList.title: Jassi's Family Insulted
episodesList.summary: Police comes to search Jassi's house. They insult Jassi's father and her family, but were unable to find anything. It was Mallika's ploy to try to insult Jassi and her family and to find out the truth.

episodesList.title: Jassi is a Fighter
episodesList.summary: Jassi finds out that her family has been insulted and humiliated from the news. Nandini consoles Jassi as she dettached herself from everything. She helps Jassi find the will and strength to fight.

episodesList.title: Armaan Interrupts The Meeting
episodesList.summary: Jassi books a flight under an alias. Armaan abruptly interrupts the meeting and asks everyone to leave the room. Mallika is can not contemplate Armaan's behavior.

episodesList.title: Family Abandons Jassi
episodesList.summary: Jassi thinks of starting everything afresh. She collaborates with Purab and starts her new work. She calls her home, but her father denies her existence and asks Jassi to not call back again.

episodesList.title: Jassi's Father Denies Mallika
episodesList.summary: Mallika and Armaan visit Jassi's house. Mallika requests Bebe that she wants to clear the air between them and it will only take a little bit of their time. But Jassi's father does not want to associate with them. Will they be able to sort things out?

episodesList.title: Raj is Mistaken
episodesList.summary: Raj bumps into Jassi in another office. He is unable to undentify her as she has tranformed herself into Jessica. Raj gets the signals wrong and is under the impression that this girl likes him.

episodesList.title: Jassi Gets Nightmares
episodesList.summary: Raj and Purab get into a heated argument as he accuses Jassi. Jassi gets nightmares about Armaan and Mallika and how she is being held accountable for all the chaos.

episodesList.title: Armaan Gets Arrested
episodesList.summary: Police arrests Armaan from Jassi's place. The press is outside to cover everything onlive news. Armaan confesses that all of this was done by him and it has nothing to do with Jassi or her family.

episodesList.title: Jassi or Jessica
episodesList.summary: Jassi has found herself in a crisis and starts to wonder wether what she is doing is right or wrong. Her past haunts her, while her presents gives her hope her to build up a strong future. What will she choose?

episodesList.title: Jassi Visits Her Home
episodesList.summary: Jassi is surprised to see Armaan in front of her house, but she avoids him. She is happy to be back and reunited her family. Unfortunately, there is no one at home as everyone is in the hospital with Bebeji.

episodesList.title: Jassi Breaks Down
episodesList.summary: Jassi clears the hospital bills but does not disclose her identity. Everyone wonders who was the mystery person that paid the bills. Jassi breaks down when she sees her family in difficult times. Armaan thinks he saw Jassi. Will he find oput the truth?

episodesList.title: Everyone's Plans
episodesList.summary: Jassi relives her memories with Armaan and all the special moments they shared. She starts crying as they are not a  reality. Armaan eagerly waits to meet Jassi. Raj, on the other hand, wants to meet Jessica. Aryan and Mallika have their own plans.

episodesList.title: Jassi Walks The Ramp
episodesList.summary: It is a big day for Jassi as she will walk the ramp for Purab. She will be recognised as the new face of fashion. She walks the ramp and everyone has compliments for her. She prays that everything to get better in her life.

episodesList.title: Mallika and Aryan Disapprove
episodesList.summary: Mallika and Aryan find it strange how a model is being given the limelight in the fashion industry and not the product. Mallika suspects there is some other angle to the story. Nandini and Mallika meet and to have a discussion about this model.

episodesList.title: Armaan Doesn't Recognise Jassi
episodesList.summary: Armaan and Jassi finally face each other. But surprisingly, Armaan does not recognise Jassi in her new looks. Armaan shows no interest in Purab's fashion show.

episodesList.title: Mallika's Masterplan
episodesList.summary: Mallika devises another masterplan to save Gulmohar. She asks Armaan to fake that he is in love with Jessica and make her to fall in love with him. Will Armaan agree to go down the slippery slope again?

episodesList.title: No One Recognises Jassi
episodesList.summary: Armaan goes out with Jessica with same old notions. Jassi returns to the hospital as Jessica to apologise, but Nandu, Jassi's mother and Bebe fail to recognise her. How will Jassi feel about the situation?

episodesList.title: Jessica Agrees With Armaan
episodesList.summary: Armaan tries to make a deal with Jessica and she finally agrees to his terms. Mallika is super excited about this deal and plans to beat Purab in his game.

episodesList.title: Jessica has a Secret Admirer
episodesList.summary: Jassi gets an envelope from one of Jessica's secret admirers. The person follows her everywhere, like a stalker, and this time he has sent her a card and a videotape. Watch to find out what is in the video.

episodesList.title: Jassi is Back In Gulmohar
episodesList.summary: Jassi is back in Gulmohar, but this time as Jessica. This time she is not going to let anyone push her arpund. She plans to smartly take revenge and put everyone in their place. Mallika gets embarrassed in front of everyone.

episodesList.title: Jassi is Completely Focussed
episodesList.summary: Jassi starts putting her terms and conditions in front of Mallika and Armaan. She is completely focussed to deal with the situation and take everything under her control.

episodesList.title: Tables have Turned
episodesList.summary: Jassi takes revenge from Mallika. She makes her go through the same embarrassment that Jassi had to during in her earlier stage of work at Gulmohar. Will this put Jassi's mind at ease?

episodesList.title: Nandu Misses Jassi
episodesList.summary: Jessica and Armaan are in Jassi's place for lunch. Nandu invites them for lunch. When Jessica tries to be friendly with Nandu, he stops her as he is misses Jassi very much.

episodesList.title: Mallika Discloses Her Crime
episodesList.summary: Mallika is unaware that Jassi and Jessica are the same person. She discloses how she manipulated the company's finances and balance sheet and left no evidence. Mallika also admits that she had put all the blame on Jassi.

episodesList.title: Reporters Troll Mallika
episodesList.summary: Jassi changes the bank details and password as she plans to expose Mallika in front of the world. Meanwhile, reporters gather around Mallika and ask her if all of this was a publicity stunt?

episodesList.title: Mallika is Afraid
episodesList.summary: Mallika plans to calm the storm by giving the money from her account to Gulmohar that she stole. But she is devastated to find out that her bank balance is nil. She is shook to her core. Will Mallika be caught?

episodesList.title: Nandu and Jassi Reunite
episodesList.summary: Nandu keeps stalking Jassi as he believes Jessica is Jassi. He starts following her at the office and her house. When he is confident about his suspicions, he confronts Jassi and they reunite.

episodesList.title: Jessica Leaves Mallika Thinking
episodesList.summary: Mallika and Raj are wondering about Jassi. Bebe wakes up after seeing a bad dream. Mallika overthinks about Jassi and Jessica and tries to find clues to her problem. Jassi asks Purab to choose a dress for her but he refrains from helping her. Mallika overhears Jessica telling Purab that Jassi is no more which makes her think that Jassi is dead. Jessica reaches her home and Billu asks her to dance with her.

episodesList.title: Armaan Begs Jessica
episodesList.summary: Armaan and Jessica Jassi's place for dinner. Mallika meets Aryan to discuss Jessica Bedi. Mallika goes to Jessica's place and is surprised to find Purab there. Later, Armaan takes Jessica to Raj's place which reminds her of the past incidents. At Raj's place, Armaan gets emotional and narrates the whole story related to Jassi and begs Jessica to arrange a meeting with Jassi.

episodesList.title: Mallika & Aryan Play It Evil
episodesList.summary: Jessica meets Nandu and tells him that Armaan is in love with Jassi. Armaan feels Jessica is Jassi and discusses this with Raj. Nandu warns Jassi to be cautious. Mallika and Aryan request the police to investigate in Jassi's case. Meanwhile, Jessica and Nandu are studying Gulmohar's documents when Armaan intervenes. Jessica informs him that Jassi wants to talk to the press.

episodesList.title: Jessica's Arrest Warrant
episodesList.summary: Raj is taken into custody and overhears police talking about Jassi's murder. He also learns that Jessica killed Jassi. Meanwhile, Jessica informs everyone that Jassi is coming back. Later, police officials arrest Jessica for killing Jassi. Armaan is shocked with these turn of events.

episodesList.title: Jessica Killed Jassi
episodesList.summary: Jessica is in news again for killing Jassi. She confesses that she killed Jassi because the world was torturing her. Everyone misunderstands her words and they are still unaware that Jessica is Jassi. Mallika and Aryan are happy.

episodesList.title: Armaan Doubts Jessica
episodesList.summary: Jessica plans to teach Mallika a lesson and asks Purab and Nandu to keep quiet. Mallika trolls Nandu and Jessica. Armaan is now suspicious about Jessica too. But Jessica has something else brewing up in her mind.

episodesList.title: Mr. Thukral's Questions
episodesList.summary: Jessica is in court fighting to prove her real identity to everyone. Everyone doubts her, but she stands in silence. Mr. Thukral's never-ending questions puts Jessica in trouble but she chooses to stay quiet. He also questions Raj, Armaan and even her girl gang.

episodesList.title: Mallika Talks Rubbish
episodesList.summary: Billu meets Jessica in Jail and enquires about Jassi. He is able to figure out that Jessica is Jassi. He notifies Bebe and Amrit about it. Later, in the court, Mallika stands face-to-face with Jessica and speaks in awe of Jassi. Jessica Bedi fights for herself and fights Mallika and Mr. Thukral back.

episodesList.title: Jessica Reveals The Truth
episodesList.summary: Jessica objects Mr. Thukral's accusations. She asks for permission to defend herself and the court agrees. She cross questions Mallika which makes Mallika nervous. She reveals the truth to everybody and discloses her true identity.

episodesList.title: Court Wants Evidence
episodesList.summary: Mr. Thukral asks Jessica to prove that she is Jassi and not Jessica. He notifies that the court needs concrete proof and not emotional statements. Jessica is now trapped. How will she gather all the evidence?

episodesList.title: Who is Indra Bhargava?
episodesList.summary: Armaan and Raj are is search for lawyers who can fight Jassi's case. Purab calls Indra and requests her to fight Jassi's case. She refuses to fight against Mr. Thukral. Armaan reaches Indra's house and begs her for help. Will Indra Bhargava agree to help Jassi?

episodesList.title: Indra Meets Jassi
episodesList.summary: Indra meets Jassi in the jail and urges to know the full story. She promises to help her prove her identity to everyone. Purab leaves for Mauritius in search of any evidence that will help prove Jessica's identity. Later, in the court, Indra fights the case on behalf of Jassi and proceeds with her interrogations.

episodesList.title: Indra Fights For Truth
episodesList.summary: Armaan and Purab are trying their best to help Jassi. Indra is in court, trying to help Jassi and fight Mr. Thukral's accusations. Purab and Armaan are involved in an accident again. Nandu informs Indra about this suspicious incident.

episodesList.title: Jessica is Jassi
episodesList.summary: Indra is fighting hard to help Jassi. Jessica comes to the court in her Jassi attire. Raj helps Jassi prove everyone wrong. Later, Armaan rushes in with the strong evidence. Jassi urf Jessica now, is proved innocent.

episodesList.title: Cid Gets Involved
episodesList.summary: A stranger shoots Jassi right in front of the court. She is rushed to the hospital. The court sent orders to find the culprit. Everyone is worried and prays for Jassi's recovery. CID is called and officers Daya, Abhijeet, and Fredricks investigate in this matter.

episodesList.title: Cid Interrogates Purab
episodesList.summary: CID officers interrogate Purab Mehra. Purab is devastated and answers their questions boldly. Armaan's mother insults him and urges him to be with Mallika and not Jassi. Mallika waits for Armaan. Armaan and Purab also join the hunt for Jassi's attacker.

episodesList.title: Jassi Gets Discharged
episodesList.summary: Armaan has a dream about Jassi and spends quality time with her in his dreams. Purab comes to meet Jassi in the hospital and is surprised when he finds out that she has been discharged. Mallika meets Purab and urges him to keep Jassi and Armaan away from each other. Armaan takes Jassi on a ride at a peaceful place.

episodesList.title: Ila Calls Angel
episodesList.summary: Jassi comes back home and is completely in awe of Armaan. She picks up the call and mistakes Purab as Armaan which hurts Purab. He fights and taunts her that she doesn't have time for him. Ila is upset with Armaan but he is not bothered about what anyone thinks. Ila calls Angel and complains about all the mess.

episodesList.title: Ila and Armaan Fight
episodesList.summary: Jassi asks Purab to support her as a friend and confesses her love for Armaan. Angel is coming to India. Ila and Armaan discuss Angel and fight over Jassi. Soon after, Jassi arrives.

episodesList.title: Armaan Proposes to Jassi
episodesList.summary: Nandu surprises Jassi by playing a song for her on the radio. Nandu urges Jassi to propose to Armaan. Ila is upset with Armaan and asks him to wait for Angel. Meanwhile, Purab and Armaan have a meeting. Mallika and Ila are back to their sinister ways and are plotting something evil. Angel is back and wants to meet everyone at home. Armaan surprises Jassi and takes her for a romantic lunch.

episodesList.title: Angel & Ila At Jassi's Home
episodesList.summary: Armaan is proposing Jassi when Angel arrives and intervenes. She is quite impressed to meet Jassi. Mallika is happy that Angel is back. Ila is shocked to see Jassi coming out of her home and is more surprised when Angel informs her about Armaan's proposal. Later, Angel and Ila reach Jassi's place with the marriage proposal.

episodesList.title: Marriage Proposal For Jassi
episodesList.summary: Ila and Angel visit Jassi's house with gifts. They ask for Jassi's approval for her marriage with Armaan. Jassi is on cloud nine and calls Armaan after which they talk about their future. Later, they meet to discuss the venue for their engagement.

episodesList.title: Armaan Talks to His Father
episodesList.summary: After Ila and Angel refuse to attend Armaan's engagement in Amritsar, he talks to his father regarding the same. Puru then assures Jassi's father that his entire family will visit them at their village.

episodesList.title: Armaan Bonds With Jassi's Family
episodesList.summary: When Armaan's family refuses to accompany him to Amritsar, he decides to visit Jassi's family by himself. Armaan breaks the ice and starts bonding with Jassi's family. Everyone finds Armaan a perfect match for Jassi.

episodesList.title: Jassi's Image is Hampered
episodesList.summary: Purab and Armaan's family receive calls from people informing them about Jassi's hoardings all over the city. Purab is shocked to see Jassi's pictures wearing lingerie on the hoardings. He immediately rushes to find out who has done the same.

episodesList.title: Armaan's Family In a Shock
episodesList.summary: Armaan's family is shaken to the core after all the humiliation they had to face because of Jassi. Armaan calls them and informs them about his engagement with Jassi. Armaan's father orders Armaan to come to Mumbai as soon as possible.

episodesList.title: Armaan Misunderstands Jassi
episodesList.summary: Jassi meets Armaan to resolve things between them. Jassi leaves after seeing Armaan doubt her love. Armaan is upset and talks to his father who suggests him to talk to Mallika for support.

episodesList.title: Jassi is Proved Innocent
episodesList.summary: Jassi is proven innocent by the media when they expose the culprit who had misused her pictures. Armaan's family visits Jassi's family to talk about everything. Armaan feels guilt to doubt Jassi.

episodesList.title: Armaan Yells At Anjali
episodesList.summary: Armaan gets angry after hey finds out that Jassi's family never accepted Anjali's offer. He yells at Anjali for lying to him and playing with Jassi's emotions. Jassi overthinks about marrying a man who is her polar opposite.

episodesList.title: Anjali Seeks Attention
episodesList.summary: After realising that Armaan is angry with her, Anjali tries to earn his sympathy. Armaan forgives her as she was very upset. She later tricks him into signing a prenup before getting married to Jassi.

episodesList.title: Jassi and Armaan's Engagement
episodesList.summary: Armaan surprises Jassi with various gifts at their engagement party. While Jassi is busy dancing with Armaan, Nandu tries to inform her about the prenup. Ila does not spare a chance to insult Jassi's family.

episodesList.title: Jassi is Shocked By The Prenup
episodesList.summary: Anjali discloses all the clauses of the prenup agreement to all the guests at the engagement party. After she finishes, Jassi's father is disturbed and makes sure that their entire family leaves the venue.

episodesList.title: Jassi Breaks Up With Armaan
episodesList.summary: Jassi's family walks out of the engagement party. When Armaan tries to talk to Jassi, she tells him that she has had enough. Ila, Anjali and Mallika are on cloud nine and celebrate their win the entire night.

episodesList.title: Misunderstanding Between Jassi & Armaan
episodesList.summary: Angel and Mallika lie to Armaan about Jassi adding a few clauses in the prenup agreement. Armaan calls Jassi and tries talking to her but it is all in vain. Will Jassi and Arman ever get back together?

episodesList.title: Jassi Talks About Prenup
episodesList.summary: Jassi gets a call from a talk show asking her to talk about prenups on national television. Jassi accepts the offer and speaks her heart out about the institution of marriage. She makes it clear that she would never sign a prenup as a condition for getting married.

episodesList.title: Jassi and Armaan Reunite
episodesList.summary: Jassi and her family visit the Suri family. Jassi agrees to sign the prenup but Armaan stops her. He tells her that nothing could come in between them. Mallika is heartbroken seeing Armaan and Jassi reunite.

episodesList.title: Armaan's Promises to Jassi
episodesList.summary: Armaan makes Jassi believe that he will only be her's forever. Jassi can not believe everything. Armaan makes several promises to Jassi and shows how deeply he is in love with her.

episodesList.title: Armaan Plans to Surprise
episodesList.summary: Jassi has a bad dream where Armaan is with another girl. Jassi gets upset and does not want to talk to Armaan. To brighten her mood, Armaan plans to surprise Jassi with Ria's help.

episodesList.title: Jassi Denies Armaan's Gift
episodesList.summary: Jassi gets offended when she sees Ria wearing Armaan's gift. She denies and gives back the gift to Armaan and asks him to respect everyone's feelings. Is Jassi overreacting?

episodesList.title: Ria Creates a Mess
episodesList.summary: Ria was handed over a few responsibilites, but she creates a mess of everything. Her documents and party arrangements were incomplete. To make things worse for everyone, she takes a leave without informing anyone. Jassi's father finalises the wedding date.

episodesList.title: Ria Complains Against Armaan
episodesList.summary: Ria lodges a complaint against Armaan that he has been harassing her. NCCW reaches Armaan's house to arrest him. Armaan is in a drunken state. Is this complaint real or fake?

episodesList.title: Jassi Being Accused
episodesList.summary: Jassi changes some sections in the company's rule book. Armaan's mother gets angry and accuses Jassi for making those changes. She thinks that Jassi is plotting something against Armaan.

episodesList.title: Unbelievable For Armaan
episodesList.summary: The allegations against Armaan filed by Ria are false. Armaan hits rock bottom when he finds out that nobody stood up for his support, not even Jassi. The allegations for a crime that he has not committed. Will Armaan be in jail?

episodesList.title: Ria Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: Ria goes missing and no one is able to find her anywhere. Everyone gets concerned. Jassi feels guilty as she was not able to support Armaan.

episodesList.title: Marriage Preparations
episodesList.summary: Armaan's mother is worried about Armaan as she thinks she will lose him once he gets married. In the Walia house, everyone in the family is excited and has started the preparations.

episodesList.title: Purab's Life and Death Situation
episodesList.summary: Armaan's mother gets disappointed as he slaps one of the relatives who tried insulting Jassi's family. Purab is stuck between life and death. The only thing he wants is Jassi.

episodesList.title: Jassi Gets The News
episodesList.summary: Jassi, Armaan and the whole family are engaged with the celebration of the biggest event of their lives. Mallika feels embarrassed and jealous. Jassi gets a call with the media that Purab is going to die.

episodesList.title: Jassi Delays Her Wedding
episodesList.summary: Jassi gets concerned about Purab as soon as she comes to know about him. She plans to visit Purab in Nanital. Armaan agrees with Jassi's decision and supports her.

episodesList.title: Purab is No More
episodesList.summary: Jassi reaches Nanital to meet Purab and they could only catch a glimpse of each other. Unfortunately, Purab soon passes away. Jassi feels devastated. Purab's friend plans to ruin Jassi's life.

episodesList.title: Cj's Evil Thoughts
episodesList.summary: CJ is determined in taking revenge from Jassi. He deliberately delays Jassi's cab so that she is not able to reach the airport in time. He also discard the message Armaan sent for Jassi.

episodesList.title: Misunderstanding Pecks In
episodesList.summary: Armaan finally reaches Nanital. CJ mixes some medicine in Jassi's food because of which she faints. Armaan witnesses them together and misunderstands the whole situation.

episodesList.title: Armaan Confronts Jassi
episodesList.summary: Armaan goes crazy when he sees CJ and Jassi together. Now when Jassi is back and functions are going in her house, Armaan comes to meet her. He confronts Jassi and asks her to say the truth.

episodesList.title: Will This Wedding Happen?
episodesList.summary: Armaan is shattered after seeing Jasi with CJ. He asks Jassi to confesss about what happened at Nanital. Though Jassi is innocent, she accept everything Armaan accuses her of. This gives rise to trust issues between the couple. Will this wedding happen?

episodesList.title: Jassi is Gone
episodesList.summary: Jassi is nowhere to be seen. Everyone, including Armaan, is anxiously waiting for her to come. Jassi's family reveals to Armaan's family that Jassi will not come for the marriage. This puts them in a shock. Will the wedding happen?

episodesList.title: Armaan Marries Mallika
episodesList.summary: Armaan finally marries Mallika. Jassi's family is shocked. Armaan's family insults Jassi's parents and leaves. Angel is very happy and so is Ila. Mallika is on cloud nine and she enters Armaan's house with pride.

episodesList.title: A Letter Says It All
episodesList.summary: Mallika is excited on her wedding night but Armaan is silent as he is heartbroken. Jassi catches a train to run away. Parbat Lal helps her find a seat and buy tickets for her. Jassi's family comes across her letter where she wrote the reason for leaving.

episodesList.title: Jesus Finds a Solution
episodesList.summary: Parbat Lal's intentions seem evil. His extreme concern for Jassi feels suspicious. Armaan gets furious when he dreams of Jassi and Vikas together. Parbat Lal tries to touch Jassi and she retaliates by raising her hand on him. Jassi reaches a church and talks about her issues with Jesus.

episodesList.title: New Name
episodesList.summary: Jassi begins a new life as Neha Shashtri. Armaan is still lost in thoughts and wonder why Jassi left. Mallika questions Armaan and his answers hurts her.

episodesList.title: New Drama Teacher
episodesList.summary: Jassi, now Neha, begins her new phase as a drama teacher. The kids appear to be spoilt brats. She has a student who is extremely difficult to handle as a teacher. Later, she follows the sound of music and reaches the music classroom.

episodesList.title: Buring Memories
episodesList.summary: Jassi meets Raghav. He is the music teacher of the school. Later, Jassi reaches her room to rest. Armaan is gathering all the gifts that he had given to Jassi and burns everything. Mallika is very worried about him.

episodesList.title: Mallika Talks to Aryan
episodesList.summary: Jassi befriends Naseem Aapa. Naseem Aapa spots Jassi's wedding dress in the almirah and questions her about it. Mallika and Armaan are surprised to see Aryan. Jassi wins over all the kids' hearts and now teaches with zeal. Riya, Armaan's new secretary, talks to his photo.

episodesList.title: Students In Awe Of Neha
episodesList.summary: Mallika is trying her best to earn a place in Armaan's heart. Purushottam asks her to give him some space. She calls Armaan and the couple ends up in a fight. Jassi feels happy that all her students now admire her and look upto her. Aryan decides to find Jassi's address seeking revenge.

episodesList.title: Rich vs Poor
episodesList.summary: Aryan pays a stalker to find Jassi. Parbat Lal also tries his luck to find out the real identity of Neha Shastri. Jassi is worried. Armaan and Mallika's arguments and fights never seem to end.

episodesList.title: Rahul is Injured
episodesList.summary: Riya is worried about Jassi and wishes to speak with Nandu. Jassi warns all the kids not to go near the lake but Rahul escapes and gets injured. Later, he apologizes to Jassi in front of the school faculty for being disobedient.

episodesList.title: Double Faced People
episodesList.summary: Aryan feels Jassi is dead and informs Mallika. Riya finds out about Jassi's new identity. Armaan, as usual, displays his frustration during the board meeting. Jyoti is on the wrong track and shows a fake side to her mother. Parbat Lal blackmails Jassi.

episodesList.title: Blabber Mouths
episodesList.summary: Parbat Lal continues to blackmail Jassi. She decides to leave this town fearing her past would catch up tp her. She plans to disclose details about the school funds. At Gulmohar, Riya's ideas are praised by everyone and Ila asks Armaan to go to Nainital. He doesn't like the suggestion and refuses to go.

episodesList.title: Parbat Lal Asked to Leave
episodesList.summary: Parbat Lal is thrown out of the school for his eveil deeds. Jassi heaves a sigh of relief. She gears up for the upcoming recital in the school. Riya urges Armaan to come to Nainital, this triggers his anger and he screams at her. Ila is worried about Armaan & Mallika's relationship.

episodesList.title: Old Memories Crop In
episodesList.summary: Jassi takes auditions of all the kids for Romeo and Juliet's roles. Riya leaves for Nainital with Armaan. Both Armaan and Jassi are in each other's thoughts. The situatuions they face themselves in are such that they are also reminded of each other.

episodesList.title: Jassi Spots Armaan
episodesList.summary: Riya tries to make Armaan and Jassi meet but things never line-up and it seems even God does not want that to happen. Jassi and other teachers are gifted flowers from all the young kids. Armaan and Riya meet Parbat Lal for work. Jassi spots Armaan and freaks out.

episodesList.title: Nazeem Aapa's Advice
episodesList.summary: Some strangers thrash Armaan. Fortunately, Jassi was there and she rushes him to the hospital. Riya reaches the hospital and is surprised to see Jassi there. Parbat Lal also comes there. Nazeem Aapa, Raghav, and all the kids are worried about Jassi's wellbeing. Jassi comes home worried.

episodesList.title: Parbat Lal's Move
episodesList.summary: Mallika comes to see Armaan in Nainital. Meanwhile, the kids practice for their play. Raghav and Jassi get involved with the rehearsals. Parbat Lal and Mrs. Khatri invite Mallika and Armaan for their school recital, to which they agree. Riya reaches Jassi's place.

episodesList.title: Riya Helps Jassi
episodesList.summary: Mallika wants to go back home and quarrels with Armaan. The play begins with Jassi's introductory speech about the play. Mallika changes her plan and reaches the school for the play but is unable to meet Neha Shastri. Jassi is terrified. What will happen next? Watch this episode to find out now!

episodesList.title: Armaan Meets Neha Shastri
episodesList.summary: Riya narrates the whole story to Jassi about what happened when she left. Jassi is very upset. Old memories keep lurking her mind. Mrs. Khatri wishes Jassi happy birthday. Students and Raghav organize a mini party for Jassi in the school. What will happen next? Watch this episode to find out now!

episodesList.title: Armaan Leaves The City
episodesList.summary: Armaan and Jassi confront each other. Armaan tells her that there is nothing left between them. Jassi has no value in his life and has disowned her forever. He hates Jassi and leaves forever. What will happen next? Watch this episode to find out now!

episodesList.title: Aryan Happy For Mallika
episodesList.summary: Jassi keeps on crying as memories of Armaan haunt her. Mallika is excited and happy after she is back from Nainital. Seeing her happy, Aryan and Armaan's mother is also very happy. What will happen next? Watch this episode to find out now!

episodesList.title: Aryan and Parbat Lal Together
episodesList.summary: Aryan meets Parbat Lal and he comes to know that even Jassi is Parbat Lal's enemy. He narrates the whole story to Aryan and lets him know how badly he wants the revenge. Raghav saves Jassi from an accident. What will happen next? Watch this episode to find out now!

episodesList.title: Jassi Gets Arrested
episodesList.summary: While Jassi is giving a speech in the school, the inspector comes in to arrest her. She is being charged with murder. Everyone goes in shock and the students are not willing to let her go. What will happen next? Will Jassi go to jail? Watch this episode to find out now!

episodesList.title: Raghav Fights For Jassi
episodesList.summary: Parbat Lal slams a case on Jassi. She is dragged to the court with no lawyers and no witnesses. But fortunately, Raghav comes in as Jassi's lawyer to help her fight the case. What will happen next? Watch this episode to find out now!

episodesList.title: Jassi is In Jail
episodesList.summary: Jassi has been sentenced to jail for a while. She thinks that she must have done something wrong in life that is why she is being cursed. Jassi's enemies are happy that she is in jail. What will happen next? Watch this episode to find out now!

episodesList.title: Jassi Loses Her Strength
episodesList.summary: With a lot happening in Jassi's life, she loses her strength. She thinks that she has become weak. But Raghav supports her and gives her motivation to fight. Will Jassi be able to save herself? What will happen next? Watch this episode to find out now!

episodesList.title: Hope Prevails
episodesList.summary: Raghav discusses his strategy with Jassi on how he is planning to fight the case. He informs Jassi that he will be going to Mumbai to find shreds of evidence and witnesses. But someone is already spying on them. What will happen next? Will they succeed? Watch this episode to find out now!

episodesList.title: Real Neha Shastri Uncovers The Truth
episodesList.summary: The real Neha Shastri is brought to court as Jassi's witness. She narrates the whole story and everyone is taken aback by the truth. This gives little hope to Jassi that everything will fall into place this time. What will happen next? Watch this episode to find out now!

episodesList.title: Future is Uncertain
episodesList.summary: Aryan calls Mallika to let her know that his plan is going as he wants. But Mallika is scared of things not turning out the same way. She does not want Jassi and Armaan to ever meet in their entire lives. What will happen next? Watch this episode to find out now!

episodesList.title: Mallika Makes Armaan Sign
episodesList.summary: Mallika plans against Jassi and makes Armaan sign a blank cheque. Armaan is unaware of this but he does what Mallika asks him to. What will happen next? Watch this episode to find out now!

episodesList.title: Jassi Determined to Bend The Rules
episodesList.summary: Armaan still has feelings for Jassi and he keeps thinking how she must be dealing with all the situations. But this time, Jassi is determined to make Armaan repay and she will play by her own rules. What will happen next? Watch this episode to find out now!

episodesList.title: Armaan Realises His Mistake
