title: Kahaani Ghar Ghar Kii
summary:
Kahaani Ghar Ghar Kii (transl. The story of each household) is an Indian soap opera which ran on StarPlus from 16 October 2000 to 9 October 2008. One of the longest running Indian television soap opera, the series was created by Ekta Kapoor and produced by her company Balaji Telefilms, starring Sakshi Tanwar and Kiran Karmarkar in the lead roles.
The show explored the lives of Parvati and Om Agarwal, members of a Marwari joint family. Parvati is portrayed as the ideal daughter-in-law of the Agarwal family, while Om is depicted as the ideal son. The story revolves around Vishwanath Agarwal’s sons and their descendants.
The show also featured Ali Asgar as Kamal Agarwal, Anup Soni as Suyash Mehra, and Shweta Kawatra / Achint Kaur as Pallavi Agarwal in significant supporting roles. Kahaani Ghar Ghar Kii consistently ranked among the top three Indian television shows during its run.
plot:
The show is based mostly on the lives and struggles within a joint family. The story, spread over three generations, focuses mainly on Parvati, who is married to Om, and her journey as the ideal wife, daughter-in-law, mother, and grandmother. It depicts how sometimes one must stand against their loved ones to do what is morally right. The story ends on the day of Dussehra with the family celebrating and highlighting the triumph of good over evil.
It all begins with the happy Agarwal family. Vishwanath Agarwal comments on how he has always treated the daughters and daughters-in-law of the house with the same love and respect. He gives his oldest daughter-in-law, Parvati, his "mala". She says that she doesn’t think she should receive it, but he insists, saying that he thinks of her as the cord that goes through the chain holding all the beads together.
These happy times are soon disrupted when Vishwanath’s third son, Ajay Agarwal, refuses to marry the daughter of reputed businessman Mr. Bhandari. Babuji tells Ajay that he can either marry Pallavi Bhandari or leave the Agarwal house for good. Ajay opts to leave and, in a time of turmoil, Kamal steps forward to save the family and Pallavi from humiliation by agreeing to marry her.
The day Pallavi enters the house, Parvati is busy shifting a glass structure from one place to another. Pallavi walks in, and both collide. The structure collapses, shattering into a million pieces. Pallavi smiles secretly, hoping that from this day forth, whatever goes wrong in the house will go wrong because of her.
Pallavi begins her venomous attack on the Agarwals and makes Parvati’s life a living hell. Soon, due to Pallavi’s conspiracies, Parvati, Om, and Shruti leave the house. Before long, however, Parvati and Chhaya run their own conspiracy against Pallavi, who is eventually caught red-handed. Chhaya reveals that she and Parvati planned everything so the family could see Pallavi’s true nature. Kamal later leaves Pallavi at her father’s house, saying that’s where she belongs. Parvati and Om return home and are finally happy again, but Parvati later brings Pallavi back, saying that family must always stay together.
Time goes on, and Om brings home his friend’s blind daughter, Khushi Kantilal Shah, after her father passes away. The family vows to take care of her. However, on the night of her celebration party, she is raped. Parvati discovers that Om’s cousins, Devin and Rohan Garg, are responsible. Unfortunately, the men of the family believe Devin and Rohan, and Ajay even fights the case for them.
During the court case, Parvati motivates Avantika to continue fighting for justice, reminding her that when one must choose between “Dharma” and “Karma,” one’s actions (Karma) define their true Dharma. Eventually, Anamika produces a letter from Devin confessing to the crime, and Devin and Rohan are sentenced.
Not long after, Pallavi takes her revenge and throws the family out. Living in poverty, Om suffers a nervous breakdown. In desperation, Parvati begs Pallavi for money, appearing to surrender to her. Pallavi, unaware of Parvati’s plan, accepts her back. Parvati secretly works with Chhaya to regain the family’s honor, but when exposed, no one believes her, and she leaves the house heartbroken. Eventually, Om brings her back, and the family reconciles.
Twenty years later, Kamal’s son Krishna returns from abroad, and Shruti falls in love with Aryan Doshi. On the day of Shruti’s wedding, Parvati discovers that Monalika is carrying Aryan’s child. After a series of events involving face transplants, mistaken identities, and family conflicts, Parvati’s identity is revealed, and the family briefly reunites.
Later, new characters such as Sasha, Machan, Neel, and Rob (the Gargs) enter the story, claiming inheritance rights. The Agarwals lose everything, and Krishna’s reckless decisions worsen their downfall. Om’s extramarital affair with Trishna, his tragic death, and Parvati’s revenge against Suyash Mehra further twist the narrative.
Eventually, it’s revealed that Trishna and Rajeshwari were behind Om and Krishna’s deaths. Parvati is framed and imprisoned. Before leaving, she advises her granddaughter Pragati to take care of the family.
After twenty years, Trishna controls the Agarwal household, tormenting everyone. A new woman, Jhanki Devi — identical to Parvati — arrives. Over time, it is revealed that Jhanki is Parvati herself, who survived and returned to restore justice. She exposes Trishna, reunites with Om (who had survived but lost his memory), and reclaims peace for the family.
In the end, good triumphs over evil — Trishna is arrested, Om and Parvati reunite, misunderstandings are cleared, and the Agarwal family returns to happiness, with Parvati watching over them once again.

title: Ek Akasher Niche
summary:
Ek Akasher Niche is a Bengali-language family drama television serial, which aired on Alpha Bangla. It was produced under the banner of Ravi Ojha Productions. One of the longest running Bengali television soap opera, the story is about a middle-class family that deals with various challenges and complications on a daily basis and fights all odds to stay united. With over a thousand episodes that aired in early 2000s the serial was a mega-blockbuster hit in Bengal and other Bengali language dominant parts of the world.
Starring an extensive cast with actors like Saswata Chatterjee, Chaiti Ghoshal, Parambrata Chattopadhyay, Swastika Mukherjee and Mansi Bhatia, this Bengali TV show ran for several years amassing a huge fan following.

title: Kaun Banega Crorepati
summary:
Kaun Banega Crorepati (simply KBC; English: Who Will Become a Millionaire) is an Indian Hindi-language television game show. It is the official Hindi version of the original British format Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?. It is presented by actor Amitabh Bachchan, who has hosted the show for its entire run except for its third season, during which Shah Rukh Khan, another actor, replaced Bachchan. The programme aired on Star Plus for its first three seasons from 2000 to 2007, and was commissioned by the programming team of Sameer Nair. In 2010, it started airing on Sony Entertainment Television and was produced by BIG Synergy (under various names over periods of time) from season 1 till season 10. Afterwards, the credited production companies co-producing are Studio NEXT since season 10 and Tree of Knowledge (Digi TOK) since season 11 respectively.
The format is similar to other shows in the Who Wants to Be a Millionaire? franchise: contestants are asked multiple choice questions and must select the correct answer from four possible choices, and are provided with lifelines that may be used if they are uncertain. Starting in season 7 in 2013, the top prize was ₹7 crore and was increased to ₹7.5 crore in Season 14 in 2022 to celebrate 75 years of India's Independence.

tagline: Kaun Banega Crorepati (simply KBC; English: Who Will Become a Millionaire) is an Indian Hindi-language television game show.

title: Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi
wikiTitle: Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi
summary:
Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi (transl. Because Even a Mother-in-Law Was a Daughter-in-Law Once) is an Indian Hindi-language television series that aired from 3 July 2000 to 6 November 2008 on Star Plus. One of the longest running Indian television soap opera, the show is produced by Shobha Kapoor and Ekta Kapoor under their banner Balaji Telefilms.
The show revolves around an ideal daughter-in-law, the daughter of a pandit married to Mihir, grandson of business tycoon Govardhan Virani. The role of Tulsi Virani was played by Smriti Irani, who holds the record for winning 5 consecutive Best Actress-Popular awards from Indian Television Academy Awards and 2 Indian Telly Awards. Debuting alongside Kaun Banega Crorepati on July 3, 2000, on Star Plus, Kyunki... was the most successful serial at its time, ranked number 1 with double digit TRPs for seven continuous years, peaking at 22.4 in May 2001. Kyunki... marked a turning point for producer Ekta Kapoor and Star Plus and resulted in iconic serials Kahaani Ghar Ghar Kii and Kasautii Zindagii Kay (2001 TV series), forming the big 3 for the channel through the 2000s. The show won 5 consecutive Best Serial-Popular awards from ITA and 6 consecutive Best Continuing Serials from Indian Telly Awards.
plot:
'''' Set in Mumbai, the series focuses on the wealthy Gujarati Virani family, who live in their lavish house, Shantiniketan, where the three daughters-in-law, Savita, Daksha and Gayatri, control the entire family and create trouble for their wise and kind-hearted mother-in-law, Amba, called Baa by everyone. Savita arranges her son Mihir's marriage to the arrogant Payal, but he falls in love with and marries the family priest's kind-hearted and caring daughter, Tulsi. Savita despises Tulsi and wants to make her life a misery. The Viranis eventually accept Tulsi as their daughter-in-law, and she ultimately wins over Savita after many hardships, resolves various issues within the family, and has a son, Gautam. Mihir is involved in an accident and is presumed dead by his family.
Alive, Mihir suffers from memory loss and his caretaker, Dr Mandira, falls in love with him. Her brother Anupam proposes marriage to Tulsi, who agrees for Gautam. The wedding is canceled when Mihir is discovered to be alive. He gradually regains his memory. Obsessed with Mihir, Mandira plots against Tulsi, but she is unsuccessful. She is presumed dead in a plane crash. Payal also plots against the Viranis in order to avenge Mihir's rejection, but is ultimately exposed as well. Tulsi gives birth to a daughter, Shobha and gives Gautam to Mihir's brother, Kiran, and his wife, Aarti, who are childless. Aarti and Kiran leave India with Gautam fearing that Tulsi might reclaim him.
Tulsi and Mihir have another son, Harsh, who was raised along with Shobha. Gautam returns to India with Kiran and Aarti, who now have a daughter, Karishma. He learns about his birth parents and, after some initial hesitation, accepts them. Tulsi wants Gautam to marry Ganga, but he marries his love, Teesha, instead. Gautam's cousin, Sahil, marries Ganga to save her honour, while Shobha marries Payal's son, Vishal. Tulsi is shocked to discover that Mihir has been cheating on her for many years with an alive Mandira, with whom he has an illegitimate son, Karan. Mandira and Karan try to trouble the Viranis and take over their industries, but fail. Payal and Vishal reform because of Shobha. Teesha and her unborn child die in an accident planned by Mandira that was intended for Tulsi. Tulsi accepts Karan, who comes to love her more than Mandira, after learning the truth.
Harsh marries the greedy Mohini, who frequently causes trouble for the family. Gautam remarries Damini, who later becomes pregnant at the same time as Ganga. Ganga miscarries, while Damini gives birth to twins, Mayank and Nakul. Damini and Gautam give Nakul to Sahil and Ganga. Vishal dies, leaving Shobha widowed. Harsh is revealed to be the son of Tulsi's cousin, Kesar. Kesar had switched Harsh with Tulsi's real son, Ansh, who was then raised by Aditya Gujral. Ansh is spoilt and ruthless, and becomes obsessed with Karan's lover, Nandini. Shobha marries Vishal's friend, Abhishek. Although Karan and Nandini are in love, he marries her to Ansh, who sexually abuses her within the marriage. The lawyer handling the rape case and Tulsi's friend, Meera Singhania, becomes fond of Mihir. Tulsi fights against her own son to secure justice for Nandini and ultimately shoots Ansh dead when he attempts to kill Nandini, who gives birth to their daughter, Bhoomi, before lapsing into a coma. Karan marries his friend Tanya to help care for Bhoomi.
Tanya is pregnant. Nandini awakens from the coma and lives with Karan. Shobha leaves Abhishek after discovering that he and Rathi had killed Vishal. Nandini, who is pregnant with Karan's child, kills Aditya to save Bhoomi from being kidnapped and is imprisoned for 14 years. Ganga and Sahil have a son, Lakshya, while Karan remarries Tanya and they have a son, Manthan. Gautam adopts Eklavya, the son of Ansh and his first wife, Shraddha. Sahil falls in love with Tripti, and they begin an extramarital affair.
Meera falls for Mihir and conspires with Mandira against Tulsi. Savita discovers their conspiracies and vows to expose them, but suffers an accident planned by the two women. Left paralyzed, she asks Tulsi to disconnect her life support and dies. Meera convinces Mihir that Tulsi killed Savita in purpose. Believing Meera, Mihir expels Tulsi from Shantiniketan. Heartbroken, she is later presumed dead in a bus accident. The Viranis are left devastated, and Mihir becomes an alcoholic, blaming himself for Tulsi's death. Ganga leaves Sahil after discovering that he has cheated on her with Tripti. Tulsi travels to Haridwar, where she sees a newborn child being abandoned by her father. Tulsi rescues the child and raises her, naming her Krishna Tulsi.
Tulsi's grandchildren are all grown up. Tulsi lives in Haridwar with Krishna Tulsi, who later comes to Mumbai for her education and stays with the Viranis. Tulsi eventually reunites with the Viranis and Mihir exposes Meera, who gets imprisoned for Savita's murder. Mihir and Tulsi remarry. Tanya plots to keep Karan close to her, but eventually divorces Karan after realizing that he still loves Nandini. Karan and Nandini remarry and attempt to find their lost son, who was taken away by Mandira after his birth, but fail. Sahil divorces Tripti after realizing her true intentions, and reunites with Ganga, who is now a successful businesswoman. Krishna Tulsi and Lakshya are in love. Mayank, who is mentally unstable, is arrested for attempting to molest Krishna. Krishna Tulsi is forced to marry Eklavya, who resembles his father Ansh and he mistreats her. Bhoomi loves Abir but ends up marrying Joydeep because of family turmoil, while Abir marries Mohini's daughter, Archita. The sisters eventually accept their respective marriages and live happily.
Damini joins forces with Tripti and Tanya to avenge her son's arrest. They create situations that make Tulsi appear mentally unstable and send her to a mental hospital, from which she tries to escape and meets with an accident. Juhi Thakral enters, claiming to be Tulsi and revealing that she had undergone plastic surgery after the accident and is allied with Mandira. Eventually, she is exposed, and the real Tulsi, who had temporarily lost her memory, returns home and regains her rightful place while Mandira and Juhi's crimes are revealed. Lakshya unknowingly marries Tripti's adopted daughter, Vaidehi, who initially tries to sow discord within the family but later reforms. Tulsi battles various enemies, including Tripti, Mandira, Juhi and Shiv (Ganga's obsessive lover), in order to protect her family from harm, and defeats them, while Damini also has a change of heart. The Viranis are reunited after a prolonged separation. Baa sadly dies, leaving her entire inheritance to an unknown person in her will.
Mihir and Tulsi live with an orphaned girl, Sugandhi, while Mihir suffers from Alzheimer's disease. After learning about Baa's will, all the children leave Shantiniketan because they receive nothing from it. In the final episode, Tulsi's best friend Parvati Agarwal reunites with Tulsi and reveals that she has raised the inheritor of Baa's property, Parth (Karan and Nandini's long-lost son).

episodesList.summary: Bharti overhears Daksha discussing her marriage to Chirag with Gayatri and Savita. Meanwhile, Hemant expresses to Tulsi his sentiments for Pooja.

episodesList.title: Sejal's Father Apologises to Anand
episodesList.summary: After Hemant sends Sejal an expensive gift, her father apologises to Anand and his mother. Later, Tulsi resolves to meet Savita late at night.

episodesList.title: Savita Becomes Suspicious
episodesList.summary: After cutting the cake, everyone gathers in Tulsi's room to celebrate Savita's birthday. Payal wishes Savita on the phone, which makes Savita and Daksha suspicious.

episodesList.title: Payal Approaches Tulsi
episodesList.summary: Payal meets Tulsi with a devious intention after Mihir and Tulsi visit the temple. Hemant's father later cautions him to keep out of Sejal's life for her good.

episodesList.title: Sejal Disputes with Anand
episodesList.summary: While talking to her husband, Savita blames Tulsi for her fight with Daksha. Meanwhile, Sejal has a disagreement with Anand about her position in the house.

episodesList.title: Payal to Destroy Mihir, Tulsi
episodesList.summary: Savita and Daksha engage in a brawl as the latter continues to mock her. Payal, meanwhile, vows to destroy Mihir and Tulsi's marriage before she gets married.

episodesList.title: Tulsi Speaks with Savita
episodesList.summary: Following a quarrel between Savita and Daksha, Tulsi resolves to speak with Savita. Meanwhile, Hemant calls Pooja's phone and swears retribution.

episodesList.title: Mihir Meets Daksha
episodesList.summary: Savita overhears Amba and Govardhan discussing the will. Meanwhile, before leaving town, Mihir meets Daksha and apologises on Savita's behalf.

episodesList.title: Savita, Daksha Sort Out Their Conflicts
episodesList.summary: Tulsi becomes concerned after Mihir fails to respond to her phone calls since he left. Later, Savita and Daksha sort out their disagreements.

episodesList.title: A Shocker for the Viranis!
episodesList.summary: Jamnadas receives a phone call regarding an accident after everyone becomes concerned about Mihir. Later, the Viranis arrive at the accident site.

episodesList.title: Baa Informs Savita the Truth
episodesList.summary: Jamnadas, heartbroken, notifies Mansukh that Mihir is no longer alive. Later, Amba tries to notify Savita of Mihir's unfortunate demise.

episodesList.title: The Truth Is Kept from Tulsi
episodesList.summary: The Viranis resolve to keep Mihir's awful news from Tulsi. Baa and Tulsi subsequently go to the temple to prevent Tulsi from finding out about Mihir.

episodesList.title: Savita Refuses to Accept the Truth
episodesList.summary: Jamnadas calls Hemant and urges him to bring Mihir's body home�before Tulsi arrives home. Later, Savita denies believing that Mihir is no longer alive.

episodesList.title: The Viranis Begin the Funeral Rites
episodesList.summary: While visiting the temple with Baa, Tulsi continues to speak about Mihir. Meanwhile, as Mihir's body arrives, the Viranis begin the funeral rituals.

episodesList.title: Tulsi Is Hospitalised
episodesList.summary: Tulsi crashes to the ground upon witnessing Mihir's lifeless body, resulting in her hospitalisation. Later, Savita falls unconscious as she makes sense of reality.

episodesList.title: Gautam Is Born
episodesList.summary: Tulsi turns hysterical upon realising Mihir isn't alive to witness the birth of their son, Gautam. Later, Baa tries to calm her down by reminding her of Mihir's memories.

episodesList.title: Gautam Arrives Home
episodesList.summary: Despair ensues as Tulsi returns home with Gautam from the hospital. Later, Baa consoles a grieving Savita and asks her to get rest while she looks after Gautam.

episodesList.title: Anupam Visits the Viranis'
episodesList.summary: Mansukhbhai is taken aback as Anupam pays a surprise visit to them. Meanwhile, while talking to the members, Anupam expresses his condolences to the family.

episodesList.title: Tulsi Spends Sleepless Nights
episodesList.summary: Savita walks into Tulsi's room in the middle of the night and chats with her. Later, while speaking with Mansukhbhai, a teary-eyed Savita evokes Mihir's memories.

episodesList.title: The Viranis' Meet Anupam
episodesList.summary: As the Viranis meet with Anupam, he informs them that he had invested a huge sum in Mihir's project. The next day, Anupam brings the documentation to the Viranis.

episodesList.title: Anupam Meets Tulsi
episodesList.summary: Tulsi and Anupam meet to express their sorrow for Mihir's death. Anupam makes an attempt to give Gautam a gift. Amba seems concerned for Tulsi for spending a life like a widow.

episodesList.title: Daksha Grows Concerned
episodesList.summary: Chirag and Prajakta are worried about keeping their relationship together. Later, Daksha grows concerned as Bapuji intends to talk about their will.

episodesList.title: Tulsi Seems Worried
episodesList.summary: Savita is advised by Tulsi to sell her wedding jewellery after the death of Mihir. When Tulsi seems concerned about the project, Amba consoles her.

episodesList.title: Aarti Plans to Handle the Business
episodesList.summary: As Mihir's family chooses to carry out Mihir's final desire of finishing his dream project, Aarti expresses an interest in handling the business.

episodesList.title: Tulsi Is Upset
episodesList.summary: While Tulsi expresses her thoughts over the second marriage, Savita holds a family discussion. Payal manages Aarti's finances and asks for a loan.

episodesList.title: Mansukh Tries to Convince Savita
episodesList.summary: Hemant approaches Pooja to congratulate her on her wedding and extends his friendship. Mansukh tries to convince Savita about Tulsi's second marriage.

episodesList.title: Anupam Helps the Viranis
episodesList.summary: Anupam makes an effort to assist the Viranis with their business. Mansukh approaches Aarti for assistance with the project.

episodesList.title: Savita Persuades Tulsi
episodesList.summary: When Amba meets Savita to discuss Tulsi's second marriage, Savita declines. Meanwhile, Savita meets Tulsi and tries to persuade to take Mihir's place.

episodesList.title: Anupam Thinks About Tulsi's Marriage
episodesList.summary: As Payal arrives at the rituals, Daksha is dissatisfied with Gayatri's approach of Payal. Later, Tulsi's wedding is on Anupam's mind.

episodesList.title: Tulsi Is Heartbroken
episodesList.summary: Daksha and Gayatri are both dissatisfied with one other's behaviour. Meanwhile, Tulsi appears heartbroken when Savita suggests her second marriage to her.

episodesList.title: A Marriage Proposal For Tulsi
episodesList.summary: The family members are overjoyed as Anupam proposes to marry Tulsi. Later, as Tulsi is informed of this developement, she is taken aback and refuses to remarry.

episodesList.title: Good News for the Viranis!
episodesList.summary: The Viranis are filled with joy as Sejal delivers a baby and Anand becomes a father. Later, Mansukh informs Anupam that his marriage proposal to Tulsi is granted.

episodesList.title: Mihir Regains Consciousness!
episodesList.summary: While Tulsi recalls the moments spent with Mihir, he comes back to his senses, leaving Mandira shocked. Later, Tulsi gets engaged with Anupam.

episodesList.title: Daksha's Silly Daydreams
episodesList.summary: Kiran and Aarti are happy that everyone is equally contributing to Mihir's project. Elsewhere, Daksha dreams about winning lots of prize money from crorepati.

episodesList.title: Mandira Cheers up Mihir
episodesList.summary: Mandira tries to boost the spirit up in Mihir as he feels lonely and miserable at the hospital. Meanwhile, Daksha decides to get Chirag engaged to Bharti.

episodesList.title: Tulsi, Savita Break Down
episodesList.summary: When Tulsi continues recollecting the memories she spent with Mihir, Savita bursts into tears. Elsewhere, Mihir is anxious as he gets flashes from the past.

episodesList.title: Savita Makes Tulsi Understand
episodesList.summary: Savita tells Tulsi that Gautam should recognise Anupam as his father, rather than struggling with Mihir's legacy. Elsewhere, Suhasi is appreciated for telling the truth.

episodesList.title: Daksha Begins Preparations
episodesList.summary: Bharti helps Daksha with reading books to prepare for her Crorepati game. Later, Hemant tells his family that Payel has returned the important files.

episodesList.title: Tulsi, Anupam are Welcomed
episodesList.summary: Anupam's mother greet Tulsi and Anupam to their home. On the occassion of Baa's birthday, Govardhan makes wishes for her and but she gets emotional.

episodesList.title: Chirag Rebukes Daksha
episodesList.summary: Daksha is excited to participate in the Crorepati game and awaits a call from them. Later, Chirag argues with her as he is not willing to get engaged.

episodesList.title: Baa's Generous Decision
episodesList.summary: Savita, Baa and Govardhan decide to buy new ornaments for Tulsi on her marriage. Elsewhere, Daksha asks Chirag about the questions to be asked at Crorepati platform.

episodesList.title: Baby Naming Ceremony
episodesList.summary: Daksha pampers Sejal's daughter, and dresses her up. Later, the Viranis take part in the naming ceremony of Sejal's daughter and Mihir's son.

episodesList.title: Chirag Gets Engaged
episodesList.summary: Everyone comes together to celebrate Chirag's engagement. In the meantime, Rakesh and Suhasi lose custody of their kid in court to his mother, Monisha.

episodesList.title: Payal's Diabolical Intentions
episodesList.summary: After Payal purchases shares in their industry, the Viranis become suspicious. Hemant later meets Payal to discover the reason for her investment.

episodesList.title: Savita Becomes Sceptical
episodesList.summary: When Payal calls to wish Hemant Diwali greetings, Savita becomes suspicious. Jamnadas later offers Anand a job at Virani Industries.

episodesList.title: Rakesh Promises Suhasi
episodesList.summary: Rakesh vows Suhasi that he will bring their son Aniket to their house. Meanwhile, as Amar goes missing, Dr Mona decides to seek help from the police.

episodesList.title: Anupam Greets the Viranis
episodesList.summary: Anupam arrives at the Virani mansion to take Tulsi with him. Meanwhile, Savita is overcome with emotion after missing Mihir during the Diwali celebration.

episodesList.title: Anupam Invites Mona
episodesList.summary: Anupam calls his sister Mona to invite her to Tulsi's marriage. After hearing Tulsi's name, Amar, who happens to be Mihir, becomes sceptical.

episodesList.title: Mona, Mihir Arrive in Mumbai
episodesList.summary: After Mona is late to reach Mumbai, Tulsi decides to return home without meeting her. Later, Anupam welcomes Amar to their house.

episodesList.title: Savita Expresses Her Concern
episodesList.summary: After Anupam visits Tulsi for work, Amar feels sceptical. Savita later expresses her concerns about Hemant and Payal becoming close.

episodesList.title: Payal's Cunning Plan
episodesList.summary: Jamnadas and Gayatri argue over Payal and Hemant's bonding. Payal, meantime, informs her mother about the man she wishes to marry.

episodesList.title: Amar Struggles to Recall His Past
episodesList.summary: Anupam invites Mansukh to meet Amar, who is waiting in the car for him. Later, as Amar struggles to recollect his past, Mona tries to reassure him.

episodesList.title: Payal's Confession to Arati
episodesList.summary: Himmat, Manuskh other family members discuss Anupam and Tulsi's marriage. Meanwhile, Payal tells Arati that she wants to marry Hemant and asks for her help.

episodesList.title: Anand Praises Sejal
episodesList.summary: Anand receives his first earnings and gives all credit to Sejal and her father. Meanwhile, the Virani family is getting ready for Anupam and Tulsi's grand wedding.

episodesList.title: Anupam,Mona discuss Amar
episodesList.summary: Anupam asks Mona about Amar's health conditions and asks her to get Mona into his marriage. Meanwhile, Payal visits the Viranis and decides to help them in Tulsi and Anupam's marriage.

episodesList.title: Gayatri, Tulsi Make a Wish
episodesList.summary: Gayatri and Tulsi tell Jamnadas that she wishes to see Payal as her daughter-in-law. Meanwhile, Payal and Hemant worry as they discuss the future of their relationship.

episodesList.title: Rakesh, Suhasi miss Aniket
episodesList.summary: Suhasi is shattered as tells Rakesh that she misses her son Aniket. Elsewhere, Tulsi recalls her memories with Mihir while she attends an opening ceremony with Anupam.

episodesList.title: Daksha Tricks Godhavari Dadi
episodesList.summary: As Godhavari Dadi calls Daksha, the latter tricks her by disguising herself as a telecaller. Meanwhile, Hemant asks Baa about her view on Payal and his relationship.

episodesList.title: Jamnadas Praises Anand
episodesList.summary: As Anand spends his time working, Jamnadas appreciates his dedication. Elsewhere, Mona shows Mihir the gifts she selected to gift Tulsi on her marriage.

episodesList.title: Mihir is Stunned
episodesList.summary: Mihir is surprised as Mona tells a photographer that she is soon going to marry him. Later, Govardhan gets emotional and asks Jamnadas to repay Payal's debt with a cheque.

episodesList.title: Hemant, Payal Discuss Their Relationship
episodesList.summary: After clearing Payal's cheque, Hemant and Payal discuss their relationship. Later, Sejal is worried as Anand spends most of his time in the company.

episodesList.title: Hemant, Payal's Engagement Ceremony
episodesList.summary: The Viranis are excited as they celebrate Hemant and Payal's grand engagement. Meanwhile, Savita gets worried as she shares Arati's perspective with Tulsi.

episodesList.title: Govardhan Confers Tulsi's wedding preparations
episodesList.summary: Payal discusses with Arati her future plans of having a baby with Hemant. Elsewhere, Govardhan discusses Tulsi and Anupam's marriage function with his sons.

episodesList.title: Tulsi's Firm Decision
episodesList.summary: Tulsi decides to keep Gautam with Savita as she is concerned about Savita's emotions. Meanwhile, Payal and Hemant about Tulsi's firm decision regarding Gautam.

episodesList.title: Amar Advises Mandira
episodesList.summary: Mandira pushes Amar to accompany her to meet Anupam on her way, but Amar advises Mandira to leave him behind and let him finish his treatment without fail.

episodesList.title: Mihir Tries to Remember His Family
episodesList.summary: Mihir struggles to recollect the memories of his family members during his medical treatment, while Tulsi and her family enjoy the Garba dance together.

episodesList.title: Tulsi Sees Mihir
episodesList.summary: When Mihir shows up at Tulsi and Anupam's wedding, Tulsi can't stop crying when she sees Mihir during her nuptials with Anupam. After this incident, Mihir goes unconscious.

episodesList.title: Anupam is Heartbroken
episodesList.summary: Anupam and Mandira feel distraught after the incident at the wedding. Meanwhile, Mihir tries to identify his family members. Everyone is hoping Mihir will recover quickly.

episodesList.title: Mandira Remembers Her Love
episodesList.summary: Mandira reveals her eternal love for Amar when Anupam advises her to forget her past and move on with her life. Mandira then meets Mihir and tells him about her pain.

episodesList.title: Tulsi Seems Concerned for Mihir
episodesList.summary: When Tulsi asks her uncle about Mihir's condition, he calms her and tells her not to worry about him. Meanwhile, Mihir remembers an incident from his past.

episodesList.title: Mihir Remembers Everything
episodesList.summary: Mihir recalls everything and embraces Tulsi to express his love for her. Mihir's family members are overjoyed when he returns to normalcy. Meanwhile, Mihir seemed perplexed by Payal and Hemant's engagement.

episodesList.title: Payal Meets Mihir
episodesList.summary: Payal sees Mihir after he regains his memory and wants his opinion on her relationship with Hemant. Mandira talks to Mihir and reveals her affection for him. Savita seems worries about Aarti and Kiran.

episodesList.title: Anupam Congratulates Mihir
episodesList.summary: Anupam congratulates Mihir on his recovery and promises him their friendship will last forever. Further, Mandira commits to love Mihir forever.

episodesList.title: Anupam Worries About Mandira
episodesList.summary: Anupam shows his concerns for Mandira for her condition and behaviour. Meanwhile, Payal prays to ruin the ecstatic life of Mihir and Tulsi.

episodesList.title: Mihir Shows His Concern for Sejal
episodesList.summary: When Mihir expresses his concerns about Sejal to J.D Virani, he is reassured and advises him to wait. Hemant confronts Anand thereafter and warns him about Sejal.

episodesList.title: Mihir Remembers Mandira
episodesList.summary: Mihir remembers Mandira when he visits the temple with Tulsi, Amba, and Bapuji. Anupam advises Mandira to forget about Mihir and concentrate on finding her healing. Gayatri starts preparing for Hemant and Payal's wedding.

episodesList.title: Tulsi Is Worried About Mihir
episodesList.summary: As Mandira returns into Mihir's life, he is anxious and acts weird around Tulsi. Tulsi senses this and asks him about what is bothering him, Mihir stays silent.

episodesList.title: Mihir Meets Mandira
episodesList.summary: Tulsi has a nightmare where Mihir revealed his love for Mandira. Later, Mihir visits Mandira in real life, while Tulsi grows suspicious.

episodesList.title: Tulsi Suspects Mihir
episodesList.summary: Tulsi gets a hint of Mihir's extra-marital affair when Mihir receives text messages from Mandira at night. Tulsi goes to Mihir's office, but doesn't find him.

episodesList.title: Mihir Acts Suspicious
episodesList.summary: Tulsi doubts Mihir of cheating but is hesitant to confront him. Payal and her mother cunningly plot against Mihir.

episodesList.title: Mihir Buys Saree for Tulsi
episodesList.summary: Mihir is buying sarees for Tulsi and on his way out he bumps into Mandira. Mihir is forced to give those sarees to Mandira instead of Tulsi!

episodesList.title: Mihir Is Upset with Aarti
episodesList.summary: Aarti returns home and surprises Tulsi. Later, Mihir is furious as Aarti shares confidential business information with Payal.

episodesList.title: Mandira Sends Mihir flowers
episodesList.summary: Mandira meets Mihir for a coffee, later, she sends Mihir a card for the saree and flowers. Kesar receives them, but who does she hand them over to?

episodesList.title: Mihir, Tulsi Get Nostalgic
episodesList.summary: Tulsi gets upset about Mihir's extra-marital relationship as Amba tries to comfort her. Later, Tulsi and Mihir visit the temple.

episodesList.title: Payal Schemes Against Tulsi
episodesList.summary: Payal sends Anupam a birthday gift in Tulsi's name, he calls to thank her, Savita receives the call. She reprimands Tulsi, who is clueless.

episodesList.title: Chirag Wants to Marry Prajakta
episodesList.summary: Chirag tries to convince Daksha about Prajakta and informs Mihir about this. While Daksha and Himmat daydream of marrying him to a girl of their choice.

episodesList.title: Tulsi, Mandira's Face-Off
episodesList.summary: Tulsi and Mihir meet Anupam and Mandira for his birthday dinner. Tulsi and Mandira get into heated arguments regarding Mihir!

episodesList.title: The Viranis Celebrate
episodesList.summary: It's the 50th wedding anniversary of Govardhan and Amba! Everyone discusses how to celebrate, while Tulsi has a grand plan in mind for the couple.

episodesList.title: Retrospection of the past year
episodesList.summary: The most popular dramas on Indian television complete a year with the 211th episode. This episode shows the best moments, bloopers and favourite scenes of the characters.

episodesList.title: Payal Up to No Good!
episodesList.summary: Payal continues plotting against the Virani family. She steals a letter from Tulsi's room and places one with Mandira's sign-off on it.

episodesList.title: Mandira Requests Anupam
episodesList.summary: Kesar meets Anupam and gives him Mandira's photographs with Mihir. Meanwhile, Mandira makes a request to Anupam and asks him to bring back Mihir to her.

episodesList.title: Payal's Vile Ploy
episodesList.summary: Chirag doubts Payal's intention when he observes Payal trying to spread misinformation about Aarti. Meanwhile, Tulsi confronts Deepak and asks him about the Photographs.

episodesList.title: Mandira is Adamant
episodesList.summary: While Savita confronts Aarti to console her, the latter learns about Payal's vile ploy. Later, Anupam tries to make understand Mandira as she gets adamant to marry Mihir.

episodesList.title: Mihir Doubts Payal's Intension
episodesList.summary: Mihir and Tulsi get declared as the 'Best Couple' in a game. Meanwhile, Mihir doubts Payal's intention and decides to remove her from the company.

episodesList.title: Chirag Makes a Plan
episodesList.summary: Himmat refuses to give permission when Chirag shares his secret plan to marry Prajakta with Himmat. Later, Savita gets tensed to overhear Tulsi on the phone with Anupam.

episodesList.title: Mihir Learns Payal's Plan
episodesList.summary: Mihir gets furious to learn about Payal's villainous plan to break his relationship with Tulsi. Meanwhile, breaks down in tears when Savita questions Tulsi's character.

episodesList.title: Daksha Learns the Truth
episodesList.summary: Pooja wants to fly to the USA and tries to give the best treatment to Rajeev. Elsewhere, Daksha gets infuriated to learn the truth about Chirag and Prajakta's wedding.

episodesList.title: Chirag, Prajakta face Daksha
episodesList.summary: An enraged Daksha raises her hand on Chirag when the latter tries to convince her. Meanwhile, Pooja gets restless when Rajeev's health deteriorates in the hospital.

episodesList.title: Tulsi Gets Emotional
episodesList.summary: Prajakta faces Daksha's wrath when she stands firm and tries to convince the latter. Meanwhile, Tulsi gets emotional and has a breakdown when Mandira asks Mihir to meet.

episodesList.title: A Shocker for Mihir
episodesList.summary: Pooja gets an emotional breakdown after Rajeev's death. Meanwhile, Mihir gets shocked to learn about Mandira's pregnancy.

episodesList.title: Mihir is in a Dilemma
episodesList.summary: When Mihir learns that Mandira is pregnant with his child he gets into a dilemma. Meanwhile, Tulsi asks for help to clear the differences between them.

episodesList.title: Jamnadas learns Payal's Truth
episodesList.summary: Kesar informs Savita about Tulsi's pregnancy. Elsewhere, Jamnadas gets shocked to learn about Payal's villainous motive and asks Mihir to inform Hemant about her plan.

episodesList.title: Jamnadas Gets a Heart Attack
episodesList.summary: Mandira's mother gets shocked to learn about Mandira's pregnancy. Meanwhile, after a conversation with Mihir about Payal's villainous motives, Jamnadas suffers a heart attack.

episodesList.title: Mandira Takes a Decision
episodesList.summary: Payal's father and Hemant make a decision to postpone Hemant and Payal's wedding till Jamnadas' health improves. Elsewhere, Mandira decides not to abort her baby.

episodesList.title: A Shocker for Mihir
episodesList.summary: Mandira calls Mihir and reveals that her mother has found out about her pregnancy. Elsewhere, JD asks Chirag and Kiran to keep an eye on Payal.

episodesList.title: Tulsi Learns the Truth
episodesList.summary: Payal finds out Mandira and Mihir's truth when she overhears their conversation at the hospital. Later, Tulsi chances upon Mihir's phone and learns his secret.

episodesList.title: Payal Spies on Mihir, Mandira
episodesList.summary: While the Viranis celebrate Raksha Bandhan, Aarti informs Kiran about her visit to the Doctor. Elsewhere, Payal tries to spy on Mandira and Mihir.

episodesList.title: Anupam's Wish for Mandira
episodesList.summary: Anupam asks Mandira to forget about Mihir as her gift to him for Raksha Bandhan. However, Anupam is disappointed when Mandira refuses to grant his wish.

episodesList.title: Mandira's Shocking Decision
episodesList.summary: Anupam is shocked to learn about Mandira's decision to get married and not move to Delhi. Later, Anupam reveals Mandira's decision to Mihir.

episodesList.title: Mihir is in a Fix
episodesList.summary: While Mandira blames herself for their situation, Mihir is worried about Payal's next move. Later, Mihir prepares for the eventuality of Tulsi learning the truth.

episodesList.title: Mihir Threatens Payal
episodesList.summary: Mihir gives a stern warning to Payal and asks her not to reveal the truth about Mandira's pregnancy to Tulsi. Elsewhere, Mandira meets with a potential groom.

episodesList.title: Surprising News for Mihir
episodesList.summary: While Savita and Gayatri plan to get Kesar out of the house, Mandira has an emotional conversation with Mihir. Later, JD reveals surprising news to Mihir.

episodesList.title: Mandira's Wedding is Called Off
episodesList.summary: Payal learns from her friend, Rahul that his wedding is fixed with Mandira and reveals the truth about Mandira's pregnancy. Later, Rahul calls off the wedding.

episodesList.title: Anupam Learns the Truth
episodesList.summary: Anupam is devastated to learn about Mandira's wedding being cancelled. Later, Anupam finds out that Mandira is pregnant with Mihir's child.

episodesList.title: Payal's Birthday Celebration
episodesList.summary: The Viranis celebrate Payal's birthday as Hemant throws a party. Later, Tulsi gets suspicious about Mandira when the latter suddenly falls ill.

episodesList.title: Mihir Confesses the Truth
episodesList.summary: Mihir reveals the truth about him being the father of Mandira's unborn child to Tulsi and his family. Later, the Viranis show their support for Tulsi.

episodesList.title: Mihir Avoids Mandira
episodesList.summary: While Tulsi and Mihir's marriage starts to slowly break apart, Mihir tries to distance himself from Mandira. Elsewhere, Anupam is still angry with Mandira.

episodesList.title: Mihir Learns a Shocker
episodesList.summary: Mihir gets worried when Anupam reveals that Mandira's abortion is not possible without risking her life. Elsewhere, Payal pretends to show her support for Tulsi.

episodesList.title: Mihir Feels Avoided
episodesList.summary: After Savita berates Tulsi for being rude, Mihir feels that Tulsi distancing herself from him. Later, Jamnadas, Mihir, and Kiran discuss how to keep Payal in check.

episodesList.title: Savita is Worried for Mandira
episodesList.summary: Payal tries to console Savita when she gets worried for Mandira and feels pity for her. Later, Payal and Hemant discuss their wedding on their way to Pooja's home.

episodesList.title: Worrying News for the Viranis
episodesList.summary: Pooja requests Jamnadas and Hemant to teach her the finer nuances of business. Meanwhile, Chirag informs the family that Raksha is on her way to the Virani home.

episodesList.title: Payal's Tactics Against Pooja
episodesList.summary: Payal misinterprets Pooja's visits to the office and plans to keep her away from Hemant. Later, Tulsi and Mihir meet Mandira at a clothing store.

episodesList.title: Savita Meets Mandira
episodesList.summary: Savita feels bad for a distraught Mandira as she tries to clear her misunderstanding about Mihir. Later, Tulsi gets curious to know about Gautam's shirt.

episodesList.title: Tulsi's Birthday Plannings
episodesList.summary: Baa wants Tulsi to accompany her for a ritual, knowing well that she won't refuse her. While the Viranis plan a surprise birthday party for Tulsi, Mihir buys her a gift.

title: Ghar Ek Mandir
summary: Ghar Ek Mandir (transl. Home a Mandir) is an Indian television show which aired on Sony TV from 24 April 2000 to 10 January 2002. It was directed By Yatindra Rawat and produced By Balaji Telefilms and Ekta Kapoor.
plot: The show centers around a middle-class Indian family headed by Gopal, a retired school principal, his wife Gayatri and their four children. The eldest son Rajesh is married to his love Sapna and has two children - daughter Rinky and son Bunty. The middle son Prem is to be engaged to a lawyer named Aanchal. The third son is Rahul. He is a law graduate but is unable to find any good employment. He is happy-go-lucky and shirks his responsibilities. The three brothers have a younger sister Archana who is immature and materialistic. Unfortunately, Prem dies due to a bomb blast on the day of his engagement to Aanchal, leaving his mother Gayatri in a state of shock. Gayatri desires to see Aanchal as a bride. Aanchal hasn't got over Prem yet while Rahul loves a spoilt rich girl, Mala. But due to family pressure to help Gayatri recover, Rahul and Aanchal get married. They consider this marriage as a sacrifice for their family’s welfare and do not have any intimate feelings for each other. Concurrently, Archana marries Aanchal's brother Vishwajeet, an emerging writer. The lives and stories of different characters are weaved together in this show, but the focus is on how Rahul and Aanchal slowly realize they are each other's soulmates and fall in love. They even end up consummating their marriage accidentally which leads to Aanchal getting pregnant with their first child, Pratham. With the arrival of baby Pratham, Gayatri recovers completely, believing that her Prem has returned to her at last.Throughout the course of the show, Rahul transforms into a more responsible person and together with Aanchal, supports his family.

title: Santhi Nivasam
summary:
Santhi Nivasam is an Indian Telugu-language television drama series that aired on ETV from 2000 to 2001, spanning 273 episodes. Directed by S. S. Rajamouli in his directorial debut, the series follows Raghavayya, the patriarch of a large family living in a house named Santhi Nivasam, as they navigate familial conflicts, relationships, and societal challenges. Produced by K. Raghavendra Rao under his banner RK Teleshow, the series played a key role in shaping Rajamouli's career, laying the foundation for his transition to feature films.
The show featured an ensemble cast, including Ranganath, Sameer, Rajeev Kanakala, and Harsha Vardhan, with music composed by M. M. Srilekha and lyrics by Chandrabose. After Rajamouli transitioned to directing Student No. 1 (2001), Vara Mullapudi took over the direction of the series. The show was well-received during its broadcast and is regarded as an early success in Rajamouli's career. Although plans for a film adaptation were announced, the project was ultimately shelved.
plot:
The series follows Raghavayya, the patriarch of a large family living in a house named Santhi Nivasam. The narrative explores the complexities of familial relationships and the challenges faced by the family, including thefts, misunderstandings, and interpersonal conflicts. Raghavayya strives to maintain harmony within the household while upholding moral values, but the family frequently encounters dramatic twists and societal pressures.
Central to the story are Raghavayya's children who, along with other family members, navigate personal struggles and collective conflicts. Notable events include Adarsh risking his life to save Anand, Dharma Das plotting to harm the family, and Raghavayya confronting financial and social challenges. The series delves into themes of sacrifice, morality, and the enduring strength of family bonds.

title: Chithi
summary:
Chithi is an Indian Tamil prime time soap opera that aired on Sun TV. The show premiered on 20 December 1999 and ended on 1 November 2001. It aired Monday through Friday at 9:30pm. The serial stars Radhika Sarathkumar in dual roles, with Sivakumar.
The show was produced by Radaan Mediaworks, directed by C. J. Baskar. The title track was composed by Dhina. It was also aired in Sri Lanka Tamil Channel on Shakthi TV and United Kingdom Tamil Channel on Deepam TV. The show started reairing from 6 April 2020 to 26 June 2021 in Sun TV. It was dubbed into Telugu as Pinni and aired on Gemini TV. The show started reairing from 2 October 2025 on Thanthi One.
A reboot version of the series titled Chithi 2 premiered from January 27, 2020, on Sun TV starring Radikaa Sarathkumar and Preethi Sharma.
plot:
Chithi is a serial based on women empowerment and the challenges faced by women in India. A Brahmin society in Srirangam, Trichy, Ramachandran, lives with his seven-year-old daughter Kaveri and a mentally challenged wife Vaidhegi. He has a best friend, Krishna, son of a box factory watchman. On the night of Karthigai Deepam, Vaidhegi drowns in a river, and following, a woman is running and a few men chasing her with firesticks. They set her saree aflame, and she jumps into the river. Vaidhegi is presumed dead and Kaveri longs for a mother's love. She waits for chithi (step-mum/aunt). Soon, she rescues the woman with the help of Krishna and Ramu. She starts calling her chithi, which creates chaos among the society people. The woman does not talk, but Kaveri clings to her. Ramu gets irritated and in the end, to prove his stand, he had no other choice but to accept the woman. The woman talks for the first time and reveals her name to be Sharadha. Krishna's father passes away, then Ramu and Krishna go to Madras searching for a job.
In Madras, they go to a textile store which is owned by Mahalingam. They buy clothes linings and materials worth about 10 Lacs and ask Mahalingam to loan it to them to which he disagrees. Distraught, they wander around the shop and bumps into Prabhavathi, the daughter of Mahalingam. She convinces her father to loan to them, and he agrees. Prabha falls for Ramu and helps both of them in all the ways she can, together with her cousin Velumani. This right side of Prabha has a qualified team, which shows that being the only daughter of a rich man, she would get anything she wants. If she does not get it, no one should get it. This behaviour of Prabha starts at a higher height when she falls in love with Ramu.
When Ramu and Krishna become successful in business, Prabha comes forward to reveal her love to Ramu, but he said he has Sharadha waiting for him at Agraharam. She becomes sad and plans to take revenge over Ramu.
Mahalingam and Padma fix a groom for Prabhavathi from the US, just because she forced Krishna to marry her. Velumani and Prabha make Krishna drink more, and makes him marry her at no other choice. Once Ramu marries Sharadha, he brings her and Kaveri to Chennai and later found Krishna being married. As Ramu said he could not leave Krishna in his life, he brings Krishna, Prabha and Velumani to the same house where he stays for rent.
The owner of the house is Janaki (Mahalingam's first love) and her two daughters. Mahalingam was forced to marry the Padma but secretly lives with Janaki with whom he gave birth to two daughters Viji and Geetha. As days pass, both Sharadha and Prabhavathi become pregnant. Prabhavathi makes Kaveri turn towards her to take revenge on her father and stepmother. Soon Kaveri leaves hostel and Sharadha starts a textile industry named Kavery Garments and builds a new house which she calls as Sharadha Illam.
They also bring Krishna's family to that house, including Velumani. Meanwhile, at Janaki's side, Viji loves a shed mechanic Surya, but Janaki reluctant to get her daughter married to a mechanic, makes Viji marry her own uncle's (Janaki's brother) son named Anand, where she faces torture from him.
Sharadha and Prabhavathi are admitted in the same hospital at the same time, and both simultaneously deliver sons. Ramu and Krishna fear these children will cause division between them, exchange the babies. Ramu names Krishna's son as Srinivasan and Krishna name Ramu's son as Prasad. Years pass, Sharadha business Kaveri Garments grows with profit, and she delivers two more kids, daughter Swetha and son Sreevatsan. Meanwhile, Prabhavathi and Krishna have another child, a daughter named Brindha. Since then all five kids grow up in the same house, like brothers and sisters. Srinivasan was found to be physically challenged as Prabha has taken a tablet to try to abort him, but Krishna is happy that the child is with Sharadha who loves him. She starts to love Srinivasan more than her other two children.
Kaveri, who went to the hostel as a child, return home as a teen. Initially, she was against her chithi by insulting her. Velumani and Prabha make Kaveri fall in love with a womaniser and drug smuggler named Nagu, without knowing his true colours, Kaveri loves him. Soon she starts to elope with him but before that she apologises to her step mom. She even used to insult Srinivas for being a lame person. On the day of fleeing on her 19th birthday, she found Nagu's true colours and both get remanded in a police station, Sharadha comes and saves her and hides the truth from her family. She starts to love her chithi more and realises her mistake, and soon shraddha starts to find a groom for her with Ramu and Krishna. Angered by Velu and Prabha, they try to stop Kaveri wedding by several attempts.
They hire Yogi as General Manager for Kaveri Garments, who kept on following Sharadha since her arrival to Srirangam, as few flash scenes were showing Sharadha and Yogi were working together and are relatives. But she does not want to bring her past and dedicates her complete life to Kaveri and Ramu. However, still, they make Yogi stay in their home, as he was a successful Manager for Kaveri Garments and Architect for Sharadha Illam as none knew about the past. Kaveri wedding gets fixed and got stopped as Ramu hid the truth to grooms parents that Sharadha belongs to different caste, as Vaidehi's mother exposed it. She did not like Ramu marrying different caste girl. To make Kaveri come out of it, Ramu and Sharadha do her work at Kaveri Garments. Meanwhile, Viji who faced torture under Anand and his family runs from their home and seeks Sharadha's house for shelter. Even she joins the same department of Kaveri at Kaveri Garments, and both enjoy working there.
Soon Sharadha finds a groom for Kaveri, from a lower-middle-class family. She gifts a house to them, and he works part-time at Temple, then in a computer training centre and evening as hotel supervisor to support his family. His name is Madhavan, who belongs to the same caste as Ramu. Wedding gets fixed, and Madhavan parents are excellent Sharadha being from a different caste. Things go smoothly, and Ramu learns that Vaidhegi is alive, he asks many times to go to his home, but she refused as he lived half of his life with Sharadha, but he secretly lives with her, and only Krishna come to know about it. One day Sharadha and Yogi spots Ramu giving flowers to a woman in a car and arguments arrives between them, an angered Yogi tells who Sharadha is.
Story shifts to flashback to Thirunelveli, where Sharadha is found to be IAS Collector of Thiruvnelveli, she has a twin sister named Sakthi Eshwar who is AC. Their father Eashwaran Pandiyan is a business tycoon and big don of the city which has fume with MLA Viswanathan. Yogi's mother's brother is Eshwara Pandi, as Yogi lost his mom as a toddler, he grew at Eashwaran house. Sakthi was his love interest. Eashwaran Pandian is not fond of Sharadha and favours Shakti over her.
Nevertheless, Sharadha and Shakti are close to each other. There comes a problem and unknowingly Eswara Pandian is a part of it. Amidst this, Sharada and Shakti's mother dies in a bomb blast, and Sharadha fights with her father. She even says that he would be punished. Angered, MLA Viswanathan and Eswara Pandian plot against Sharadha. Shakti suspecting this takes the form of her sister's avatar as Sharadha IAS and goes with Yogi. When they reach a temple, MLA and Eswaran, mistaking Shakti for Sharadha, kills her. Sharadha devastated, argues with her father, who realises his mistake. The MLA, on the other hand, orders his men to kill Sharadha. Eswaran Pandian and Yogi fail to save Sharadha, and Eswaran are arrested. Sharadha runs for her life and jumps into the water, and the little Kaveri saves her life in Kavery River, at Srirangam, which happened at the beginning of the show.
Yogi completes telling the story to Ramu and the rest and Sharadha's secret is out. And Vaidheghi's existence is revealed to Sharadha by Krishna and they bring her with Sharadha's approval. Meanwhile, Kaveri gets pregnant while at the same time, Nagu is out of jail to avenge Kaveri. (Madhavan knows about Nagu and Kaveri). Viji faces problems at the factory due to her past life with Anand and Sharadha gets her married to Yogi. Angered and insulted, Anand comes to throw acid at Viji's face but gets involved in an accident. He apologises to Viji before dying, and Anand's chapter is over. Nagu tries very hard to avenge Kaveri. Kaveri is admitted to the hospital at night, and Nagu goes there, which results in Kaveri's miscarriage. Kaveri's mother-in-law starts hating her for hiding the truth about Nagu. Suddenly, Krishna who has gotten liver cancer by his drinking habit last time, But he is mysteriously killed by a group. Prabhavathi poisons Prasad's mind that Ramu and Sharadha are the reason Krishna died. Prasad curses them before leaving Sharadha Illam with his family and Velu. Ramu is left heartbroken with the death of his best friend and rift between his family and Krishna's family. Viji gets pregnant but slips and falls and goes into labour. She dies of injuries but gives birth to a healthy baby girl whom Yogi names Sakthi.
The year rolls by, and all the kids are grown up. Kavery is left childless even after consulting many doctors and gains more of her mother-in-law's wrath. Madhavan keeps on supporting her. Srinivas, who is bounded to crutches, becomes a journalist and writer. Shakti is seen to have a feeling for Srinivasan. Shweta becomes a teacher at a school while Srivatsan becomes a doctor. Prasad an engineer and Brindha start training as for IPS. Now Vaidhegi and her mother are staying with Sharadha in a rented house, but act against Sharadha by indirectly helping Prabha. Sharadha Islam is undergoing a court case after Prabha files the fact that she too has a share in it. Things start to heat up when the children fall in love, and Eswaran gets released. Shakti's crush on Srinivas starts to bother Ramu as technically, Srinivas and Shakti are brother and sister as their biological mothers, Prabha and Viji are half-sisters. But Srinivas starts to fall for a fan of him, Kamini. Brindha and her fellow IPS friend, Shreedar form a mutual friendship, but Shreedar falls for Brindha. Prasad's friend, Daniel, eventually marries Brindha and Prasad gets committed with a girl called Charulatha. Srivatsan marries his doctor friend Sangeetha and stays in her house. What Shweta does comes as a shock to the whole family. At the day of her wedding, Shweta runs away with a useless, poor slum guy called Kannan. Ramu leaves home after this and stays in an Ashramam. It is Prasad, who arranged Kannan through Daniel to torture Sharadha using her daughter, Shweta. But he did not expect Shweta to fall for Kannan. Under some circumstances, Sharadha and the family move to the Janaki's house like before, Vaidhegi chases her mother out and goes a change of heart. Kavery Garment starts to fall apart, and Sharadha stumbles. Eswaran comes and stays with the family. Padmavathy angrily goes to Prabha and tells the truth about her son. It was shown that Krishna told Padmavathy the truth before he died. Later, Padmavathy dies in a car accident and Mahalingam also died out of shock. Prabha comes to meet Ramu in the ashram and learns the truth. She is left heartbroken as she loves Prasad a lot.
Kaveri stays with Sharadha and her mother-in-law falls sick. Madhavan comes to bring her back but Kaveri disagrees much to Madhavan's anger. But things changes and Madhavan's mother accepts Kaveri with a full heart. Shweta lives a hard and troubled lifestyle. Later, Kanan changes his heart and start a business through the indirect help of Sharadha. But Shwetha starts to demand from Sharadha. Shweta scolds her saying that she always preferred Kaveri over her children, causing Sharadha to get angrier on her and chase her out of Kavery Garments. Ramu returns after some time. Meanwhile, murders take place and it surrounds Prabha and Sharadha's families. Eswaran also dies after fighting with some old rivals in Prabha's residence. Shreedar starts to investigate the case with Brindha and they suspect Prabha to be responsible. Prabha is having a dilemma to choose between Prasad or Srinivas. Her slight affection towards her biological son, Srinivas, anger and upsets Prasad. Velu Mani finds the relevant document of Sharadha being Prasad's birth mother and is shocked. Heart-broken in thinking that Prasad is not his real nephew at first, he changes and demands 5 crores from Prabha to hide the truth. Prabha, scared and helpless, kills Velu also. Everyone is shocked about this. Shakti kills herself after discovering from Prabha that Srinivas, the man she loved is her cousin. The whole family is shattered. Sharadha illam case is solved and Sharadha gets back her home. Srinivas goes to meet Prabha and learns that Shakti went there before killing herself after Prasad accidentally blurts it out. Srinivas fights with Prabha and Prasad accidentally pushes him against a wall, injuring his head. Prabha angered at Prasad argues with him and he leaves home devastated.
Sharadha learns of Srinivas's injury and is angered, goes to kill Prasad and Prabha. Ramu stops her and tells her the truth that Prasad is her real son. Sharadha cries learning the truth. Meanwhile, Yogi learns the truth about the original sons of Sharadha and Prabha from the suicidal letter of Sakthi. Srinivas comes home and Sharadha breaks down in front of him. They get a call and learn that Prabha had locked herself in a room and wants to speak to Sharadha. They go to Prabha's house and Prabha begs Sharadha to not take Prasad away from her. Sharadha, realizing Prabha's true love for Prasad, promises her that she would not tell anyone the truth and that Prasad is her son. Prabha, thankful, surrenders to the police. Sharadha has to take care of both Prasad and Srinivas.
Several days later, Yogi brings photograph crew to the Sharadha Illam to take a family photo. To their shock, the crew looks exactly like the dead Eswaran, Velu Mani and much to Ramu's shock, Krishna. But they are not their men. While taking the photograph, Kaveri declares she is pregnant. A few years later, Prabha is released and the whole family with their children pose for the final family photograph.

title: Aabhalmaya
summary: Aabhalmaya (transl. Skylove) is an Indian Marathi language television series which was aired on Alpha TV Marathi. It starred Sukanya Kulkarni, Manoj Joshi and Sanjay Mone in lead roles.
plot: The story revolves around the Professor Sudha Joshi teacher in Ratanbai College, whose family includes her husband Sharad who is also a professor, and they have two daughters Akansha and Anushka. When Sharad falls in love with another Professor Chitra with whom he has a one daughter named Chingi, it leads to a rift in the family.

title: Ek Mahal Ho Sapno Ka
wikiTitle: Ek Mahal Ho Sapno Ka (TV series)
summary: Ek Mahal Ho Sapno Ka (transl. A palace of dreams) is a Hindi language Indian soap opera that aired on Sony TV. The show was a remake of Gujarati show on ETV Gujarati called Sapna Na Vavetar. It was the first Hindi-language fiction series to reach 1000 episodes.
plot: The story revolves around a Gujarati business tycoon, Purushottam Nanavati, who is the head of his joint family of four married sons. It focuses on the trials & tribulations that a joint family faces, whether it is due to the family members' separation or their union. In addition, it shows how the family members find ways to cope with these differences.

title: Hip Hip Hurray
summary: Hip Hip Hurray is an Indian teen drama series that aired from 21 October 1998 to 25 May 2001 on Zee TV. Produced under the banner of UTV Television, it was created and directed by Nupur Asthana.
plot: The show focuses on the lives of 12th-grade students at the DeNobili High School and their adventures, their fears and hopes, and their relationships and interactions. The show additionally discusses various issues pertinent to teenagers such as dating, drugs, careers, health, exams and causes, with a balance of drama and humour.

episodesList.title: Will Alisha be Able to Make Friends In Her New School?

episodesList.title: Fight Between Prishita and Alisha

episodesList.title: What Kind Of Condition did The Children Give to Mrs Sharma Mam?
episodesList.summary: Vincent Announces A Class Test As A Punishment For The Students Troubling Mrs Sharma. Kiran Is Unhappy To See Mazhar Work As A Waiter. She Is Furious At Him And Insults Him.

episodesList.title: Everyone is Making Fun Of Meera

episodesList.title: The Thief Who Stole Money Came In Front Of Sammy
episodesList.summary: Samantha Loses Her Money. Rafey And The Other Students Plan To Hide In The Class And Catch The Thief. They Are Shocked To See Manjeet Stealing Money. Manjeet's Deed Hurts Raghav.

episodesList.title: Raghav Got Hurt Due to Manjeet's Actions.
episodesList.summary: The Changes In Manjeet Dishearten Raghav. Manjeet Falls Down Senseless And Foam Comes Out Of His Mouth. His Friends Panic On Seeing Him Unwell. Vincent Takes Him To The Hospital.

episodesList.title: Heated Argument Between Raghav and Mona
episodesList.summary: Arjun Appoints Raghav To Train His Juniors For A Basketball Tournament. Raghav's Juniors Are Offended By His Strictness. Rajeev Fights With Raghav And Quits The Team.

episodesList.title: What Kind Of Bonus did The Principal Give to Raghav?
episodesList.summary: Raghav Is Removed From His Captainship. He Feels That Rajeev Has Instigated The Team Against Him. Rajeev Fights With Raghav. Mrs Rodrigues Reappoints Raghav As The Sports Captain.

episodesList.title: Rafey Made Homeless By His Aunt
episodesList.summary: Rafey Blames Himself For Rahil's Mistake. Rafey's Aunt Gets Furious And Throws Him Out Of Her House. He Fails To Contact His Friends And Ends Up Staying In Alaknanda's House.

episodesList.title: Rafey Decided to Live Separately
episodesList.summary: Rafey Doesn't Wish To Go Back To His Aunt's House And Wants To Earn His Livelihood. Chandragupta Decides To Accommodate Rafey In His House And Asks Him To Make Tea For Him.

episodesList.title: Hussain Started Children's Class
episodesList.summary: Kiran And Alisha Tell Cyrus About The Expectations Of The Older People. Cyrus Realises Their Words And Intends To Perform The Republic Day Drill In An Old-age Home.

episodesList.title: Bella Late Color Your Dreams
episodesList.summary: Alisha Encourages Bela To Participate In A Painting Competition. Bela's Parents Refuse To Support Her. They Pressurise Her To Study Medical Science And Become A Doctor.

episodesList.title: The Path Of Art Opened For Bella In Paris
episodesList.summary: Bela's Father Refuses To Sign Her Participation Form For An Art Competition. Chandragupta Signs Bela's Form On Her Father's Behalf. She Wins The Contest And Thanks Chandragupta.

episodesList.title: Alisha and Rafey's Love Story Begins
episodesList.summary: All The Friends Congratulate Bela For Her Achievement. Bela's Parents Are Unhappy As She Participated In The Art Contest Without Their Agreement. Kiran Is Unwell, And She Vomits.

episodesList.title: Kiran Became Hyper After Listening to His Friends.
episodesList.summary: All The Friends Celebrate Valentine's Day. John Gives Gifts To Alaknanda. Alisha Accepts Being Rafey's Valentine. Kiran Is Unwell And Faints While Dancing.

episodesList.title: Kiran Shouted At Aniket
episodesList.summary: Mazhar And Mona Research Kiran's Sudden Change. They Feel That Kiran Needs Medical Help. Vincent Asks Aniket To Take Kiran To A Psychiatrist, But He Is Furious At Vincent.

episodesList.title: Neetu and Aniket Came to Know About Kiran's Illness.
episodesList.summary: Dr Chhabria Informs Kiran About Her Eating Disorder. Ritu Apologises To Kiran For Not Being Able To Understand Her. The Students Celebrate Holi In Alaknanda's House.

episodesList.title: Alaknanda's Pregnancy News had a Negative Impact
episodesList.summary: Sunila Sees Alaknanda At A Gynaecologist's Clinic And Spreads The News About Her Pregnancy. All The Parents Appeal To The School Authority To Expel Alaknanda From The School.

episodesList.title: Sandhya Mam Cried Due to Misbehavior Of Children
episodesList.summary: Alaknanda Decides To Take Leaves Of Absence. The Students Support Alaknanda's Pregnancy And Decide Not To Appear For Their Board Exams If She Doesn't Join The School.

episodesList.title: What Question did Avinash Ask Mrs. Sharma?
episodesList.summary: Sunila's Realisation Influences The Decision Of The School Authority. Alaknanda Informs The Children About The Decision In Her Favour. A New Student, Nonie, Joins De Nobili School.

episodesList.title: Bela is Motivating Everyone For No Uniform
episodesList.summary: The Students Of 12th Standard Picnic. Alisha Is Disturbed To See Rafey Roaming Around With Nonie. Mazhar Feels Bad For Alisha And Accompanies Her.

episodesList.title: John Lost Consciousness After Seeing Mona
episodesList.summary: Alisha Is Upset With Rafey's Closeness With Nonie. Mazhar Tells Rafey To Spend Time With Alisha. Alisha Scolds Nonie And Rafey Gets Angry With Alisha. Alisha Breaks Up With Rafey.

episodesList.title: Is There Any Chance Between Rafey and Alisha?
episodesList.summary: Cyrus Tells His Friends About Rafey And Alisha's Break-up. Everyone Holds Nonie Responsible For The Break-up. She Is Hurt By The Criticism Regarding Her. Nonie Likes Mazhar.

episodesList.title: Who is Mehul Going to Date?
episodesList.summary: Mehul Narrates A False Love Story Of Him And Shalini To His Pals. Mehul's Friends Insist On Him Bringing Shalini To Mazhar's Party. Mehul Fools Cyrus By Lying About His Break-up.

episodesList.title: Jagda About The Dance Between Kiran and Mona
episodesList.summary: All The Girls Plan To Protect The Environment And Animals. They Gather All The Stray Dogs And Approach People To Adopt Them. Yadav Connects The Students To A Dog Adoption Centre.

episodesList.title: How did Kiran Get Hurt Before The Dance?
episodesList.summary: Kiran And Mona Get Involved In Two Competitions To Occupy The Central Position In The Dance Performance. Kiran's Ankle Gets Injured, And She Quits The Group. Mona Follows Kiran.

episodesList.title: What Kind Of Opportunity did Raghav Give to Rajni?
episodesList.summary: Mona And Kiran, Along With The Other Girls, Decide To Work On Educating The Poor Children. They Gather Some Of The Kids In The School And Tutor Them With The Help Of Their Friends.

episodesList.title: John is Liking Mona?
episodesList.summary: Mona Announces A College-oriented Tv Show To Be Produced By The Students. Mona And John's Concepts Differ. The Majority Of The Class Support John, Which Angers Mona.

episodesList.title: John was Given The Responsibility Of Teaching Rehearsal.
episodesList.summary: Prishita Is Excited To Audition For The Role Of The Host For The Collegiate Tv Show. She Is Sure Of Getting Selected, But She Is Shocked To Know About Samantha's Selection.

episodesList.title: Sharma Mam Started Cooking Class
episodesList.summary: Prishita Calls Samantha Incapable. Samantha Lashes Out At Prishita And Challenges Her To Win The Final Audition. Mona And John Express Their Feelings To Each Other.

episodesList.title: Misses Sharma Telling Hindi Marks to Children
episodesList.summary: The Students Prank Mrs Sharma. Yadav Catches The Student Mischief And Decides To Punish Them. Prishita Tries To Save Herself From Being Punished. Yadav Is Unhappy With Prishita.

episodesList.title: John's Sister Came to His House
episodesList.summary: Samantha And Kiran See Prishita Trying To Steal A Question Paper. Kiran Gets Angry With Prishita For Trying To Cheat. But She Saves Prishita From Getting Caught By The Teachers.

episodesList.title: What is Bella Upset About?

episodesList.title: Bella's Brother Beats Her Friends

episodesList.title: Nonie and Kiran are Copying Lavaniya

episodesList.title: Lavanya Called The Class Children Animals

episodesList.title: Shareen Got Admission In Special School
episodesList.summary: Sharon Has Down Syndrome. Cyrus Wants To Help Sharon Develop Herself. He Helps Sheila Admit Sharon To A School For Special Children. Sharon Enjoys Going To A School.

episodesList.title: Why did Jhon Get Scolded By His Father?

episodesList.summary: Mrs Rodrigues Is Unhappy With The Students For Joining Coaching Classes. She Discusses With The Parents And Decides To Arrange Extra Classes In The School To Help The Students.

episodesList.title: Mona's Father Congratulating Rodriguez
episodesList.summary: Mona Is Unhappy With Mr Joshi's Inclination Towards Mrs Rodrigues. She Gets Angry On Seeing Both Of Them Together. Mona Is Upset With The Situation And Her Friends' Remarks.

episodesList.title: Principal Gave Punishment to Mona
episodesList.summary: Mr Joshi Scolds Mona For Speaking Ill Of Mrs Rodrigues. He And Mrs Rodrigues Discuss Mona. He Tells Mrs Rodrigues About Mona's Insecurities. Mona Apologises To Mr Joshi.

episodesList.title: The Distance Between Mona and Her Father Started Increasing

episodesList.title: Principal Rodriguez is Saddened By Mike's Departure
episodesList.summary: Mona Arranges A Prayer Meeting For Mike. She Asks Mrs Rodrigues To Marry Mr Joshi, But She Calls Mr Joshi, Her Friend. Rafey Feels Insecure With Alisha And Raghav's Closeness.

episodesList.title: Jhon The Monkey Came In Front Of Mona

episodesList.title: Rafey Became Jealous Seeing Alisha With Raghav
episodesList.summary: Rafey Feels Jealous About Alisha Dancing With Raghav. Rafey Approaches Her For A Dance And Apologises To Her. He Requests Her To Return To His Life. She Patches Up With Him.

episodesList.title: Cyrus Lied In Front Of Anuradha
episodesList.summary: Yadav Catches Cyrus Talking In The Class And Asks Him To Solve A Theorem. Cyrus Feigns Sickness And Bunks His Class With John. Cyrus And John Go To Water Kingdom.

episodesList.title: Cyrus John Wakes Up With Anuradha

episodesList.title: Rafey is Going to Marry Alisha
episodesList.summary: Vincent Gets An Opportunity To Teach At An Ngo In Kenya For Two Years. The Students And Alaknanda Try Their Level Best To Stop Him From Going Away, But They Fail.

episodesList.title: Children Became Emotional After Vinnie Sir Went to London
episodesList.summary: Vincent Rethinks And Decides Not To Go To Kenya. He Surprises All The Students With His Changed Decision. Prishita's Conduct Makes Meera Feel Isolated.

episodesList.title: Why did Meera Sleep In Class?
episodesList.summary: An Upset And Lonely Meera Joins A Social Media Chatroom. Prishita Criticises Meera For Talking To Unknown People. Meera Gets Angry With Prishita And Scolds Her.

episodesList.title: Her Cool Dude Came to Meet Meera
episodesList.summary: The Teachers Plan To Surprise The Students On Children's Day. Vincent Manages To Bring The Students To The School. The Teachers Perform A Skit And Entertain The Students.

episodesList.summary: Chandragupta Discusses The Relationship Between A Man And A Woman. Mazhar Invites Nonie To His House, And They Try To Behave Intimately, But John And Cyrus Ruin Their Plan.

episodesList.title: Mehul Understood His Father's Helplessness.

episodesList.title: Kiran Apologized to Vinnie Sir On The Trip

episodesList.title: John Took Mona On a Boat Ride

episodesList.title: What is The Rift Between Yadav and Vinnie Sir?
episodesList.summary: Mrs Rodrigues Appoints Yadav As The Substitute Principal. The Students And Teachers Are Unhappy With Yadav's Strictness. Vincent Discusses With Yadav And Finds A Middle Path.

episodesList.title: Vinnie Sir Stopped Kiran From Driving
episodesList.summary: Kiran Steals The Car Keys From Ritu's Drawer And Attempts To Learn Driving From Cyrus. Kiran Ends Up Accidentally Hitting A Man. The Police Arrest Kiran, Cyrus And Prishita.

episodesList.title: Whose Accident did Kiran and Cyrus Do?
episodesList.summary: Vincent And Mehul Apologise To Mr Mehra And Take The Case's Withdrawal Letter From Him. Vincent Frees The Students From Police Custody. Mr Mehra Accepts Kiran's Apology.

episodesList.title: Yadav Sir Became Strict Regarding This Matter On Children

episodesList.title: Yadav Played Band For Boycotting Children
episodesList.summary: Cyrus Plans To Promote The Literacy Campaign Of De Nobili High School By Celebrity Endorsement. Actor Milind Soman Decides To Promote Their Campaign Free Of Cost.

episodesList.title: The Boys Came to See Prishita

episodesList.title: With Whom did Nonie Introduce John?
episodesList.summary: Nonie And Maya Become Friends. Nonie Attempts To Imitate Maya And Steals A Neck-piece From A Showroom. The Detector Rings, And Nonie Gets Into Trouble. Maya Saves Nonie.

episodesList.title: Alisha Doesn't Want to Go to White Horn School
episodesList.summary: Mr Mehta's Job Is Transferred To Delhi, And He Plans To Admit Alisha To Her Previous School. Rafey Loses His Calm On Knowing About Alisha Leaving De Nobili High School.

episodesList.title: Why did Vinnie Sir and Alisha Become Emotional?
episodesList.summary: Vincent Helps Alisha To Deal With The Situation. Alisha's Friends Arrange A Surprise Farewell Party For Her. Rafey Promises To Be In Touch With Alisha Through Emails And Calls.

episodesList.title: Ishita Betrayed Kiran
episodesList.summary: Vincent Decides To Take An Audition To Select The Eligible Students To Play The Characters Of Romeo And Juliet. Vincent Chooses Meera To Play The Role Of Juliet, And Kiran Is Hurt.

episodesList.title: Kiran Got The Role Of Juliet
episodesList.summary: John And Cyrus Play A Trick And Send Flowers To Alaknanda In Vincent's Name. The Students Perform The Play Flawlessly, And They Get A Standing Ovation From The Audience.

episodesList.title: Why does Sammy Feel Like Crying?
episodesList.summary: The Students Start Preparing For Their Exams. Vincent Proposes Marriage To Alaknanda, Who Accepts His Proposal. They Surprise The Students With Their Wedding Announcement.

episodesList.title: Alaknanda and Vinnie Sir's Upcoming Wedding
episodesList.summary: The Students Finish Their Exams And Go To Attend Vincent-alaknanda's Wedding. Alaknanda And Vincent Get Married. Alaknanda Undergoes Labour Pain, And She Delivers A Girl.

episodesList.title: Vinnie Sir Changed Children's Teacher

title: Saaya
summary: Saaya (transl. Shadow) is an Indian soap opera aired on Sony TV in 1998. The series was produced by popular production house, UTV Software Communications and revolved around two very different girls – Sudha (Manasi Joshi Roy) and Kamiya (Achint Kaur) who become friends.
plot:
Sudha is a quiet, fragile and an incredibly shy girl who comes from an orthodox family where her father Jagat Narayan has the final say. Kamiya, on the other hand, is bursting with a vibrant zest for life and is an extroverted, confident young girl from a modern family.
Sudha and Kamiya meet in college and become best friends always there to support each other through the rough times until things change between them.
