title: Aashirwad
summary: Aashirwad is a Hindi television serial that aired on Zee TV from 19 June 1998 to 13 July 2001. The serial was based on story of two best friends who raise their children in different styles. The Show was produced by Manish Goswami.
plot: The story is of two friends who raise their children in contrasting styles — one allowing them all possible liberties and the other keeping a strict hold on them. It explores a central theme of parenting — whether leniency in upbringing of children is justified or not — and traces the consequent pros and cons as the children mature into adults.
tagline: The story is of two friends who raise their children in contrasting styles — one allowing them all possible liberties and the other keeping a strict hold on them.

title: X Zone
summary: X Zone is an Indian television series aired on Zee TV from 8 June 1998 to 30 October 2000. It was the Indian version of X-Files Directors like Anurag Basu, Tulsi Ramsay, Shyam Ramsay, Kushan Nandy, Vivek Agnihotri, Imtiaz Ali, Anil Sharma, Ketan Mehta directed the episodes of X Zone. It used to air every Monday at night.
tagline: X Zone is an Indian television series aired on Zee TV from 8 June 1998 to 30 October 2000.

title: CID
summary:
CID is an Indian police procedural television series that premiered on Sony Entertainment Television on 21 January 1998. The series was created by B. P. Singh and produced by Singh and Pradeep Uppoor under the banner of Fireworks Productions in season 1; Deepak Dhar, Rajesh Chadha, Akshay Singh and B.P. Singh under Banijay Asia in season 2 alongside Fiction Factory. It features Shivaji Satam as ACP Pradyuman, Aditya Srivastava as Sr. Inspector Abhijeet, Dayanand Shetty as Sr. Inspector Daya, Dinesh Phadnis as Inspector Fredricks and Narendra Gupta as Dr. Salunkhe.
The location of CID is set in Mumbai. The series is one of the longest-running television series in India. The series first premiered on 21 January 1998 and aired its 500th episode on 18 January 2008, 1000th episode on 13 September 2013, 1500th episode on 4 March 2018, last episode on 27 October 2018.  The series renewed for a second season, which aired from 21 December 2024 to 14 December 2025.The second season also started streaming simultaneously on Netflix from 21 February 2025.

episodesList.summary: Five kids in the Suryakiran Apartments play the role of their favourite CID characters in order to find their lost cat Sweety. However, their adventure is cut short as one of them named Micky stumbles upon the dead body of Jay.

episodesList.title: Devil Robbers
episodesList.summary: While a young girl waits for her friend, Happy, who has entered the departmental store to come out, she sees a gang of thieves with masked faces enter and take over the store, holding those inside hostage.

episodesList.title: The Secret of Rebirth
episodesList.summary: The CID team finds a skeleton chained to a big rock in the water. They come over to Namitha's house to ask why her and Baljeet's relationship broke.

episodesList.title: Bus Hijack
episodesList.summary: Freddie takes all of the children in his colony on a summer camp. On the way to the summer camp, the driver stops the bus because the road will be blocked with barricades. Freddie and the driver get off the bus to check and a man comes from behind and holds Freddie at gun point while a few other armed men enter the bus.

episodesList.title: The Case of the Mark
episodesList.summary: Kunal witnesses two robbers escaping from the society with a bag and a bloody knife. CID arrive to investigate the robbery and find out that a second robbery has taken place in the society, along with a murder.

episodesList.title: Brave Kid
episodesList.summary: Dhruv who was upset with his exam result. He gets lost on his way to school and while finding his way back, he sees a man exhausted from running and helps him. He gets himself in deep trouble by helping the stranger.

episodesList.title: Heroine in Danger
episodesList.summary: Tinu, who works with a tea seller, is a huge fan of Bindiya, an actress. But, Bindiya dislikes acting and is only doing it because her stepmother pressurises her. Tinu goes to the C.I.D s bureau to tell them about the imminent threat to Bindiya s life, as he fears that she may be kidnapped.

episodesList.title: Neighbor in Danger
episodesList.summary: Micky sees a woman locked in a room, as another woman drives off in a silver-coloured car. Meanwhile, the CIDs find a dying man who has been on the road. With the help of Dhenchu, the CIDs find the man s killer.

episodesList.title: The Mystery of the Tifin Box
episodesList.summary: A school teacher has been poisoned, and the CID team investigate. The man was poisoned while having food from a pupil, Guddu s lunchbox. Guddu is missing, and his friends tell the CID's that they had offered Guddu s lunchbox to the sir, without Guddu's permission.

episodesList.title: Kidnap in the Airport
episodesList.summary: Airport managers find a child, Tanya, who is lost and weeping miserably. On checking her boarding-pass they find that she has come from Mumbai to Delhi. They decide to send Tanya back to Mumbai with an air hostess to hand her over to her parents. On reaching Mumbai, Tanya goes missing again from the wash room.

episodesList.title: Daya in Danger
episodesList.summary: Ravi, a former offender, tries to kill Daya by dropping a huge concrete slab on Daya s car, but he escapes in the nick of time. Then, Daya remembers a drawing that he had got with the morning newspaper, that depicts the scene exactly.

episodesList.title: Innocent Killer
episodesList.summary: From the Autopsy, the doctor finds a piece of betel nut from Aakash's body. Taking this as a cue and with clever investigation the CID team finds the tool, which was used to murder Aakash.

episodesList.title: Murder in a Car Race
episodesList.summary: A young man dies in a mysterious go-karting accident, witnessed by his own friends & a few youn boys. However, one of the boys claim that it may not have been an accident but murder, as a few days ago all of them had almost been killed in another car accident.

episodesList.title: Little Comedian Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Rajat learns that Roma had undergone a failed kidney transplant, and Daya and the others go their separate ways searching for the hospital where Roma had undergone the surgery for the transplant. Later, the CIDs learn that Rajat s vehicle has met with an accident, and Rajat is missing.

episodesList.title: The Secret of Absconding Girls
episodesList.summary: Damini is assumed to have eloped with a stranger. Damini's neighbour, Sunita, too is missing and is assumed to have eloped with another boy. Later, Damini's younger sister identifies a dead body as Sunita.

episodesList.title: The Secret of Treasure Hunt
episodesList.summary: Tourists, Randeep and Savita, take their daughter, Tanya, on a tour of an island. However, Randeep is forced to call the CID team when he finds his daughter missing. The CID, on their investigation, find that Tanya was involved in a treasure hunt.

episodesList.title: Code of Remote
episodesList.summary: As the CID team investigates a kidnapping case, Ajit, the director of a bio plant company whose daughter, Poonam, was kidnapped, receives a call from the culprit who asks him to produce the remote that controls the cooling plant as a ransom for Poonam. However, upon handing over the remote, he learns that Poonam has been relocated and poisoned. Ajit is then told that unless he produces the code to activate the remote within three hours, she will not be given the antidote to the poison and will be left to die.

episodesList.title: Sniper Rifle Murderer
episodesList.summary: During a critical rescue operation, Abhijeet tragically loses his daughter Shreya due to a minor error by Daya. Three months later, a mysterious shooting incident occurs on a metro, leaving a woman injured. How will ACP Pradyuman and his team uncover the truth behind this case?

episodesList.title: A Mid-Air Murder
episodesList.summary: On a mid-air flight, Abhijeet receives voice notes with certain instructions. He soon discovers a dead passenger on one of the seats. How will team CID aid Abhijeet solve the case and catch the culprit before the flight lands?

episodesList.title: Body In The Red Suitcase
episodesList.summary: During a journey from Nagpur to Mumbai, Richa's husband, Alok, vanishes under mysterious circumstances. Shockingly, his dismembered body is later discovered inside a suitcase. Who is behind this chilling crime?

episodesList.title: Chehre Par Chehra
episodesList.summary: CID officer Avni investigates a case involving her injured friend uncovering a tangled web of deception, identity twists, and a tragic past Can the team bring clarity to the chaos?

episodesList.title: Murder On The Island
episodesList.summary: Three charred bodies are discovered in a bungalow on a secluded island by catering staff. The CID team steps in to uncover the mystery behind the gruesome deaths. What secrets does the island hold?

episodesList.title: Salunkhe's Catwalk
episodesList.summary: The CID team investigates the mysterious death of Digvijay, an NRI groom, at his own wedding. As the case unfolds, they uncover a web of deception, hidden grudges, and unexpected twists, leading to a dramatic revelation about the true motive behind the crimes.

episodesList.title: Grehani
episodesList.summary: Vishal is a tech genius, whose AI, Grehani, leads to his mysterious death. The CID uncovers secrets of betrayal, rivalry, and a conspiracy surrounding the AI's dangerous potential.

episodesList.title: Bank Robbery
episodesList.summary: A bank robbery in Mumbai leaves manager Rahul as the sole victim of a planned attack. As CID investigates, they uncover a web of betting addiction, kidnapping, and betrayal involving Rahul, his sister-in-law Kanchan, and others.

episodesList.title: Twelfth Victim
episodesList.summary: A young man, Vasu, is jailed for his girlfriend Jhanvi’s murder, but years later, a serial killer confesses. CID uncovers a web of corruption, revenge, and deception tied to Jhanvi’s workplace, ultimately preventing a sinister plot and delivering justice.

episodesList.title: Jungle
episodesList.summary: A foreign photographer’s mysterious death in a forest sparks a CID investigation. As they uncover corruption, illegal activities, and local rituals, the team faces unforeseen challenges.

episodesList.title: Gumnaam Hai Koi
episodesList.summary: Tragedy strikes when a dancer suddenly collapses and dies while performing a hoola hoop routine on stage.

episodesList.title: Ready to Eat
episodesList.summary: The CID investigates a series of gruesome discoveries: fingers with numbers found in sausage packets. Tracing the source to a factory, they uncover a smuggling ring using victims to transport diamonds to Dubai.

episodesList.title: Charcoal
episodesList.summary: A corporate party turns deadly when a mysterious poison causes multiple deaths. The CID races against time, following clues to uncover the culprit and stop the poison's spread.

episodesList.title: Katputli Ka Khel
episodesList.summary: CID investigates a dancer's murder, uncovering a series of killings tied to an artistic pattern and a dark past. As they race to stop the next crime, the case leads to a dramatic showdown in an abandoned theatre.

episodesList.title: Killer Route
episodesList.summary: A series of gruesome murders targeting bus conductors on a specific route every Sunday baffles the CID, as victims are found beheaded with no trace of blood or their missing heads. Going undercover as conductors, the CID team hunts for the elusive killer.

episodesList.title: The Last Fight
episodesList.summary: The sudden death of a very famous underground fighter, Vikram in the ring. His girlfriend, sensing the situation, calls the CID.

episodesList.title: Flat No 403
episodesList.summary: A gunshot echoes through a society, leading CID to Vikrant's flat, where they find bloodstains and a skull on the wall. What mystery lies behind this chilling scene?

episodesList.title: Mechanical Trap
episodesList.summary: A deadly threat frames CID, putting Daya under suspicion. As the team investigates, they uncover a web of deception and the real mastermind behind the setup.

episodesList.title: Haunted House
episodesList.summary: Rajveer and his friends discover bloodstains in an abandoned bungalow and alert the CID. As the team investigates, they uncover something suspicious.

episodesList.title: Murder In The House
episodesList.summary: A woman is found dead in her home after a chandelier mysteriously falls on her. As CID investigates, they uncover suspicious details surrounding the incident.

episodesList.title: Gilheri Rakshas
episodesList.summary: A man discovers a dead body in the forest and suspects the Gilheri Rakshas is behind it. Can CID uncover the truth?

episodesList.title: Death Of A Therapist
episodesList.summary: Inspector Abhijeet discovers Dr. Meera dead at her clinic. As CID investigates, their search leads them to a Softech Solutions company. Who is behind the murder?

episodesList.title: Not Guilty
episodesList.summary: After an accident on a jungle road, Akshita seeks refuge with Dr. Salunkhe, who tries to shield her. As CID investigates, hidden truths unravel, leading to a shocking revelation.

episodesList.title: Curse Of The Burning Man
episodesList.summary: A man is found dead with burning footprints leading away. As the CID investigate, they uncover a deadly plot tied to an old shipyard legend.

episodesList.title: Swimmers
episodesList.summary: Three state-level swimmers go for a swim, but when one of them is found dead under mysterious circumstances, CID steps in. As they investigate, dark secrets and a cunning murder plot unravel, leading to a shocking truth.

episodesList.title: Room No 804
episodesList.summary: A man checks into Forest Woodland Resort only to realize that the eighth floor, which existed earlier, has mysteriously vanished. Later, CID arrives to investigate the murder of a girl found in Room 408. What is the truth behind this baffling case?

episodesList.title: Baby Steps
episodesList.summary: A yoga instructor, Rohini, mysteriously dies while on a call with CID, with only her baby present. Soon, another instructor, Puja, also dies. CID discovers both were killed remotely using Bluetooth hacks. How will CID solve this case?

episodesList.title: The Talking Skeleton
episodesList.summary: CID investigates a restaurant staff member’s death and uncovers hidden remains in a statue. As more victims emerge, they follow clues leading to a smuggling operation. How will CID get to the bottom of the case?

episodesList.title: Men's Premier League
episodesList.summary: The CID team is thrown into action when a biker hurls a duffel bag onto their car, raising bomb concerns. Upon inspection, they find cash and a tape recorder exposing a syndicate linked to match-fixing, with clues tied to cricket.

episodesList.title: Nakabposh
episodesList.summary: While Inspector Abhijeet pursues a criminal, he meets a man at a bus stop who claims to have a vision of a girl being murdered, with her hair being cut off. Soon after, CID investigates a case that matches his eerie prediction. Is this coincidence or something more sinister?

episodesList.title: The End Of The Watch
episodesList.summary: CID uncovers a bomb plot, only to realize it’s a trap by Barboza of the Golden Eye Gang. He hijacks the bureau and successfully kills ACP Pradyuman. Is this end of CID and ACP Pradyuman?

episodesList.title: The Aftermath
episodesList.summary: Barboza makes a threatening call to Daya, revealing ACP’s death. As the team reels from the loss, they prepare to take down Barboza and his gang. Meanwhile, Sachin remains in the ICU and Avni battles her injuries.

episodesList.title: Ticket To Heaven
episodesList.summary: Rajeev, a shopkeeper, is found dead on a bus under alarming circumstances - his face had turned cherry red with signs of rapid rigor mortis. CID officers Purvi and Pankaj are joined on the case by a couple of other officers, who doubt the team's capabilities in ACP Pradyuman's absence.

episodesList.title: Purze
episodesList.summary: ACP Ayushmaan arrives as the new ACP and sets boundaries before the team. Team CID then investigates the cases of gruesome, organ-harvesting murders, where the victims are abducted and are operated on when alive.

episodesList.title: Murder At The Studio
episodesList.summary: Podcaster Aniket, who had recently uncovered the identity of the culprit behind a two-year-old murder case, is found dead in his studio with his throat slit. ACP Ayushmaan and the CID take charge of the investigation to uncover the truth behind this chilling crime.

episodesList.title: Murder At The Railway Tracks
episodesList.summary: A girl is found dead near the Mahim railway tracks, prompting CID to take charge of the investigation. Meanwhile, Sachin notices something suspicious about the victim's footwear and urgently asks to speak with Inspector Daya,

episodesList.title: Death In The Car
episodesList.summary: A company prepares for a grand launch of its latest car, meant to showcase the future of automobiles. But during the big reveal, a corpse is discovered in the driver's seat. How will CID solve the case?

episodesList.title: The Silent Den
episodesList.summary: A mysterious murder takes place inside a silent den, leaving Team CID with no clear leads. As suspicion spreads among the staff and guests, will they be able to uncover the killer hiding in plain sight?

episodesList.title: CID Mein Gaddar
episodesList.summary: Team CID arrives at a school under threat from an unknown man. Meanwhile, ACP Pradyuman and ACP Ayushmaan clash over the Barboza case, with Ayushmaan suspecting a mole within their own team

episodesList.title: Accidental Death Or A Planned Murder?
episodesList.summary: Two celebrities from a reality show meet a mysterious end, sending shockwaves through the industry. As the investigation unfolds, team CID is soon alerted to yet another tragic incident - the accidental death of rising star Dhwani. Are these deaths truly accidents, or is there a sinister plot at play? With the pressure mounting, CID races against time to uncover the truth and bring the culprits to justice.

episodesList.title: The Last Stroke
episodesList.summary: A painter is found dead in his art gallery while working on a painting. As CID begins their investigation, they discover a lipstick mark on a cup, a diary, a photograph, and a mobile phone. Can these clues lead them to the killer?

episodesList.title: Missing Flight
episodesList.summary: Team CID is left baffled when they discover a corpse strapped to a seat, resembling a pilot who appears to have crashed. What is the mystery behind this strange death?

episodesList.title: The Mysterious Death Of A Businessman
episodesList.summary: A successful businessman is found dead while swimming in his pool at his farmhouse. Team CID investigates the case and is unable to find the cause of the death of the businessman. Soon after, another man is murdered. How will the team crack the cases?

episodesList.title: Skeleton At A Construction Site
episodesList.summary: CID team takes on a new case involving a skeleton found buried in the ground. With no initial clues, how will the team unravel the mystery?

episodesList.title: Case Of Real Diamonds
episodesList.summary: Two men are brutally murdered on the same night, one at home and the other at his office. The CID begins investigating and finds a diamond studed vase in both the crime scenes. Could there be a connection between the two cases?

episodesList.title: The Last Call
episodesList.summary: Unknown calls trigger deadly phone explosions across the city. CID discovers chips secretly installed in phones via a fake repair campaign. Linked to the old EchoNet project, the mastermind remains unknown.

episodesList.title: Jewellery Theft
episodesList.summary: A raid turns shocking when CID uncovers stolen jewellery in a godown - alongside Inspector Daya's badge. As suspicion clouds the team, a second daring heist strikes another jewellery store, carried out by masked men. Is Daya truly behind it, or is someone framing him?

episodesList.title: ACP Pradyuman Is Alive?
episodesList.summary: Daya tells the CID team that ACP Pradyuman is alive-but in a shocking twist, he reveals that the ACP failed to recognize him and opened fire. As the team reels from the news, Daya exposes a dark secret about Barboza and his gang that shakes them to the core. Can CID reach ACP Pradyuman before it's too late?

episodesList.title: ACP Pradyuman Tricks CID
episodesList.summary: ACP Pradyuman escapes with Barboza, deceiving the entire CID team. When he walks into the bureau, Abhijeet refuses to believe his story. Later, ACP reveals the shocking truth behind how he survived the bureau blast.

episodesList.title: Accident Or Murder?
episodesList.summary: Purvi comes under suspicion as the team believes she's the mole, until the DIG arrives just in time to defend her. Meanwhile, CID investigates a minor car crash with a shocking twist. Was the driver killed in the accident, or was he already dead before the impact?

episodesList.title: Behind the Glamour
episodesList.summary: Ira, an actress who had bagged a coveted role, is found hanging in her apartment. Team CID investigates the case as they find out about Ira's rival. Who killed Ira, and why?

episodesList.title: Death In The Jungle
episodesList.summary: While trekking, four friends stumble upon a headless body deep in the jungle. When CID investigates, they find something even stranger - the body has no blood. With no clues and rising fear, can CID uncover the truth behind this eerie mystery?

episodesList.title: Dead Men In Uniform
episodesList.summary: A group of kids find a gun in their society. Soon after, a policeman falls to his death. A young girl silently sees someone who looks like Daya behind a mask. Later, two more police officers are murdered. What is this case really about?

episodesList.title: Janamdin Par Maut
episodesList.summary: Officer Daya tampers some of the evidence of a case. Parallelly, a man is murdered as he enters his house for his surprise birthday party. Notably, while waiting for Salil to return, Dodo makes a statement about the incident of a man being killed on his birthday. Who killed Salil and why?

episodesList.title: Omkar Sawant Joins The Team
episodesList.summary: Daya shoots Inspector Milan on a moving bus. As CID begins their investigation, Superintendent Omkar Sawant joins the team. While interrogating the passengers, they uncover four distinct personalities within the same man. Can they reach Daya in time and will Inspector Milan survive?

episodesList.title: Omkar Sawant Has A Breakthrough
episodesList.summary: Superintendent Omkar Sawant announces that the death of Officer Milan has resulted in a breakthrough in the case. Soon after, he states that he has been tracing Officer Daya's moves. Meanwhile, team CID is notified about murder cases that lead to similar, torturous deaths of different victims.

episodesList.title: Officer Daya Is On The Run
episodesList.summary: Officer Daya disguises himself and boards a flight. The same flight happens to get hijacked. With team CID on the hunt for Officer Daya, will he be able to save the passengers, conceal his identity, and get away without drawing any attention towards him?

episodesList.title: An Encrypted Message
episodesList.summary: Team CID raids Officer Daya's house and discovers that he has escaped in disguise. While Officer Daya takes Shreya's help once he lands in Delhi, some of the members of Team CID decrypt his secret message left behind. What will the encrypted message lead to?

episodesList.title: Purvi Receives A Message
episodesList.summary: While team CID surrounds the Governor's residence, Daya succeeds in sending an encrypted message to Purvi. Daya and Shreya continue working on their operation. Will Purvi be able to decipher Daya's message?

episodesList.title: Double Agent Daya
episodesList.summary: When Omkar Sawant exposes Daya's truth, Abhijeet defends him and reveals the real mastermind. As Purvi and Abhijeet enter the building to rescue Daya and the Governor, will their mission succeed?

episodesList.title: Team CID On A Vacation
episodesList.summary: While team CID is on vacation at a resort, they discover that a comedian's manager named Mohan has been murdered after being hit on the head by a coconut. Can they solve the case while still on holiday?

episodesList.title: Officer Purvi's Narrow Escape
episodesList.summary: Team CID finds out the cause of Tanya's death. Soon after, Officer Purvi narrowly escapes acid being flung towards her. On further investigation, the team narrows down the list of suspects. Will the culprit outwit team CID?

episodesList.title: Ekk Anokha Case
episodesList.summary: Sarthak, a man who is found dead, writes in his suicide note about murdering somebody else. Team CID has 72 hours to crack the case and save the life of the victim. Who is the victim and why did Sarthak kill him before dying?

episodesList.title: Dr Salunkhe Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: With only 42 hours left, Dr. Salunkhe is missing. Meanwhile, the man impersonating him is found dead inside the jail. During the investigation, it is revealed that someone posing as Daya had visited Dr. Salunkhe in jail. Will CID be able to find the real Dr. Salunkhe and uncover the cure for the poison in time?

episodesList.title: CID Ke Naam Ek Gift
episodesList.summary: ACP Pradyuman receives a mysterious call about a gift from someone calling himself the Chessmaster. CID finds themselves caught in a real-life game of chess as they race to solve the case. What danger lies ahead for the team?

episodesList.title: Ekk Insaan, Do Maut
episodesList.summary: Team CID investigates the death of a man and finds out that he has died twice. How will the team uncover this curious mystery, and what is the cause of the death?

episodesList.title: Accident Ya Murder?
episodesList.summary: A bike accident takes a shocking turn when the autopsy reveals hidden truths. The team begins to suspect foul play. Was it really an accident or a cleverly planned murder? The race to find out the truth begins.

episodesList.title: Officer Abhijeet Witnesses A Crime
episodesList.summary: While recovering at home from an injury, Officer Abhijeet believes that he has witnessed a crime take place in the apartment opposite his. Officer Daya arrives at the aforesaid apartment and finds the apartment bare. Team CID investigates whether a crime has taken place or if Officer Abhijeet is hallucinating.

episodesList.title: Failed Transactions
episodesList.summary: Multiple payment transactions fail across the city. Meanwhile, CID probes an accident involving a doctor set to receive an award on 15th August, only to discover he was responsible for YPI transaction security. What mystery will this investigation uncover?

episodesList.title: Shraap
episodesList.summary: CID investigates a case in a chawl where young Prasad collapses during Dahi Handi practice, his body twisted backwards from the waist. While an old lady calls it a curse, will CID uncover the real cause?

episodesList.title: Dead Principal
episodesList.summary: The principal of a college is found dead under mysterious circumstances. When CID investigates, they find red powder in his nails and deep scratches on his neck. Their suspicion falls on Professor Ajit, but is he really behind the murder or is there more to the case?

episodesList.title: Do Minute, Do Khoon
episodesList.summary: As the organisers at Lunaro Art Gallery gear up for their most anticipated exhibition, Dr Myra and Vikram are found murdered. Team CID investigates the case but gets trapped at the gallery when the anti-theft alarm goes off. Will they solve the crime with depleting oxygen levels in the gallery?

episodesList.title: Manch Par Maut
episodesList.summary: Amid Ganpati celebrations, the CID team is called in to investigate the mysterious death of a famous dance teacher. While it appears to be a heart attack, suspicions of murder grow stronger. Will the truth come out?

episodesList.title: The Headless Dead Body
episodesList.summary: Team CID investigates the case of a headless dead body found in a trunk on top of a bus. Who is the victim, why was he murdered and who is the culprit?

episodesList.title: An Author's Murder Mystery
episodesList.summary: While Team CID is busy playing a game of chess, they receive news of the murder of renowned novelist Surya. The case appears to be a natural death at first, until they discover a burnt paper with details about the murder in his room. How will CID unravel this mystery?

episodesList.title: A Serial Killer's Revenge
episodesList.summary: Chaos erupts when a feared serial killer breaks free, determined to hunt those behind his arrest. As fear grips the city, the CID team must stay one step ahead and track him down before his deadly revenge claims more victims.",shortDescription:"Chaos erupts when a feared serial killer breaks free, determined to hunt those behind his arrest. As fear grips the city, the CID team must stay one step ahead and track him down before his deadly revenge claims more victims.

episodesList.title: Shooting Stars
episodesList.summary: Arpan mysteriously dies moments after proposing to his girlfriend through a video under a shooting star. When the CID begins its investigation, they discover his charred body at the very spot of the attack. Was Arpan truly killed by a celestial phenomenon, or is there a darker conspiracy at work?

episodesList.title: High Security Murder
episodesList.summary: Abhijeet receives a threat that his friend Dhanraj's life is in danger. With Dhanraj under high-profile security, can Abhijeet reach him before it's too late?

episodesList.title: Haunted Amusement Park
episodesList.summary: A social media experiment to revive an abandoned amusement park turns sinister when an influencer dies mid-stunt. Can the CID team uncover the dark truth hidden inside?

episodesList.title: Bureau Mein Murder
episodesList.summary: A man walks into the CID bureau to report a threat to his life and warns ACP Pradyuman about an impending attack in Mumbai. But before he can say more, he suddenly dies right there in the bureau. How will ACP Pradyuman and his team uncover the truth behind this case?

episodesList.title: Influencer Ki Maut
episodesList.summary: On being called by Shanaya's concerned manager, team CID smashes Shanaya's door and finds her murdered. The top suspects involve Shanaya's current boyfriend and her ex-boyfriend. Based on the postmortem results, team CID hunts for an important clue. How will they catch the murderer?

episodesList.title: Pariyon Ki Duniya
episodesList.summary: CID takes on a baffling case where people act possessed, speak of a fairyland, and then die by suicide. With no substances found in their bodies and all deaths occurring at the same time, what is really behind this mystery?

episodesList.title: A Poisoned Necklace
episodesList.summary: Shreya arrives to attend the engagement ceremony of Rashi and Aman. Soon after, Rashi is found murdered after having wom a poisoned necklace. Team CID investigates the case and finds out that a slow poison was being administered to Rashi since a while. Who is the culprit and why was Rashi murdered?

episodesList.title: Curious Case Of Artificial Intelligence
episodesList.summary: Cricketer Neerav's daughter is kidnapped from school, and CID steps in to investigate. They discover that an unknown person picked her up claiming to have Neerav's permission. How will CID crack the case?

episodesList.title: Murder At The Resort
episodesList.summary: Team CID reaches a resort to investigate the mysterious death of a young girl. Upon inspection, they discover she was stabbed in a fit of rage. Will CID uncover the truth behind Surbhi's death while questioning her friends?

episodesList.title: Deadly Overtime
episodesList.summary: A woman is murdered under mysterious circumstances while working late in her office. The CID team notices something strange in the CCTV footage. Motion sensors detect movement but no body appears. Forensics reveal unusual entry and exit wounds. Can the team solve this baffling case?

episodesList.title: Bungalow Mein Maut
episodesList.summary: CID investigates a shocking case where a man named Kunal is found dead, but the police discover that Kunal himself had reported his own death before it happened. What is the mystery behind this eerie case?

episodesList.title: An Obsessed Fan
episodesList.summary: Neha is found dead in actress Aisha's green room, stabbed in the back with a pair of scissors. During the investigation, Pankaj discovers a strange necklace with Aisha's photo made from blue hair. What dark secret lies behind this eerie clue?

episodesList.title: RJ Ki Maut
episodesList.summary: Pankaj is on a call with RJ Rishabh when suddenly, the RJ calls out for help and is then found murdered. When team CID investigates the case, they find a few dead honeybees in the room. Who is the culprit and why was the crime committed?

episodesList.title: Karmo Ka Phal
episodesList.summary: A man is found dead with his face crushed by a stone and a message scrawled in his blood at an isolated spot with no CCTV. Was his death a personal vendetta, or is there a darker motive behind it?

episodesList.title: Death Of A Fortune Teller
episodesList.summary: A crowd gathers to hear messages from their ancestors through a woman, but suddenly the woman collapses and dies right before their eyes. When CID arrives to investigate, they discover someone else's blood stains at the scene. What dark truth lies behind this mysterious case?

episodesList.title: Buried In Cement
episodesList.summary: A unique case comes up for the CID team when a body is discovered buried in cement inside an abandoned bungalow. What clues will the team uncover from this corpse that has been lying there for months?

episodesList.title: Cursed Mirror
episodesList.summary: Actress Reva is found unconscious after a mysterious accident that appears to be deliberate. When CID takes charge of the investigation, they discover that Reva possessed a cursed mirror. What dark secret lies behind this shocking incident?

episodesList.title: Death After Discharge
episodesList.summary: Dhiren, a businessman, is found dead in his car after being discharged from the hospital. Team CID investigates the case and finds out more about his family dynamics and the ongoing politics in his business. Who murdered Dhiren and why?

episodesList.title: Maut Ki Dhamki
episodesList.summary: Businessman Kuldeep receives a threatening phone call over a bungalow dispute and is later found dead in his meditation room. Team CID investigates the case and discovers a broken window and aroma oil on his face. Who killed Kuldeep?

episodesList.title: Apsara
episodesList.summary: While team CID heads out for a picnic, they stumble upon a mysterious case involving a missing policeman. The prime suspect is a woman who lives by the lake and is known to lure men with her charm and jewellery. As the team dives deeper into the investigation, they uncover multiple corpses hidden beneath the lake's surface. What dark secret lies behind this eerie mystery?

episodesList.title: Ekk Anokha Shadyantra
episodesList.summary: Team CID investigates a case where they find a woman's body without the head. The entire team stitches various clues together and identifies the victim to be Alisha. On further investigation, the team narrows down the flow of the events leading to the murder. Who murdered Alisha and why?

episodesList.title: A Chain Of Murders
episodesList.summary: The CID team stumbles upon a strange case where an auto-rickshaw driver is found strangled to death with no signs of struggle and no witnesses. Soon after, another eerily similar death is discovered not far from the first scene. Is a serial killer on the loose, or is there a deeper connection behind these murders?

episodesList.title: SOS Call
episodesList.summary: Team CID follows a set of coordinates to a secluded location after receiving an SOS call. As they begin their search, they try to track down Officer Shreya and a woman named Sarla who was with her. What mystery lies behind this case, and where have Shreya and Sarla disappeared?

episodesList.title: Rakshak Baba
episodesList.summary: Three friends trespass onto land owned by Rakshak Baba. One escapes, but the other two are found decapitated and their bodies discovered deeper in the forest. How will CID piece the case together?

episodesList.title: The Ghost Of Kalighati Village
episodesList.summary: While on vacation, Daya discovers a village plagued by murders. Locals claim a witch is behind these deaths. Can he uncover the truth?

episodesList.title: Murder At The Bureau
episodesList.summary: When a serial killer dies in CID custody, suspicion falls on Abhijeet. ACP Pradyuman defends him as the team fights to clear his name.

episodesList.title: Abhijeet's Secret Caller
episodesList.summary: A truck driver named Munna is found dead and his partner is missing. CID is stunned to discover that the RDX once loaded in the truck has vanished. During the investigation, Abhijeet receives a rose and a call from a mysterious woman asking for help. Are these two incidents connected?

episodesList.title: Abhijeet Shoots Daya
episodesList.summary: With Abhijeet suspected of having gone rogue, team CID attempts to track 400 kg of RDX across the city. The team follows a lead and tracks delivery boys in the city. Shortly after, during a shootout, Abhijeet fires at Daya before escaping. What is Abhijeet's plan?

tagline: CID is an Indian police procedural television series that premiered on Sony Entertainment Television on 21 January 1998.

title: Ramany vs Ramany
summary:
Ramany vs Ramany (also spelled as Ramani vs Ramani) is a Tamil-language sitcom directed by Naga and produced by K. Balachander under the banner of Min Bimbangal. It is recognized as the first ever Tamil sitcom. The series humorously depicts the daily life of a married couple, both named Ramany, highlighting their interpersonal clashes and quirky adventures. The narrative revolves around Mr. Ramany, an innocent sales representative, and Mrs. Ramany, a dissatisfied housewife who frequently laments her husband's shortcomings.
The series originally aired in two seasons. The first season, starring Vasuki Anand and Prithvi Raj, premiered on Sun TV in 1998 and consisted of 25 episodes. The second season, featuring Ram G and Devadarshini, aired on Raj TV in 2001 with a total of 51 episodes. Both seasons were later re-telecast on Vasanth TV and uploaded to Kavithalayaa's YouTube channel, where they gained a renewed audience and popularity.
In 2022, a third season titled Ramany vs Ramany 3.0 was released as a web series on aha. Vasuki Anand and Ram G reprised their roles from the earlier seasons, while Devadarshini did not return. The season marked the show's transition to digital platforms, with the first episode premiering on 4 March 2022.

episodesList.title: Introduction
episodesList.summary: This family comedy series tells about Ramani(Babloo) and Ramani(Vasuki), two different characters brought together by nuptial knot. Everyday comedy takes new shape in this serial.

episodesList.title: Introduction
episodesList.summary: Ramani vs Ramani (Part II) is first telecasted in 2001 on Raj TV. This is one of the most popular Tamil comedy play in the "sitcom" format, directed by Naaga and produced by K. Balachander under the banner Min Bimbangal.

episodesList.title: Grahapravesham
episodesList.summary: The episode begins with the buoyant celebration of the house-warming ceremony. Ramany's family moves into their newly built house, and they spend a night there amidst the funny chaos caused by their kith and kin.

episodesList.title: Masterly Servants
episodesList.summary: Ramany’s family moves into their new house. Later, a stranger claims the land as his father’s and threatens the family. A brassy woman randomly barges into the house and asks the family to appoint her as their housemaid.

episodesList.title: Adopted Pet
episodesList.summary: Youngest son Ram tries to convince his parents to adopt a pet dog. But both the Ramanys and their daughter comes up with a plan to stop him from doing so, it backfires them.

episodesList.title: Seven Year Itch
episodesList.summary: The Ramanys' daughter gets intrigued by the mention of 'Seven Year Itch' and her misunderstanding spirals into a web of confusions. How Mrs.Ramany comes out with a good plan and makes him & understand Makes this episode wholesome and hilarious.

episodesList.title: Get Well Soon
episodesList.summary: Mr. Ramany tries to prove to himself that he's still young and strong by doing many 'activities'. However, his attempts lead to some mild consequences which get blown out of proportion. Whom does he weaponize to deflect the issue? Watch and find out.

episodesList.title: Digital Detox
episodesList.summary: When a stranger sneaks into Ramany's house to steal stuff, the whole family is distracted by one or other digital gadgets. On the brink of escape, the thief gets caught by the housemaid. After realizing how the whole Ramany family was indulged in different digital media, the maid comes up with a funny idea to sort out the problem.

episodesList.title: Food Delivery
episodesList.summary: When children demand Mrs. Ramany to cook one lunch meal for a change, she makes every effort to prepare a decent meal. But when all her efforts fail goes in vain, she does something as a final resort which instigates more chaos and makes the episode even funnier.

episodesList.title: Hit and Run
episodesList.summary: Mrs. Ramany’s father commits a minor accident and dashes into Ramanys house to hide from the victim. The victims show up at Ramany’s door demanding an apology. What happens when the Ramanys invite them into their house to resolve the issue?

episodesList.title: Unwanted Guest
episodesList.summary: To escape from the monotonous routine of daily life, Ramany family decides to go on a family trip. When they are about to leave, an unwanted guest appears at their doorstep and ruins their trip plan. When he starts to get on their nerves with his braggy personality, who will put a stop to him?

episodesList.title: Fixed Fashion
episodesList.summary: When Ragini shows up with a nose piercing, Mrs. Ramany desires to get one. Mr. Ramany advises her to use a fake nose ring before getting a real piercing. But the story takes a hilarious turn when Ramany’s son replaces body glue with superglue. How will her mother-in-law react to this bizarre transformation?

episodesList.title: Boyfriend
episodesList.summary: When Ramanys’ children are left in their grandparent’s care for a while, it induces a clash between two different generations. When both her grandmothers suspect Ragini and her male friends, she reveals a shocking secret, which leaves the whole family stunned. What is that jaw-dropping secret?

episodesList.title: Birthday
episodesList.summary: The whole family gears up to celebrate Mr. Ramany’s upcoming birthday and strives to select the perfect birthday attire for him. When the plan falls to pieces, how will the birthday boy react to his ‘special’ attire?

title: Rishtey
summary: Rishtey is an Indian television series that aired from 1998 to 2001 on Zee TV channel.
plot: It features small stories of human relationships. The show highlights the essence of life and brings to the forefront the various aspects of human relationships, such as husbands and wives, lovers, parents and children, friends and siblings. Each episode delves into the intricate lives of the characters, their circumstances and their deepest emotions.

episodesList.title: Dooriyan...
episodesList.summary: Mike (Raj Zutshi) is in love with Veena (Arundhati), so he woos her and finally marries her. However, marriage does not prove to be a bed of roses as Mike and Veena find themselves to be incompatible. They have a little daughter named Tanya. Meanwhile, Mike meets Priya and they fall in love. Veena learns of their affair, and soon they separate, with Veena taking custody of Tanya. Priya too asks Mike to take a decision as she can share him with Tanya but not with Veena. Will Mike return to his family or to Priya? This episode is produced by Mrugesh and Akshay Mankad under Media Square.

episodesList.title: Aur Waqt Tham Gaya
episodesList.summary: Rashmi does not believe in love until she reads a notification in a newspaper of an aged Captain Anand (Alok Nath) asking his love Urmi to meet him just once before dying. The ad raises Rashmi's curiosity and she goes to meet Anand, where he narrates about his love, Urmi. Anand and Urmi had loved each other very much. However, one day when Anand goes to meet Urmi, her mother tells him that she will marry someone else. But an old Anand still fosters a hope to meet his love just one more time. Will his hope turn into a reality, fifty years later? This episode is produced by Suchitra, Anand and Ravi Raisinghani under Suchitra Home Entertainment.

episodesList.title: Halki si dhoop
episodesList.summary: Mansi and Sandeep have been married for five years but in these years they have fallen apart as Sandeep is totally obsessed with his work and success. Then enters Arvind (Madhavan) in Mansi's life, and an initial attraction blooms into love for Arvind. But what about Mansi? Being married, will she be able to reciprocate? This episode is produced by Rajesh Pradhan, Sanjay Datta, Sujata Sengupta and Madhuri Bajpai under Group 2 Films.

episodesList.title: Kinara
episodesList.summary: Kinara Laxmi (Seema Bhargav) and her husband (Benjamin Gilani) have been looking after Raju from the time she was orphaned as a baby after Benjamin's sister's death. Raju has been left behind a huge inheritance. Now grown up, their son, Venky (Deepraj Rana), wants to pursue an MBA degree from a US university but lacks the funds. His father suggests that despite not loving Raju (Natasha Rana), he should marry her as all her wealth would become his and he could then go to the US. And thus, after getting married, Venky leaves for further studies. Will Venky remain committed to his marriage, once he reaches the US? Or has he just used Raju for his selfish interests? This episode is produced by Manju Asrani and Sushil Bhatnagar under V3tv (Vision 3 Television).

episodesList.title: Pahli Nazar Main
episodesList.summary: Raji is travelling in a bus when Ankit sees her for the first time and falls in love with her instantly. On learning that she is blind, he promises to have her eyesight restored. However, Raji is in love with Nilesh but at his mother's behest, cuts off all ties with her after she turns blind. Is Ankit going to keep his promise and have Raji's eyesight restored? And will Raji eventually reciprocate Ankit's feelings? This episode is produced and directed by Ravi Kemmu under Martand Movies.

episodesList.title: Chupke Chupke
episodesList.summary: Shekhar has left the custody of his three children to their governess, Ms. Komal, who is a very stern lady and an absolute disciplinarian. Their neighbour, Rohini (Rohini Hattangadi) tries to befriend the children but is turned away by both Shekhar and Ms. Komal. With her friend, Madhuri's help, Rohini plans a way to get both Shekhar and Ms. Komal out of the way so that she can be friends with the children. But for how long with this charade last? This episode is produced by Saurabh Sengupta and Sanjay Chandna under Puji Zubi Combine.

episodesList.title: Mere Apne
episodesList.summary: When Aditya (Raju Kher) declares to his young children that he wants to remarry, they are furious. However, despite their resistance, he goes ahead and marries Shraddha (Mandira Bedi). Shraddha is confident about winning over the children's hearts sooner or later, so she puts up with their tantrums. Aditya is disheartened but Shraddha assures him that all will be well. Will the children ever accept Shraddha, or will they compel her to leave her new home? This episode is produced by Dinesh Bansal under Meteor Films.

episodesList.title: Mujhe Mat Yaad Karna
episodesList.summary: Jai Saxena is a flourishing businessman, and during a company takeover, he meets Sunanda (Kitu Gidwani). Dissatisfied with his wife Savitri (Zarina Wahab) and children, Jai finds himself drawn to Sunanda. Their relationship gradually turns to love. Disgusted at this, Jai's son, Rohit, goes to kill Sunanda, but she explains her side of the story, and he softens his stand towards her. Meanwhile, Jai dies and his brother Hansraj takes over all of Jai's wealth and property. What will happen to Jai's family? Who will come to their rescue now? This episode is produced by Kamlesh Pandey under Roots & Wings.

episodesList.title: Pal Do Pal]
episodesList.summary: After her grandmother, Priya's death, Shweta goes to her room and looks at her mementos, where she sees a letter from Vikram (Pavan Malhotra) on the photograph of a house. An abode called Priyashiana which was Vikram's dream house. Priya, an already married woman when she met Vikram, ends up sharing a special bond with him. A short time shared together but imprinted in their lives forever. Shweta's curiosity gets her to Vikram's Priyashiana. Does Vikram's dream house turn a reality now? This episode is also produced by Group 2 Films.

episodesList.title: Yooheen Kaheen
episodesList.summary: Shalu (Pallavi Joshi) is in desperate need of a job, so she lies about being a nurse to tend to Vikas (Rajesh Khera), a leukaemia patient. But Vikas' pain and agony is beyond Shalu, so she decides to quit her job. However, Vikas convinces her otherwise. Shalu brings sunshine into Vikas's life. But one day in a discothèque, Vikas collapses. Consumed with guilt, she leaves his house. Will Shalu ever be able to forgive herself? Will Vikas survive his illness? This episode is produced by Satyen Kappu under Kappu Arts.

episodesList.title: Karan
episodesList.summary: Thakur (Lalit Parimoo), despite being a married man, is a womaniser and showers his affection on Meenabai, a courtesan and his lover. His wife tries everything to lure her man but of no avail. Karan Singh, the younger brother of Thakur's friend gets employed in the mansion as a helper. Feelings of sympathy for Thakur's wife turn to love but she has her eyes only for Thakur. To keep her happy, Karan tries his best to convince Thakur not to go to Meenabai. Will he eventually succeed, or will things take a turn for the worse? This episode is also produced by Meteor Films.

episodesList.title: Ajnabee
episodesList.summary: Aman (Rohit Roy) is an artist by profession. One day, while painting, Nidhi (Achint Kaur) catches his eye and he makes many sketches of her. Nidhi is in the process of getting her divorce, and finds a good friend in Aman. After getting a divorce, Nidhi leaves for the US. Will she return to Aman? This episode is produced by G.D. Arora under G. Arora Films and NAT.

episodesList.title: Hansa
episodesList.summary: Hansa (Sushma Prakash) has been married to Gautam (Denzil Smith) for seven years, and has a son Rahul. Gautam has given her everything, yet she finds something amiss in life. In a chance encounter, she meets Adi (Arjun Raina) and is attracted to him. A question asked by Rahul whether Adi is better than his father, Gautam, leaves Hansa thinking. And only she can answer this question. This episode is produced and directed by Parvati Balagopalan under Parvati Pictures.

episodesList.title: Ae Mote...
episodesList.summary: Sachin Pandey (Saurabh Shukla) is in love with his office receptionist Sandhya but has never been able to muster the courage to express his feelings for her as he is extremely conscious of being overweight. There are times when Sandhya's words and actions make him believe that even she feels strongly about him but he cannot get himself to ask her. Is Sachin going to confess his love for her someday, or will it remain unexpressed? This episode is also produced by Media Square by the Mankad brothers.

episodesList.title: Zindagi
episodesList.summary: Vikram Godbole (Vikram Gokhale) and his wife Leena (Reema Lagoo) are always at loggerheads despite being married for 35 years. Their elder son, Ravi, gets a transfer and moves out of their home with his family because his work place is far away. As the grandchildren need to be looked after, Vikram stays back with their younger son, Kiran and his family, while Leena goes away with Ravi. After initial joy at their new found freedom, Vikram and Leena now yearn for each other. What will they do to rekindle the lost romance? This episode is produced by Rajeev Tandon under RT Entertainment.

episodesList.title: Mehmaan
episodesList.summary: Shankar (Alok Nath) cannot father a child as he is infertile but he never discloses this to his wife Mano. Kishan, a young botanist, comes to their house seeking refuge on a rainy night. But sensing Kishan's goodness, Shankar allows him to stay in his house for as long as he wants. One day, Mano confides to Shankar how devastated she is at being barren. Shankar feels very guilty about this, so what does he do to alleviate this feeling? This episode is also produced by Meteor Films.

episodesList.title: Tumhare liye
episodesList.summary: Captain Rahul Khanna (Harsh Chhaya) is married to Pooja (Irawati), and they now long for a baby. But their fertility report shows that Rahul cannot father a child. However, knowing that Rahul will be devastated with the finding, she puts the blame on herself. A loving husband once, Rahul now distances himself from Pooja. Will Rahul's behaviour put an end to their marriage? This episode is produced by Rajiv Mehta under Final Take Films.

episodesList.title: Gunjan
episodesList.summary: Pandey(Manohar Singh) refuses to accept his daughter Ritu and grandchild Gunjan (Baby Gazala) when they come to live with him after Ritu's husband files for a divorce. He hates Gunjan as she reminds him of Ritu's husband, a man he had always disliked, and whom he cannot forgive for destroying his daughter's life. But will little Gunjan win over his heart with her innocent ways? This episode is produced and directed by Ajay Kartik under Karma Television.

episodesList.title: Do Boondein Chaand ki
episodesList.summary: Deepika (Shilpa Tulaskar) is pregnant with Naveen's (Waqar Shaikh) baby. She is delighted as Naveen simply loves children but their dream is short-lived as Deepika has to have her uterus removed. Looking at Naveen after this always makes Deepika sad, so she decides to go to her father's house for a few days. She learns there that her younger sister Roshni (Gautami Gadgil) is pregnant. How does Deepika react to this? Will Deepika and Naveen come close again? This episode is produced by Adib Contructor and Tarun Chopra under Picasso.

episodesList.title: Likhe Jo Khat Tujhe]
episodesList.summary: Raju (Nasirr Khan) has no time for love as he is too engrossed in his studies. But one look at Parul (Mouli Ganguly) changes all the rules for him as he falls head over heels in love with her. However, he lacks the courage to confess his feelings to her. To his rescue comes his author friend, Som, who advises him to write letters to her, and agrees to be the mediator between them. Is Raju going to win over Parul's heart, or does Som have some other plan? This episode is also produced by Martand Movies.

episodesList.title: Bandhan Kachhey Dhaagon Ka
episodesList.summary: Amar and Prem (Amita Behl and Ravi Gosain, respectively) are two childhood friends who find odd jobs to do to survive. On the other hand, Dayashankar (Pankaj Dheer) uses his younger sister, Munni (Bhairavi Raichura), to get money for him. Daani Seth (Paintal) is a money lender whom Amar, Prem and Munni go to when in need. One day, Dayashankar comes and takes away all the money which Munni has made in her business. How is she going to repay Daani Seth now? Will Amar and Prem come to her rescue? This episode is produced by Amitabh and Rahul Sinha under Vision Channel India.

episodesList.title: Nai Buniyad
episodesList.summary: Tripathi (Naveen Nischol) is born during India's independence struggle, and is an extremely righteous man. And these principles become the root cause of all fights at home between him and his two sons. Eventually, his elder son's alcohol addiction compels him to apply for a government house using deceitful means as both the sons need money. But guilt overwhelms him. Is Tripathi going to be able to put with this guilt for the rest of his life? This episode is also produced by Ajay Kartik's Karma Television.

episodesList.title: Aur Aasman Jhuk Gaya
episodesList.summary: Nisha (Anchit Kaur) and Rahul have a baby girl named Pinky. As they are a working couple, they have a maid to look after her. But one day when Pinky falls ill, Nisha refuses to come home as she has an important party to attend. Furious with her callous attitude, Rahul slaps Nisha. She cannot forgive him for this and they get divorced. Pinky is now in the care of Asha, a neighbour of Rahul's parents. Rahul and Asha marry. But years later, Nisha decides to fight for Pinky's custody in court. Will the verdict go in her favour? This episode is produced in-house by Zee TV itself.

episodesList.title: Uphaar
episodesList.summary: Ridhi has been blind from six months, and Gitika is her best friend. Always together, Gitika asks Ridhi what she wants as a birthday gift, and she says she would like to have eyes. Gitika is adamant about getting Ridhi's gift for her. Will she be able to do so? Will Ridhi be able to see the world? This episode is produced by Karuna Samtani under Pratham Media Entertainment.

episodesList.title: Ek Anokha Rishta
episodesList.summary: Vikas sees a winner in Deepak, Vishaka's son, and coaches him to be a table tennis champion. Initially, Vishika is reluctant to let Deepak play as she had lost her husband, yet another sports lover, but after Vikas's persistence, she relents. Vikas begins grooming Deepak, and the big day arrives. Will Vikas be able to realise his dream through Deepak? This episode is produced by Kapil Kumar under Imaginatio.

episodesList.title: Ek Nishwas
episodesList.summary: Shahji (Benjamin Gilani) is married to (Shahiji) Neena Gupta but she has not been able to bear any children. Desperate to give her husband an heir, Shahiji gets him married to Choti (Gautami Gadgil), so that she can bear him a son and his family name will carried down to the next generation. Is this gamble going to pay for Shahiji? This episode is also produced by Manju Asrani and Sushil Bhatnagar's India Vision International (IVI), the V3tv's sister company.

episodesList.title: Tu hi Tu
episodesList.summary: Vicky is an architect and loves flirting with all the girls, including Sapna, who works with him and loves him. But he falls madly in love with Anamika, a girl he sees in a restaurant. Is he going to muster the courage to confess his feelings for her? Or is a surprise in store for him? This episode is produced and directed by Girish Malik under Clap-Stem.

episodesList.title: Chaaya
episodesList.summary: Jona (Sulabha Desphande) is the caretaker of her relative John's bungalow. John lives in Canada with his wife and has promised Jona that he will take her back with him. Jona has two paying guests, Rohit and Vijay, living with her but they are forced to vacate the house once John arrives as he wants to sell the house to a builder. But what about Jona? Will John take her back to Canada or will she be left all alone to fend for herself? This episode is produced by Aditya Bhamra's Wild & Wacky Entertainment and Shyam Jeet Gupta's Vijayshyam Inc.

episodesList.title: Suhaagan
episodesList.summary: Gangaprasad worships his father, Shivnath (Satyen Kappu) and marries Laxmi, only on one condition that she stays with his father and tends to him well after marriage. Ganga leaves for the city for work but keeps visiting his wife and father often. On one occasion when Laxmi also accompanies him to the city, fate plays an evil trick. What happens to Ganga and Laxmi? This episode is also produced by Meteor Films.

episodesList.title: Mr & Mrs... "Divorce
episodesList.summary: Vinod Verma and Revathy (Renuka Shahane) have been happily married but gradually, they start fighting. One day, Revathy walks out of the house in a huff. They file for a divorce and the court gives them a separation period of one year to reconcile their differences. Revathy gets a job as a secretary of Vinod's client. Professional circumstances throw them together this time. Are Vinod and Revathy going to give their marriage a second chance? This episode is also produced by Saurabh Sengupta and Sanjay Chandna's Puji Zubi Combine.

episodesList.title: Aarambh
episodesList.summary: Ravi Mahajan (Jayant Kriplani) and Anita (Divya Seth) get a surprise when all of a sudden, Sonia (Rajeshwari Sachdev) turns up at their doorstep. Sonia is Ravi's daughter from his first marriage and has come to him as her mother is dead and she has no money. Bitterness rents the air between Ravi and Sonia. Are the father-daughter ever going to reconcile their differences? This episode is produced by Rajit Kapur and Deep Dudani under Saaransh.

episodesList.title: Taqraar
episodesList.summary: Seema (Shefali Chaya) and Abhinav (Parmeet Sethi) meet in the most unpleasant circumstance. However, Abhinav, prodded by his little daughter, Kajol, asks him to call Seema and apologise for his behaviour. But Seema is not willing to forgive him. Eventually, she realises that Abhinav is genuine and peace prevails between them. Soon, Kajol and Seema's son Mukund become thick friends. Abhinav asks Seema to be with him forever. Will she accept his proposal, or will her past wounds stop her from doing so? This episode is produced and directed by Vinta Nanda and Raman Kumar under Tracinema.

episodesList.title: Aagosh
episodesList.summary: Amar is a very successful author who writes about prisoners facing death penalty. The thirst for fame and success even makes him distort stories. All this changes when he meets Pareen (Renuka Shahane) who has been sentenced to death for killing her mother. He tries to gather all the information from her for his book but she remains silent initially. Gradually, the ice is broken and love blossoms between them. Pareen finally confesses that she killed her mother to set her free from her evil father's constant misdeeds. Will Amar be able to seek pardon for Pareen now? This episode is produced by Lalit Modi under Modi Entertainment, later renamed Modi Entertainment Network (MEN).

episodesList.title: Yoon Hee Chhoo Liya
episodesList.summary: Parul (Grusha Kapoor) is a prostitute and operates at night from a flat opposite KP's (Mahesh Thakur) flat. Being a righteous man, KP complains about her activity to the building secretary and she is thrown out. Furious, she stays back in KP's flat and refuses to leave till he arranges for another flat for her. Deriving inspiration from this anecdote, KP writes an article for his magazine along the same lines and turns it into a love story. But will love story bloom even in reality? This episode is produced by Seema Kapoor's S.K. Media.

episodesList.title: Ankur
episodesList.summary: Anu (Divya Seth) and Rishabh (Jayant Kriplani) are having an affair, and though he wants to marry her, she refuses because of her earlier bad marriage. A street urchin named Ghanti who sells flowers catches her attention. He begins to run small errands for the money she gives him. After frequent interaction with Ghanti, Anu realises that she needs to change her perspective and priorities in life. Is she going to give Ghanti a better life? This episode is also produced by Rajit Kapur and Deep Dudani's Saaransh

episodesList.title: Dashrath ka Vanwaas
episodesList.summary: Babun (Anup Soni) always longed for the love of his father Suraj (Mohan Joshi) but Suraj only inflicted miseries on him. Fed up with his father's atrocities, Babun goes to live with his paternal uncle, Ishwar (Benjamin Gilani). Suraj is now old and ailing. Ishwar keeps pleading Babun to go and meet his father just once. However, painful memories of his childhood keep haunting Babun and he never relents. Even his wife Sudha (Gautami Gadgil) is not able to convince him. One day, Ishwar phones Babun to inform him that his father has had a heart attack. Will Babun have a change of heart at least now? Will he be willing to forgive and forget? This episode is also produced by Manju Asrani and Sushil Bhatnagar's V3tv

episodesList.title: Anjali
episodesList.summary: Anjali (Urvashi Dholakia) works in a discothèque as a singer and looks after her parents and younger brother. Gautam, who is a drummer in the same place, loves her but she loves Michael. Like her parents, even Michael uses her for her money. One day, she finds out that Michael is already a married man with a child. The betrayal shatters her completely. What devastates her further is that her father was aware of it. Is this the end of all her dreams? Will she ever find a man who will love her? This episode is also produced by Karma Television.

episodesList.title: Maa
episodesList.summary: Mother (Sulbha Deshpande) has never come to terms with life even 4 years after seeing her son, Kundan, die in her arms. Kundan was shot dead by the dreaded terrorist Rashid Gul (Aditya Srivastav) because he was going to inform the police about Rashid. Mother watches a news flash that Rashid has escaped from prison and is on the run. She recognises Rashid as her son's killer and is shocked to see him seeking refuge in her own house. Threatened at gunpoint by him, mother has no choice but to lie when the police come to her house asking for him. Rashid suffers from malaria and mother and her daughter, Usha, tend to him day and night. Mother cannot get herself to hate the man who killed her son, and soon, there emerges a mother-son bond between Rashid and her. Mother asks Rashid to surrender to the police so that he stops leading the life of a fugitive. Will Rashid heed her or will he escape? This episode is also produced by Meteor Films.

episodesList.title: Prayischit
episodesList.summary: Rahul is a struggling actor and in a party, he meets Divya Dalal (Moon Moon Sen), a very influential elder lady. An intimate bond develops between them, and Divya manages to get Rahul a much needed break as a film actor. While he shoots, he meets a journalist, Sapna, and they fall in love. Rahul returns to confess to Divya that there is another woman in his life. When he shows her Sapna s photograph, Divya is terribly shocked. Who is Sapna, and what is her relationship with Divya? This episode is produced by Anu and Shashi Ranjan under Anushka Images.

episodesList.title: Iss Saal...
episodesList.summary: Edward (Saurabh Shukla) has just lost his wife Margaret and is very lonely before Christmas. He had lost his son, Peter earlier, and his daughter Barbara lives out of the country with her family. Deciding not to be alone, he gets two orphaned siblings, Cynthia and Steven home to celebrate Christmas. But having been abandoned at such a young age, Cynthia has turned into a very difficult child. All Edward wants to do is love the children, but will they reciprocate his feelings? Will Edward also get a Christmas gift which he so much desires? This episode is produced by Kiran Bhatia's Flying Colors.

episodesList.title: Saal Mubarak
episodesList.summary: Both Joy and Jyoti (Sangeeta Ghosh) are engaged to their respective partners, but a meeting at a discothèque on New Year s changes the equation. Joy falls in love with Jyoti, and after much wooing and persistence, both of them break their engagement. But fate plays a cruel joke on them and there is no sign of Joy as he disappears. Will Jyoti and Joy ever reunite?. This episode is produced by Manish R Goswami's Siddhant Cinevision

episodesList.title: Dil Se... Lekin?
episodesList.summary: Neena (Divya Dutta) and Prem love each other and plan to marry. Neena learns that she is pregnant. Thrilled at the news, Prem promises to talk about their marriage with his father. But on his way home, he meets with an accident and dies. Fear of getting scorned by society for getting pregnant out of wedlock, Neena's family friends advise her to marry Sachin. She eventually relents. But will Neena be able carry this burden of lying to Sachin, for long? This episode is also produced in-house by Zee TV.

episodesList.title: Mujrim
episodesList.summary: Inspector Vivek Gupta (Vikram Gokhale) working with the Police Force is a man of high scruples. A year away from retirement, he is given orders by his senior to arrest the murderer, Neelkant Sawant, who has been absconding for 6 months after murdering the renowned but amoral businessman Laxmanrai. Gupta reaches Neelkant s village and arrests him. While waiting for their train, Neelkant tells him he does not regret murdering Laxmanrai as he had killed many labourers by exploiting them. Even Gupta fosters feelings of hatred for Laxmanrai because his younger brother and nephew had lost their lives due to Laxmanrai s atrocities. Realising that Neelkant is indeed a good man otherwise, he asks him to escape and start life afresh. Will Neelkant heed him? What about Inspector Gupta s famed principles? This episode is also produced by Meteor Films.

episodesList.title: Saughaat
episodesList.summary: For Eijaz, it was love at first sight. He gets totally smitten by Sabiah when he sees her for the first time at a jeweller shop. And when he learns that he has got a marriage proposal for a girl named Salma from the same home where Sabiah lives in, he readily agrees thinking the girl is Sabiah. Sabiah decides to play a prank on him and impersonates herself as her friend Salma. What will happen once the truth is out? Will Ehjaz agree to marry Salma, or will it be only Sabiah for him? And what about Sabiah? Will she betray her close friend Salma? This episode is also produced by Adib Contructor and Tarun Chopra's Picasso

episodesList.title: Itni Choti Baat, Itni Lambi Raat
episodesList.summary: Two little children, Atul and Gudiya, are unable to figure out what s wrong with elders and why they are constantly fighting. Fed up with their parents perpetual bickering, they decide to run away from home. With their pocket money, they roam all around and find adults fighting everywhere. They vow that when they grow up, they will never fight. Finally they settle for the night in a jungle. Their parents worried sick, come to the jungle in search of them. Are they able to trace their children? Will the children return to their parents? This episode is also produced by Girish Malik's Clap-Stem.

episodesList.title: Shyamli
episodesList.summary: Shyamli (Pallavi Joshi), a journalist, has always been scorned at because of her dark complexion. Her sister Gauri is fair, so her father (Benjamin Gilani) and she mock at Shyamli's skin colour all the time. However, for Satyen, who is a photographer in the same organisation, Shyamli is the most beautiful woman. She is working on an article about how the world loves only good looking people. As always, Satyen promises to assist her in her work but on one condition that she agrees to marry him once it is over. Meanwhile, even Gauri has her eyes on Satyen and forces him to have a photo shoot with her. She even manages to simultaneously charm Satyen's mother and marry him. Shyamli's father is furious with Gauri and when he's about to blurt the truth to Gauri, Shyamli stops him. What is this truth about Gauri which Shymali does not want her to know? This episode is produced by Asha Parekh under Akruti.

episodesList.title: Ishq Hua! Kaise Hua!
episodesList.summary: A chain of love story about eight people. But not a single person's feeling is reciprocated. A comedy of errors. It begins with Shweta who loves Tarun (Rajiv Paul), who has eyes only for Pammi. Pammi, in turn, is totally smitten by Akshay who has lost his heart to Seema. Seema has a dog Kukku who is madly in love with Pishti, a female dog owned by Mr. Pitawala. Pitawala simply can not get enough of Saroj, a middle-aged divorcée. But Saroj is totally infatuated by Anshu, a boy half her age. And completing this circle of love is Anshu who is in love with Shweta. A music band formed by Anshu, Shweta and Akshay celebrate their launch party on Valentine's Day. Is this going to be the day when feelings of love will be expressed? This episode is produced by Kashmira and Vidyadhar Pathare under Iris Productions.

episodesList.title: Wapsi
episodesList.summary: Both Sujata and her husband Ashish decide that he should go to the US for research for a year or so. And thus begins a never ending, long wait for Sujata. Gripped with feelings of dejection, she finds a caring friend in her neighbour Sandeep (Harsh Chaya). One day when she returns home, she finds Ashish there. Her happiness knows no bounds. But she soon realises that Ashish is a changed man now, with him having no time for her, and everything revolving only around his work. What is Sujata going to do now? Is their marriage going to survive this change of equation? This episode is also produced by Picasso.

episodesList.title: Rang di Chunaria
episodesList.summary: Priyakant (Madhavan) is a happy-go-lucky guy and comes to visit his friend s wife (Jaya Bhattacharya) along with his friend on the occasion of Holi, the festival of colours. One look at Kusum (Gracy Singh), and Priyakant is totally smitten. However, he is blissfully unaware that Kusum is a child widow, and pours coloured water on her on Holi. Kusum s family is shocked at this behaviour, and that s when he is told that Kusum is a widow. Will Priyakant stop loving Kusum now? This episode is also produced by V3tv.

episodesList.title: Ek Din...
episodesList.summary: After 20 years of being a housewife, of Vishal (Mehul Buch). Priya (Divya Seth) takes up a career as a fashion designer, where she meets her boss Ritu (Shefali Chaya). The two instantly take a liking towards each other and become best of buddies in a matter of just a few hours. On a professional overnight trip together, they end up talking about their personal lives. Priya learns that Ritu is having an affair with a married man. She urges Ritu to ask him to either leave his wife, or else she will end the relationship. Just then, he phones Ritu. However, she cannot get herself to say so, and she gives the phone to Priya. But Priya s world gets shattered when she hears the voice of the man at the other end of the phone. Who is this man? This episode is produced by Manjul Sinha's Fantasia.

episodesList.title: Cross connection
episodesList.summary: Vishaka (Sonali Kulkarni) is an aggressive girl, while her good friend Smita is timid. Whenever Smita is in trouble, Vishaka helps her out. Once, while they are talking over the phone, they get a cross connection where Anand (Akshay Anand) also starts talking to them. Something makes Smita divulge Vishaka s phone number to him. Thus begin regular telephonic conversations between Vishaka and Anand, and one day they agree to meet. As she is nervous, Vishaka asks Smita to impersonate her, and Anand asks Uday (Anup Soni) to do the same for him. Uday and Smita vibe well instantly. But how are Vishaka and Anand going to react when they realise that their friend is in love with the person they were interested in? This episode is also produced by Saaransh

episodesList.title: My Hero
episodesList.summary: Rahul is the son of estranged couple, Mohini and Dilip, and because of this, he ends up dividing his time between both his parents. Mohini always makes deriding comments about what a failure Dilip is, but for Rahul, his father is his super hero. For the first time, Rahul asks for an expensive music system for his birthday from his father. Rahul being a terminally ill cancer patient, Dilip does not want to disappoint him although he knows that arranging for such a big amount of money will be tough. Is the father going to be able to fulfil his dying son's last wish? This episode is also produced by Karma Television.

episodesList.title: Rang
episodesList.summary: Rahul has been born blind and because of this handicap, his mother, Mrs. Singh (Surekha Sikri) has sheltered him from the world. And to such an extent that he has not been allowed to make any friends. His only friend is his mother. But this changes when Bindiya becomes his new neighbour. They become good friends, and when Bindiya hears him sing, she takes him to a music company. She urges him to have a career of his own, to befriend people, to be independent. Although Bindiya has the noblest intentions, Mrs. Singh is furious with her and asks her not to show Rahul false dreams. Is Rahul ever going to get a chance to live life as per his wish? This episode is produced by Vivek Bahl's White Cloud.

episodesList.title: Tanha-Tanha
episodesList.summary: Samir (Akshay Anand) loves Suman but has never been able to muster the courage to confess his feelings to her. And then it gets too late as Rohit (Aman Verma) announces in college one day that Suman and he are getting married. Years later, Suman and Samir meet again. She tells him that her marriage to Rohit was a disaster and then asks him to marry her. It's a long cherished dream come true for Samir. However, his dream crashes as he finds her gone away for good. Why did Suman come into Samir's life again and why did she go away so suddenly? This episode is produced by Surinder Kaur's Shivranjani Kala Sangam.

episodesList.title: Mere Saath Chalogi...
episodesList.summary: Considering her aged mother Sylvia (Shefali Chaya) to be a burden, her daughter, Sandy, puts her in a Home for the Aged, promising to take her to Australia a few months later. Sylvia cannot wait to get out of the home and eagerly awaits her daughter s letter. However, Sandy finally writes that it ll be tough for her to take Sylvia to Australia. On the other hand, is Avinash (Annu Kapoor) who has lost his best friend Prabhakar. Devastated, Avinash plans to slit his wrist and kill himself. At the same time, Sylvia also plans to commit suicide by consuming sleeping tablets. Is it the end of the road for Avinash and Sylvia, or does fate have some other plans for them? This episode is also produced by Fantasia.

episodesList.title: Vasundhara
episodesList.summary: Inder s mother gets him married to a village belle Vasundhara. Vasundhara wonders why her husband sleeps in a different room, so she tries hard to entice him but of no avail. She asks his mother what s wrong, and she says that Inder is impotent and that she got him married only to avoid societal scorn. Feeling like an incomplete woman, the man of Vasundhara s affection soon turns out to be the family driver, Kailash (Ravi Gosain). Inder and his mother plan to get Vasundhara pregnant through artificial insemination but she announces that she is already carrying Kailash s child. Will Inder and his mother accept her baby? Or will Vasundhara leave them and go away with Kailash? This episode is also produced by Karma Television.

episodesList.title: Highway
episodesList.summary: Veera and her fiancé, Vinay, go for a drive and park on a highway when they are accosted by thugs. They kidnap Veera. Vijay (Aditya Srivastava), the head of the group plans to sell Veera but the plan is put on hold as he learns that her fiancé's father is a police commissioner.
